'dulab/ spyodartsi (4)0001 'dul ba gzhi/ dmang pos bkur ba la sogs pa'i sde tshan/(smad) na'akhor gyi sde tshan/ 82kauṇ+ḍi nu'i sde tshan/ 262rdzu 'phrul gyi sde tshan/ 275kau shi skru'i sde tshan/ 421ngang pa'i sde tshan/ 577mnar med kyi sde tshan/ 615kha che'i mkhan po sarba tsā de ba dang / rgya gar gyi mkhan po bca ka ra pra bha dang / kha che'i mkhan po dharmā ka ra dang / lots+tsha ba bad de dpal gyi kun pos bsgyur cing /rgya gar gyi mkhan po bca ka ra pra bha dang /zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de dpal brtsegs 1
(719) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(841)

༄༅༅/ /'dul ba gzhi/ bam po brgyad bcu zugasum pa/ gzigs nas kyang kha lo sgyur ba la gsungs pa/ kha lo sgyur ba mi skya bo rbab rbab po rid pa nyam zhuchung ba dbang po nyams pa/ skye bo mang po'i mig gis kyang lta ④mi phod pa 'di ci yin/ lha 'di ni bro 'tshal ba ༅zhes bgyi'o/ /kha lo sgyur ba nad kyis thebs pa zhes bya ba 'di ci yin/ lha mi 'di gang 'dis 'gum par 'gyur ba'i gnas de mchis te/ lha 'di ni bros thebs pa zhes bgyi'o/ /kha lo sgyur ba nga yang nad kyi chos dang nad kyi chos nyid las ma 'das sam/ lha yang snyun gyi chos dang snyun gyi chos nyid las ma 'das so/ /kha lo sgyur ba de'i phyir shing rta phyir sgyur cig pho brang nyid du 'dong ngo / /'di ltar nga pho brang nyid ༅du phyin nas nga nad las ma 'das zhes grags ⑦pa'i don de nyid bsam par bya'o/ /kha lo sgyur bas shing rta phyir bsgyur srinas pho brang nyid du chas te/ der byang chub sems 4—3

dpa' shākya thub pa pho brang gi nang du gshegs nas bdag kyang nad las ma 'das pa lta zhig ces ①mi dgyes shing thugs ngan dgongs so/ /'dir smras pa/ mi ni lus rid skya ②bo rbab rbab po/ /rang dbang med pa'i nad thebs 'dir gzigs nas/ /nad las bdag ma 'das pa lta zhig ces/ /de nas mi dgyes thugs ngan dgongs par mdzad/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang gis kha lo sgyur ba la smras pa/ kha lo sgyur ba ci gzhon nu yid dga' ba dang mgu bas skyed mos ⑧tshal gyi gzhir byung ngam/ skyed ④mos tshal la mngon par dga' bar gyur tam/lha ma lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ lha gzhon nu skyed mos tshal gyi gzhir byung ba na mi skya bo rbab rbab po rid pa/ nyam chung ba/ dbang po nyams pa/skye bo mang po'i mig gis lta ⑤mi phod pa zhig gzigs so/ /gzigs nas kyang bdag la bka' stsal pa/ kha lo sgyur ba mi skya bo rbab rbab po rid pa/ nyam chung ba/ dbang po nyams pa/ skye bo mang po'i mig gis lta ⑥mi phod pa 'di ⑦ci yin / de la bdag gis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /lha 'di ni bros thebs pa zhes bgyi'o/ /de 'di ②skad ces gsungs te/ kha lo sgyur ba nad kyis thebs pa zhes bya ba 'di ci yin/ de la bdag gis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /mi 'di gang gnod pa 'dis 'gum par 'gyur ba'i gnas de mchis te/ lha de ni bros thebs pa zhes bgyi'o/ /de 'di skad ces gsungs te/༅ kha lo sgyur ba nga yang nad kyi chos dang nad kyi chos nyid las ma 'das sam/ de la bdag gis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /lha yang snyun gyi chos dang snyun gyi chos nyid las ma 'das so/ /de 'di tshuskad ces gsungs te⑩/ kha lo sgyur ba de'i phyir shing rta phyir sgyur ④cig pho brang nyid du 'dong ngo / /'di ltar nga pho brang nyid du phyin 4—4

nas nga nad las ma 'das zhes grags ①pa'i don de nyid bsam par bya'o/ /lha gzhon nu de pho brang gi nang du gshegs nas nga yang nad las ma 'das pa lta zhig ces mi dgyes shing thugs ngan dgongs so/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang 'di snyam du sems te/ mtshan mkhan dang ltas mkhan gyi bram ze de rnams kyi tshig yang dag par bden par mi 'gyur grang / gzhon nu skra dang kha spu bregs te/gos ngur smrig bgos nas dad pa yang dag pa kho nas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu 'byung ②bar 'gyur du 'ong gis/ ma la bdag gis gzhon nu la 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga las phal mo che zhig byin la ci nas kyang 'di la dga' zhing rab tu 'byung bar mi 'gyur bar bya'o dusnyam mo/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang gis byang chub sems dpa' shākya thub pa la 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga ④las phal mo che zhig byin te ci nas kyang 'di la dga' zhing rab tu 'byung bar mi 'gyur bar byas so/ /'dir smras pa/ de 5tshe dga' nas bdag 'dor mi gzhug phyir/ /gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang ro rnams dang / /reg bya yid du 'ong ba gtso rnams kyi/ /'dod pa'i ༅yon tan lnga po yang byin no//chos nyid kyis byang chub sems dpa' rtsoskyed mos tshal gyi gzhir gshegs par dubazhed par gyur pa ⑨de'i tshe kha lo sgyur ba la/ kye kha lo sgyur ba re zhig nyu )bzhon pa bzang po myur du shoms shig dang / der nga zhugs nas skyed mos tshal gyi gzhir 'gro'o zhes gsung bar 'gyur bas de nas byang chub sems dpas kha lo sgyur ba la gsungs pa/ kye kha lo sgyur ba re zhig bzhon 0pa bzang po myur du shoms shig /der nga zhugs nas skyed mos tshal gyi gzhir 'gro'o/ /lha bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes kha lo sgyur bas byang chub sems dpa' shākya thub pa'i ltar 4—5

mnyan nas bzhon ①pa bzang po bshams te byang chub sems dpa' shākya thub pa gang na ba der song nas phyin pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' shākya thub pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /lha bcibs pa bzang po bshams lags kyis/ lha da de'i dus la bab par dgongs su gsol/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' shākya thub pa bzhon ②pa bzang por zhugs te skyed mos tshal gyi gzhir ①byung ba dang /byang chub sems dpa' shākya thub pas ras kha dog sna tshogs las byas pa'i bla re bres pa dang / khyogs khyer ba dang / mdun na me sgron thogs pa dang / skye bo'i tshogs chen po mdun nas 'gro ba dang / bud med skra bshig pa rnams ngu zhing rjes bzhin ④⑤'brang ba zhig gzigs so/ /gzigs nas kyang kha lo sgyur ba la gsungs pa/ kha lo sgyur ba ras kha dog sna tshogs las byas pa'i bla re bres pa dang / khyogs khyer ba dang / mdun na me sgron thogs pa dang / skye bo'i tshogs chen po mdun nas 'gro ba dang / bud med skra bshig pa rnams ngu zhing rjes bzhin ༅du 'brang ba 'di ci yin/ lha 'di ni gum pa zhes bgyi'o/ /kha lo sgyur ba shi ba zhes bya ba 'di ci yin/ lha mi 'dis slan chad sdug pa'i pha ma mi ⑦mthong zhing bu pho dang / bu mo dang / bran pho dang / bran mo dang / las bgyid ⑧pa dang / zho shas 'tsho ba'i mi rnams kyang ma lags la/ de dag gis kyang slan chad 'di mi mthong bas lha 'di ni gum pa zhes bgyi'o/ /kha lo sgyur ba nga yang 'chi ba'i chos dang 'chi ba'i chos nyid las ma 'das sam/ lha yang 'chi ba'i chos dang 'chi ba'i chos nyid las ma 'das so/ /kha lo sgyur ba de'i phyir shing rta phyir sgyur 0cig pho brang tshunyid du 'dong ngo / /'di ltar nga 0pho brang nyid du phyin nas nga 'chi ba las ma 'das zhes grags pa'i 'don de 0nyid bsam 4—6

par bya'o/ /kha lo sgyur bas shing rta phyir bsgyur ①nas pho brang nyid du chas te/der byang chub sems dpa' shākya thub pa pho brang gi nang du gshegs nas bdag kyang 'chi ba las ma 'das pa lta zhig ces mi dgyes shing thugs ngan dgongs so/ /'dir smras pa/ tshe zad pa yis 'du shes bral ⑤gyur cing / /sems med mi yi ro zhig gzigs nas ni/ /'chi las bdag ma 'das pa lta zhig ces/ /de nas mi dgyes thugs ngan dgongs par lamadzad/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang gis kha lo sgyur ba la smras pa/ kha lo sgyur ba ci gzhon nu yid dga' ba dang mgu bas ⑤skyed mos tshal gyi gzhir byung ngam/ skyed mos tshal la mngon par dga' bar gyur tam/ lha ma lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ lha gzhon nu skyed mos tshal gyi gzhir byung ba na ras kha dog sna tshogs las bgyis pa'i bla re bres pa dang / khyogs khyer ba dang / mdun na me sgron thogs pa dang / skye bo'i tshogs chen po mdun nas mchi ba dang / bud med skra bshig pa rnams ngu zhing rjes bzhin rjes bzhin du 'brang ba zhig gzigs so/ /gzigs nas kyang /dag la gsungs pa/ kha lo sgyur ba ras kha dog sna tshogs las byas pa'i bla re bres pa dang / khyogs khyer ⑤ba dang / mdun na me sgron thogs pa dang / skye bo'i tshogs chen po mdun nas 'gro ba dang / bud med skra bshig pa rnams ngu zhing rjes bzhin rjes bzhin du 'brang ba 'di ci yin/ de la bdag gis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /lha 'di ni gum pa zhes bgyi'o/ /des ⑥'di skad ces gsungs te/ kha lo sgyur ba shi ba zhes bya ba 'di ci yin/ de la bdag gis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /lha mi 'dis slan chad sdug pa'i pha ma mi mthong zhing /bu pho dang / bu mo dang / bran pho dang / bran mo dang / las bgyid pa 1—7

dang / zho shas 'tsho ba rnams kyang ma lags la/ de rnams kyis kyang slan chad 'di mi mthong bas lha 'di ni gum pa zhes bgyi'o/ /de 'di skad ces gsungs te/kha lo sgyur ba nga yang 'chi ba'i chos dang 'chi ba'i chos nyid las ma 'das sam/de la bdag gis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /lha yang 'chi ba'i chos dang 'chi ba'i chos ①nyid las ma 'das so/ /des 'di skad ces gsungs te/ kha lo sgyur ba de'i phyir shing rta ②phyir sgyur ③cig pho brang nyid du 'dong ngo / /'di ltar nga pho brang du phyin nas 'chi ba las thum 'das zhes grags ⑤pa'i don de nyid bsam par bya'o/ /lha gzhon nu de pho brang gi nang du gshegs te bdag kyang 'chi ba las ma 'das pa lta zhig ces mi dgyes ⑥shing thugs ngan dgongs so/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang 'di snyam du sems te/ mtshan mkhan dang ltas mkhan gyi bram ze de rnams kyi tshig yang dag par bden par mi 'gyur grang / gzhon nu skra dang kha spu bregs te gos ⑦dur smrig bgos blunas dad pa yang dag pa kho nas khyim nas 0khyim med par rab tu 'byung bar 'gyur du 'ong gis/ ma la bdag gis gzhon nu la 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga las phal mo che zhig byin la ci nas kyang 'di la dga' zhing rab tu 'byung bar mi 'gyur bar bya'o snyam mo/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang gis byang chub sems dpa' shākya thub pa la 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga las phal mo che zhig byin nas ci nas kyang 'di la dga' zhing rab tu 'byung tshubar mi 'gyur bar byas so/ /'dir smras pa/ grong khyer dam pa dpal ldan yid 'ong der/ /lha yi lhar gyur sgron ma dang mtshungs pa/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga pos kun dgyes pa/ /mig stong dga' ba'i tshal na gnas pa bzhin/ /de nas gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha rnams 'di snyam du sems te/ byang chub 4wa 8

sems dpa' rnams ni rgyu'i stobs can yin mod kyi 'on kyang rkyen bsgrub par bya dgos te/ 'di ltar ①rgyu'i stobs chen po yang rkyen gyi stobs la ltos so snyam nas de rnams kyis ②mi skra bregs shing gos ngur smrig gyon pa lag pa na lhung bzed thogs pa zhig khyim nas khyim dang khang pa nas khang par rgyu zhing 'gro ba zhig sprul to/ /chos nyid kyis byang chub sems dpa' skyed mos tshal gyi gzhir ②gshegs par bzhed par gyur pa de'i tshe kha lo sgyur ba la kha lo sgyur ba re zhig ④bzhin ⑤pa bzang po myur du shoms shig dang der nga zhugs nas skyed mos tshal gyi gzhir gshegs so zhes gsung bar 'gyur bas/ de nas byang chub sems dpas ⑥kha lo sgyur ba la gsungs pa/ kha lo sgyur ba re zhig bzhon ⑦pa bzang po myur du shoms shig /der nga zhugs nas skyed mos tshal gyi gzhir ⑧gshegs so/ /lha bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes kha lo sgyur bas byang chub sems dpa' shākya thub pa'i ltar mnyan nas bzhon ⑨pa bzang po bshams nas byang chub sems dpa' shākya thub pa gang na ba der song nas phyin pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' shākya thub pa la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /lha bcibs pa bzang po bshams lags kyis/lha da de'i dus la bab par dgongs su gsol/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' shākya thub pa bzhin ⑩pa bzang por zhugs nas skyed mos tshal gyi gzhir byung ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' shākya thub pas mi skra bregs shing gos ngur smrig gyon pa lag pa na lhung bzed thogs pa zhig khyim nas khyim dang / khang pa nas khang par rgyu zhing 'gro ba zhig gzigs so/ /gzigs nas kyang kha lo sgyur ba la gsungs pa/ kha lo sgyur ba mi skra bregs shing lag yin lhung bzed thogs nas khyim nas khyim dang / khang pa nas khang par 8rgyu zhing 'gro la 'di'i gos kyang kha 1—9

dog mi mtshungs te/ ji ltar yang mi gzhan dag gi dang mi 'dra ba 'di ci yin/lha de ni rab tu byung ba zhes bgyi'o/ /kha lo sgyur ba rab tu byung ba zhes bya ba 'di ci yin/ lha ①rab tu byung ba de ni dul ba legs pa dang / yang dag par sdom pa legs pa dang / don spyod pa legs pa dang / chos spyod pa legs pa dang / dge ba spyod pa legs pa dang / dge legs spyod pa legs par rig ②nas skra dang kha spu bregs te/ gos ngur smrig bgos nas dad pa yang dag pa kho nas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ba ③ste/ ④lha 'di ni rab tu byung ba zhes bgyi'o/ /kha lo sgyur ⑤ba de'i phyir shing rta 'di rab du byung ba gang na ba de ༅logs su sgyur ⑦cig /lha bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes kha lo sgyur bas byang chub sems dpa' shākya thub pa'i ltar mnyan nas shing rta de rab tu byung ba gang na ba der bsgyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' shākya thub pas rab tu byung ba de la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /kye mi ⑧khyod ci'i phyir skra bregs shing lag pa na lhung bzed thogs nas khyim nas khyim dang / khang pa nas khang par rgyu zhing 'gro la khyod kyi 0gos kyang kha dog mi mtshungs te/ ci ltar yang ⑩mi gzhan dag gi yidang mi 'dra ba yin/ des 'di skad ces smras so/ /gzhon nu bdag ni rab tu byung ba zhes bgyi'o/ /kye mi ⑫khyod ji ltar na rab tu byung ba zhes bya/ gzhon nu bdag gis dul ba legs pa dang / yang dag par sdom pa legs pa dang / don spyod pa legs pa dang / chos spyod pa legs pa dang /dge ba spyod pa legs pa dang / dge legs spyod pa legs par rig nas skra dang kha spu bregs te gos ngur smrig bgos nas dad pa yang dag pa 'kho nas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ste/ de ltar na bdag rab tu byung ba zhes bya'o/ /4—10

kye mi ①khyod kyis dul ba legs pa dang / yang dag par sdom pa legs pa dang /don spyod pa legs pa dang / chos spyod pa legs pa dang / dge ba spyod pa legs pa dang / dge legs spyod pa legs par rig nas skra dang kha spu bregs te gos ngur smrig bgos nas/ dad pa yang dag pa kho nas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ba legs so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' shākya thub pas kha lo sgyur ba la gsungs pa/ kha lo sgyur ba de'i phyir shing rta phyir sgyur ②cig pho brang nyid du 'dong ngo / /'di ltar nga pho brang du phyin nas don 'di kho na bsam par bya'ol/ /kha lo sgyur bas shing rta phyir bsgyur chanas pho brang nyid du chas te/der pho brang du gshegs pa dang byang chub sems dpa' shākya thub pa kye ma'o bdag ni skra dang kha spu bregs te/ gos ngur smrig bgos ④nas dad pa yang dag pa kho nas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu 'byung ⑤bar bya'o snyam pa'i don de nyid dgongs so/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang gis kha lo sgyur ba la smras pa/ kha lo sgyur ba ci gzhon nu yid dga' ba dang mgu bas skyed mos tshal gyi gzhir byung ngam/skyed mos tshal la ⑥mngon par dga' bar gyur tam/ lha ma lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ lha gzhon nu skyed mos tshal gyi gzhir ༅byung ba na mi skra bregs shing gos ngur smrig 'tshal ba sug ⑧pa na lhung bzed thogs nas khyim nas khyim dang / khang pa nas khang par rgyu zhing mchi ba zhig gzigs so/ /gzigs nas kyang bdag la 'di skad ces gsungs te/ kha lo sgyur ba mi skra bregs pa ⑨lag pa na lhung bzed thogs nas khyim nas khyim dang / khang pa nas khang par rgyu zhing 'gro la 'di'i gos kyang kha dog mi ⑩mtshungs te/ ji ltar yang mi gzhan dag gi dang mi 'dra ba 'di ci yin/ de la bdag gis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /lha 4—11

de ①ni rab tu byung ba zhes bgyi'o/ /de 'di skad ces gsungs te/ kha lo sgyur ba rab tu byung ba zhes bya ba 'di ci yin/ de la bdag gis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /lha rab tu byung ba de ni dul ba legs pa dang / yang dag par sdom pa legs pa dang / don spyod ②pa legs pa dang / chos spyod pa legs pa dang / dge ba spyod pa legs pa dang / dge legs spyod pa legs par rig nas skra dang kha spu bregs te gos ngur smrig bgos nas dad pa yang dag pa zhukho nas ༅khyim med par rab tu byung ba ste/ lha 'di ni rab tu byung ba zhes bgyi'o/ /de 'di skad ces gsungs te/ kha lo sgyur ba de'i phyir shing rta 'di rab tu byung ba gang na ba ⑤de logs su sgyur ༅cig /lha bka' snubazhin 'tshal zhes byang chub sems dpa' shākya thub pa'i ltar mnyan nas shing rta de rab tu byung ba gang ⑧na ba de logs su bsgyur ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' shākya thub pas rab tu byung ba de la 'di skad ces gsungs te/ kye mi spukhyod ci'i phyir skra bregs la lag pa ⑩na lhung bzed thogs nas khyim nas khyim dang / khang pa nas khang par rgyu zhing 'gro la khyod kyi gos kyang kha dog mi mtshungs te/ ji ltar yang mi gzhan dag sh+yadang mi 'dra ba yin/ des 'di skad ces gsol to/ /gzhon nu bdag ni rab tu byung ba zhes bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpas gsungs pa/ kye mi 8khyod ji ltar rab tu byung ba zhes bya/ des 'di skad ces gsol to/ /gzhon nu bdag gis dul ba legs pa dang / yang dag par sdom pa legs pa dang / don spyod pa legs pa dang / chos spyod pa legs pa dang / dge ba spyod pa legs pa dang / dge legs spyod pa legs par rig nas skra dang kha spu bregs te gos ngur smrig bgos nas dad pa yang dag pa kho nas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu 4—12

byung ste༅/ de ltar na bdag rab tu byung ba zhes bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpas ②gsungs pa kye mi ②khyod kyis dul ba legs pa dang / yang dag par sdom pa legs pa dang / don spyod pa legs pa dang / chos spyod pa legs pa dang /dge ba spyod pa legs pa dang / dge legs spyod pa legs par rig nas skra dang kha ⑦spu bregs te gos ngur smrig bgos nas dad pa yang dag pa kho nas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ba legs so/ /lha ⑤de nas ⑥gzhon nus gsungs pa/kha lo sgyur ba de'i phyir shing rta phyir sgyur ⑦cig pho brang nyid du 'dong ngo / /'di ltar nga pho brang du phyin nas don 'di bsam par bya'o/ /bdag gis de nas shing rta bsgyur nas gzhon nu ⑧lo brang du zhugs so/ /rgyal pos bsams pa/mtshan mkhan dang ltas mkhan gyi bram ze de rnams kyi tshig yang dag par bden par mi 'gyur grang / gzhon nu skra dang kha spu bregs nas gos ngur smrig bgos te dad pa yang dag pa kho nas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu 'byung khyabar 'gyur du 'ong gis/ ma rtsol bdag gis gzhon nu zhing pa'i grong du btang la ci nas kyang de la sems g.yengs par 'gyur bar bya'o snyam nas/ gzhon nu shākya thub pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /gzhon nu tshur shog /khyod zhing pa'i grong du song la las kyi mtha' la ltos shig /de nas byang chub sems dpa' tu)rgas pa dang /nad pa dang / shi ba mthong nas ni yid byung ngo ⑫/ /rab tu byung ba la ni mngon par zhen pa'i blos yab shākya zas gtsang gi tshig tsogasan nas shing rtar zhugs te zhing pa'i ④grong du skus gshegs kyi thugs kyis ni ma yin no/ /de la lam kur ⑫gter lnga brgyas kha nye bar bstan te sgra phyung ba/ gzhon nu bdag cag ni khyod kyi nye du'i gter lags kyis bdag cag bzhes shig /byang chub sems dpas 1—13

gsungs pa/ re zhig de rnams kyis blun po'i yongs su gzung ①ba byas nas ci zhig byas/② khyed nga la dgos pa med kyis song shig② /tshigs su bcad pas kyang gsungs pa/ /gang gis nga la 'chi ba'i gtam smras pa/ /de dag kyang ④shi gtam du ⑤gyur pa yin/ /bdag kyang shi nas ring po mi thogs par/ /gzhan dag gi yang gtam du 'gyur bar 'ong / ci/de rnams kyis yang sgra phyung ba/ /gzhon nus gal te mi bzhes na/ /bdag cag rgya mtsho chen por 'jug go/ /byang chub sems dpas ci bde bar zhugs shig ces gsungs pa dang / de rnams rgya mtsho chen po'i nang du zhugs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' gshegs pa dang / ji ༅tsam na zhing pa skra gyen du 'greng ba/ lag pa dang rkang pa ser ga ⑦byung ba/ lus rdul gyis yog ④pa dag cig dang / rmon pa lcag gzer ༅bu rnon po can gyis lus dral bas rgyab dang mjug ⑩do'i phyogs khrag ༅gis yog 8pa/ltogs pa dang skom pas dbugs brdzags 8shing snying ga'i 8phyogs nas dbugs brdzags 6pa ring du 'dren thul gnya' shing gis mnan pa'i rma las rnag khrag 'dzag pa la sbrang bu dang 'bu'i tshogs za ba/ thong lcags kyis 2rkang pa rma byung zhing / kha dang sna nas kha chu 8sna chu 'dzag la sbal pa ⑨ dang / sha sbrang dang /sbrang bu mchu rings kyis yog du pa rnams gzigs so/ /gzigs nas kyang thog ma med pa'i dus nas bsod nams bskyed cing bsags pa'i thugs rjes kun nas bskyod pa'i thugs kyis zhing pa rnams la 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /shes ldan dag khyod 0su'i yin/ de rnams kyis gsol pa/ lha'i lags so/ /des gsungs pa/ shes ldan dag deng duphan chad bran du mi bya/ mngag gzhug par mi bya/ rang dbang can gar dga' bar 'gro bar byas phyo/ bde ba la reg 4—14

par gnos ①shig /rmon pa rnams kyang bkrol ②nas gsungs pa/ khyed cag kyang deng phyin ②chad rtswa ④mchog ma nyams pa la za zhing chu ma rdul ma bsnyogs ⑤shing dang ba dag la 'thungs ⑥shig /khyod ⑦la phyogs bzhi nas kyang rlung bsil ba ldang bar gyur cig /de nas byang chub sems dpa' yid byung ba de nyid kyis yab shākya zas gtsang gi zhing blas kyi mtha' la dugazigs nas shing 'dzam bu'i grib ma gang na ba der gshegs te byon nas/ shing 'dzam bu'i grib ma la bzhugs te/'dod pa las dben pa⑨/ sdig pa mi dge ba'i chos ⑩las dben pa/ rtog pa dang bcas/ dpyod pa dang bcas shing dben pa las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang bde ba can /hwazag pa med pa dang 'dra ba'i bsam gtan dang po la snyoms par zhugs so/ /skye bo'i tshogs chen po yang byang chub sems dpa' spangs te mi 'gro bar shing gzhan rnams kyi drung na sdod do/ /rgyal po zas gtsang gis bsams pa byang chub sems dpa' ring zhig thogs te 'di ltar 8dro'i dus las yol gyis ltar 'gro'o zhes de shing rtar zhugs nas zhing pa'i grong du song ste phan tshun du byang chub sems dpa' tshol zhing shing 8'dzam bu'i drung du phyin to/ / 6de'i tshe nyi ma'i gung yol nas shing gzhan 6rnams kyi grib ma shar phyogs su gzhol/ shar phyogs su 'babaskye/ shar phyogs su bab ༅par gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa'i mthus shing 'dzam bu'i grib ma ni byang chub sems dpa'i sku mi gtong ngo / /rgyal po zas gtsang gis tho)nyi ma'i gung yol nas shing gzhan rnams kyi grib ma shar phyogs su gzhol/ shar phyogs su 'bab/ shar phyogs su bab yipar gyur na shing 'dzam bu'i grib ma ni byang chub sems dpa'i sku mi gtong ba mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang de 'di snyam du sems te/ gzhon nu ni rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che 1—15

ba yin te/ 'di ltar da lta ①nyi ma'i gung yol nas shing gzhan rnams kyi grib ma shar phyogs su gzhol/ shar phyogs su 'bab/ shar phyogs su bab par gyur na ②shing 'dzam bu'i grib ②ma ni byang chub sems dpa'i sku mi gtong ba rdo mtshar che'o snyam mo/ /de nas ④dga' ba'i bsti ④stang byas te byang chub sems dpa'i zhabs gnyis la gtugs nas tshigs su bcad pas smras pa/ ji ltar bltams ⑥tshe sa ni g.yos pa ltar/ /'dzam bu'i grib mas khyod sku mi gtong ba/ /blo chen khyod kyi ya mtshan gnyis 'di ste/ /kun gzigs khyod kyi 0zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo / /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang gis byang chub sems dpa' skyil mo krung ④bcas pa las bslang spunas shing rtar zhugs te/ dur khrod kyi tsonang nas ser skya'i gzhir gshegs pa na byang chub sems dpas yidur khrod kyi nang na 8mi ro rnam par sngos 8pa dang / rnam par 'bus gzhigs pa dang / rnam par bam pa dag gzigs nas de shin tu skyo ba skyes te/ shing rtar zhugs bzhin du skyil mo krung 8bcas nas bzhugs so/ /de nas yang 8rgyal po zas gtsang gis thuskyil mo krung rngubacas pa las bslang skyonas/ ser skya'i gzhir gshegs te/ grong khyer gyi nang du 'jug pa na mtshan mkhan rnams kyis skyogal te gzhon nu zhag bdun gyi bar du rab tu ma byung na 'khor los du )sgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur bar lung bstan par rig nas de rnams kyis 0rgyal po zas gtsang la 'di skad ces smras so/ /gal te de yi chabazang po gzigs bzhed na/ /de'i zhuslad du dgung bdun bar du srungs shig dang / /mi dbang gdugs ni bdal bar gyur pa na/ /rin chen sna bdun 'byung bar the tshom ( stemed/ /khyod sras rin chen bdun po yi/ /dbang phyug gi ni rgyal por 'gyur/ /rgya mtsho la ni thug pa'i sa/ /chad pa med 4—16

pas laskyong bar 'gyur/ /'on te sa ni spangs nas su/ /bsnyengs med nags su bzhud na ②ni/ /thams cad mkhyen pa thob gyur nas/ /'gro ba sgrol bar mdzad par 'gyur/ /shākya dus legs kyi bu mo ri dgas ③skyes zhes bya ba de skar khung na 'dug pas byang chub sems dpa' mthong nas tshigs su bcad de smras pa/kye ma 'di yi yum bde zhing / /yab de yang ni bde ba yin/ /kye ma gang gi khyim thab 'gyur/ /bud med de yang mya ngan 'das/ /skyes mchog bsam gtan pa de yis/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i sgra thos nas/ /mya ngan 'das pa zhi nyid du/ /mkhyen nas de la thugs dgyes gyur/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas ④legs par smras pa'i phyir mu tig gi phreng ba 'phangs pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i mthus skar khung nas song ste de'i mgul du 'khris par gyur to/ /skye bo'i tshogs kyis nang du song ba de mthong nas/ de rnams kyis rgyal po zas gtsang la rgyas par smras nas rgyal po zas gtsang gis ri dgas skyes 'khor nyi khri dang byang chub sems dpa'i btsun mor blangs so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa'i btsun mo sa 'tsho ma dang / ri dgas skyes la sogs pa'i 'khor bud med drug khri yod do/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang gcung bre bo zas dang / zas dkar dang / tshad med zas gsum dang lhan cig gcig tu tshogs nas gros bya ⑤bar brtsams pa/ shes ldan dag mtshan mkhan dang ltas mkhan gyi bram ze rnams kyis byang chub sems dpa' shākya ༅thub pa la gal te zhag bdun gyi bar du rab tu ma byung na 'khor los ④sgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan gyis/ de lta bas na bdag cag gis byang chub sems dpa' zhag bdun gyi bar du bsgrims te bsrung bar bya zhing grong khyer yang legs par bsrung bar bya'o/ /de nas de 4—17

rnams kyis ser skya'i gzhi'i grong khyer ra ba rim pa bdun dang 'obs rim pa bdun gyis bskor nas grong khyer gyi sgo ①'phar lcags las byas shing / sgo 'phar rnams la dril bu shin tu sgra gsal ba btags te sgo phye na de'i sgras dpag tshad gcig kho ra khor yug tu grag ②par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' ni khang bzangs kyi chagazhi na bud med yid 'phrog pa gzugs bzang ba rnams dang /gar dang glu dang / rol mo rnams kyi spyod pas bsnyen bkur byed du bcug go/ /blon po rnams ni dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi dang lhan cig ra ba'i phyi rol kho ra khor yug tu gcan pa byed du bcug go/ / skas spor rung ba mi lnga ④brgyas tshugs pa yang byas so/ /btsun mo'i 'khor gyi sgor yang sgo phye na de'i sgras rgyal po zas gtsang gi pho brang du grag cing de thos nas btsun mo'i 'khor gyi mi dang /grong khyer gyi ④sgo srung (7rnams dang / pho brang 'khor gyi mi grong khyer gyi phyi rol nas srung du bcug pa rnams bag dang chas te 'dug par 'gyur ba de lta bu btags so/ /byang chub sems dpa' ni steng gi khang bzangs kyi gzhi skyes pa med par zhugs nas pi bang ༅dang / gling bu dang / 'khar thurnga dang / sgra snyan la sogs pa rol mo'i cha spyad ⑨dag nye bar len cing 'byor ba chen pos bzhugs so/ /mtshan mo ni rgyal po zas gtsang yang dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi dang shar sgo'i phyi rol na 'dug go/ /lho phyogs na ni bre bo zas so/ /nub phyogs na ni zas dkar ro/ /byang phyogs na ni tshad med zas so/ ci /grong khyer gyi dbus kyi 'gram ⑨ po byed pa ni shākya ming chen no/ /de shar sgor song nas smras pa/ su zhig mel tshe 0byed/ su zhig mel tshe 'byed rgyal po zas gtsang gis smras pa/ kho bo mel tshe 0byed do/ /lha mel tshe ④mdzod cig /mel tshe 4—18

mdzad ①dang khyod la legs par 'gyur ro zhes smras te/ tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ 'jig rten gnyid log ro dang mtshungs/ /gnyid log bdud kyi dbang du song / /'di na ②mi nyal rtag tu mkhas/ /de bas ma nyal mel tshe ②byos / /lho sgor song nas smras pa/ su zhig mel tshe ⑤byed/ su zhig mel tshe ⑤byed / bre bo zas kyis smras pa/ kho bo mel tshe ⑦byed do/ /lha mel tshe ⑦mdzod cig /mel tshe mdzad ⑧dang khyod la legs par 'gyur ro zhes smras nas tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ 'jig rten gnyid log ro dang mtshungs/ /gnyid log bdud kyi dbang du song / /gnyid log 'chi bdag dbang du song / /de bas ma nyal mel tshe 0byos/ /nub sgor song nas smras pa/ su zhig mel tshe ⑩byed / su zhig mel tshe 0byed/ zas dkar gyis smras pa/ kho bo mel tshe ⑫byed do/ /lha mel tshe rtsamadzod cig /mel tshe mdzad cadang khyod la legs par 'gyur ro zhes byasmras nas tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ gnyid log pa ni rtag tu myos / /myos 'gyur bre ⑩bos 'thungs pa nyal/ /dgon pa'i ⑩nags su nyal ba 'dra(sme/ /de bas ma nyal mel tshe hu'ebyos/ /byang sgor du dī song nas smras pa/su zhig mel tshe tsu〉byed/ su zhig mel tshe dubyed/ tshad med zas kyis smras pa/kho bo mel tshe 3byed do/ /lha mel tshe zhu mdzod cig /mel tshe mdzad dudang khyod la legs par 'gyur ro zhes smras nas tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ ri nyal ri sul nyal ba bzhin/ /rgya mtsho'i 0chur ni nyal ba dang / /ljon shing rtse la nyal ba bzhin / /de bas ma nyal mel tshe 0byos/ /dbus kyi bzhi mdo dang sum mdo dag tu song nas smras pa/ su zhig mel tshe ( )byed/ su zhig mel tshe ()byed/srung ⑥ma rnams kyis smras pa/ bdag cag mel tshe ⑥bgyid do/ /mel tshe 0byos 1—19

shig /mel tshe byas ①dang legs par 'gyur ro zhes smras nas tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ chos spyod chos ma yin ma spyod/ /bden pa smros shig brdzun ma smra/ /mun pa chen por 'jug par 'gyur/ /de bas ma nyal mel tshe 0byos/ /de nas ③nam nangs ④nas shākya ming chen gyis rgyal po zas gtsang la smras pa/ lha dgung sangs lags te dgung bdun la dgung gcig ni thal/ dgung drug ni lus so/ /rgyal po zas gtsang gis smras pa/ legs kyis zhag drug 'das na ⑤gzhon nu 'khor los ༅sgyur bar gyur na bdag cag nam mkha'i 0ngos la rgyu zhing gling bzhir phyi bzhin dong ngo / /de bzhin du dgung ⑧gcig lus so zhes bya ba'i bar du ste/lha rnams kyi spudabang po brgya byin gyi shes pa mthong ba ni 'og tu 'jug pa yin pas tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ mi dbang shākya'i kyisras po thub pa 'di/ /bdag nyid chen po pha rol phyin drug rdzogs/ /thub rnams dgyes par (1mdzad pa dka' mthub tshal/ /'phags pa dgyes pa'i 8nags su gshegs par bzhed/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' btsun mo dang lhan cig skyes pa med pa na rol mos rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur hu spyod par byed pa na 'di snyam du dgongs te/ bdag la gzhan dag gzhon nu shākya thub pa ni skyes pa ma yin te/ gang gi phyir grags 'dzin ma dang / sa 'tsho ma dang / ri dgas skyes dang / bud med drug khri spangs nas rab tu byung ngo zhes gzhi des kha zer bar 'gyur du 'ong gis/ ma la bdag gis 8grags 'dzin ma dang lhan cig dga' mgur spyad par bya'o snyam nas des grags 'dzin ma dang lhan cig dga' mgur spyod ⑩pa dang grags 'dzin ma sems can dang ldan par gyur nas/ de 'di snyam du sems te/ nam nangs ⑩nas byang chub sems dpa'i snyan du gsol 1—20

lo snyam mo/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas ①de'i tshe rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba dang ldan pas tshigs su bcad de gsungs pa/ bud med dang bdag khyim ②nyal ba'i/ /tha ma deng gi 'di yin te/ /phyin cad khukhyim du bud med dang / /nga ni lhan cig mi gnas ④so/ /de nas bud med de rnams gar dang glu dang rol mos dub nas kha nas kha chu ⑤'dzag cing skra zhig la gos dang lag pa dag lhug par btang nas bsla ⑥ba'i tshig byung rgyal du brdol zhing gnyid log go//⑦byang chub sems dpas bud med de ⑧dag thams cad kha nas kha chu 'dzag cing skra zhig la gos dang lag pa dag lhug par ⑨btang nas bsla yi ba'i tshig byung rgyal du brdol zhing gnyid log pa gzigs so/ /gzigs nas kyang btsun mo'i 'khor la dur khrod kyi 7'du shes skyes tsonas des tshigs su bcad de gsungs pa/ rlung gi shugs kyis pad ma'i tshal ltar sa gzhi 'dir/ /lag pa dag dang rkang pa brkyang ⑫nas 'gyel gyur te/ /skra rnams zhig cing mdoms byadang rkub kyi 8phyogs snang ba//shākya'i sras kyis gzigs ⑩nas rang bzhin skyo bar gyur/ /tshul dang bral ba'i bud med na chung tshogs 'di dag /dur khrod 'jigs su rung ba'i rang bzhin 'drar mthong nas/ /sems can byis pa'i spyod pa'i yul la deng dga' na/ /sems dang ngablo gros dran dang bral ba yin nam ci/ /'dod pa tha chad tso'adam dang mda' mdung dug me tho)'dra/ /rmi lam lta bu yin te tshwa rdu )chu'i ro dang mtshungs / /'dod pa phung byed 0rtsod dang sdig pa'i rgyur gyur pa/ /mtha' tsongan sbrul gyi dbang po lta bu bdag gis spang phye/ /bar skabs der skye dgu'i bdag mo chen mo'i rmi lam du bzhi rmis pa/ zla ba sgra can ④gyis zin pa dang /nyi ma shar phyogs nas shar tshunas de nyid du nub pa dang / skye bo'i tshogs chen 4—21

pos bdag la phyag byas pa dang / bdag nyid dgod cing ngu ba'o/ /grags 'dzin ma'i rmi lam du brgyad rmis pa/ bdag nyid kyi 0khyim gyi ②gdung chag pa dang / bkra shis kyi mal khri chag pa dang / lag pa'i gdu ③bu chag pa dang /so'i phreng ba lhags pa dang / skra'i lan bu zhig pa dang / dpal khyim nas byung ba dang / zla ba sgra can ④gyis zin pa dang / nyi ma shar phyogs nas shar nas de nyid du nub pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpas kyang rmi ⑤lam lnga rmis pa/sa chen po nyid kyi gzims ⑥mal du byas shing / ri rab ri'i rgyal po dbu rten du bcug /phyag g.yon pa shar phyogs kyi rgya ⑦mtsho chen por 'jug /phyag g.yas pa nub phyogs kyi rgya mtsho chen por 'jug /zhabs gnyis rgya mtsho chen por 'jug pa dang / 'greng ⑧ba zhes bya ba'i rtsa'i rigs lte ba nas byung nas nam mkha'i bar du 'phags te 'dug pa dang / bya kun nas dkar la mgo gnag pa rnams kyis ⑨zhabs gnyis la gtugs nas pus mo'i lha nga la thug gi bar du ldag paci chadang bya sna tshogs phyogs bzhi nas 'ongs nas mdun du kha dog gcig tu 'dug pa dang / mi gtsang ba'i ri'i steng nas bdag nyid mi gtsang bas ma gos par 'chag pa'o/ /tunyemis thechenas kyang thugs dgyes te dgongs pa/nga'i rmi lam 'di tso'adra ba za bomis pas ring po mi thogs pa kho nar bla na med pa'i ye shes thob par 'gyur ro snyam mo/ /de nas grags 'dzin mas byang chub sems dpa' la rmi lam gsol pa/ lha da gzod tsobadag gis ⑩g.yar lam du brgyad rmis pa/ bdag gi sdum pa'i gdung chag pa dang / bkra shis kyi mal khri chag pa dang / sug pa'i gdu spre)bu chag pa dang / so'i phreng ba lhags pa dang /skra'i lan bu zhig pa dang / dpal sdum pa nas byung ba dang / zla ba sgra can tso4—22

gyis ①zin pa dang / gdugs shar phyogs nas bdal nas de nyid du nub pa mis lags so/ /byang chub sems dpas grags 'dzin ma'i yid mi bde ba bsal ②ba'i phyir rmi lam rnams bshad pa/ bdag gi dukhyim gyi gdung chag go zhes smras pa gang yin pa de mi 'dug gam/ bdag gi bkra shis kyi mal khri chag go zhes smras pa gang yin pa de yang ma chag ste 'dug pa'o ④ni yin mod/ lag pa'i gdu ⑤bu chag go zhes smras pa gang yin pa ci chag gam ma chag rang nyid ༅rtogs shig /so'i phreng ba lhags ⑦so zhes smras pa gang yin pa de yang so so rang gis rig par bya ba yin pas ci lhags sam ma lhags rtogs shig /bdag gi lan bu zhig go zhes gang smras pa de yang khyod kyis so so rang gis rig par bya ba yin pas ci zhig gam ma zhig rtogs shig /khyim nas dpal byung ngo zhes smras pa gang yin pa de ni bud med rnams kyi dpal ni khyo yin la dung ni 'dug pa nyid do/ /zla ba sgra can ⑨gyis zin ces smras pa gang yin pa de ni zla ba 'di mngon sum du 'dug pa ma yin nam/ nyi ma shar phyogs nas shar nas de nyid du nub bo zhes smras pa gang yin pa de ni da dung yang nam phyed yod de/ re zhig shar kyang ma shar na nub par lta ga la gyur ces ⑨ de ltar brda 7sprad nas btsun mo grags 'dzin cang mi smra bar 'dug go/ /byang chub sems dpas dgongs pa grags 'dzin ma'i rmi lam de 'dra ba rmis pas gdon mi za bar nga 'kho na bdag 'gro bar byas 'di la tshig zur gyis bstan no snyam nas des de la tshig tho)zur gyis bstan pa dang / grags 'dzin mas gsol pa/ lha khyod gang du bzhud pa der bdag khrid cig /byang chub sems dpas mya ngan las 'das pa las dgongs nas bka' stsal pa/ de bzhin du bya ste/ (stegang du 'gro ba de dang der khyod 1—23

bkri'o / /de nas brgya byin dang tshangs pa la sogs te lha rnams kyi sems kyis byang chub sems dpa'i dgongs pa shes nas byang chub sems dpa' gang na ba der song ste phyin pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /nags kyi spre'u ni spyod yul rgyu 'dra zhing / /yan par 'dug pa'i rte'u dang 'dra ba'i ①thugs/ /gal te 'dod pa'i yon tan las bzlog na/ /de nas shin tu gsal ba'i snang ba gzigs/ /blo gros bzang po bzhengs shig bzhengs/ /sa ni spangs te bzhud mdzod la/ /thams cad mkhyen nyid brnyes nas ni/ /'gro ba dag ②ni bsgral bar ②mdzod/ /byang chub sems dpas gsungs pa/ kau shi ka ma mthong ngam/ nga ni ri dgas bdag po rgyas ④bskor ltar/ /mi ni mthu ldan gzhu gematshon ral gri ༅thogs/ /rta glang shing rta dpung tshogs mang po yis/ /grong khyer ser skya kun nas yongs su bskor/ /zas gtsang la sogs shākya'i tshogs 'di dag /glang chen rta zhon legs par go bgos lus/ /mi sdug sna tshogs lag na mtshon thogs te/ /khyams dang rta babs khang bzangs gzhi nang gnas / /pho brang dang ni khyim sgo dang / /de bzhin grong khyer sgo dag kyang / /bcad nas gtan pa dam bcug ste/ /de bzhin kun nas bsrungs par gyur༅/ /rwa dung pa ṭa ⑤ha sgra rnga sgra yis/ /khyams dang rta babs khang bzangs nang gnas shing / /glang chen rta dmag 'bad pa'i skye bo'i tshogs/ /rgyun du nga mi btang 0phyir sung bar byed/ /brgya byin gyis gsol pa/ des pa mar me mdzad kyis lung bstan dang / /sdug bsngal gyis gdungs 'jig rten 'di dang yang / /khyod kyi sngon gyi dam bcas dgongs mdzod la/ /khab dag spongs te nges par 'byung bar mdzod/ /ji ltar khyod ni bgegs med par/ /deng ⑩4—24

nyid nags su gshegs 'gyur ba/ /bdag cag tshangs sogs bcas pa yil/ /lha rnams kyis ni de bzhin bgyi/ /byang chub sems dpas ②legs so zhes gsungs nas thugs dgyes par gyur to/ /de nas lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyis gnyid kyis myos par byas nas/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lngas rtsen la bsgo ba/ grogs po byang chub sems dpa' steng gi khang bzangs nas 'babs kyis skas long shig /des skas blangs pa la byang chub sems dpa' 'babs ③pa dang / de nas brgya byin gyis brda ④byas ma thag tu zhabs 'bring ba ⑤'dun pa gang na ba der gshegs nasayi/ ji tsam na 'dun pa gnyid stug pos non par ⑦gzigs nas byang chub sems dpas bsgrims te bslang ⑧nas tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis gsungs pa/ 'dun pa longs kye khyim nas myur du ni/ /nga yi rta pho ⑨rin chen bsngags 0ldan long / /sngon gyi rgyal bas longs spyod yidaka' thub tshal/ /thub rnams dgyes par mdzad par nga gshegs sol/ /'dun pa gnyid log pa'i mig phye nas smras pa/ lha khyod 0skyed mos tshal gyi dus ma bab/ /des pa khyod dang 'ga' yang khon ma mchis/ /khyod la dgra bo su yang ma mchis na/ /dgung phyed khyod la bcibs pas ci zhig bgyid/ /byang chub sems dpas bka' stsal pa/ 'dun pa khyod kyis tsolan 'ga' yang / /nga yi tshig ni ma bcag na/ /nga ④yi deng dus tha ma la/ /nga 8yi tshig 'di ⑩ma gcag shigaci /'dun pas gsol pa/ gzhon nu mtshan mo 'di ni 'jigs pa dang 'jigs su rung ba mchis pas bdag bcibs pa mi len no/ /byang chub sems dpas dgongs pa/ lan dang yang lan gyis gdon mi za bar skye bo sad par 'gyur gyis bdag nyid song la rta'i rgyal po bsngags ldan sta gon bya'o snyam na8/1—25

de nas nyid kyis pho brang gi sgo phye nas rta'i rgyal po bsngags ①ldan bzung ②bar brtsams pa na de khros pa'i me rab tu 'bar bas rkang pa 'phra/ 'jing kyog byed la phar bros tshur bros ①shing 'dug tu mi btub bo/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa'i phyag bsod nams brgya phrag du mas bskyed pa/ 'khor lo dang bkra shis dang / g.yung drung 'khyil ④pa mnga' ba/ skrag pa rnams la dbugs 'byin par mdzad pas mgo la byugs nas gsungs pa/ bsngags ①ldan tha ma yi ni khur long ste/ /dka' thub nags su ma thogs nga skyol cig /byang chub thob nas myur du 'gro ba kun/ /bsam gtan rnam thar char gyis tshim par bya/ /chos nyid kyis dud 'gro yang gdams na phyi ⑥lang mi byed pas rta'i rgyal po bsngags ②ldan mi g.yo bar 'dug go/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' thugs dgyes pa skyes te rta'i rgyal po bsngags ②ldan bstad ⑨nas bzhes 0so/ /brgya byin dang tshangs pa la sogs pa lha 4sprernams kyis byang chub sems dpa' phyir gshegs pa'i phyir lha'i bu bzhi po bsgo ste bzhag 8pa/ 'gram dang / nye 'gram dang / lo ma dang / lo ma gyon pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpas de rnams la gsungs pa/ shes ldan dag nga sus bkur/ de rnams kyis gsol pa/bdag cag gis bkur lags so/ /khyed cag la 8stobs ji tsam yod/ gcig gis gsol pa/ gzhon nu bdag gis ni sa'i rdul ji snyed mchis pa khur du thogs te mchi'o/ /gnyis pas gsol pa/ bdag gis ni rgya mtsho chen po bzhi dang / mtsho dang mtshe'u dang lteng ka dang / chu mig rnams kyi chab ji snyed mchis pa de thams cad khur du thogs te mchi'o/ /gsum pas gsol pa/bdag gis ni sa la ri ji snyed mchis pa de thams cad khur du thogs te mchi'o/ /4—26

bzhi pas gsol pa/ bdag gis ni sa la rtswa ①dang shing dang yal ga dang lo ma ji snyed mchis pa de thams cad khur du thogs te mchi'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas zhabs sa la bzhag pa na de rnams kyis bsgul bar yang ma nus nas ngo mtshar skyes te gsol pa/ gzhon nu bdag cag gis ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams la stobs 'di 'dra ba mnga' bar ②ma 'tshal to/ /②gal te 'tshal na bdag cag mi mchis pa ④lags pa zhig /gtam de 'dun pa sngar sad pas thos nas byang chub sems dpa'i spyan sngar song ba dang / de nas byang chub sems dpa' ④rta'i rgyal po bsngags ldan la bcibs/ 'dun pa yang 'phongs la zhon nas 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi byang chub sems dpa'i mthu dang / lha rnams kyis ④lha'i mthus rta rin po che bsngags ldan steng gi nam mkha' las ⑦mngon par 'phags pa dang pho brang na gnas pa'i lha rnams byang chub sems dpa' dang bral bas ngu bar brtsams so/ /de rnams ngu ba'i mchi ma'i thigs pa ②rnams lus dang sa la bab bo/ /'dun pas gsol pa/ gzhon nu char gyi thigs ⑨pa dag 'bab na ci lhas dgung char phab ⑩bam/ byang chub sems dpas gsungs pa༅/ lhas char phab pa ma yin te/ 'on kyang pho brang na gnas pa'i lha rnams nga dang bral chubs ngu bar brtsams te/ de rnams kyi mchi ma'i thigs pa rnams lus la bab pa yin no/ /de nas 'dun pa mig mchi mas gang zhing dbugs ring 4)po'i shugs nar gyis phyung nas cang mi smra bar ⑫'dug go/ /byang chub sems dpa' sku thams cad kyis glang po che'i tsogazigs stangs kyis g.yas phyogs su gzigs te dgongs pa/ nga bud med dang lhan cig khyim na nyal ba'i tha ma ni 'di yin no snyam mo/ /yang dgongs pa gal te nga ⑩1—27

shar sgo spangs te sgo gzhan nas byung na gzhon nus ni bdag la tha ma'i dus na ①yang ma bltas so snyam du rgyal po mi dga' bar 'gyur ro snyam mo/ /ji tsam na rgyal po zas gtsang gnyid stug pos non pa gzigs nas des ②de la bskor ba mdzad de gsungs pa/ yab gus pa ma mchis pa dang / zhe sa ma mchis pas skrag nas mchi ②ba ni ma lags te/ gzhan du na 'jig rten rga ba dang 'chi bas bcom pa rga ba dang 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal gyis 'jigs pa las yongs su dgrol ④ba'i slad du lags so/ /ji tsam na shākya ming chen 'gram ༅po byed pa skye bo nyul ⑥zhing phyogs der phyin pa dang byang chub sems dpa' gshegs par chas ⑦pa mthong ngo / /de nas skad 'dzer cing mig mchi mas gang bas ⑤smras pa/ gzhon nu 'di ci ⑨mdzad/ ming chen 'gro'o/ /gzhon nu 'di ni rigs pa ma lags so/ /ming chen gang gi phyir ngas bskal pa grangs med pa gsum du dka' ba brgya stong du mas sems can rnams kyi 0 don du byang chub yang dag par bsgrubs pa des na da nga yici khyim na 'dug phod dam/ 'di ni nges te dka' thub kyi tshal du 'gro'o/ /de nas gsung tshig drag pos shākya ming chen spyos 8pa dang / cho nges btab ste kyi ⑫hud / deng ④du rgyal po zas gtsang dang / /shākya dag ni thams cad kyis/ /yang dang yang du bsams pa yi/ /re ba 'bras bu med par gyur/ ci /deng du rgyal po zas gtsang ni/ /sras kyi mya ngan gyis gdungs pas/ /lag bsgreng ⑫shin tu sdug bsngal zhing / /mi bzad sgra ni 'byin par gyur⑩/ /sa 'tsho ⑩grags 'dzin ri dgas skyes/ /de bzhin btsun mo'i 'khor rgyas pa'ang / /don grub dang ni bral ba yis/ /shin tu sdug bsngal myong bar gyuratso/ /zhes smras nas/ de sngangs pas grags 'dzin ma bslang ste ⑩smras pa/ don grub 'di 4—28

ni gshegs gyur gyis/ /khyim thab sdug bsngal ①gyis gdungs nas/ /sdug bsngal nyam ②thag ngur 'ong gis/ /khyim thab sdug pa de zlog shig③ /khyod kyis ⑦khyim thab gshegs 'gyur ⑤'di ni mthong dka' ste/ /khyod kyis 'di ltos khyim thab mthong ba'i tha ma yin/ /kyi hud phongs pas bdag gis mtshan mo kus btab kyang / /sus kyang lan ma ster bas bdag gis ma nyes so/ /des ni de ltar khus btab kyang / /'di ltar lha rnams byin rlabs ⑥kyis/ /dgon par 'o dod bos pa bzhin/ /'ga' yang sad par ma gyur to/ /de nas shākya ming chen sdug bsngal zhing yid mi bde bas gdungs nas ⑦de rings par rgyal po zas gtsang gi drung du song nas rgyal po zas gtsang bslang ste smras pa/ don grub 'di ni bzhud lags kyis/ /sa bdag de ni bzlog par mdzod/ /sras kyi mya ngan gyis thebs nas/ /sdug bsngal gyis gdungs bshums 'gyur mchisal ma stes te de ⑨yang gnyid ma sad do༅/ /de nas brgya byin dang / tshangs pa la sogs pa lha rnams kyang lha brgya 7stong phrag du mas yongs su bskor nas byang chub sems dpa' gang na ba der song ste phyin pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' bskor cing dong ste g.yas phyogs nas gzugs na spyod pa'i lha rnams spyod lam zhi ba dang / g.yon phyogs nas 'dod pa na spyod pa'i lha tsornams kyis tho)rgyal mtshan dang ba dan bsgreng nas lha'i rol mo'i khyad par sna tshogs dang / mdun nas ④brgya byin dang tshangs pa la sogs pa rang rang gi spyod lam gyis dong ngo / /nam mkha'i ngos la gnas pa'i lha brgya stong phrag du mas ni byang chub sems dpa'i steng nas lha'i me tog ut+pa la dang / pad ma dang / ku mu da chadang / pad ma dkar tsopo rnams kyis ⑩gtor ro'/ /a ga 7ru'i phye ma dang / tsan dan gyi — 1—29

phye ma dang / ta ma la'i 'dab ①ma'i phye ma dang / lha'i me tog man dā ②ra bas kyang gtor to/ /lha'i rol mo'i cha byad sna tshogs kyang brdungs so/ /gos rnams kyang gtor rol/ /'dir smras pa/ mkha' la lha rnams ga zha'i sgra chen 'byin byed la/ /dga' ba'i yid kyis gos kyi g.yab mos 'debs byed cing / /kha cig byang chub sems dpa' la ni stod byabyed del/ /nam mkha' la ni sor mo brgya phrag sgyur ⑥bar byed/ /kha cig dag ni sgo rnams 'byed byed cing / /me tog man dā ⑦ra bas 'thor bar byed/ /kha cig dag ni bcibs ⑧pa'i rkang 'dzin cing / /bde bar gshegs pa 0rtog cing rjes ⑩bzhin 'brang / /kha cig dag kyang g.yas nas rjes bzhin 'brang / /g.yon nas 'gro ba dag kyang rjes bzhin 'brang / /brgya byin de bzhin tshangs par bcas pa dang / /lus ngan bdag nyid shul ni mtshon par byed/ /zla ba nya ba rgyu skar tshogs kyis ltar/ /bdag nyid chen po lha tshogs mdun bdar nas/ /dka' thub nags ni yithub rnams dgyes byed pa/ /'phags pa dgyes pa'i nags su thugs dgyes gshegs/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' grong khyer ser skya'i gzhi nas phyir byung ba dang brgya byin dang tshangs pa la sogs pa lha tho)rnams yid dga' bas spro ba bskyed pa/grogs po khyod yun ring po nas nam zhig na nga bgegs las thar te dka' thub kyi nags su 'gro bar 'gyur snyam du dgongs pa skyed 8pa gang lags pa de deng du yongs su rdzogs pa lags kyis/ nam khyod kyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par byasangs rgyas pa de'i tshe/ bdag cag la yang dgongs shig /byang chub sems dpas 8de bzhin du bya'o zhes dam bcas nas sku thams cad kyis g.yas phyogs su glang po che'i lta stangs kyis 1—30

gzigs nas/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis bstan pa yinya/ /lam gyi mchog ni ma thob par/ /grong khyer ser skya'i gzhir ni ②slar/ /nga ni 'jug par mi bya'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' thun gnyis kyi chadapag tshad bcu gnyis su byon nas bcibs pa las babs te rgyan bkrol nas 'dun pa la bka' stsal pa/ 'dun pa rgyan dang rta khyer la slar song shig /'dir smras pa/kha lo sgyur khyod nga yi ④rta 'di dang / /rgyan 'di rnams kyang gnyen pa dag la byin / /nga ni 'dod pa rgya chen spangs nas su/ /da ltar 'di nyid du ni rab byung bya/ /de nas 'dun pa gdong la mchi ma char bzhin 'bab pas byang chub sems dpa' la gsol pa/ seng ge stag gis bltam ⑤pa dang / /phyugs ⑥rjes bltam ༅pa'i nags tshal du/ /'ba' zhig sku gnyen dang bral nas/ /'phags pa ji ltar spyod par 'gyur/ /byang chub sems dpas gsungs pa/skye dgu 'di ni skye na'ang gcig pu ste du / /de bzhin 'chi na'ang gcig pu 'chi bar 'gyur/ /'di ni gcig pus sdug bsngal myong 'gyur gyi/ /'khor ba la ni grogs yod ma yin no/ /'dun pas gsol pa/ kye guhud gzhon nus sdug bsngal ma gzigs te/ /zhabs 'jam glang chen rta la bcibs goms pa/ /sa gzhi rtswa dang rdo bas bltam tho )rtsub par/ /ji ltar zhabs kyis gshegs shing nags su rgyu/ /byang chub sems dpas gsungs pa/ 'chi bdag 'jigs pa de ni lan 'ga' yiyang / /skyid tshul brtsams 8med bde bar goms la min/ /mgon bcas la min rigs btsun la ma yin/ /dpa' dang brtson ④min skye bo dga' la min/ /dga' tsobs 'chi bdag 'jigs pa dag /bskyed nas 'ongs par ⑩'gyur zhes grags0/ /don ma byas shing ma brtsams par 'chi 1—31

bar yang ni 'gro bar 'gyur/ /'dun pas gsol pa/ lha ①rgyal po bgres po ②ni sras kyi mya ngan gyis 'grongs par 'gyur ro/ /'on kyang byang chub sems dpa' byang chub kyi tshogs bsags pa'i phyir 'dun pa'i tshig thugs la ma bab bo /de nas byang chub sems dpas ut+pa la sngon po 'dra ba'i ral gri shubs nas chaphyung nas gtsug phud bregs te steng gi nam mkha' la bor ba dang lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyis blangs nas bkur sti thuchen po byas te sum bcu ⑤ma gsum gyi lha rnams kyi nang du khyer nas gtsug phud kyi mchod pa chen po btsugs ⑥so/ /bram ze dang khyim bdag dad pa can rnams kyis phyogs der dbu skra blangs pa'i mchod rten ⑦brtsigs te da dung yang mchod rten la phyag byed ②pa'i dge slong dag phyag byed do// //'dul ba gzhi/ bam po brgyad bcu ⑨bzhi pa/ byang chub sems dpas gsungs pa/ 'dun pa ji snyam du sems/ gang la 'di lta bu'i brtul ba yod pa de ci ga rngu yang nyunyekhyim na gnas par 'gyur ram/ lha ma lags so/ /'dun pas bsams pa/ gzhon nu ni rgyal rigs kyi nga rgyal can yin pas 'di phyir bzlog par mi 8nus so snyam mo/ /de nas rta'i rgyal po bsngags ldan gyis byang chub sems dpa'i zhabs gnyis la lces bldags pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i phyag 'khor lo dang / bkra shis dang / g.yung drung 'khyil paṃ mnga' bas byugs nas gsungs pa/ bsngags ldan song shig dang / mngon par rdzogs par byang chub nas khyod kyi byas pa gzo bar 'gyur ro/ /'dun pa la yang gsungs pa/ khyod kyis bsngags ldan pho brang du ma bkri shig /de skad ces gsungs pa dang / 'dun pa skad 'dzer cing tsomig mchi mas gang nas rta'i 1—32

rgyal po bsngags ldan khrid de yang dang yang du byang chub sems dpa' ①la blta zhing ②song ngo / /de gnyis kyis thun gnyis kyis son pa'i sa gang yin pa de nas zhag bdun gyis phyir 'khor to/ /'dun pas bsams pa/ gal te lhan cig tu dong na smre sngags chen pos bdag shi bar 'gyur ro snyam nas des skyed mos tshal du 'dug nas bsngags ②ldan btang ngo / /des skad phyung ba dang pho brang gi skye bo dang skye bo'i tshogs gzhan gyis kyang skad de shes nas re ste phyir byung ④ba las byang chub sems dpa' ma ⑤mthong nas bsngags ldan de'i mgul du 'jus te ngu bar brtsams so/ /'di ni chos nyid yin te/ dud 'gro'i skye gnas su song ba'i srog chags phal pa gzhan la yang kun rdzob kyi shes pa yod na rta'i rgyal po bsngags ldan la lta smos kyang ci dgos pas des skye bo'i tshogs chen po smre sngags 'don pa'i sgra thos te dbugs khong du song ba nyid kyis brnangs te shi nas de sgra can ༅gyi bram ze las drug la brtson pa zhig gi rigs su nying mtshams ④sbyor ba blangs so du /gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i nyubyang chub mngon par byang chub hu )pa de'i tshe de la dmu rgod kyi gdams pas gtams 7nas 'khor ba'i dgon pa las bsgral te shin tu mthar phyin pa'i grub 8pa dang bde ba 0mya ngan ④'das pa la 'jog par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' la ngur smrig gis bodagos pa byung nas grong khyer dpe med du khyim bdag phyug po ⑩nor mang ba0/ longs spyod che ba/ yongs su gzung ba yangs shing rgya che ba/rnam thos kyi bu'i nor dang ldan pa/ rnam thos kyi bu la nor gyis 'gran 8pa zhig gnas pa des yirigs mnyam pa las chung ma blangs te/ de de dang lhan cig rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed do/ /de rtse bar 4—33

byed / dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par ①byed pa na khye'u zhig btsas so zhes bya ba nas de bzhin du khye'u bcu btsas so zhes bya ba'i bar du ste/de dag thams cad rab tu byung rjonas rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub mngon sum du byas so/ /de dag gi ma rgan mo des de dag la sha na'i gos dag cig byin pa dang /de rnams kyis smras pa/ yum bdag cag yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bas 'di dag bdag cag la mi dgos te 'on kyang rgyal po zas gtsang gi sras gzhon nu shākya thub pa zhes bya ba bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ba zhig yod kyis 'di dag de la phul cig /des na khyod kyis 'bras bu chen po thob par 'gyur ro zhes lasmras nas 'bar ba dang / gsal ba dang / char 'bebs pa dang / glog 'byin pa'i cho 'phrul dag byas nas phung po lhag ma med pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su yongs su mya ngan las 'das so/ /rgan mo des kyang 'chi khar gos de dag bu mo la gtad nas ji ltar gyur pa rnams smras so/ /de'i bu mo de yang nad kyis thebs te 'chi bar shes nas des kyang shing drung zhig tu bzhag nas shing de la gnas pa'i lha gang yin pa de la khyod kyis 'di dag rgyal po zas gtsang gi sras la phul cig ces gsol ba btab bobya / /lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyi ⑤shes pa mthong ba ni 'og tu 'jug pa yin pas des de dag shes nas blangs te/ de nas rngon pa rgas 'khogs pa lta bu zhig tu bdag nyid mngon par sprul nas de dag bgos te lag na ⑥mda' gzhu thogs nas byang chub sems dpa' gshegs pa'i lam kur ⑦bsdad pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' yang rim gyis dulam der byon ⑨nas rngon pa lag na mda' gzhu thogs shing gos ngur smrig gyon pa zhig gzigs so/ /gzigs 1—34

nas kyang mi de la gsungs pa/ kwa'i ①nang rje sha na'i gos 'o ni dag ni ②rab tu byung ba la 'tsham pa yin gyis/ ka shi ku'i ras phran 'di dag khyer la 'o ni dag nga snol byin cig des gsol pa/ gzhon nu bdag la gzhan dag khyod kyis rgyal bu gzhon nu bkrongs thunas ka shi ku'i ras phran gyi gos 'di dag blangs so zhes gzhi des g.yar mchi bar 'gyur lags pas bdag 'di dag mi 'bul lo/ /byang chub sems dpas gsungs pa/ kye nang rje nga ni mthu ji lta bu dang ldan pa 'jig rten thams cad kyis shes te su zhig gis nga dgrongs ⑤par nus / khyod kyis nga dgrongs ༅par su zhig yid ches kyis bag tsha ba med par byin cig /de nas lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyis byang chub sems dpa'i zhabs gnyis la gtugs ⑦nas sha na'i gos dag phul te ka shi ku'i ras phran rnams blangs so/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sku dang sha na'i gos de dag 'tsham par ma gyur pa dang de 'di snyam du dgongs te/ kye ma'o ②sha na'i gos rnams bdag gi 0sku dang 'tsham par gyur cig snyam nas tshig tu smras ma thag tu sha na'i gos de dag 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi byang chub sems dpa'i mthu dang / lha rnams kyi ⑩ lha'i mthus byang chub sems dpa'i sku dang 'tsham par gyur to/ /⑨byang chub sems dpas dgongs pa/ da ni bdag rab tu byung zin gyis/ 'gro ba rnams rjes su gzung tsobar bya'o snyam mo/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa'i ka shi ku'i ras phran gyi gos de dag lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyis blangs nas sum bcu tho)rtsa gsum gyi lha rnams kyi nang du ka shi ku'i mchod pa chen po btsugs so/ /bram ze dang khyim bdag dad pa can rnams kyis kyang phyogs der ngur smrig blangs pa zhes bya ba'i mchod rten brtsigs 4—35

te da dung du ①yang mchod rten la phyag 'tshal ba'i dge slong dag phyag byed do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' dbu skra bregs shing na bza' ngur smrig mnabs te dka' thub kyi nags su phan tshun rgyu zhing drang srong ngan spong gi bu'i bste gnas su gshegs pa dang / de'i tshe drang srong ngan spong gi bu lag pa la ②'gram pa chagatad nas sems khong du ༅chud cing 'dug pa de lta bu de byang chub sems dpas ⑤gzigs nas gsungs pa drang srong chen po ci'i phyir lag pa la ⑥'gram pa ⑦gtad nas sems khong du ②chud cing 'dug /des gsol pa/bdag gi bsti gnas 'di na 0shing ta la rnams gser gyi lo ma dang / me tog dang / 'bras bu chags pa las de rnams snga ma kho bzhin du ma 4) gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpas gsungs pa/ drang srong chen po gang gi 0mthus bste gnas 'di ni shing tsu)ta la rnams gser gyi lo ma dang / me tog dang /'bras bur 8ldan pa de rga ba dang / na ba dang / 'chi ba yang dag par mthong nas yid byung ste dka' thub kyi nags su gnas pas so/ /gal te des rga ba tsodang / na ba dang / 'chi ba yang dag par mthong nas yid byung ste dka' thub kyi nags su ④gnas par ma gyur na/ skyed mos tshal 'di de'i yin par 'gyur ba zhig /de skad ces gsungs pa dang / drang srong chen po tsongan spong gi bus byang chub sems dpa' la brtag ⑩par brtsams so/ /de nas gzugs bzang zhing zhi ba'i cha byad du tsomathong nas yun ring du brtags te ngo mtshar skyes nas gsol pa/ kye rab tu byung ba de khyod kho na ma lags grang / byang chub sems dpas gsungs pa/ drang srong chen po de ltar nges so/ /de nas ngan spong gi bu ya mtshan skyes pa'i mig bgrad ⑩de bltas nas/ byang chub sems 1—36

dpa' thog mar gdan la spyan drangs te me tog dang / 'bras bu ①bstabs so/ /de ltar kun du dgyes par byas pa dang byang chub sems dpas skad cig gcig ②bzhes chanas gsungs pa/ drang srong chen po 'di nas grong khyer ser skya'i gzhir ④ji srid yod/ des gsol pa/ dpag tshad bcu gnyis mchis so/ /byang chub sems dpas dgongs pa/ grong khyer ser skya'i gzhi nye'o/ /'dir gnas pa ni rung ba ma yin te/ shākya rnams kyis grong gi 'khrug pa ⑤byed par 'gyur gyis / ma ⑥la bdag gang gā rgal lo snyam nas de gang gā rgal nas mthar gyis rgyu zhing gshegs pa dang rgyal po'i khab tu byon to/ /byang chub sems dpa' ⑦ni bzo'i duganas dang / las kyi gnas de dang / de rnams la mkhas pa yin pas des 0shing ka ra bī ra'i cilo ma las lhung bzed byas nas spyod lam zhi bas rgyal po'i khab tu 0bsod snyoms kyi phyir zhugs ciso/ /de'i tshe rgyal po gzugs can snying po steng gi khang bzangs kyi gzhi (sten 'dug pa des de 'gro ba dang /ldog 4)pa dang / lta ba dang / rnam par lta ba dang / bskum pa dang /brkyang ba dang / chos gos snam sbyar dang / lhung bzed thogs pa byamadzes pas bsod snyoms spyod pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang 'di snyam du sems te/ rgyal po'i khab na rab tu byung ba ji snyed cig gnas pa la ji ltar rab tu byung ba 'di'i spyod lam de lta bu ni 'ga' yang med do snyam nas yi'adir smras pa/ ji ltar mig can 'gro ba ltar/ /rab tu byung ba bsgrags ⑩par bya/ /'di yini brtags ⑩par mdzad nas su/ /rab tu byung ba yang dag bzhed/ /khyim gnas 'di ni sdug bsngal te/ /'di ni rdul gyi 0gnas yin zhing / /rab tu byung ba bar snang ltar/ /mkhyen nas de tshe rab tu byung / /rab tu byung nas sku yi ⑥ni/ /4—37

sdig pa'i las ni spangs pa dang / /gsung gi sdig pa spangs nas ni/ /'tsho ba kun nas dag par mdzad/ / de nas ①ma ga dhā ②yi ni/ /grong mchog rgyal po'i khab gshegs nas/ /mgon po shes bzhin dran ldan pasal/ /bsod snyoms phyir ni gshegs pa de/ /bzo sbyangs ma ga dhā yi ④bdag /khang bzangs na ni 'dug pas ⑤mthong / /mthong nas sems dad ⑥de nas ni/ /blon po rnams la 'di skad smras/ /mtshan mchog gi ⑦ni rgyas gyur cing / /kho lag phun sum tshogs pa dang / /gnya' shing gang du lta ba yini/ /'di la shes ldan dag ltos shig /spyan mi 'deg ⑨la yid gzhungs ⑩shing / /dman pa'i rigs yilas ma 'khrungs 8'di/ /gang du gnas par gshegs gyur pa/ /rgyal pos pho nya rjes bzhin btang / /de nas pho nya la bsgo 8ba/ /dge slong de ni gar 'gro zhing / /gang du gnas ni btab pa yi/ /rjes bzhin du ni 'brang bar gyis/ /de ni bsod snyoms tho'e gshegs pa na/ /sgo drug legs par bsdams nas ni/ /shes bzhin dran dang ldan pa yis/ /lhung bzed myur du gang bar mdzad/ /bsod snyoms spyad pa byas nas kyang / /thub pa grong khyer phyir 'byung nas/ /skya bseng las ni mngon gshegs te/ /de la gnas ni btab par gyur/ /gnas btab pa ni shes nas kyang / /pho nya gcig gis ⑫bsdad byas nas/ /gzhan ni myur du slar log ste/ /rgyal po la ni tshig ⑩smras pa/ /rgyal po chen po dge slong de/ /seng ge'am 8stag gi phru gu dang yi/ /ri sul dag na gnas pa ltar/ /skya bseng du gi ni steng na gnas/ /pho nya rnams kyi tshig thos nas/ /sa bdag shing drung zhugs nas ni/ /de ni blon pos yongs bskor nas/ /myur du kho nar dong bar 0gyur/ /bzhon 3pas bgrod pa'i 1—38

sar zhon te/ /de ni bzhon ①pa las bab ②nas/ /rkang gis ①nye bar song nas ni/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mthong / /rgyal pos 'dug nas dgyes pa dang / /mgu bar 'gyur ba'i gtam gsol nas/ /de ni ma khengs ④mi brlang ⑤bar/ /don 'di dag ni rab smras ⑥so/ /dge slong lang tsho ⑦dang po lam/ /bab par yang dag gnas gyur cing / /'di 'dra ⑧gzi brjid ldan pa lam/ /bsod snyoms spyod pa mdzes ma lags/ /khang pa nyams dga' dag dang ni/ /bud med rgyan gyis brgyan pa dang / /longs spyod mchog ni khyod gsol na/ /nyid kyi gdung ni zhu yis gsungs/ /rgyal po gangs ⑨ri nye ba na/ /yul gyi ljongs ni nor dag dang / /'bru dag gis ⑩ni gang gyur pa/ /ko sa la zhes grags yipa yod/ /bu ram shing pa nyi ma'i rus/ /shākya dag ni de na gnas/ /rgyal po nga'i rigs 8rgyal rigs te/ /nga ni 'dod pa don mi gnyer/ /sa 'di ri dang bcas shing rgya mtshor bcas/ /rin chen kun dang ldan pa bskyangs ⑫gyur kyang / /mi ni nam yang ngoms par mi 'gyur te/ /so ga tsha 'dus shing gis ④me bzhin no/ /'dod pa rnams ni sha khon 'brel ces gsungs/ /mi dbang rgal bar dka' zhing 'dam rdzab 'dras/ /sdug bsngal dang ni mya ngan 'jigs pa yi/ /rtsa ba'i gtso ste blo ngan rnams kyis bstan⑩/ /rgyal po ngas ni byung ma thag tu yang / /'dod pa rnams la mi dga'i 'ablo bskyed na/ /'jigs byed chos kyi dgra bor gyur pa dag /bor ba de kho slar yang ji ltar blang / /rtse mo sna tshogs yangs ⑩par gyur pa yi/ /lhun po gangs can rlung gis bskyod srid kyil/ /nga yi blo ni thar pa la brten ⑥ pa/ /'dod pa'i shugs kyis bskyod par mi nus so/ /'jig rten 'di ni 'dod par bying 0gyur nas/ /'khor 4—39

ba'i 'khor los yongs su 'khyam ①pa la/ /mi dbang nga skyabs yin te gzhan med pas/ /'jigs pa che las de ni thar bar bya/ /'dod pa rnams kyi nyes dmigs mkhyen/ /mya ngan 'das pa zhi ba ②gzigs/ /spang phyir gang du nga yi yid / /dga' ba dag tu 'gro bar bya/ /rgyal po gzugs can snying pos gsol pa/ kye rab tu byung ba brtul zhugs 'dis/ ci zhig don du gnyer/des gsungs pa/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub bo/ /rgyal pos gsol pa/ kye rab tu byung ba gang gi tshe khyod bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par sangs rgyas par gyur pa de'i tshe bdag la yang dgongs shig③ /byang chub sems dpas gsungs pa/ de bzhin du ba sam par bya'o zhes gsungs nas/ rgyal po'i khab nas byung ste bya rgod kyi ⑤phung po'i ri dang ha cang yang mi ring bar drang srong rnams kyi bsti gnas der gshegs so/ /de rnams spyod pa dang gnas pas bsam gtan la brtson par gnas te/ de rnams gang gi zhutshe rkang pa gcig yigis nyin thun gcig 'greng ba de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' thun ⑦gnyis su bzhengs so/ /gal te de rnams gdung ba lnga'i sbyor bas ②nyin thun ⑨ gcig 'dug pa de'i tshe byang chub sems dpas kyang sbyor ba des thun gnyis su bzhugs so/ /de nas de rnams ya mtshan skyes nas dge sbyong 'di ni chen po zhig go zhes smras pas dge sbyong chen po dge sbyong chen po zhes bya bar gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpas de rnams la smras pa/ shes ldan dag khyed brtul zhugs 'dis tho) ci zhig don du gnyer/ de na kha cig gis gsol pa/ brgya byin nyid do/ /kha cig gis gsol pa/ bdag cag ni tshangs pa nyid do/ /kha cig gis ⑩gsol pa/ bdud nyid do/ /byang chub sems 1—40

dpas dgongs pa/ drang srong 'di dag ni slar 7ltung ba lam log par zhugs pa ste/ lam de ni nus ②pa ma yin no snyam nas de 0sgyu rtsal shes kyi bu ring du 'phur gang na ba der gshegs te byon pa dang / sgyu rtsal shes kyi bu ring du 'phur la 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /ring du 'phur gal te khyod la mi bde ba med na khyod kyi drung du kho bo tshangs par spyod pa spyad do/ /des smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa gi ⑦ta ma bdag la mi bde ba med kyis/ khyod ⑤ci bde ba kho nar bzhugs shig /byang chub sems dpas gsungs pa/ ring du 'phur khyod kyis chos ji snyed cig rtogs par gyur/ des gsol pa/ tshe dang ldan pa gi ta ma ci yang med pa'i skye mched kyi bar du'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam du dgongs te/ sgyu rtsal shes kyi bu ring du 'phur dad pa de la ni nga yang dad la/ sgyu rtsal shes kyi bu ring du 'phur la brtson 'grus dang / dran pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / shes rab yod pa ltar bdag ༅la yang brtson 'grus dang / dran pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / shes rab yod pas sgyu rtsal shes kyi bu ring du 'phur gyis ༅ci yang med pa'i skye mched kyi bar du duchos de snyed mngon sum du byas na/ ci'i phyir bdag gis kyang chos 'di dag mngon sum 0du mi bya snyam nas/ de nas byang chub sems dpas 7chos de rnams kho na ma thob pa thob par bya ba'i phyir dang / ma rtogs pa rtogs par bya ba'i phyir dang /mngon sum du ma byas pa mngon sum du bya ba'i phyir gcig pu dben pa bag yod pa/rtun ⑩pa dang ldan pa/ bdag nyid gtod par gnas te gcig pu dben pa bag yod pa rtun 8pa dang ldan pa/ bdag nyid gtod par gnas pa na ring po ma thogs pa kho nar chos de dag mngon sum du mdzad par gyur to/ /'chos de dag ⑫1—41

mngon sum du mdzad nas yang sgyu rtsal shes kyi bu ring du 'phur gang na ba der gshegs te byon nas sgyu rtsal shes kyi bu ring du 'phur la 'di skad ces gsungs so//ring du 'phur khyod kyis ci yang med pa'i skye mched kyi bar gyi chos 'di dag rang gi mngon par shes pas mngon sum du byas sam/ des 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa gi ta ma mad ①de/ bdag gis ci yang med pa'i skye mched kyi ②bar gyi chos de dag ①mngon sum du byas so/ / byang chub sems dpas gsungs pa / tshe dang ldan pa ring du 'phur bdag gis kyang ci yang med pa'i skye mched kyi bar gyi chos de dag rang gi mngon par shes pas mngon sum du byas so/ /④tshe dang ldan pa gi ta ma de lta na ༅khyod kyi ji tsam pa ⑥bdag gi yang de tsam la/bdag gi ⑦ji tsam pa khyod kyi yang de tsam pas don 'di la 'o 0skol mtshungs shing mnyam ste 'dra bar thob kyis tshur spyon 'o laskol gnyi gas ⑩'khor 'di yongs su drang bar bgyi'o/ /de nas sgyu rtsal shes kyi bu ring du 'phur byang chub sems dpa'i thog ma'i slob dpon nyid kyis byang chub sems dpa' la rjed pa'i dam pas rjed cing mchod pa'i dam pas mchod do/ /de'i rtogs pa dag la 7yang dga' ba dang mgu bar gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam du dgongs te/ lam 'di ni ⑩shes par nus pa ma yin/ mthong bar nus pa ma yinam / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs par byang chub par nus pa ma yin no snyam mo/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas lam de nus pa med par rig nas rangs byed kyi bu lhag spyod gang na ba der gshegs te byon nas rangs byed kyi bu lhag spyod la 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /lhag spyod gal te khyod la mi bde ba med na khyod kyi drung du nga tshangs par spyod pa spyad do/ /des gsol pa tshe dang 4—42

ldan pa gau ta ma bdag la mi bde ba med kyis khyod ci bde ba kho nar bzhugs shig/khyod kyis chos ji snyed cig mngon sum du byas tshe dang ldan pa gi ta ma 'du shes med 'du shes med min gyi skye mched kyi ①bar du'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam ②du dgongs te/ rangs byed kyi bu lhag spyod dad pa la ni bdag kyang dad la rangs byed kyi bu lhag spyod la brtson 'grus dang / dran pa dang / ting nge ②'odzin dang / shes rab yod pa lta bu'i brtson 'grus dang /dran pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / shes rab ni bdag la yod na rangs byed kyi bu lhag spyod kyis 'du shes ④med 'du shes med min gyi skye mched kyi bar gyi chos 'di snyed cig mngon sum du byas na bdag gis kyang ci'i phyir chos 'di dag mngon sum du mi bya snyam mo/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas ⑤chos de rnams kho na ma thob pa thob par bya ba'i phyir dang / ma rtogs pa rtogs par bya ba'i phyir dang / mngon sum du ma byas pa mngon sum du bya ba'i phyir gcig pu dben pa bag yod pa rtun ⑥pa dang ldan pa/ bdag nyid gtod par gnas te/ gcig pu dben pa bag yod pa rtun ⑦pa dang ldan pa/bdag nyid gtod par gnas pa na ring po ma thogs pa kho nar chos de mngon sum du mdzad par gyur toni/ /chos de mngon sum du mdzad nas rangs byed kyi bu lhag spyod gang na ba der gshegs te byon pa dang rangs byed kyi bu lhag spyod la 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /lhag spyod khyod kyis 'du shes med 'du shes med min gyi skye mched kyi bar du chos 'di dag rang gis ⑨mngon sum du byas sam/tshe dang ldan pa gau ⑩ta ma mad lags te bdag gis 'du shes med 'du shes med min gyi skye mched kyi bar gyi chos 'di dag mngon yisum du bgyis so/ /byang chub 1—43

sems dpas gsungs pa/ tshe dang ldan pa lhag spyod bdag gis kyang 'du shes med 'du shes med min gyi khyoskye mched kyi bar gyi chos 'di dag rang gis ②mngon sum du byas so/ /tshe dang ldan pa go ta ma de lta na khyod kyi ②ji tsam pa bdag gi yang ④de tsam la/ bdag gi ji tsam pa khyod kyi yang de tsam pas don 'di la 'o ⑤skol mtshungs shing mnyam ste 'dra ba 0thob kyis tshur spyon 'o ༅skol gnyi gas ⑧tshogs 'di yongs su drang bar bgyi'o/ /de nas rangs byed kyi bu lhag spyod byang chub sems dpa'i thog ma'i slob dpon gyis byang chub sems dpa' la rjed pa ⑨dam pas rjed ⑩cing mchod pa'i dam pas mchod do/ /de'i shes pa rnams la yang dga' ba dang mgu bar gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam du dgongs te/ lam 'di ni shes par nus pa ma yin/ mthong bar nus pa thom yin/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs par byang chub par nus pa ma yin no snyam mo/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' lam de yang nus pa med par rig nas gshegs so/ /rgyal po zas gtsang 8bu'i mya ngan gyis rtag tu gdungs nas byang chub sems dpa' btsal ba'i phyir pho nya btang ba las/ des ji ltar gzhon nu don thams cad grub pa rangs byed kyi bu lhag spyod dang lhan cig bzhugs pa las rgyal po'i khab nas phyir byung ste rim gro pa med par 'khyam mo zhes 8thos so/ /thos nas rim gro byed pa sum brgya ④btang ngo / /grong khyer lhas bstan du shākya legs par rab sad ④kyis kyang de bzhin du thos nas des kyang rim gro byed pa nyis brgya btang ngo / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' rim gro pa lnga brgyas yongs su bskor nas dka' thub kyi nags su rgyu ba na des dgongs pa/ dka' thub kyi ⑩nags gang bar tshuspyod cing gnas pas ni bdud rtsi thob par mi nus kyis/ ma 4—44

la bdag gis ①rim gro byed pa lnga zhig blangs la lhag ma ni dgye'o snyam nas des yum gyi phyogs las gnyis/ yab kyi phyogs nas ②gsum khrid de/ de rnams kyis de'i rim gro byed do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' rim gro pa ⑧lngas yongs su bskor te ④ga lnga'i ⑤sto phyogs na lteng rgyas 'od srung gi sde'i grong rdal ⑥gang na ba der ④rgyu zhing gshegs te byon nas de phan tshun du 'chag ⑧pa na sa ⑨phyogs dga' dga' ltar 'dug pa/ nags 'tshang tshing mdzes pa/ chu klung nai rañdza yin bsil bar 'bab pa/ gse 8gu can 'jug ngogs bde zhing mtha' rgya che la gsing ma sngon po 'dang shing sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa dga' dga' ltar 'dug pa zhig gzigs so/ /gzigs nas kyang 'di snyam du dgongs te/ kye ma'o sa phyogs 'di ni dga' dga' ltar 'dug pa/ nags tshang tshing mdzes pa/chu klung nai rañdza na bsil ④bar 'bab 8pa/ gse tshug can 'jug ngogs bde zhing mtha' rgya che la gsing ma sngon po dang / shing sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa dga' dga' ltar 'dug pa zhig ste/ kye ma ༅spong ba don du gnyer ba'i rigs kyi bus ⑫nags khrod 'dir brten na spong ba bya bar nus so/ /bdag spong ba don du gnyer ba yin pas ma la bdag gis yikyang nags khrod 'dir ⑥ brten la spong ba bya'o snyam mo/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' nags khrod du zhugs te shing zhig gi drung du bzhugs nas 0tshems la tshems gtad 3/ ljags rkan phyal bcar nas ④thugs kyis 'thugs mngon du bzung / mngon du bsdams/ shin tu mngon du bsdams so/ /de thugs kyis thugs mngon du bzung tso/ mngon du bsdams/shin tu mngon du bsdams pas ba spu'i khung bu thams cad nas rngul byung bar gyur te / dper na mi stobs dang ldan pas mi stobs shin tu chung ba zhig phying 0ka 1—45

log tu bzung / mngon du bsdams/ shin tu mngon du bsdams na de'i ba spu'i khung bu thams cad nas rngul 'byung ba de bzhin du de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' tshems la tshems gtad①/ ljags rkan ②la bcar te ②thugs kyis ⑤thugs mngon du bzung / mngon du bsdams/ shin tu mngon du bsdams pa na ba spu'i khung bu thams cad nas rngul byung bar gyur kyang de zhum pa ma yin gyi brtson 'grus brtsams pa yin/ sku ma sbyangs pa ma yin gyi sbyangs pa yin/ rmugs pa ma yin gyi dran pa nye bar gzhag pa yin te/ sems rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag ⑤pa yin no/ /byang chub sems dpas sdug bsngal mi bzad pa rtsub pa tsha ba yid du mi 'ong ba'i tshor ba de lta bu nyams su myong ⑥yang 'di ltar sku bsgoms ⑦pa yin pa'i phyir thugs yongs su gtugs te mi gnas so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam du dgongs te/ ma la bdag gis rnam par bam pa'i bsam gtan dag la snyoms par 'jug par bya'o snyam mo/ /des rnam par bam pa'i bsam gtan dag la snyoms par 'jug par brtsams te/ de rnam par bam pa'i bsam gtan dag la snyoms par zhugs pa na zhal dang shangs nas dbugs rngub pa dang 'byung ba bgags ②so/ /de'i zhal dang shangs nas dbugs rngub pa dang 'byung ba bgags ⑨pa dang rlung thams cad spyi bo'i nang du song nas/de ⑨ de'i dbu la dbu'i tshor ba shin tu mi bzad pa skyes so༅/ /dper na mi stobs dang ldan pas mi stobs shin tu chung ba'i spyi bor lcags kyi phur pa rnon pos btab na de'i mgo la tsomago'i tshor ba shin tu mi bzad pa skye ba tsode bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' rnam par bam pa'i bsam gtan dag la snyoms par zhugs pa na dbu la dbu'i tshor ba shin tu mi bzad pa skyes kyang de zhum pa ma yin gyi 4—46

brtson 'grus brtsams pa yin/ sku ma sbyangs pa ma yin gyi sbyangs pa yin/rmugs ①pa ma yin gyi dran pa nye bar gzhag pa yin te/ sems rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag ②pa yin no/ /byang chub sems dpas ②sdug bsngal mi bzad pa rtsub pa tsha ba yid du mi 'ong ba'i tshor ba de lta bu nyams su myong ④yang 'di ltar sku bsgoms pa yin pa'i phyir thugs yongs su gtugs te mi gnas so/ /de 'di snyam du dgongs te/ ma la bdag gis lhag par rnam par ⑤bam pa'i bsam gtan dag la snyoms par 'jug par bya'o snyam mo/ /des lhag par rnam par bam pa'i bsam gtan ⑥dag la snyoms par 'jug par brtsams te/ de rnam par bam pa'i bsam gtan dag la snyoms par ༅zhugs pa na zhal dang shangs nas dbugs rngub pa dang 'byung ba bgags so/ /de'i zhal dang shangs nas dbugs rngub pa dang 'byung ba bgags ②pas rlung thams cad snyan gnyis kyi bu ga nas rgyus par gyur to/ /dper na mgar ⑨bas sbud pa bus na rlung thams cad kyi rgyun grwa gnyis gyi bu ga nas rgyu ba de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' rnam par bam pa'i bsam gtan dag la snyoms par zhugs pa na rlung thams cad kyi rgyun snyan gnyis kyi bu ga nas rgyus par gyur kyang de zhum pa ma yin gyi brtson 'grus brtsams ⑩pa yin/ sku ma sbyangs pa ma yin gyi sbyangs pa yin/ rmugs pa ma yin gyi dran pa nye bar gzhag pa yin te/ sems rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag pa yin no/ /byang chub sems dpas ②sdug bsngal mi bzad pa rtsub ④pa tsha ba yid du mi 'ong ba'i tshor ba de lta bu nyams su myong yang 'di ltar sku bsgoms pa yin pa'i phyir thugs yongs su gtugs te mi gnas so/ /de 'di snyam du dgongs te/ ma la bdag gis lhag par yang rnam par bam pa'i bsam tsogatan 4—47

dag la snyoms ①par 'jug par bya'o snyam mo/ /des ②lhag par rnam par bam pa'i bsam gtan dag la snyoms par 'jug par brtsams te/ de rnam par bam pa'i bsam gtan dag la snyoms par zhugs pa na zhal dang shangs nas dbugs rngub pa dang 'byung ba bgags so/ /de'i zhal dang shangs nas dbugs rngub ③pa dang 'byung ba bgags pas phyal gyi ④nang thams cad rgyas par gyur/ shin tu rgyas par gyur to⑤/ /dper na mgar ⑥ba'i sbud pa bus na gang bar gyur/shin tu gang bar gyur pa de bzhin du de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' rnam par bam pa'i bsam gtan dag la snyoms ༅par zhugs pa na phyal gyi dunang thams cad rgyas par gyur/ shin tu rgyas par gyur kyang de zhum pa ma yin gyi brtson 'grus brtsams ⑨pa yin/ lus ma sbyangs pa ma yin gyi sbyangs pa yin/ rmugs pa ma yin gyi dran pa nye bar gzhag pa yin te/ sems rtse ⑨ gcig tu mnyam par bzhag pa yin no/ /byang chub sems dpas sdug bsngal mi bzad pa rtsub pa tsha ba yid du mi 'ong ba'i tshor ba de lta bu nyams su myong huyang 'di ltar 8sku bsgoms pa yin pa'i phyir thugs yongs su gtugs te mi gnas so/ /de 'di snyam du dgongs te/ ma la bdag gis rnam par bam pa'i bsam gtan dag tshul snyoms par 'jug par bya'o snyam mo/ /des lhag par rnam par bam pa'i bsam gtan dag la snyoms par 'jug par brtsams te/ de rnam par bam pa'i bsam gtan dag la snyoms par zhugs pa na zhal dang shangs nas dbugs rngub pa dang 'byung ba bgags tsoso/ /de'i zhal dang shangs nas dbugs rngub pa dang 'byung ba bgags pa dang de'i tshe dbu tshul dbu'i tshor ba shin tu mi bzad pa ⑩skyes so/ /dper na mi stobs dang ldan pas mi stobs shin tu chung ba'i mgo 'breng ⑩pas 1—48

yang nas yang du dam du bcings na de'i mgo la ①mgo'i tshor ba shin tu mi bzad pa skye ba de bzhin du de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' rnam ②par bam pa'i ①bsam gtan dag la snyoms par zhugs pa na dbu la dbu'i tshor ba shin tu mi bzad pa skyes kyang de zhum pa ma yin gyi brtson 'grus brtsams pa yin/ lus ma sbyangs pa ma yin gyi sbyangs pa yin/ rmugs pa ma yin gyi dran pa nye bar gzhag ④pa yin te⑤/sems rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag pa yin no/ /byang chub sems dpas sdug bsngal mi bzad pa rtsub pa tsha ba yid du mi 'ong ba'i tshor ba de lta bu nyams su myong yang sku bsgoms pa yin pa'i phyir thugs yongs su gtugs te mi gnas so/ /de 'di snyam du dgongs te/ ma la bdag gis rnam par bam pa'i bsam gtan ⑥dag la snyoms par 'jug par bya'o snyam mo/ /der ⑦lhag par rnam par ⑤bam pa'i bsam gtan dag la snyoms par 'jug par brtsams te/ des rnam par bam pa'i bsam gtan dag la snyoms par zhugs pa na zhal dang shangs nas dbugs rngub pa dang 'byung ba bgags 0so/ /de'i zhal dang shangs nas dbugs rngub pa cidang 'byung ba bgags 7pa dang de'i tshe khong du khong gi tshor ba mi bzad pa skyes so/ /dper na ba lang gi shen 8pa mkhas pa'am/ ba lang gi shen 0pa'i slob ma mkhas pas ba lang gsod ④pa'i gri rnon pos ba lang 8gi lto dral na de'i khong du 'khong gi tshor ba shin tu mi bzad pa skye ba de bzhin du de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' rnam ⑩par bam pa'i bsam gtan dag la snyoms par zhugs pa na khong du 'khong gi tshor ba shin tu mi bzad pa skyes kyang de zhum ༅pa ma yin gyi brtson 'grus brtsams pa yin/ lus ma sbyangs pa ma ⑥ yin gyi sbyangs pa yin / rmugs pa ma yin gyi (1dran pa nye bar gzhag pa yin te/ sems rtse 4—49

gcig tu mnyam par bzhag pa yin no/ /byang chub sems dpas sdug bsngal mi bzad ①pa rtsub pa tsha ba yid du ②mi 'ong ba'i tshor ba de lta bu nyams su myong ②yang 'di ltar sku bsgoms pa yin pa'i phyir thugs yongs su gtugs te mi gnas so/ /de 'di snyam du dgongs te/ ma la bdag gis lhag par rnam par bam pa'i bsam gtan dag la snyoms par 'jug par bya'o snyam mo/ /des ④lhag par rnam par bam pa'i bsam gtan dag la snyoms par 'jug par brtsams te/des rnam par bam pa'i bsam gtan dag la snyoms par ②zhugs ⑥pa dang ⑦/zhal dang shangs nas dbugs rngub pa dang 'byung ba bgags so/ /de'i zhal dang shangs nas dbugs rngub pa dang 'byung ba bgags ⑧pa dang / de'i tshe sku la sku'i gdung ba shin tu mi bzad pa skyes so/ /dper na mi shin tu stobs dang ldan pa gnyis kyis mi stobs shin tu chung ba zhig phying ka log tu bzung ste me dong gi nang du sbyangs na de'i lus la lus nyukyi gdung ba shin tu mi bzad pa skye ba de bzhin du de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' rnam par bam pa'i bsam gtan dag la snyoms par zhugs pa na/ sku la sku'i gdung ba shin tu mi bzad pa skyes kyang /de zhum pa ma yin gyi ⑨ brtson 'grus brtsams pa yin⑩ / lus ma sbyangs pa ma yin gyi sbyangs pa yin/ rmugs pa ma yin gyi dran pa nye bar gzhag pa yin te/sems rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag pa yin no/ /byang chub sems dpas ⑫sdug bsngal mi bzad 8pa rtsub pa tsha ba yid du mi 'ong ba de lta bu'i tshor ba nyams su myong ④yang 'di ltar ④sku bsgoms pa yin pa'i phyir thugs yongs su gtugs te mi gnas so/ /de 'di snyam du dgongs te/ ma la bdag gis tshuthams cad kyi thams 0cad du zas mi za ba tsobasgrub par bya'o snyam mo/ /de nas lha rab tu mang 1—50

po'i sems kyis byang chub sems dpa'i ①thugs shes nas byang chub sems dpa' gang na ba der dong ②ste phyin nas/ byang chub sems dpa' la 'di skad ces smras so/ /grogs po gal te khyod mi'i kha zas kyis 'dzem par mdzad/ ngo tsha bar ③mdzad/ smod par mdzad/ rnam par smod par mdzad na/ bdag cag gis khyod kyi ④ba spu'i khung bu thams cad nas lha'i mdangs bsgrub ⑤par bgyis te/ khyod kyis gtor cig /de nas byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam du dgongs te/ gal te bdag gis mi'i zas mi bza' ⑥bar dam bcas la bdag gi ⑦ba spu'i khung bu thams cad du lha rnams kyis lha'i mdangs bsgrubs nas de bdag gir byed pa ni bdag gi brdzun ⑧yin la/ bdag gi ⑨brdzun gang yin pa de ni bdag gi log pa yin no/ /bdag gi log pa gang yin pa de'i rkyen gyis ni ⑩'di na sems can kha cig lus zhig ste shi nas ngan song ngan 'gro log par ltung ba sems can dmyal ba rnams su skye bar 'gyur gyis/ ma la bdag gis lha rnams 0kyi tshig ni thams cad kyi thams cad du spangs la kha zas nyung ba dang /chung ba dang / chung 8zad dang / chang chung bza' ba'amatso/ yang na mon sran sde'u'i 8khu ba'am/ 'on te rgya sran gyi khu ba'am/ yang na ha re nu ma'i ⑫'bras bu'i khu ba btung ngo 8snyam mo/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas ༅de'i tshe lha rnams kyi tshig thams cad kyi thams cad du spangs nas zhal zas nyung ba dang /chung ba dang / chung zad dang / chang chung gsol ba'am/ yang na mon sran sde'u'i 'khu ba'am/ 'on te rgya sran gyi khu ba'am/ yang na ha re nu ku'i 'bras bu'i khu ba gsol lo/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' zhal zas nyung ba dang /chung ba dang / chung zad dang / chang chung ⑩gsol ba na yan lag dang bu nying ⑥1—51

lag thams cad zhum kun du zhum ste/ skem zhing dbal ②chung bar gyur to/ /dper na ldum ③bu a si ta'i sdong bu dang / ka li ku'i sdong ③bu 'jum kun du 'jum pas sha chung zhing skams ④par gyur pa de bzhin du de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' zhal zas nyung ba dang / chung ba dang / chung ༅zad dang / chang chung gsol ba na yan lag dang nying ⑥lag thams cad zhum ⑦kun du zhum ste skem zhing dbal ⑤chung bar gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' de'i tshe zhal zas nyung ba dang / chung ba dang / chung zad dang / chang chung gsol ba na dbu la dbu'i pags ⑨pa rnyis skyakun du rnyis 7te 'khums shing 'bar 'bur du gyur to//dper na ku 8ba rtsa ba nas bcad na nyis 8kun du rnyis ④pas 'khums la 'bar 'bur du gyur pa de bzhin du de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' zhal zas nyung ba dang / chung ba dang /8 chung ༅zad dang / chang chung gsol ba na dbu la dbu'i pags ⑩pa rnyis 8kun tu rnyis te 'khums shing 'bar 'bur du ⑩gyur kyang de zhum pa ma yin gyi brtson 'grus brtsams pa yin/ lus ma sbyangs pa ma yin gyi 0sbyangs pa yin/ rmugs pa ma yin gyi dran pa nye bar gzhag pa yin te/ sems rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag pa yin no/ /byang chub sems dpa' 0de'i tshe bdag nyid gnod 6pa'i sdug bsngal mi bzad 6pa rtsub pa tsha ba yid du mi 'ong ba'i tshor ba de lta bu nyams su myong yang 'di ltar ④sku bsgoms pa yin pa'i phyir thugs yongs su gtugs te mi gnas so/ /de 3zhal zas nyung ba dang / chung ba dang / chung zad dang / chang chung gsol ba na spyan gnyis kyi spyan gyi 'bras bu phug tu song shin tu phug tu 0song ste/ zab pa shin tu zab par ring du song bas phyung chab lta bur snang ngo / /dper na khron pa zab mo'i chur skar 4—52
