ma'i gzugs brnyan phug tu song shin tu phug tu ①song ste/ zab pa shin tu zab par ring du song bar ②gtam du bya ③ba de bzhin du de'i tshe byang chub sems dpas ④thal zas nyung ba dang / chung ba dang / chung bzad dang / chang chung gsol ba na spyan gnyis kyi spyan gyi 'bras bu phug tu song shin tu phug tu ⑥song ste/zab pa shin tu zab par ring du song bas phyung ba lta bur snang yang de zhum pa du ma yin gyi brtson 'grus brtsams pa yin/ lus ma sbyangs pa ma yin gyi ⑤sbyangs pa yin / rmugs pa ma yin gyi 0dran pa nye bar gzhag pa yin te/ sems rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag pa yin no/ /de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' bdag nyid gnod ⑨ pa'i sdug bsngal mi bzad 7pa rtsub pa tsha ba yid du tsomi 'ong ba'i tshor ba de lta bu 8myong yang 'di ltar sku bsgoms pa yin pa'i phyir 8thugs yongs su gtugs te mi gnas so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' zhal zas nyung ba dang / chung ba dang / chung bzad dang / chang chung cigasol ba na de'i tshe rtsib ma'i bar mthon chadaman can du gyur te/ tsodaper na rtswa khang yilo gnyis sam 0 gsum lon pa'i phyam dgu po mthon sh+ya dman du gyur pa de bzhin du de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' zhal zas nyung ba dang / chung ba dang / chung 6zad dang /chang chung gsol ba na rtsib ma'i bar mthon dudaman ④du gyur kyang de zhum pa ma yin gyi brtson 'grus brtsams pa yin/ lus ma sbyangs pa ma yin gyi sbyangs pa yin / rmugs pa ma yin gyi 'dran pa nye bar gzhag pa yin te/ sems rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag pa yin nocha/ /byang chub sems dpa' de'i tshe bdag nyid gnon ⑦pa'i sdug bsngal mi bzad phyopa rtsub pa tsha ba yid du mi 'ong ba'i tshor ba de ⑥lta bu nyams su myong yang 'di ltar sku bsgoms pa yin pa'i phyir thugs yongs su 4—53

gtugs te mi gnas so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' zhal zas nyung ba dang /chung ba dang / chung ②zad dang / chang chung ②gsol ba na sgal pa'i tshigs ③'di lta ste/ skra'i lan bu lta bur gyur to/ /mjug do ④ni 'di lta ste rnga mo'i rkang pa lta bur gyur to/ /de lan 'ga' 0ldang bar 'dod na kha sbub ⑥ku 'gyel ⑦la/lan 'ga' 'dug par 'dod na gan rkyal du 'gyel lodu/ /de ro stod la brten nas ro smad 'jog par byed/ ro smad la brten nas ro stod 'jog par byed do/ /de phyag gnyis kyis sku la byugs yongs su byugs te/ de'i phyag gnyis kyis sku la byugs yongs su byugs pa de'i tshe ba spu rnams drung rul bas sa la lhags rtsopar gyur to/ /de 'di snyam du dgongs te/ lam 'di yang shes par nus pa ma yin/ mthong bar nus pa ma yin/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs par byang chub par nus pa ma yin no snyam mo/ /de nas lha gsum zhig byang chub sems dpa' gang na ba der lhags te/ de nas lku gcig gis 'di skad ces smras so/ /dge sbyong gau nyunyeta ma ni nag po zhig go/ /gnyis pas 'di skad ces smras so/ /'di nag po ni 8ma yin gyi 'on kyang sngo skyobasangs zhig go / /gsum pas 'di skad ces smras so/ /'di nag po yang ma yin/ sngo bsangs kyang ma yin gyi mdog dmar smug cig 6go/ /byang chub sems dpa'i 8sku mdog bzang por snang ba ni thams cad kyi mthams cad du nub par gyur to/ /de nas de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' la sngon ma gsan pa'i dpe gsum zhig snang ba 'di lta ste/ shing rlon pa chu can zhig chu nas phyung ste nye bar skam la bzhag pa dang / de nas mi ⑩mi don du gnyer ba me tshol ba zhig der 'ongs nas des 8de la gtsub thastan byas te gtsub du shing bzhag nas gtsubs na 'di 4—54

ltar shing de rlon pa chu can yin pa'i phyir me 'byung ba dang / 'bar du mi btub ①pa de bzhin du dge sbyong ngam bram ze kha cig ②'dod pa rnams la lus dang sems kyis thag sring bar mi gnas kyi/ de rnams kyi ②'dod pa rnams la 'dun pa dang / 'dod pa la chags pa dang / 'dod pa la dga' ba dang /'dod pa la zhen pa dang / 'dod pa la 'chums pa dang / 'dod pa la lhag par zhen pa gang yin pa de ni de rnams kyi sems yongs su gtugs te/ gnas pa yin pas lus dang sems kyis ④thag sring bar mi gnas pa rnams kyi ni de dang 'dra'o / /de rnams bdag nyid gnon ⑤pa'i sdug bsngal mi bzad pa rtsub pa tsha ba yid du mi 'ong ba'i tshor ba de lta bu nyams su myong mod kyi/ 'on kyang de rnams kyis shes par nus par ⑥ma yin/ mthong bar nus pa ma yin/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs par byang chub par nus pa ma yin te/ de la 'di ni de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' la sngon ma gsan pa'i dpe snang ba dang po yin no/ /dper na shing rlon pa chu can zhig chu nas phyung thoste/ nye bar skam la bzhag pa dang / de nas mi me don du gnyer ba me tshol ba zhig 'ongs nas des de la gtsub stan byas te/ gtsub shing bzhag nas gtsubs na 'di ltar shing de rlon pa chu can duyin pa'i phyir me 'byung ba dang 'bar du mi btub pa de bzhin du dge sbyong ngam bram ze kha cig 'dod pa rnams la lus kyis ༅spong bar gnas kyi sems kyis ma yin pa de rnams kyi ⑨ 'dod pa rnams la 'dod pa la 7'dun pa dang /'dod pa la chags pa dang / 'dod pa la dga' ba dang / 'dod pa la zhen pa dang / 'dod pa la 'chums pa dang / 'dod pa la lhag par zhen pa gang yin pa de ni de rnams kyi sems yongs su gtugs te gnas pa yin no/ /de 1—65

rnams bdag nyid gnon ①pa'i sdug bsngal mi bzad pa rtsub pa tsha ba yid du mi 'ong ba'i tshor ba de ②lta bu nyams su myong mod kyi/ 'on kyang de rnams kyis ②shes par nus pa ma yin/ mthong bar nus pa ma yin/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs par byang chub par nus pa ma yin te/ de la 'di ni de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' la sngon ma gsan pa'i dpe snang ba gnyis pa yin no/ /'di lta ste shing skam khong stong chu med pa zhig chu dang thag ring ④por skam la bzhag pa dang / de nas mi me don du gnyer ba me tshol ba zhig 'ongs nas des de la gtsub stan byas te/ gtsub ༅shing bzhag nas gtsubs na 'di ltar shing de skam zhing khong stong yin pa'i phyir me 'byung ba dang 'bar du btub ⑥pa de bzhin du ⑦dge sbyong ngam bram ze kha cig 'dod pa rnams la lus dang sems kyis thag sring bar gnas pa de rnams kyi 'dod pa rnams la 'dod pa la 'dun pa dang /'dod pa la chags pa dang / 'dod pa la dga' ba dang / 'dod pa la zhen pa dang / 'dod pa la 'chums pa dang / 'dod pa la lhag par zhen pa gang yin pa de ni de rnams kyi sems yongs su gtugs te mi gnas pa yin no/ /de rnams bdag nyid gnon ⑧pa'i sdug bsngal mi bzad pa rtsub ⑨pa tsha ba yid du mi 'ong ba'i tshor ba de lta bu nyams su myong mod kyi/ 'on kyang de rnams kyis ⑩shes par nus/ mthong bar nus bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs par byang chub par nus te/ de la 'di ni de'i tshe ⑩byang chub sems dpa' la sngon ma gsan pa'i dpe snang ba gsum pa yin no/ /'di ltar de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' la dpe gsum pa snang nas ma la bdag gis til 'bru gcig gi 8zas bza' bar bya'o zhes de til 'bru gcig gi zas tsogasol te/ ji srid de'i mdangs de ④sku las 4—56

yal bar ma gyur gyi bar du til 'bru gnyis pa'i zas mi gsol te/ yal nas til 'bru gnyis pa'i zas de gsol bar mdzad ②do/ /de til 'bru gcig gi ②zas gsol bas yan lag dang nying lag rnams shin tu skams ②par gyur to/ /til 'bru gcig byaji lta bar ⑤'bras 'bru yigacig dang / sran ko ⑦la 'bru gcig dang / rgya sran 'bru gcig dang ⑧/ mon sran gre'u 'bru gcig dang / mon sran sde'u 'bru gcig dang / rtswa'i gding ba la ⑨mnal bar mdzad do/ /rgyal po zas gtsang gis dka' ba spyod pa'i gnas skabs de thos nas nyi ma re re zhing rtog ⑩pa nyis brgya lnga bcu gtong bar byed do/ /rgyal po legs par rab skyesad kyis kyang nyis brgya lnga bcu'o/ /de dag nyi ma re re zhing de gnyis la myur ba myur bar gtam skyel bar byed de/sre/ byang chub sems dpa' ni 'di 'dra ba'i /spredaka' ba ④spyod de/ til 'bru gcig dang / 'bras 'bru gcig dang / sran ko la 'bru gcig dang / rgya sran 'bru gcig dang / mon sran gre'u 'bru gcig 8dang / mon sran sde'u 'bru gcig gi tho9zas gsol zhing rtswa'i (rtegading ba la mnal to zhes smra'o/ /de rgyal po zas gtsang gis thos nas bu'i mya ngan gyis skunon pas lhag par dang khar na zhing mig mchi mas brnangs 'u te gdungs nas btsun mo'i 'khor dang bcas par du )rtswa'i gding ba la nyal bar byed do/ /btsun mo grags 'dzin yang byakhyim thab kyi gnas skabs de thos nas khyim thab 3kyi mya ngan gyis bunon te gdong mchi mas rlan cing me tog phreng dang / rgyan dang spud pa rnams bor nas dka' ba spyod par byed de/ til 'bru gcig dang /'bras 'bru gcig phyedang / sran ko la 'bru gcig dang / rgya sran 'bru gcig dang / mon sran gre'u 'bru gcig dang / mon sran sde'u cha'abru gcig gi ༅zas 4—57

za zhing rtswa'i gding ba la nyal bar byed do/ /de'i rum mi bde'o zhes rgyal po zas gtsang gis thos nas des bsams ①pa/ gal te grags 'dzin mas byang chub sems dpa'i gtam nyi ma re re ②zhing thos na 0khyim thab ④kyi mya ngan gyis non te dka' ba spyad pa 'dis mngal mi 'chags pa'am/ srog 'chad ⑤par 'gyur ba'i gnas 'di yod pas des na grags 'dzin ma la byang chub sems dpa'i gtam su yang gleng bar ⑥mi 'gyur ro snyam nas/ rgyal po zas gtsang gis ⑦btsun mo'i 'khor gyi ②skye bo thams cad la khrims su bcas pa/ sus kyang byang 0chub sems dpa'i gtam grags 'dzin ma la brjod par mi bya'o/ /gtam skyel ba la yang bsgo ba/ nga ma gtogs par su la yang byang chub sems dpa'i gtam brjod par mi bya'o/ /rang gis thos na tho )yang grags 'dzin ma la bsams nas mya ngan mnags 3)te gang thos na btsun mo grags 'dzin ma mi 'chi bar 'gyur 8ba'i gtam gzhan gyis btsun mo'i ci'akhor la 'drid par byed dol/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam du dgongs te/ lam 'di yang shes par nus pa ma yin/ mthong bar nus pa ma yin/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs par 8byang chub par nus pa ma yin no snyam mo/ /de 'di snyam du dgongs te/ ma la bdag gis kha zas shin tu ngan pa bza' bar bya'o snyam ste/des ④kha zas shin tu ngan pa gsol bar mdzad do/ /de la zas phal pa ni 'di yin te/ be'u byung tsonas ring po ma lon par ma'i tshu'o ma 'thung ba gang yin pa de rnams kyi gcin dang lci ba yin no/ /ji ltar 0de'i sku las mdangs de yal bar ma gyur pa de srid du zas gnyis pa mi gsol te/ yal nas kha zas phyi ma gsol bar mdzad do/ /dur khrod chen por gshegs nas kyang mi ro dbu rten ⑫1—58

du bcug /zhabs la zhabs bzhag ste snang ba'i 'du shes dang / ca dran pa dang shes bzhin dang / ldang ba'i 'du shes yid la mdzad pas glo g.yas pas mnal bar mdzad do/ /de'i tshe grong khyer gyi gzhon nu rnams dang / grong khyer gyi gzhon nu ma rnams lhags nas shing bus de'i snyan gnyis kyi bu gar 'dzugs ①par byed / rna ba gnyis ②nas 'dren par byed cing 'di skad ces kye phyag dar khrod kyi sha za la ltos/ kye phyag dar khrod kyi sha za la ltos zhes ②smra bar yang byed do/ /de'i tshe phyag dar dang bong rdog dang / gseg ④mas kyang 'thor bar byed do/ /'on kyang byang chub sems dpa' ni grong khyer gyi gzhon nu rnams sam/ grong khyer gyi gzhon nu ma de rnams la ngan sems skyed ⑤pa'am/ sdig pa'i tshig dbyung ⑥bar mi dgongs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' de lta bu'i dka' ⑦ba spyod pa na 'di snyam du dgongs te/ gang su dag sdug bsngal spang bar brtson ⑧par gnas pa de thams cad ni 'di tsam du zad de/ de las lhag pa yang med de'i gong na yang med na⑨/ lam 'di yang shes par nus pa ma yin/ mthong bar nus pa ma yin/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs par byang chub par nus pa ma yin no snyam nas/ de zhum pa ma yin gyi hu) brtson 'grus brtsams pa yin/lus ma sbyangs pa ma yin gyi sbyangs pa yin/ rmongs pa ma yin gyi dran pa nye bar gzhag pa yin te/ sems rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag pa yin no/ /de 'di snyam du dgongs te/ shes par nus pa dang / mthong bar nus pa dang / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs par byang chub par nus pa'i lam de gang yin snyam ⑨na / de 'di snyam du dgongs te/ bdag yab shākya zas gtsang gi khyim na gnas pa'i tshe zhing las 8kyi mtha'i drung du song nas shing 'dzam bu'i grib ma la 4—59

'dug ste/ 'dod pa las dben pa/ sdig pa mi dge ba'i chos ①las dben pa/rtog pa dang bcas shing ②dpyod ③pa dang bcas pa④/ dben pa las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang / bde ba can ⑤bsam gtan dang po nye bar bsgrubs te gnas pa de mngon par dran te/ de ni lam yin/ de ni sgrub ⑥pa yin/ shes par nus pa yin/ mthong bar nus pa yin/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs par byang chub par nus pa yin na/ de bdag gis bskyed du yang 'di ltar rid cing nyam chung ⑦la zhan pas sla ②ba ma yin te/ ma la bdag gis ci bder dbugs rngub pa dang / ci bder dbugs 'byung ba dang / ci bder 'bras chan ⑨dang zan dron gyi kha zas rags pa bza' zhing lus mar sar dang til mar gyis byugs la chu 'jam pos lus bkru bar bya'o snyam ste/ de tsu )ci bder dbugs rngub pa dang / ci bder dbugs 'byung ba dang / ci bder 'bras chan dang zan dron gyi zhal zas rags pa gsol zhing sku til mar dang mar sar gyis byugs nas chu 'jam pos sku 'khru bar mdzad do// //'dul ba gzhi/ bam po brgyad bcu 7lnga pa/ de nas rim gro pa lnga po de rnams 'di snyam du sems te/ shes ldan dag dge sbyong gi ta ma 'di ni sdom pa lhod pa/ bya ba mang btso/ mang pos 'tsho ba/ spong ba mnyams par gyur pa yin te/ 'di da lta ci'abras chan chadang zan dron gyi kha zas mang du za la lus zhun mar dang til mar gyis byugs nas chu 'jam pos lus khrus (9byed de/'dis da ni chung zad kyang thob par mi nus so snyam du bsams nas byang chub sems dpa' bor te dong ba las/ rim gyis bā rā ṇa sīr 0phyin nas 'jig rten pa'i dgra bcom pa gang yin pa de tsol brten nas rab tu byung ste/ lnga po 1—60

de rnams blo mthun ①zhing lhan cig 'grogs la kun du dga' bas rtsod pa med par drang srong smra ba ri dgas kyi nags na gnas pas lnga sde lnga sde zhes bya bar gyur to / /byang chub sems dpas rim gyis lalus kyi stobs dang / mthu dang brtson 'grus yang dag par bskyed nas rim gyis ①sde can gyi grong khyer du gshegs sol/ /de na grong khyer gyi dpon po sde can zhes bya ba de la bu mo gnyis yod de/dga' mo dang / dga' stobs ma'o/ /de gnyis kyis shākya rnams kyi gzhon nu gangs ri'i ngos chu bo skal ldan shing rta'i 'gramathu/ drang srong ser skya'i bsti gnas dang ha cang yang mi ⑤ring bar byung ba de mtshan mkhan dang ltas mkhan gyi bram ze rnams kyis ༅'khor los ⑦snar ba'i rgyal por 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan pa de yang gzugs bzang ba/ blta na sdug pa/ mdzes pa/ mtshan thams cad dang ldan pa/ skye 2bo thams cad kyi yid 'phrog pa yin pas bud med gang gis lo bcu gnyis su 'di lta bu'i ⑨brtul zhugs yang dag par blangs te spyod pa de'i khyim thab ⑨ tu 'gyur ro zhes thos so/ /thos nas kyang bud med ni skyes pa la mngon par dga' ba yin pas de gnyis yikyis lo bcu gnyis su dka' thub blangs te de rdzogs par byas nas de rdzogs pa dang / lan bcu drug tu snying khur tsobyas pa'i 'o thug sbrang rtsi ltar mngar bas drang srong dka' thub kyis yongs su dub pa glo ⑫bur du 'ongs pa la 'bul ④bar byed do/ /de gnyis kyis ba stong bzhos nas ba stong po 8de nyid la blud do/ /de nas ⑩ba stong po de dag nyid ⑩bzhos nas lnga brgya la blud do/ /de nas lnga brgya phyepo de yidag bzhis nas lnga brgya po de dag nyid la blud do/ /de nas lnga brgya po de dag chabazhos nas nyis brgya lnga bcu la blud dol/ /de nas nyis brgya lnga bcu po de dag nyid bzhos nas nyis brgya lnga bcu po ⑥1—61

de dag ①la blud do/ /de nas nyis brgya ②lnga bcu po de dag nyid bzhis nas brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga la blud do/ /de nas brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga po de dag bzhos nas brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga po de dag nyid la blud do/ /de nas brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga po de dag bzhis nas drug bcu ②rtsa gsum ④la blud do/ /de nas drug bcu rtsa gsum po de dag bzhos nas drug bcu rtsa gsum po de dag nyid la blud do/ /de nas drug bcu rtsa gsum po de dag bzhos nas sum bcu rtsa gnyis la blud do/ /de nas sum bcu rtsa gnyis po de dag bzhos te/ sum bcu rtsa gnyis po de dag nyid la blud do/ /de nas sum bcu rtsa gnyis po de dag ⑤bzhos nas bcu drug la blud do/ /de nas bcu drug po de dag yibazhis nas bcu drug po de dag nyid la blud do/ /de nas bcu drug po de dag nyid bzhis nas brgyad la blud do/ /de nas brgyad po de dag nyid bzhos nas brgyad po de dag nyid la blud do/ /de nas brgyad po de dag nyid lan bcu drug tu snying khur ༅byas pa bzhos te/ shel las byas pa'i snod kyi nang du blugs nas bskol te 'o thug sbrang rtsi ltar mngar bar byed pa na gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha rnams kyis bsams pa/ 'o ma'i thug pa 'di byang chub sems dpas gsol na ⑤deng nyid du bla na med pa'i ye shes thob par ⑨'gyur gyis de lta bas na 'di la mthu zhig bstabs 0par bya'o snyam nas/ de rnams kyis mod la mthu skyed pa zhes bya ba'i sman blugs so/ /'o ma khol ba de la 'khor lo dang bkra shes dang / g.yung 0drung 'khyil pa'i mtshan ma dag snang ngo //der yang kun du 'tsho nyer 'gro zhes bya ba 'khyam zhing phyogs der phyin na 8des 'o ma'i thug pa de mthong nas/ des bsams pa/ 'o ma'i thug pa 'di sus 'thungs pa des deng nyid du bla na med pa'i tson shes thob par 'gyur gyis/ ma 1—62

la bdag gis 'di bslang ngo snyam nas re zhig ①ma phyung ②gi bar du de yud tsam zhig mtha' gcig ②tu song ste bsdad nas des song ste/du smras pa/ kho bo bkres pa dang skom pas dub cing nyen ⑤gyis 'di kho bo la lud ༅cig /de gnyis kyis smras pa/ mi sbyin no/ /de cang mi smra bar song ngo / /de nas de gnyis kyis 0shel las byas pa'i snod kyi nang nas rin po che'i yol go'i nang du blugs so/ /lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyi ⑧shis pa mthong ba ni 'og tu 'jug pa yin pas des de'i bram ze'i cha byad du mngon par sprul nas de gnyis kyi mdun du 'dug go/ /tshangs pa ⑨yang 'ongs nas de dang nye ba zhig tu 'dug go/ /de gnyis kyis brgya byin la sbyin pa (bye sbyin par brtsams pa dang /des smras pa/ ci bdag la sbyin nam/ 'on te bdag bas ches khyad par du 'phags pa gang yin pa de skyel sbyin de gnyis kyis smras pa/ khyod bas ches khyad par 8'phags pa gang yin pa de la phul 8lo/ /des smras pa/ tshangs pa 'di ni bdag bas ches khyad par du 'phags pa yin gyis tsu'ude la phul cig /de gnyis kyis de la sbyin par brtsams pa dang / des smras pa/ ci bdag la sbyin nam / 'on te bdag bas ches khyad par du 'phags pa gang yin pa de (smel/de gnyis kyis smras pa/ khyod bas ches khyad par du phya'aphags pa gang yin pa de la dbul lo/ /des smras pa/ gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha 'di dag ni bdag bas ches khyad par du ⑩'phags pa yin gyis de dag la phul cig /de gnyis kyis de dag la sbyin par brtsams pa dang / de dag gis kyang smras pa/ ci bdag cag la sbyin nam/ 'on te bdag cag bas ches khyad par du tso'aphags pa gang ⑪yin pa de (sprel/ de gnyis kyis smras pa/ khyed ( 〉bas ches khyad par du ( spre1—63

'phags pa gang yin pa de ①la'o/ /de dag gis smras pa/ byang chub sems dpa' bcom ldan 'das 'di chu klung nai rañdza nar ②zhugs nas sku khrus mdzad de nyam ③chung ba nyid kyis bzhengs mi spyod pa zhig yod de/ de bdag cag bas ches khyad par du 'phags pa yin gyis de la phul cig /de gnyis de'i drung du chas pa dang ④/ de'i tshe lha rnams kyis shing ardzu na'i yal ga btud nas btud pa la byang chub sems dpa' 'jus te chu klung nai rañdza na nas byung nas chos gos bgos te chu klung nai rañdza na'i 'gram na bzhugs so/ /de nas de gnyis kyis gus pa dang bsam pa drag pos de la 'o thug sbrang rtsi ltar mngar ba de phul lo/ /byang chub sems dpas kyang de gnyis rjes su gzung ⑤ba'i phyir bzhes so/ /bzhes nas gsungs pa/ ci yol go ⑥'di yang ⑦yongs su btang dungam/ de gnyis kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di yang yongs su btang spulags so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas 'o thug sbrang rtsi ltar mngar ba gsol nas ⑩yol go de bkrus te chu klung nai rañdza nar bor ba klu rnams kyis blangs so/ /'di ni chos nyid yin te/ lha rnams kyi shes pa mthong ba ni 'og tu 'jug pa yin pas lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyis nam mkha' lding gi cha byad du sprul te/ chu klung nai rañdza na dkrugs nas klu skrag par byas te yol go de phrogs skyonas sum bcu rtsa gsum gyi lha rnams kyi nang du khyer te yol go'i tho)mchod pa chen po btsugs so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas tsodaga' mo dang / dga' stobs ④la gsungs pa/ sbyin pa 'dis ci zhig don du gnyer/ de gnyis kyis gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das shākya rnams kyi gzhon nu gangs ri'i ngos/ chu bo skal ldan shing rta'i 'gram/ drang srong ser skya'i bsti gnas dang ha cang yang mi ring bar 1—64

byung ba de mtshan mkhan dang ltas mkhan gyi bram ze rnams kyis 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por lung bstan pa zhig mchis pa de sems bskyed pa dang zhal zas phul ba'i dge ba'i rtsa bas ①bdag cag gi khyim thab tu gyur cig /byang chub sems dpas gsungs pa/ de 'dod pa rnams la don du mi gnyer bas rab tu byung zin no/ /de gnyis kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das gal te 'dod pa rnams don du mi gnyer na/ bsod pa phul ba'i bsod nams ci mchis pas/ /grags dang ldan pa ②don rnams kun grub pa/ /mi yi mchog gyur blo shemachog ldan pa de'i/ /don kun myur du shin tu grub gyur cig /byang chub sems dpas de bzhin du gyur cig ces gsungs nas 'o thug sbrang rtsi ltar mngar ba gsol te/ dbang po drug tshim zhing stobs dang mthu thob nas chu klung nai rañdza na'i 'gram na phan tshun du bzhugs pa'i sa btsal ba dang / ji tsam na ri brags thuchen po me tog dang 'bras bu sna tshogs dang ldan pa zhig gzigs nas/de de la 'dzegs te phyogs dben zhing gsal ba'i sa phyogs su skyil mo krung ⑤bcas te bzhugs so/ /bzhugs ma thag tu ri de nyid nyil yoto/ /byang chub sems dpas dgongs pa/ nges par bdag gis las skyon can zhig byas te des na ri 'di nyil ⑦sto snyam mo/ /lha rnams kyi ②sems kyis byang chub sems dpa'i ⑨thugs shes nas gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das khyod kyis skyon can gyi phrin cilas ma mdzad do/ /'on kyang 'di ni chos nyid lags te/ sa thams cad kyis gzung yibar rngo mi thog ④pa ni gnyis te/ dge ba'i rtsa ba chad pa cigang lags pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba sbyangs pa gang lags pa'o/ /khyod ni dge ba'i rtsa ba sbyangs pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams 1—65

kyi gnas ma lags te/ 'on kyang chu klung nai rañdza na rgol la phyogs che ge mo zhig na rdo rje'i gdan mchis kyis ①bzhud cig /der ni 'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bzhugs nas bla na med pa'i ye shes thob par gyur cing thob par 'gyur ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' lhas lam bstan pa ②bzhin gshegs pa na ③de'i zhabs bzhag par pad ma dag byung ④bar gyur to/ /rgya lamatsho chen po bzhi las kyang chu bab yinas pad ma'i rdzing dag byung bar gyur to/ /gom pa bor nas mnan pa na sa chen po 'di khar rnguba'i snod bzhin du sgra 'byin par brtsams so/ /bya tsa sha dang ri dgas dag gis kyang byang chub sems dpa' la skor ba byed do/ /rlung gtong ba'i lha'i bu rnams kyis kyang dal bu dudal bus rlung gtong bar byed do/ /char pa rtsa'abebs pa'i lha'i bu rnams kyis kyang char pa chung 7zad 'bebs par byed do/ /byang chub sems dpas skyedagongs pa/ nga la 'di 'dra ba'i mtshan ma byung bar gyur pas deng nyid bdag gis bla na med pa'i ye shes thob par 'gyur ro snyam mo/ /chu klung nai rañdza nar klu'i rgyal po dus 8can sngon gyi las kyi rnam par smin pa las skyes pa'i gnas shig byung bar gyur te/ de sangs rgyas byung zhing sangs rgyas 'byung ba skyon mig thob par 'gyur ba yin pas de sa'i sgra grags pas gnas nas byung ba na rgyang ring po kho na nas byang chub sems dpa' ④sku skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum bcu rtsa gnyis kyis 8kun nas brgyan pa/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad bcus 7spras pa/ 'od 'dom gang gis brgyan pa/ nyi ma stong bas lhag pa'i 'od zer dang / rin po che'i ri bo 'gro ba ltar kun nas mdzes pa ⑩mthong ngo / /mthong ma thag tu byang chub sems dpa' la tshigs su 1—66

bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis bstod ①par brtsams pa/ dga' ba'i dbyangs kyis ②kun gang ba'i②/ /sa yi sgra ni thos nas kyang / /klu ni gnas nas byung nas su//phyogs kun du yang lta ④bar byed/ /brang gis 'gro ba'i gtso bo ste/ /klu yi rgyal po mthu chen gyis/ /nai rañdza na'i ngos su ni/ /'jig rten 'dren pa gshegs pa mthong / /sangs rgyas byung ba'i mthu yis ni/ /klu yis mig ni thob gyur te/ /sems dga' zhing ni yid mgu nas/ /des ⑤ni 'di skad tshig gsol to/ /bdag gis sngon ni mthong ba yi/ /sangs rgyas mthu chen de rnams dang / /thub pa khyod ni mthong gyur na༅/ /de dang tha dad dbyer ma mchis/ /thub pa ji ltar thog mar ni/ /g.yas pa'i zhabs ni bteg pa las/ /khyod ni sangs rgyas deng ④gyur nas/ /'jig rten gyi ⑧ni yon gnas 'gyur ⑨/ /ji ltar chos gos mnabs ⑩pa dang / /nai rañdza na'i chu bsil la/ /ji lta bur ni 'jug pa las/ /de ring khyod ni sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /ji ltar rab brten 0'gros su gshegs pa dang / /ba lang khyu mchog 'gying ba ltar gshegs pas/ / skyes bu mkhyu mchog chos 'dzin rnams kyi mchog /deng 'dir khyod ni sangs rgyas mchog 'gyur ro/ /da 0ltar mkha' la tsa 8sha brgya phrag gis/ /khyod sku rgya chen rgya chen mdzad de la8/ /lding zhing bskor ba bgyid par gyur pa las/ /mi mchog deng ni sangs rgyas mchog 'gyur ro/ /ji ltar dri zhim rlung ni ldang ba dang / /ri dgas bya yi tshogs kyang mi skrag la/ /ljon shing rlung gis g.yos ⑩par ma gyur ⑩pas/ /mi mchog deng ni sangs rgyas mchog 'gyur ro/ /ji ltar btsun pa khyod kyi zhal gyi 'od//dri med gser 'od 'bar ba 'dra ba de/ / rnam par mdzes shing 8kha dog ldan pas na/ /mi mchog deng ⑩ni sangs rgyas mchog 'gyur ro// //1—67

bar sdom la/ sgra dang mthong dang sangs rgyas dang / /rdzogs dang zhabs ①dang chos gos dang / /brten dudang rtswa ②sha de bzhin rlung / /khyod gtogs pa dang de bcu'o④/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' klu'i rgyal po dus ⑤can gyis yang dag par bstod nas rdo rje'i gdan logs su gshegs te des dgongs pa/ rtswa'i gding ba la 'dug par bya'o snyam pa dang / de la rtswa'i ⑥dgos pa byung bar lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyi ⑦sems kyis byang chub sems dpa'i dgongs pa shes nas/ ri spos kyi ngad ldang las shing bal gyi 'dab ma ⑤ltar reg na bde ba'i rtswa khur gcig 0blangs nas rtswa ⑨ 'tshong bkra shis kyi kha dog tu bdag nyid mngon par sprul te byang chub sems dpa'i spyan sngar ⑪bsdad do/ /byang chub sems dpas gsungs pa/ bzhin bzangs rtsartswa 'o ni dag nga tsol phul cig /lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyis byang chub sems dpa'i zhabs gnyis la gtugs nas gus pa dang bcas pas phul lo/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas bkra shis kyi rtswa 8'tshong las rtswa 8bzhes te lha rnams kyis bstan pa'i lam nas byang chub kyi ④snying po gang na ba der gshegs te byon nas rtswa ⑩rnams ma 'khrugs pa dang / stug srab med pa 8dgram par brtsams so de nas rtswa 8de rnams bskor thabs su lhung nas byang chub sems dpas dgongs pa/ji ltar rtswa du 'di rnams bskor thabs su lhung ba las bdag gis gdon mi za bar deng bla na med pa'i ye shes rtogs par 'gyur ro snyam du dgongs nas rdo rje'i gdan la 'dzegs te brang gis 'gro ba'i 0rgyal po gnyid log pa'i lus bskyil tsob ltar skyil mo krung tsobacas sku drang por bsrang dran pa mngon du phyogs par bzhag ④ste bzhugs nas sems bskyed cing tshig tu yang gsungs pa/ ji srid zag pa 1—68

zad pa ma thob kyi bar du skyil mo krung ①gzhig par mi bya'o zhes des re zhig zag pa zad pa ma thob kyi bar du skyil mo krung ②ma bshig go/ /bdud sdig can gyi ①rgyal mtshan gnyis po dga' ba'i gnas dang / dogs pa'i gnas gnyis yod pa las / dogs pa'i gnas kyi rgyal mtshan g.yo bar brtsams so/ /sdig can gyis bsams pa/ ji ltar rgyal mtshan 'di g.yo ba las gdon mi za bar gnod pa ⑤byed pa zhig byung ngo snyam ste/ de bsam ⑤pa la zhugs pa dang / ji tsam na byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje'i gdan la bzhugs pa mthong ngo / /de 'di snyam du sems te/ shākya zas gtsang gi bu 'di rdo rje'i yigadan la 'dug gis/ ci ⑦tsam bdag gi ⑤yul las ma 'das kyi bar du de la bgegs bya'o snyam du bsams nas phrin yig skyel ⑨ba skra gyen du 'greng ba ⑩/ sha na'i smad g.yogs bgos pa zhig gi kha dog tu mngon par sprul nas/ byang chub sems dpa' gang na ba der song ste phyin nas rtabs ⑩par smras pa/ grong khyer ser skya'i gzhi ni lhas byin gyis mnan pho brang ni bcom/ shākya rnams ni kha btag 4)na khyod ci'i phyir gnas btab ste 'dug /de na ⑫ byang chub sems dpa' la sdig pa mi dge ba'i rnam par rtog pa gsum skyes pa 'di lta ste/ 'dod pa'i rnam par rtog pa dang /gnod sems kyi rnam par rtog pa dang / rnam par 'tshe ba'i rnam par rtog pa'obya//de la 'dod pa'i rnam par rtog pa ni grags 'dzin ma dang / ri dgas skyes dang /sa 'tsho ma la'o/ /gnod sems kyi rnam par rtog pa ni lhas byin ④la'o/ /rnam par 'tshe ba'i rnam par rtog pa ni de'i rjes su 'tsho ba'i shākya rnams la'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam du dgongs te/ ci'i phyir bdag la sdig pa mi dge ba'i rnam par rtog pa gsum skyes 8snyam na/ ji tsam na ⑩bdud sdig can 'di 1—69

lta ste/ dkrug ①pa'i las kyi phyir nye bar 'ongs pa ②gzigs so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' la chadage ba'i rnam par rtog pa gsum skyes te/ 'di lta ste④ / nges par 'byung ba'i rnam par rtog pa dang / gnod sems med pa'i rnam par rtog pa dang /⑤ rnam par mi 'tshe ba'i rnam par rtog pa'o/ /yang bdud kyis smras pa/ khyod ci'i phyir byang chub kyi snying po la 'dug /byang chub sems dpas bka' stsal pa/ bla na med pa'i ye shes thob par bya ba'i phyir ro/ /bdud kyis smras pa/ khyod kyis bla na med pa'i ye shes ga la thob/ byang chub sems dpas bka' stsal pa/ sdig can khyod kyis re zhig mchod sbyin gcig byas pas kyang 'dod pa'i khams kyi ⑥dbang phyug phun sum tshogs par gyur na/ ngas bskal pa grangs med pa gsum du mchod sbyin bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag du ma byas shing sems can rnams kyi phyir mgo dang / lag pa dang / rkang pa dang /mig dang / sha dang / khrag dang / bu dang / chung ma dang / dbyig ⑦ dang / gser la sogs pa yongs su btang bas bla na med pa'i ye shes thob par 'gyur ba lta smos kyang ci dgos te/ ngas bla na med pa'i ye shes thob par mi 'gyur ba de srid re skan/ de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / bdud kyis smras pa / re zhig ji ltar bdag gi ④mchod sbyin gcig 0gis 'dod pa'i ⑩khams kyi dbang phyug thob par gyur pa'i bdag gi dpang ni khyod nyid yin na/ ji ltar khyod kyi 0bla na med pa'i ye shes thob par bya ba'i phyir bskal pa grangs med pa gsum du mchod sbyin bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag du ma byas shing sems can rnams kyi phyir mgo dang / lag pa dang / rkang pa dang / mig dang / sha dang / khrag dang / bu dang / chung ma dang / dbyig dang / gser la 1—70

sogs pa yongs su btang bar khyod la dpang du su ①yod/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' bcom ldan 'das kyi ②phyag la'akhor lo dang / bkra shis dang /g.yung drung 'khyil ④pa dang / dra bas 'brel pa bsod nams brgya phrag du mas bskyed pa skrag pa rnams la dbugs 'byin par mdzad pas sa la reg par mdzad nas ngas bskal pa grangs med pa gsum du mchod sbyin bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag du ma byas shing sems can ⑤rnams kyi phyir mgo dang / lag pa dang /rkang pa dang / mig dang / sha dang / khrag dang / bu dang / chung ma dang / dbyig dang / gser la sogs pa yongs su btang ba'i nga'i dpang ni sa ⑥'di yin no/ /de nas sa'i lhas sa brtol nas thal mo sbyar te skad phyung ba⑦ / sdig can bcom ldan 'das kyis ji skad ⑤bka' stsal pa de ⑨bzhin yin ⑩rna zhes de skad smras pa dang / bdud sdig can cang chumi smra tsobar gyur te/zhum zhum por gyur/ bag 'khums par gyur/ spyi bo smad nas spobs pa med la sems khong du 8chud cing 'dug par ④gyur te/ de sdug bsngal zhing yid mi bde bas bsams pa/ bdag gis shākya zas gtsang gi bu la de ltar byas kyang glags 8ma rnyed kyis/ ma la 'di la bdag gis yang ⑩bgegs shig bya'o zhes smras nas song ngo / / de nas ⑩des bu mo gsum po sred ma dang / dga' byed ma dang / dga' spyod ma mngags te de rnams gzugs dang / lang tsho'i ⑫rgyags pas dregs shing lha'i gos dang rgyan gyis bklubs yinas byang chub sems dpa'i mdun du bud med kyi g.yo rnams bstan par brtsams so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' thabs la mkhas pas ji ltar rgan mor gyur pa de ltar byin gyis brlabs nas bdud gang na ba der dong ba dang / bdud kyis de ⑩rnams de lta 1—71

bu'i rnam par mthong nas yi chad nas lag pa la 'gram pa gtad de gang gis na shākya zas gtsang ①gi bu'i rgyadaka' thub la bgegs byed par 'gyur ba'i thabs legs pa ci yod snyam nas sems khong du ③chud cing 'dug go/ /des 'byung po'i ④dpung tshogs dang ldan pa glang po che dang / rta dang / rnga mo dang /ra dang / ri dgas dang / ma he dang / phag dang / khyi dang / 'ug pa dang / ne'u le dang / spre'u dang / wa la sogs pa 'dra ba ral gri ⑤dang ⑥/mda' bo che dang / mtshon rtse gcig pa dang / 'khor lo dang / mdung thung dang / gzhu dang / zhags pa dang / dgra sta dang / lcags kyi ber ka ⑦la sogs te mtshon cha can bye ba phrag sum bcu rtsa drug ded nas rang nyid gzhu rna drung du bkang ⑧ste byang chub sems dpa' yongs su ⑨bskor nas 'dug go/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas skyo gzugs rnam pa du ma can mtshon cha rnam pa sna tshogs mang po dang bcas pa de rnams gzigs nas dgongs pa/ re zhig pho ⑩phal pa zhig dang lhan cig 'thab par rtsom tson yang de'i gnyen po'i phyogs la sbyor ba byed na 'dod pa'i khams kyi dbang phyug 'di la lta smos kyang ci dgos kyis/ma la bdag gis gnyen po'i phyogs la sbyar bar bya'o snyam du dgongs nas de zhi bar 'gyur ba'i thabs la dgongs par brtsams so/ /bdud kyis 8'byung po bye ba phrag sum bcu rtsa drug dang lhan cig tu byang chub sems dpa'i steng nas 'khor lo dang / mdung dang / mda' bo che dang / mtshon rtse gcig pa dang /mda' la sogs pa'i ④mtshon cha rnams tsodabab par brtsams so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' byams pa la snyoms par zhugs pa na de'i tshumatshon cha de rnams lha'i me tog ut+pa la dang / pad ma dang / ku mu da chadang / pad ma dkar 1—72 ci

por gyur nas byang chub sems dpa'i nye 'khor du 'bab par brtsams so /de nas bdud steng gi bar snang la ①mngon par 'phags te phyag dar gyi char dbab par brtsams na/ de yang lha'i me tog man dā ②ra ba rnams su gyur nas byang chub sems dpa'i steng nas 'bab par brtsams ①so/ /de nas bdud kyis gdug ④pa'i rlung dang / rdo'i char phab pa dang / gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha rnams kyis byang chub sems dpa'i steng du lo ⑤ma las ma yin pa'i spyil po mngon par sprul pas rdo'i char dang gdug pa'i rlung du bcas pa des byang chub sems dpa' la chung ༅zad kyang gnod par ma gyur to/ /bdud kyis bsams pa/bdag gis nam du yongs su bskor te 'dug /bsam gtan gyi tsher ma ni sgra yin gyi༅/ byang chub kyi shing shel las byas par mngon par sprul la song ba ⑤dang / de'i lo ma rnams rtag par sgra 'byin ⑨pas de'i sems rtse gcig par mi 'gyur ro snyam du bsams nas byang chub kyi shing shel las byas par (rtemangon par sprul te/ rna ba gtad nas bsgrims ༅te bsdad pa na byang chub kyi shing gi lo ma 8shel las byas pa rnams myur ba myur bar sgra 'byin par brtsams pas bsam gtan gyi tsher ma ni sgra yin pasabla / byang chub sems dpas sems rtse gcig pa ma thob bo/ /gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha rnams kyis bsams ④pa/shel las byas pa'i byang chub kyi shing gi lo ma shel las byas pa 8rnams kyi sgras byang chub sems dpa' sems rtse gcig pa ma thob kyis thabs shig bsham par bya'o snyam ste/ de nas de rnams kyis lo ma re re bzung na/ 'on kyang bdud kyi dpung de bzhin du gnas nas gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha rnams kyis (9bsams pa/ bdud sdig can 'di 4)ni ring mo zhig tu byang chub 1—73

sems dpa' la rnam par 'tshe bar 'gyur ro snyam du bsams nas bdud kyi dpung de khor yug gi pha rol du 'phangs so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' bcom ldan 'das lteng ①rgyas nas 'bab chu ②rna ③rardzo na'i 'gram byang chub kyi ④shing drung du bzhugs te rtag tu bya ba dang / 'grus skyong dang ldan zhing ⑤byang chub kyi phyogs dang mthun pa'i chos rnams la bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor gyi rjes su brtson pas bzhugs so/ /de nam gyi thun dang po la rdzu 'phrul gyi yul shes pa mngon sum du bya ba'i mngon par shes pa la dgongs pa mngon du bzhag pa na/de rdzu 'phrul gyi yul rnam pa du ma nyams su myong bar mdzad de⑥/ 'di lta ste gcig tu gyur cing mang por gyur pa dang ⑦/ mang por gyur cing gcig tu gyur pa dang / snang bar gyur cing mi snang bar gyur pa ye shes gzigs pas nyams su myong bar mdzad do/ /skus rtsig pa dang / ri dang / ra ba la yang thad kur gshegs par mdzad ⑤de/ dper na nam mkha' la bya ba bzhin no/ /sa la yang steng du 'byung ba dang / byi'u zul ⑨mdzad de/ dper na chu la bya ba bzhin no/ /chu'i rgyun la yang mi nyams par gshegs te/ dper na sa la bya ba bzhin no/ /nam mkha' la yang skyil mo krung ⑫ gis gshegs par mdzad de/dper na 'dab tsu〉chags bya bzhin no/ /nyi ma dang zla ba 'di 8gnyis 'di ltar rdzu 'phrul che btso/ 'di ltar gzi brjid che ba la ciphyag gis rnam zhing nyug par mdzad cing tshangs pa'i 'jig rten gyi bar du skus tusredabang sgyur bar 4)mdzad do/ /yang bdud kyis bsams pa/ bsam gtan gyi tsher ma ⑩sgra yin pas ma la bdag gis rgyang ring po kho tsonar 'dug la sgra dbyung bar bya'o snyam nas des 'byung po bye ba phrag sum bcu rtsa drug dang / 'jigs yipa chen 4—74

po 'jigs su rung ba'i sgra phyung ngo / /byang chub sems dpas kyang de bsgrib ①pa'i phyir dpag tshad bcu gnyis kyi bar du shing ka dam pa'i tshal sprul pas des na sgra de rdugs ②pas mi grag go②/ /byang chub sems dpas dgongs pa / ma la bdag gis lha'i rna ba shes pa mngon sum du bya ba'i mngon par shes pa la sems mngon du bzhag nas/ des na lha dang ④mi rnams kyi sgra gang dang gang dag thos par 'dod pa de dag mnyan par bya'o snyam du dgongs nas lha'i rna ba shes pa mngon sum ⑤du bya ba'i mngon par shes pa la dgongs ༅pa bzhag pa na/ de lha'i snyan rnam par dag pa mi rnams kyi las 'das pas sgra gnyis po mi rnams ⑦dang / mi ma ⑤yin pa rnams kyi dang / gang dag ring ba dang / gang dag nye ⑨ba yang gsan to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas dgongs pa/ bdud kyi 'khor 'byung po bye ba phrag sum bcu rtsa drug las bdag la 0su dag ni gnod par yisems/ su dag ni ma yin zhes de dag ji ltar shes par bya snyam pa dang de 'di snyam du dgongs 8te/ sems kyi rnam grangs shes pa mngon sum du bya ba'i mngon par shes pa yin no snyam nas/ de nam gyi gung thun la sems kyi rnam grangs shes pa mngon sum du bya ba'i mngon par shes pa la dgongs pa mngon du bzhag pa na/ de'i thugs kyis sems can gzhan dag dang gang zag gzhan gyi 8rnam par rtog pa dang / rnam par dpyod pa'i yid ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu mkhyen te④/ 'dod chags dang bcas pa'i sems la 'dod chags dang bcas pa'i sems so zhes ji lta ④ba bzhin du rab tu mkhyen to/ /'dod chags dang 7bral ba'i sems la 'dod chags dang bral ba'i sems so zhes ⑩ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu mkhyen to/ /zhe snang dang bcas pa dang / zhe snang 1—75

dang bral ba dang / gti mug dang bcas pa dang / gti mug dang bral ba ①dang / bsdus pa dang / rnam par g.yengs pa dang / zhum pa dang /rab tu 'dzin pa dang / rgod pa dang / mi rgod pa dang / nye bar ma zhi ba dang / nye bar zhi ba dang / mnyam par ma bzhag pa dang / mnyam par bzhag pa dang / ma bsgoms pa dang / bsgoms ②pa dang / sems rnam ②par ma grol ba dang / rnam par grol ba zhes ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu mkhyen to//shin tu rnam par grol ba'i sems la ④shin tu rnam par grol ba'i sems so zhes ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu mkhyen to/ /de 'di snyam du dgongs te/ bdud kyi mngag gzhug pa 'di rnams las su dag bdag dang tshe rabs gzhan na mar 'brel ba'am/ phar 'brel ba'am/ su dag gshed ma'am/ phyir rgol ba'am⑤/dgrar gyur pa de dag ji ltar shes par bya snyam mo/ /de 'di snyam du dgongs yite/sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa'i shes pa mngon sum du bya ba'i mngon par shes pa yin no snyam nas/ de nam gyi ༅gung thun la sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa'i shes pa mngon sum du bya ba'i mngon par shes pa la dgongs pa mngon du bzhag pa na/des sngon gyi gnas rnam pa du ma rjes su dgongs te/ 'di lta ste/② des skye ba gcig dang / gnyis dang / gsum dang / bzhi dang / lnga dang /drug dang / bdun dang / brgyad dang / dgu dang / bcu dang / nyi shu dang / sum bcu dang / bzhi bcu dang / lnga bcu dang / skye ba brgya dang /skye ba stong dang / skye ba brgya stong dang /7 skye ba brgya phrag du ma dang / skye ba stong phrag du ma dang / skye ba brgya stong phrag du ma dang / 'jig pa'i bskal pa ⑩dang / 'chags yipa'i bskal 8pa dang / 'jig pa dang 'chags ⑩pa'i 1—76

bskal ①pa dang / 'jig pa'i bskal ②pa du ma dang / 'chags ⑧pa'i bskal pa du ma dang / 'jig dupa dang 'chags ⑤pa'i bskal pa du ma rjes su dgongs te / bdag sngon sems can 'di dag gi nang na gnas pa na ming ni du'adi zhes bya/ rigs ni 'di zhes bya①/ rus ni 'di zhes bya/ ⑧zas ni 'di lta bu zhig za zal/ bde ba dang sdug bsngal ni ⑨ 'di lta bu zhig nyams su myong /tshe ni 'di srid cig lon/ yun yini 'di srid cig 'dug 'dug /tshe ni ⑩'di srid cig lon te gnas de nas bdag shi 'phos te che ge mo zhig tu skyes so/ /de nas kyang shi 'phos nas che ge mo zhig tu skyes so/ /de nas kyang shi 'phos nas 'dir skyes so zhes bya ba rnam pa tsodang bcas te skeyul phyogs dang bcas par ⑫sngon gyi gnas rnam pa du ma rjes su dgongs so/ /de 'di snyam du dgongs te/bdud kyi mngag gzhug 'di rnams las su dag ni ngan song du 'gro/ su dag ni mi 'gro ba de dag ji ltar shes par bya 0snyam mo/ /de 'di snyam du dgongs te/'chi 'pho dang skye ba shes pa mngon sum du bya ba'i mngon par shes pa yin no snyam ste / de nam gyi 0thun tha ma la 'chi 'pho dang skye ba shes pa mngon sum du bya ba'i mngon par shes pa la dgongs pa mngon du bzhag pa na/ de'i lha'i spyan rnam par dag pa mi rnams kyi las 'das pas gzigs na sems can rnams kyi 'chi 'pho dang / skye ba dang / kha dog bzang po dang / kha dog ngan pa dang /dman pa dang / gya rnam pa dang / bde 'gro dang / ngan 'gro dang /tunyengan 'gror 'gro ba'i sems can rnams las ji lta ba bzhin gyi rjes su 'gro ba ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu mkhyen te/ shes ldan sems can 'di zhes bya ba 'di ⑪dag ni lus kyi nyes par spyod pa dang ldan⑥/ ngag dang yid kyi nyes par spyod pa 1—77

dang ldan te/ 'phags pa rnams la skur pa 'asdebs pa log par lta ba ste/log par lta ba'i chos dang las yang dag par blangs ①pa'i rgyus rgyu de dang rkyen des lus zhig nas shi ba'i 'og tu ngan song ②ngan 'gro log par ltung ba sems can dmyal ba rnams su skye bar 'gyur ro/ /shes ldan sems can 'di dag ni ②lus kyi legs par spyod pa dang ldan/ ngag dang ④yid kyi legs par spyod pa dang ldan te/ 'phags pa rnams la skur pa mi 'debs shing yang dag par lta ba ste / yang dag par lta ba'i chos dang las yang dag par blangs pa'i rgyus rgyu de dang rkyen des lus zhig nas shi ba'i 'og tu bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten du lha dang mi rnams su skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de 'di snyam du dgongs te/ shes ldan sems can 'di dag ni 'dod pa'i zag pa dang / srid pa'i zag pa dang /ma rig pa'i zag pas 'khor ba na 'khor ro/ /'di rnams kyi 'dod pa'i zag pa dang / srid pa'i zag pa dang / ma rig pa'i zag pa de ji ltar spang ba de ⑤ji ltar shes par bya snyam mo/ /de 'di snyam du dgongs te/ zag pa zad pa shes pa mngon sum du bya ba'i mngon par shes pa yin no snyam ste༅/ de rtag tu byed ⑦pa dang / 'grus skyong dang ldan zhing byang chub kyi phyogs dang mthun pa'i chos rnams la bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor gyi rjes su brtson pas ⑧gnas nas zag pa med pa'i shes pa mngon sum du bya ba'i mngon par shes pa la dgongs pa mngon du bzhag pa na/ des 'di ni 0sdug bsngal 'phags pa'i bden pa'o zhes ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu mkhyen to/ /'di ni sdug bsngal kun 'byung ba'o/ /'di ni sdug bsngal 'gog pa'o/ /'di ni sdug ⑩bsngal 'gog par 'gro ba'i lam yi'aphags pa'i bden pa'o zhes ji lta tsob bzhin du rab tu mkhyen to/ /de 4—78

de ltar shes shing de ①ltar mthong na 'dod pa'i ②zag pa las sems rnam par grol bar 'gyur zhing nisrid pa'i zag pa dang / ma rig pa'i zag pa las sems rnam par grol bar 'gyur rodu/ /rnam par grol nas rjobadag gi skye ba zad do/ /tshangs par spyod pa la bsten ༅to/ /bya ba byas so/ /'di las srid pa gzhan mi shes so zhes rnam par grol ba'i ye shes nyid mthong bar 'gyur rol/ /de ltar de na bcom ldan 'das byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te/ bya ba byas / byed pa byas nas me'i khams la snyoms par zhugs ⑧so/ /gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpas ⑨bdud kyi 'khor 'byung po bye ba phrag sum bcu rtsa drug byams pa'i mtshon gyis tho )mngon du 0bcom nas bla na med pa'i ye shes brnyes pa'i tshe bdud sdig can gyi tsolag nas gzhu lhung / rgyal mtshan 'gyel/gnas kyang g.yos so/ /de nas bdud sdig can tho)'byung po'i 'khor bye ba phrag sum bcu rtsa drug sdug bsngal zhing yid mi bde ba yid la bcags ④te de nyid du mi snang bar gyur to/ /bdud kyi ris kyi tho)lha rnams kyis grong khyer ser skya'i gzhir byang chub sems dpa' shākya thub pa ni dka' ba lo drug spyad nas rdo rje'i gdan la ⑩'dzegs te rtswa'i cigading ba la grongs so zhes bsgrags 8pa gang yin pa de yirgyal po zas gtsang btsun mo dang / gzhon nu dang / blon po'i tshogs dang / grong khyer ser skya na gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs dang bcas pas thos nas sdug bsngal 0 chen po dang yid mi bde bas gdungs par gyur to/ /sa 'tsho ma dang / ri dgas skyes 0dang / grags 'dzin ma yang byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan rjes su dran nas brgyal te sa la 'gyel nas chus gtor ba las slar dbugs byung ngo / /btsun 3mo'i spro ba sring ba'i skye bo dag ni mig mchi 4—79

mas gang la myur ba myur bar dbugs brdzags ①shing dal bus snodal bus smre sngags 'don cing 'dug go/ /de dag sdug bsngal ba sangs rgyas la mngon par dad pa'i lha dga' ba skyes pa rnams kyis ①mthong nas byang chub sems dpa' shākya thub pa ma nongs te/ 'di ltar des bla na med pa'i ye shes bsnyes ④so zhes smras pa gang yin pa rgyal po zas gtsang ⑤'khor dang bcas pa dang / ser skya'i skye bo'i tshogs kyis thos nas mchog tu dga' ba skyes so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bla na med pa'i ye shes brnyes pa na grags 'dzin ma la yang khye'u zhig btsas so/ /bdud rtsi zas kyi yang khye'u zhig btsas so/ /zla ba yang sgra can ⑥gyis zin to/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang gis phun sum tshogs pa de mthong nas/ dga' ba dang / mgu ba dang / rab tu dga' ba dang / rangs ⑦pa rgya chen po dang /yid bde ba skyes par gyur to/ /des grong khyer ser skya'i dugazhi rdo ba dang /gseg ma dang / gyo mo rnams bsal ⑨nas tsan dan gyi chus chag chag btab/shin tu dri zhim po'i pog por ⑨ nye bar bshams/ dar gyi chun phyang ༅mang po dpyangs8 / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan bsgreng ⑫/ me tog sna tshogs kyis dga' dga' ltar bkram nas grong khyer gyi sgo bzhi dang sum tsomado rnams su tsosbyin gtong gi khang pa brtsigs so/ /de nas grong khyer gyi tsoshar sgor dge sbyong dang /bram ze dang hu)/ spyod pa pa dang / kun du rgyu dang / ngan pa dang /mgon med pa dang / bkren pa dang / phongs 8pa dang / slong yomo pa rnams la sbyin pa dag gtong ngo / /lho dang / nub dang / byang dang /dbus kyi sum mdo rnams su yang sbyin pa dag 0 gtong / bsod nams dag byed do/ /grags 'dzin ma'i bu'i ⑥ming 'dogs par byed de/ btsun mo'i 1—80

'khor gyi skye bos smras pa/ 'di btsas pa na zla ba sgra can ①gyis zin pa ②de bas na khye'u'i ②ming sgra can 0zin zhes gdags so zhes btags so/ /bdud rtsi zas kyi yang de bzhin du sbyin pa dag btang / bsod nams dag byas nas khye'u'i ming cir btags zhes 0bu'i ming 'dogs par byed do༅/ /nye du dag gis smras pa/ gang gi tshe 'di btsas pa na grong khyer thams cad dga' bar gyur pas de'i phyir khye'u'i ming kun dga' bor gdags so zhes btags so/ /rgyal po zas gtsang ⑦gis smras pa/ grags 'dzin ma'i bu gang yin pa 'di ni shākya thub pa'i bu ma yin no zhes smras pa/ grags 'dzin mas thos nas yi ⑤chad par gyur to / /de nas des byang chub sems dpa'i pang tshad kyi pha bong la zhon nas rol pa'i rdzing 'gram du 'dug ⑨ste bden pa gsol ba btab pa/ gal te 'di byang chub sems dpa' las skyes pa yin na de bzhin du rdzing 'dir pha bong dang lhan cig 'phyo bar gyur cigaci /ci ste ma yin na bying bar gyur cig ces smras nas chur bor ba dang de shing bal gyi 'dab ma 7bzhin du pha bong dang lhan cig 'phyo bar brtsams so/ /rgyal po zas gtsang gis ya mtshan du gyur pa de thos nas skye bo'i tshogs chen ngo sa yongs su bskor te byang chub sems dpa' rol pa'i rdzing 'gram du song na8/ ji tsam na sgra can 6zin bzang po byang chub sems dpa'i pang tshad kyi pha bong la zhon nas shing bal gyi 'dab ma 8bzhin du chu na 'phyo ba mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang dga' ba dang / mgu ba dang / rab tu dga' ba dang / rangs pa rgya chen po dang / yid bde ba skyes te de ma thag tu rdzing der zhugs nas gzhon nu sgra can tsozin bzang po pang du blangs nas langs so//gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis bdud kyi 'khor 'byung po bye ba phrag sum bcu rtsa 1—81

drug byams pa'i mtshon gyis mngon du btul nas bla na med pa'i ye shes brnyes pa de'i tshe sa chen po 'di shin tu g.yos par gyur to/ /'jig rten 'di thams cad kyang ①snang ba rgya chen pos gsal bar gyur te/ 'di ltar 'jig rten dang 'jig rten gyi bar gyi mun pa mun nag smag tu gyur pa nyi ②ma dang zla ba 'di gnyis 'di ltar rdzu 'phrul che zhing 'di ltar mthu che ba'i snang bas snang ba nyams su ma myong ba gang yin pa de dag kyang de'i tshe snang ba rgya chen pos gsal ②bar ④gyur nas der sems can gang dag skyes pa de ⑤rnams kyis snang ba des sems can gcig gis gcig mthong nas/ shes ldan dag sems can gzhan dag kyang ⑥'dir skyes pa lta zhig shes ldan dag sems can gzhan zhig kyang 'dir skyes pa lta ⑦zhig ces ngo shes par gyur to// // sdom ⑧la/ 'khor bzhi dang ni lang tsho dang / /yab dang sras ni mjal ⑨ba dang / /shākya de bzhin rang byung dang / /dung skyong khyod la phyag 'tshal ba'o//de nas tshangs ris kyi lha gnyis shig tshangs pa'i 'jig rten na 'dug pa 'di snyam du sems te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das lteng ⑩rgyas na chu klung nai tshurañdza na'i 'gram byang chub kyi shing drung na bzhugs te mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas ring po tsom lon par me'i khams la snyoms par zhugs te skyil mo krung ⑫gcig gis zhag bdun 'das par mdzad nas/ de la sus kyang bsod snyoms ma phul gyisabla/ ma la bdag cag der song la tshigs su bcad pa re res mngon par bstod do snyam mo/ /de nas tshangs ris kyi lha de gnyis kyis 'di lta ste/skyes bu stobs dang ldan pa'i dpung pa bskums te brkyang ba'am brkyang 8ste 4—82

bskums ①pa tsam gyis tshangs ris kyi lha gnyis tshangs ris kyi 'jig rten nas mi snang bar gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar phyin nas phyogs gcig tu ②'dug ste/ tshangs ris kyi lha gnyis las gcig gis tshigs su bcad de gsol pa/ded dpon g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba po②/ /sdig pa mi mnga' bzhengs shig 'jig rten gzigs/ /rin chen chos ni 'tshal bar 'gyur mchis kyis/ /bde gshegs chos kyi mchog ni bshad du ④gsol/ /cig 0shos kyis kyang tshigs su bcad de gsol pa/ nga rgyal bcom zhing g.yul las rnam rgyal ba/ /sdig pa mi mnga' bzhengs shig 'jig rten gzigs/ /bco 0lnga lon pa'i ⑦dgung zla nya ba ltar/ /khyod kyi thugs ni shin tu rnam dag lags/ /zhes gsol nas de nyid du mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das ting nge 'dzin de las bzhengs nas de'i tshe tshigs su bcad de bka' stsal pa/ 'jig rten 'dod pa'i bde gang dang / /lha yul byung bde gang yin pa/ /srid ⑤pa zad pa'i bde de la / /bcu drug char yang mi phod do/ /khur khyer ba ni sdug bsngal te/ /khur bor ba ni bde ba yin/ /khur ni lci ba rnams bor nas/ /gzhan dag blang ⑨bar mi bya'o/ /sred pa thams cad rnam spangs shing / / 'dus byas 0thams cad zad nas ni/ /dngos po thams cad yongs shes nas7/ /slar yang srid ⑫par mi 'ong ngo / /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnam par grol ba'i dga' ba dang bde ba sku nyams su btar nas/ skyil tsomo krung ④gcig gis bzhag bdun 'das par mdzad pa na/ /de la sus kyang bsod snyoms ma phul lo/ /de'i tshe tshong pa ga gon dang bzang po gnyis shing rta lnga brgya tsam dang lhan cig dong ba na lam de nyid du zhugs par gyur to/ /de nas tshong ⑩pa ga gon dang / bzang 1—83

po'i sngon gyi grogs po dang / blon po dang / nye du dang / mdza' bshes su gyur pa'i lha zhig yod pa 'di snyam du sems te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di lteng rgyas na chu klung nai rañdza na'i 'gram byang chub kyi shing drung na bzhugs te mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas ring po ①ma lon par rnam par grol ba'i dga' ba dang bde ba sku nyams su btar ②nas/ skyil mo krung gcig ②gis zhag bdun 'das par mdzad pa na/ de la sus ④kyang bsod snyoms ma phul gyis / de la tshong pa ga gon dang / bzang po gnyis kyis der 0thog mar bsod snyoms 'bul du bcug na/ de ni tshong pa ga gon dang / bzang po de gnyis kyi yun ring po'i don dang phan pa dang bde bar 'gyur gyis/ ma la bdag rang gis 'di gnyis 'di lta ste/ bcom ldan 'das la bsod snyoms 'bul du gzhug ༅pa'i phyir brtson par bya'o snyam nas/ de nas lha des shing rta dang tshong pa thams cad snang ba rgya chen pos gsal bar ④byas nas tshong pa ga gon dang / bzang po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshong pa tshong pa dag sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di lhong ④rgyas na chu klung nai rañdza na'i 'gram ⑨byang chub kyi shing drung na bzhugs te mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas ring po ma lon par rnam par grol ba'i dga' ba dang / bde ba sku nyams su btar ⑩ba na skyil mo krung yigacig gis zhag bdun 'das par mdzad de/ de la sus kyang bsod snyoms ma phul gyis/ de la khyed kyis der thog mar bsod snyoms phul na de ni khyed kyi yun ring mo'i 8don dang phan pa dang bde bar 'gyur ro zhes smras nas lha de de nyid du mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas tshong pa ga gon dang bzang po gnyis 'di snyam du sems te/ sangs rgyas ni mchog ma yin pa ma yin la/ chos 1—84

bshad pa yang mchog ma yin pa ma yin te/ gang gi phyir 'di ltar lhas kyang 'di lta ste/ bcom ldan 'das de la bsod snyoms dbul ①ba'i phyir brtson par byed do snyam du bsams nas sbrang rtsi dang lde ②gu mang du khyer nas bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song thunas phyin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi bzhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te phyogs gcig ⑤tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig ༅tu 'dug nas tshong pa ga gon dang / bzang pos bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyi ched du 'dir ⑦bdag cag ⑤gis sbrang rtsi dang lde ⑨ga mang du 'tshal te mchos kyis/ bcom ldan 'das thugs brtse ba ⑩ nye bar bzung ste 'di bzhes su gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das 'di snyam du dgongs te0/ gal te bdag gi phyag 4)gis bsod snyoms bzhes na dper na 8myu stegs can bzhin du 'gyur bas ④de ni bdag gi cha ma yin gyis/ma la bdag gis sngon gyi yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ④kyis srog chags rnams la phan pa'i phyir bsod snyoms gang du bzhes pa bsam tshupar bya'o snyam pa na bcom ldan 'das la lha rnams kyis gsol pa/ btsun pa sngon gyi yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis srog chags rnams ⑩la sman 8par bgyi ba'i slad du lhung bzed du bsod 7snyoms bzhes lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang dgongs shing ye shes gzigs pa bskyed na sngon gyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis srog chags rnams la phan pa'i phyir bsod snyoms lhung bzed du bzhes par gyur nas de nas du bcom ldan 'das la lhung bzed kyis lhung bzed kyi ⑥dgos pa byung ngo / /de nas rgyal po chen po tsobazhis bcom ldan 'das la lhung bzed kyis dulhung bzed kyi dgos pa byung bar rig nas ri brags rdzi1—85

can zhig la rdo las byas pa'i lhung bzed mi ma yin pas byas shing mi ①ma yin pas zin par byas la gsal ba/ gtsang ②ma/ dri mi zhim pa ①med pa bzhi khyer te bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der dong nas phyin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi rjozhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas nas phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig ①tu 'dug nas rgyal po chen po bzhis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das la lhung bzed kyis lhung bzed kyi mkho ba byung bar bdag cag gis 'tshal nas ri brags ༅can zhig ⑦las rdo'i lhung bzed mi ma lags pas bgyis shing mi ma lags pas legs par bgyis pa gsal ⑧ba / gtsang ma dri nga ba ma mchis pa bzhi 'dir 'tshal te mchis na/ bcom ldan 'das thugs brtse ba nye bar bzung ste 'di bzhes su gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das 'di snyam du dgongs te/ gal te bdag gis rgyal po chen po gcig ⑨las lhung bzed gcig ⑨ bzhes na gsum gyi sems mi dga' bar 'gyur ro / /gal te gnyis las na ni gnyis kyi sems mi dga' bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te gsum las na ni gcig gi sems mi dga' bar 'gyur gyis0/ ma la bdag gis rgyal po chen po bzhi las lhung bzed bzhi bzhes la 0lhung bzed gcig 8tu byin gyis brlab ④par bya'o snyam nas/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal po chen po bzhi las lhung bzed bzhi bzhes te lhung bzed gcig tu byin gyis brlabs so// //'dul ba gzhi'/ bam po brgyad bcu ⑩drug pa/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshong pa ga gon dang bzang po las srog chags rnams la phan pa'i phyir bsod snyoms bzhes so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshong pa ga gon dang 1—86

bzang po la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /①tshong pa dag khyed tshur sangs rgyas la skyabs su deng shig /chos la skyabs su deng shig /ma 'ongs pa'i dus na 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i dge 'dun zhes bya ba gang yin pa de la yang skyabs su deng shig /btsun pa bdag cag sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ /chos ②la skyabs su mchi'o/ /ma 'ongs pa'i dus na 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i dge 'dun gang lags pa de la yang skyabs su mchi'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshong pa ga gon dang bzang po'i sbyin pa de la rjes su yi rang bas rjes su yi rang bar mdzad de/gang gi don du sbyin pa btang / / de yi ②don du 'gyur ba ste/ /bde ba'i don du sbyin btang na/ /de ni cibade bar 'gyur ba yin/ /bsod nams rnam smin bde ba dang / /bsams ⑤pa yang ni 'grub ༅par 'gyur/ /myur du zhi ba dam ⑦pa yi/ /mya ngan 'das pa nirtogs par 'gyur/ /pha rol las byung gnod pa ni/ /lha dang bdud kyi rigs dag gis/ /bsod nams kho na byed pa na/ /bar chad bya bar mi nus so/ /gal te 'phags pa'i shes rab phyir/ /gtong ldan de ni 'bad byed na/ /sdug bsngal tha mar byed pa dag /rnam par mthong zhing reg par 'gyur/ /de nas tshong pa ga spugon dang / /bzang po bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa la mngon par dga' ste rjes su yi rangs ⑩nas bcom ldan 'das kyi 0zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga nas dong ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshong pa ga gon dang / bzang po la 8bsod snyoms bzhes nas chu klung nai rañdza na cigang na ba der gshegs te byon nas 8chu klung nai rañdza na'i 'gram du bzhugs te zhal zas kyi bya ba mdzad do/ /de nas sbrang rtsi yang rlung slong la lde 'gu yang rlung slong bas 4—87

des ①bcom ldan 'das rlung nad kyi snyun gyis thebs so/ /de nas bdud sdig can gyis bcom ldan 'das rlung nad kyi snyun gyis thebs par rig nas bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba'i dus la bab ②lags so/ /bde bar gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'da' rduba'i dus la bab lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 'di snyam du dgongs te/ 'di lta ste dkrug ④pa'i las kyi phyir bdud sdig can 'di nye bar 'ongs so snyam du dgongs nas/ bdud sdig can la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /sdig can ji srid nga'i nyan thos mkhas pa/ gsal ba/ yid gzhungs ④pa/ pha rol ༷gyi rgol ba 9byung zhing byung ba rnams chos bzhin gyis tshar gcod nus pa/ rang gi smra ba gsal bar byed nus pa'i dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen tsudang / dge bsnyen ma rnams byung bar ma gyur pa dang / nga'i tshangs par spyod pa rgya chen po skye bo samang po dang lha dang mi'i bar la rgya cher yang dag par legs shepar rab tu ma bstan gyi bar du nga yongs su mya ngan las mi 'da'otshe//de nas bdud sdig can 'di snyam du sems te/ kye ma'o dge sbyong gi ta ma ni yongs su mya ngan las nyutre mi 'da'o/ /6snyam du bsams nas skye sdug bsngal zhing yid mi bde la 'gyod pas de nyid du mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas lha rnams kyi 6dbang po brgya byin gyis bcom ldan 'das rlung nad kyi snyun gyis thebs par rig blanas shing 'dzam bu skyezhes bya bas 'dzam bu'i co gling du gdags 8pa gang yin pa de dang ha cang yang mi ring ba zhig na a ru ra chen po'i tshal yod de/ de nas kha dog dang / dri dang / skyero dang ldan pa'i a ru ra blangs nas bcom ldan 'das 1—88

gang na ba der song ste phyin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs ①gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te phyogs gcig ②tu 'dug gol/ /phyogs gcig ⑤tu 'dug nas lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bser ⑤ma'i snyan nad kyis 0thebs par bdag gis 'tshal nas shing 'dzam bu zhes bgyi bas ⑦'dzam bu'i gling du btags pa gang lags pa de dang ha cang yang ⑧mi ring ba na a ru ra chen po'i tshal mchis te/ de nas bdag gis kha dog dang / dri dang / ror 0ldan pa'i a ru ra 'dir 'tshal te mchis kyis de bcom ldan 'das kyis ⑨ gsol cig /bcom ldan 'das kyis de yigasol tsodang / bser tsom dang mthun par 'gyur zhing bser ma'i snyan nye bar zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de gsol ba dang rlung dang mthun par gyur nas rlung nad kyi snyan nye bar zhi bar gyur to / / des na ④bcom ldan 'das shin tu bzod cing lhag par 'tsho bar gyur to / /de nas bcom ldan 'das ji tsam dgyes kyi bar du byang chub kyi shing drung du bzhugs nas klu'i rgyal po btang bzung ⑫ gi gnas gang na ba der gshegs ༅te byon nas shing zhig gi drung du brten te skyil mo krung 0bcas nas sku drang por bsrang ste dran pa mngon du phyogs par bzhag tsonas bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe klu'i rgyal po btang bzung yigi gnas su zhag bdun du dus ma yin pa'i sprin chags par gyur to/ /de nas klu'i rgyal po btang bzung du gis zhag bdun du dus ma yin pa'i sprin chags par rig nas gnas nas mngon par 'phags te/ bcom ldan 'das zhag bdun po 'di la bser ( sprebar 'gyur du 'ong / tsha ba dang /sbrang ma dang / sha sbrang dang / rlung dang / nyi ma dang / sdig sbrul gyi reg ⑥1—89

pas sku la gnod par 'gyur du 'ong zhes lus kyis bcom ldan 'das la lan bdun du dkris te steng du mgo'i gdengs ka chen po byas nas 'dug go/ /de nas klu'i rgyal po btang bzung ①gis zhag bdun gyi dus ma yin pa'i sprin chags pa med par rig nas bcom ldan 'das kyi ②sku lus ③las lus bkrol ④te dpung rgyan dang / rna rgyan ⑤dang / phreng ba dang / rgyan sna tshogs dang / byug pas byugs nas bcom ldan 'das gang na ba de 0logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das dgung bdun po 'di la bser ⑦bar ma gyur tam/ tsha ba dang / sbrang ma dang / sha sbrang dang / bser ⑧ma dang / gdugs ⑨dang / sdig sbrul gyi gnod pas sku la reg par ma gyur tam/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad de bka' stsal pa/ dben pa'i dga' ba bde ba 0yin/ /chos thos pa la lta ba dang / /srog ⑨chags rnams la sdom pa yis/ /'jig rten 'tshe ba med pa bde/ /'jig rten 'dod chags bral ba dang / /'dod chags rnams las rgal ba bde/ /nga'o nga rgyal thul tsob gang / /de nyid bde ba'i dam pa yin / /de nas bcom ldan 'das ji tsam bzhed 8kyi bar du klu'i rgyal po btang bzung (stegi gnas na bzhugs nas byang chub kyi snying po gang na ba der gshegs te byon pa dang rtswa'i tsogading ba bshams pa nyid la skyil mo krung skyabacas/sku drang por bsrang ⑩nas dran pa mngon du phyogs par bzhag nas 8bzhugs te/ skyil mo krung yigacig gis zhag bdun 'das par mdzad cing rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i yan lag bcu gnyis po 0lugs dang mthun pa dang / lugs dang mi mthun pa 'di nyid la gzigs par mdzad de/ 'di lta ste 'di yod pas 1—90

'di yod/ 'di skyes pas 'di skye ba 'di lta ste/ ma rig pa'i rkyen gyis 'du byed / 'du byed kyi rkyen gyis rnam par shes pa/ rnam par shes pa'i rkyen gyis ming dang gzugs/ ming ①dang gzugs kyi rkyen gyis skye mched drug /skye mched drug gi rkyen gyis reg pa/ reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba/ tshor ba'i rkyen gyis sred pa/ sred pa'i rkyen gyis len pa/ len pa'i rkyen gyis srid pa/ srid pa'i rkyen gyis skye ba/ skye ba'i rkyen gyis rga ②shi dang / mya ngan dang / smre ③sngags 'don pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba dang / 'khrug pa rnams 'byung bar 'gyur te/ de ltar sdug bsngal gyi phung po chen po 'ba' zhig po 'di 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /'di lta ste 'di med na ④'di med la/'di 'gags pas 'di 'gag par 'gyur te/ 'di lta ste ma rig pa 'gags pas 'du byed 'gagadu /'du byed 'gags pas rnam par shes pa 'gag⑥ /rnam par shes pa 'gags pas ming dang gzugs 'gag⑦ /ming dang gzugs 'gags pas skye mched drug 'gag⑧ /skye mched drug 'gags pas reg pa 'gag⑨ /reg pa 'gags pas tshor ba 'gag⑩ /tshor ba 'gags pas sred pa 'gag⑩ /sred pa 'gags 8pas len pa 'gag0 /len pa 'gags pas srid pa 'gagatso /srid pa 'gags pas skye ba 'gagatso /skye ba 'gags pas rga shi dang / mya ngan dang / smre sngags 'don pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang /yid mi bde ba dang / 'khrug pa rnams 'gag ⑩par 'gyur te/ de ltar sdug bsngal gyi phung po chen po 'ba' zhig po 'di 'gag ⑩par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis zhag bdun po de nyid 'das par mdzad tsonas ting nge 'dzin de chalas bzhengs te de'i tshe tshigs su bcad de bka' stsal pa/ gang tshe 1—91

chos 'di dag ni skyed byed pa'i/ /brtson 'grus ldan pa'i bsam gtan tshangs pa yin/ /gang tshe chos rnams rgyu dang bcas shes pa①/ /de nas de yi som nyi thams cad 'bral②/ /gang tshe chos 'di dag ni skyed byed pa'i/ /brtson 'grus ldan pa'i bsam gtan tshangs pa yin/ /gang tshe sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas shes pa/ /de nas de yi som nyi thams cad 'bral / /gang tshe chos 'di dag ni skyed byed pa'i/ /brtson 'grus ldan pa'i bsam gtan tshangs pa yin / /gang tshe tshor ba zad pa thob 'gyur ba/ /de nas de yi som nyi thams cad 'bral/ /gang tshe chos 'di ④dag ni skyed byed pa'i/ /brtson 'grus ldan pa'i bsam gtan tshangs pa yin/ /gang tshe rkyen rnams zad pa thob nas ni/ /de nas de yi som nyi thams cad 'bral/ /gang tshe chos ⑤'di dag ni skyed byed pa'i / /brtson 'grus ldan pa'i bsam gtan ༅tshangs pa yin/ /gang tshe zag pa zad pa thob gyur nas/ /de nas de yi ⑦som nyi thams cad 'bral/ /gang tshe chos 'di dag ni skyed byed pa'i/ /brtson 'grus ldan pa'i bsam gtan tshangs pa yin/ /'jig rten kun du snang bar 'dug pa ni/ /ji ltar nyi ma bar snang shar ba bzhin/ /gang tshe chos 'di dag ni skyed byed pa'i/ /brtson 'grus ldan pa'i bsam gtan tshangs pa yin/ /bdud kyi sde rnams rnam par bcom gnas te/ /sangs rgyas kun du sbyor las rnam par grol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 'di snyam du dgongs te/ bdag gis chos zab ⑤mo zab par snang ba mthong bar dka' zhing khong du chud par dka' ba rtog ge pa rnams kyi rtog ge'i spyod yul ma yin pa zhib mo mdzangs ⑨pa'i mkhas pa dang / rig pas rnam par shes par ⑩bya ba rtogs te/ de bdag gis yigazhan la smras kyang gzhan gyis 4—92

de mi shes pas des bdag dub par 'gyur①/ ngal bar 'gyur/ sems la spro ba med pa ②kho nar 'gyur bar zad pas ma la bdag gcig pu dgon pa'i nags stug por mthong ba'i chos la bde bar gnas pa'i rnal 'byor la rjes su brtson pas gnas ③par bya'o snyam ste/ de nas bcom ldan 'das thugs las chung ngus bzhugs pa la thugs gzhol bar mdzad cing chos 'chad ④pa la ma yin no / /de nas tshangs pa mi mjed kyi bdag po 'di snyam du sems te/ kye ma'o 'jig rten 'di ma rung ba'o kye ma'o 'jig rten 'di ma rung ba ⑤ste/ gang gi ⑥phyir da ⑦ltar brgya lam na lan 'ga' de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byung ba ni dper na u dum bā ⑤ra'i me tog bzhin na⑨/ bcom ldan 'das de da ltar thugs las chung ngus bzhugs pa la thugs gzhol bar mdzad cing chos 'chad pa la ni ma yin pas ma la bdag der song la cigasol ba gdab bo snyam mo/ /de nas tshangs pa mi mjed kyi bdag pos dper na skyes bu stobs dang ldan pa'i dpung pa bskums yinas brkyang ba'am / brkyang nas bskums ④pa tsam gyis tshangs pa mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa'i 'jig rten nas mi snang bar byas te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi 8spyan sngar 'dug go/ /de nas tshangs pa mi mjed kyi bdag pos de'i tshe tshigs su bcad de gsol pa/ ma ga d+mar tu)ni sngon chad ④chos byung ba/ /dag pa ma lags dri mar bcas pas ④rtogs/ /bdud rtsi chos kyi sgo ni phye mdzod la/ /dri ma med pas rtogs pa skyabashad par tsomadzod/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ tshangs pa ngas 0ni tshegs chen gyis/ /skyon rnams bcom nas rtogs gyur pa/ /srid dang chags pas dkris ⑦ rnams kyis/ /chos ni 0legs par 4—93

rtogs mi 'gyur/ /rgyun las bzlog 7phyogs 'gro ba'i lam/ /zab cing shin tu mthong dka' bal/ /mun pa'i phung pos bsgribs pa yi/ /'dod chags zhen pas mthong mi 'gyur/ /btsun ①pa 'jig rten du skyes shing 'jig rten du rgas pa'i sems can rnams la dbang po rnon po dang / dbang po 'bring po dang /dbang po rtul ④po dang / drang sla ba dang / gdul sla ba dang / nyon mongs pa ⑤chung ba dang / rdul chung ba'i rigs mchis te/ de dag gis dam pa'i chos ma thos na yongs su nyams par 'gyur lags so/ /btsun pa dper na ut+pa la'am / pad ma'am/ ku mu da'amakhye/ pad ma dkar po dag chab nas skyes shing chab ⑦nas chen por gyur te chab nas 'phags te mchis pa las ②kha cig ni chab dang mnyam/ kha cig ni chab kyi nang du nub cing ⑨mchis pa de bzhin du btsun pa 'jig rten du skyes shing 'jig rten du rgas pa'i sems can rnams la yang dbang po rnon po dang / dbang po 'bring po dang / dbang po rtul 0po dang / drang sla ba dang / gdul 0sla ba dang / nyon mongs pa chung ba dang / rdul chung ba'i rigs mchis te de dag gis dam pa'i chos ma thos na yongs su nyams par 'gyur bas 'chos rin po che 'tshal bar 'gyur ba mchis kyis/bcom ldan 'das chos bshad du gsol/ bde bar gshegs pa chos bshad du gsol / de nas bcom ldan 'das 'di snyam du dgongs te/ ma la nga ④nyid kyi byasangs rgyas kyi 8spyan gyis ⑩'jig rten la blta bar bya'o snyam nas/ de nas bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis 'jig rten la gzigs te/bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis 'jig rten la gzigs pa dang /'jig rten du skyes shing 'jig rten du rgas pa'i sems can rnams la dbang po 4—94

rnon po dang / dbang po 'bring po dang / dbang po rtul ①po dang / drang sla ba dang / gdul ②sla ba dang / nyon mongs pa chung ba dang / rdul chung ba'i rang bzhin yod de②/ de dag dam pa'i chos ma thos na yongs su nyams par 'gyur bar rjogazigs so/ /gzigs nas kyang sems can rnams la thugs rje 'chen po gzhol bar ①gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad de bka' stsal pa/ bdud rtsi'i tshusgo mo dag ni dbye ⑧bar byas / /nyan par su 'dod som 0nyi sol cig dang / /tshangs pa mi rnams la ni gya nom chos/ /klan ⑨ ka mi btsal yimado tsam bshad par bya/ /de nas tshangs pa mi mjed kyi bdag po 'di snyam tsodu sems te/ kye bcom ldan 'das kyis chos bshad par 'gyur ro/ /kye bde bar gshegs pas chos bshad 8par 'gyur ro snyam du rig nas dga' ④ba dang / mgu ba dang / mchog tu dga' ba dang / dga' ba rgya chen po dang / yid bde ba skyes nas bcom ldan 'das kyi 8zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te/ bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas nas de nyid du mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 'di snyam du dgongs te/ ngas su la thog mar chos bshad snyam mo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 'di snyam du dgongs te/ ma la ngas sgyu rtsal shes kyi bu ring du 'phur (9de la thog mar chos bshad par bya ste/ de ni nga'i thog ma'i slob dpon kho na yin bzhin du rjed pa'i dam pas rjed cing mchod pa'i dam pas mchod la rtogs pa dam pa dag la yang yid rangs shing dad par gyur pa yin no snyam mo/ /bcom ldan 'das la lha rnams kyis gsol pa/btsun pa sgyu rtsal shes kyi bu ring du 'phur gum nas dgung bdun tshulags so/ /4wa 95

bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang dgongs pa la zhugs te/ ye shes gzigs pa bskyed na sgyu rtsal shes kyi bu ring du 'phur shi nas zhag bdun lon no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 'di snyam du dgongs te/ e ma'o sgyu rtsal shes kyi ①bu ring du 'phur shi ba de ni ②te por ma stes so/ /ga.e ma'o sgyu rtsal shes kyi bu ring du 'phur shi ba de ni shin tu te por ma stes te chos 'dul ba 'di ma thos so/ /gal te des rjochos 'dul ba 'di ⑧thos na ༅shes par 'gyur ba zhig snyam mo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 'di snyam du dgongs te/ ma la ngas thog mar su zhig la chos bshad snyam mo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 'di snyam du dgongs te/ ma la ngas rangs byed kyi bu lhag spyod de la thog ⑦mar chos bshad par bya ste/ de ni nga'i thog ma'i slob dpon kho na yin bzhin du rjed pa'i dam pas rjed cing mchod pa'i dam pas mchod la rtogs ⑧pa dam pa dag la yang yid ⑨rangs shing dad par gyur to snyam mo/ /bcom ldan 'das la ⑩lha rnams kyis gsol pa/ btsun ⑩pa rangs byed kyi 'bu lhag spyod mdang sum ④srod la gum lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang dgongs pa la zhugs ④te ye shes gzigs pa bskyed na rangs byed kyi bu lhag spyod srod la shi bar gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 'di snyam du dgongs te/ e ma'o rangs 'byed kyi bu lhag spyod shi ba de ni te por ma stes so/ /⑩e ma'o rangs byed kyi bu lhag spyod shi ba de ni shin tu te por ma stes te chos ⑩'dul ba 'di ma thos so8/ /gal te des chos 'dul ba 'di thos na shes par 'gyur ba zhig snyam mo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das ⑩'di snyam du dgongs te/ma la ngas thog mar su zhig la chos bshad snyam mo/ /de nas 'di snyam du dgongs te/ ma la ngas lnga sde'i dge slong de rnams la thog mar chos bshad par 4—96

bya ste/ de dag gis nga sngon sdug bsngal spong ba'i rnal 'byor gyis ②rjes su brtson par gnas pa na bla ma ②dang / gus pa dang / sdug pa dang bcas pas gnas pa yin no snyam mo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 'di snyam du dgongs te/lnga sde'i dge slong rnams da ltar gang na 'dug snyam nas bcom ldan 'das kyis ②lha'i spyan rnam par dag pa mi rnams kyi ④las 'das pas lnga sde'i dge slong rnams bā rā ṇa sī na drang srong smra ⑤ba ri dgas kyi nags na 'khod pa gzigs so/ /gzigs nas kyang ji ༅tsam bzhed kyi bar du ①byang chub kyi shing ②drung du bzhugs na 0bā rā ṇa sī'i ka shi'i grong khyer tshugang na ba der rgyu zhing gshegs so/ /de'i tshe kun tu rgyu yinyer 'gro lam de nyid du zhugs par gyur te/ kun tu rgyu 8nyer 'gros bcom ldan 'das lam nas gshegs pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang 'di skad ces gsol to/ /dge sbyong gi ta ma khyod kyi dbang po rnams ni dngas/bzhin gyi mdog 8ni yongs su dag /pags ④pa'i mdog ni gsal na/ tshe dang ldan pa gi ta ma khyod kyi ston pa ni gang / khyod su las brten ④te rab tu byung / khyod su'i chos la dga'atshu/ bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad de bka' stsal pa/ nga dang 'dra ba yod min pas/ /nga la slob dpon 'ga' med do/ /'jig rten sangs rgyas nga gcig pu/ /yang dag byang chub dam pa thob/ /thams cad zil mnan ⑩'jig rten kun mkhyen la/ /'di na ⑫chos kun gyis ni nga ma gosayi/ /thams cad spangs shing sred bral rnam grol te/ /rang gis mngon par shes na su la brtenadu/ /de bzhin gshegs pa lha mi'i ston pa po0/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i stobs ni kun ldan pas/ /nyid kyis byang chub rtogs nas rab gsung bas/ /mi mnyam mtshungs pa med na su la 1—97

brten① / /nga ni 'jig rten dgra bcom ste/ /'jig rten ⑧bla med nga ①yin pas / /lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten na/ /nga ni rgyal ba bdud zil gnon//tshe dang ldan pa gi ta ma rgyal ba zhes gsung ngam/ gang gis zag pa zad thob pa / /rgyal ba nga 'dra ④shis par bya/ /sdig pa'i chos ni ngas bcom pas/ /de bas nyer 'gro nga ①rgyal ba'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa gi ta ma gang du bzhud/ bā rā ṇa sīr dugashegs nas ni/ /ngas ni chos kyi rnga brdung ①zhing / /'jig rten ma bskor dugang yin pa'i0/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor⑩/ /'jig rten chags las rgal ba yi/ /kun mkhyen sangs rgyas zhi gyur pa/ /'jig rten bsgral ba ma byas par/ /skyes bu dam pa grags mi srid/ /tshe dang ldan pa gi ta ma rgyal ba legs so/ /zhes gsol nas kun du rgyu nyer 'gro lam nas song ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das yul ka shi'i ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs pa na bā rā ṇa sīr byon to/ /de'i tshe lnga sde'i dge sbyong ⑨rnams bā rā ṇa sī na drang srong smra ba ri dgas kyi nags na 'khod do/ /lnga sde'i dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das rgyang ring po kho na nas mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang phan tshun nas ched du bsams te legs par tso'adug nas khrims su bcas pa/ shes ldan dag dge sbyong gau ta ma mi brtan pa/ bya ba mang ba/ mang pos 'tsho zhing ⑫/ spong ba nyams pa de da 8'bras chan tsodang / zan 8dron gyi ⑩kha zas tsomang du za zhing lus mar sar dang til mar gyis byugs nas chu 'jam pos lus khrus byed cing 'ong gis de bdag cag gi drung du 'ongs pa chadang de la smra bar mi bya/ phyag mi bya / ldang ba du mi bya/ langs te stan bstab 0par mi bya'o/ /gzhan du na stan nar byam kho na bting la tshig 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa gi ta ma stan 4—98

yod kyis ji ste 'dod na 'dug shig ①ces brjod par bya'o zhes khrims ②bcas so//bcom ldan 'das kyis ②ji lta ji ltar lnga sde'i dge slong rnams la gzigs pa'i phyir nye bar gshegs pa de lta de ltar lnga sde'i rjodage slong rnams bcom ldan 'das kyi gzi brjid ⑤dang / dpal dang / bkur sti rjom bzod nas stan las langs te kha cig ni bcom ldan 'das kyi ched du gdan shom mo/ /kha cig ni zhabs bkru ba'i 2chu dang zhabs kyi rten dag mtha' gcig tu 'jog par byed do/ /kha cig ni bsu ste ⑧na bza' chos gos dag blangs nas 'di skad ces shes ldan gi ta ma tshur spyon/ shes ldan gi ta ma byon pa legs so/ /shes ldan gi ta ma gdan ⑨bshams pa nyid la bzhugs shig zhes 0zer ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 'di snyam du dgongs te/ kye ma skyes bu blun po 'di rnams kyis khrims bcas nas rang gis bshig go snyam du mkhyen nas gdan bshams pa nyid la bzhugs so/ /de nas lnga sde'i dge slong rnams lhag par yang bcom ldan 'das kyi mtshan nas brjod/ gdung nas brjodayi/ tshe dang ldan pas brjod 8pa kun du rjod ⑩par byed do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis lnga sde'i dge slong rnams la bka' tho)stsal pa/ dge slong dag khyed lhag par yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan nas brjod ④pa dang / gdung nas brjod pa dang / tshe dang ldan pas rjod pa'i tsokun du ma brjod ⑩cig /khyed la yun ring por gnod pa dang phan pa ma yin pa dang / sdug bsngal bar 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ dge slong dag gang la la lhag par yang 'de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan nas brjod ⑩pa dang / gdung nas brjod tshupa dang / tshe dang ldan pas rjod ⑥pa'i kun du brjod pa de ni skyes bu blun 3po de la yun ring por gnod pa 1—99

dang / phan pa ma yin pa dang / sdug bsngal bar 'gyur ro/ /de dag gis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /tshe dang ldan pa go ta ma khyod kyis re zhig sngon gyi tshul dang / spyod pa dang dka' ①ba spyad ②pa des mi'i ②chos bla ma 'phags pa'i khyad par thob par nus ④pa'am/ shes pa'am/ mthong ba'am/ reg par gnas pa cung zad kyang ma thob ⑤na/ da lta ⑥khyod mi brtan zhing bya ba mang la mang pos 'tsho byazhing spong ba nyams pas da khyod 'bras chan ⑧dang / zan dron dang / kha zas la mang du za zhing lus mar sar dang til mar gyis byugs nas chu 'jam pos lus khrus byed pa pelta smos kyang ci tshi dgos/ dge slong dag khyod ⑫kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhal mdog dang dbang po rnams gsal ba sngon las tha dad du bya ba 8gzhan lta mthong ngam/ de rnams kyis 'di skad ces gsol to//tshe dang ldan pa gi ta ma de de bzhin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis lnga sde'i dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag rab tu byung bas ni mtha' nyunye'adi gnyis la brten rtso) par mi bya/ bsnyen par mi bya/ bsnyen bkur comi bya ste/ gnyis gang zhe na/ 'dod pa rnams la 'dod pa'i bsod myesnyoms kyi rjes su brtson pa/ dman pa/ ngan pa/ tha chad ma rabs gang yin pa dang / bdag nyid dub pa la rjes su brtson pa ⑩/ sdug bsngal ba/ 'phags pa ma yin pa/ gnod pa dang ldan pa gang yin pa'o/ /khyed 8kyis mtha' 'di ⑪gnyis la mi brten bu par dbu thuma'i lam mig byed pa/ ye shes byed pa/ nye bar zhi bar 'gyur ba/ mngon par shes pa dang / rdzogs par byang chub pa dang /mya ngan las 'das par 'gyur ba yod de/ dbu ma'i lam ( sregang zhe na/'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa 'di lta ste/ yang dag pa'i lta ba dang /4wa 100

yang dag pa'i rtog pa dang / yang dag pa'i ngag dang / yang dag pa'i las kyi mtha' dang / yang dag pa'i 'tsho ba dang / yang dag pa'i rtsol ba dang /yang dag pa'i dran pa dang / yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin yin no/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis lnga sde'i dge slong rnams la shes par bya ba 'dis shes par mdzad spyod pas bcom ldan 'das lnga sde'i dge slong rnams las gnyis la snga dro gdams ngag 'bogs pa na gsum grong du bsod snyoms la 'jug ste/ gsum gyis bsgrub ①pa gang yin pa des drug char 'tsho bar byed do/ /bcom ldan 'das lnga sde rnams kyi dge slong gsum la phyi dro gdams ngag 'bogs ②pa na ③gnyis grong du bsod snyoms ④'jug ste/ gnyis kyis bsgrub rjopa gang yin pa des lnga sde 'tsho bar byed de / de bzhin gshegs pa ni snga dro'i dus kho nar gsol ba yin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis lnga sde'i dge slong rnams la bka' stsal ⑥pa/ dge slong dag nga ༅sngon ma thos pa'i chos rnams la 'di ni sdug bsngal 'phags pa'i bden pa'o zhes tshul bzhin yid la byed pa na mig skyes so/ /shes pa dang / rig pa dang / blo dang / rtogs pa skyes so/ /dge slong dag nga ⑤sngon ma thos pa'i chos rnams la 'di ni sdug bsngal kun 'byung ba'o/ /'di ni sdug bsngal 'gog pa'o / /'di ni sdug bsngal 'gog par 'gro ba'i lam mo zhes tshul bzhin yid la byed pa na mig skyes so/ /shes pa dang / rig pa dang / blo dang /rtogs pa skyes so/ /dge slong dag nga sngon ma thos pa'i chos rnams la sdug bsngal 'phags pa'i bden pa de ngas mngon par shes pas yongs su shes par ⑨bya'o zhes tshul bzhin 0yid la byed pa na mig skyes so/ /shes pa dang / rig pa dang /blo dang / rtogs pa skyes so/ /dge slong dag nga 0sngon ma thos pa'i chos rnams 1—101

la sdug bsngal kun 'byung ba 'phags pa'i bden pa de ngas mngon par shes pas spang bar bya'o zhes tshul bzhin yid la byed pa na mig skyes so/ /shes pa dang /rig ①pa dang / blo dang / rtogs pa skyes so/ /dge slong dag nga sngon ma thos pa'i chos rnams la sdug bsngal 'gog par 'gro ba'i lam 'phags ②pa'i bden pa de ngas mngon par shes pas mngon sum ③du bya'o zhes tshul bzhin yid la byed pa na mig skyes so/ /shes pa dang / rig pa dang / blo dang /rtogs pa skyes so/ /dge slong dag nga sngon ma thos pa'i chos rnams la sdug bsngal 'gog par 'gro ba'i lam 'phags pa'i bden pa de byangs mngon par shes pas bsgom ⑤par bya'o zhes tshul bzhin yid la byed pa na mig skyes so/ /shes pa dang /rig pa dang / blo dang / rtogs pa skyes so/ /dge slong dag nga sngon ma thos pa'i chos rnams la sdug bsngal 'phags pa'i bden pa de ngas mngon par shes pas yongs su shes so zhes tshul bzhin yid la byed pa na mig skyes so/ /shes pa dang / rig pa dang / blo dang / rtogs ⑥pa skyes so/ /dge slong dag nga sngon ma thos pa'i chos rnams la sdug bsngal kun 'byung ba 'phags pa'i bden pa de ngas mngon par shes pas spangs so zhes tshul bzhin ⑦yid la byed pa na mig skyes so/ /shes pa dang / rig pa dang / blo dang / rtogs ⑧pa skyes so/ /dge slong dag nga sngon ma thos pa'i chos rnams la sdug bsngal 'gog pa 'phags ⑨pa'i bden pa de ngas mngon par shes pas mngon sum du byas so zhes tshul bzhin yid la byed pa na mig skyes so/ /shes pa dang / rig pa dang / blo dang /rtogs ⑨ pa skyes so/ /dge slong dag nga sngon ma thos pa'i chos rnams ⑩la sdug bsngal 'gog par 'gro ba'i lam 'phags pa'i bden pa de ngas mngon par shes 1—102
