pas bsgoms so zhes tshul bzhin yid la byed pa na mig skyes so/ /shes pa dang /rig pa dang / blo dang / rtogs ①pa skyes so/ /dge slong dag nga ji lasrid du ③'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi po 'di rnams la ④de ltar lan gsum du bzlas te rnam pa bcu gnyis su bskor ba'i mig ma skyesaX/ shes pa ma yin/ rig pa ma yin / blo ma yin/ rtogs ⑥pa ma ⑦skyes pa de nisrid du nga lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten ⑨bdud ⑩dang bcasayi/ tshangs pa dang bcas dge sbyong dang bram zer bcas pa'i skye dgu dang / lha dang mir bcas pa 'di las grol ba dang /nges par 'byung ba dang / mi ldan pa dang / rab tu grol ba dang / phyin ci log dang bral ba'i sems kyis mang du gnas par ma gyur cing dge slong dag ngas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so zhes bya bar ma shes so/ /dge slong dag ngas gang nas 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi po 'di rnams la de ltar lan gsum du bzlas te rnam pa 8bcu gnyis su bskor ba'i mig skyes shing shes pa dang / rig pa dang / blo dang /rtogs pa skyes pa de nas nga lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten/ bdud dang bcas/tshangs pa dang bcas/ tsodage sbyong dang bram zer bcas pa'i skye dgu dang lha dang mir bcas pa tso'adi las grol ba dang / nges par 'byung ba dang / mi ldan pa dang / rab tu grol ba dang / phyin ci log dang bral ba'i sems kyis mang du gnas par gyur cing / dge slong dag ngas de nas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so zhes bya bar shes so chos kyi rnam grangs de bka' stsal pa na tshe dang ldan pa kauṇ+ḍi n+ya byadang / lha brgyad khri la 0chos rnams la chos kyi mig rdul med cing dri ma dang bral ba skyes so/ /4—103

de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kauṇ+ḍi n+ya ①la bka' stsal pa/ kauṇ+ḍi n+ya khyod kyi ②chos kun shes sam/ bcom ldan 'das kun 'tshal lags so/ /kauṇ+ḍi n+ya khyod kyis chos ①kun shes sam/ kun shes sam/ bde bar rjogashegs pa kun 'tshal lags so/ /kun 'tshal lags so/ /tshe dang ldan pa kauṇ+ḍi rgyas chos kun shes pas de'i phyir tshe dang ldan pa kauṇ+ḍi n+ya kun shes kauṇ+ḍi n+ya zhes tshig bla dgas su btags so/ /tshe dang ldan pa kauṇ+ḍi rgyas chos kun shes so/ /zhes sa bla'i gnod sbyin rnams sgra sgrogs 0par byed do/ /grogs po dag bcom ldan 'das kyi 0bā rā ṇa sīr drang srong smra ba'i ①ri dgas kyi nags su lan gsum du bzlas te rnam ⑤pa bcu gnyis su chos kyi 'khor lo chos dang ldan pa/ dge sbyong ngam / bram ze'am/ lha'am/ bdud dam/ tshangs pa'am/ sus kyang 'jig rten du chos dang ldan ⑨par ma bskor ⑨ ba skye bo mang po la phan pa dang /skye bo mang po la bde ba dang / 'jig rten la snying brtse ba dang / lha dang mi rnams kyi don dang / phan pa dang / bde ba'i phyir bskor bas lha'i ris mngon par 'phel zhing lha ma yin gyi ris yongs su nyams so zhes dbyangs bsgrags yiso/ /sa bla'i gnod sbyin rnams kyi 8sgra thos nas nam mkha' la rgyu ba'i gnod sbyin dang /rgyal chen bzhi'i ris dang / sum bcu rtsa gsum pa'i lha dang / 'thab bral dang / dga' ldan dang / 'phrul dga' dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnams nas skad cig de dang / thang cig 8de dang / yud tsam de dang /skad cig dang / thang cig chadang / yud tsam de la 'tshangs pa'i 'jig rten gyi bar du sgra bsgrags so/ /tshangs ris kyi lha rnams kyis kyang sgra sgrogs ⑩par byed do/ /grogs 0po dag bcom ldan 'das kyis bā rā ṇa sīr drang srong ⑩smra 1—104

ba'i ri ①dgas kyi nags su lan gsum du bzlas te rnam pa bcu gnyis kyi chos kyi 'khor lo chos dang ldan pa ②dge sbyong ngam/ bram ze'am/ lha'am/ bdud dam / tshangs pa'am/ sus kyang 'jig rten du chos dang mthun par 'ga' yang ma bskor ba skye bo mang po la phan pa dang / skye bo mang po la bde ba dang /'jig rten la snying brtse ba dang / lha dang mi rnams kyi don dang / phan pa dang / bde ba'i phyir bskor bas lha'i ris mngon par 'phel zhing lha ma yin gyi ris ②yongs su nyams so zhes dbyangs bsgrags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bā rā ṇa sbor drang slong smra ba'i ④ri dgas kyi nags su lan gsum ⑤bzlas te rnam pa bcu gnyis su chos kyi 'khor lo chos dang ldan pa bskor bas de'i phyir chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba zhes tshig 0bla dgas su btags ⑦so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis lan gnyis su yang lnga sde'i dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi ni 'di dag yin te/bzhi gang zhe na/ sdug bsngal 'phags pa'i bden pa dang / sdug bsngal kun 'byung ba dang / sdug bsngal 'gog pa dang / sdug bsngal ⑧'gog par 'gro ba'i lam 'phags pa'i bden pa'o/ /sdug bsngal 'phags pa'i bden pa gang zhe na / skye ba sdug ⑨bsngal ba dang / rga ba sdug bsngal ba dang / na ba sdug bsngal ba dang / 'chi ba sdug bsngal ba dang / sdug pa dang bral ba sdug bsngal ba dang / mi sdug pa dang phrad pa 0sdug bsngal ba dang / gang 'dod pa btsal te ma rnyed pa de ⑩yang sdug bsngal ba dang / mdor na nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga sdug bsngal ba ste/ de yongs su shes par bya ba'i phyir 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa bsgom ⑩par bya'o/ /sdug bsngal kun 'byung ba 'phags 4—105

pa'i bden pa gang zhe na/ yang srid pa'i sred pa dga' ba'i 'dod chags dang ldan pa de dang de la mngon par 'dod pa ste/ de spang ba'i ①phyir 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa bsgom par bya'o/ /sdug bsngal 'gog pa 'phags pa'i bden pa gang zhe na/ yang srid pa'i sred pa dga' ba'i 'dod chags dang ldan pa de dang de la mngon par dga' ba gang yin pa de nyid ma lus par spangs pa dang / bor ba dang / bsal ②ba dang / zad pa dang / 'dod chags dang bral ba dang / 'gags ②pa dang / nye bar zhi ba dang / nub pa ste/de mngon sum du bya ba'i phyir 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa bsgom par bya'o / /sdug bsngal ④'gog par 'gro ba'i lam 'phags pa'i bden pa gang zhe na / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa te⑤/ 'di lta ste/ yang dag pa'i lta ba dang / yang dag pa'i rtog pa yidang / yang dag pa'i ngag dang /yang dag pa'i las kyi mtha' dang / yang dag pa'i 'tsho ba dang / yang dag pa'i rtsol ba dang / yang dag pa'i dran pa dang / yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin te/ de yang bsgom ⑦par bya'o/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bshad pa na tshe dang ldan pa kun shes kauṇ+ḍi n+ya len pa med par zag pa rnams las sems rnam par grol lo/ /lnga sde'i dge slong lhag ma rnams dul ni chos rnams la ①chos kyi ⑩mig rdul med cing dri ma dang bral ba skyes so/ /de'i tshe 'jig rten na dgra bcom pa gcig dang / gnyis pa ni bcom ldan 'das so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis yang dge slong lnga sde lhag ma rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag gzugs ni bdag ma yin no/ /dge slong dag gal te gzugs bdag yin na ⑩gzugs la gnod pa dang / sdug bsngal bar mi 'gyur zhing gzugs la 1—106

bdag gi gzugs 'di lta bur gyur cig /'di lta bur ma gyur cig snyam ①yang 'thob par ①'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag gang gi phyir gzugs bdag ma yin pa de'i phyir gzugs ②la gnod pa dang / sdug bsngal bar 'gyur zhing gzugs la bdag gi gzugs 'di lta bur gyur cig /'di lta ④bur ma gyur cig snyam ⑤yang 'thob ༅par mi 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang /'du byed ⑦dang / rnam par shes pa la rnam par shes pa ni bdag ma yin no/ /dge slong dag gal te rnam par shes pa bdag yin na rnam par shes pa la gnod pa dang / sdug bsngal bar mi 'gyur zhing rnam par shes pa la bdag gi ⑧rnam par shes pa 'di lta bur gyur cig /'di lta bur ma gyur cig snyam ༅yang 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag gang gi byaphyir rnam par shes pa bdag ma yin pa de'i phyir rnam par shes pa la gnod pa dang / sdug bsngal bar 'gyur zhing rnam par shes pa la bdag gi rnam par shes pa 'di lta bur gyur cigaskye /'di lta bur ma gyur cig snyam 8yang 'thob nyunyepar mi 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag lku ji snyam du sems / gzugs rtag gam mi rtag btsun pa mi rtag lags so/ /mi rtag pa ④de sdug bsngal yin nam/ sdug bsngal ma yin/ btsun pa sdug bsngal skyelags sol/ /mi rtag pa sdug bsngal ba byarnam par 'gyur ba'i chos gang yin pa de la cig 8'phags pa'i 0nyan thos thos pa dang ldan pa 'di ni bdag go/ /bdag 0ni 'di yin no/ /'di ni bdag gi bdag go zhes bdag tu khas len tam/btsun pa ma lags so/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ tshor ba dang /'du shes dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa rtag gam mi rtag /btsun pa mi rtag lags so/ /mi rtag pa gang yin pa de sdug bsngal yin nam 4—107

sdug bsngal ma yin/ btsun pa sdug bsngal lags so/ /mi rtag pa sdug bsngal ba rnam par 'gyur ba'i chos gang yin pa de la cig ①'phags pa'i ②nyan thos thos pa dang ldan pa 'di ③ni bdag go/ /bdag ni 'di yin no/ /'di ni bdag gi bdag go zhes bdag tu khas len tam/ btsun pa ma lags so/ /dge slong dag de lta bas na gzugs gang yin pa ci yang rung ④'das pa'am/ ma 'ongs pa'am / da ltar byung ba'am/ nang gi'am/ phyi'i 'am/ rags pa'am/phra ba'am/ ngan pa'am/ gya rnam pa'am/ gang dag thag ring ba'am/gang dag thag nye ba de dag thams cad ni bdag ma yin/ bdag ni de ma yin/de ni bdag gi bdag ma yin no zhes ji lta ba de bzhin du yang dag pa'i shes rab kyis blta bar bya'o/ /dge slong dag de lta bas na tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa ji snyed pa gang ci yang rung 'das pa'am / ma 'ongs pa'am/ da ltar byung ba'am/ nang gi'am/ phyi'i 'am/rags pa'am/ phra ba'am/ ngan pa'am/ gya rnam pa'am/ gang dag thag ring ba'am/ gang dag thag nye ba de ⑤dag thams cad ni bdag ma yin/bdag ni de ma yin/ de ni bdag gi bdag ma yin no zhes ji lta ba de bzhin du yang dag pa'i shes rab kyis blta bar bya'o/ /dge slong dag 'di ltar 'phags pa'i nyan thos thos pa dang ldan pa ni nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga po yi'adi bdag ma ⑦yin/ bdag gi ⑧ma yin par lta ba ste/ de de ltar blta ⑨ba na 'jig rten ci yang len pa med do/ /len pa med na yongs su gdung ba med do/ /yongs su gdung ba med na bdag nyid yongs su mya ngan las 'das te ⑩bdag gi skye ba zad do/ /tshangs par spyod pa la bsten 0to/ /bya ba byas so/ /srid pa 4—108

'di dag ①las gzhan mi shes so zhes bya bar 'gyur ro/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bshad pa na/ lnga sde'i dge slong lhag ma rnams kyis len pa med par zag pa rnams ②las rju sems rnam par grol lo/ /de'i tshe ④dgra bcom pa lnga dang drug pa ni bcom ldan 'das so//de nas bcom ldan 'das bā rā ṇa sī'i ⑤'bab chu gnod pa can gyi 'gram ⑥na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe bā rā ṇa sī na rigs kyi ⑦gtso bo zhes bya ba'i bu grags pa zhes bya ba zhig gnas te/ de nyi ma re re zhing bud med kyis byas pa'i rol mos rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed pas lus snyom/ lus dub/ she lus rgud ⑨pas myur du gnyid kyis log par gyur to/ /bud med de rnams kyang lus snyomakye / lus dub/ lus rgud ⑨pas myur du gnyid kyis nyu)log par gyur to/ /rigs kyi 8gtso bo'i bu grags pa mtshan mo gnyid sad pa na bud med de dag thams cad rdol zhing sgren mor byung la skra skyozhig lag pa brkyang ste byung rgyal du bla ba mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang de rang gi chung ma la dur khrod kyi 'du shes skyes par gyur to/ /de nas rigs kyi gtso bo'i bu grags pa mal chen po las skyebabs te/ rin po che'i lham brgya stong ri ba zung gcig ⑩gon nas nyal khang gi sgo gang na ba der song ste phyin nas grogs po bdag ni gtses so/ /grogs po bdag ni nyams so zhes skad ngan phyung ba dang /de'i sgo mi ma yin pa rnams kyis phye nas skad kyang mi grag ⑩par byas so/ /de nas rigs kyi gtso bo'i bu grags pa khyim gyi sgo gang na ba tsoder song ste phyin nas grogs po bdag ni gtses so/ /grogs po bdag ni nyams so zhes skad ngan phyung ba dang / de'i sgo mi ma yin pa yirnams kyis phye nas skad kyang mi grag du par byas 1—109

so / /de nas rigs kyi gtso bo'i bu grags pa grong khyer gyi sgo gang na ba der song ste phyin nas grogs po bdag ni gtses ①so/ /grogs po bdag ni ②nyams so zhes skad ngan phyung ba dang / de'i sgo mi ma yin pa ②rnams kyis phye nas rgyaskad kyang mi grag par byas so/ /de nas rigs kyi gtso bo'i bu grags pa 'bab chu gnod pa can gang na ba der song ba dang / de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das 'bab chu gnod pa can gyi 'gram na gtsug lag khang gi phyi rol bla gab med pa na rigs kyi gtso bo'i bu grags pa 'ong ba ⑤la yang dang yang du gzhes ⑥shing 'chag pas 'chag rdzigo/ /rigs kyi gtso bo'i bu grags pas bcom ldan 'das 'bab chu gnod pa can gyi 'gram na 'chag ⑧pa rgyang ring po nas mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang dge sbyong bdag ni gtses so/ /dge sbyong bdag ni nyams so zhes skad ngan phyung 0ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rigs kyi gtso bo'i bu grags pa la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /gzhon nu tshur shog gnas 'di ni khyod la 'tshe ba med pa yin/ 'di ni nyams pa med pa yin no/ /de nas rigs kyi gtso bo'i bu grags pa rin po che'i lham brgya stong ri ba zung gcig po ⑩'bab chu gnod pa can gyi 'gram du phud nas 'bab chu gnod pa can rgal te/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi 7zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis (sprerigs kyi gtso bo'i bu grags pa khrid de nyid kyi gtsug lag khang gang na ba der ⑫gshegs nas byon pa dang gdan bshams ④pa nyid la bzhugs so/ /bzhugs nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rigs kyi gtso bo'i bu grags pa la chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par bstan/ yang dag par 'dzin du bcug /yang dag 4—110

par gzengs bstod①/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad de/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis thog ②ma'i dus su chos kyi gtam gleng ba gang yin pa de ni 'di lta ste/ sbyin pa'i gtam dang / tshul khrims kyi gtam dang /mtho ris kyi gtam dang / 'dod pa rnams la mnog ②chung zhing nyes dmigs dang / kun ④nas nyon mongs pa dang / rnam par byang ba dang / nges par 'byung ba dang / rab tu dben pa rjes su bsngags pa dang / rnam par byang ba'i phyogs kyi chos rnams rgya cher bshad do/ /gang gi tshe de bcom ldan 'das kyis dga' ba'i sems dang / dge ba'i sems dang / mgu ⑤ba'i sems dang /sgrib pa dang bral ba'i sems dang / skal ⑥ba ⑦dang ldan pa dang / yang dag phul gyi chos bshad na shes par nus par gzigs pa de'i tshe sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi ②yang dag phul gyi chos bshad pa gang yin pa 'di lta ste/'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi po sdug bsngal dang / kun 'byung ba dang /'gog pa dang / lam de rgya cher 0bshad do/ /dper na gos gtsang ma nag nog med pa tshon rtsi 'os pa'i nang du bcug na tshon rtsi legs par 'jen 0 du btub pa de bzhin du rigs kyi gtso bo'i bu grags pa stan 7de nyid la 'dug bzhin du 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi po 'di lta ste/ sdug bsngal dang / kun 'byung ba dang / 'gog pa dang / lam rtogs so/ /de nas rigs kyi cigatso bo'i bu grags pa chos mthong ba dang / chos thob 'apa dang / chos rig pa dang /chos kyi gting slebs ④pa dang / som nyi las rgal ba dang / the tshom las rgal ba dang / gzhan gyi 8dring mi 'jog pa dang / gzhan gyis ⑩mi bkri ba dang /ston pas bstan pa'i chos rnams la mi 'jigs pa thob nas stan las langs te bla 4—111

gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba de ②logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de②/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bdag ni 'phags so/ /mngon par 'phags so bdag bcom ldan 'das dang / chos dang / dge slong gi sridage 'dun la skyabs su mchi lags kyis/bdag dge bsnyen du gzung du gsol/ deng slan chad ji srid 'tsho'i ④bar du srog dang yang bsdos te skyabs su mchi bar mngon par dad lags so// //'dul ba gzhi༅/ bam po brgyad bcu yibadun pa/ bran mo zhig de nyid kyi mtshan mo ⑦gnyid log pa las sad na gzhon nu grags pa mal chen po na ⑧mi snang bar mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang khyim bdag gi ⑨gtso bo gang na ba der song ste phyin nas khyim bdag rigs kyi gtso bo la 'di skad ces smras staso/ /jo bo mkhyen par mdzod cig /gzhon nu grags pa ni yirang gi mal chen po na mi gda' lags so/ /de nas khyim bdag rigs kyi gtso bo 'di snyam du sems te/gzhon nu nor gyi phyir chom rkun nam g.yon can rnams kyis 8phyi rol du khrid par ma gyur grang snyam du sems shing phyogs bzhir pho nya rta 8pa dag bkye nas rang nyid mi lag na sgron ma thogs pa rnams dang lhan cig tu 'bab chu gnod pa can gang na ba de logs su song ba dang / khyim bdag rigs kyi gtso bos 'bab chu gnod pa ④can gyi 'gram na rin po che'i lham brgya stong ri ba zung gcig 8phud pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang de 'di snyam du sems te/ gzhon nu ni nor gyi phyir chom rkun nam g.yon can rnams kyis phyi rol du ma 8khrid kyi0/ 'di ltar 'bab chu gnod pa can gyi 'gram na rin po che'i 8lham brgya stong ri ba zung gcig ⑩phud pa las na gzhon nu 'bab chu gnod pa can gyi ngogs du'adi nyid nas rgal bar ma 1—112

gyur grang / 'di ltar 'bab chu gnod pa can gyi 'gram na rin po che'i lham brgya stong ri ba zung gcig ①bor ro snyam du bsams nas/ 'bab chu gnod pa can gyi ngogs ②de nyid nas rgal te bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ngo / /②bcom ldan 'das kyis hrikhyim bdag rigs kyi gtso bo rgyang ring po nas gzigs so//gzigs nas kyang 'di snyam du dgongs te/ ci nas kyang ngas rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du bya ba ji lta bus ⑤mngon par 'du bya bas khyim bdag rigs kyi ⑥gtso bos gzhon nu grags pa stan 'di nyid la 'dug bzhin du mi mthong ba de lta bu zhig bya'o snyam nas/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rdzu 'phrul mngon par ⑦'du bya ba ji lta bu mngon par 'du mdzad pas khyim bdag rigs kyi gtso bos gzhon nu grags pa stan de ②nyid la 'dug bzhin du mi mthong ba de lta bu mdzad do/ /de nas khyim bdag rigs kyi gtso bo bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /⑨bcom ldan 'das ci ga gzhon nu grags pa gzigs sam khyim bdag de'i phyir 'dug shig cadang / stan 'di kho na la gzhin nu grags pa 'dug pa mthong bar 'gyur ba'i gnas gang yin pa de yod do/ /de nas khyim bdag rigs kyi gtso bo 'di snyam du sems te/gdon 7mi za bar bcom ldan 'das kyis gzhon nu grags pa gzigs par gyur to//'di ltar bcom ldan 'das kyis tso'adi skad ces khyim bdag de'i phyir tso'adug shig ④dang / stan 'di kho na la gzhon nu grags pa 'dug pa mthong bar 'gyur ba'i gnas gang yin pa de 8yod do zhes bka' stsal to snyam tsodu rig 0nas dga' ba dang / mgu ba dang / mchog tu dga' ba dang / dga' ba rgya chen po dang / yid bde ba skyes nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos 4—113

phyag byas te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug ①pa dang /khyim bdag rigs kyi gtso bo la chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par bstan / yang dag ②par 'dzin du bcug /yang dag par gzengs bstod /yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad deX/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi ༅thog ma'i dus su chos kyi gtam gleng ba gang yin pa 'di lta ste/ sbyin pa'i gtam dang / tshul khrims kyi yigatam dang / mtho ris kyi gtam dang /'dod pa rnams la mnog chung zhing nyes dmigs dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa ⑦dang / rnam par byang ba dang / nges par 'byung ba dang / rab tu dben pa'i rjes su bsngags pa dang / rnam par byang ba'i phyogs kyi chos rgya cher bshad dom/ /gang gi tshe de bcom ldan 'das kyis dga' ba'i sems dang / dge ba'i sems dang ⑧/ mgu ba'i sems dang / sgrib pa dang bral ba'i sems dang / skal ba dang ldan pa dang / yang dag phul gyi chos bshad na shes par nus par gzigs pa de'i tshe sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi ⑨yang dag phul gyi chos bshad pa gang yin pa 'di lta ste/ 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi po sdug bsngal ⑨ dang / kun 'byung ba dang / 'gog pa dang / lam rgya cher bshad do/ /dper na gos gtsang ma nag nog med pa tshon rtsi 'os pa'i nang du bcug na tshon rtsi legs par 'jen 0du btub pa de bzhin du khyim bdag rigs kyi gtso bo stan de nyid la 'dug bzhin du 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi po 'di lta ste/sdug bsngal dang / kun 'byung ba 'dang / 'gog pa dang / lam rtogs te⑩/chos kyi rnam grangs ④de bshad pa na khyim bdag rigs kyi gtso bo chos rnams la chos kyi mig rdul med cing dri ma dang bral ba 8skyes so/ /tshe dang ldan pa grags 4—114

pa yang rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan bzhin du len pa med par zag pa rnams las sems rnam par grol bar gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du mdzad pa de slar bsdus nas de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pas bka' stsal pa/ rgyan gyis brgyan bzhin du ni chos spyad ①de/ /dul zhing yang dag sdom pa tshangs spyod la/ /'byung po kun la chad pa spangs pa ②ni/ /de ni bram ze dge sbyong dge slong yin/ /de'i tshe 'jig rten na dgra bcom pa drug dang bdun pa ni bcom ldan 'das so/ /khyim bdag rigs kyi gtso bos gzhon nu grags pa stan de nyid ③la 'dug pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang gzhon nu grags pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /gzhon nu tshur shog khyod kyi ④ma lus ngal zhing lus dub pas smre sngags 'don gyis khyim du 'dong / de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis khyim bdag rigs kyi gtso bo la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /khyim bdag ji snyam du sems/ gang gis mi slob pa'i shes pa dang / mi slob pa'i lta bas 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi po 'di lta ste/ sdug bsngal dang /kun 'byung ba ⑤dang / 'gog pa dang / lam mngon par rtogs pa de ci ga khyim pa khyim na gnas pa'am/ sogs ⑥'jog gi longs spyod kyis 'dod pa la ⑦spyod par 'gyur ram/ btsun pa ma lags so/ /khyim bdag ji ltar khyod kyis slob pa'i shes pa dang / slob pa'i lta bas 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi po 'di lta ste / sdug bsngal dang / kun 'byung ba ⑧dang / 'gog pa dang / lam mngon par rtogs pa de bzhin du gzhon nu grags pas mi slob pa'i shes pa dang /mi slob pa'i lta bas 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi po 'di lta ste/ sdug bsngal dang /kun 'byung ba ⑨dang / 'gog pa dang / lam mngon par rtogs so/ /btsun pa 4—115

gzhon nu grags pas gang gis na mi slob pa'i shes pa dang / mi slob pa'i lta bas 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi po 'di lta ste/ sdug bsngal dang / kun 'byung ba ①dang / 'gog pa dang / lam mngon par rtogs pa ②ni rnyed pa legs par rnyed lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das slad bzhin 'brang ba'i dge sbyong grags pa dang thugs brtse ba nye bar bzung ste rigs kyi gtso bo'i khyim zhugang na ba der gshegs na legs so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis khyim bdag rigs kyi gtso bo la cang mi gsung bas gnang ngo de nas khyim bdag rigs kyi gtso byabos bcom ldan 'das cang mi gsung bas gnang bar rig nas bcom ldan 'das kyi h+phuzhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga nas ༅song ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de nyid kyi rtsomatshan mo 'das nas snga rgyadro na bza' sham mthabs mnabs/ lhung bzed dang chos gos bsnams te/ phyi bzhin 'brang ba'i dge sbyong tshe dang ldan pa grags pa dang khyim bdag rigs kyi gtso bo'i khyim gang con ba der gshegs so/ /de'i tshe tshe dang ldan pa grags pa'i ma dang / chung ma gnyis bcom ldan 'das la yang dang yang du bsu nyu ba'i phyir bar sgo na sdod do/ /tshe dang ldan nyunyepa grags pa'i ma dang / chung ma gnyis kyis tho)bcom ldan 'das sku rgyang ring po nas mthong ngo / / nyusnyemathong nas kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi phyir gdan bshams nas 'di skad ces kyang gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das tshur spyon bcom ldan 'das byon pa legs so/ /bcom ldan 'das gdan bshams pa nyid la bzhugs su gsol zhes gsol nas bcom ldan 'das gdan ⑩bshams pa nyid la bzhugs so/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa grags pa'i ma dang chung ma gnyis kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi 7zhabs gnyis la mgo bos 1—116

phyag byas te phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /phyogs gcig tu 'khod nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa grags pa'i ma dang / chung ma gnyis la chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par bstan༅/ yang dag par 'dzin du bcug /yang dag par gzengs dubastod/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad de/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi ⑧thog ma'i dus su chos kyi gtam gleng ba gang yin pa ༅'di lta ste/ sbyin pa'i gtam dang / tshul khrims kyi gtam dang /mtho ris kyi gtam phyedang / 'dod pa rnams la mnog ༅chung zhing nyes ⑦dmigs dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa dang / rnam par byang ba dang /nges par 'byung ba dang / rab tu dben pa'i rjes su bsngags pa dang / rnam par byang ba'i phyogs kyi chos rnams rgya cher bshad do/ /gang gi tshe de gnyis bcom ldan 'das kyis dga' ba'i sems dang / dge ba'i sems dang / mgu ba'i sems dang / sgrib pa dang bral ba'i sems dang / skal ba dang ldan pa dang /yang dag phul gyi 5chos bshad na shes par nus pa gzigs pa de'i tshe/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi yang dag phul gyi chos bshad pa gang yin pa 'di lta ste/ 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi po sdug bsngal thodang / kun 'byung ba dang / 'gog pa dang / lam de rgya cher bshad do/ /dper na gos gtsang ma nag nog med pa tshon rtsi 'os pa'i nang du bcug na co tshon 7rtsi legs par 'jen 8du btub pa de bzhin du tshe dang ldan pa grags pa'i ma dang /chung ma gnyis kyis stan de nyid la 'khod bzhin du 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi po 'di lta ste/ sdug bsngal tsodang / kun 'byung ba ⑪ dang / 'gog pa dang /lam mngon par rtogs so/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa grags pa'i ma dang /4—117

chung ma gnyis kyis chos mthong ba dang / chos thob pa dang / chos rig pa dang / chos kyi gting slebs ①pa dang / som nyi las rgal ba dang / the tshom las rgal ba dang / gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog ②pa dang / gzhan gyis mi bkri ①ba dang / ston pas bstan pa'i chos rnams la mi 'jigs pa thob nas stan ④las langs te/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba de ②logs su thal ⑥me sbyar ba btud nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di ⑦skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bdag cag ni 'phags so/ /⑧bdag cag ni mngon par 'phags ⑨lags te/ bdag cag ⑩bcom ldan 'das dang chos dang dge slong gi yidage 'dun la skyabs su mchi lags kyis/ bdag cag tsodage bsnyen du gzung tsodu gsol/ deng slan chad ji srid 'tsho'i bar du srog dang yang bsdos te skyabs su mchi bar mngon par dad lags so/ /btsun pa de'i slad du 'dir tu) zhal zas kyi mdzad pa mdzad du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa grags pa'i ma dang /chung ma gnyis la cang mi gsung bas gnang ngo / /de rgyusmenas tshe dang ldan pa grags pa'i ma dang / chung ma gnyis kyis bcom ldan 'das kyis spre'ucang mi gsung bas gnang bar rig nas bcom ldan 'das gdan la bde bar ⑩bzhugs pa dang / gtsang zhing bsod pa'i bza' ba dang bca' ba dag rang gi lag ⑫nas stobs shing tshim par byed do/ /rnam yigangs du mar gtsang zhing bsod pa'i bza' ba dang bca' ba dag rang gi lag nas bstabs shing tshim par byas nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gsol zin cing phyag bcabs te lhung bzed gyu bar rig du nas stan ches dma' ba zhig blangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi 0spyan sngar chos mnyan pa'i phyir 'khod do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa 4—118

grags pa'i ma dang / chung ma gnyis la chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par ston par mdzad/ yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug par mdzad/ yang dag par gzengs stod ①par mdzad/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad de/rnam grangs du mar chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par bstan②/ yang dag par 'dzin du bcug /yang dag par gzengs ②bstod/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad nas gdan las bzhengs te khyogashegs so/ /dge slong rnams the tshom skyes nas the tshom ⑤thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa tshe dang ldan pa grags pas las ci zhig bgyis na las de'i rnam par smin pas mchis 'brang ⑤gi 'khor na mchis na rang gi mchis 'brang ⑦la dur khrod kyi 'du shes skyes shing rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan bzhin du bcom ldan 'das kyi laspyan sngar dgra bcom pa mngon ⑨sum du bgyis lags/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag grags pa 'di nyid kyis ⑩las tshogs rnyed pa/ rkyen yongs su bsgyur ba/ 'od pa bzhin du nye bar gnas pa(spre/ gdon mi za bar 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i las dag byas shing bsags te ⑫/ 'di nyid kyis las byas shing bsags pa dag gzhan su zhig gis myong bar 'gyur/ dge slong dag las byas shing bsags pa dag ni phyi rol gyi sa'i khams la rnam par smin par tho)mi 'gyur/ chu'i khams la thostemi 'gyur/me'i khams la mi 'gyur/ rlung gi khams la mi 'gyurabya/ 'di ltar las dge ba dang mi dge ba byas shing bsags pa dag ni zin pa'i phung po dang khams dang /skye mched la rnam par smin par 'gyur te/ las rnams bskal pa brgyar yang ni⑩/ /chud mi za ba'ang tshogs dang dus/ /rnyed na lus can rnams la ni/ /'bras 4—119

bu dag tu 'gyur ba nyid/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba la'i rā ṇa sri'i grong khyer dang ha cang yang ②mi ring ba zhig na drang ⑧srong byams pa'i bdag nyid snying rje can sems can thams cad la phan par sems pa zhig gnas pa de bsod snyoms la zhugs pa na mi ro zhig mthong nas/ de de la zhen pa'i sems kyis bsod snyoms la zhugs te/ bsod snyoms spyad nas slar log pa dang / ji tsam na mi ro de rnam par sngos ④shing rnam par bam par 'gyur ba bltas pa dang / de nyid kyi mdun du zhigs nas des de nyid du 'dod ⑤chags dang bral ba bskyed do/ /dge slong dag ji ༅snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus kyi drang srong gang yin pa de ni gzhon nu grags pa 'di nyid yin te/ 'dis de na ⑦'dod ༅chags dang bral ba bskyed de/ des na ⑨da ltar chung tho )ma'i nang na 'dug pa na rkyen rnyed pa yin no/ /dge slong dag de lta bas na las gcig tu gnag pa rnams kyi rnam par smin pa ni gcig tu gnag /༄pa yin la/gcig tu dkar ba rnams kyi ni gcig tu dkar ba dang / 'dren tsom rnams kyi ni 'dren tsom yin pas dge 8slong dag de lta bas na las gcig tu gnag pa dang 'dren ma 8rnams ni spangs la las gcig tsoku dkar ba rnams la brtsal bar bya ste/ dge slong dag khyed kyis 4)de lta bu la bslab par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / dge slong de dag yi tsorangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do/ /bā rā ṇa sī na khyim bdag rigs kyi gtso bos tho)bu gnyis pa 0 dang / gsum pa dang / bzhi pa dang / lnga pa gang po dang / dri med 0dang / ba lang bdag dang / lag bzangs te(sme/ rigs kyi gtso bo'i bu dag gis 4—120

rigs kyi gtso bo'i bu grags pa skra dang kha spu bregs te gos ngur smrig bgos nas dad pa yang dag pa kho nas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ngo zhes thos so/ /thos nas kyang de dag 'di snyam du sems te/ kye ma'o sangs rgyas ni mchog ma yin pa ma yin zhing / chos bstan pa yang mchog ma yin pa ma yin te/ gang gi phyir da ltar rigs kyi gtso bo'i bu grags pa re zhig shin tu gzhon pa shin tu bde ba 'dod pa yang skra ①dang ②kha spu bregs te gos ngur smrig bgos ②nas dad pa yang dag pa kho nas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung gis/ ma la bdag cag ④gis kyang skra ⑤dang kha spu bregs te/ gos ngur smrig bgos nas dad pa yang dag pa 0kho nas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu 'byung ⑦bar bya'o snyam mo/ /de nas rigs kyi gtso bo'i bu gnyis pa dang / gsum pa dang / bzhi pa dang / lnga pa gang po dang / dri med dang / ba lang bdag dang / lag bzangs te③/rigs kyi gtso bo'i bu rnams bā rā ṇa sī nas byung ⑨nas bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der dong ste lhags nas bcom ldan 'das kyi 7zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te phyogs gcig tu 'khod do /༄/ /phyogs gcig 8tu 'khod nas rigs kyi gtso bo'i bu gnyis pa dang / gsum pa dang / bzhi pa dang / lnga pa gang po dang / dri med dang / ba lang bdag dang / lag bzangs teX/ rigs kyi gtso bo'i bu rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la bdag cag byarab tu 'byung ba dang bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos po gnang na/ bdag cag bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar tshangs par spyod pa spyad par bgyi'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa de dag gis legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la tshurab tu byung ⑩ba 4—121

dang bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi ①dngos po thob ste/ de ltar rab tu byung nas tshe dang ldan pa de dag gcig pu dben pa bag ②yod pa rtun ①pa dang ldan pa/bdag nyid gtong bar gnas so/ /gcig pu dben pa bag yod pa rtun ④pa dang ldan pa/ bdag nyid gtong bar gnas pa na gang gi phyir rigs kyi bu dag skra dang kha spu bregs te gos ⑤dur smrig bgos nas dad pa yang dag pa ༅kho nas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu 'byung bar ⑦byed pa tshangs par ⑧spyod pa'i mtha' bla na med pa tshe de nyid la rang gi mngon par shes pas mngon sum du byas te/bsgrubs nas bdag cag gi skye ba ⑨zad do/ /tshangs par spyod pa bsten to/ / bya ba ⑩byas so/ /srid pa 'di las gzhan mi shes so zhes go bar byed cing tshe dang ldan pa de dag sems shin tu rnam par grol ba kun shes pa dang ldan pa'i dgra bcom par gyur to/ /de'i tshe 'jig rten na dgra bcom pa bcu dang bcu gcig pa ni bcom ldan 'das so/ /bā rā ṇa sī'i grong mi gtso bo gtso bo (sprernams kyi khye'u 8lnga bcus rigs kyi gtso bo'i bu dang po phyedang / gnyis pa dang /gsum pa dang / bzhi pa dang / lnga pa ste/ grags pa dang / gang po ④dang /dri med dang / ba lang 8bdag dang / lag bzangs te⑩/ rigs kyi gtso bo'i bu rnams skra dang kha spu bregs te gos ngur smrig bgos te chadad pa yang dag pa kho nas khyim nas 8khyim med par rab tu byung ngo zhes thos so/ /thos nas kyang de dag 'di snyam du sems te/ kye ma sangs rgyas ni mchog ma yin pa ma yin zhing chos bstan pa yang mchog ma yin pa ma yin te/ gang gi phyir da ltar rigs kyi gtso bo'i bu dang po dang / gnyis pa dang / gsum pa dang /bzhi pa dang / lnga pa ste/ grags pa dang ⑩/ gang po dang / dri med dang /4—122 kyi

ba lang bdag dang / lag bzangs te①/ rigs kyi gtso bo'i bu rnams ni re zhig shin tu gzhon pa shin tu bde ba 'dod pa yang spa dang kha spu bregs te gos ngur smrig bgos ②nas dad pa yang dag pa kho nas khyim nas zhukhyim med par rab tu byung gis/ ma la bdag cag kyang skra dang kha spu bregs ④nas gos ngur smrig bgos te dad pa yang dag pa kho nas khyim nas khyim med ⑤par rab tu byung ba bya'o 0snyam mo/ /de nas grong gi ⑦mi gtso bo lagatso bo rnams kyi khye'u lnga bcu po dag bā rā ṇa sī nas ⑨bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste lhags pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs tshul mgo bos phyag byas te phyogs gcig 0tu 'khod do//phyogs gcig 8tu 'khod nas grong mi gtso bo gtso bo rnams kyi ⑫khye'u tsolnga bcu po dag gis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bdag cag legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu 'byung ba dang bsnyen 8par rdzogs pa tshudage slong gi dngos po gnang rkyen/ bdag cag bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar tshangs par spyod pa spyad par bgyi'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa de dag legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu byung ba dang bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos po thob ste/ de ltar rab tu byung nas tshe dang ldan pa de dag gcig pu dben pa bag yod pa rtun 8pa dang ldan pa/ bdag nyid gtong bar gnas so/ /gcig pu dben pa bag yod pa rtun yipa dang ldan pa/ bdag nyid gtong bar gnas pa na chagang gi phyir rigs kyi bu dag skra dang kha spu bregs te gos ngur smrig bgos nas dad pa yang dag pa 0kho nas khyim nas 'khyim med par rab tu 'byung bar byed pa tshangs par spyod pa'i mtha' bla na med pa de 'tshe de nyid la rang gi mngon par shes pas mngon sum du byas te bsgrubs nas bdag cag rdzi1—123

gi skye ba zad do/ /tshangs par spyod pa bsten to/ /bya ba byas so/ /srid pa 'di las gzhan mi shes so zhes go bar byed cing tshe dang ldan pa de dag sems shin tu rnam par grol ba kun shes pa dang ldan pa'i dgra bcom par gyur to/ /de'i tshe 'jig rten na dgra bcom pa drug bcu dang drug bcu rtsa ②gcig pa ni bcom ldan 'das so//de nas bcom ldan 'das bā rā rgyaṇa sī'i drang srong smra ba'i duri dgas kyi genags na bzhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag nga ④ni lha dang mi'i 'ching ba gang yin pa thams cad las grol ba skyoyin no/ /dge slong dag khyed kyang lha dang mi rnams kyi 'ching ba gang yin pa thams rtsocad rdulas grol ba yin gyis/ dge slong dag skye bo mang po la phan pa dang / skye bo mang po la yang rtsabade ba dang / 'jig rten la snying brtse ba dang / lha dang mi rnams la phan pa dang bde ba'i ched du rgyu zhing deng la khyed gnyis shing ni gcig tu ma 'gro shig /nga yang lteng rgyas kyi grong khyer sde can gang na ba der rgyu zhing gshegs so/ /de nas bdud sdig can 'di snyam du sems te / dge sbyong gi ta ma 'di bā rā n+tu ṇa sī'i drang srong smra ba'i /nyeri dgas kyi nags na 'dug nas de nyan thos rnams la 'di skad du chos ston rteto/ /dge slong dag nga ni lha dang mi'i 'ching ba gang yin pa mthams cad las grol ba yin no/ /dge slong dag khyed kyang lha dang mi'i 'ching ba gang yin pa thams cad las grol ba yin gyis/ dge slong dag skye bo mang po la phan pa dang zhes bya ba nas rgyu zhing deng shig ces bya ba'i bar du ste/ nga yang lteng rgyas kyi grong khyer sde can gang na bar ⑫rgyu zhing 'gro'o zhes zer gyis/ ma la bdag gis de la 'di lta ste/ dkrug pa'i 4—124

las shig bya ba'i phyir nye bar 'gro'o snyam mo/ /de nas bdud sdig can bram ze'i khye'u'i ①kha dog tu bdag nyid mngon par lasprul te bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der gsong ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi 0spyan sngar 'dug ste tshigs su bcad pas gsol pa/ ma grol grol bar 'du shes na/ /ji ltas bdag nyid grol bar sems/ /bdag gis dge sbyong ma bkrol ⑤bas/ /'ching ba chen pos bcings pa yin/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 'di snyam du dgongs te/e ma'o 'di ni bdud sdig can yin te/ 'di lta ste/ dkrug ⑥pa'i las kyi phyir nye bar 'ongs so snyam du thugs su chud nas tshigs su bcad de bka' ⑦stsal pa / nga ni lha dang mi rnams kyi/ /'ching ba ⑤gang yin kun las grol/ /bar chad byed pa ⑨khyod bcom par/ /sdig can de ltar shes par gyis/ /de nas bdud sdig can 'di snyam du sems te/ dge sbyong go ta ma'i sems kyis bdag gi ⑩sems shes so snyam du rig nas sdug bsngal zhing yid mi bde ba yid ⑩la gcags tsonas de nyid du mi snang bar gyur tsoto/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis lan gnyis su yang dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag cing ni lha dang mi rnams kyi 'ching ba gang yin pa thams cad las grol ba yin no/ /dge slong dag khyed kyang lha dang mi rnams kyi tso'aching ba gang yin pa thams cad las grol ba yin gyis/ dge slong dag skye bo mang po la phan pa dang zhes bya ba nas rgyu zhing deng shig ces bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /nga yang cilteng rgyas kyi grong 0khyer sde can gang na ba der gshegs so/ /btsun pa bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das las mnyan tsonas ljongs rgyu zhing dong ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bā rā ṇa sīr ji tsam bzhed ⑩kyi 4—126

bar du bzhugs nas lteng rgyas kyi grong khyer sde can gang na ba der rgyu zhing gshegs te rim gyis rgyu zhing gshegs pa dang / grong khyer sde can du byon to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das ras bal can gyi nags tshang tshing gang na ba der gshegs te byon nas shing zhig gi drung du brten te nyin par gyi ①gnas pas bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe drug bcu sde bzang po'i 0tshogs grong khyer sde can gyi phyi rol du nyi ma re re zhing bud med kyis byas pa'i rol mos rtse bar byed/ dga' ①bar byed/dga' mgur spyod par byed pa na④/ de rnams las bud med cig phyedam bcas pa dral te bros so/ /de nas drug bcu sde ⑥bzang po'i tshogs bud med de tshol zhing ras bal can gyi nags tshang tshing gang na ba der dong ba ⑦dang / drug bcu sde bzang po'i tshogs kyis bcom ldan 'das mdzes pal/ dad par ci'os pa/bzang 0 po zhi ba/ thugs zhi ba/ thugs mchog 0tu dul ba/ zhi ba dang ⑫dul ba dang ldan pa/ gser gyi mchod sdong ༅lta bur gyur pa 6/ dpal gyis 'bar zhing shing gi 8drung na brten te bzhugs pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste lhags nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das ci ga bud med cig gzigs sam/gzhon nu dag 8bud med de khyed cag gi cir 'ong / btsun pa 'di ni bdag cag gi 0drug bcu sde bzang po'i tshogs grong khyer sde can 8gyi slad rol du bud med kyis bgyis pa'i rol mos rtse ⑩bar bgyid0 / dga' bar bgyid/ dga' mgur spyod par bgyid de/ de rnams dang bdag cag rtse 61bar bgyid/dga' bar bgyid/ dga' mgur spyod par bgyid pa na bud med cig dam bcas pa dral te bros nas bdag cag tshol lags so/ /gzhon nu dag ji snyam du 1—126

sems / bud med tshol ba gang yin pa dang / bdag nyid tshol ba gang yin pa gang bdamal/ btsun pa bdag cag la bud med kyis ci bgyi/② bdag cag ni bdag nyid tshol ba gang lags pa de 'dam ②lags so/ /gzhon nu dag de'i phyir 'dug shig ④dang khyed la chos bshad do/ /de nas drug bcu sde bzang po'i tshogs kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi 0zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /phyogs gcig tu 'khod nas bcom ldan 'das kyis drug bcu sde bzang po'i tshogs la chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par bstan / yang dag par 'dzin du bcug /yang dag par gzengs ⑥bstod/yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad de/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ⑦kyi thog ⑧ma'i dus ⑨su chos kyi gtam gleng ba gang yin pa 'di lta ste/sbyin pa'i gtam dang / tshul khrims kyi gtam dang / mtho ris kyi gtam dang /'dod pa tsu )rnams la mnog chung zhing nyes (skyedamigs dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa dang / rnam par byang ba dang / 8 nges par 'byung ba dang / rab tu dben pa'i rjes su bsngags pa dang / rnam par byang ba'i phyogs kyi chos rnams rgya cher bshad do/ /gang gi tshe de dag bcom ldan 'das kyis dga' ba'i sems dang / dge ba'i sems dang / mgu ba'i sems dang / sgrib pa dang bral ba'i sems dang / skal tsob dang tsoldan pa dang / yang dag phul gyi chos bshad pa shes par nus par gzigs pa de'i tshe sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi ⑫yang dag phul gyi yichos bshad pa gang yin pa 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi po 'di lta ste/ sdug bsngal dang / kun 'byung ba tshudang / 'gog pa dang / lam de rgya cher bshad do/ /dper na gos gtsang tsom nag nog med pa tshon yi: 'os 4—127

pa'i nang du bcug na tshon ①ci legs par 'jen ②du btub pa de bzhin du drug bcu sde bzang po'i tshogs kyis stan de nyid la 'dug bzhin du 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi po 'di lta ste/ sdug bsngal dang / kun 'byung ba ③dang /'gog ④pa dang / lam mngon par rtogs so/ /⑤de nas drug bcu sde bzang po'i tshogs kyis chos mthong ba dang / chos thob ⑥pa dang / chos rig pa dang /chos kyi gting slebs ⑦pa dang / som nyi las rgal ba dang / the tshom las rgal ba dang / gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog pa dang / gzhan gyis mi bkri ⑧ba dang /ston pas bstan pa'i chos rnams la mi 'jigs pa thob nas stan las langs te/bla gos phrag pa gcig 0tu gzar ⑨ nas bcom ldan 'das gang yin ba de 8logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bdag cag 'phags 8so/ /mngon par 'phags so/ /bdag cag bcom ldan 'das dang chos dang dge slong gi dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi lags kyis/ bdag cag dge bsnyen du gzung du gsol/ deng slan chad ji srid 'tsho'i bar du srog dang yang bsdos te skyabs su mchi bar mngon par dad lags so/ /de nas drug bcu sde bzang po'i ④tshogs bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal 8pa la mngon par dga' ste rjes su yi rangs tshunas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi ⑨zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga nas dong ngo / /de'i tshe ser skya'i gzhi na bram ze lha zhes bya ba phyug pa nor mang ba/longs spyod che ba/ bcom ldan 'das kyi sngon gyi thugs rag tsopor gyur pa zhig gnas pa de dus gzhan zhig na gnyen yizad/ nor zad/ 'byor pa zad par gyur to0/ /gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis ⑥bdud kyi 3'khor 'byung 4—128

po bye ba phrag sum bcu ①drug bcom nas bla na med pa'i ye shes brnyes pa de'i tshe bram ze lha chung ma dang lhan cig grong khyer sde can du 'ongs so/ /bram ze lhas bcom ldan 'das kyis bla na med pa'i ye shes brnyes so zhes thos nas/ des chung ma la smras pa/ bzang mo bcom ldan 'das ⑤bla na med pa'i ye shes brnyes te / 'khor los sgyur ②ba'i rigs su 'khrungs pa'i bcom ldan 'das de ④ni grong khyer sde can du bsod snyoms la gshegs na ⑤bdag cag gis bcom ldan 'das de la bsod snyoms dbul du gang gi phyir bdag 0gi khyim na nyi ma gcig gi kha zas kyang med kyis༅/ ngas khyod gtar bcug ste kār ṣā pa ṇa ⑧lnga zhig ⑨skyin por blang ngo ⑩/ /des smras pa/ rje'i sras de bzhin du mdzod cig /bram ze lhas chung ma bram ze zhig la gtar bcug nas kār ṣā pa ṇa 0lnga bcom ldan 'das bshos gsol ba'i phyir skyin po'i 8tshul du blangs so/ /de'i chung mas smras pa/ rje'i sras bdag cini byang chub sems dpas lan ④'ga' yang dri ma can dang gos ngan pa gyon pa ma gzigs so/ /bram ze lhas khyim bdag cig ⑫las rgyan rnams brnyas canas chung ma la bskon no/ /de nas bram ze lha chung ma dang lhan cig gtsang zhing bsod pa'i bza' ba dang bca' ba dag sta gon byas nas bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gi sdum ⑩par gdugs tshod sbyor zhing mchis na gnang bar mdzad du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bram ze lha la cang mi gsung bas gnang ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das bram ze lha'i bkad sa tsogang na ba der gshegs te byon nas gdan bshams pa nyid la bzhugs so/ /de nas bram ze lhas bcom ldan 'das bde bar bzhugs par rig tsonas chung ma 1—129

dang lhan cig tu gtsang zhing bsod pa'i bza' ba dang bca' ba dag rang gi lag nas stobs shing tshim par byed de①/ rnam grangs du mar gtsang zhing bsod pa'i bza' ba dang bca' ba dag rang gi lag nas bstabs shing tshim par byas so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis gsol zin nas phyag bcabs te lhung bzed gyu bar ②rig nas stan ches dma' ba zhig blangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar chos mnyan pa'i phyir 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bram ze lha ③la yon bsngo ba mdzad nas gshegs so/ /de'i chung mas rgyan rnams bkrol ④ te bzhag pa de ma byin par len pas brkus so zhes bram ze lhas ⑤jos nas sdug bsngal zhing yid mi bde bar gyur te༅/ 'brog dgon pa zhig tu song nas nga ⑦la rgyan sbyin ⑧du ga la yod gzhan byar med kyis bdag 'chi'o ⑨snyam pa dang / ji tsam na mi zhig gis dong brkos canas song ngo / /bram ze lha ngo mtshar skyes nas de na ci yod re zhig blta'o snyam pa las/ ji tsam na rgyan de mthong nas des rgyan ⑪blangs te khyim du 'ongs sokye/ /8lha'i chung ma yang sdug bsngal zhing yid mi bde bas gdungs nas khyim phyag dar byed pa na 'di ltar sangs rgyas rnams kyi tsustesangs rgyas kyi mthu dang lha rnams kyi lha'i mthus ji tsam na gser gyi bum pa 'tsher bag can zhig mthong ngo / /lhas de la dris pa/ bzang mo 'o ni ci yin/des smras pa/ rje'i bsras bdag gis gser gyi bum pa zhig mthong ngo / /des kyang smras pa/ bzang mo kho bos kyang rgyan de mthong ngo / /de gnyis kyis lhag par yang bcom ldan 'das la dad pa bskyed do/ /de ltar mngon par dad pa dang bcom ldan 'das kyis de gnyis ⑩ji ltar 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi rtogs par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i chos bshad pa mdzad pas bram ze lha chung ma dang bcas 1—130

te 'jig ①tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo nyi shu mtho ba ye shes kyi rdo rjes bcom nas rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas sodu//de nas bcom ldan 'das de'i nub mo 'das nas snga dro na bza' sham thabs mnabasadu/ lhung bzed dang chos gos bsnams te grong khyer sde ④can du bsod snyoms la zhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das grong khyer sde can du bsod snyoms la zhugs pa na 'di snyam du dgongs te/ ma la ngas grong khyer sde can rgyader thog mar su zhig la chos bshad snyam pa las/ de nas bcom ldan 'das 'di snyam du dgongs te/ ngas grong pa'i bu mo dga' mo dang / dga' stobs ma la thog mar chos bshad par bya ste/ de dag gis nga sngon gyi thosdug bsngal spong ba'i rnal 'byor la rjes su brtson pas gnas pa na 'dis mar sar dang 'o thug sbrang rtsi ltar mngar bas bsnyen bkur byas so snyam mo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das grong pa'i bu mo dga' mo dang / dga' stobs ma'i khyim gang na ba der gshegs so/ /grong pa'i bu mo dga' mo dang / dga' stobs mas bcom ldan 'das rgyang ring po nas mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi thoched du gdan bshams nas 'di skad ces du gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das tshur spyon/ bcom ldan 'das byon pa legs so/ /bcom ldan 'das gdan bshams pa 'di nyid la skyobazhugs sku zhes gsol nas bcom ldan 'das gdan khyabashams pa de nyid la bzhugs so/ /de nas grong pa'i bu mo dga' mo dang / dga' stobs mas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te phyogs gcig 8tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig 0tu 'dug nas bcom ldan 'das kyis ④grong pa'i bu mo dga' mo dang / dga' stobs ma la chos dang ldan 1—131

pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par bstan①/ yang dag par 'dzin du bcug② /yang dag par gzengs ③bstod/ yang dag par rab tu rjodaga' bar mdzad de/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi thog ma'i dus su chos kyi gtam gleng ba gang yin pa 'di lta ste/ sbyin pa'i gtam dang / tshul khrims kyi gtam dang /mtho ris kyi gtam dang / 'dod pa rnams la mnog ⑤chung zhing nyes dmigs dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa dang / rnam par byang ba dang / nges par 'byung ba dang / rab tu dben pa'i rjes su bsngags pa dang / rnam par byang ba'i phyogs kyi chos rgya cher bshad do/ /gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis de dag dga' ba'i sems dang / dge ba'i sems dang / mgu ba'i sems dang / /sgrib pa dang bral ba'i sems dang / skal ba dang ༅ldan pa ⑦dang / yang dag phul gyi chos bshad na shes par nus par gzigs pa de'i tshe sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi ༅yang dag phul gyi chos bshad pa gang yin pa 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi po 'di lta ste/ sdug bsngal dang / kun 'byung ba ⑨dang / 'gog pa dang / lam de ⑩rgya cher bshad do/ /dper na gos gtsang ma nag nog med pa tshon rtsi 'os pa'i nang du bcug na tshon rtsi legs par 'jen 0du btub pa de bzhin du grong pa'i bu mo dga' mo dang / dga' stobs ma 8stan de nyid la 'khod bzhin du 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi po 'di lta ste/ sdug bsngal dang /kun 'byung ba tsodang / 'gog pa dang / lam mngon par rtogs so/ /de nas grong pa'i bu mo dga' mo dang / dga' stobs mas chos mthong ba dang /chos thob pa dang / chos rig pa dang / chos kyi gting slebs pa dang / the tshom las rgal ba dang / som nyi las rgal ba dang / gzhan gyi dring mi (sre4—132

'jog pa dang / gzhan gyis mi bkri ba dang / ston pas bstan pa'i chos rnams la mi 'jigs pa thob nas stan las langs te bcom ldan 'das gang na ba de lalogs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bdag cag 'phags so/ /mngon par 'phags so/ /bdag cag bcom ldan 'das dang chos dang dge slong gi dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi lags kyis bdag cag ②dge bsnyen du gzung ①du gsol/ deng slan ④chad ji srid 'tsho'i bar du ⑤srog dang yang bsdos te skyabs su mchi bar mngon par dad lags so/ /de nas grong pa'i bu mo dga' mo dang / dga' stobs mas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa de'i slad du 'dir zhal zas kyi mdzad pa mdzad du gsol bcom ldan 'das kyis grong pa'i bu mo dga' mo yidang / dga' stobs ma la cang mi gsung bas gnang ngo / /de nas grong pa'i bu mo dga' mo dang / dga' stobs mas bcom ldan 'das cang mi gsung bas gnang bar rig cing / bcom ldan 'das bde bar bzhugs par rig nas gtsang zhing bsod pa'i bza' ba dang bca' ba dag rang gi lag nas stobs shing tshim par byed de/ rnam grangs du mar gtsang zhing bsod pa'i bza' ba dang bca' ba dag rang gi lag nas bstabs shing tshim par byas so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis gsol zin te phyag bcabs shing lhung bzed gyu bar rig ⑦nas stan ches dudama' ba zhig blangs te bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar chos mnyan ⑨pa'i phyir 'khod do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis grong pa'i bu mo dga' mo dang / dga' stobs ma la chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par bstan/yang dag par 'dzin du bcug /yang dag par gzengs ⑩bstod/ yang dag 4—133

par rab tu ①dga' bar mdzad nas gdan las bzhengs te gshegs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das grong khyer sde can nas gshegs pa na 'di snyam du dgongs te/ ngas yul ma ga dhā ②'dir ngang tshul bzang por bkur ba'i dge sbyong ngam bram ze gang zhig dbang du byas na ③de dbang du gyur pas ༅tshegs chung ngus skye bo'i tshogs chen po dbang du 'gyur ba 0su zhig yod snyam mo/ /de'i tshe lteng rgyas 'od srung ⑥ral pa can btsas ⑦nas lo brgya nyi shu lon pa rgas 'khogs gtugs pa zhig yod pa de ma ga d+ma'i ⑧mi rnams kyis bkur sti ⑨bya ba dang / bla mar bya ba dang / rjed par bya ba dang / mchod par bya bas ⑨ dgra bcom par bkur 0cing 'khor lnga brgya dang nai tsorañdza na'i 'aklung gi 'gram gyi bsti gnas na dka' thub spyod do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 'di snyam du dgongs te/lteng rgyas 'od srung ④ral pa can btsas nas lo brgya nyi shu lon pa rgas 'khogs gtugs pa 'di ma ga d+ma'i 8mi rnams kyis zhes bya ba nas dka' thub spyod do zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du ste/ ma la ngas lteng rgyas 'od srung tshural pa can dbang du byas te/ 'di dbang du gyur na tshegs chung ngus skye bo'i tshogs chen po ⑦dbang du 'gyur ro 8snyam mo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can gyi bsti yoganas gang na ba der gshegs so/ /lteng rgyas 'od srung tshural pa can gyis bcom ldan 'das rgyang ring po nas mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi ched du gdan bshams nas 'di skad ces kyang 0gsol to / /dge sbyong chen po tshur spyon/ dge sbyong chen po byon pa legs so/ /dge sbyong chen po yun ring po zhig lags na gang nas 'khor te 'dir byon( spre/dge sbyong chen po gdan bshams pa nyid la bzhugs shig ces gsol to/ /4—134

bcom ldan 'das kyis ① gdan bshams pa nyid la bzhugs so/ /de nas lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can dang / bcom ldan 'das lhan cig mngon du 0yang dag par dga' bar 'gyur ba dang / mgu bar 'gyur ba'i gtam rnam pa sna ②tshogs mdzad nas phyogs gcig byatu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig ⑤tu 'dug pa dang bcom ldan 'das kyis lteng rgyas 'od srung byural pa can la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /bya'od srung gal te khyod la mi bde ba med na/ khyod kyi me khang du bdag zhag gcig du'adug go/ /dge sbyong chen po bdag la ni bomi bde ba ma mchis na/ 'on kyang de na 2klu gdug pa rtsazhig gnas te/ des khyod⑫ tho btsams mapar 'gyur du mchi'o/ /'od sung khyod kyis re zhig gnang bar gyis shig dngo tho rtsabatsams par mi 'gyur ro/ /dge sbyong chen po gal te khyod la tho mi btsam tsunan dge sbyong chen po ci bde ba kho nar bzhugs shig /de nas bcom ldan 'das lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can gyi me khang gang na ba der gshegs te byon nas me khang gi phyi rol du zhabs bsil nas me khang gi nang du zhugs te/ nyid kyis rtswa gding ba bshams nas sku drang por bsrang ste/ skyil mo krung tsobacas nas dran pa mngon du phyogs par bzhag ste bzhugs so/ /klu gdug pas bcom ldan 'das rgyang ring po nas mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang khros ⑩pa'i mthus dud pa phyung ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang rdzu 'phrul gyi mthus dud pa phyung ngo / /klu gdug pas khros pa'i 8mthus 'bar bar byas so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang me'i khams la snyoms par zhugs so/ /de na 7klu gdug pa khros pa'i mthu dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi mthus me khang thams cad 'bar/ rab tu 'bar/ kun tu rab tu 'bar te me lce gcig 1—135

tu gyur pas sreg par byed do/ /lteng ①rgyas 'od sung ral pa can mtshan mo rgyu skar la lta ba na me khang thams cad 'bar/ rab tu 'bar/ kun tu rab tu 'bar te ②me lce gcig tu gyur nas sreg pa ②mthong ngo / /mthong nas ④kyang 'di snyam du sems te/ dge sbyong gi ta ma chen po 'di ltar mdzes pa/ klu gdug pas thal bar byas par ma gyur grang / kyi hud nyon mongs pa dag phyegi tshig ma nyan to snyam mo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 'di snyam du dgongs te/ nga lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can 'khor dang bcas pa ༅chas bcad kyis/ ma la ngas rdzu 'phrul ji lta bu mngon par 'du bya ba la sems mnyam par bzhag na/ mes klu gdug pa'i me zil gyis mnan la des kyang de'i lus la gnod par ④mi byed cing de dul bar mkhyen nas lhung bzed du bcug ste dulteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can de la sbyin pa de lta bu zhig bya'o snyam nas/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rdzu 'phrul ji lta bu mngon par nyu'adu mdzad pa la thugs mnyam par bzhag na mes klu gdug pa'i me cezil gyis mnan la des kyang de'i lus la gnod pa mi byed pa de lta bu mngon par 'du mdzad de/ de skyedul bar mkhyen nas lhung bzed du bcug ste lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can 8gang na ba der bsnams nas 8gshegs so/ /lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can gyis bcom ldan 'das rgyang ring po nas mthong ngo /mthong nas kyang bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /dge sbyong chen po gson pa lta zhig /'od srung gson no/ /dge sbyong chen po khyod kyis lhung bzed na ④bsnams te byon pa ci/ 'od srung klu gdug pa gang gi mthus khyod kyi me khang du mir gyur pa rdzu 'phrul dang mi ldan pa gnas su mi ster ba de ngas btul nas lhung bzed du bcug nas khyer te 'ongs so/ /de nas lteng rgyas 'od srung 1—136

ral pa can 'di snyam du sems te/ 'di ltar dge sbyong chen po rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che ba yin te/ ya mtshan che mod kyi bdag kyang dgra bcom pa yin no snyam mo//de nas bcom ldan 'das lteng rgyas na lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can gyi ①bsti gnas kyi nags tshang tshing na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can gyi bste gnas na bram ze'i khye'u lnga brgya tsam me la yongs su spyod pa re re'i me thab drugasum gsum ste me thab stong lnga brgya yod do/ /de nas bram ze'i khye'u de rnams me la yongs su spyod par 'dod na me de spar bar ma nus so/ /de nas bram ze'i khye'u de rnams lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can gang na ba der song ste phyin nas lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can la 'di skad ces smras so/ /mkhan po mkhyen par mdzod cig /'dir bdag cag zhugs la yongs su spyod par 'tshal zhun zhugs de spar bar sarngo ma thog 3lags so/ /de nas lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can 'di snyam du sems te/ dge sbyong chen po bdag gi nye 'khor na gnas pa ṭude'i mthu zhig ma byung grang snyam mo/ /de nas lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /dge sbyong chen po mkhyen par mdzod cig /'dir bdag gi bram ze'i khye'u lnga brgya tsam me la yongs su spyod par 'tshal na me de spar bar rngo ma thog nas bdag 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag gi nye 'khor na dge sbyong chen po bzhugs na de'i mthu zhig ma byung grang snyam bgyid do༅/ /'od srung me de spar bar 'dod dam/ dge sbyong duchen po spar du gsol/ de nas 'di ltar sangs rgyas ⑨rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi ⑨ mthu dang / lha rnams kyi 0lha'i mthus me de rang nyid 'bar bar gyur to/ /de nas lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa 1—137

can 'di snyam du sems te/ 'di ltar dge sbyong chen po rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che ba yin te/ ya mtshan che mod kyi bdag kyang dgra bcom pa yin no snyam mo//de nas bcom ldan 'das lteng rgyas na lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can gyi bsti gnas kyi nags tshang tshing na bzhugs so/ /de nas bram ze'i khye'u de rnams me la yongs su spyad nas me bsad ①par 'dod na me bsad ②par ma nus so/ /③bram ze'i khye'u de rnams lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can gang na ba der song ༷ste lhags nas lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can la 'di skad ces smras so/ /mkhan po mkhyen par mdzod cig /'dir bdag cag zhugs ⑤la yongs su spyad nas zhugs dgum par 'tshal na dgum pa'i rngo ma thog ⑥lags so/ /de nas lteng ⑦rgyas 'od srung ral pa can 'di snyam du sems te/ dge sbyong chen po bdag gi nye 'khor na gnas pa de'i mthu zhig ma byung grang snyam mo/ /de nas lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /dge sbyong chen po mkhyen par mdzad du gsol/'dir bdag gi bram ze'i khye'u rnams zhugs la yongs su spyad nas zhugs dgum par 'tshal na dgum par 0rngo ma thog ⑨nas bdag 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag gi nye 'khor na dge sbyong chen po bzhugs na de'i mthu zhig ma byung grang snyam ⑩bgyid do/ /'od srung me de bsad ⑩dam/ dge sbyong chen po dgum du gsol/ de nas 8'di ltar sangs rgyas rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi mthu dang / lha rnams kyi lha'i mthus me de rang nyid shi'o/ /de nas lteng rgyas 'od sung ral pa can 'di snyam du sems te/ 'di ltar dge sbyong chen po rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che ba tsoyin te/ ya mtshan tsoche mod kyi bdag kyang dgra bcom pa yin no snyam mo//1—138

de nas bcom ldan 'das lteng rgyas na lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can gyi bsti gnas kyi nags tshang tshing na bzhugs so/ /de nas dus gzhan zhig na lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can rang nyid me la yongs su spyod par 'dod na spar bar ma ①nus so/ /de nas lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can 'di snyam du sems te/bdag gi nye 'khor na dge sbyong ②chen po gnas na de'i mthu zhig byung bar ma ③gyur grang snyam mo/ /de nas lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to//dge sbyong chen po mkhyen par mdzad du gsol/ 'dir bdag nyid zhugs la yongs su spyod par 'tshal na spar bar rngo ma thog ④nas bdag ⑤'di snyam du sems te/ bdag gi nye 'khor na dge sbyong yichen po bzhugs na de'i mthu zhig byung bar ma gyur grang snyam bgyid do/ /'od srung me de spar bar 'dod dmagyo/dge sbyong chen po spar du gsol/ de nas 'di ltar sangs rgyas rnams kyi ⑧sangs rgyas kyi ⑨mthu dang / lha rnams kyi ⑩lha'i mthus me de rang nyid 'bar bar gyur 7to/ /de nas lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can 'di snyam du sems te/'di ltar dge sbyong chen po rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che ba yin te/ ya mtshan tsoche mod ⑩kyi bdag kyang dgra bcom pa yin no snyam mo//de nas bcom ldan 'das lteng rgyas na lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can gyi bsti gnas kyi nags tshang tshing na tshubazhugs so/ /de nas dus gzhan zhig na lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can rang nyid me la yongs su spyad nas 8me bsad ⑩par 'dod na bsad ⑦par ma nus so/ /de nas lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag gi nye 'khor na dge sbyong chen po gnas na de'i 1—139

mthu zhig byung bar ma gyur grang snyam mo/ /de nas lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /dge sbyong chen po mkhyen par chemadzad du gsol/'dir bdag nyid zhugs la yongs su spyad nas zhugs dgum par 'tshal na dgum pa'i rngu rngo ma thog nas dubadag 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag gi nye 'khor na dge sbyong chen po bzhugs na de'i mthu zhig byung bar ma gyur grang snyam bgyid do/ /drang srong me de bsad rtsodam/ dge sbyong chen po dgum du gsol/ de nas 'di ltar sangs rgyas rnams kyi phyesangs rgyas kyi mthu dang / lha rnams kyi lha'i mthus me de rang nyid shi'o/ /de nas lteng rgyas 'od sung ral pa can 'di snyam du sems te/ 'di ltar dge sbyong chen po rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che ba yin te/ya mtshan che mod 'ukyi bdag kyang dgra bcom pa yin no snyam mo// cide nas bcom ldan 'das lteng rgyas na sheltong rgyas 'od srung ral pa can gyi bsti gnas kyi nags tshang tshing na bzhugs so/ /de nas dus gzhan zhig na lhong rgyas 'od srung ral pa can gyi me khang thams cad 'bar rab tu 'bar/ kun du rab tu 'bar te me lce gcig tu gyur nas sreg par byed pa de la lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can 'khor dang bcas pa dang / gzhan yang skye ⑧bo'i tshogs chen po rnams kyis bsgrims kyang bsad rtsam nus so/ /de nas lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag gi nye 'khor na dge sbyong chen po gnas na de'i mthu zhig byung bar ma gyur grang snyam mo/ /de nas lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /dge sbyong chen po mkhyen par mdzad du 1—140

gsol / dge sbyong chen po 'dir bdag gi ①me khang thams cad 'bar rab tu 'bar / kun du rab tu 'bar te me lce gcig tu gyur nas sreg par bgyid pa de la bdag 'khor dang bcas pa dang / gzhan yang skye bo'i tshogs chen pos bsgrims na zhugs dgum pa'i ②ngo ma thog ③nas bdag 'di snyam du sems te/bdag gi nye 'khor na dge sbyong chen po bzhugs na de'i mthu zhig byung bar ma gyur grang snyam bgyid do/ /'od srung me khang de ④zhi bar bya'am dge sbyong chen po zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ de nas 'di ltar sangs rgyas rnams kyi dusangs rgyas kyi mthu dang / lha rnams kyi ⑦lha'i mthus me khang de rang nyid zhi bar gyur to/ /de nas lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can 'di snyam du sems te/ 'di ltar dge sbyong chen po rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che ba yin te/ ya mtshan che ⑦mod kyi bdag kyang dgra bcom pa yin no snyam mo// //'dul ba gzhil/ bam po brgyad bcu ⑨brgyad pa/ de nas bcom ldan 'das lteng rgyas na ⑩ lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can gyi bste gnas yinags tshang tshing na bzhugs so/ /de nas rgyal po chen po bzhi po dag kha dog 'phags pas mtshan mo la bab pa na/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der dong ste lhags nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs tsol mgo bos phyag byas te/ de rnams dper na me'i phung po 'bar/ rab tu 'bar/ kun du rab tu 'bar te me lce gcig tu gyur nas sreg par byed pa bzhi lta bu'i lus kyis 'phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can de ④nyid kyi mtshan mo rgyu skar rnams la blta 8ba na/bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga na me'i phung po 'bar rab tu 'bar/ kun du rab tu 'bar te me lce gcig tu gyur nas sreg par byed pa bzhi mthong ngo /1—141

mthong nas kyang 'di snyam du sems te/ dge sbyong chen po yang me la yongs su spyod de①/ 'di ltar de'i spyan snga na me'i phung po 'bar rab tu 'bar/ kun du rab tu 'bar te me lce gcig tu gyur nas sreg par byed pa bzhi yod do snyam mo/ /de nas lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can nang par sngar langs te bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song nas ②phyin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /dge sbyong chen po mkhyen par mdzad du gsol/ 'dir mdang sum bdag rgyu skar rnams la blta ③ba na dge sbyong chen po'i spyan snga na bzhugs kyi phung po 'bar rab tu 'bar/ kun du rab tu ⑤'bar te me lce gcig tu gyur te sreg par byed pa bzhi mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang bdag nyid ⑥'di snyam du sems te/ dge sbyong chen po yang me la yongs su spyod de/ 'di ltar de'i spyan snga na ⑨me'i phung po 'bar rab tu 'bar/ kun du rab tu 'bar te me lce gcig tu gyur nas sreg par bgyid pa bzhi mchis so ④snyam mo/ /'od srung ci nga me la yongs su spyod dam/ nga me la yongs su mi spyod de/ de lta mod kyi 'dir mdang sum rgyal po chen po bzhi po dag kha dog 'phags pas mtshan mo la bab pa na nga gang ⑨na ba der 'ongs te lhags nas/ nga'i zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te de rnams dper na me'i phung po 'bar rab tu 'bar/ kun du rab tu 'bar te me lce gcig tu gyur nas sreg par 0 byed pa bzhi lta bu'i lus kyis phyogs gcig tu 'dug pa yin no/ /de nas ltong rgyas 'od srung ral pa can 'di snyam du sems te/ 'di ltar dge sbyong chen po rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che ba yin te/ya mtshan che mod kyi bdag kyang dgra bcom pa yin no snyam mo//de nas bcom ldan 'das lteng rgyas na lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can gyi 4—142

bsti gnas kyi nags tshang tshing na bzhugs so/ /de nas lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin kha dog 'phags pas mtshan mo la bab pa na bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la ①phyag 'tshal te/ de dper na me'i phung po 'bar rab tu 'bar/ kun du rab tu 'bar te me lce gcig tu gyur pa bzhi po de dag bas kyang ches lhag cing ches 'phags la ches bzang ba lta bu'i lus kyis 0phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can de nyid kyi mtshan mo rgyu skar rnams la blta ④ba na bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar ④me'i phung po chen po 'bar rab tu 'bar/ kun du rab tu 'bar te me lce gcig tu gyur nas sreg par byed pa zhig mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang 'di snyam du sems te/ dge sbyong chen po yang me la yongs su spyod de/ 'di ltar de'i mdun na me'i phung po chen po 'bar rab tu 'bar/ kun du rab tu 'bar te me lce gcig tu gyur nas sreg par byed pa zhig yod do snyam mo/ /de nas lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can nang par sngar langs nas ⑤bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to//dge sbyong chen po mkhyen par mdzad du gsol/ 'dir bdag mdang sum rgyu skar rnams la blta ⑥ba na dge sbyong chen po'i spyan snga na zhugs kyi phung po chen po ⑦'bar rab tu 'bar/ kun du rab tu 'bar te me lce gcig tu gyur nas sreg par bgyid pa zhig mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang bdag ⑧'di snyam du sems te/dge sbyong chen po yang me la yongs su spyod de/ 'di ltar de'i spyan snga na me'i phung po chen po ⑨'bar rab tu 'bar/ kun tu rab tu 'bar te me lce gcig tu gyur nas sreg par bgyid pa zhig mchis so snyam ⑨ mo/ /'od srung ci nga me la 1—143

yongs su spyod dam/ nga me la yongs su mi spyod de/ de lta mod kyi 'dir mdang sum lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin kha dog 'phags pas mtshan mo la bab pa na nga nyugang na ba der 'ongs te phyin nas nga'i zhabs la mgo bos phyag byas te/de dper na me'i phung po 'bar rab tu 'bar/ kun du rab tu 'bar te me lce gcig tu gyur nas sreg ②pa bzhi po de dag pas kyang ches ②lhag cing ches 'phags la ches bzang ba lta bu'i lus kyis byaphyogs gcig tu 'dug pa yin no/ /de nas lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can 'di snyam du sems te/ 'di ltar dge sbyong chen po rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che ba yin te/ ya mtshan che mod kyi bdag kyang dgra bcom pa yin no snyam mo//de nas bcom ldan 'das lteng rgyas na lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can gyi bste gnas kyi nags tshang tshing na bzhugs so/ /de nas mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa kha dog 'phags pas mtshan mo la bab pa na bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs ⑤la mgo bos phyag byas te/⑦dper na me'i phung po bzhi po de dag nyid snga ma bzhin du sreg pa zhes bya ba nas me'i phung po ༅lnga pa de me lce gcig tu gyur nas sreg par byed do zhes bya ba'i bar de dag pas kyang ches lhag cing ches 'phags la ches bzang ba lta bu'i lus kyis phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /lteng rgyas 'od sung ral pa can de nyid kyi mtshan mo rgyu skar rnams la blta ba na ⑧bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga na me'i phung po chen po 'bar rab tu 'bar ba ⑨zhes bya ba nas sreg par byed pa zhes bya ba'i bar zhig mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang de 'di snyam du sems te/ /dge sbyong chen po yang me la yongs su spyod de/ 'di ltar de'i mdun du me'i phung po chen po ⑩zhes 4—144

bya ba nas sreg par byed pa'i bar zhig yod do snyam mo/ /de nas lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can nang par sngar langs nas bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /dge sbyong chen po mkhyen par mdzad du gsol/ 'dir bdag mdang sum rgyu skar ①rnams la blta ②ba na dge sbyong chen po'i spyan snga na zhugs kyi phung po chen po ②'bar ba zhes bya ba nas sreg par byed pa zhes bya ba'i bar zhig mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang bdag 'di snyam du sems te/ dge sbyong chen po yang me la yongs su spyod de/'di ltar de'i spyan snga na me'i phung po chen po 'bar ④rab tu 'bar/ kun du rab tu 'bar te me lce gcig tu gyur ⑤nas sreg par bgyid pa zhig mchis so snyam mo / /'od srung ci nga me la yongs su spyod dam/ nga me la yongs su mi spyod de/⑥de lta mod kyi 'dir mdang sum mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa kha dog 'phags pas mtshan mo la bab pa na nga gang na ba der 'ongs te phyin nas/ nga'i zhabs la mgo bos phyag byas te/ de dper na me'i phung po 'bar rab tu 'bar ba bzhi po de dag nas snga ma bzhin du me'i phung po ⑨lnga pa de 'bar ba nas me lce gcig tu gyur pa chanas sreg par byed pa'i ⑨bar gong ma bzhin du ste/ de dag pas kyang ches lhag cing ches 'phags la ches ⑨ bzang ba lta bu'i lus kyis phyogs gcig tu 'dug pa yin no/ /de nas lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can 'di snyam du sems te/'di ltar dge sbyong chen po gau ta ma ni rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che ba yin te/ ya mtshan che mod kyi bdag kyang dgra bcom pa yin no snyam mo//de nas bcom ldan 'das lteng rgyas na lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can gyi bsti gnas kyi nags tshang tshing na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe lteng rgyas 'od srung ral 1—145

pa can gyi 'dug gnas na 〉mchod sbyin zhag du bdun pa byed pa la bab bo/ /de nas lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can 'di snyam du sems te/ gal te ma ga d+ma'i ghumi rnams kyis chodage sbyong chen po 'di ltar rdzu 'phrul che zhing rgya'adi ltar mthu che ba yin par shes na de nyid la bya ba byed par sems kyi/ bdag la ni de ltar ma yin pa'i gnas 'di yod kyis/ kye ma dge sbyong chen po zhag bdun zhig 'di nas gzhan du song yang ci ma rung snyam mo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs kyis lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can gyi sems mkhyen nas skyozhag bdun gzhan du bzhud tsodo de'i tshe zhag bdun du lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can la rnyed thupa dang bkur sti chen po byung nasanyu/ bza' ba dang bca' ba rab tu mang po dang ngaldan/skye bo'i tsu tshogs chen po yang dbang du gyur to/ /de nas lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can gyi 'dug gnas na mchod sbyin de zhag bdun du byas zin nas 'di snyam du sems te/ 'dir bdag la zhag bdun du rnyed pa dang bkur sti chen po byung zhing bza' ba dang bca' ba rab tu mang po dang yang ldan/ skye bo'i tshogs chen po yang dbang du gyur gyis/ kye ma da ni dge sbyong chen po 'ongs kyang ci ma rung /bdag gis de yang de la longs spyod du gzhug go snyam mo//de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs kyis nyu mosteng rgyas 'od sung ral pa can gyi sems mkhyen nas steng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can gang na ba der gshegs so/ /lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can gyis bcom ldan 'das rgyang ring po nas mthong ngo //mthong nas kyang bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /dge sbyong chen po byon tam/ 'od sung 'ongs so/ /dge sbyong chen po khyod ci'i slad du zhag bdun 'di nas gzhan du bzhud 8lags/ 'od srung khyod kyi 'dug gnas na 4wa 146

mchod sbyin zhag bdun du byed pa la bab nas 'di snyam du/ gal te ma ga d+ma'i mi rnams kyis dge sbyong chen po ni 'di ltar rdzu 'phrul che ba 'di ltar humathu che ba yin par shes na de kho na la bya ba byed par sems kyi/ bdag la ni de lta ma yin pa'i gnas 'di yod par 'gyur gyis/ kye ma dge sbyong chen po zhag bdun zhig 'di nas gzhan du song yang ci ma rung snyam du sems pa ma yin nam/ nga'i thugs kyis khyod ④kyi sems shes nas zhag bdun zhu'adi nas gzhan du song ngo / /'o na ci'i slad du 'dir byon lags/ 'od srung khyod kyis ④mchod sbyin zhag bdun ⑧du byas zin nas 'di snyam du bdag la zhag bdun du rnyed pa dang bkur sti chen po byung zhing bza' ba dang bca' ba rab tu mang po dang yang sneldanartso/skye bo'i tshogs chen po yang dbang du gyur gyis/ kye ma dge sbyong chen po 'ongs kyang ci ma rung / bdag gis de yang de la yongs su longs spyod du gzhug 3go snyam du ⑨sems pa ma yin nam/ dge sbyong chen po de lta lags so/ /nga'i thugs kyis khyod kyi sems shes nas nga 'ongs pa yin no/ /dge sbyong chen po ci bde 'ikho nar longs spyad ri :du gsol/ /de nas lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can 'di snyam du sems te/ 'di ltar dge sbyong chen po rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che ba yin te/ ya mtshan che mod kyi skyebadag kyang dgra bcom pa yin no snyam mo//de nas bcom ldan 'das lteng rgyas na lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can gyi bsti gnas kyi nags tshang tshing na bzhugs so/ /de nas lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can gyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /dge sbyong chen po de'i slad du bdag gi nye 8'khor du bzhugs shig 8dang bdag gis khyod la chos dang mthun pa'i 'tsho ba sbyar 8ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis lteng rgyas 'od srung 4—147

ral pa can ①la cang mi gsung bas gnang ngo / /de nas lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can gyis bcom ldan 'das kyi ②ched du rang kho nas g.yos byas nas bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /dge sbyong chen po gdugs tshod lags shing mchis na/dge sbyong chen po da ②de'i dus la bab par dgongs su gsol/ 'od srung de'i phyir song shig nga yang 'ong ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byalteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can song nas ring po ma lon par mkhyen nas ji ltar thugs mnyam par bzhag na shing 'dzam bu zhes bya ba gang gis 'dzam ④bu'i gling du gdags pa de las kha dog dang dri dang ro dang ldan pa'i 'dzam yibu'i snye ma rnams kyis lhung bzed bkang nas bsnams te/ lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can gyi ⑦bste gnas gang na ba der gshegs pa de lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te byon nas gdan bshams pa nyid la bzhugs so/ /de nas de'i 'og tu lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can 'ongs nas lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can gyis bcom ldan 'das bsti gnas kyi gdan bshams pa nyid la bzhugs pa ⑧mthong ngo //mthong nas kyang 'di skad ces gsol to/ /dge sbyong chen po byon tam/ 'od srung 'ongs so/ /dge sbyong chen po khyod kyi lhung bzed na ci mchis/ 'dir ngas 'od srung khyod song nas ring po ma lon par mkhyen nas ji ltar thugs mnyam par bzhag na shing 'dzam bu zhes bya ba gang gis 'dzam bu'i gling du gdags pa de las kha dog dang / dri dang / ro dang ldan pa'i 'dzam bu'i snye ma rnams kyis lhung bzed bkang nas 'dir phyin pa de lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs kyis/ gal te 'dod na longs spyod cig /dge sbyong chen po ci bde kho 1—148

nar 'tshal lags so/ /de nas lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can 'di snyam du sems te/ 'di ltar dge sbyong chen po rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che ba yin te/ya mtshan che mod kyi bdag kyang dgra bcom pa yin no snyam mo/ /'dzam bu'i snye ma ji lta bar skyu ru ra'i snye ma rnams kyang de bzhin no/ /byang gi sgra mi snyan gyi gling du gshegs nas ma rmos ma btab pa'i 'bras ①sna ②lha'i 'brus ②lhung bzed bkang ste bsnams nas/ lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can gyi bsti gnas gang na ba der gshegs te byon nas gdan bshams pa nyid la bzhugs so/ /de nas de'i 'og tu lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can 'ongs nas lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can gyis bcom ldan 'das bste gnas kyi gdan bshams pa nyid la bzhugs pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang 'di skad ces gsol to/ /dge sbyong chen po byon tam/ 'od srung ④'ongs so/ /dge sbyong chen po khyod kyi lhung bzed na ci mchis / 'dir ngas 'od srung khyod song nas ring po ma lon par mkhyen nas ji ltar thugs mnyam par bzhag na byang gi sgra mi snyan gyi gling du gshegs nas ma rmos ma btab pa'i 'bras sā ⑤phu'i 'brus lhung bzed bkang nas 'dir phyin pa de lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs kyis/ gal te 'dod na longs spyod cig/dge sbyong chen po ci bde kho nar 'tshal lags so/ /de nas lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can 'di snyam du sems te/ 'di ltar dge sbyong chen po rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che ba yin te/ ya mtshan che mod kyi bdag kyang dgra bcom pa yin no snyam mo//de bzhin du rgyal po chen po bzhi dang / sum bcu rtsa gsum pa'i gnas su gshegs nas lha'i bdud rtsis lhung bzed bkang nas bsnams te zhes brjod par bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das lteng rgyas na lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can gyi 4—149

bsti gnas kyi nags tshang ①ming na bzhugs so/ /de nas lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can gyis bcom ldan 'das kyi ②ched du rang nyid kyis g.yos byas nas/bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /chadage sbyong chen po gdugs tshod lags shing mchis na/dge sbyong chen po da de'i dus la bab par dgongs su gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das snga dro na bza' sham thabs mnabs lhung bzed dang chos gos bsnams te lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can gyi bsti gnas gang na ba der gshegs te byon nas gdan bshams pa nyid la bzhugs so/ /de nas lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can gyis bcom ldan 'das bde bar bzhugs par rig nas gtsang zhing bsod pa'i bza' ba dang bca' ④bas lhung bzed bkang nas phul ⑧lo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis lteng rgyas 'od sung ral pa can las bsod snyoms bzhes nas phyogs gzhan zhig tu bzhugs nas zhal zas kyi bya ba mdzad do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la chus chu'i dgos pa zhig byung ngo / /de nas lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyis bcom ldan 'das la chus chu'i dgos pa byung bar shes nas bcom ldan 'das gang na ⑥ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar lag pas sa la bsnun pa dang / de nas bkod ma chen po zhig byung ste / chu bab ⑦pa de la bcom ldan 'das kyis chus chu'i bya ba mdzad do/ /lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa ⑧can ⑨bsti gnas na 'chag pa na bkod ma chen po byung ste chu bab ⑩pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang 'di snyam du sems te⑩/ chu 'di sngon ni med na cha'adi da ltar tsogang nas bab snyam mo/ /de nas lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom 1—150

ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /dge sbyong chen po mkhyen par mdzad du gsol / bdag 'dir bsti gnas na 'chag pa na bkod ma chen po'i chab cig mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang ①'di snyam du sems te②/ chu 'di sngon ni ma mchis na da ltar chu 'di gang nas bab snyam ④bgyid do/ /'od srung ral pa can ④'dir khyod las ngas bsod snyoms bzhes nas phyogs 'dir zhugs ⑤te zhal zas kyi bya ba mdzad pa na nga la chus chu'i dgos pa zhig byung ngo / /de nas lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyis nga la chus chu'i dgos pa byung bar shes nas phyogs 'dir lag pa sa la bsnun pa las/ de nas bkod ma thochen po byung ba de la ngas chus chu'i bya ba mdzad do/ /tho'od srung rdzing 'di ni dulag pas brkos pa zhes bya'o/ /de nas lteng rgyas spu'od srung ral pa can 'di snyam du sems te/kwa /'di ltar dge sbyong chen po rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che ba yin te/ ya mtshan che mod kyi bdag kyang dgra bcom pa yin no snyam mo//de nas bcom ldan 'das lteng rgyas na nyunyesteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can gyi bsti gnas kyi nags tshang tshing na bzhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das phyi 'bred nyusnyenang du yang dag 'jog las bzhengs nas rdzing lag pas brkos skyepa gang na ba der gshegs te 6byon nas/ rdzing lag pas brkos pa'i 'gram gyi mtha' gcig byatu na bza' chos gos rnams bzhag ste/ rdzing lag pas brkos ⑩par zhugs ⑩nas sku khrus mdzad nas rdzing lag pas brkos pa nas 'byung bar bzhed pa na shing ardzu na gang na ba de 8logs su phyag brkyang ngo / /de nas ardzu na'i yal ga chen po 'dud ⑩par gyur tezhu / de la bcom ldan 'das kyis bzung nas rdzing lag pas brkos pa nas byung ngo / /lteng rgyas 'od sung ral pa can 0bsti 4—151

gnas na 'chag pa na rdzing lag ①pas brkos pa'i 'gram na ②ardzu na'i yal ga chen po 'dud pa zhig mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang 'di snyam du sems te/ardzu na'i yal ga 'di sngon ni 'dud par ma gyur na/ ardzu na'i yal ga chen po 'di da 0su zhig gis btud snyam mo/ /de nas lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das ④la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /dge sbyong chen po mkhyen par mdzad du gsol/bdag 'dir bsti gnas na 'chag ⑤pa na rdzing lag pas brkos pa'i 'gram na ardzu na'i yal ga chen po 'dud ⑥pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang bdag ⑦'di snyam du sems ④te/ ardzu na'i yal ga chen po 'di sngon ni 'dud par ma gyur na/da spu'adi su zhig gis btud snyam bgyid do/ /'od srung nga 'dir phyi 'bred ⑩nang du yang dag 'jog las nyunyebazhengs nas rdzing lag pas brkos 8pa gang na ba der gshegs te byon nas/ rdzing lag pas brkos pa'i 'gram gyi mtha' gcig na shesan bza' chos gos rnams bzhag ste rdzing lag pas brkos par zhugs te/lus khrus byas nas rdzing lag pas brkos pa nas 'byung bar 'dod nas shing ardzu na 'di gang na ba de cologs su lag pa brkyang ba dang / de nas ardzu na'i yal ga chen po 'di 'dud par gyur te/ de la nga 'jus nas rdzing lag pas brkos pa nas byung 8ngo / /'od srung shing 'di ni ardzu na lag pas bzung ba ⑩zhes bya'o/ /de nas lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can 'di snyam du sems te/ 'di ltar dge sbyong chen po rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che ba yin te/ ya mtshan che mod kyi bdag kyang dgra bcom pa yin no snyam mo// de nas bcom ldan 'das lteng rgyas na lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can gyi 4—152
