bsti gnas kyi nags tshang tshing na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis phyag dar khrod pa'i ①sha na'i ras dag brnyes ②nas/ de nas bcom ldan 'das 'di snyam du dgongs te/ nga'i phyag dar khrod pa'i sha na'i ras dag ②gang du bkru ④snyam mo/ /de nas lha rnams kyi ⑤dbang po brgya byin gyi ⑥sems kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi dgongs pa shes nas ⑦grag cig ⑧las rdo leb che la ring ba zhig blangs ⑨nas bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das phyag dar khrod pa'i sha na'i ras dag 'di la bkru bar gsol/ de la bcom ldan 'das kyis phyag dar khrod pa'i sha na'i ras rnams bkrus so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 'di snyam du dgongs te/ nga'i phyag dar khrod pa'i sha na'i ras rnams gang du dgram snyam pa dang / de nas lha rnams kyi 0 dbang po brgya byin gyi sems kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi yidagongs pa shes nas/ brag cig tsolas rdo leb che la ring ba ⑩zhig khyer nas bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di la phyag dar khrod pa'i sha na'i ras rnams dgram du gsol/ de la bcom ldan 'das kyis phyag dar khrod pa'i sha na'i ras dag bkram mo/ /lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can bsti gnas na 'chag pa na rdo leb che la ring ba dag mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang tso'adi snyam du sems te/ rdo leb che la ring ba 'di dag sngon ni med na rdo 8leb che la 0ring ba 'di dag da su zhig gis khyer te 'ongs 7snyam mo/ /de nas lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin nas/bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /dge sbyong chen po mkhyen par 4—153

mdzad du gsol/ 'dir bdag bsti gnas na 'chag pa na rdo leb che la ring ba dag cig mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang bdag ①'di snyam du sems te/ rdo leb che la ring ba 'di dag sngon ni ma mchis na rdo leb che la ring ba 'di dag da su zhig gis 'tshal te mchis snyam bgyid do/ /'od srung 'dir ngas phyag dar khrod pa'i sha na'i ras dag cig brnyes so༅/ /de nas nga she'adi snyam du dgongs te / phyag dar khrod pa'i sha na'i ras gang du bkrucho snyam pa dang / de nas lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyi ④sems kyis nga'i dgongs pa shes nas brag cig las ༅rdo leb che la ring ba zhig blangs te/ nga gang na ba der 'ongs zhute/phyin nas nga la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di la phyag dar khrod pa'i sha na'i ras rnams bkru bar gsol/ ngas de 3la phyag dar khrod pa'i sha na'i ras rnams bkrus so/ /nga 'di snyam du dgongs te/ ngas 3phyag dar khrod pa'i sha na'i ras rnams gang du dgram snyam pa dang / de nas lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyi ⑨sems kyis nga'i dgongs pa shes nas brag cig las rdo leb che la ring ba gzhan zhig blangs te/ nga gang na ba der 'ongs te phyin nas nga la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di la 7phyag dar khrod pa'i sha na'i ras rnams dgram du gsol/ ngas de la phyag dar khrod pa'i sha na'i ras rnams bkram mo/ /'od sung rdo leb che zhing ring ba 'di dag ni gnod sbyin gyis blangs pa zhes bya'o ⑩/ /de nas lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can 'di snyam du sems te/ 'di ltar dge sbyong chen po rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che ba yin te/ya mtshan che mod kyi bdag kyang dgra bcom pa yin no snyam mo//de nas bcom ldan 'das lteng rgyas na lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can gyi 1—154

bsti gnas kyi nags tshang tshing na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe nai rañdza na'i chu cher brug nas ①bab bo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das chu klung mi gang bas lhag pas khebs ②pa'i steng nas sa durdul gyis yog pa bla gab med pa la 'chag pas 'chag par mdzad do/ /de nas lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can 'di snyam du sems te/dge sbyong chen po de ltar mdzes pa chu chen po brug ④pas khyer bar ༅ma gyur grang /ma la ༅bdag gis dge sbyong chen po btsal lo snyam du bsams nas shing gcig pa'i gru'i nang du zhugs te bcom ldan 'das btsal ba na/ lteng rgyas cu'od srung ral pa can gyis bcom ldan 'das chu klung mi gang bas lhag pas khebs ⑧pa'i steng nas rdul gyis yog pa bla gab med pa na 'chag pas 'chag pa rtsamathong ngo n+tu/ /mthong nas kyang bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /dge sbyong chen po gson nam/ 'od srung gson no/ /dge sbyong chen po zhugs shing gcig pa'i grur 'jug gam/ 'od srung 'jug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 'di snyam du dgongs te/ ma la ngas ji ltar thugs mnyam par bzhag na shing gcig pa'i gru ji lta bar chu la 'jug pa de lta bu'i rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du bya ba 'du bya'o snyam nas/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis ji ltar thugs mnyam par bzhag na shing gcig pa'i gru ji lta bar chu la 'jug pa de lta bu'i rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du mdzad do/ /de nas lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can 'di snyam du sems te/'di ltar dge sbyong chen po rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che ba yin te/ ya mtshan che mod kyi bdag kyang dgra bcom pa yin no snyam mo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs kyis lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can gyi sems mkhyen nas lteng rgyas 'od sung ral pa can la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /'od srung khyod ni dgra bcom 1—155

pa ma yin/ dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du bya ba'i phyir zhugs pa ma yin te/ dgra bcom pa'i lam gang yin pa de yang mi ①shes so/ /de nas lteng rgyas 'od sung ral pa can 'di snyam du sems te/ dge sbyong chen po gi ta ma'i thugs kyis bdag gi ②sems mkhyen to ④snyam du rig nas bcom ④ ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /dge sbyong chen po bdag legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu 'byung ba dang bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos po thob ⑤pa lta na/ dge sbyong chen po'i spyan sngar bdag tshangs par spyod pa spyad par bgyi'o/ /'od srung khyod ⑥kyis 'khor la bltas thosam/ dge sbyong chen po ma bltas lags so/ /'od srung de'i phyir re zhig 'khor la ltos shig /'di ltar khyod lta bu'i mi grags pa dang ldan pa shes nyen can rnams kyis ni 'khor la blta ba rdulegs pa yin no/ /de nas lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can rang gi bsti gnas gang yin pa der song ste phyin nas bram ze'i khye'u rnams la smras pa/bram ze'i khye'u dag shes par gyis shig /bram ze'i khye'u dag kho bo ni dge sbyong chen po'i spyan sngar tshangs par spyod pa spyad can shes ldan dag ci byed/ mkhan po bdag cag gis chung nyuX zad ci 'tshal ba de thams cad ni mkhan po la brten nas lags 7pas gal te mkhan po dge sbyong chen po'i spyan sngar tshangs par spyod pa spyad 8na/ bdag cag kyang mkhan po rab tu byung ba'i rjes su rab tu 'byung ⑫ngo / /bram ze'i khye'u dag khyed byakyis de'i phyir g.yang gzhi dang / shing shun dang / khar cib dang / ril ba spyi blugs dang / blugs chagazar 'di dag chu klung nai rañdza na'i nang du 'or cig /mkhan po bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes bram ze'i khye'u de rnams kyis g.yang gzhi dang / shing shun dang / khar ⑩ba 1—166

dang / ril ba spyi blugs ①dang / blugs ②gzar rnams chu klung nai rañdza na'i nang du bor nas lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can gang na ba ①der song ste phyin nas lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can la 'di skad ces smras so/ /mkhan po 'di ltar bdag cag gis bgyi ba gang lags pa de bgyis lags so/ /de nas lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can 'khor lnga brgya dang bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /dge sbyong chen po bdag gis 'khor la bltas lags te/ bdag legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu 'byung ba dang bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos po 'thob pa lta na/ bdag dge sbyong chen po'i spyan sngar tshangs par spyod pa spyad par bgyi'o/ /'od srung tshur shog /tshangs par laspyad pa spyod cig /de nyid kyis tshe dang ldan pa de dag rab tu byung ba dang / des bsnyen par rdzogs pa dang / des dge slong gi dngos por gyur to/ /de'i tshe lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can gyi spun chu klung 'od srung dang / ga yā cu'od srung gnyis 'khor nyis brgya lnga bcu lnga bcu dang 8chu klung nai rañdza na'i 'jug ngogs kyi sku'agram gyi bsti gnas na dka' ༅thub spyod do/ /chu klung 'od srung dang / ga yā du'od srung spun gyis g.yang gzhi dang / shing shun dang / khar ba spudang / ril ba spyi blugs dang / blugs ⑩gzar de dag chu klung nai rañdza skyenas khyer ba tsomathong ngo / /mthong nas kyang de dag 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag cag gi tsotshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa rnams rgyal po'am/ chom rkun nam/ me'am/ chus nyes dmigs 'ga' zhig byung bar ma gyur grang / ma la bdag cag gis tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa rnams btsal lo snyam mo/ /de nas chu klung 'od sung dang /1—157

ga yā ②'od srung spun dag lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can tshol zhing lteng rgyas 'od sung ral pa can gyi bsti gnas gang na ba der dong ba dang de'i tshe tshe dang ldan pa lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can skra byi snam sbyar bgos nas 'khor lnga brgya dang bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga na chos nyan dupa'i phyir ②'khod do/ /chu klung 'od srung dang / ga yā bya'od srung spun gyis lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can skra byi snam sbyar bgos nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga na chos nyan ④pa'i phyir 'dug pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang tshe dang ldan pa ༅'od srung ral pa can la 'di skad ces smras so/ /'od srung ༅'di ni mchog yin la/ de mchog ma yin nam/ 'od srung dag 'di ni mchog yin te/ de ni ma yin no/ /de nas chu klung 'od srung dang / ga yā du'od srung spun dag 'di snyam du sems te/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ni mchog ma yin pa rtsam yin zhing chos bshad pa yang mchog ma yin pa ma yin te/ gang gi phyir da ltar lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can btsas nas lo brgya nyi shu lhag lon pa rgas 'khogs gtugs pa/ ma ga d+ma'i mi rnams kyis nyu )bkur sti byas/ bla mar byas/ rjed nyunyepar byas/mchod par byas shing dgra bcom par bkur ba de yang lan gnyis kyi bar du dge sbyong chen po'i spyan sngar rab tu 'byung bar khas blangs kyis/ ma la bdag cag kyang dge sbyong chen po'i tu)spyan sngar tshangs par spyod pa spyad par bya'o snyam du bsams tsonas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /dge sbyong chen po bdag cag legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu 'byung ba dang bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos po thob ④pa lta na/ bdag cag dge sbyong chen po'i spyan sngar tshangs par spyod pa spyad par bgyi'o(ste/ /khyed kyis 4—158

'khor la bltas sam/ dge sbyong chen po ma bltas lags so/ /'od srung dag de'i phyir re zhig ①'khor la ltos shig /'di ②lta bu'i mi grags pa dang ldan pa shes nyen ②can dag gis ni 'khor la blta byab legs pa yin no/ /de nas chu klung 'od srung dang / ga yā ༅'od sung spun rang gi bsti gnas gang na ba der song ste phyin nas/ bram ze'i khye'u rnams la 'di skad ces smras so/ //bram ze'i khye'u dag shes par gyis thoshig /kho bo cag ni dge sbyong chen po'i spyan sngar tshangs par spyod pa spyad dun shes ldan nyudag ci lku byed/ mkhan po dag bdag cag kyechung zad ci 'tshal ba de thams cad ni mkhan po dag la brten nas lags kyis / gal te mkhan po dag dge sbyong chen po'i spyan sngar tshangs par spyod pa spyad skyon bdag cag kyang mkhan po dag nyunyerab tu byung ba'i rjes su rab tu 'byung ngo / /bram ze'i khye'u dag de'i dus da miyin par shes par gyis shig /de nas chu klung 'od srung dang / ga yā skye'od srung spun skye'akhor nyis nyu brgya lnga bcu lnga bcu dang nyu8bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste lhags nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /dge sbyong chen po bdag cag gis 'khor la bltas lags te/ dge sbyong chen po bdag cag legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu 'byung ba dang / bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos po 'thob pa lta na/ bdag cag dge sbyong chen po'i spyan sngar tshangs par spyod pa spyad par bgyi'o / /'od srung dag tshur sheg mtshangs par spyod rngu pa spyod cig /de nyid kyis tshe dang ldan pa de rnams rab tu byung ba dang / des bsnyen par rdzogs pa dang / des dge slong gi dngos por gyur to//de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis ral pa can stong po de rab tu phyung 2bsnyen 4wa 159

par rdzogs par mdzad nas lteng rgyas su ji tsam bzhed kyi bar du bzhugs nas ga yā ①gang na ba der rgyu zhing gshegs te/ rim gyis rgyu zhing gshegs pa na ga lngar ②byon nas ga yā na ga yā ④mgo'i mchod rten la bsngon gyi ral pa can thams cad rab tu byung ba'i dge slong stong dang thabs cig ⑤tu bzhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong stong po de la cho ༅'phrul ⑦rnam pa gsum gyis 'doms par mdzad de/ rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul dang / kun rjod ④pa'i cho 'phrul dang / rjes su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul lo/ /de la bcom ldan 'das kyi ⑨rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul ni cha'adi yin te/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis ji ltar thugs mnyam par bzhag na/ nyid kyi hugadan gyi nang du mi snang bar gyur cing shar phyogs kyi steng gi bar snang la mngon 8par 'phags nas spyod lam rnam pa bzhi mdzad deskye/ 'di lta ste 'chag pa dang / bzhengs pa dang / bzhugs pa dang / mnal ba skyo rimadzad do/ /me'i ting nge 'dzin la yang snyoms par 'jug par mdzad de/ me'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs pa na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi sku las nyusnye'od zer byarnam pa sna tshogs dag 'byin par mdzad de/ 'di lta ste sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang /dkar po dang / le brgan dang / shel gyi kha dog go/ /cho 'phrul zung du yang ston par mdzad de/ sku'i smad nas 'bar bar mdzad lam/ sku'i stod ⑫nas chu grang mo'i rgyun 'bebs par mdzad do/ /sku'i stod nas 0'bar bar mdzad la du sku'i smad nas chu grang mo'i rgyun 'bebs par mdzad pa de lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /shar phyogs la ༅ji lta ba bzhin du lho dang /nub dang / byang phyogs su yang ④de bzhin no/ /phyogs bzhir rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 4—160

'phrul rnam pa bzhi bstan nas rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du mdzad pa rnams bsdus te/dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi gung la gdan bshams pa nyid la bzhugs te/ de la 'di ni bcom ldan 'das kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul yin no/ /de la bcom ldan 'das kyi kun rjod ①pa'i cho 'phrul ni 'di yin te/ dge slong dag khyed kyi sems ni 'di lta bu'o/ /khyed kyi rgyayid ni 'di lta bu'o/ /rnam par shes pa ni 'di lta bu'o/ /'di ni rtogs shig /'di ni ma rtogs shig /'di ni yid la byos shig /'di ni yid la ma byed cig /'di ni spongs shig / 'di ni ma spongs shig /rgya'adi ni lus kyis mngon sum du byas la rdzogs par byas te gnos ④shig /'di ni bcom ldan 'das kyi kun rjod phyepa'i cho 'phrul yin no/ /de la bcom ldan 'das kyi rjes su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul ni 'di yin te/ dge slong dag 'di thams cad ni kun du 'bar ba yin no/ /dge slong dag thams cad kun du 'bar ba de ci yin zhe na/ dge slong dag mig dang / gzurges dang / mig gi rnam par shes pa dang / mig gi 'dus te reg pa kun du 'bar ba yin zhing mig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis nang gi tshor ba bde ba'am/sdug bsngal ba'am/ bde ba yang ma yin sdug bsngal ba yang ma yin pa 'byung ṣ+yob gang yin pa de yang kun du 'bar ba yin no/ /dge slong dag rna ba dang /sna dang / lce dang / lus dang / yid dang / chos dang / yid kyi rnam par shes pa dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa ni kun du 'bar ba yin zhing yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis nang gi tshor ba bde ba'am/ sdug bsngal ba'am/bde ba yang ma yin sdug bsngal ba yang ma yin pa 'byung ba gang yin pa de yang kun du 'bar ba yin no/ /gang gis kun du 'bar zhe na/ 'dod chags kyi 1—161

me dang / zhe sdang gi me dang / gti mug gi mes kun du 'bar/ skye ba dang /rga ba dang / na ba dang / 'chi ba dang / mya ngan dang / smre sngags 'don pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba dang 'khrug pa ste/ sdug bsngal gyis ①kun du 'bar ba'o zhes smra'o/ /de la 'di ni bcom ldan 'das kyi ②rjes su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul yin no/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bshad pa na sngon thams cad ral pa can du gyur pa'i dge slong de dag zhulen pa med par zag pa rnams las sems rnam par grol lo//de nas bcom ldan 'das ga yā na ga yā byamago'i mchod rten la zhusngon thams cad ral pa can du gyur pa'i dge sbyong ⑥thams cad kyang dgra bcom pa/zag pa zad pa/ bya ba byas pa/ byed pa byas pa/ khur bor ba/ rang gi don rjes su thob pa/ srid par thokun du sbyor ba yongs su zad pa/ yang dag pa'i shes pas sems shin tu rnam par grol ba sha stag dang thabs cig 3tu bzhugs so/ /rgyal po gzugs can snying po'i zho shas 'tsho ba'i mi rnams ljongs rgyu ba na shākya shernams kyi gzhon nu gangs ri'i ngos/ chu bo skal ldan shing rta'i 'gram / drang srong ser skya'i bsti gnas dang ha cang yang mi ring ba zhig tu byung chob de bram ze mtshan mkhan dang ltas nyu3mkhan rnams kyis/ gal te khyim par gyur te khyim na gnas na nyunyeni 'khor los sgyur 8ba'i rgyal po chos dang ldan pa'i 8chos kyi 8rgyal po mtha' bzhir rnam par rgyal ba rmye/ rin po che sna bdun dang ldan par 'gyur te/ de'i 2rin po che sna bdun ni 'di lta bu dag yin par 'gyur ro/ /'di lta ste 'khor lo rin po che dang / glang po rin po che dang /rta rin po che dang / nor bu rin po che dang / bud med rin po che dang ⑫/4—162

khyim bdag rin po che dang / bdun pa blon po rin po che yin no/ /de la bu stong yang tshang bar 'byung bar 'gyur te/ dpa' ba rtul ①pod pa/ yan lag mchog gi gzugs dang ldan pa/ pha rol gyi sde rab tu 'joms pa/ de rgya mtsho la thug pa'i sa chen po ma lus par gnod par sdo ba med cing 'tshe ba med pa 'di nyid chad pa med cing mtshon gyis bda' rjob med la/ chos dang mthun zhing snyoms par ②legs par phab ④ste gnas par 'gyur ro/ /gal te skra dang kha spu bregs te gos ngur smrig ⑤bgos nas dad pa yang dag pa kho nas khyim nas khyim med par ⑥rab tu byung bar gyur na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su 'jig rten du sgra rnam par grags par 'gyur bar lung bstan to zhes thos so/ /thos nas kyang tsom ga d+ma'i rgyal po bzo ⑧sbyangs gzugs can snying po gang na ba der song ste phyin nas/ ma ga d+ma'i rgyal po bzo sbyangs ⑨gzugs can snying po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /lha mkhyen par mdzad du gsol/ bdag cag 'dir lha'i yul na rgyu ba na shākya rnams kyi gzhon nu gangs ri'i ngos/ chu bo skal ldan shing rta'i 'gram/ drang srong ser skya'i bsti gnas dang ha cang yang mi ring ba zhig tu byung ba de ⑫ bram ze mtshan mkhan dang ltas mkhan rnams kyis/ gal te khyim par gyur te khyim na gnas na 'khor los sgyur 0ba'i rgyal po mtha' bzhir rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba nas/bdun pa blon po rin po cher 'gyur ro zhes bya ba'i bar du'o/ /de la bu stong yang tshang bar 'byung bar tso'agyur ro zhes bya ba nas chos dang mthun zhing snyoms par legs par phab ste gnas par 'gyur ro zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o//gal te skra dang kha spu bregs te gos ngur smrig 4)bgos nas zhes bya ba nas/4—163

'jig rten du sgra rnam par grags par ①'gyur bar lung bstan pa zhig thos so zhes bya ba'i bar ②gong ma bzhin du'o/ /lha de khum shig /lha bas gtso bo bas ches dugatso bor 'gyur du mchi'o/ /grong pa dag shākya rnams kyi gzhon nu gangs ri'i ngos/ chu bo skal ldan shing rta'i 'gram/ drang srong ser skya'i bsti gnas dang ha cang yang mi ring ba zhig tu byung ba zhes ④bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du ste/ gal te khyim par gyur te khyim na gnas na 'khor los sgyur ⑤ba'i rgyal po 'es bya ba nas ⑤chos dang mthun zhing snyoms par legs par phab ste gnas par 'gyur ro zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /gal te spa dang kha spu bregs te gos ngur smrig bgos nas dad pa yang dag pa kho nas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung bar gyur na⑦/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su 'jig rten du sgra rnam par grags par 'gyur ba de lha khum shig② /lha bas gtso bo bas ches gtso bor 'gyur ④du mchi'o zhes khyed cag de skad ma smra shig⑩ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ grong pa dag shākya rnams kyi gzhon nu zhes bya ba nas byung ba zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du ste/ gal te 'khor los sgyur 7ba'i rgyal por gyur na de'i g.yog bya'o/ /gal te skra dang kha spu bregs te gos ngur smrig tsobagos nas dad pa yang dag pa kho nas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung bar gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag (sprerdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su 'jig rten du sgra rnam ④par grags par gyur na de'i nyan thos su khas blang bar bya'o/ /de nas ma ga ṅgā'i rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying po steng 8gi khang bzangs kyi gzhi la 'dug nas smon pa'i gzhi lnga smon par byed de/ kye ma bdag gi ⑦yul du 'jig rten gyi ston pa de bzhin 1—164

gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu ①'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ba bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ②ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'byung ba dang / de la yang blta ba'i phyir bdag nye bar 'gro ba dang / nye bar song ba na des kyang bdag la chos bshad pa dang /bdag gis kyang chos bshad pa de shes pa dang ②/ bdag gis chos shes nas bslab pa bcas shing bslab pa de yang bdag gis blangs te gnas ④kyang ci ma rung snyam mo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/dge slong dag ma ga ṅgā'i rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying po de steng gi khang bzangs kyi gzhi la 'dug nas smon pa'i gzhi lnga smon par byed de/ kye ma'o bdag gi yul du 'jig rten gyi ston pa de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ba bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'byung ba dang / de la yang blta ba'i phyir bdag nye bar 'gro ba dang / nye bar song ba na des kyang bdag la chos bshad pa dang / bdag gis kyang chos bshad pa de shes pa dang / bdag gis chos shes nas bslab pa bcas shing bslab pa de yang bdag gis blangs te gnas kyang ci ma rung snyam mo/ /ma ga ṅgā'i rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying po'i zho shas 'tsho ba dag cig ljongs rgyu ba na shākya rnams kyi gzhon nu gangs ri'i ngos⑤/ chu bo skal ldan shing rta'i 'gram / drang srong ⑥ser skya'i bste ⑦gnas dang ha cang yang mi ring lab zhig 4—165

tu byung ba gang yin pa de bram ze mtshan mkhan dang ltas mkhan zhes bya ba nas 'jig rten du sgra rnam par grags par 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan pa zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /de skra dang kha spu bregs te gos ngur smrig bgos nas dad pa yang dag pa kho nas khyim nas khyim med par ①rab tu byung ba de bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas/de ga ya na ga ya mgo'i ②mchod rten la sngon thams cad ral pa can du gyur pa'i dge slong stong thams cad kyang dgra bcom pa/ zag pa zad pa/ bya ba byas pa/byed pa byas pa/ khur bor ba/ bdag gi don rjes su thob pa/ srid par ③kun du sbyor ba yongs su zad pa/ yang dag pa'i shes pas ④sems shin tu rnam par grol ba sha stag dang thabs cig ⑤tu bzhugs so zhes thos so/ /thos nas kyang ma ga ṅgā'i rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying po gang na ba der dong ste lhags nas/ ma ga ṅgā'i rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /lha mkhyen par mdzad du gsol/ bdag cag 'di na lha'i yul na rgyu ba na shākya rnams kyi gzhon nu gang lags pa de zhes bya ba nas 'jig rten du sgra rnam par grags par 'gyur ro zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du ste/ de skra dang kha spu bregs te gos ngur smrig bgos nas dad pa yang dag pa kho nas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ba de bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par yisangs rgyas nas/ de ga yā na ga yā ⑦mgo'i mchod rten la sngon thams cad ral pa can du gyur pa'i dge slong thams cad kyang dgra bcom pa/ zag pa zad pa zhes bya ba dunas yang dag pa'i shes pas sems shin du rnam par grol ba sha stag dang thabs cig ①tu bzhugs so zhes bya ba'i bar 4—166

du ste/ lha de la bkur sti mdzod cig dang ①/ de lta na lha gtso bo bas ches gtso bor 'gyur ro/ /de nas ma ga ṅgā'i rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying pos mi zhig la bsgo ba/ kwa'e ②nang rje tshur khyod bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der ②mong nas kho bo'i tshig 'di dag gis bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byos la/ gnod pa chung ngam/ nyam nga ba nyung ngam/'tsho'am / bskyod ④pa yang ngam/ stobs dang / bde ba dang / sku nyams dang ldan nam/ reg par spyod dam zhes zhus la 'di skad ces kyang gsol cig /bdag bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun dang thabs cig ⑤la ji srid 'tsho'i bar du na bza' chos gos dang / bsod snyoms dang /gzims cha dang / snyun yidapyad kyi rkyen sman dang / yo byad rnams kyis bsnyen bkur bgyid na/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab tu gshegs su gsol zhes gsol cig /lha bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes mi des ma ga ṅgā'i rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying po las mnyan nas/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi ༅zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te/phyogs gcig tu 'dug steni/ bcom ldan 'das la mi des 'di skad ces gsol to / /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la ma ga d+ma'i rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying po ⑨mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas gnod pa chung tu )ngam/nyam nga ba nyung ngam zhes bya ba nas reg par spyod dam zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin te⑩/ snyun gsol lags so/ /kye mi khyod dang ma ga d+ma'i rgyal po bzo ⑫sbyangs gzugs can snying po bde bar gyur cig /btsun pa ma ga ṅgā'i rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying po'i mchid nas 'di skad ces/ bdag bcom 1—167

ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun dang thabs cig ①la ji srid 'tsho'i bar du na bza' chos gos dang / bsod snyoms dang / gzims cha dang / snyun dpyad kyi rkyen sman dang / yo byad rnams kyis bsnyen bkur bgyid na/bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab tu gshegs su gsol zhes mchi lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis mi de la cang mi gsung bas gnang ngo ②/ /de nas mi des bcom ldan 'das cang mi gsung bas gnang bar ②rig nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga nas song ngo //de nas bcom ldan 'das sngon thams cad ral pa can du gyur pa'i dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po thams cad kyang dgra bcom pa/ zag pa zad pa zhes bya ba byanas yang dag pa'i shes pas sems shin du rnam par grol ba zhes bya ba'i bar sha stag dang thabs cig ⑤tu ma ga ṅgā'i ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs pa na yul ma ga dhā pa rnams kyi mchod rten legs par rab gnas ltang brang gi khyatshal na yod pa gang na ba der gshegs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das legs par rab gnas su byon nas ⑦ma ga dhā pa rnams kyi mchod rten legs par rab gnas ltang 'ubrang gi tshal na yod pa na bzhugs so/ /ma ga ṅgā'i rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying pos bcom ldan 'das sngon thams cad ral pa can du gyur pa'i dge slong stong gi spudage slong gi dge 'dun chen po zhes bya ba nas/ sems shin tu rnam par grol ba zhes bya ba'i bar du ste/ ma ga ṅgā'i ljongs rgyu shing ⑨ gshegs pa na/ ma ga dhā pa rnams kyi mchod rten legs par rab gnas ltang ⑫brang gi tshal na yod pa gang na ba der gshegs te/ ma ga dhā pa rnams kyi 1—168

mchod rten legs par rab gnas ltang ①brang gi tshal na yod pa na bzhugs so zhes thos so/ /thos nas kyang shing rta bzang po'i ②nang du zhugs te 'khor brgya phrag du ma dang ③rgyal po'i khab nas byung nas bcom ldan 'das la blta ba dang /bsnyen bkur bya ba'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar song ba na/ de'i shing rta'i 'khor lo sa'i nang du bying bar gyur to/ /des bsams pa bdag gis las skyon can chung zad byas par ma gyur grang snyam mo/ /lha rnams kyis de la smras pa/rgyal po chen po khyod kyis las skyon can ma byas mod kyithu/ khyod dang lhan cig las mtshungs par spyod ⑤pa gang yin pa de dag btson ra na 'dug gis de dag thon cig /rgyal pos smras pa/ gal te de lta na gdon no ⑥zhes rgyal pos btson rnams 'don du bcug go/ /yang rgyal po phyir 'byung bar brtsams pa na de'i dbu rgyan sgo la thug go/ /des yang ⑦bsams pa/ bdag gis ni gdon mi za bar las skyon can zhig byas te/ des na bdag la ltas ngan pa gzhan sgo la dbu rgyan thug pa 'di byung ngo snyam mo/ /lha de rnams kyis yang smras pa/ rgyal po chen po ⑧khyod kyis las skyon can ma byas mod kyi7/ khyod dang lhan cig las mtshungs par spyod pa gang yin pa de dag kha cig ni 'dus/ kha cig ni yul phyogs gzhan ⑫ ga ge mo zhes bya ba dag na las kyi mtha' byed cing 'dug pa de dag spron cig /rgyal pos yul de na gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs thams cad bkug go / /de nas rgyal po gzugs can snying po shing rta khri nyis stong dang / zhabs ⑩'bring ba rta pa'i tshogs khri brgya 8stong dang / ma ga d+ma'i bram ze dang / khyim bdag brgya 8stong phrag du ma dang lhan cig rgyal po'i khab nas byung ste/ bcom ldan 'das la blta ba dang / bsnyen bkur bya ba'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyi 4—169

spyan sngar song ngo / /de ji tsam bzhon ①pa'i sa'i bar du bzhon pas song ste/bzhon pa las babs ②nas rkang pa kho nas kun dga' ra bar zhugs so/ /ma ga d+ma'i rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying pos thag ci ①tsam nas bcom ldan 'das mthong ba'i bar de nas rgyal po'i mtshan ma lnga po ze'u kha dang / gdugs dang / ral gri dang nor bu'i rnga yab dang / lham khra bo rnams phud do// //'dul ba gzhibya/ bam po brgyad bcu ⑤dgu pa/ de nas ma ga ṅgā'i rgyal po bzo sbyangs ⑥gzugs can snying pos rgyal po'i ⑦mtshan ma lnga bzhag nas bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin pa dang / bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar ⑧nas bcom ldan 'das gang na ba de 0logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de rang gi ming nas phyung ste/ lan gsum du gsol pa/ btsun pa bdag ni ma ga ṅgā'i rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying po lags so/ / btsun pa bdag ni ma ga ṅgā'i rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying po lags so/ /⑩rgyal po lags so/ /rgyal po chen po de de bzhin te/ de de bozhin no/ /rgyal po chen po khyod ma ga ṅgā'i rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying po yin no/ /rgyal po chen po khyod ma ga ṅgā'i rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying po yin no/ /rgyal po yin no/ /rgyal po chen po khyod rang gi stan ji lta ba la 'dug shigayi /de nas ma ga d+ma'i rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying pos bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /ma ga ṅgā'i bram ze dang khyim bdag kha cig gis ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /kha cig ni bcom ldan 'das dang lhan cig mngon du yang dag par dga' ba dang / yang dag par mgu bar 1—170

'gyur ba'i gtam rnam pa sna tshogs byas te phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /kha cig ni bcom ldan 'das gang na ba de 7logs su thal mo sbyar te 'khod do/ /kha cig ni bcom ldan 'das rgyang ring po nas mthong nas cang mi smra bar phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /de'i tshe tshe dang ldan pa lteng rgyas 'od srung 'khor de nyid du 'dus shing 'dug par gyur to/ /de nas ma ga d+ma'i bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams 'di snyam du sems te/ ci dge sbyong chen po lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can gyi tshangs par spyod pa la spyod dam/ 'on te lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can dge sbyong chen po'i tshangs par spyod ②pa la ①spyod snyam mo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi ༅thugs kyis ma ga ṅgā'i bram ze dang / khyim bdag rnams kyi sems mkhyen nas tshe dang ldan pa lteng rgyas 'od sung la tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis dri ba rmas ⑤pa/ lteng rgyas gnas pa khyod 'dir ci mthong na/ /me spangs nas ni brtul zhugs 'di dag spyod/ /khyod ⑥kyis ci ltar me yi mchod spangs pa//don de 'od srung nga la smra bar gyis/ /lteng rgyas 'od srung gis gsol pa/'di ni ④kha cig zas skom de bzhin rol/ /'dod pa dag dang bud med kho na smra/ /de dag thabs kyi dri ma ⑨rab mthong ste/ /des bdag mchod sbyin mi dga' sreg blugs ⑩min/ /khyod ni 'dod dang bza' dang btung ba dang / /de bzhin ro la yid ni mi dga' na/ /lha mi 'jig rten la ci khyod kyi yid/ /dga' ba yin nam 'od srung dri yis smosayi/ /phung po ma mchis zhi ba ci ma mchis/ /'dod srid tsom chags gzhan du 'gyur ma mchis/ /gzhan gyis tsomi bkri'i tsogo 'phang mchog mthong ste/ / des bdag skemachod sbyin mi dga' sreg blugs ⑩min/ /go 'phang mi nyams mchog ni ma mthong bas/ /mchod sbyin brtul zhugs dang ni 4—171

zhugs dag gis/ /grol snyam bdag gi yid ni rmongs gyur te/ /dmus long gyur nas skye shi rjes bzhin 'thom/ /skyob pa gtso bo mchog gis legs bshad pa//go 'phang ①'dus ma byas te gzod ②mthong na/ /thub pa gi tam rnam par 'dren khyod ni/ /skye bo phal chen don brtson bden la zhugs②/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' 455 pa/ /khyod kyi ④rtogs pa legs rtogs te/ /khyod kyis nyes par bsams ma yin/ /rab tu phye ba'i chos rnams la/ /gtso bo gang yin de blangs so/ /'od srung 'khor skyo ba skyed cig /de nas tshe dang ldan pa lteng rgyas 'od srung bcom ldan 'das kyis skabs phye nas ji ltar sems mnyam par bzhag na rang gi stan gyi nang du mi snang bar gyur cing / shar phyogs kyi steng gi bar snang la mngon par 'phags nas spyod lam rnam pa bzhi byed de/'di lta ste/ 'chag pa dang / 'greng ba dang / 'dug pa dang / nyal ba ⑤byed do/ /me'i ting nge 'dzin la yang snyoms par 'jug par byed de/ me'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs pa na tshe dang ldan pa lteng rgyas 'od srung gi lus las 'od zer rnam pa sna tshogs 'byin par byed de/ 'di lta ste sngon po dang /ser po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po dang / le brgan dang / shel gyi kha dog dag yigo/ /cho 'phrul zung du yang ston par byed de/ lus kyi smad nas 'bar bar byed la lus kyi stod nas chu grang mo'i rgyun 'bebs par byed do/ /lus kyi stod nas 'bar bar byed la lus kyi smad nas chu grang mo'i rgyun 'bebs par byed pa de lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /shar phyogs la ji lta ba bzhin du lho dang / nub dang / byang phyogs su yang de bzhin no/ /phyogs bzhir rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul rnam pa bzhi bstan nas rdzu 'phrul mngon par 1—172

'du bya ba dag bsdus te/ bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ bcom ldan 'das gong na ba de 7logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das ni bdag gi ston pa lags so/ /bdag ni bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das ni bdag gi ston pa lags so/ /ston pa lags so/ /bdag ni bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos lags so/ / nyan thos lags so/ /⑤'od srung de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ 'od sung nga ni khyod kyi ston pa yin no/ /khyod ②ni nga'i nyan thos yin no/ /'od srung nga ni khyod kyi ston pa yin no/ /khyod ni nga'i nyan thos yin no/ /'od srung khyod rang gi stan ji lta ba la 'dug shig④ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa lteng rgyas 'od sung gis bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /de nas ma ga d+ma'i bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams 'di snyam du sems te/ dge sbyong chen po ni lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can gyi ④tshangs par spyod pa la mi spyod kyi/ lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can nyid dge sbyong chen po'i tshangs par spyod pa la spyod do snyam mo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis ma ga ṅgā'i rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying po la bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po chen po gzugs la skye ba yang yod/ 'jig pa yang yod de/ de'i skye ba dang 'jig pa yang rig par bya'o/ /rgyal po chen po tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang /'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa la skye ba yang yod/ 'jig pa yang yod de/de'i skye ba dang 'jig pa yang rig par bya'o/ /rgyal po chen po rigs kyi bus gzugs kyi skye ba dang 'jig pa'i chos nyid rig nas gzugs de yongs su shes so//4—173

rgyal po chen po rigs kyi bus tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang /rnam par shes pa'i skye ba dang 'jig pa'i chos nyid rig nas rnam par shes pa de yongs su shes so/ /rgyal po chen po rigs kyi bus gzugs yongs su shes na ①gzugs la bdag gam bdag gir khas mi len/ mi 'dzin lhag par mi gnas/mngon par zhen par mi byed do/ /rgyal po chen po rigs kyi bus tshor ba dang /'du shes dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa yongs su shes na ②bdag gam bdag gir khas mi len/ mi 'dzin/ lhag par mi gnas/ mngon par zhen par mi byed do/① /rgyal po chen po rigs kyi bus gzugs la bdag gam/bdag gir khas mi len/ mi 'dzin/ lhag par mi gnas/ mngon par zhen par mi byed na tshad med cing grangs med pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa yin no zhes smra'o / /rgyal po chen po rigs kyi bus ④tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang /'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa la bdag gam/ bdag gir khas mi len/mi 'dzin/ lhag par mi gnas/ mngon par zhen par mi byed na tshad med cing grangs ⑤med pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa yin no zhes smra'o/ /de nas ma ga ṅgā'i bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams 'di snyam du sems te/ gal te gzugs bdag ma yin/ tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa bdag ma yin na⑥/ 'o na bdag gamacha/ sems can nam/ srog gam / skye ba po'am/ gso ba po'am/ gang zag gam/ shed las skyes sam / shed bu'am/ byed pa po'am/ byed du 'jug pa po'am/ shes pa po'am / kun nas shes pa po'am/ slong ba po'am/ kun nas slong ba po'am / smra ba po'am/ tshor ba po'am/ kun nas tshor ba po gang yin pa 1—174

nam yang ma byung 'byung bar mi 'gyur zhing da lta yang yod pa ma yin na/ gang gis de dang der dge ba dang sdig pa'i las byas pa rnams kyi rnam par smin pa so sor nyams su myong zhing gang gis phung po 'di bor te phung po gzhan dang nying mtshams sbyor ba de su zhig yin par 'gyur snyam mo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs kyis ma ga ṅgā'i bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams kyi sems mkhyen nas/dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag bdag bdag ces bya ba ni byis pa so so 'i skye bo thos pa dang mi ldan pas btags pa'i rjes su lhung ༅ba yin te/'di la bdag ce'am ②bdag gi med kyi/ dge slong dag skye snub na sdug bsngal 'di skye zhing 'gag pa na yang sdug bsngal 'gag go/ /skye ba na ④'du byed rnams skye zhing 'gag pa na 'du byed rnams 'gag par 'gyur te/ rgyu dang rkyen de la brten nas sems can rnams kyi 'du byed kyi rgyud 'jug go/ /dge slong dag de bzhin gshegs pas 'du byed kyi rgyud nying mtshams sbyor ba thugs su chud nas sems can rnams kyi ⑤'chi 'pho dang skye ba 'dogs par mdzad de/ dge slong dag ngas lha'i spyan rnam par dag pa mi'i las 'das pas sems can rnams kyi 'chi 'pho dang / skye ba dang kha dog bzang po dang / kha dog ngan pa dang /dman pa dang / gya rnam pa dang / bde 'gro dang / ngan 'gror 'gro ba yang gzigs so/ /las ji lta ba bzhin ⑥nye bar 'gro ba'i sems can rnams yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du ⑦rab tu mkhyen te/ sems can 'di dag ni lus kyi nyes par spyod pa dang ldan/ ngag dang yid kyi nyes par spyod pa dang ldan/'phags pa rnams la skur pa 'debs pa dang / log par lta ba yin te/ log par lta ba'i las dang chos blangs pa'i nirgyus rgyu de dang rkyen des lus zhig nas shi 4—175

ba'i 'og tu ngan song ngan 'gro log par ltung ba sems can dmyal ba rnams su skye bar 'gyur ro/ /sems can 'di dag ni lus kyi legs par spyod pa dang ldan/ngag dang yid kyi legs par spyod pa dang ldan/ 'phags pa rnams la skur pa mi 'debs ①pa dang / yang dag par ②lta ba yin te/ yang dag par lta ba'i las dang chos blangs pa'i rgyus rgyu de dang rkyen des lus zhig nas bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten gyi lha rnams su skye bar 'gyur ro zhes bya bar mkhyen to/ /dge slong dag ngas de ltar mkhyen cing de ltar gzigs pas nga 'di skad ces bdag gam/ sems can nam/ srog gam/ skye ba po'am/ gso ba po'am/gang zag gam/ shed las skyes sam/ shed bu'am/ byed pa po'am/ byed du 'jug pa po'am/ shes pa po'am/ kun nas shes pa po'am/ slong ba po'am/kun nas slong ba po'am/ smra ba po'am/ tshor ba po'am/ kun nas tshor ba po gang yin pa ni nam yang ma byung 'byung bar mi 'gyur zhing da ltar yang yod pa ma yin pas gang gis de dang der dge ba dang / sdig pa'i las byas pa'i las kyi rnam par smin pa so sor nyams su myong zhing gang gis phung po 'di bor te ③phung po gzhan dang nying mtshams sbyor ba de chos su brdar btags pa ma gtogs pa 'di yin no zhes mi gsung ngo / /de la chos kyi brdar btags pa ni 'di yin te / 'di lta ste 'di yod pas 'di yod/ 'di skyes pas 'di ⑤skye ba ste/'di lta ste ma rig pa'i rkyen gyis 'du byed/ 'du byed kyi rkyen gyis rnam par shes pa / rnam par shes pa'i rkyen gyis ming dang gzugs/ ming dang gzugs kyi rkyen gyis skye mched drug /skye mched drug gi rkyen gyis reg pa/ reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba/ tshor ba'i rkyen gyis sred pa/ sred pa'i rkyen gyis len pa/1—176

len pa'i rkyen gyis srid pa/ srid pa'i rkyen gyis skye ba/ skye ba'i rkyen gyis rga shi dang / mya ngan dang / smre sngags 'don pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang /yid mi bde ba dang / 'khrug ①pa rnams 'byung ste④/ de ltar na sdug bsngal gyi phung po chen po 'ba' zhig ③po 'di 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /'di lta ste 'di med pas 'di med la/ 'di 'gags pas 'di 'gag ④par 'gyur te/ 'di lta ste ma rig pa 'gags pas 'du byed 'gag /'du byed 'gags pas rnam par shes pa 'gag /rnam par shes pa 'gags pas ming dang gzugs 'gag/ming dang gzugs 'gags pas skye mched drug 'gag /skye mched drug 'gags pas reg pa 'gag /reg pa 'gags pas tshor ba 'gag /tshor ba 'gags pas sred pa 'gag /srid pa 'gags ⑤pas len pa 'gag /len pa 'gags pas srid pa 'gag /srid pa 'gags pas skye ba 'gag /skye ba 'gags pas rga shi dang / mya ngan dang / smre sngags 'don pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang /yid mi bde ba dang / 'khrug pa rnams 'gag ste/ de ltar na sdug bsngal gyi phung po chen po 'ba' zhig ༅po 'di 'gag par 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag 'du byed rnams ni sdug bsngal lo/ /mya ngan las 'das pa ni zhi ba'o/ /rgyu kun 'byung bas ༅sdug bsngal kun 'byung zhing rgyu 'gags pas sdug bsngal 'gag steni/rgyun bcad pas mi 'byung zhing nying mtshams sbyor ba med par 'gags pa 'di nyid ni sdug bsngal gyi mtha' yin no/ /dge slong dag de la yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa gang zhe na/ gzhan med kyi sdug bsngal 'gags pa gang yin pa de ni nye bar zhi ba/ de ni bsil bar gyur pa de ni nub pa ste/ dge slong dag zhi ba'i gnas 'di yin te/ 'di lta ste phung po thams cad spangs pa/ sred pa 4—177

zad pa/ 'dod chags dang bral ba/ 'gags pa/ mya ngan las 'das pa yin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis ①yang ②ma ga ṅgā'i rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying po la lan gnyis su bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po chen po ji snyam du sems / gzugs rtag gam mi rtag /btsurno pa 'di mi rtag lags so/ /mi rtag pa gang yin pa de sdug bsngal ②yin nam/ sdug bsngal ma yin/ btsun pa 'di ni sdug bsngal lags so/ /mi rtag pa ④sdug bsngal ba ⑤'gyur ba'i chos can gang yin pa de la ci ga 'phags pa nyan thos thos pa dang ldan pa 'di ni bdag yin no/ /bdag ni 'di ⑥yin no/ /'di ni bdag gi bdag go zhes bdag tu khas len par byed dam/ btsun pa ma lags so/ /rgyal po chen po ji snyam du sems/ tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa rtag gam mi rtag /btsun pa 'di ni mi rtag ⑦lags so/ /mi rtag pa gang yin pa de sdug bsngal yin nam/ sdug bsngal ma yin/ btsun pa 'di ni sdug bsngal lags so/ /mi rtag pa sdug bsngal ba 'gyur ba'i chos can gang yin pa de la ci ga 'phags pa 2nyan thos thos pa dang ldan pa 'di ni bdag yin no//bdag ni 'di yin no/ /'di ni bdag gi bdag go zhes bdag tu khas len par byed dam/ btsun pa ma lags so/ /rgyal po chen po de lta bas na khyod kyis gzugs gang yin pa ci yang rung / 'das pa'am/ ma 'ongs pa'am da ltar byung ba'am/ nang gi'am/ phyi'i 'am/ rags pa'am/ phra ba'am/ngan pa'am/ gya nom pa'am/ gang dag thag ring ba'am/ gang dag thag nye ba ⑨yang rung ste/ de thams cad la 'di ni bdag ma yin no/ /bdag ni 'di ma yin no/ /'di ni bdag gi bdag ma yin no zhes de bzhin du yang dag pa'i 1—178

shes rab kyis ji lta ba bzhin du blta bar bya'o/ /rgyal po chen po de lta bas na khyod kyis tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed ①dang / rnam par shes pa gang ci yang rung ②/ 'das pa'am/ ma 'ongs pa'am/ da ltar byung ba'amathu/nang gi'am/ phyi'i 'am/ rags pa'am/ phra ba'am/ ngan ④pa'am/ gya rnam pa'am/ gang dag thag ring ba'am/ gang dag thag nye ba ⑤yang rung ste/de dag thams cad la 'di 6ni bdag ma yin no/ /bdag ni 'di ma yin no/ /'di ni bdag gi bdag ma yin no zhes de bzhin du yang dag pa'i shes rab kyis ji lta ba bzhin du blta bar bya'o/ /rgyal po chen po 'phags pa nyan thos thos pa dang ldan pa de ltar mthong ba ni gzugs la yang yid 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa la yang yid 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /yid byung na 'dod chags dang 'bral rtsolo/ /'dod chags dang bral na rnam par grol bar 'gyur ro/ / rnam par grol na ghubadag gi skye ba zad do/ /tshangs par spyod pa bsten to/ /bya ba byas so/ /srid pa 'di las gzhan mi shes so zhes rnam par grol ba'i ye shes mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bshad pa na ma ga ṅgā'i rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying po dang / lha brgyad tsakhri dang / ma ga d+ma'i bram ze dang / khyim bdag 'bum phrag du ma la chos rnams la chos kyi mig rdul med cing dri ma dang bral ba skyes so/ /de nas ma ga d+ma'i rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying pos chos mthong ba dang / chos thob pa dang / chos rig pa dang /chos kyi gting slebs 0pa dang / som nyi las rgal ba dang / the tshom las rgal ba dang / gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog pa dang / gzhan gyis tho)mi bkri ba dang /1—179

ston pas bstan pa'i chos rnams la mi 'jigs pa thob nas stan las langs te bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ①ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bdag ni 'phags so/ /mngon par 'phags so/ /bdag btsun pa bcom ldan 'das dang / chos dang / dge slong gi dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi lags kyis/ dge bsnyen du gzung ②du gsol/ deng slan chad ji srid 'tsho'i bar du srog dang yang bsdos te skyabs su mchi bar mngon par dad lags sol/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag bcom ldan 'das dang / chos dang /③dge slong gi dge 'dun du bcas pa la ji srid 'tsho'i bar du na bza' chos gos dang / bsod snyoms dang / gzims ⑤cha dang / snyun dpyad kyi rkyen sman gyi yo byad rnams kyis bsnyen bkur bgyid lags na/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab tu gshegs su gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ma ga d+ma'i rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying po la cang mi gsung bas gnang ngo / /de nas ma ga d+ma'i rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying pos bcom ldan 'das cang mi gsung bas gnang bar rig nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga nas song ngo / /dge slong rnams the tshom skyes nas the tshom thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa ma ga d+ma'i rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying po 'khor dang bcas pas las ci zhig bgyis na/ las de'i rnam par smin pas bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar bden pa mthong bar bgyis ⑤lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag rgyal po gzugs can snying po 'khor 4—180

dang bcas pas las tshogs rnyed pa/ rkyen yongs su bsgyur ba/ 'od pa bzhin du nye bar gnas pa/ gdon mi za bar 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i las dag byas shing bsags pa ni rgyal po gzugs can snying po 'khor dang bcas pas las byas shing bsags pa dag gzhan su zhig gis so sor myong bar 'gyur/ dge slong dag las byas shing bsags pa dag ni ①phyi rol gyi sa'i khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur/ chu'i khams la mi 'gyur/ me'i khams la mi 'gyur/rlung gi khams la mi 'gyur gyi/ 'di ltar las dge ba dang mi dge ba dag byas shing bsags pa dag ni zin pa'i phung po dang / khams dang / skye mched rnams la rnam par smin par 'gyur te/ las rnams bskal pa brgyar yang ni/ /chud mi za ba'ang tshogs dang dus/ /rnyed na lus can rnams la ni/ /'bras bu dag tu 'gyur ba nyid/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa na 'jig rten du ston pa rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa bde bar ②gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ②ba bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rtsibs kyi lte ba zhes bya ba byung ④nas des sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mtha' dag mdzad de/ phung po lhag ma med pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su yongs su mya ngan las 'das so/ /skye bo'i tshogs chen pos de'i sku gdung la sku gdung gi mchod pa byas nas sa phyogs dben zhing yangs pa zhig tu mchod rten chen po brtsigs so/ /de'i tshe 'khor los sgyur ⑤ba'i rgyal po kṛ tī ⑥zhes bya ba khrom gyi ru pa bye ba phrag bcwa brgyad dang steng gi nam mkha' las yul rgyu ba na mchod rten de dang nye ba zhig tu phyin pa dang / sangs rgyas la mngon par dad pa'i lha rnams kyis de'i 'khor lo rin po che thogs par 1—181

byas so/ /rgyal po kṛ kris bsams pa/ 'di ltar 'khor lo rin po che 'di thogs pa las na ①bdag gi bsod nams zad par ma gyur grang snyam mo/ /de la lha rnams kyis smras pa/ rgyal po 0khyod kyi ③bsod nams ma zad mod kyi phyogs 'di na ④yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rtsibs kyi lte ba'i mchod rten bzhugs pas/ des na 'khor lo rin po che 'di de'i steng du mi 'gro zhing thogs par gyur to/ /de nas rgyal po kṛ tī ①khrom gyi ru pa bye ba phrag bcwa ⑥brgyad dang lhan cig babs na ji tsam na mchod rten byi dor ma byas pa de mthong nas 'khor dang bcas pa des byi dor byas te dri dang / byug pa dang / bdug pa dang / phye ma dang / rol mo rnams kyis mchod pa byas nas 'khor dang bcas pas drung du btud de smon lam btab pa⑦/ bdag gis yon gnas dam pa 'di lta bu la bya ba byas pa gang yin pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis bdag gis yon tan 'di lta bu dag thob dupar 'gyur ba dang / ston pa 'di lta bu mnyes par byed cing mi khyamanyes par mi byed par ⑪ gyur cig ces btab bo/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus kyi 'khor los sgyur yiba'i rgyal po kṛ gī zhes bya ba 'khor dang bcas pa gang yin pa de ni de'i tshe de'i dus na rgyal po gzugs can snying po 'di nyid yin te/ 'khor dang bcas pa des yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rtsibs kyi lte ba'i mchod rten la mchod pa byas pa gang yin pa de'i las kyi rnam par smin 8pas 'dis bskal pa bye ba brgya stong phrag ⑫mang por lha dang mi rnams kyi bde ba khyad par du 'phags pa nyams su myong bar gyur to/ /'di lta bu'i yon tan dag thob par gyur cig ces smon lam btab pa gang yin pa des ni nga'i spyan sngar 'khor dang bcas pa bden pa mthong bar byas 4—182

sol/ /ston pa 'di lta bu mnyes par byed cing mi mnyes par mi byed par gyur cig ces smon lam btab pa gang yin pas ni ①nga nyid dang yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rtsibs kyi lte bar lhan cig mnyam par ②mnyam ste/ stobs mnyam pa dang / shugs mnyam pa dang brtson 'grus mnyam pa dang / thob pa mnyam pa yin te/ 'dis ston par ③mnyes par byas kyi/ mi mnyes ④par ma byas pa yin no/ /dge slong dag de lta bas na las gcig ⑤tu gnag pa rnams kyi ni ༅rnam par smin pa ni gcig tu gnag pa yin la/ gcig tu dkar ba rnams kyi ni dkar ba yin/ 'dren ⑦ma rnams dukyi ni 'dren ⑨ma yin no/ /dge slong dag de lta bas na las gcig ༅tu gnag pa dang / 'dren yim rnams ni spangs la/ las gcig tu dkar ba la brtsal 8bar bya ste/ dge slong dag khyed kyis de lta bu la bslab par bya'o/ /dge slong rnams the tshom ⑩skyes nas the tshom ④thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa tshe dang ldan pa lteng rgyas 'od srung gis las ci zhig bgyis na/ des na cho 'phrul lnga brgyas btul bar gyur lags/ chu klung 'od srung dang / ga yā bya'od srung dag ni tshegs chung spre'udus btul bar gyur lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag 'di dag tho)nyid kyis las tshogs rnyed pa(spre/rkyen yongs su bsgyur chab zhes bya ba nas/ lus can dag la 'bras bur 'gyur zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba bskal pa bzang po 'di nyid la skye dgu'i tshe lo nyi khri thub pa na 'jig rten du ston pa de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes ⑥1—183

bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ①ba bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'od sung zhes bya ba byung nas/ de la'i rā ṇa sī'i grong khyer dang nye ba zhig tu brten te drang srong smra ba ②ri dgas kyi nags ④na bzhugs so/ /des sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mtha' dag mdzad nas/ shing zad pa'i me bzhin du phung po'i lhag ma med pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su ⑤yongs su mya ngan las 'das so/ /de'i sku gdung ⑥rgyal po kṛ khris spos kyi shing thams cad spungs te ⑦spungs pas bsregs ⑧nas me 'o ⑨mas bsad de/sku ⑩ gdung de dag ni 7rin po che sna bzhi las byas 8pa'i bum pa'i nang du blugs nas sa phyogs dben zhing yangs par sku gdung gi mchod rten 'phang du dpag tshad gcig la rgyar dpag tshad phyed pa zhig rtsig 8tu bcug go/ /de'i tshe bahā rā ṇa sī na khyim bdag phyug pa nor mang ba/ longs spyod che ba/ yongs su gzung 8ba yangs shing rgya che ba/ rnam thos kyi bu'i nor dang ldan pa/ rnam thos kyi bu la nor gyis 'gran pa zhig gnas pa des rigs mnyam pa las chung ma blangs te/ de de dang lhan cig rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed do/ /de rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed pa na rim gyis khye'u gsum btsas so/ /ji tsam na khyim bdag de nad kyis thebs nas de rtsa ba dang / sdong bu ⑩dang / lo ma dang /'dab ⑩ma dang / 'bras bu'i sman rnams kyis bsnyen bkur byas kyang de'i nad zhi bar ma gyur nas de 'chi ba'i chos dang ldan par gyur to/ /de nas de'i tsobu rnams kyis ras sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / dkar pos khyogs brgyan nas dur khrod du khyer te bsregs so/ /de nas pha la pha'i bya ba 1—184

byas nas mya ngan sangs te/ ①rnar so sor ②bgo bar gros bya bar brtsams nas phu bo shos kyis smras pa/ nor bgo'o②/ /nu bo spun gnyis ma dad do/ /des gal gyis gcus ④pa dang de gnyis kyis smras ⑤pa/ gal te de lta yin re zhig 'jig rten pha rol gyi lam rgyags 0blangs la phyis bgo bar bya'o/ /des smras pa/ci dag bya⑤/ de gnyis kyis ⑨smras pa/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung 'di la mchod do/ /de dad pa chung ba zhig pas des bka' ⑩'khor du khas blangs so/ /de nas de rnams kyis yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung la mchod nas smon lam gdab par brtsams te/ gnyis kyis 'di skad ces smras so/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis bdag cag gnyis yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'od srung gis bram ze'i khye'u bla ma zhes bya ba la bram ze'i khye'u khyod skye dgu rnams kyi tshe lo brgya thub pa na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa zhes bya bar 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan pa gang yin pa de'i bstan pa la bdag cag rab tu byung nas khyad par thob par gyur cig ces btab bo/ /de gnyis kyis smon lam btab pa phu bo des thos nas drung du btud de/ smon lam gdab par brtsams pa / bdag ni dad pa chung la dmu rgod yin pas dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis na bdag kyang bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa des cho 'phrul lnga brgyas btul nas rab tu phyung ste/ rab tu byung nas kyang ⑩khyad par rtogs par gyur cig ces byas so/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ phu bo shos dmu rgod dad pa chung ba gang yin pa de ni lteng rgyas 'od srung 'di nyid yin no/ /nu bo gnyis po gang dag yin pa de dag ni chu klung 'od sung dang / ga yā tso'od srung 'di dag nyid 4—185

yin no/ /smon lam gyi dbang des na lteng rgyas 'od srung cho 'phrul lnga brgyas btul ba yin no/ /chu klung 'od srung dang / ga yā cha'od srung ni tshegs chung ②ngus btul ba yin no/ /gang gi tshe rgyal po gzugs can snying po gzhon nur gyur pa de'i tshe rgyal po'i khab na khyim bdag cig yod pa de la kun dga'i ra ba me tog dang / 'bras bu dang / chu phun sum tshogs pa zhig yod ②de/ de de la lhag par chags par gyur to④/ /ji tsam na gzugs can snying po phyi rol du byung bas skyed mos tshal de mthong ba dang / de yang lhag par chags par gyur nas smras pa / khyim bdag skyed ⑤mos tshal 'di ⑥nga la byin cig /des ma byin no/ /lan gnyis lan gsum du yang smras na yang ma byin nas/ yang smras pa/ rin sbyin no/ /des smras pa/ gzhon ⑦nu nyis dun kho bo yul nas spyugs kyang bla'i skyed mos tshal ni mi 'bul lo/ /gzhon nu gzugs can snying pos smras pa/khyim bdag khyod kyis smras pa dran par byos shig / nga nam 0rgyal por gyur pa de'i tshe nga nyid kyis bkur ro/ /des smras pa/ nam khyod rgyal por gyur pa de'i tshe kho bo yang rgyal po'i khab tu ⑩'gro'o/ /gzhon nu gzugs can snying pos mjal yito zhes byas nas song ngo / /ji tsam dus tsogazhan zhig na rgyal po pad ma chen po shi nas/ gzhon nu gzugs can snying po rgyal srid la bzhag pa dang /des skyed mos 'tshal de mthus phrogs so/ /khyim bdag de snying na zhing skyed mos tshal de la lhag par chags pas shi nas de nyid (9sbrul gdug pa zhig tu skyes te/de rgyal po la rgyun du glags tshol ba lhur len ④cing gnas so/ /ji tsam na rgyal po gzugs can snying po so ga'i dus la bab ste/ me tog gi shing rnams kha 'bus pa na btsun mo dang lhan cig skyed mos tshal der zhugs nas de de na skyes pa med 1—186

par rol mos btsun mo'i bud med dang lhan cig dga' ba'i rtsed mo nyams su myong bar byas nas gnyid log go/ /bud med ni me tog dang 'bras bu la dga' ba yin pas kun du 'khyam du dong ngo / /bud med gcig gis ral gri ①bskur te rgyal po srung du bcug go/ /de nas sbrul gdug pa des rgyal po'i drung na sgra mi grag par rig nas rgyal po la gzung ba'i phyir tshang nas byung ste chas so/ /rgyal po'i bsod nams kyi mthus bya ka lan da ②ka zhes bya ba de rnams kyis sbrul gdug pa ②de kun nas bskor nas tsi ci'i ④sgra phyung ngo / /bud med ral gri thogs pas thos nas dngangs zhute sgra chen po byung yonas ral gris thobasad do/ /de nas rgyal po yang dngangs dute sad nas smras pa/ 'di ci byung / bud med des smras spupa/ lha sbrul gdug pa 'di lha la gzung skyoba'i phyir chas pa na bya ka lan da ka rnams kyis tsi skyeci'i sgra phyung nas bdag gis bkum lags so/ /rgyal po'i gnas skabs de gzhon nu dang / blon po dang / khrom gyi ru pa dang / rgyal po'i khab na gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs rnams kyis thos nas skyed mos tshal de'i phyi kyenang du ku co'i sgra chen pos gang bar gyur te/ rgyal po de skye dgu la byams pa zhig pas phyir zhing btsun mo skye bo'i tshogs dang bcas te mig mchi mas gang zhing 'khod do/ /de nas rgyal pos smras pa/ shes ldan dag rgyal po rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba la srog skyob pa de la mchog ci zhig 8phyin/ skye bo'i tshogs kyis smras pa/ lha rgyal srid kyi ⑨ phyed do/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ shes ldan dag bya ka lan da ka rnams kyis nga'i srog byin pas rgyal srid phyed 'di dag la sbyin 8no/ /blon po rnams kyis smras pa/ lha bya 'di dag ni dud 'gro'i skye gnas su song ba lags pas rgyal srid phyed kyis tso'adi dag la ci bgyi/ 'di 4—187

dag 'od ma'i tshal gang du gnas pa der 'di dag gi gnas bca'o/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ de bzhin du gyis shig /skyed mos tshal de 'od ma'i tshal gyis yongs su bskor te/ blon po rnams kyis de rnams kyi ciganas 'od ma'i tshal gyi nye 'khor du bcas pas/ de 'od ma'i tshal bya ka lan da ka gnas pa zhes bya bar gyur to/ /rgyal po gzugs can snying po'i zhang po kun du 'tsho rnams kyi nang du rab tu byung nas des skyed mos tshal de de'i gnas kyi phyir byin no//ji tsam na bcom ldan 'das ma ga dhā nas ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs pa dang rgyal po'i khab tu byon nas shing zhig gi drung na bzhugs so/ /ma ga ṅgā'i rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying pos sebacom ldan 'das ma ga dhā nas ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs pa na rgyal po'i khab tu byon nas shing zhig gi drung du bzhugs so zhes thos so/ /thos nas kyang rgyal po'i 'byor pa chen po dang rgyal po'i mthu chen pos rgyal po'i khab thunas byung ste/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi 'izhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te phyogs gcig 3tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig 4tu 'dug pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis ma ga ṅgā'i rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying po la chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par ston par zumadzad/ yang dag dupar 'dzin du 'jug par mdzad/ yang dag par gzengs stod khyapar mdzad/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad de rnam grangs du mar chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par bstan/ yang dag par 'dzin du bcug /yang dag par gzengs ⑨ bstod7/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar 8mdzad nas cang mi gsung ngo / /de nas ma ga d+ma'i rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying po stan 4wa 188

las langs te bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ①ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to / /bcom ldan 'das sang bdag gi sdum par dge slong gi dge 'dun dang thabs cig ②tu gdugs tshod sbyor zhing mchis na/ gnang bar mdzad du gsol/bcom ldan 'das kyis ma ga ṅgā'i rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying po la cang mi gsung bas gnang ngo / /de nas ma ga d+ma'i rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying pos bcom ldan 'das cang mi gsung bas gnang bar rig nas/bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas nas stan las langs te song ngo / /de nas ma ga ṅgā'i rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying pos de nyid kyi mtshan mo nas gtsang zhing bsod pa'i bza' ba dang bca' ba dag sta gon byas nas nang par sngar langs te/ gdan bshams nor bu'i chu snod bzhag nas bcom ldan 'das la spyan 'dren gyi ⑧dus tshod gsol pa/ btsun pa gdugs tshod lags na da de'i dus la bab par dgongs su gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das snga dro na bza' sham thabs mnabs/ lhung bzed dang chos gos bsnams te / dge slong gi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor cing dge slong gi dge 'dun gyis ④mdun du bdar ⑤te/ ma ga ṅgā'i rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying po'i bkad sa gang na ba der gshegs te byon nas dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi gung la gdan bshams pa nyid la bzhugs so/ /de nas ma ga ṅgā'i rgyal po bzo sbyangs dugazugs can snying pos sangs rgyas la ⑦sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun bde bar bzhugs par rig nas gtsang zhing bsod pa'i bza' ba dang bca' ba dag rang gi lag nas stobs shing tshim par byed de rnam dugrangs du mar gtsang 1—189

zhing bsod pa'i bza' ba dang bca' ba dag rang gi lag nas bstabs shing tshim par byas te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ①gsol zin nas phyag bcabs te lhung bzed gyu bar rig nas/ gser gyi bya ma bum blangs te btsun pa 'od ma'i tshal bya ka lan da ka gnas pa 'dir bcom ldan 'das ci bder ②bzhugs shig ces bcom ldan 'das la skyed mos tshal de phul lo/ /de bzhin du gnas brtan rnams kyis kyang mdo sde rnams kyi nang du bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab 'od ma'i tshal bya ka lan da ka gnas pa snun bzhugs so zhes gdags ④par byas so//de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab 'od ma'i tshal bya ka lan da ga'i gnas na bzhugs so/ /rgyal po'i khab na khyim bdag cig gnas pa des bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun dang thabs cig ⑧ku rang gi khyim du spyan drangs so/ /yang de'i tshe khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis skyodagos pa 'ga' zhig gi ༅phyir rgyal po'i khab tu phyin nas de khyim bdag de'i khyim du nub mo 'brang rgyabatab bo/ /de nas khyim bdag de de nyid kyi mtshan mo langs te nang mi rnams la bsgo ba/ nang rje dag longs shig /bzhin bzang dag longs shigazu/shing rnams gshegs sku shig /me dag bus shig /'bras chan mtshos shig /sran tshod tshos shig /bca' ba dag bzang du gyis shig / bkad sa'i 8zhal ta dag gyis shig /de nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin 'di snyam du sems te / ci khyim bdag 'di bag ma len tam/ bag ma gtong ngam/ yul mi'am / tshong pa'am/ tshogs sam/ 'khor tam/ 'dis ma ga d+ma'i rgyal po bzo tu)sbyangs gzugs tustecan snying po sang khyim du gdugs tshod la spyan thostedrangs sam snyam du bsams nas khyim bdag de la 'di skad ces smras so/ /khyim 4—190

bdag khyod ci bag ma len tam/ bag ma gtong ngam/ yul mi'am/ tshong pa'am / tshogs sam/ 'khor tam/ khyod kyis ①ma ga ṅgā'i rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying po sang khyim du gdugs tshod la spyan drangs sam/ khyim bdag kho bo bag ma len pa'amacha/ bag ma gtong ba yang med yul mi ①ma yin/④tshong pa ma yin/ tshogs ⑤ma yin/ 'khor ma yin/ ma ga d+ma'i rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying po yang gdugs tshod la spyan drangs pa ma yin te/'on kyang kho bos sangs rgyas la ⑥sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun gdugs tshod la spyan drangs so/ /khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis sangs rgyas zhes ④bya ba'i sgra sngon dum thos pa thos pa dang ba spu'i khung bu thams cad nas spu zing zhes byed nas ⑨de spu zing zhes byed pas khyim bdag de la 'di skad ces smras so/ /khyim bdag sangs rgyas zhes bya ba 'di ⑩ su yin/ khyim bdag dge sbyong go ta ma shākya'i sras shākya'i rigs las skra dang kha spu bregs te gos ngur smrig bgos nas dad pa yang dag pa kho nas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung nas de bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa zhig yod de/ khyim bdag de ni sangs rgyas zhes bya'o/ /khyim bdag dge 'dun zhes bya ba 'di su yin/ khyim bdag rgyal rigs las kyang rigs kyi bu skra dang kha spu bregs te gos ngur smrig bgos nas dad pa yang dag pa ༅kho nas khyim nas khyim med par bcom ldan 'das de kho na rab tu byung ba'i 8rjes su rab tu byung ba dag yod④ / bram ze'i rigs dang rje'u rigs dang / dmangs ④rigs las kyang rigs kyi bu dag skra dang kha spu bregs te gos ngur smrig bgos nas dad pa yang dag pa kho nas khyim nas khyim med par bcom ldan 'das de kho na rab tu byung 4—191

ba'i rjes su rab tu byung ba dag yod de/ khyim bdag de ni dge 'dun zhes bya ba yin te sang kho bo'i khyim du sangs rgyas la ①sogs pa ②dge slong gi dge 'dun de rnams dugadugs tshod la spyan drangs so/ /khyim bdag bcom ldan 'das de da ④ltar gang na bzhugs/ rgyal po'i khab 'di nyid kyi dur khrod ⑤bsil ba'i tshal na bzhugs so/ /khyim bdag bcom ldan 'das de bdag cag gis bltar ⑥rung ngam/ khyim bdag de'i phyir ༅re zhig sdod cig dang / gal te bcom ldan 'das 'di nyid du gshegs pa dudang sang khyod kyi ⑨mthong bar 'gyur ba'i gnas gang yin pa de yod do/ /de nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin 0 sangs rgyas la dmigs pa'i dran pas nyal lo/ /de nam skyem nangs 8par nam nangs nyunyepa'i 'du shes kyis lho sgo gang na ba der song ba dang / de'i tshe lho sgo thun gnyis la sgo phye nas 'jog ste/ thun dang po la ni pho nya glo bur du 'ongs pa rnams mi thogs par 6bya ba'i phyir phye ste 'jog go/ /thun tha ma la ni pho nya 'gro bar chas pa rnams mi thogs par bya ba'i phyir phye ste 'jog go/ /de nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin thonye'adi snyam du sems te/ 'di ltar lho sgo phye ste 'dug pas gdon mi za bar nam nangs skyeso snyam skyedu rig nas snang ba de nyid du grong khyer nas byung ba dang / de byung ma thag tu snang ba gang yin pa 8med nas slar mun nag por gyur to/ /de 'jigs par gyur/ bag tsha bar gyur cing ⑩/spu zing zhes byed par gyur nas bdag mi'am/ mi ma yin pa'am/ g.yon can 'ga' zhig gis gtses par mi 'gyur grang snyam du bsams nas slar ldog par 'dod pa dang / de nas lho phyogs kyi sgo na gnas pa'i lha gang yin pa des ci tsam lho phyogs kyi sgo nas bsil ba'i tshal gyi 0dur khrod kyi bar thams cad snang 4—192

ba rgya ①chen pos gsal bar byas nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin la 'di skad ces smras so/ /khyim bdag spyan ②sngar song shigal /slar ma ldog shig④/khyod spyan sngar song na legs par 'gyur gyi slar log ⑤na ni ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rta brgya dang ni gser rgyan ⑥brgya/ / dre 'u'i ④shing rta brgya dang ni/ /sna tshogs nor gyis spud pa ni⑤/ /rta rgod ma yi shing rta brgya/ /gom pa gcig cig ⑨bor ba yi/ /bcu drug char yang mi phod do/ /khyim bdag spyan sngar song shig⑩ /slar ma ldog shigayi /khyod spyan sngar song na legs par 'gyur gyi slar log na ni ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ gangs can ri yi glang chen brgya/ /gser dang nor bus brgyan byas la/ /lus che gshol mda'i mche bar ldan/ /ma tang gar 8skyes stod po che/ /gom pa gcig cig tsobor ba yi / /bcu drug char yang mi phod do/ /khyim bdag spyan sngar song shigaci /slar ma ldog shigatso /khyod spyan sngar song na legs par 'gyur gyi/ slar log na ni ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ tho gar yul gyi bu mo brgya/ /⑩rna cha dang ni cigadub kor thogs/ /gser gyi dpung rgyan thogs pa yi/ /mgrin pa rgyan gyis legs brgyan pa/ /gom pa gcig cig bor ba yi/ /bcu drug char yang mi phod do/ /khyim bdag spyan sngar song shigatso /slar ma ldog shigatso /khyod spyan sngar song na legs par 'gyur gyi slar log na ni ma yin no/ /de nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin du gyis lha'i bu de la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bzhin bzangs 0khyod su zhig /khyim bdag kho bo ni khyod nyid kyi grogs po rnying ⑤pa bram ze'i khye'u sprang rtsi'i phung po yin te/ kho bos dge slong shā ri'i bu dang / mod gal ⑤gyi bu gnyis la sems dad pa bskyed nas shi ba dang / rgyal chen 1—193

bzhi'i ris kyi lha rnams su skyes te lho sgo 'di nyid la ①gnyug mar gnas so/ /de'i phyir khyod la kho bos ⑧'di skad ces khyim bdag spyan sngar song shig② /slar ma ldog shig④ /khyod spyan sngar song na legs par 'gyur gyi/ slar log na ni ma yin no zhes smra'o/ /de nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin 'di snyam du sems te/ kye ma'o sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ni mchog ma yin pa ma yin zhing chos bshad pa yang mchog ma yin pa ma yin te/ da ⑤ltar bcom ldan 'das de la blta bar lha yang brtson par byed do snyam du bsams nas/ bsil ba'i tshal gyi dur khrod du song ba dang / de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das gtsug ⑥lag khang gi phyi rol bla gab med pa na ⑦'chag cing lhag par yang khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin 'ong ba ②la gzhes so/ /de nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das la khyim bdag ④gis ⑩ yang dag par dgyes par 'gyur bas yang dag par dgyes par byed do / /skyebacom ldan 'das ci ga bde bar mnal tam/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad de bka' stsal pa/ gang zhig 'dod pas ma gos la/ /zag med rab tu rnam grol ba/ /mya ngan yongs 'das bram ze ni/ /thams cad du ni bde bar mnal/ /'dir ni re ba kun bcad tsonas/ /thugs kyi rims nad rnams bsal cing / /zhi ba thob pa'i thugs kyis na/ /nye bar zhi ba bde bar mnal/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin khrid nas gtsug lag khang du zhugs te gdan bshams pa nyid la bzhugs pa dang / khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis bcom ldan 'das kyi 8zhabs gnyis ④la mgo bos phyag byas te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /1—194

phyogs gcig tu 'dug pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin la chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par bstan/ yang dag par 'dzin du bcug /yang dag par gzengs ①bstod/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad de/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi thog ma'i dus su chos kyi gtam gleng ba gang yin pa ②'di lta ste sbyin pa'i gtam dang / tshul khrims kyi gtam dang / mtho ris kyi gtam dang / 'dod pa rnams chamanog chung ba dang / nyes dmigs dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa dang / rnam par byang ba dang / nges par 'byung ba dang / rab tu dben pa'i phan yon gyi rjes su bsngags pa dang / rnam par byang ba'i 0phyogs dang mthun pa'i chos kyi gtam rgyas par yang dag par bstan to/ /gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis de dga' ba'i sems dang / dge ba'i sems dang / mgu ba'i sems dang /sgrib pa dang bral ba'i sems dang / skal ba dang ldan zhing ⑤yang dag phul gyi chos bshad pa kun shes par nus par gzigs pa de'i tshe/ sangs rgyas ⑥bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi yang dag phul gyi ༅chos bshad pa 'phags pa'i bden pa ⑤bzhi po gang yin pa 'di lta ste/ sdug bsngal dang / kun 'byung ⑨dang /'gog pa dang / lam rgyas par rab tu bstan to/ /dper na gos gtsang ma nag nog ⑩ med pa tshon rtsi 'os pa'i nang du bcug yin tshon rtsi legs par 'jen du tsobatub pa de bzhin du khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin stan de nyid la 'dug bzhin du 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi po 'di lta ste/ sdug bsngal dang / kun 'byung tsodang / 'gog pa dang / lam mngon par rtogs so/ /khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis chos mthong ba dang / chos thob pa dang / chos rig 4—195

pa dang / chos kyi gting slebs pa dang / som nyi las rgal ba dang / the tshom las rgal ba dang / gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog pa dang / gzhan gyis mi bkri ba dang / ston pas bstan pa'i chos rnams la mi 'jigs pa thob nas stan las langs te bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba de ②logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bdag ni 'phags so/ /mngon par 'phags so/ /bdag bcom ldan 'das dang / chos dang / dge slong gi dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi lags kyis bdag dge bsnyen du gzung du gsol/ deng slan chad ji srid 'tsho'i bar du srog dang bsdos te skyabs su mchi bar mngon par dad lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /khyim bdag khyod kyi ming cil/ btsun pa bdag gi ming bzang sbyin lags mod kyi bdag gis zhumagon ma mchis pa rnams la 'tshal ④ma stsol ⑤bas des na bdag mgon med zas sbyin zhes bgyi bar skye bos 'tshal to/ /khyim bdag khyod kyi gnas gang yin/ btsun pa yul pra tsi na zhes bgyi ba na ko sa la pa 0rnams kyi grong rdal ⑦mnyan yod ces bgyi ba mchis te/de na bdag mchis lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod du gshegs shig dang / bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun dang thabs cig ⑧la bdag ji srid 'tsho'i bar du na bza' chos gos dang / bsod snyoms ⑨dang /gzims cha dang / snyan dpyad kyi rkyen sman dang / yo byad rnams kyis bsnyen bkur ⑨ bgyi lags so/ /khyim bdag mnyan yod na gtsug lag khang yod dam/btsun pa ma mchis lags so/ /khyim bdag gang na gtsug lag khang yod pa der 4—196

dge slong rnams 'ong ba dang / 'gro ba dang gnas par sems so bcom ldan 'das gshegs shig dang / bdag gis ci nas kyang mnyan yod du dge slong rnams mchis pa dang / gzhan du mchi ba dang / mchi bar sems par 'gyur ba de ltar gtsug lag khang brtsig ①lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin la cang mi gsung bas gnang ngo / /de nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis bcom ldan 'das kyis ②cang mi gsung bas gnang bar rig nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis ③la mgo bos phyag byas te bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga nas song ngo / /des ④rgyal po'i khab tu bya ba dang ⑤bsgrub pa gang yin pa de ⑥thams cad byas shing bsgrubs ⑦nas bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gi grogs dge slong blugacig ⑨stsal du gsol/ de dang lhan cig bcom ldan 'das kyi slad du gtsug lag khang brtsig 0lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa/ dge slong su zhig gis yikhyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin 'khor dang bcas pa dang / mnyan yod na gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs 'dul bar 'gyur snyam na dge slong shā ri'i bus 'dul bar gzigs nas/de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu la bka' stsal pa/ shā ri'i bu khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin 'khor dang bcas pa dang / mnyan yod na gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs la soms shig /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu cang mi smra bas ⑤bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' mnyan totsa/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa shā 4—197

ri'i bus ①bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga nas song ngo / /③tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus ③de nyid kyi mtshan mo 'das nas snga dro sham thabs bgos lhung bzed dang chos gos thogs te/rgyal po'i khab tu bsod snyoms la zhugs nas rgyal po'i khab tu bsod snyoms spyad de zas kyi bya ba byas nas zas phyi ma'i bsod snyoms spangs te/ gnas mal ji ltar spyad pa mkhos su phab nas de lhung bzed dang chos gos blangs te mnyan yod gang na ba der rgyu zhing song ngo / /de nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin lam rgyags ④mang po khyer nas nub mo nub mo ⑤zhing mnyan yod du song ste phyin nas de mnyan yod du ma zhugs pa nyid du kun dga' ra ba nas kun dga' ra ba dang /skyed mos tshal nas skyed mos tshal dang / nags tshal nas nags tshal du 'chags nas ⑥'chag sar ⑦dpyod cing 'di skad ces smras so/ /mnyan yod dang ha cang yang mi ring la ha cang yang mi nye ba dang nyin par lang long nyung zhing ku co ⑧nyung ba dang / mtshan mo gcom chung ba dang / sgra chung ba dang / sbrang bu dang / sha sbrang dang / rlung dang nyi ma dang / sdig sbrul gyi reg pa chung ba'i sa phyogs gang na yod pa der bdag gis bcom ldan 'das kyi phyir gtsug lag khang brtsig blun n+tu phyogs de gang na yod snyam pa las/ khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis gzhon nu rgyal byed kyi kun dga' ra ba ni mnyan yod dang ha cang yang 7mi ring la ha cang yang mi nye ba dang / nyin par tshulang long nyung zhing ku co 8nyung ba dang / mtshan mo gcom chung ba dang / sgra chung ba dang / sbrang bu dang / sha yisbrang dang / rlung dang / nyi ma dang / sdig sbrul gyi reg pa nyung bar mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang 'di snyam du sems te/ 'dir bdag 4—198

gis bcom ldan 'das kyi phyir gtsug lag khang brtsig go snyam nas/ de rang gi khyim du ma song ba nyid du gzhon nu rgyal byed gang na ba der song ste phyin nas gzhon nu rgyal byed la 'di skad ces smras so/ /gzhon nu kun dga' ra ba bdag la stsol cig der bdag gis bcom ldan 'das kyi ①phyir gtsug lag khang brtsig lags so/ /des smras pa/ khyim bdag de ni nga'i kun dga' ra ba ni ma yin te / skyed mos tshal yin mod kyi de nga'i yin no/ /khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis lan gnyis lan gsum du yang gzhon nu rgyal byed la 'di skad ces smras so/ /gzhon nu bdag la kun dga' ra ba na ②stsol cig /bdag gis der ①bcom ldan 'das kyi phyir gtsug lag khang brtsig lags so/ /khyim bdag kun dga' ra ba de gser bye ba gshibs ④kyang nga ⑤mi gtod do0// //'dul ba gzhi/ bam po dgu bcu pa/ yang khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis gzhon nu rgyal byed la 'di skad ces smras so/ /gzhon nus kun dga' ra ba'i rin thang bkum lags kyis dbyig dang / gser bzhes shig /kun dga' ra ba ni bdag gi ⑦lags so/ /rin thang sus bcad/ khyod kyis rin thang bkum mod/ de gnyis rin thang bcad do/ /rin thang ma bcad do zhes rtsod ⑧par gyur nas zhal che ⑨gcod pa'i mi gang na ba der dong ba dang /bar skabs der 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi 'di snyam du sems te/ khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin 'di ni ⑨ bcom ldan 'das kyi phyir gtsug lag khang rtsig ⑩par brtson gyis de'i grogs bya'o snyam nas de nas zhal che cigacod pa'i mir bdag nyid mngon par sprul nas dgos pa'i phyir 'dus so/ /khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin dang gzhon nu rgyal byed gnyis zhal che 0gcod pa sna chen po la gtogs 1—199

pa'i drung du song nas/ de nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis zhal che ①gcod pa sna chen po la gtogs pa rnams la don de rgyas par smras pa dang / de rnams kyis smras pa/ gzhon nu ②kun dga' ra ba'i ②rin thang bcad zin gyis gser long shig /kun dga' ra ba ni khyim bdag gi yin no/ /de cang mi smra bar 'dug go④/ /de nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis shing rta dang /rgya dang / gzeb dang / rnga mo dang / glang dang / bong bu rnams la gser mang po bkal te 'ongs ⑤nas rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal thams cad gshib par brtsams pa dang / sa phyogs 'ga' zhig ma yog pas ma bkram pa nyid du 'dug go/ /de nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin don de sems shing yud tsam zhig cang mi smra bar 'dug ste/ gang ⑤gis ma bkram pa'i sa phyogs 'di bkram nas slar yang sba bar bya mi dgos pa'i gter ha cang nyung ngu yang ma yin ha cang ⑦mang po yang ma yin pa de gang yin snyam pa dang / gzhon nu rgyal byed kyis bsams pa/ khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin ni gdon mi za bar ci'i phyir kun dga' ra ba'i ched du nor gyi phung po chen 0po ⑨'di snyed yongs ⑨ su btang zhes 'gyod pa skyes so snyam du bsams nas yikhyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin la 'di skad ces smras so/ /khyim bdag gal te khyod 'gyod pa 8skyes na gser slar long ⑩shig /kun dga' ra ba ni nga ④nyid kyi yin no/ /gzhon nu bdag ni 'gyod pa ma skyes te 'on kyang don 'di sems shing yud tsam zhig cang mi smra bar 'dug pa ni 8bdag gis ma bkram pa'i sa phyogs 'di bkram tshunas slar yang sba bar bya mi dgos pa'i gter ha cang nyung ba yang ma yin/ ha cang mang po yang ma yin pa de gang ⑦yin snyam mo/ /de nas gzhon nu rgyal byed 'di snyam 4—200

du sems te/ kye ma sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mchog ma yin pa ①ma yin zhing chos bshad pa yang mchog ma yin pa ma yin te②/ de la da ②ltar khyim bdag 'di kun dga' ra ba'i ched du nor gyi phung po 'di snyed yongs su gtong rjongo snyam du bsams nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin la 'di skad ces smras so//khyim bdag ma bkram pa'i sa phyogs kho bo la byin ⑤cig /der kho bos ⑥bcom ldan 'das kyi phyir sgo khang brtsig par bya'o/ /de nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis gzhon nu rgyal bu ⑦rgyal byed la ma bkram pa'i sa phyogs byin nas der gzhon nu rgyal byed kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi phyir sgo khang rtsig btu bcug go//de nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis bcom ldan 'das kyi phyir gtsug lag khang brtsig par brtsams pa dang / mu stegs can zhe snang drag pos kun nas slong ba'i ⑨yid can rnams 'dus nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gang na ba der song ⑩ste lhags pa dang / smras pa/ khyim bdag khyod dge sbyong gi ta ma ni phyir gtsug lag khang ma rtsig shigatso /ci'i phyir kho bo cag gis grong khyer bgos te dge sbyong gi ta ma'i 4)rgyal po'i khab yin no/ / kho bo cag 6)gi ni mnyan yod yin no/ /des smras pa/ khyed cag gis grong khyer rnams bgos kyi / bdag gi nor ma bgos pas gang la mngon par dga' ba de'i chos kyi phung po brtsig go/ /de rnams rgyal po'i drung du dong ba dang / der yang khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis pham par byas pa dang / mu stegs spyi brtol ⑫can mu cor smra ba rnams kyis smras pa/ khyim bdag khyod skedaga' mgur byed du mi gzhug ste/ dge sbyong gau ta ma'i nyan thos kyi mchog cig (9'ongs nas/gal te de'i shags kyis kho bo cag pham par gyur na gtsug lag khang rtsigs ⑩shig/4—201

des smras pa/ rung gis ①re zhig 'phags pa shā ri'i bu la brtag go/ /de nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gang na ba der song ste phyin nas/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu'i rkang pa gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu la 'di skad ces smras so/ /btsun pa shā ri'i bu mu stegs can rnams 'di skad ces khyim bdag khyod dga' mgur byed du mi gzhug stedu/ dge sbyong gi ta ma'i nyan thos kyi mchog 'ongs nas/ gal te de'i shags kyis kho bo cag pham par gyur na gtsug lag khang rtsigs ⑧shig ces mchi na/ de la ji ltar bsgrub par bgyi/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus bsams pa / ji 'di rnams la rtsodage ba'i rtsa ba chung zad yod dam 'on te med ces bsams pa las yod par mthong ngo / /su zhig la rag las par 'gyur snyam na bdag kho na la'o/ /yang bsams pa ji 'di snyed cig kho na bdag la rag las pa'i tshig gis 'dul bar 'gyur ram/ 'on te gzhan yang tshig gis 'dul ba yod snyam pa las 5yod par mthong ngo / /dus ji srid kyis skyotshogs par 'gyur snyam na zhag bdun lon nas so/ /bsams nas smras pa/ khyim bdag de bzhin du bya ste/ 'on kyang zhag bdun pa'i nyin par bya'o/ /de nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin dga' ba dang mgu ba skyes nas mu stegs can rnams gang na ba der song ste phyin nas mu stegs can rnams la 'di skad ces smras so/ /shes ldan dag 'phags pa shā ri'i bu na re de bzhin du bya ste/ 'on kyang zhag bdun pa'i nyin par bya'o zhes zer ro/ /de rnams kyis bsams pa 'di la rgyu gnyis yod par 'gyur te/ yang na ni de 'bros 'dod do/ /yang na ni de 4—202
