phyogs tshol lo/ /de ma yin na dus der gdab ci dgos/ bdag cag kyang phyogs btsal lo zhes de rnams phyogs btsal bar brtsams te de rnams kyis phyogs btsal ba dang / kun du rgyu mig dmar mthong nas de la de rnams kyis smras pa/khyod dang bdag cag ni tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa yin gyis/ dge sbyong gi ta ma'i nyan nyuthos kyi mchog bdag cag gis brtsad pa'i phyir bkug na de phyogs tshol gyis/ khyod kyang bdag cag gi ⑧grogs gyis shig /dus ji tsam zhig na/ 'di nas zhag bdun gyi nyin zhupar bya'o/ /rung gis de bzhin du bya ste/gang gi tshe khyed cag sdu'adus par gyur pa de'i tshe kho bo la sbron cig /mu stegs can rnams bag tsha ba dang sems khral skyes nas nyin re zhing phyogs tshol ba dang /nyi ma bgrang thobar byed do/ /ji tsam na zhag bdun lon pa dang / khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis bla gab med pa'i sa phyogs yangs par stan shom du bcug go/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu'i ched du yang seng ge'i khri bshams so/ /yul sna tshogs na gnas pa'i mu stegs can rnams dang / mnyan yod na gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs dang / de'i nye 'khor na gnas pa'i srog chags brgya stong phrag du ma dag kyang kha cig ni 3ngo mtshar skyes/ kha cig ni sngon gyi dge ba'i rtsa bas bskul nas 'dus so/ /de nas tshe dang ldan byapa shā ri'i bu khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin spu'akhor dang bcas pas mdun du bdar te rtsod pa'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs nas gdul ⑩ba'i skye bo rnams la bltas te 'dzum pa sngon du btang nas spyod lam zhi bas seng ge'i khri la 'dzegs nas 'dug go/ /'khor thams cad sems mi g.yeng bar tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu la rtog cing 'dug go/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus mu stegs can rnams la smras pa/ shes ldan dag 4—203

ci re zhig byed dam/ 'on te 'jig /de ①rnams kyis ②smras pa/ kho bo cag gis byas/ khyod kyis shig cig tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus bsams pa/gal te bdag gis byas na 'jig rten lha dang bcas pas kyang 'jig par mi nus na kun du rgyu mig dmar gyis lta smos kyang ci dgos snyam du rig nas kun du rgyu mig dmar ③la 'di skad ces smras so/ /khyod kyis byos shig ngas gzhig go/ /de mig 'phrul byed pa ④yin pas des shing sa ha kur shin tu me tog gis rgyas pa zhig sprul pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus rlung dang char drag po phab ste/des de rtsa ba nas phyung nas phan tshun du rnam par gtor te rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi yul du yang ma gyur to/ /de nas des ⑤pad ma'i rdzing zhig sprul pa dang /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus glang po che bzang po zhig sprul nas des kun du brnal ⑥nas ming gi lhag ma tsam zhig bzhag go/ /des sbrul mgo bdun pa zhig sprul pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus nam mkha' lding zhig sprul te des de blangs so//des ro langs shig sprul pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus sngags kyi phur pas ⑦btab pa las nyes par spyod ⑧pa'i ro langs ni bdag nyid la gsod ⑨par byed pas des de nyid la ⑩bsnyags pa dang / de nas de 'jigs skrag phongs shing ba 0spu zing zhes byed tsonas/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu'i rkang pa gnyis la gtugs te/ 'phags pa shā ri'i bu skyabs su mchi lags kyis yongs su bskyab ⑫tu gsol/ de nas tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus sngags kyi phur ⑩pa phyung ba dang ro langs de zhi bar gyur to/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus de la chos bshad de/de dad pa skyes nas smras pa/ 'phags pa shā ri'i bu bdag legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu byung ba dang bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos 1—204

po gnang na bdag 'phags pa shā ri'i bu'i spyan sngar tshangs par spyod pa spyad par bgyi'ol/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus de rab tu phyung ①bsnyen par rdzogs par byas nas ②gdams ngag byin te/ des brtson pa dang 'bad pa dang / brtsal ba byas pas nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs nas dgra bcom pa mngon sum du byas te dgra bcom par gyur nas/ khams gsum gyi 'dod chags dang bral ba/bong ba dang gser du mnyam pa/ nam mkha' dang lag mthil du mtshungs pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ tsan dan dang ste'ur mnyam pa/ rig pas ma rig pa'i sgo nga'i sbubs dral cing rig pa dang / mngon par shes pa dang / so sor yang dag par rig pa thob pa①/ srid pa dang 'dod pa'i ༅rnyed pa la chags pa dang / bkur sti la rgyab kyis phyogs pa dbang po dang nye ba'i ⑤dbang po dang bcas pa'i lha rnams kyis mchod par bya ba dang / rjed par bya ba dang /mngon du smra ⑥bar bya bar gyur to/ /de nas de'i 'khor rnams ngo mtshar gyi mig bgrad ⑦nas tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu la mngon par dad par gyur te/ smras pa/'phags pa shā ri'i bus ni smra ba'i 'khyu mchog chen po tshar ⑨bcad do snyam du rig nas / tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu'i gdong du lta bar gyur to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus 'khor de'i bsam 4)pa dang bag la nyal 6〉dang /khams dang / rang bzhin shes nas 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi so sor tsoyang dag par rtogs par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i chos bshad par byas so/ /de thos pas sems can brgya phrag du mas khyad par chen po thob ste/ kha cig gis ni nyan thos kyi byang chub tu sems bskyed8/ kha cig gis ni rang sangs rgyas kyi ④byang chub tu/kha cig gis ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu/ kha cig 4—205

gis ni skyabs su 'gro ba dang bslab pa'i gzhi rnams blangs/ kha cig gis ni rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum ①du byas/ kha cig gis ni lan gcig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang / kha cig gis ni ②phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu/kha cig gis ni rab tu byung nas nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs te/ dgra bcom pa mngon sum ②du byas so/ /'khor de phal cher yang sangs rgyas la gzhol④ / chos la 'bab⑤/ dge 'dun la bab pa la bkod do/ /mu stegs can rnams kyis bsams pa/ bdag cag gis 'di shags kyis tshar bcad ༅mi nus kyis thabs shig bsham par byas la/ de nas glags rnyed nas 'di bgags te gsad ⑦par bya'o snyam nas thams cad 'dus te khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi drung du dong ste smras pa/ khyim bdag khyod kyis kho bo cag gi 'tsho ba'i gzhi thams cad ni bcad ⑧pas de bas snying brtse ⑨bar gyis shig dang / khyod kyi 0 gtsug lag khang du gla mi'i las bya'o/ /kho bo cag 'di na yiring zhig tu gnas gnas pas yul bor na 8mi rung ngo / /khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis smras pa/ re zhig 'phags pa shā ri'i bu la brtag go zhes de tshe dang ldan pa shā /༷ri'i bu gang na ba der song ste phyin nas tshe dang ldan pa shā ④ri'i bu la 'di skad ces smras so/ /'phags pa mu stegs can rnams kyi mchid nas khyod kyis kho bo cag gi 'tsho ba'i gzhi thams cad bcad pas de bas tson snying brtse ⑩bar gyis shigaci /khyod kyi tsogatsug lag khang du gla yimi'i las bya'o/ /kho bo cag 'di na ring zhig tu gnas gnas pas yul bor na mi rung ngo zhes mchi'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu bsam ① pa la zhugs te/ ci 'di dag la dge ba'i rtsa ba cung zad yod dam 'on te med snyam na des yod par mthong ngo / /su zhig la 4wa 206

rag lus snyam na/ bdag kho na la'o ⑨snyam nas des bsams te smras pa/khyim bdag de la 'gal ba ci yod kyis de bzhin du gyis shig /de rnams gtsug lag khang der gla mi'i las byed par brtsams pa na tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus lcag ②thogs kyi mi btum ①po zhig sprul nas des de rnams las byed du gzhug ④par brtsams so/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus ⑤de rnams kyi gdul ba'i dus shes nas/ de dang nye ba'i shing drung zhig na 'chag cing 'dug pa dang ⑥/ de rnams kyis mthong nas de rnams kyis bsams ⑦pa/ dben pa na 'dug pas 'di bsad ⑧pa'i dus ni ⑨'di yin no snyam nas/ de rnams kyis de'i drung du dong ste bskor 4) nas 'dug go/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus bsams pa/'di rnams bsam pa ci 'dra bas bdag gi 7drung du 'ongs snyam na/ ci tsam na bsad ④pa'i sems kyis yin par 8shes nas des lcag kye thogs sprul pa de sbad nas / des de rnams las byos deng zhes thag ༅bcug pa dang / de rnams kyis smras pa/ 'phags pa shā ri'i bu yongs su bskyab tu gsol/ des smras pa/tshe dang ldan pa re zhig song la ngal sor chug shig tho) /de rnams kyis smras ༅pa/'di ni 'di lta bur bdag nyid che ba yin te/ bdag cag gis ni 8gsad ⑩par bsams na 'di ni bdag cag la byams par sems so zhu snyam du rig nas dad par gyur to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus de rnams kyi ⑥bsam pa dang bag la nyal ( stedang / khams dang / rang bzhin shes tsonas 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi po ④so sor rtogs par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i chos bshad par byas te/de thos nas de rnams kyis bla'ajig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo nyi shu mtho ba ye shes kyi rdo rjes bcom nas rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum ⑩du byas te de 4—207

rnams kyis bden pa mthong nas smras pa/ btsun pa bdag cag legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu 'byung ba dang bsnyen par rdzogs pa ①dge slong gi dngos po gnang na bdag cag btsun pa shā ri'i bu'i spyan sngar tshangs par spyod pa spyad par bgyi'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ②ri'i bus de rnams rab tu phyung ③bsnyen par rdzogs par byas nas ④gdams ngag byin te/ de rnams kyis brtson pa dang / 'bad pa dang brtsal ⑤bar byas pas 'khor ba'i 'khor lo cha lnga pa g.yo ba dang mi g.yo ba 'di nyid rig ste/ 'du byed kyi rnam pa thams cad nyams pa dang / lhung ༅ba dang / rnam par 'thor ba dang / rnam par 'jig pa'i chos nyid kyis ༅zil gyis mnan nas nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs te/ dgra bcom pa mngon sum du byas te/ dgra bcom par gyur nas khams gsum gyi 'dod chags dang bral ba/ bong ba dang gser du mnyam pa/ nam mkha' dang lag mthil du mtshungs pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ tsan dan dang ste 'ur mnyam pa/ rig pas ma rig pa'i sgo nga'i sbubs dral zhing rig pa dang mngon par shes pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa thob pa/ srid pa dang 'dod pa'i larnyed pa la chags pa dang / bkur ste la cergyab kyis phyogs pa/ dbang po dang nye ba'i ⑨dbang po dang bcas pa'i lha rnams kyis mchod par bya ba dang /rjed par bya ba dang / mngon du smra bar bya bar gyur to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus gtsug () lag khang gi thig skud kyi mtha' gcig nas bzung /mtha' gcig nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis bzung ba dang / tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus 'dzum dbyung bar brtsams so/ /khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis smras pa/ 'phags pa shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa rnams 4—208

sam / de bzhin gshegs pa'i nyan thos rnams ni rgyu med rkyen med par 'dzum pa mi mdzad na/ 'phags pa shā ri'i bu ci'i rgyu ci'i rkyen gyis 'dzum pa mdzad/khyim bdag de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams sam / de bzhin gshegs pa'i nyan thos rnams ni rgyu med rkyen ①med par 'dzum pa mi mdzad de②/ khyod kyis 'dir thig skud bzung ba dang ②/ dga' ldan ④gyi lha'i ris su yang gser gyi khang pa grub par gyur to/ /de nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin ngo mtshar skyes pa'i mig bgrad de ⑤smras pa/ 'phags pa shā ri'i bu gal te de lta na de'i slad du yang thig skud brkyang dang lhag par sems mngon par dad par bgyi'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus yang thig skud yide bzung ba dang / khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis lhag par dang ba ⑦drag po'i shugs kyis sems mngon par dad par ⑤byas te/ dad pa de'i mjug ⑨thogs kho nar gser gyi khang pa rin po che sna bzhi cilas byas par gyur nas tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus kyang de la go bar byas so/ /de nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin rtso)gong nas gong du bsod nams rab tu 'phel ba'i rgyud kyis tho)gtsug lag khang chen po tsobacu drug dang / khang phran drug bcu rtsig tu bcug ste/des tsogatsug lag khang chen po bcu drug dang / khang phran drug bcu brtsigs nas yo byad thams cad kyis rgyas par byas te/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i 'bu gang na ba der song ste phyin pa dang / tshe dang tshuldan pa shā ri'i bu la 'di skad ces smras so/ /'phags pa shā ri'i bu bcom ldan 'das gshegs na shul so ༅ji tsam du byon par 'gyur/ khyim bdag dper na 'khor los sgyur tsoba'i rgyal po'i ⑩tsam mo/ /'khor los ⑥ sgyur ba'i rgyal po mchi ba'i tshad ji tsam/ khyim bdag 1—209

'khor los ①snar ba'i rgyal po ni nyi ma ②gcig gis rgyang grags bcu'i lam du 'gro'o / /de nas khyim bdag mgon med zas ②sbyin gyis gang yang mnyan yod nas rgyal po'i khab de'i bar gyi gshegs dgongs brtsis ④nas gzhes sa dag byed du bcug /sbyin gtong gi khang pa dag byed du bcug /dus tshod gsol ba'i mi dag bkod/ gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan gyis brgyan/tsan dan gyi chus chag chag btab/ shin tu dri zhim po'i pog por dag nye bar bkod / rta babs dag byed du bcug /⑤dus kyi dang thun tshod kyi sman dag kyang 'jog tu bcug go/ /de ltar tshogs bsags yinas mi zhig la bsgo ba/kye nang rje tshur spyon/ khyod bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song la son pa dang /kho bo'i tshig gis bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis mel mgo bos phyag 'tshol la/⑧gnod pa nyung spungam/ nyam nga ba chung ngam0 / 'tsho'am bskyod pa yang ngam/stobs dang bde ba la reg par gnas sam zhes zhus la 'di skad ces bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod du gshegs su gsol/ bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun dang thabs cig yil bdag ji srid 'tsho'i bar du na bza' chos gos dang /bsod snyoms dang / gzims cha dang / snyun dpyad 8kyi rkyen sman gyi yo byad rnams kyis bsnyen bkur bgyid do zhes kyang gsol cig jo bo bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes mi des khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi ltar mnyan nas rgyal po'i khab gang na ba der chas te rim gyis rgyal po'i khab tu phyin to/ /de nas lam gyis dub pa ngal sos nas bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyi 8zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te/ phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas mi des bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad 4—210

ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ①ldan 'das kyi ②thabs gnyis la khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas zhes bya ba nas/ reg par gnas sam zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /kye mi khyod dang khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin bde bar gyur cig /btsun pa khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi ②mchid nas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod du gshegs su gsol/bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun dang thabs cig la bdag ji srid 'tsho'i bar du na bza' chos gos dang / bsod snyoms dang / gzims ⑤cha dang / snyun dpyad ⑤kyi rkyen sman gyi yo byad rnams kyis bkur stir bgyid do/ /zhes mchi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis mi de la cang mi gsung bas gnang ngo / /de nas mi de bcom ldan 'das cang mi gsung bas gnang bar rig nas/bcom ldan 'das kyi ༅zhabs gnyis ⑦la mgo bos phyag byas te bcom ldan 'das kyi laspyan snga nas 0song ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das dul ba 'khor dul ba/zhi ba 'khor zhi ba/ grol ba 'khor grol ba/ dbugs phyin ⑩pa 'khor dbugs phyin pa/ rnam par dul ba 'khor rnam par dul ba/ dgra bcom pa 'khor dgra bcom pa/ 'dod chags dang bral ba 'khor 'dod chags dang bral ba/mdzes pa 'khor mdzes pa/ khyu mchog ba lang gi tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/glang po che'i mchog glang po che'i ༅phru gu'i tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ seng ge mche 8ba can gyi tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ ngang pa'i rgyal po ngang pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ nam mkha' tho)lding bya'i tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/bram ze slob ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ 'khor los sgyur ④ba bu stong gis ⑫bskor ba lta bu/ zla ba rgyu skar gyi tshogs kyis skyabaskor ba lta bu/ nyi ma 'od 4—211

zer stong gis bskor ①ba lta bu/ yul 'khor srung dri za'i tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ 'phags skyes po grul bum gyi tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ mig mi bzang klu'i tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ rnam thos kyi bu gnod sbyin gyi tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ thags zangs ②ris lha ma yin gyi tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu / brgya ②byin sum bcu rtsa gsum gyi tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ tshangs pa tshangs ris kyi ④tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ rgya mtsho g.yo ba med pa lta bus/sprin ⑤chu dang bcas ⑦pa lta bu/ glang lapo che ⑨dam pa dregs ⑩pa dang bral ba ltar dbang po rnams shin tu dul bas spyod lam gyi tshul ma 'khrugs ⑩pa/ sku skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum bcu rtsa gnyis kyis tsokun nas brgyan 8pa/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad bcus ④rnam par mdzes par byas pa/ 'od 'dom gang gis 8brgyan pa'i sku nyi ma'i 'od zer yistong bas lhag pa'i 'od can/ rin po che'i ri bo 'gro ba ltar kun nas mdzes pa/ stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / ma 'dres pa'i dran pa nye bar gzhag pa gsum dang / thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang / khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin 'khor dang bcas ⑩pa dang / mnyan yod na gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs dang lha tsobargya stong phrag du mas zhabs yi'abring byas nas mnyan yod kyi grong khyer du gsherges so/ /gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod kyi grong khyer du gshegs nas/ mngon par 'du mdzad pa dang bcas pas grong khyer gyi sgo'i them pa la zhabs g.yas pas mnan pa de'i tshe sa rnam pa drug tu g.yos par gyur te/sa chen po 'di g.yos/ rab tu g.yos/ kun du rab tu g.yos/ ldeg /rab tu ldeg /kun du rab tu ldeg ste/ shar phyogs mtho na nub phyogs dma'/4—212

nub phyogs mtho na shar phyogs dma'/ lho phyogs mtho na byang phyogs dma'agye/byang phyogs mtho na lho phyogs dma'/ mtha' mtho na dbus dma'/ dbus mtho na mtha' dma' bar gyur cing / 'jig rten 'di thams cad 'jig rten gyi bar dang ②bcas te snang ba rgya chen pos khyab par gyur to/ /bar snang la yang lha'i rnga brdung ③zhing nam mkha'i dkyil na gnas pa'i lhas bcom ldan 'das kyi steng nas lha'i me tog ut+pa la khyodang / pad ma dang / ku mu da ⑤dang /pad ma dkar ༅po dang / a ga ⑦ru'i phye ma dang / rgya spos kyi phye ma dang /tsan dan gyi phye ma dang / gur gum gyi phye ma dang / ta ma la'i lo ma'i phye ma dang / lha'i me tog man dā dur ba rnams 'thor zhing lha'i gos rnams kyang 'thor ro/ /bcom ldan 'das grong khyer du gshegs pa na 'di dag dang /gzhan yang ngo mtshar de lta bu dag byung bar gyur to/ /gzhan yang dog pa rnams ni yangs par gyur to/ /dma' ba rnams ni mthon por gyur to/ /mthon po rnams ni mnyam par gyur to/ /glang po che yang skad 'byin to0/ /rta yang skad 'byin⑩ / khyu mchog rnams kyang skad 'byin to/ /khyim na yod pa'i rol mo'i ⑩cha byad sna tshogs pa rnams kyang rang sgra 'byin to/ /long ba rnams kyis ni mig thob botso/ /'on pa rnams kyis ni 8rna bas thos so/ /lkugs ④pa rnams kyis ni smra nus par gyur to/ /dbang po ma tshang ba rnams kyis 8ni dbang po rnams yongs su tshang ba thob botso/ /chang gis 0myos pa rnams ni myos pa dang bral bar gyur to/ /dug 'thungs pa rnams ni dug zhi bar gyur to/ /phan tshun khon 'byung ba rnams ni byang bar gyur to/ /sbrum ma rnams ni bde bar btsas par gyur to/ /btson ⑩du bcings pa rnams ni bcings pa ⑥ las thar to0//1—213

nor med pa rnams ni nor rnyed par gyur to/ /de dag dang gzhan yang bcom ldan 'das grong khyer du gshegs pa na ngo mtshar ①brgya stong dag byung bar gyur to//de nas bcom ldan 'das ②bkur sti chen po de lta bus mnyan yod du gshegs so//gshegs nas dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi gung la gdan bshams pa nyid la bzhugs so/ /de nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin mdza' bshes ②dang nye du dang gnyen gyi skye bos yongs su bskor nas gser gyi bya ④ma bum blangs te chu'i rgyun sbreng ⑤bar brtsams pa las/ de 'dzag tu ma btub pas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin yid mi bde ste bsams pa/ bdag gis ⑥las nyes pa dang bcas pa chung zad byas par ma gyur grang snyam pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyim bdag khyod kyis las nyes pa dang bcas pa chung zad kyang byas pa med do/ /'on kyang khyod kyis phyogs 'dir 'dug nas sngon gyi yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams la phyogs 'di nyid phul ba yin gyis phyogs gzhan zhig tu 'dug la sbrengs shig /des phyogs gzhan zhig tu 'dug nas byungs pa dang / bcom ldan 'das nyid kyis yan lag lnga dang ldan pa'i gsung ⑦dbyangs kyis rgyal byed kyi dutshal brjod par mdzad de/ rgyal byed kyi tshal brjod par mdzad pa na/ gzhon nu rgyal byed kyis bsams pa/ kye ma bcom ldan 'das kyis der bdag gi ming thog mar smos kyang ci ma rung snyam pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs kyis gzhon nu rgyal byed kyi sems mkhyen nas dge slong dag 'di ni rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi 0tshal ⑩mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba yin no zhes der ming thog mar smos par yimadzad do/ /gzhon nu rgyal byed kyis bcom ldan 'das kyis deng tsobadag gi ming thog mar smos pa mdzad pa thos nas shin tu 4—214

dga' bar gyur te/ dga' ba dang mgu ba skyes pa des nor gyi rigs las bcom ldan 'das kyi ①phyir rin po che sna bzhi'i sgo khang byed du bcug go/ /de bzhin du gnas brtan sdud ②pa byed pa rnams kyis kyang mdo sde'i nang du bcom ldan 'das rgyal bu rgyal ⑤byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so zhes gdags pa ④byas so/ /ko sa la'i ②rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis dge sbyong gau ta ma ko sa la'i ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs pa na mnyan yod du byon nas/ mnyan yod du yirgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal ⑦mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs te/ shes ldan gau ta ma de bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par dusangs rgyas par bdag nyid zhal gyis 'che'o zhes thos so/ /thos nas kyang bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das dang lhan cig mngon du yang dag par ⑨dga' ba dang / yang dag par mgu bar 'gyur ba'i gtam rnam pa sna tshogs byas te/ phyogs gcig tu 'dug go//phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /kye gau ta ma bdag gis shes ldan gau ta ma bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par yisangs rgyas par bdag nyid zhal gyis 'che'o zhes thos lags na/ gi ta ma gang dag de skad ces lung ston pa de dag ci ga dge sbyong gi ta ma la skur pa 'debs pa ma lags sam/thal bar smra ba ma lags sam/ shes ldan gau ta mas gsungs pa ⑩bzhin smra ba lags sam/ chos smra ba lags sam/ chos dang mthun pa'i chos lung ston pa lags sam/ ci ga de dag gi drung du pha rol po chos dang mthun pa'i tsortsod pa'i rjes su rtsod ()pa mchis na smod pa'i chos kyi gnas su mi 'gyur lags sam/1—215

rgyal po chen po gang dag de skad du smra ba de dag ni de skad du lung ston pa bden pa ①de nga la ②skur pa 'debs pa ma yin/ thal bar smra ba ma yin/ de ni gsungs pa bzhin smra ba yin/ chos smra ba yin/ chos dang mthun pa'i chos lung ston pa yin te/ de dag gi drung du pha rol po chos dang mthun pa'i rtsod pa'i rjes su rtsod pa 'ongs na smod pa'i chos kyi gnas su mi 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po chen po de ci'i phyir zhe na/ ngas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub nimangon par byasangs rgyas so/ /shes ldan go ta ma de skad gsungs ⑤mod kyidu / shes ldan ⑦gi ta ma la bdag yid mi ches lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ kye gi ta ma re zhig rgan zhing cirgan pa'i dge sbyong dang bram ze ni 'di dag lags te/ 'di ltari ste 'od srung 0rdzogs byed dang / kun du rgyu gnag lhas kyi bu dang / smra 'dod kyi bu mo'i bu yang dag rgyal ba can dang / mi pham ⑩skra'i la ba 0can dang / ka sat+ya'i bu nog can dang /ci gcer bu pa tsoganyen gyi bu gang lags pa de dag kyang da dung bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par bdag nyid g.yar gyis ④mi 'che ba ⑫lags na/ shes ldan gi ta ma 'khrungs nas ring po ma lags pa gsar du rab tu byung bas lta smos kyang ci 'tshal/ rgyal po chen po gzhon nu bzhi po 'di dag la khyad du gsad par ⑩mi bya gzhon nu tshul zil gyis mnan par mi bya ste/ bzhi ⑫gang zhe na/ rgyal po chen po rgyal rigs gzhon nu la yikhyad du gsad par mi bya gzhon nu la zil gyis mnan par mi bya'o/ /rgyal po chen po sbrul gzhon nu la khyad du gsad par mi bya/ gzhon nu la zil gyis mnan ⑥par mi bya'o/ /rgyal po chen po me chung ngu 0khyad du gsad par mi bya/ chung ngu la zil gyis mnan 1—216

par mi bya'o/ /rgyal po chen po dge slong gzhon nu la khyad du gsad par mi bya gzhon nu la zil gyis mnan par mi bya'o/ /①de ci'i phyir zhe na/ dge slong gzhon nur gyur kyang de rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che ba'i dgra bcom par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces/ /bka' stsal nas ni bde ②gshegs kyis/ /de skad ces ni bka' stsal nas/ /ston pas gzhan yang 'di skad gsungs/ /rgyal rigs dpe byad ldan pa dang / /rigs btsun grags par ldan pa la/ /blo dang ldan pas de gzhon ③zhes/ /khyad du mi gsad 0zil mi mnan/ /rgyal po rgyal rigs mkhas pa yis/ /rgyal srid dag ni thob gyur nas/ /chad pas gcod ⑤pa'i gnas de yod/ /de bas de la shin tu gdung / /de ltas ⑥rang gi srog bsrung ༅zhing / /rang gi don la lta bas ni/ /de ⑧ni khyad du mi gsad ⑨cing / /de la legs par bag kyang bya/ /gal te grong ngam dgon pa'ang rung //gang du sbrul ni mthong gyur na/ /blo dang ldan pas de gzhon ⑩zhes/ /⑩khyad du ⑫mi gsad zil mi mnanatso/ /'di ltar sbrul ni rgyu ba na/ /rigs ni rnam pa sna tshogs la/ /glags rnyed nas ni gzhon nus kyang / /skyes pa bud ④med du ma zin / /de ltas rang gi srog bsrung 6zhing / /rang gi don la lta bas ni/ /de ni khyad du mi gsad cing / /de la legs par bag kyang bya/ /mang po sreg ⑫cing 'bar 0byed pa'/ /lam gnag bsreg ⑩bya za ba'i me/ /blo dang ldan pas de chung zhes/ /khyad du mi gsad rjo zil mi mnan/ /me ni chung ngur gyur pa yang / /rkyen las 0chen por 'gyur ba 0yin/ /mes ni ring por ⑥mi thogs par/ /grong rdal phyodang ni grong khyer sregabya /de ltas 0rang gi srog bsrung 0zhing / /rang gi don la lta bas ni/ /de ni khyad du mi gsad 'acing /4—217

de la legs par bag kyang bya/ /lam gnag bsreg ①bya za ba'i mi②/ /nags tshal sreg ②pa gang yin de/ /zhag 'das nas ni 'ga' zhig tu/ /'dab ④ma rnams ni skye 'gyur gyi/ /dge slong tshul khrims ldan pa la/ /brten nas gang zhig tshig gyur pa/ /de la bu tsha yod min pas/ /bgo ༅skal spyod pa 'thob mi 'gyur / /ta la'i mgo ni bcad pa bzhin/ /ring por mi thogs rabs kyang 'chad ⑥ / /de bas rang gi srog bsrung rtsizhing / /rang gi don la lta bas ni/ /de ni khyad du mi gsad cing / /de la legs par bag kyang bya/ /rgyal rigs dpe byad ldan pa dang / /de bzhin brang 'gro me dang ni/ /dge slong tshul khrims ldan de la/ /blo dang ldan pas brnyas mi bya/ /de bas rang gi srog bsrung gzhing / /rang gi don la lta bas ni/ /de la khyad du mi gsad nyucing / /de la legs par bag kyang bya/ /de nas ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la nyu) mngon par dga' ste rjes su yi rangs /khyenas bcom ldan 'das kyi 8zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi maspyan snga canas song 8ngo //de nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi tsokun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis rgyal po zas gtsang ⑩la spring yig bskur 8ba/ lha dgyes pa bskyed du gsol/khyod kyi sras kyis bdud rtsi thob nas bdud rtsis 'gro ba 2tshim par byed do zhes spring ba rgyal po zas gtsang gis zhu thos nas pho nya btang ba las de de nyid du rab tu byung ngo / /gnyis pa btang 0ba dang / de yang de nyid du rab tu phyung ④ste/pho nya gang dang gang btang ba de dang de dag de ④nyid du legs par gsungs pa'i 1—218

chos 'dul ba nyid la rab tu byung bar gyur to/ /rgyal po zas gtsang ①lag pa la 'gram pa gtad ②nas pho nya gang dang gang btang ②ba de dang de dag de ④nyid du legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba nyid la rab tu byung ngo snyam mo/ /rjosems khong du ༅chud cing 'dug pa 'char kus mthong nas smras pa/ lha ⑦ci'i slad du khyod phyag la zhal gtad ⑤nas thugs mi dgyes shing bzhugs/ des smras pa / 'char ka gang gi tshe gzhon nu don thams cad grub pa dka' ba spyod pa de'i tshe kho bos phrin ⑨yig skyel ba'i mi btang ba las de dag kho bo'i ⑨ gan du 'ongs (chenas gzhon nu don thams cad grub pa bzhugs pa 'di dang 'dir ⑫bzhugs so zhes smra'o/ /da ni kho bos phrin yig skyel ba'i mi btang na 'ga' yang phrin yig tho)khyer te mi 'ong na ji ltar sems khong du thostechud par mi 'gyur/'char blakas smras pa/ lha bdag mchi ste bka' mchid ⑩'tshal la 7slar mchi'o/ /rgyal po zas gtsang gis smras pa/ 'char ka gang dang gang song ba de dang tsode de'i bstan ⑩pa phun sum tshogs pa mthong nas de nyid du 'dug pas du khyod kyang ⑥song na de nyid du 'dug par 'gyur ba'i gnas gang yin pa de yod do/ /'char gas smras pa/ lha slar mchi lags so/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang tsorang nyid kyis spring yig bris pa/ lhums su zhugs pa bzung nas su/ /khyod ni bdag gis cher bskrun te/ /nyon mongs me rab bla'abar ⑤bzhin du/ /rgyal ba ④nyon shing la bsdad na/ /da ni khyod kyi slob ma yi/ /yal ga lcug ma 'phel 'gyur bas( 9 / /gzhan ni bde bas dga' bar gyur0/ /bdag ni sdug bsngal rdziskal bar 0ldan/ /gzhan yang gang gis khyod ni ljon shing lhag ⑥ phran mtshungs tsam na/ /bdag gi bu ni 'di yin snyam nas chung nas bskrun bskrun te/ /bu 4—219

gcig yul mis 'bras bus ①yongs su spyad thob na/ /de la yon tan 'bras bu mi ster ②khyod la snying rje med/ /gang tshe thog ma bltams ②pa na/ /nyid don bsgrubs nas gnyen rnams ni/ /shin tu che dang ༅phan gdags zhes/ /khyod kyis dam bcas ⑤mdzad nas ni/ /khyod kyis zhi gnas de brnyes naX/ /bdag dang gnyen gyi tshogs rnams la/ /thugs brtses ④rjes su zung ⑧mdzod de//gshegs par dgongs pa mdzad du gsol/ /zhes spring ba'i yi ge 'char gas khyer nas chas te rim gyis mnyan yod du phyin pa dang / lam gyis dub pa ngal sos nas bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das rgyal po zas gtsang 0gis gsol ba'i yi ge lags so zhes bcom ldan 'das la yi ge phul ba dang / bcom ldan 'das nyid kyis bzhes nas bklags ⑨ so/ /bklags (lhanas yi ge mtha' gcig tu bzhag pa dang 'char gas gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das ci lags ser skya'i gzhir mi bzhud 8dam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'char ka 'dong ngo / /'char ka sngon tsobacom ldan 'das dang lhag par 'dris pa yin pas de sngon gyi 'dris pa kho nas gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das gal te mi bzhud dang / bdag gis tsomathus bkri bar bgyi lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byung ba 'di la tshigs su bcad de bka' lcal pa/ gang zhig yul gyi rgya mor tsom chags shing / / sred 'gags ⑫bkri ba yod pa ma yin pa'i/ /sangs rgyas spyod yul mtha' yas mnga' ba de/ /gzhi med na ni gang gi gzhi yis bkri/ /gang zhig yul gyi rgya 0mor ma chags shing / /sred 'gags tsobakri ba yod pa ma yin pa'i/ /sangs rgyas mtha' yas pa yi rtsal mnga' de/ /gzhi med na ni gang gi gzhi yiyis bkri/ /gang zhig 4—220

bcom nas brtsegs pa med gyur cing / /'jig rten ma bcom cung zad yod min pa①/ /sangs rgyas spyod yul mtha' yas mnga' ba de/ /gzhi med na ni gang gi gzhi ②yis bkri/ /gang zhig bcom nas brtsegs pa med gyur cing / /'jig rten ma bcom cung zad yod min pa③/ /sangs rgyas mtha' yas pa yi durtsal mnga' de/ /gzhi med na ni gang gi gzhi yis bkri/ /lan la spobs pa med nas gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mchi ste/ba rgyal po zas gtsang la rig par bgyi'o0/ /'char ka sangs rgyas kyi pho nya ni 'di lta bu ma yin no/ /'char kus gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci 'dra ba zhig lags/ rab tu byung ba yin gyis khyod kyang rab tu byung shig /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis rgyal po ༅zas gtsang la slar mchi bar dam bcas lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'char ka rab tu byung la ⑤ji ltar dam bcas pa bzhin du gyis shig /'di ltar bcom ldan 'das sngon byang chub sems dpar gyur pa na/ yab dang / yum dang / mkhan po dang / slob dpon dang /bla ma dang / bla ma'i gnas lta bu rnamase kyi chos dang mthun pa'i tshig lan 'ga' yang slar ma bzlog go/ /'char gas gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das gal te de lta na rab tu 'byung lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu la bka' stsal pa/ shā ⑨ri'i bu 'char ka 'di ni yun ring po'i don dang phan pa dang bde ba'i phyir rab tu phyung shig /btsun pa bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus bcom ldan 'das las mnyan nas 'char ka rab tu phyung bsnyen par rdzogs par byas te kun du spyod pa'i chos dag de la rgyas par smras nas/ 'char ka 'di ni khyod kyi bya ba yin te/ deng phan chad 4—221

bud med dang lhan cig ①khang pa gcig ②tu nyal bar mi bya'o zhes bya ba la sogs pa dudag go/ /btsun pa bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes 'char gas tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu'i rkang pa gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te song nas bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi byazhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das ser skya'i gzhir mchi lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa / 'char ka song la khyod ⑤mod kho nas ⑥rgyal po'i khab tu ma 'jug pa ra sgo na sdod la shākya'i dge slong 'ongs so zhes brjod par bya'o/ /gal te nang du spyon cig ces gleng na 'jug par bya'o/ /zhugs nas gal te shākya'i dge slong gzhan yang yod dam zhes zer na yod do zhes brjod par bya'o/ /gal te gzhon nu don thams cad grub pa yang 'di 'dra zhing cha byad 'di 'dra'am zhes 'dri na/ 'di 'dra zhing cha byad 'di 'dra'o zhes brjod par bya'o/ /khyod kyis rgyal po'i khab tu yang gnas par mi bya'o/ /gal te gzhon nu don thams cad grub pa yang rgyal po'i khab tu gnas par mi byed dam zhes gleng na/ mi bzhugs so zhes brjod par bya'o/ /gal te gang du gnas par byed ces 'dri na dgon ⑦pa'am gtsug lag khang du'o zhes brjod par bya'o/ /gal te gtsug lag khang ci 'dra zhes 'dri na / rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal gyi ⑧rnam pa bris te bstan par bya'o/ /gal te gzhon nu don thams cad grub pa byon nam zhes 'dri na/ byon no zhes brjod par bya'o/ /ji srid cig na byon zhes 'dri na zhag bdun lon na'o zhes brjod par bya'o/ /des gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mchi lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ song shig /sa bdag rnams 0ni tshig gis 1—222

te / /lha rnams bsams pas 'grub ①'gyur zhing / /de bzhin bsam gtan pa rnams kyis/ /sems bskyed pas ni thams cad 'grub/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa ②'char ka de ji ltar skad cig de nyid la grong khyer ser skya'i gzhir son pa de ltar byin gyis brlabs pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka bcom ldan 'das la dad pa mi bzod ②pa skyes pa de rgyal po'i khab kyi sgor bsdad ④nas smras pa/ shes ldan dag rgyal po la shākya'i dge slong mchis so zhes gsol cig /de rnams kyis smras pa/ ci shākya'i dge slong gzhan dag kyang yod dam/ shes ldan dag yod do/ /de rnams kyis rgyal po la smras pa/shākya'i dge slong mchis so/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ nang du thong shig /de nang du zhugs pa rgyal po zas gtsang gis mthong nas smras pa/ 'char ka rab tu byung ngam / des smras pa/ lha rab tu byung ngo / /khyod slar 'ong ngo zhes smras pa ma ⑤yin nam/ 'di ci yin/ 'char kus smras pa/ lha bcom ldan 'das kyis sangs rgyas kyi pho nya ni 'di lta bu ma yin no zhes ⑥bka' stsal nas chos 'dul ba legs par gsungs pa'i phyir bdag rab tu byung mod kyi bdag rang gi dad pas kyang rab tu byung ngo / /rgyal pos yan lag thams cad kyis ⑦'khyud nas stan ⑧bshams pa nyid la 'dug tu bcug ste/ de'i don du chu btsags rtsa ba ⑨dang 'bras bu brtags pa gtsang sbra byas te zar bcug go/ /tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka mchog tu nye bar zhi ba dang / dul bar gnas pa dang ldan zhing ji skad rjes su bstan pa'i cho ga bzhin yongs su longs spyad ⑩do/ /rgyal pos de la brtags yinas ngo mtshar bskyes te smras pa/ 'char ka ci gzhon nu don thams cad grub pa yang 'di 'dra ba tho)nye bar zhi ba yin nam/ 'char gas smras pa/4—223

lha bdag gi dul ba dang nye bar zhi ba ni cung zad tsam lags so/ /dper ji lta bu ri rab dang yungs 'bru bzhin no/ /rgya mtsho dang mig ⑤rjes bzhin no/ /nyi ma dang srin bu me khyer bzhin no/ /nam mkha' dang pad ma'i rtsa ba'i bu ga bzhin no/ /rgyal po zas gtsang ②gis smras pa/ 'char ka gzhon nu don thams cad grub pa yang 'di 'dra zhing cha byad 'di 'dra'am/ lha 'di 'dra zhing cha byad 'di 'dra'o/ /rgyal po zas gtsang brgyal ②nas sa la 'gyel pa dang /chu ④mang du btab nas dbugs slar byung ste smras pa/ 'char ka gzhon nu don thams cad grub pa byon nam/ 'char gas smras pa byon no/ /dus ji srid ⑤na dgung bdun lon na'o/ /rgyal po zas gtsang gis yiblon po rnams la bsgo ba shes ldan dag gzhon nu don thams cad grub pa byon par 'gyur gyis rgyal po'i khab dang 0pho brang byi dor byos ⑧shig /'char gas smras pa/ lha bcom ldan 'das ni pho brang du bzhugs ⑨par mi ⑩mdzad do/ /rgyal pos smras pa gang du bzhugs / 'char kus smras pa/ dgon pa'am gtsug lag khang du'o/ /rgyal po zas gtsang 0gis smras pa/ 'char ka gtsug lag tsokhang ci 'dra ba yin/tshe dang ldan pa 'char kus 0rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal gyi rnam pa ri mor bris te bstan to/ /de nas rgyal pos blon po rnams la smras pa/ shes ldan dag n+ya gro dha'i kun dga' ra bar ④rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal gyi rnam pa gtsug lag khang chen po bcu drug dang / khang phran drug bcu rtsig 8tu chug shig /lha bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes blon po rnams kyis rgyal po zas gtsang las ⑩mnyan nas n+ya gro dha'i kun dga' ra ⑩bar rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal gyi rnam pa gtsug lag khang chen po bcu drug dang / khang phran drug bcu rtsig 8tu bcug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 4—224

'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to//mod gal gyi bu song la dge slong rnams la bcom ldan 'das ser skya'i gzhir gshegs te yab sras gdan 'dzom na khyed cag ①las su zhig lta bar spro ba de chos gos dag ②long shig ces sgo ①shig /btsun pa bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos bcom ldan 'das las ④mnyan nas dge slong rnams la smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag bcom ldan 'das ser skya'i gzhir gshegs te yab sras gdan 'dzom na khyed cag las su ⑤lta bar spro ba de chos gos dag long shig ces bka' stsal to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dul ba 'khor dul ba/ zhi ba 'khor zhi ba/ grol ba 'khor grol ba/ dbugs phyin pa 'khor dbugs phyin pa/ rnam par dul ba rmekhor rnam par dul ba/ dgra bcom pa 'khor dgra bcom pa/ 'dod chags dang bral ba 'khor 'dod chags dang bral ba/ mdzes pa 'khor mdzes pa/ khyu mchog ba lang ༅gi tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ glang po che glang po'i phru ༅gu'i tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ seng ge mche ba can gyi tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ ngang pa'i rgyal po ngang pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ nam mkha' lding bya'i tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ bram ze slob ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ sman pa mkhas pa nad pa'i tshogs kyis ⑧bskor ba lta bu/ dpa' bo ru ba'i tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ lam mkhan 'gron 0po'i tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ ded dpon tshong pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ khams kyi rgyal phran blon po'i tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/'khor los ⑨ sgyur ba bu stong gis 0bskor ba lta bu/ zla ba rgyu skar 8gyi tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ nyi ma 'od zer stong gis tsobaskor ba lta bu/ yul 'khor 4—225

skyong dri za'i tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ 'phags skyes po grul bum gyi tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ mig mi bzang klu'i tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ rnam thos kyi bu ①gnod sbyin gyi tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ thags zangs ②ris lha ③ma yin gyi tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ brgya byin sum bcu rtsa gsum gyi tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ tshangs pa tshangs ris kyi ④tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu/ rgya mtsho g.yo ba med pa lta bu/ sprin chu dang bcas pa lta bu/ glang po dam pa dregs ⑤pa dang bral ba ltar yidabang po rnams shin tu dul bas spyod lam gyi tshul ma 'khrugs ⑦pa/ sku skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum bcu rtsa gnyis kyis kun nas ⑧brgyan pa/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad bcus ⑨rnam par mdzes par byas ⑨ pa/'od 'dom ༅gang gis brgyan pa'i sku nyi ma'i 'od zer stong bas lhag pa'i 'od can/rin po che'i ri bo 'gro ba ltar kun nas mdzes pa/ stobs bcu dang mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / ma 'dres pa'i dran pa nye bar gzhag pa gsum dang / thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang thabs cig btu 'bab chu ro hi kur byon to/ /rgyal po zas gtsang gis gzhon nu tsodon thams cad grub pa 'bab chu ro hi kur byon to ()zhes thos so/ /thos nas kyang rgyal po zas gtsang gis grong khyer ser skya'i gzhi rdo ba dang / gyo mo dang / gseg ma rnams bsal byanas tsan dan gyi chus chag chag btab/ dri shin tu zhim po'i pog por 8nye bar bshams/ dar gyi chun phyang ⑩mang po dpyangs 8te/ gang yang 'bab chu ro hi ka nas gang yang n+ya gro dha'i kun dga' ra ba de'i bar gyi ⑩lam shin tu mdzes par byas te/ sa phyogs yangs shing rgya che bar gdan rnam par bkra ba dag shom du bcug go/ /de na du'abab chu ro hi ka la dge slong kha 1—226

cig ni lag pa 'khru bar byed do①/ /kha cig ni so shing 'dor bar byed do/ /kha cig ni khrus byed do/ /ser skya'i gzhi na gnas pa'i shākya ②rnams kyis ②gzhon nu don thams cad grub pa gshegs so zhes thos so/ /thos nas kyang kha cig ni sngon gyi dge ba'i rtsa bas bskul/ kha cig ni ya mtshan skyes nas thams cad n+ya gro dha'i kun dga' ra ba nas byung ste ci yab sras kyi zhabs la phyag byed dam/ 'on te ④sus yab kyi zhabs la phyag byed pa blta'o 0snyam mo// //'dul ba gzhiyi/ bam po dgu bcu rtsa ⑦gcig pa/ de nas bcom ldan 'das 'di snyam du dgongs te/ gal te nga khyazhabs kyis ser skya'i gzhir gshegs na/ shākya nga rgyal can rnams kye ma'o gzhon nu don thams cad grub pas dka' thub kyi nags su gshegs nas ltogs 0po zhig grub pa lta zhig ste/ de lha brgya stong phrag du mas zham ⑩'bring byas nas steng gi nam mkha' las gshegs te dus de srid du dka' 0ba brgya stong spyad pas bdud rtsi thob nas da 8zhabs kyis gshegs pa lta 8zhes ma dad pa skyed par 'gyur ro snyam nas/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis ji ltar thugs mnyam par bzhag ④na shar phyogs kyi steng ④gi bar snang la mngon par 'phags nas spyod lam rnam pa bzhi mdzad de/ 'di lta ste 'chag pa dang / bzhengs pa dang /skya bzhugs pa dang mnal ba ⑩mdzad do/ /me'i ting nge 'dzin la yang snyoms par 'jug pa tsomadzad do/ /me'i ⑩ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs pa na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi sku las 'od zer rnam pa sna tshogs dag 'byin par mdzad de/ 'di lta ste sngon po dang /ser po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po dang / le brgan dang / shel gyi kha dog ① go/ /cho 'phrul zung du yang ston par mdzad de/ sku'i smad nas 4—227

me ①'bar bar ⑧mdzad de / sku'i stod nas chu grang mo'i rgyun 'bebs dupar mdzad do/ /sku'i stod nas me ⑤'bar bar mdzad la/ sku'i smad nas chu grang mo'i rgyun 'bebs par mdzad pa'i yiting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /shar phyogs la ji lta bar lho dang nub dang byang phyogs su yang de bzhin no/ /phyogs bzhir rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul rnam pa bzhi bstan nas rdzu 'phrul ⑦mngon par 'du mdzad pa bsdus te ②ta la bdun gyi srid tsam na bzhugs so/ /dge slong rnams ni ta la drug gi srid tsam na'o/ /bcom ldan 'das drug gi srid tsam na ni dge slong rnams lnga'i srid tsam na'o/ /bcom ldan 'das lnga'i srid tsam na ni dge slong rnams bzhi'i srid tsam na'o/ /bcom ldan 'das bzhi'i srid tsam na ni dge slong rnams ⑨gsum gyi srid tsam na'o/ /bcom ldan 'das gsum gyi srid tsam na ni dge slong rnams ciganyis kyi srid tsam na'o/ /bcom ldan 'das gnyis kyi srid tsam na ni phyedage slong rnams ta la gcig gi srid tsam yina'o/ /bcom ldan 'das mi bdun gyi srid tsam na bzhugs na ni dge slong rnams mi drug gi srid tsam na'o/ /bcom ldan 'das drug gi srid tsam na ni dge slong rnams ⑫lnga'i srid tsam na'o/ /bcom ldan 'das lnga'i srid 8tsam na ni tsodage slong rnams bzhi'i srid tsam na'o/ /bcom ldan 'das bzhi'i srid tsam na ni dge slong rnams gsum gyi srid tsam na'o/ /bcom ldan 'das gsum gyi srid tsam na ni dge slong rnams gnyis kyi srid tsam na'o/ /bcom ldan 'das gnyis kyi srid tsam na ni dge slong rnams mi gang lhag tsam na'o/ /bcom ldan 'das mi gang lhag tsam na ni dge slong rnams sa la'o/ /rgyal po zas gtsang gis cho 'phrul de lta bu ⑩de dang / dge slong mang po mthong nas de la bcom ldan 'das gang yin 1—228

pa ma shes te rmongs par gyur to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka la smras pa/'char ka 'di na ngur smrig gyon pa'i rab tu byung ba mang po zhig yod na de la gzhon nu gang yin/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char kus bcom ldan 'das bstan nas smras pa/ 'di ni bcom ldan 'das lags srid pa'i mthar byed sems kyi dbang phyug 'dren pa lags/ /'di ni nyon mongs sel mdzad nyin byed de nyid don ni kun tu ston mdzad lags/ /'di ni dgongs pa bzhin brnyes ②stobs bcu mnga' bas ②kun gyi pha rol gshegs pa lags/ /dri med gsal ba chos kyi dbang phyug khyod kyi sras lags mi dbang da gzigs shig /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang gis lus btud nas zhabs la phyag byas te tshigs su bcad pas gsol pa/blo gros yangs pa khyod la 'di dang ni/ /kun spyan zhabs la lan gsum phyag bgyis te/ /bltam ②pa'i tshe na sa ni g.yos pa dang / /'dzam bu'i grib ma sku las ma 'das pa'o/ /de nas shākya dang shākya mo rnams kyis rgyal po zas gtsang bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la gtugs pa ④mthong nas da ⑤ltar yab sras kyi zhabs la phyag byed pa ci ⑥tha tshig ces ma dad pa bskyed do/ /rgyal po zas gtsang ⑦gis shākya dang shākya mo rnams la go bar bya ba'i phyir 'di skad ces smras so//shes ldan dag da gdod kho bos gzhon nu don thams cad grub pa'i zhabs la phyag byas pa ma ⑧yin te/ gang gi tshe gzhon nu don thams cad grub pa bltam ⑨pa na sa chen po g.yos par gyur cing 'jig rten 'di thams cad snang ba rgya chen pos gsal bar gyur te/ 'jig rten na 'jig rten gyi bar gyi mun pa 0mun gnag smag tu gyur pa nyi ma dang zla ba 'di gnyis 'di ltar rdzu 'phrul che ba/ 'di ltar mthu che ba'i 'od kyi snang ba nyams su ma myong ba gang yin pa de yang de'i tshe snang ba 4—229

rgya chen pos gsal bar gyur nas/ der sems can gang dag skyes pa de dag snang ba des sems can ①dag gcig gis gcig mthong ba dang ②/ shes ldan dag 'dir sems can gzhan dag kyang skyes pa lta/ shes ldan dag ②'dir sems can gzhan dag kyang skyes pa lta zhes ngo shes par gyur pa de'i tshe yang kho bos byang chub sems dpa'i zhabs la mgo bos phyag byas so/ /gang gi ④tshi gzhon nu don thams cad grub pa/ zhing blas ⑤kyi mtha' la gzigs pa na shing 'dzam bu'i grib ma la bzhugs nas ⑥'dod pa rnams las dben pa/ sdig pa mi dge ba'i chos rnams las dben pa/ rtog pa dang bcas pa/ dpyod pa dang bcas pa/ dben pa las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang / bde ba zag pa med pa dang mtshungs pa'i bsam gtan dang po nye bar bsgrubs ⑦te bzhugs pa na shing gzhan rnams kyi grib ma ni shar phyogs su gzhol/ shar phyogs su 'bab/shar phyogs su bab kyang shing 'dzam bu'i grib ma ni byang chub sems dpa'i sku las ma 'das par gyur pa de'i tshe yang ngo mtshar snormad du byung ba'i chos des kho bo'i yid bsdus pas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la yang phyag byas te/ 'di dang bcom ldan 'das kyi ⑨zhabs la lan gsum phyag byas so/ /de bas na 'di skad ces / blo gros yangs pa khyod 0 la 'di dang ni/ /kun spyan zhabs la lan gsum phyag bgyis te/ /bltam ⑩pa'i tshe na sa ni g.yos pa dang / /'dzam bu'i grib ma sku las ma 'das pa'o zhes smra'o⑩/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du mdzad pa de brtul nas 'khor brgya stong phrag du ma zil gyis tsomanan nas dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi gung la gdan ④bshams pa nyid la bzhugs so/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang 8skad 'dzer cing snying dang mig mchi 4—230

mas gang bas bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis zhu ba ②zhus pa / gzhal med khang gi gnas rnams las/ /yab kyi khab na bzhugs pa las//dgon pa'i 'jigs dang bcas rnams su/ /ji lta chabur ni 'ba' ②zhig bzhugs / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ / mi yi ④bdag po gang du ni/ /khyim gyi 'ching ba las grol ba/ /'phags pa yi ni gnas pa bcus⑤/ /thub pa rnams ni gnas par mdzad/ /rgyal pos gsol pa/ ba so gser gyi rtsa ba can/ /shin tu bde ba bting ba yi/ /khri la mnal bar mdzad pa las/ /gding ba la ni ji ltar mnal/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /rgyal po rnam grol gnas mal ni/ /dga' ba byang chub yan lag giyi/ /me tog bkram par chags med cing / /yongs su gdung ba rnam ༅spangs mnal/ /rgyal po zas gtsang dugis gsol pa/ /dpa' bo nyid kyi khab na ni/ /gser dngul bum pas khrus mdzad na/ /rtog pa can la dro ba yi/ /chab kyis ji ltar khrus mdzad lags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /gi tam dad pa'i 'bab chu rnyog pa med/ /bsod nams 'jug ngogs dam pas bsngags pa ste//de la rig pa'i yon tan mi rngubakrus nas/ /lus mi gsher bar byapha rol rab tu rgal / /rgyal po zas gtsang gis gsol pa/ /dpa' bo khyod sngon ser skya yi7//tsan dan gyis ni sku bkrus 8shing / /ka shi'i mchog gnas mdzes pa las8/ /de dang bral na byamadzes ma lags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /tshul khrims nga yi rgyan yin te/ /tshul khrims nyid ni tsobyug pa yin/ /gser dang nor bu rna cha dag /rmongs skyed cing la ci zhig bya/ /rgyal pos gsol pa/dpa' bo nyid kyi pho brang na/ /glang po shing rta rtas bzhud pa/ /tsher mar 1—231

bcas pa'i sa gzhi ①la/ /zhabs kyis ji ltar gshegs par mdzad/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ / nga yi ②shing rta rdzu 'phrul rkang / /yang dag rtsol ba'i bzhon ①pa yis/ /sa kun rnam par rgyu na yang / /nyon mongs tsher mas gnod pa med/ /rgyal po zas gtsang gis gsol pa/ /dpa' bo sngon ni ka shi ku'i/ /na bza' mnabs ④na mdzes pa las/ /ngur smrig rtsub po'i gos mnabs ⑤pa/ /ji ltar khyod kyi sku yis bzod/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /rgyal po nga yi ༅gos ni zhungo tsha shes/ /nga yi bgo ba snam ④sbyar te/ /de bgos thub pa zhi ba rnams/ /nags khrod na ni mdzes ⑨par 'gyur / /rgyal po zas gtsang gis gsol pa/ /'di ltar khyod sngon gser gyi gzhong ④pa lasahu/ /du ma'i ro ldan 'bras chan 8gsol ba las/ /'di ltar gtso bo da lta'i bsod snyoms ni/ /phal pa gsol ba ji ltar mgur du mchi/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /zas kyi sred pa thams cad spangs nas ni / /nges par byung dang mnyam par bzhag ldan pa'i/ /nga ni chos kyi ro mchog gsol mod kyi/ /'jig rten kun la brtse phyir nga spyod do/ /rgyal po zas gtsang gis gsol pa/ /mgur du bde ba mang bgyid pa'i/ /dgun ⑫skyems kha ra'i chab gsol na/ /rnyog pa can la dro ba yi/ /chab ni ji lta cozhig tu gsol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /mi yi bdag po gang 'thungs na/ /bdag la btung ba thams cad ni/ /dug dang 'dra bar snang gyur pa/ /chos kyi ro mchog nga btung ngo / /rgyal po zas gtsang blugs gsol pa/ /'di ltar khyod sngon bsil khang gzhal 8med khang / /khang bzangs ⑩steng na ji lta'i dus bzhin tsobazhugs/ /da lta yigacig pu nags khrod khyod ⑥bzhugs pa/ /1—232

blo bzangs ①ji ltar bsnyengs pa med par bzhugs/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /gau tam 'jigs pa'i rtsa ba gang yin de/ /dri ma bag chags bcas par ngas spangs pas/ /nga ni ②mya ngan 'jigs pa med gnas te/ /nga la 'di na 'jigs pa cung zad med/ /rgyal po zas gtsang gis gsol pa/ /khyod sngon khrus khang shin tu yid 'ong bar/ /khrus ②mchog khyad par 'phags pas rtag bsil na/ /gcig po ④khyod ni nags khrod gnas ldan ⑤par/ /thub dbang da ltar su yis khrus ⑥mdzad 'gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa / /gi tam chos kyi mtsho bran dri med pa/ /tshul khrims 'jug ngogs dam pas bsngags pa ste/ /de la rig pa'i yon tan mi bkrus nasal/ /lus mi gsher bar pha rol rab tu rgal/ /rgyal po zas gtsang gis gsol pa/ /gang gis khyod ni khyad du gsod/ /gang las 'jigs su rung ba skyedzo/ /yid 'byung ba yang gang las skye/ /zhus pa de dag bdag la gsungs/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /gang gis nga yi 0khyad gsod dang / /gang zhig las ni 'jigs pa dang / /gang las yid 'byung ⑩skyes pa dag /nyon cig khyod la bshad par bya/ /rga dang na dang 'chi ba ste/ /gal te 'di gsum yod min na//nga yang shin tu yid 'ong ba'i/ /yul rnams la ni dga' bar 'gyur/ /rgyal po zas gtsang 0gis gsol pa/ /shākya rnams kyi rigs dga' ba/ /legs par 'khrungs pa'i dpa' bo legs/ /khyod ni 'jig rten chos brgyad kyis/ /ji lta bur yang ma gos so/ /de nas rab dga' dad pa rgyas byas nas/ /drang srong dge 'dun bskor ba byas nas ni/ /thub pa'i zhabs la mgo bos phyag byas te / /bde bar gshegs la kun nas rtog cing 'dug /de nas rgyal po zas 4—233

gtsang 'di snyam du sems te/ gang bdag gi ①bus yon tan gyi tshogs 'di lta bu thob pa ni bdag gi ③rnyed pa legs par rnyed ②do snyam mo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis n+ya gro dha'i kun dga' ra bar 'khor de'i bsam pa dang / bag la nyal dudang / khams dang / rang bzhin mkhyen nas de dang mthun pa'i chos bshad pa mdzad do/ /⑤de thos pas zas dkar la sogs pa shākya bdun khri rjobadun stong gis rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas te rgyal po zas gtsang ⑦ni ma gtogs so/ / lha sbyin dung rgyal ⑨las kyang nga rgyal can/ sdig pa 'dod pa des bden pa mthong bar ma byas pas khro ba'i kun nas dkris ⑩pa dang bcas pas smras pa/ gal te bdag gis 'di 'dra ba'i sgyu mas dbang du byed pa ⑩shes na bdag gis kyang 'jig rten thams cad dbang du bya ba zhig /de la shākya rnams kyis bshes pa'i tshig gis smras pa/ lha sbyin bcom ldan 'das ni rdzu 'phrul che ba mthu che ba yin gyis de skad ma smra shig ces bzlog nas cang mi smra bar 'dug go/ /tshangs pas bskor ba'i skyed mos tshal du 'di lta bu'i chos bshad pa tsomadzad de/ de 8thos pas rgyal po zas gtsang ma gtogs par bre bo zas la 8sogs pa shākya bdun 8khri drug stong gis rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas pa na yang lha sbyin de kho na bzhin du kha zer ro/ /ro hi ta ga'i skyed mos tshal du 'di lta bu'i chos bshad pa mdzad de/ de thos pas rgyal po zas gtsang ma gtogs par bdud rtsi zas la sogs pa shākya bdun khri lnga stong gis rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas pa na yang lha sbyin de kho na bzhin du kha zer ro/ /'khor lhag ma rnams las kha cig gis ⑩ni nyan thos kyi byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /kha cig gis ni rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub tu sems 1—234

bskyed do/ / kha cig gis ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /①kha cig gis ni rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas / kha cig gis ni lan gcig ②phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu/ kha cig gis ni phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu/ni kha cig gis ni rab tu byung nas nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs te dgra bcom par gyur/ kha cig gis ni sangs rgyas la skyabs su song / kha cig gis ni chos la/ kha cig gis ni dge 'dun la ste/ 'khor de dag kyang phal cher kyang ④sangs rgyas la gzhol/ chos la 'bab/ dge 'dun la bab par bkod ⑤do/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang 'di snyam du sems te / sngon ni bcom ldan 'das lha dang lha ma yin gyi 'gro bar bcas pas mchod pa dang / rjed pa dang mngon du smra bar bya bar gyur na/ da lta ni mis mchod kyi lhas ni ma yin no snyam mo/ /de nas shākya gzhon nu zhig gis tshigs su bcad de gsol pa/ drang srong chen po smra mchog dam chos kyiyi/ /char pas 'gro ba 'di ni tshim mdzad do/ /⑦mi bzad ⑧lam du lhung ba'i 'jig rten 'di//drongs te thar pa'i lam la sbyar ⑨bar mdzod/ /rgyal po zas gtsang ni 'di snyam du bdag gi 0bu 'ba' zhig 'di ltar rdzu 'phrul che zhing 'di ltar mthu che ba yin no snyam ste/ lhag par dga' bas bden pa ma mthong ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa/ rgyal po zas gtsang gis ci'i phyir bden pa ma mthong snyam pa las de 'di snyam du bdag gi bu 'ba' zhig 'di ltar rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che ba yin no snyam ste/ lhag par dga' bar ⑩gyur gyis mdor na de'i dregs pa spong du gzhug 8go/ /rgyu gnyis kyis bden pa rnams tsomathong bar mi 'gyur te/ ha cang zhum pa dang / shin tu dga' ba'o/ /de la zhum pa'i sems dang shin tu 1—235

dga' ba yod ①kyis/ ma la ngas de'i zhum pa dang / shin tu dga' ba gnyis spong du gzhug ②go snyam nas/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po la bka' stsal pa/ mod gal gyi bu rgyal po zas gtsang la soms shig /btsun pa bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos bcom ldan 'das las mnyan nas rgyal po zas gtsang gang na ba der song ba dang / rgyal po zas gtsang gis me dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po rgyang ring po nas 'ong ba mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /btsun pa mod gal gyi bu chen po tshur spyon / mod gal gyi bu chen po khyod byon pa legs so/ /btsun pa mod gal gyi bu chen po gdan chabashams pa nyid la bzhugs shig /tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos ④stan bshams pa nyid la 'dug go/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos sems ji ltar mnyam par bzhag na rang gi stan las mi snang bar gyur te/ shar phyogs kyi steng ⑤gi bar snang la mngon par 'phags nas spyod lam rnam pa bzhi byed de/ 'di lta ste 'chag pa dang / 'greng ba dang / 'dug pa dang / nyal bar byed do/ /me'i ting nge 'dzin la yang snyoms par 'jug par byed do/ /me'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs pa dang ⑥/ tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po'i lus las 'od zer rnam pa sna tshogs dag 'byin par byed dol/ /'di lta ste/ sngon po dang / ser po dang /dmar po dang / dkar po dang / le brgan dang / shel gyi kha dog dag go/ /cho 'phrul zung du yang ②ston par byed de/ lus kyi stod ⑨nas ⑩'bar bar byed la / lus kyi smad yinas chu grang mo'i rgyun 'bebs par byed do/ /lus kyi 1—236

smad ①nas me ②'bar bar byed la lus kyi stod srinas chu grang mo'i rgyun 'bebs par byed pa de lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs ④so/ /shar phyogs la ji lta ba bzhin du lho dang / nub dang / byang phyogs su yang de bozhin no/ /phyogs bzhir rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul rnam pa bzhi bstan nas/ rdzu 'phrul ⑤mngon par 'du bya ba bsdus te stan ⑥bshams pa nyid la 'dug go/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang gis tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu ①chen po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /btsun pa mod gal gyi bu chen po bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos 'di ltar rdzu 'phrul che zhing ⑧mthu che ba gzhan yang mchis lags sam/ rgyal po chen po mchis so zhes tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ mthu che ba dang gsum rig dang / /sems kyi rnam grangs shes pa dang / /zag zad dgra bcom gang yin pa/ /thub pa'i nyan thos mang du mchis/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang 'di snyam du sems te/bdag gi 0bu 'ba' zhig 'di ltar rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che bar ma zad de 'di ltar ⑨ rdzu 'phrul che zhing ⑩mthu tsoche ba'i rab tu byung ba gzhan yang yod do snyam nas de shin tu dga' ba gang yin pa de dang bral bar gyur to/ /skabs tsoder bcom ldan 'das kyis 'jig rten pa'i thugs bskyed pa mdzad de/ kye ma brgya byin dang tshangs pu la sogs pa lha rnams 'ongs na lha'i 'khor dag pa la chos bshad do snyam pa dang / chos nyid kyis gang gi 8tshe sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis 'jig rten pa'i thugs bskyed pa mdzad pa de'i tshe srog chags grog sbur rnams kyi sems kyis kyang bcom ldan 'das kyis yidagongs pa shes par 'gyur na/ brgya byin dang tshangs pa la sogs pa lha rnams kyis lta smos kyang ci dgos / gang gi tshe 'jig rten las 'das pa'i thugs bskyed pa de'i tshe/4—237

nyan thos chen po rnams kyi sems ①kyis kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi ②dgongs pa mi shes na/ brgya byin dang tshangs pa la sogs te lha rnams kyis ②lta ci smos/srog chags grog sbur rnams kyis lta ga la shes/ de nas lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin 'di snyam du sems te/ bcom ldan 'das ci'i phyir 'jig rten pa'i thugs bskyed pa mdzad do ④snyam pa las de 'di snyam du sems te/ lha'i 'khor dag pa rnams la chos 'chad par bzhed do snyam nas/ des ④lha'i bu bzo thams cad pa la bsgo ba/ bzo thams cad pa bcom ldan 'das lha'i 'khor dag pa la chos 'chad par bzhed kyis n+ya gro dha'i kun dga' ra bar rin po che sna bzhi'i khang pa rtseg dum gdan sna tshogs bshams pa zhig sprul cig /kau ④shi ka khyod kyi mchog tu bzang ngo zhes lha'i bu bzo thams cad pas lha'i ⑧dbang po brgya byin las mnyan te n+ya gro dha'i kun dga' ra bar rin po che sna bzhi'i khang pa rtseg ⑨ma gdan sna tshogs bshams pa zhig sprul to/ /de nas ⑩rgyal po chen po bzhi sgo ⑪bzhi na 'khod pa'i 7yul 'khor skyong dang / 'phags skyes po dang / mig mi bzang dang / lus ngan po ste0/ shar phyogs ④na ni yul 'khor skyong dpung rgyan dang / rna cha gdub kor tsodang / phreng ba dang / rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa'o/ /lho phyogs na ni 'phags skyes po lha'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /nub phyogs na ni mig mi bzang rin po che sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa'o/ /byang phyogs na ni lus ngan po rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan tho)pa'o/ /de nas lha rnams kyi sh+yidabang po brgya byin gyis n+ya gro dha'i kun dga' ra ba che thang du brgyan du bcug ste/bcom ldan 'das gang tson ba der song ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das la don de rgyas par gsol toyo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das brgya byin dang tshangs pa la 4—238

sogs pa ②lha brgya stong phrag du mas yongs su bskor nas khang pa brtsegs par zhugs te②/ lha'i 'khor phal po che'i gung la rin po che sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa'i seng ge'i khri la bzhugs so/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos rgyal po zas gtsang khrid de/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po dang nang du zhugs pa dang / rgyal po zas gtsang la rgyal po chen po yul 'khor skyong gis rgyal po chen po nang du ma 'gro ②bar sdod cig ces bzlog go/ /ci'i phyir/ bcom ldan 'das lha'i 'khor dag pa la chos 'chad de/ der mir gyur pa 'jug tu mi dbang ngo / / rgyal po zas gtsang gis smras pa/④ bzhin bzangs khyod su zhig / yul 'khor skyong gis smras pa/② rgyal po chen po bdag ni yul 'khor skyong ngo / /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang lho sgor song ba dang / rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes pos mthong nas smras pa/ rgyal po chen po nang du ma 'jug par sdod cig /rgyal po zas gtsang gis ⑤smras pa/ bzhin bzangs khyod su zhig /'phags skyes pos smras pa/ rgyal po chen po bdag ni 'phags skyes po'o/ /ci'i phyir/ bcom ldan 'das lha'i 'khor dag pa la chos 'chad de/ der mir ⑩gyur pa 'jug tu mi dbang ngo / /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang nub sgor song ba dang / rgyal po chen po mig mi bzang gis mthong nas smras pa/ rgyal po chen po dunang du ma 'jug par sdod cig / rgyal po zas gtsang gis smras pa/ bzhin bzangs khyod su zhig /mig mi bzang gis smras pa/ rgyal po chen po bdag ni mig mi bzang ngo / /0ci'i phyir/ bcom ldan 'das lha'i 'khor dag pa la chos 'chad de/der mir gyur pa 'jug tu mi dbang ngo / /de nas rgyal po zas ⑨ gtsang byang 1—239

sgor song ba dang / rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi ①bus mthong nas ②smras pa/rgyal po chen po nang du ma 'jug par sdod cig /rgyal po zas gtsang gis smras pa/bzhin bzangs khyod su zhig /rnam thos kyi bus smras pa/ rgyal po chen po bdag ni rnam thos kyi bu'o/ /ci'i phyir/ bcom ldan 'das lha'i 'khor dag pa la chos ③'chad de/ der mir gyur pa 'jug tu mi dbang ngo / /de nas rgyal po chazas gtsang kye ma'o bcom ldan 'das lha'i 'khor dag pa la chos 'chad pa de bdag gis blta'o 0snyam pa'i 'dod pa skyes so/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang yizhum pa'i rgyud gang yin pa de dang ༅bral bar ⑤gyur to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa/ rgyal po zas gtsang gis gal te nga ma mthong na khrag dron mo skyugs nas 'chi bar 'gyur ba'i gnas skabs gang yin pa de yod pas ⑨de la thabs shig bsham ⑩par bya'o snyam nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis rin po che sna bzhi'i khang pa brtsegs pa gang yin pa de shel las byas par sprul pa dang / des na yirgyal po zas gtsang gis tshosangs rgyas kyi sku sgrib pa med par mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang dga' ba dang mgu ba skyes nas bcom ldan 'das kyi 8zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te phyogs gcig tsoku 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal po zas gtsang gi bsam pa dang / bag la nyal phyedang /khams dang / rang bzhin mkhyen nas 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi so sor ⑫rtogs par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i chos bshad pa mdzad de/ de thos pas rgyal po zas gtsang gis 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo nyi shu mtho ba ye shes kyi tshurdo rjes bcom nas rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum ⑩du byas te/ de bden pa mthong nas lan gsum du ched du brjod pa ched tsodu brjod payi/ btsun pa 4—240

bcom ldan 'das ①bdag la phas ma bgyis/ mas ma lags/ rgyal pos ma lags / lha rnams kyis ma lags/ sngon gyi 'das pa rnams kyis ②ma lags/dge sbyong dang bram ze rnams kyis ma lags/ sdug pa dang / rang gi skye bo dang / gnyen gyi tshogs kyis ma lags pa gang lags pa de ni bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag la mdzad de/ khrag dang mchi ma'i rgya mtsho ni bskams/ rus pa'i ri bo dag chalas ni bsgral④/ ngan song gi sgo rnams ni bkum/du mtho ris dang thar pa'i sgo rnams ni phye/ bdag lha dang mi rnams su ༅ni bzhag go/ /yang gsol pa/ pha la lan du phan gdags pa/ /dam pa'i bus ni bgyi ba ⑦gang / /khyod kyis bdag la mdzad lags te⑤/ /sems ni grol bar gzhol bar bgyis/ /khyod kyis bdag ni ngan 'gro las/ /drangs te mtho ris thar pa la/ /bsgrim mi 'tshal bar bzhag lags te/ /khyod kyis dka' ba mdzad pa legs/ /mgon po ⑨byams pa ⑩khyod kyis ni/ /bdag ni tshong pa rnyed ldan ltar/ /mtho ris rnyed pas srid pa yi7/ /longs spyod dag ni rnyed par mdzada'/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang stan ⑨las langs te bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas bcom ldan 'das gang na ba de 8logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun dang thabs cig 8tu sang ⑩bdag gi sdum par gdugs tshod sbyor zhing mchis na ⑩gnang bar mdzad du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 8rgyal po zas gtsang tshul cang mi gsung bas gnang ngo / /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang bcom ldan 'das cang mi gsung bas gnang 6)bar rig nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi 0zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga nas chas te/1—241

zas dkar gang na ba der song ste phyin ①nas zas dkar la 'di skad ces smras so//gzhon nu khyod rgyal srid thob kyis rgyal srid khyer cig /ci'i slad du ngas bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar bden pa mthong bas so/ /gang gi gdugs la byu lags ske/ de ring kho na'o/ /bdag gis kyang bcom ldan 'das kyis ②gang gi nyi ma la n+ya gro dha'i kun dga' ra bar chos bshad pa de'i nyi ma la shākya bdun khri bdun stong dang lhan cig ③bden pa mthong lags so/ /de bzhin du bre bo zas la rgyal srid khyer cig ④ces smras pa dang / des ⑤smras pa/ bdag gis kyang bcom ldan 'das kyis gang gi tshe tshangs pas bskor ba'i skyed mos tshal du chos bshad pa de'i tshe shākya bdun ༅khri drug stong dang lhan cig ༅bden pa mthong lags so/ /de bzhin du bdud rtsi zas la rgyal srid khyer cig ces dusmras pa dang /des smras pa/ bdag gis kyang gang gi 0tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis ⑨ ro hi ta ma'i skyed mos tshal du chos bshad pa de'i tshe shākya bdun khri lnga stong dang lhan cig ⑪bden pa mthong lags so/ /gal te de ltar gyur na da su zhig rgyal srid la gzhag /de rnams kyis smras pa/ shākya'i rgyal po bzang ldan gyis bgyi'o zhes de rnams 'dus nas shākya'i rgyal po bzang ldan rgyal srid kyi dbang phyug la dbang bskur ro/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang 6gis de nyid kyi mtshan mo nas gtsang zhing bsod pa'i bza' ba dang bca' ba tsodag sta gon byas nas nang par sngar langs te/ gdan yibashams shing nor bu'i chu byasnod bzhag nas bcom ldan 'das la spyan 'dren gyis gdugs tsotshod gsol pa/ btsun pa ⑩bcom ldan 'das gdugs tshod lags na/ da de'i dus la bab par dgongs su gsol/de nas bcom ldan 'das snga dro na bza' sham thabs mnabs 7lhung bzed dang 1—242

chos gos bsnams te/ dge slong gi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor cing dge slong gi dge ①'dun gyis mdun du bdar nas rgyal po zas gtsang gi bkad sa gang na ba der gshegs te byon nas dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi gung la gdan bshams pa nyid la bzhugs so/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang gis sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun bde bar bzhugs par rig ②nas gtsang zhing bsod ②pa'i bza' ba dang bca' ba dag ④rang gi lag nas stobs shing tshim par byed de/rnam grangs du mar gtsang zhing bsod pa'i bza' ba dang bca' ba ⑤rang gi lag nas bstabs shing tshim par byas te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsol zin nas phyag bcabs te lhung ༅bzed gyu bar ④rig nas gser gyi bya ma bum blangs te/bcom ldan 'das la n+ya gro dha'i kun dga' ra ba phul lo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis yan lag lnga dang ldan pa'i gsung dbyangs kyis yon bsngo ba dumadzad pa/sbyin pa'i bsod nams gang yin 'dis/ /shākya rnams kyis spubasams pa yi/ /yid la re ba rdzogs nas ni/ /rtag pa'i gnas ni thob par shog/de nas bcom ldan 'das ser skya'i gzhi coshing n+ya gro dha'i kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de bzhin du gnas brtan rnams kyis kyang mdo sde la bcom ldan 'das ser skya'i gzhi shing n+ya gro dha'i kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so zhes gdags par 7byas so/ /bcom ldan 'das ser skya'i gzhi de nyid na bzhugs nas 8nyi ma gcig ni rgyal po'i pho brang 8du gdugs tshod gsol/ nyi ma gcig ni btsun mo'i nang du gsol lo/ /rgyal po zas gtsang gis ral pa can las rab tu byung ba'i dge slong rnams spyod lam zhi zhing sems dang ba yin na dka' thub drag po'i brtul zhugs kyi khyad par dag ④gis lus gdungs pas lus mi mdzes 1—243

par mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang 'di snyam du sems te/ 'di ltar ral pa can 'di dag spyod lam zhi zhing sems dang ba yin mod kyi/ lus mdzes pa ma yin na ①'khor ci 'dra ba zhig gis bcom ldan 'das mdzes par 'gyur snyam pa las / des bsams pa/ shākya'i 'khor gyis yin no snyam nas/ de nas shākya ②thams cad bsogs ②te smras pa/ shes ldan dag gal te gzhon nu don thams cad grub pa rab tu ma byung bar gyur na cir 'gyur/ 'khor los sgyur ④ba'i rgyal por 'gyur ro/ /khyed cag ci zhig byed par 'gyur/ g.yog bgyid par 'gyur ro/ /da ⑤ltar gzhon nu don thams cad grub pa bla na med pa'i chos kyi rgyal por gyur na/ khyed cag ⑤ci'i phyir g.yog mi byed/ lha ci rab tu 'byung ngam/ rab tu byung shig /ci thams cad dam/ khyim re nas re re'o/ /bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes ⑦rgyal po zas gtsang gis 0grong khyer ser skya'i gzhir dril sgrogs su bcug pa/ rgyal po'i zhal nas nga'i yul na gnas pa'i shākya rnams kyis khyim re nas re re rab tu byung shig ces de skad bka' stsal to/ /bre bo zas la bu gnyis yod pa ma 'gags pa dang / ming chen no/ /ming chen ni zhing blas 0kyi mtha' la lhag par brtson no/ /ma 'gags pa ni steng gi khang bzangs kyi gzhi la 'dug nas skyes pa med pa'i rol mos rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed6) / dga' mgur spyod par byed do/ /ming chen la mas smras pa/bu rgyal pos dril sgrogs su bcug pa/ shākya rnams las khyim re nas 7re re rab tu byung shig ces bsgos tsokhyod rab tu byung shig /des smras pa/ bdag ni rab tu mi 'byung gis khyod kyi bu sdug pa bde ba dang ldan par gnas pa gang yin pa de rab tu phyung 0shig /bu ④bsod nams kyi dbang thang chen po can gyi sems 4—244

can de la khyod 'gran ①ma tshol cig /yum khyod gang la dgyes pa de bsod nams kyi dbang thang chen po can lags mod/ de ring ②de la chung zad kyang ma bskur chadang / ci bsod nams kyi dbang thang chen po legs ④sam ma legs ⑤mngon par 'gyur ro/ /bu de bzhin du byas te yid ches par bya'o/ /des gzeb stong pa rje'u yis ⑥bkang nas kha ras dkar pos dkris te rgya skyegs ⑦la rgyas btab nas bu mo mngag gzhug ma'i lag tu bskur nas bsgo ba/ gal te de na ci yod ces 'dri dang ci yang ma mchis so zhes smros shig /des de la ⑧khyer nas song ba dang / lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyi 0shes pa mthong ba bya'og tu 'jug pa yin pas des bsams pa/ rang sangs rgyas kun shes pa 0la bsod snyoms phul ba gang yin pa de deng ci'i phyir zas kyis phongs par bya/de'i zan sbyar bar bya'o zhes des rje'u de rnams su sran tshod dang / tshod ma sna tshogs ro dang ldan pa dang zas kyis bkang ngo / /ji tsam na mngag gzhug tsam des khyer nas ma 'gags pa'i drung du phyin pa dang / des smras pa/ bu mo 'o na ni ci yod/ des smras pa/ gzhon nu ci yang ma mchis so ma 'gags pas bsams pa/ bdag la ma byams 8na 'di stong par ci ste bskur/gdon mi za bar 'di ni ci hu yang ma yin pa zhes bya ba'i zas shig bskur gyis re zhig blta'o/ /zhes ci tsam na kha phye ba dang / skyed mos tshal de thams cad zas kyi dri zhim pos gang bar gyur te④/ de bsnams nas ma 'gags pa mchog tu ya mtshan skyes so/ /de ma la gus pa yin pas des ma la zas kyi phud bskur nas spring ba/ yum gdugs re re zhing zas ci yang ma yin pa zhes bgyi ba 'di lta bu sha stag cibaskur ba'i rigs so/ /des kyang mthong nas mchog tu ya mtshan 4—245

skyes te/ des ming chen la bstan nas bu mthong ngam/ yum mthong lags so/ /khyod la ②kho mos sngar bsod nams kyi dbang thang chen po'i sems can mi ska la ②ba bzang po dang ldan pa la khyod 'gran ①ma tshol cig ces ma smras sam/ des smras pa/ yum bsod nams kyi dbang thang chen po dang ldan yang rung mi ①ldan yang rung bdag ni rab tu mi 'byung ngo zhes ji ⑤ltar ming chen gnas skabs thams cad du rab tu byung bar khas len du ma btub bo/ /de nas des ⑥ma 'gags pa la smras pa/ bu rgyal pos dril sgrogs su bcug pa shākya rnams las khyim re nas re re rab tu byung shig ④ces bsgo na khyod ci ⑧rab tu 'byung ngam0/'on te khyim par 'dug /des smras pa/ yum rab tu byung ba la phan yon ci mchis / nyes dmigs ci mchis/ khyim par mchis pa la phan yon ci mchis/nyes dmigs ci mchis/ bu rab tu byung bas legs par bsgrubs na/ mya ngan las 'das pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /legs par ⑩ma bsgrubs na lha dang mi thob par 'gyur ro/ /khyim par 'dug ste ⑩legs par bskyangs na lha dang mi thob bo/ /ma bskyangs tson sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro dang / yi dgas 'thob tsobo/ /yum rab tu byung ba'i nyes dmigs gang lags pa de ni khyim na gnas pa'i phan yon lags pas de bas na khyim na gnas pa mi 'tshal gyis ⑫gnang bar mdzod cig dang rab tu 'byung ngo / /des smras pa/ bu legs kyis ⑫de bzhin du gyis shig /ma 'gags pa'i ne'u zla shākya'i rgyal po bzang ldan yin pas de (9de'i drung du song ngo / /⑩de'i tshe shākya'i rgyal po bzang ldan pi bang ⑫len 7te/ de pi bang 0len pa na rgyud chad nas sgra gzhan du gyur to/ /ma 'gags pa pi bang tshulen pa la byang dub yin pas des sgra ci 'dra bar gyur pa'i 4—246

rtags bzung nas de sgor bsdad de sgo srung gi ①mi la smras pa/ kye nang rje song la rgyal po bzang ldan la ma 'gags pa lha'i zhal mthong bar 'tshal nas sgo na sdod cing mchis so zhes gsol cig /sgo srung ②song nas shākya'i rgyal po bzang ldan la smras pa/ lha ma 'gags pa lha'i zhal mthong bar 'tshal nas chab sgo na sdod cing mchis so/ /des smras pa/ shes ldan ma 'gags pa la su 'gog /shes ldan ma 'gags pa nang du thong shig② /de nang du zhugs pa dang / rgyal pos 'khyud nas 'dug tu bcug ste smras pa/ khyod 'ongs nas ji srid lon/ des smras pa/ gang gi tshe khyod ④yi bang ④len pa na rgyud chad nas sgra gzhan du gyur pa na'o༅ / /de mchog tu ya mtshan skyes nas des smras pa/ khyed pi bang ④len pa la byang ba yin no/ /shākya'i rgyal po bzang ldan gyis smras ⑧pa/ gzhon nu don ci zhig la 'ongs/ ma 'gags pas smras pa/ lha rgyal po zas gtsang gis dril sgrogs su bcug pa shākya rnams la khyim re nas re re rab tu byung shig ⑨par bsgo bas de khyod kyis ⑩mkhyen par mdzod cig rab tu 'byung 0ngo / /rgyal pos smras pa / gal te de lta tson kho bo yang tsorab tu 'byung ste/ gros bya ba yod kyis khyod di tsoring 'di nyid du gnas thob shig /de 8de nyid du gnas btab bo/ /mal 'cha' tshubs rims bag gi dri can gyi ⑩gos kyis bting zhing me tog gi sil mas bkram pa'i mal du ma 'gags pa nyal ba dang / de'i 'og na me tog gi rtsa ba yod pa'i reg pa de'i nyams su tshor tsonas smras pa/ ci 'di'i 'og na rdo phre'u yod dam/ de rnams kyis brtag ⑩par brtsams pa na me tog gi rtsa ba zhig mthong nas de rnams mchog tu ngo mtshar ⑩skyes so/ /ma 'gags pa 0mtshan mo mi bde bzhin nyal nas nam nangs so/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ ma 'gags pa ci 4—247

ga bde ①bar gnyid log gam/ des smras pa/ lha bde bar gnyid ma log go//rgyal pos smras pa/ ci'i phyir/ ma 'gags pas smras pa/ lha rims bag ②gi dri can gyi gos bting bar me tog gi rgyasil ma bkram pa'i me tog gi rtsa bas lus gnad 0lags so/ /rgyal pos mal 'cha' ⑤ba bkug nas khyod kyis rims bag gi dri can gyi gos bting ste ci bya/ mal 'cha' ⑥bas smras pa/ lha bdag la dkor bas gtad ⑦pa lags so/ /rgyal pos dkor ba bkug nas smras pa/khyod kyis rims bag gi dri can gyi gos phog ste ⑤ci bya/ des smras pa/ lha bdag la tha ga pas gtad ⑨pa lags so/ /rgyal pos tha ga pa bkug nas smras pa/khyod kyis ci'i phyir rims bag gi 0dri can gyi yigos dbul/ tha ga pas smras pa/lha snam bu 'thag pa'i 'phro ④cung zhig lus pa na bdag rims kyis tsothobs bzhin bgyis ④pa lags so/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ gzhon nu khyod kyis ji ltar shes/des smras pa/ tsha ba'i reg pa nyams su myong bas rims bag gi dri lags so/ /rgyal po mchog tu ya mtshan skyes te smras pa/ shes ldan ma 'gags pa ni shākya skal ba tsobazang po dang ldan pa yin no/ /de nas shākya'i rgyal po bzang ldan gyis smras pa/ gzhon nu gal te kho bo rab tu byung na lha sbyin shākya rnams kyi ⑩rgyal por gyur te/ de shākya rnams la ⑩gnod par 8byed par 'gyur gyis/ ma la bdag cag thams cad 'dus la lha sbyin spro ba bskyed par bya'o zhes shākya'i rgyal po bzang ldan gyis de bkug ste/ de nas thams cad 'dus nas smras pa/ lha sbyin kho bo cag thams cad rab tu 'byung na khyod ci byed/ lha sbyin gyis bsams pa gal te rab tu mi 'byung ngo zhes smras pa dang / shākya'i rgyal po bzang ldan rab tu 'byung bar mi 'gyur gyis/ de la thabs cig bsham ⑩par bya ste bslu'o//4—248

gzhan yang bcom ldan 'das kyis gang gi ①nyi ma la n+ya gro dha'i kun dga' ra bar sgyu ma'i cho 'phrul bstan pa de'i tshe bdag blo skyes pa/ ji ltar 'di'i sgyu mas skye bo'i tshogs chen po dbang du byed pa de bzhin du bdag gis kyang dbang ②bya'o zhes bsams so snyam nas smras pa/ khyed cag rab tu 'byung na bdag ci ste 'dug /shākya'i rgyal po bzang ldan gyis bsams pa/ 'di ni brdzun du smra ba yin gyis dam 'char bcug la 'gro ba mang pos ①so sor rig par bya'o snyam mo/ /de nas rgyal pos tshig de glegs bu la bris nas grong khyer ser skya'i gzhir dril sgrogs su bcug pa/ grong khyer ser skya'i gzhi na gnas pa'i shes ldan dag nyon cig /bzang ldan dang / nam gru dang / ma 'gags pa dang / lha sbyin la sogs te shākya lnga brgya thurab tu 'byung bar 'gyur gyis/ thos par gyis la rab tu dga' ba skyed ⑤cig ces bsgo'o/ /lha sbyin gyis de thos nas sdug bsngal chen po dang yid mi bde ba skyes nas/ gal te bdag gis shākya'i rgyal po bzang ldan nges par rab tu 'byung ba ⑤shes par gyur dang bdag khas len par mi 'gyur ba zhig na/ da ⑦ni gal te rab tu ma byung na brdzun du smra ba yin no zhes rgyal srid kyang thob par mi 'gyur bas thams cad kyi thams cad du dus 'dir zad dam cis rab tu byung la bdag rab tu byung ⑧bzhin du rgyal srid bya'o snyam mo/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang 'di snyam du sems te/ shākya rnams kyi tha ma'i 'byor pa la blta'o snyam nas des grong khyer gseg ⑨ma dang gyo mo bsal/ tsan dan gyi ⑩chus chag chag btab/ gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan bsgreng / dar gyi chun 'phyang ⑩mang po dpyangs8/ shin tu dri zhim po'i pog por 8nye bar bzhag /me tog sna tshogs kyi sil mas dga' dga' ltar byed du bcug go/ /de nas shākya 4—249

brgya stong phrag du mas yongs su bskor nas grong khyer gyi sgo na ①seng ge'i khri la 'dug go/ /shākya mo dang shākya gzhon nu ma ngo mtshar skyes pa rnams kyang ②skar khung khol ma ②can dang / skar khung dang / stegs bu dag la 'dug go/ /shākya rnams kyi 'byor pa la blta ④bar 'dod pa'i skye bo'i tshogs yul sna tshogs nas lhags pa dag kyang lam po che'am⑤/ tshong 'dus dang / bzhi mdo dang /sum mdo rnams su 'dug go/ /shākya las su dag gis ni mnyes par 'gyur/su dag gis ⑥ni ⑨thugs byung bar 'gyur ba brtag pa'i phyir bram ze dang ⑤/mtshan mkhan dang / ltas mkhan dag bkug go/ /shākya rnams do shal dang /gdu 0bu dang / dpung rgyan dang / rgyan gyis brgyan pa rnams kyis pha tshudang ma dag la ⑩bltas nas so so'i ④shing rtar zhugs te phyir 'byung bar brtsams pa na/shākya'i rgyal po bzang ldan sna la byung ba mtshan mkhan rnams kyis mthong nas de dag gis smras pa/ re zhig 'dis ni mnyes par byed par 8'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du nam gru dang / ma 'gags pa la sogs pa ④phyir byung ba na 8de rnams kyang mtshan mkhan rnams kyis lung bstan to/ /de nas lha sbyin phyir byung ste/de phyir byung ba na bya khras gtsug gi nor bu phrogs pa mtshan mkhan rnams kyis mthong nas de rnams kyis smras pa/ 'di'i rtags tsodang sbyar na gdon mi za bar ston pa la 'khus nas dmyal ba la ⑩gzhol bar 'gyur ro/ /ko ka li ka dang / khaṇ+ḍa dra tsobya dang / ka ta tsomo ra ka ti gyi ⑥ dang / rgya mtshos byin ⑥rnams phyir byung steb dang tsobong bu'i skad grag nas de dag kyang mtshan mkhan rnams kyis rdzibastan pa/ 'di dag gis kyang nyan thos chen po rnams la tshig ngan pa smras nas dmyal bar gzhol bar 'gyur ro/ /nye dga' glang po che la zhon 1—250

nas ①phan tshun du lta bar byed pa na mu tig gi do ②shal lhung ba dang / de glang po che las babs te blangs so/ /de yang de rnams kyis lung bstan pa/ 'di ha cang 'dod chen ches pas sems can dmyal ba rnams su skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas bzang ldan dang / nam gru dang / ma 'gags pa dang / lha sbyin la sogs pa shākya lnga brgya po de rnams skyed mos tshal du dus ston la 'gro ba chabazhin du bzang pos 'gran ④cing bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der dong ⑤ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa/ gal te ngas shākya rnams la dge slong tshur ༅shog ces bya bas rab tu phyung na kha cig gis ni mnyes ⑦par byed par 'gyur/ kha cig gis ni mnyes ⑧par byed par mi 'gyur te/ mnyes par byed par mi 'gyur ba gang ⑨yin pa de dag gzhan du sems la/ dge slong tshur shog ces bya ba ni thams cad srid pa tha ma yin pas n+tu ma la ngas thams cad dge slong rnams kyis yigasol ba dang bzhi'i skelas kyis rab tu byung ba dang bsnyen par rdzogs su gzhug 'go snyam du dgongs nas dge slong rnams la bka' lcal pa/ dge slong dag ser skya'i gzhi'i shākya rnams gsol ba dang bzhi'i cilas kyis rab tu 'byung ba ⑫dang bsnyen par rdzogs par gyis shig /btsun pa bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes dge slong de rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das las mnyan to/ /rgyal po zas gtsang gis shākya rnams kyi 'breg ⑩mkhan nye ba tho)'khor zhes bya ba de rnams rab tu 'byin pa na skra 'breg yipar btang nas shākya'i rgyal po bzang ldan gyi skra 'breg ⑩pa na de ngom zung gnag ( )cing mchi ma 'dzag la skad 'dzer cing dbugs brdzags par skra 'breg ⑥par byed do/ /shākya'i rgyal po bzang ldan gyis smras pa/nye ba 3'khor ci'i phyir du/ de snying rje rje 0skad du gcom 'chung ngu ⑤dal bus 4—251

tshig re ①nas smras pa/ lha bdag 'dzam bu'i gling ②gi skyes bu gtso bo rnams la bsnyen bkur bgyid ⑧pa mi phal 0pa rnams la yang bsnyen bkur bgyid par ⑤'gyur ba lta zhig /khyed kyis spangs te gso na pa ⑥bas ni 'gum ⑦mi bsdo'o/ /shākya'i rgyal po bzang ldan gyis smras pa/ nye ba ⑧'khor khyod kyis jo bo la snying nye ba'i mnyes par bya ba bstan zin te/ chog gis mya ngan ma byed cig /ngas ji ltar ①mi phal pa rnams la bsnyen bkur byed par mi 'gyur ba de ltar bya'o zhes smras nas des yi phyogs gcig tu ras zhig yibating nas shākya gzhon nu rnams la smras pa/ shes ldan gzhin nu dag ston cig /'breg tsomakhan nye ba tso'akhor 'dis bdag cag la bkur ④ste byas la bdag cag kyang slar khyim du mi gnas kyis 8rgyan rnams de'i tso'atsho ba'i rkyen du ras kyi steng du zhog shigayi /de rnams kyis tho)se mo do dang / do shal dang / mgul rgyan dang / gdu bu dang /dpung rgyan dang / rna rgyan tshul sogs pa rin po che sna tshogs kyis ༅ brgyan pa'i hurgyan khyad par can rnams kyis ras kyi steng du phung po chen por spungs so/ /nye ba 0'khor gyis de rnams mthar gyis skra bregs te de rnams khrus la dong ba dang /des bsams pa/ re zhig gzhon nu 'di dag rigs dang ④/ 'byor pa dang /lang ④tsho la bab cing chung ma dang ldan la/ mdzod dang bang mdzod kyis rgyas phyepa yang spangs nas rab tu 'byung na/ bdag rgyan 'di tsam la chags pa ni tshul ma yin pas sdug bsngal bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te bdag rigs ngan du ma skyes na bdag kyang legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba 0la rab tu 'byung zhing chu bo las rgal ba dang / sbyor ba las yang dag par 'da' ⑥bar bya ba'i phyir brtsal phyeb dang 'bad pa la brtson par bya ba zhig snyam mo/ /'di ni chos nyid yin te/1—252
