chud pa'am/ rnam par mi rig pa cung zad kyang mi mnga'o/ /chos nyid kyis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa/ 'jig rten la phan par zhugs pa/ srung ba gcig pu pa/ nyag gcig dpa' ba/ zla med pa / gnyis su mi gsung ba/ zhi gnas dang / lhag mthong gis bzhugs pa/dul ①ba'i gnas gsum gyi gzhi la mkhas pa/ chu bo bzhi ②las rgal ba/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi'i duzhabs legs par gnas pa/ bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi la yun ring po nas goms pa④/ yan lag lnga spangs pa/ 'gro ba lnga las 'das pa/ yan lag drug dang ldan pa⑤/ pha rol du phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs pa/ byang chub kyi yan lag bdun gyi me tog gis phyug pa/ lam gyi yan lag brgyad ston pa/ mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu la mkhas pa / stobs bcu'i stobs dang ldan pa/ phyogs bcur snyan pas yang dag par rgyas pa brgya phrag bcur ⑥dbang sgyur ⑦ba las khyad par du 'phags pa rnams ni nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum dusangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis ⑨'jig rten la gzigs nas gang ni nyams par 'gyur⑩/ gang ni 'phel bar 'gyur/2/ gang ni gnod par 'gyur8/ gang ni nyam nga bar 'gyur8/ gang ni mi bde bar gyurathoste / gang ni gnod pa dang / nyam nga ba dang / mi bde bar gyur/gang ni ngan song la gzhol/ gang ni ngan song la 'bab/ gang ni ngan song la bab / ngas gang ni tsongan song las bslang ste mtho ris dang thar pa la gzhag ⑫par bya/ gang gi dge ba'i rtsa ba ma bskyed ⑩pa dag ni bskyed par bya/ gang gi ⑫bskyed pa dag ni yongs su smin par bya/ gang gi smin pa ni grol bar bya/zhes mkhyen pa dang yigazigs pa 'jug go/ /yang smras pa/ chu srin gnas kyi 4—351

dug can pa/ /dus las 'da' bar 'gyur srid kyi/ /sangs rgyas gdul la byams pa ni/ /dus las 'da' bar mi 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa/ gzhon nu kun dga' bo ni srid pa tha ma pa yin pas de nga'i bstan pa la rab tu 'byung ste/ rab tu byung nas nga'i rim gro byed cing gsung rab 'dzin pa dang / nga yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas bdud rtsi thob par 'gyur gyis / ma la ngas gzhon ①nu kun dga' bo bstan pa la gzhug par bya'o snyam nas ma tshor ba kho nar grong khyer ser skya'i gzhir byon nas bdud rtsi zas kyi gnas khang du gshegs ②te gdan bshams pa nyid la bzhugs so/ /bdud rtsi zas kyis gzhon nu kun dga' bo khang phran gzhan zhig gi nang du bcug ste bzhag ②go//bcom ldan 'das kyis gang gi tshe khyon sgo rang bye ⑤bar 'gyur ba ⑥de ltar byin gyis brlabs nas thog ma kho nar bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis ⑦la mgo bos phyag byas te bsil ②yab blangs nas bcom ldan 'das kyi snam logs nas ⑨bcom ldan 'das la g.yob cing 'dug go/ /de nas bdud rtsi zas kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi byazhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te phyogs gcig 0tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug tsu)pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bdud rtsi zas la chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par ston par mdzad/ yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug par mdzad/ yang dag par gzengs stod 4)par mdzad/yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad de/ rnam grangs du mar chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par bstan/ yang dag par 'dzin du bcug /yang dag par gzengs bstod(ste/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad nas gdan las bzhengs te bzhud do/ /rgyu'i stobs che yang rkyen gyi 8stobs la ltos ⑫1—352

dgos pas srid pa tha ma pa'i sems can kun dga' bo bcom ldan 'das kyi rjes bzhin rjes bzhin ①'brang ba na/ bdud rtsi ②zas chung ma'i 'khor dang bcas pas bzlog ③par ma nus pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/'di ni srid pa tha ma pa'i sems can yin pas khyed kyis bzlog par mi nus kyis ma zlog shig④ /bdud rtsi zas kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das gal te de ltar gyur na 'di la rim pa bzhin bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pal/ de bzhin du byos shig /de nas bdud rtsi bzas kyis dge sbyong dang /bram ze dang / bkren pa dang / phongs pa dang / 'gro bar chas pa'i slong ba pa ⑨rnams kyi ⑦phyir sbyin pa dag dugatong du bcug /bsod yinams dag byed du bcug /rang gi skye bo dang gnyen gyi tshogs rnams la yang bzod pa gsol du bcug nas rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan ༅te/ glang po che la zhon nas skye bo du mas yongs su bskor te/ n+ya gro dha'i kun dga' ra ba logs su phyogs te bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar btang ngo / /de yang sung gi dbus nas 7'gro ba na glang po ches ut+pa tsola'i chun po zhig zos so/ /mtshan mkhan rnams kyis mthong nas de rnams kyis smras pa/ gzhon nu 'di ni thos pa 'dzin pa rnams kyi mchog tu 'gyur ro/ /de ji tsam bzhon pa'i sa'i bar du bzhon pas song nas bzhon pa las 0babs te rkang pa kho nas n+ya gro dha'i kun dga' ra bar zhugs nas bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te phyogs gcig tu ④'dug go/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis 'od sung gzhon 8nu rab tu phyung shig ces 'od srung stobs bcu ldan la gtad tsonas des de rab tu phyung ba 8snyen par rdzogs par byas so/ /1—353

de nas bcom ldan 'das ser skya'i gzhir ①ji tsam bzhed kyi bar du bzhugs nas rgyal po'i khab gang na ba der rgyu zhing gshegs te/ rim gyis rgyu zhing gshegs pa dang rgyal po'i khab tu byon nas rgyal po'i khab 'od ma'i tshal bya ka lan da ka gnas pa na bzhugs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo'i spyi bor phol mig byung nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'tsho byed la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong kun dga' bo la dpyad byos shig /btsun pa bka' ②bzhin 'tshal zhes 'tsho byed gzhon ②nus bskyed kyis bcom ldan 'das las mnyan to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi gung la gdan ④bshams pa nyid la bzhugs nas chos 'chad ⑤do/ /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo yang chos mnyan pa'i phyir de nyid na 'dug go/ /'tsho byed gzhon ⑥nus bskyed kyis bsams pa/'di chos la dad pa bdo snubar gyur pas mi tshor gyis dpyad bya ba'i dus la bab bo snyam nas/ des de'i phol mig smin par 'gyur ba dag bskus nas de nyid du dral khyate de nyid du sos par byas so/ /de na chos bshad pa rdzogs nas 'tsho byed kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gis 'phags pa kun dga' bo 'di nyid na mchis bzhin du phol mig smin par bgyis te brtol nas sos par bgyis lags so/ /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos smras pa/ gal te bdag gi lus til 'bru tsam du gtubs ⑨par gyur kyang bdag gis mi tshor lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi ⑨ chos las byung ba'i dad pas bsam 0pa bsdus pa la 'tsho byed mchog tu ya mtshan skyes so/ /dge slong rnams the tshom skyes nas the tshom thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos las ci zhig bgyis na/ des na spyi bor phol mig ⑫4—354

byung bar gyur lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag dge slong kun dga' bo 'di nyid ①kyis las byas shing bsags ②pa dag ni zhes bya ba nas/ lus can dag la 'bras bur 'gyur zhes ③bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /dge slong dag ⑤sngon byung ba yul mtha' 'khob cig na rgyal po ki ra ta zhes bya ba gnas so/ /sangs rgyas rnams 'byung ba med pa na 'jig rten du rang sangs rgyas dman pa dang ngan pa la snying brtse ⑤ba can/ bas mtha'i gnas mal la dga' ba/ 'jig rten gyi yon gnas gcig pu pa dag 'byung bar 'gyur bas de nas rang sangs rgyas zhig de ⑥der rgyu ba na ki ra ta'i grong khyer du phyin nas de der bsod snyoms kyi phyir ki ra ta'i rgyal po'i khyim du zhugs pa dang / de de la mi bzod pa skyes te sems gdug ⑦pas 'jim ril gyi ngan kong gis rgyab tu bsnun pa las bdag nyid chen po de byadregs pa dang nga rgyal bcom pa yin pas de snod du ma gyur par 0shes nas song ngo / /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems / ki ra ta'i rgyal po gang yin pa de ni dge slong kun dga' bo de 0nyid yin te/ gang 'dis rang sangs rgyas la mi bzod pa skyes te zlosems gdug pas 'jim ril gyi ngan kong gis rgyab tu bsnun pa de'i las kyi rnam par smin pas tshe rabs lnga brgyar gang dang gang du skyes pa de dang der spyi bor phol mig byung bar gyur to/ /'di ltar da ltar 'di'i srid pa tha ma la yang spyi bor phol mig byung ngo / /gang gi tshe tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo bcom ldan 'das dang thabs cig 4)'gro ba de'i tshe (sprebacom ldan 'das la lhag par dad pa dang /gus pa dang / khrel yod pa dang / ngo tsha shes pa dang / 'dzem pa nyid kyis nye bar gnas so/ /gang gi tshe sprul pa yin na ni dad pa dang / gus pa dang /4—355

ngo tsha shes pa dang / khrel yod pa dang / 'dzem pa de 'dra ba dag gis ①mi gnas so/ /ji tsam na khyim bdag cig gis sangs rgyas la sogs ②pa dge slong gi dge 'dun rang gi khyim du gdugs tshod la spyan drangs pa dang / bcom ldan 'das snga dro na bza' sham thabs mnabs lhung bzed dang chos gos bsnams te dge slong gi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor cing dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi mdun ②gyis bltas nas khyim bdag de'i khyim du gshegs te/ gdugs tshod gsol nas slar gshegs so/ /dge slong rnams kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la dris pa/tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo ci de ring khyod bcom ldan 'das dang thabs cig byasong ngam/ 'on te sprul pa dang / des smras pa/ bcom ldan 'das dang thabs cig 'usong gis 'usangs rgyas kyi sprul pa dang ni ma yin no/ /ci mngon gang gi tshe kho bo bcom ldan 'das dang thabs cig 2'gro ba de'i tshe bdag bcom ldan 'das la lhag par dad pa dang / gus pa dang / ngo tsha shes pa dang khrel yod pa dang / 'dzem pas nye bar gnas pa yin no/ /gang gi tshe sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa yin pa de'i tshe de ltar mi 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag phan tshun smras pa/tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo ni mtshan ma la mkhas so/ /phyogs dang phyogs mtshams rnams su dge slong kun dga' bo mtshan ma la mkhas so zhes bya ba'i dusgra bsgrags so//de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 2rgyal po'i khab tu ji tsam bzhed kyi bar du bzhugs nas mnyen nyu )yod gang na ba derngo rgyu zhing gshegs te/ rim gyis rgyu zhing gshegs pa dang mnyan yod du byon nas mnyan yod na rgyal bu sgrol byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de nas tshe dang 4—356

ldan pa kun dga' bo snga dro sham thabs bgos chos gos dang lhung bzed thogs nas mnyan yod du bsod snyoms kyi phyir zhugs pa bram ze zhig gis mthong nas bsams pa/ dge sbyong gau ta ma'i nyan thos dge slong kun dga' bo mtshan ma la mkhas so/ /zhes thos pa gang yin pa de ni 'di yin gyis re zhig shing sha pa zhes bya ba ①'di la 'dab ②ma du yod pa dri'o snyam nas des de la dris pa/'phags pa shing sha pa 'di la 'dab ②ma ji snyed mchis/ des smras pa/ brgya dang / stong dang / khri phrag 'di snyed yod do zhes smras nas song ngo bram ze des de la lo ma dag cig btogs ④nas bgrangs te bor ro/ /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos bsod snyoms spyad ⑤de slar log pa dang / bram ze des yang smras pa/ 'phags pa da ltar shing sha pa 'di la 'dab ⑥ma ji snyed mchis mkhyen tam / des smras pa/ sngar ni brgya dang / stong dang / khri ⑦mog 'di snyed yod pa las de las 'di khyasnyed cig btogs so/ /bram ze de 'phags pa ni rtsis la yang de ltar mkhas pa lta zhes mchog tu ngo mtshar skyes so/ /dge slong rnams the tshom skyes nas the tshom thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos las ci zhig bgyis na des na mtshan ma la mkhas par gyur lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/dge slong dag dge slong kun dga' bo 'di ①nyid kyis las byas shing bsags pa dag ni zhes bya ba nas/ lus can dag la 'bras bur 'gyur zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba bā rā ṇa sī na bram ze zhig yod pa des rigs mnyam pa las chung ma blangs te/ de de dang lhan cig rtse bar byed/dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed do/ /de rtse bar byed/4—357

dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed pa las khye'u zhig btsas te zhag bdun gsum nyi shu ①gcig tu de btsas pa'i btsas ston rgya cher byas te rigs dang mthun pa'i ming btags nas gsos ②bskyed de chen por gyur to/ /de yul gzhan dudu song ste mtshan ma'i bstan chos drug khri bslabs so/ /de bzhin du tshe rabs lnga brgya'i bar du 'khor ba na 'khor ba'i tshe mtshan ma'i bstan chos drug khri bslabs shing gzhan la ④yang bstan pa'i rgyu de dang rkyen des gang dang gang du skyes pa de dang der mtshan mkhan rnams kyi mchog tu byung ngo / /'di ltar da ltar gyi srid pa tha ma gyel yang mtshan mkhan rnams kyi mchog tu byung ngo / /ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal la yang 'unyi ma re re zhing dro ku'i dus su gzhong par 'bras sā lu'i chan dang / bu ram shing gi sdong bu zhig dang / sreg pa gnyis lhung la de gnyis las gcig ni gzhong pa'i steng du 'bab/ cig 3shos ni sa la'o / /des tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la rig par byas te/ des kyang dge slong rnams la'o/ /dge slong rnams the tshom skyes nas the tshom thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis las ci zhig bgyis na/ des na 'tshal thuma'i dus su gzhong par 'bras sā lu'i chan dang / bu ram shing gi sdong bu nyu zhig dang / sreg pa gnyis lhung la/ de gnyis las gcig kyi ni gzhong pa'i steng du 'bab/ cig skyeshos ni sa la lhung bar gyur lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/dge slong dag ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal 'di nyid kyis sngon gyi tshe rabs gzhan 8dag tu las byas shing bsags te/ des na 'di'i zas kyi dus su gzhong par 'bras sā lu'i chan dang / bu ram shing gi sdong bu dang / sreg pa gnyis lhung ⑫4—358

la / de gnyis las gcig ni gzhong pa'i steng du 'bab/ cig ①shes ni sa la lhung bar gyur pa ni dge slong dag sngon byung ba grong khyer bā rā ṇa sī na khyim bdag phyug cing nor mang la ②longs spyod che ba zhig gnas te/ de'i mngag gzhug ①pa rnams kyis zhing pa'i grong nas 'bras sā lu sar pa zhig dang / sreg pa gnyis dang / bu ram shing gi sdong bu ④zhig khyer te 'ongs so/ /sangs rgyas rnams 'byung ba med pa na 'jig rten du rang sangs rgyas dman pa ⑤dang ngan pa la ⑥snying brtse ba can/ bas mtha'i gnas mal la dga' ba/ 'jig rten gyi yon gnas gcig ⑦phu pa dag 'byung bar 'gyur bas de ④nas rang sangs rgyas zhig bā rā ṇa sīr 'ongs nas de snga dro na bza' 0sham thabs bgos chos gos dang lhung bzed thogs te bsod snyoms la khyim bdag de'i khyim du zhugs pa na des de lus de ⑩mdzes pa dang / sems dad par mthong nas des der de la thog mar lo tog sar pa 'on cig ces byas yinas 'bras sā lu'i chan dang / bu ram shing gi sdong bu zhig dang / sreg pa gnyis phul ba las/ de las gcig ni lhung bzed du 0lhung ngo / /cig 0shos ni sa la'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus kyi khyim bdag gang yin pa de ni rgyal po gsal rgyal 'di nyid yin te/ 'dis rang sangs rgyas la 'bras sā lu'i chan dang / bu ram shing gi sdong bu dang / sreg pa gnyis phul ba de'i las kyi rnam par smin pas lo mang po dang / lo brgya phrag mang po dang / lo stong phrag mang po dang / lo brgya stong phrag mang por mi'i bde ba nyams su myong ngo / /da ltar yang 'di'i zas kyi dus su gzhong par 'bras sā lu'i chan dang / bu ram shing gi sdong bu dang / sreg pa gnyis lhung stethoste/1—359

de las gcig ①ni gzhong pa'i steng du lhung la/ cig 0shos ①ni sa la'o/ /ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis dubacom ldan 'das kyis bdag gi las kyi ⑤rgyu ba gcig lung bstan pas sngon gyi mtha'i ni ⑥las kyi rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu ni yod do snyam du rig nas nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa la mngon par dad ⑦de de ltar las kyi rnam par smin pa la yid ches pa'i blo gros kyis gnas so/ /ltas mkhan rnams kyis 'phags pa kun dga' bo ni cod pan gyis bcings ⑤par 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan pas ci 0tsam nam nangs pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo'i 'phral ⑩bar phol mig byung ngo zhes ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis thos nas de 'di snyam du ⑨sems te/ yon gnas rnams la bya ba byas na ⑫bsod nams kyi 'bras bu tsokhyad par med par mi 'gyur bas ma la bdag gis 'di la rang nyid kyis bkur snyi 4)bya'o snyam nas/ des sman pa thams cad bkug ste/ 'phags pa kun dga' bo'i dpyad gyis shig /de'i dpyad gsal ba na bya bar brtsams pa dang / ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la rang nyid kyis rtsibs brgya yod pa'i gdugs bzung ④zhing /'phral ⑩ba'i rtsa 'debs ⑩pa na cod pan gyis bcings so/ /dge slong rnams the tshom skyes nas the tshom thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa / btsun pa tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos las ci zhig bgyis na las de'i rnam par smin pas ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis tshe dang ldan pa kun tsodaga' bo la rang nyid kyis 7rtsibs brgya mchis pa'i gdugs bzung du zhing rang nyid kyis ( cod pan dkar pos bcings te bsnyen bkur 'bagyis lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag dge slong kun dga' bo 'di nyid 4—360

kyis sngon gyi tshe rabs gzhan dag tu las byas shing bsags ①pa ②dag ni zhes bya ba nas/ lus can dag la 'bras bur 'gyur zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o / /dge slong dag sngon byung ba bā rā ṇa sī na sman pa zhig gnas pa'i drung du rang sangs rgyas nad pa zhig song ba dang / des de la yo byad thams cad kyis bstabs ②te rang nyid kyis sman dpyad dang bkur sti ④byas so/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus kyi sman pa gang ⑤yin pa de ni dge slong kun dga' bo 'di nyid yin te/ de na 'dis rang sangs rgyas la bya ba byas nas smon lam btab ⑥pa de'i las kyi rnam par smin pas lo brgya phrag du ma ⑦dang /lo stong phrag du mar rgyal po dang / blon po dang / bram ze dang / khyim bdag rnams kyis 'di la bsnyen bkur ⑧byas so/ /ji ltar da ltar kyang ⑨'di la ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis rtsibs brgya yod pa'i gdugs spyi bor bzung zhing rang nyid kyis bsnyen bkur byas so//de nas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na ji tsam bzhed kyi bar du bzhugs nas shing sā la can gang na ba der rgyu zhing gshegs te/ rim gyis rgyu zhing gshegs pa dang sā la can du byon nas sā la can gyi bram ze'i grong khyer na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe 'di lta bu'i nyan thos chen po gnas brtan gnas brtan ⑩rnams bcom ldan 'das kyi nye 0'khor na nye bar brten ⑩cing tso'adug pa 8'di lta ste/ tshe dang ldan pa kun shes kauṇ+ḍi n+ya dang / tshe dang ldan pa rta thul dang /bzang ldan dang / rlangs pa dang / ming chen dang / grags pa dang /gang po dang / dri ma med pa dang / ba lang bdag dang / lag bzangs ⑫dang / tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu dang / tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen 1—361

po dang / tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen po dang / tshe dang ldan pa gsus po che dang / tshe dang ldan pa ka pi na chen po dang / tshe dang ldan pa ma 'gags pa dang / dga' ①yod dang / kim pi ②la dang / sa la na ⑧gnas pa'i gnas brtan grags ldan dang / yul chu mig can na gnas pa'i gnas brtan gang po dang / de dag dang gzhan yang gnas brtan nyan thos chen po rnams bcom ldan 'das ④kyi nye 'khor na nye bar brten te gnas sol// //'dul ba gzhiyi/ bam po dgu bcu rtsa 0drug pa/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag da ni nga durgas 'khogs gtugs te 'khor bzhi 0po tho byedage slong dang / dge slong ma dang /dge bsnyen yidang / dge bsnyen 'am la gdams ngag dbog tu dub kyis dge slong dag nga'i rim gro la 'thugs la mi 'thad pa ma yin gyi thugs la 'thad pas rim gro byed cing bka' stsal pa 'dzin pa dang / rang gi don yang nyams par mi 'gyur ba'i dge slong zhig spro ba skyed cig /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun tsoshes kauṇ+ḍi n+ya stan khrulas langs te bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba de tsologs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bdag bcom ldan 'das la thugs la mi 'thad pa ma lags kyi/ thugs la 'thad pas rim gro bgyid cing bka' stsal pa 'dzin pa dang / rang gi don yang nyams par mi 'gyur ba lags so/ /kauṇ+ḍi n+ya khyod re zhig rgas 'khogs gtugs pas khyod nyid la rim gro ba dgos kyis 0re zhig kauṇ+ḍi n+ya khyod nyid kyi stan ji lta ba bzhin la 'dug shigatso /tshe dang ldan pa kun shes kauṇ+ḍi n+ya rang gi stan ji lta ba la 'dug go/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa rta thul 4—362

dang / bzang ldan dang / rlangs pa dang / ming chen dang / grags pa dang / gang po dang / dri ma med pa dang / ba lang bdag dang / lag bzangs ①dang / tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu dang / tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po dang / tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen po dang / tshe dang ldan pa gsus po che dang / tshe dang ldan pa ka pi na ②chen po dang / tshe dang ldan pa ma 'gags ②pa dang / dga' yod dang / ki ma pi dul dang / sa la na ⑤gnas pa'i gnas brtan grags pa dang / yul chu mig can gyi gnas brtan ⑥gang po stan las langs te bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas bcom ldan 'das gang na ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bdag ni bcom ldan 'das la thugs la mi 'thad pa ma lags kyi thugs la 'thad pas rim gro bgyid cing / bka' stsal pa 'dzin pa dang / bdag gi don yang nyams par mi 'gyur ba lags so/ /gang po khyod kyang rgas 'khogs gtugs te/ khyod nyid la rim gro ba dgos kyis re zhig gang po khyod nyid kyi stan ⑦ji lta ba bzhin la 'dug shigal /tshe dang ldan pa ⑨gang po rang gi stan ji lta ba la 'dug go/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po 'di snyam du sems te/ bcom ldan 'das dge slong gang zhig rim gro par bzhed par 'gyur/ ma la bdag gis ji ltar sems mnyam par gzhag na bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs la lta bar 'gyur ba de lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par 'jug par bya'o snyam mo/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos ji ltar sems mnyam par bzhag na bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs la lta bar 'gyur ba de lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs 0te/ tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi 1—363

bu chen pos bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs la bltas na nga'i rim gro dge slong kun dga' bos byas na thugs la mi 'thad pa ma yin gyi thugs la 'thad pa dang /bka' stsal pa 'dzin pa dang / rang gi don yang nyams par mi 'gyur ba yin no zhes ①bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la gtad pa ②mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang ting nge 'dzin de las langs te tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu shes par gyis shig/bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs ⑤la bltas na dge slong kun dga' bos nga'i rim gro byas na thugs la mi 'thad ④pa ma yin gyi thugs la 'thad pa dang / bka' stsal pa 'dzin pa dang / rang gi don yang nyams par mi 'gyur ba yin no zhes snom dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la gtad do/ /dper na khang pa brtsegs pa'am/khang pa brtsegs pa'i khyams byang phyogs su ring ba shar phyogs su skar khung btod ⑥pa / shar phyogs su ⑦skar khung nas nyi ma'i 'od zer shar ba nub phyogs kyi rtsig pa'i ngos la 'bab pa de bzhin du nga'i rim gro ⑧dge slong kun dga' bos byas na thugs la mi 'thad pa ma yin gyi thugs la 'thad pa dang / bka' stsal pa 'dzin pa dang ⑨/ rang gi don yang nyams par mi 'gyur ba yin no zhes bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la gtad kyis tshur bdag cag dong la spro bar bya'o/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu dang / tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo gang na ba der song ste phyin nas/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo dang lhan cig mngon du yang dag par dga' ba dang / yang dag par mgu bar 'gyur ba'i gtam rnam pa sna tshogs byas te/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu dang / mod gal gyi bu gnyis 1—364

phyogs gcig ①tu 'khod do/ /phyogs gcig ②tu 'khod nas/ de nas tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo khyod bcom ldan 'das ②kyi rim gro par spro'am/bde bar gshegs pa la bsnyen bkur bya ba ni khyod la don chen por 'gyur ro/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu bcom ldan 'das kyi rim gro par bdag mi spro'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ④ni bsnyen par dka' ⑤zhing bzod ⑥par dka' ⑦ba yin no/ /'di lta ste dper na me 'bar ba'i me phrag ni bsnyen par dka' ⑤zhing bzod par dka' ⑨ba yin no/ /de bzhin du sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyang bsnyen par dka' (bye zhing bzod par dka' (7bas bcom ldan 'das kyi rim gro par bdag mi spro'o/ /'di lta ste dper na gcan gzan 8gyi rgyal po seng ge ri phug na gnas pa'i so phrag ni bsnyen par dka' yizhing bzod par dka' ba yin no/ /de bzhin du sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyang bsnyen par dka' zhing bzod par dka' ba yin no/ /'di lta ste dper na ma tang ga'i glang po che'i rgyal po lo drug bcu lon pa dar la bab pabya/ grags pa/ mche ba gshol mda' tsam yod pa/ brang gi phel ka che ba/ g.yul myong ba/ g.yul ngor son pa'i mche ba'i phrag ni bsnyen par dka' zhing bzod par dka' ba yin no/ /de bzhin du sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyang bsnyen par dka' zhing bzod par dka' tshubs tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu bcom ldan 'das kyi rim gro par bdag mi spro'o/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa shes par gyis shig /bcom ldan 'das ni 4—365

nga'i rim gro dge slong kun dga' bos byas na thugs la mi 'thad pa ma yin gyi thugs la 'thad pa dang / bka' stsal pa 'dzin pa dang ①/ rang gi don yang nyams par mi 'gyur ro zhes tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la thugs gtad ②de dper na khang pa brtsegs pa'am/ khang pa brtsegs pa'i khyams byang phyogs su ring ba shar phyogs su skar khung btod ③pa shar phyogs kyi skar byakhung nas nyi ma'i 'od zer shar ba nub phyogs kyi rtsig ⑤pa'i ngos la 'bab pa de bzhin du bcom ldan 'das ni nga'i rim gro dge slong kun dga' bos byas na thugs la mi 'thad pa ma yin gyi ༅thugs la 'thad pa dang / bka' stsal pa 'dzin pa ⑦dang / rang gi don yang nyams par mi 'gyur ro zhes tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la thugs gtad na tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo khyod bcom ldan 'das kyi rim gro par spro'am / bde bar gshegs pa la bsnyen dubakur bya ba ni khyod la don chen por 'gyur ro/ /tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu bdag gis de bzhin du bgyi ste/bcom ldan 'das kyi rim gro bgyi bar ⑨spro bar bgyid ⑨ na/ gal te bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag la mchog gsum po bcom ldan 'das kyi na bza' smad g.yogs yidang chos gos bdag gis mi bcang 8ba dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi phyir gang zag pa'i mgron 'du 'bod na bdag gis 8bdag gir mi bya ba dang /bdag bcom ldan 'das blta ba tsodang / bkur sti bya ba'i phyir nye bar 'gro ba la dus ma yin pa cung zad kyang med par gnang ngam/ tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po gal te bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag la mchog gsum gnang ba lta na bdag de bzhin du bcom ldan 'das kyi rim gro bgyid par spro'i gzhan du na ma lags so/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po dang / tshe dang ldan 4—366

pa shā ri'i bus tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo bcom ldan 'das kyi rim gro par spro ba bskyed nas/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der dong ①ste phyin pa dang ②/bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te phyogs gcig ②tu 'khod do/ /phyogs gcig ⑦tu 'khod nas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyi ⑤rim gro bgyid ⑥pa'i dge slong bdag cag gis spro ba bskyed pa ni 'di lta ste/tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo lags na/ de'i mchid nas 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po bdag gis de bzhin du bcom ldan 'das kyi rim gro bgyid par spro bar bgyi na/ gal te bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag la mchog gsum po bcom ldan 'das kyi na bza' smad g.yogs dang chos gos bdag gis mi bcang ⑦ba dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi phyir gang zag pa'i mgron 2du 'bod na bdag gis bdag gir mi bya ba dang / bdag bcom ldan 'das la blta ba dang bkur sti bya ba'i phyir nye bar 'gro ba ②dus ma yin pa cung zad kyang med pa rkyeganang ngam/ gal te bcom ldan 'das kyis khyabadag la mchog gsum gnang ba lta na bdag de bzhin du bcom ldan 'das kyi rim gro bgyid par spro'o zhes mchi lags so/ /mod gal gyi bu chen po legs so legs so/ /dge slong kun dga' bo ni mkhas pa yin te/ des ma 'ongs pa na tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa rnams las rtsod cing rjes su rtsod pa smad pa'i gnas kyi 4)chos 'byung la/gzhi hu)'dis bdag la tshangs pa mtshungs (srepar spyod pa rnams dge slong kun dga' bo ni chos gos kyi rgyus ston pa la bkur thonyesti byed do zhes kha zer bar 'gyur ba mthong ste/ mod gal gyi bu 'di ni dge slong kun dga' bo'i ngo mtshar 4—367

rmad du byung ba'i chos yin no/ /mod gal gyi bu legs so/ /legs so/ /dge slong kun dga' bo ni mkhas pa yin te/ des ma 'ongs pa ①na tshangs pa mtshungs ②par spyod pa rnams las ①rtsod cing rjes su rtsod pa'i ④mad pa'i gnas kyi chos 'byung la/ gzhi 'dis bdag la tshangs pa mtshungs ⑤par spyod pa rnams dge slong kun dga' bo ni kha zas kyi rgyus ston pa la bkur ste byed do zhes kha zer bar 'gyur ba mthong ste/ mod gal gyi bu 'di ni dge slong kun dga' bo'i ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i chos yin no/ /mod gal gyi bu legs so legs so/ /dge slong kun dga' bo ni mkhas pa yin te/ dus shes shing dus rig pas de 'di ni bdag gis bcom ldan 'das la ⑥blta ba'i phyir 'gro ba'i dus yin/'di ni dus ma yin/ 'di ni dge slong gi dge 'dun dang / dge slong ma'i dge 'dun dang / dge bsnyen ⑦gyi 'khor dang / dge bsnyen ⑧ma'i 'khor gyi dus yin/ 'di ni gzhan mu stegs can dang ⑨/ kun tu rgyu dag bcom ldan 'das la blta ba'i phyir 'gro ba'i dus yin/ 'di ni dus ma yin/ gzhan mu stegs can dang / kun tu rgyu 'di dag ni bcom ldan 'das kyi ⑨ bka' la spobs pa dang ldan par 'gyurabi/ 'di dag ni 8bka' la spobs pa dang ldan par mi 'gyur/ bza' ba dang bca' ba tso'adi ni bcom ldan 'das la bde ba skyed par 'gyur/ 'di ni bde ba skyed pa ma 8yin no 8zhes shes/ te/ mod gal gyi bu dge slong kun dga' bo ni mkhas pa yin te0/ dus shes shing dus rig pas de 'di ni bdag gis bcom ldan 'das la blta ba'i phyir 'gro ba'i dus yin no0/ /'di ni dus ma yin no/ /'di ni dge slong gi dge 'dun dang /dge slong ma'i dge 'dun dang / dge bsnyen 'gyi 'khor dang / dge bsnyen ⑪4—368

ma'i 'khor gyi dus yin no/ /'di ni gzhan mu stegs can dang / kun tu rgyu dag bcom ldan 'das la blta ①ba'i phyir 'gro ba'i dus yin no/ /'di ni dus ma yin no/ /gzhan mu stegs can dang / kun tu rgyu 'di dag ni bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' ②la spobs pa dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /'di dag ni bka' la spobs pa dang ldan par mi 'gyur ro/ /bza' ba dang bca' ba 'di ni bcom ldan 'das la bde ba skyed par 'gyur ro/ /'di ni bde ba skyed pa ma yin no zhes shes pa gang yin pa 'di ni mod gal gyi bu dge slong kun dga' bo'i ngo mtshar rmad ②du byung ba'i chos yin no/ /mod gal gyi bu legs so legs so/ /dge slong kun dga' bo ni mkhas pa yin no/ /de sems kyi rnam grangs la mkhas pa yin te/ de bzhin gshegs pa phyi ma 'bred thunang du yang dag 'jog las bzhengs pa mtshan ma'am gsung ⑤bstan pas shes par 'gyur zhing bde ba'i gnas pa 'di dang 'dis ⑥bcom ldan 'das mang du bzhugs so/ /gnas pa 'di dang 'dis bde bar gshegs pa mang du bzhugs so zhes ston par 'dod na ji skad bstan ⑦pa de dag thams cad de bzhin du 'gyur te/ gzhan 0du mi 'gyur ba gang yin pa 'di ni mod gal gyi bu dge slong kun dga' bo'i rmad du byung ba'i chos yin te/ des de bzhin gshegs pa'i rim gro byas na thugs la mi 'thad pa ma yin gyi thugs la 'thad pa dang / bka' stsal pa 'dzin pa dang /rang gi don yang nyams par mi 'gyur ro/ /mod gal gyi bu de bzhin gshegs pa'i rim gro dge slong kun dga' bos byas na thugs la mi 'thad pa ma yin gyi thugs la 'thad pa dang / bka' stsal pa 'dzin pa dang / rang gi don yang nyams par mi 'gyur ba gang yin pa 'di ni dge slong kun dga' bo'i rmad du byung 1—369

ba'i chos yin no/ /gang gi tshe tshe dang ldan pa shā ①ri'i bu dang / mod gal gyi bu gnyis kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo bcom ldan 'das kyi rim gro par spro ba bskyed pa na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis rjes su bsngags pa mdzad pa ②de'i tshe dge slong rnams the tshom skyes nas the tshom thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos ②las ci zhig bgyis na las de'i rnam par smin pas bcom ldan 'das kyi mched du gyur cing thos pa mang ba dang / thos pa 'dzin pa dang / thos pa bsags pa'i rim gro par gyur lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag dge slong kun dga' bo 'di nyid kyis las byas shing bsags ④pa dag ni zhes bya ba nas/ lus can dag la 'bras bur ⑤'gyur zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o / /dge slong dag sngon byung ba grong khyer bā rā ṇa sī na rgyal po 'od zer zhes bya ba 'byor pa dang zhes bya ba nas/ skye bo dang / mi mang po yod pa na rgyal srid byed du 'jug ste zhes bya ba'i bar du ste/ de ⑥btsun mo dang lhan cig rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed do༅/ /de rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed pa las ⑧khye'u zhig btsas te de'i btsas pa'i ⑨btsas ston rgya cher byas nas khye'u'i ming cir gdags zhes ming 'dogs par byed do/ /blon po rnams kyis smras pa/ 'di'i yab 'od zer lags pas de'i slad du khye'u'i ming 'od zer 0can du gdags so ⑩zhes de'i ming 'od zer can du btags nas/ bsrings bskyed de chen por gyur pa dang phas rgyal tshab 8tu dbang tsobaskur to/ /yang de rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed / dga' mgur spyod par byed pa na khye'u zhig btsas nas de'i yang ④btsas 4—370 3

ston rgya cher byas te 'od zer ldan zhes bya bar ①ming btags so/ /②gzhon nu 'od zer can nges par 'byung ba la mngon par dga' zhing des ②pha chos dang chos ma yin pas rgyal srid byed du 'jug pa mthong nas des bsams pa/bdag kyang yab 'das nas rgyal por 'gyur te bdag gis kyang chos dang chos ma yin pas rgyal srid byed du bcug nas dmyal bar gzhol bar 'gyur ro snyam nas/de pa'i drung du song ste byarkang pa gnyis la gtugs nas smras pa/ lha mkhyen par mdzad du gsol/ rab tu 'byung lags so/ /des smras pa/ bu gang gi don du mchod sbyin mchod par byed/ sbyin bsreg sreg ⑥par byed/ dka' thub kyis gdung bar byed pa'i rgyal srid de khyod kyi lag tu 'ongs na ⑦ci'i phyir rab tu 'byung zhes de bzlog kyang ma btub po/ /rgyal pos gdon mi za bar gal gyis 'chu bar shes nas gnang ba dang / de drang srong rnams kyi nang du song ste rab tu byung ngo / /rgyal pos dugazhon nu 'od zer ldan rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur to/ /'od zer can drang srong rnams kyi nang du rab tu phyung ⑨ste/ mtha' gcig tu song nas mkhan po med pa dang / slob dpon med par rang byang chub mngon sum du byas so/ /de dus gzhan zhig na nad kyis thebs par gyur nas phan tshun 'khyam ⑩pa na bā rā ṇa srir phyin to/ /rgyal po 'od zer gyis 'od zer can rang byang chub mngon sum du byas te de ⑩der 'ongs so zhes thos nas de 8de'i drung du 'ong 8ste rkang pa ④la gtugs blanas smras pa/ drang srong chen po khyod ni bsod ⑩snyoms don du gnyer ba lags la/ bdag ni bsod tshunams 'tshal ba lags kyis bdag gi skyed mos tshal tso'adi nyid du bzhugs 7shig dang khyod la bdag gis yo byad thams cad kyis mi brel bar bgyi'o/ /des khas blangs pa dang rgyal pos 4—371

de'i rim gro par gzhon nu 'od zer ldan ①byin te des de'i rim gro bya rgyab la zhugs pa na rang sangs rgyas kyis de zhag bdun na 'chi bar 'gyur ba'i mtshan smin pa mthong nas des de la smras pa/ nu bo ci'i phyir rab tu mi 'byung /des smras pa/ drang srong chen po rab tu 'byung ngo / /gal te de ltar gyur na solnge la yab la ①rtogs shig /de rgyal po'i drung du song nas lha mkhyen par mdzad du gsol/ bdag rab tu 'byung lags so/ /rgyal pos smras pa/khyod kyi phu bo rab tu byung bas nga 'das na ④khyod kho na rgyal po yin na ci'i phyir rab tu 'byung zhes des ⑤rab tu 'byung ba ⑥ma thob bo/ /rang sangs rgyas de nyid rgyal po'i drung du song ste ⑦song nas tshigs su bcad pas dusmras pa/ 'od zer 'od zer ldan thong ⑨dang / /'od zer ldan pa rab tu 'byung / /'od zer rab tu byung ⑩ba legs/ /'di ltar rgyal ba rnams kyis 7bsngags/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ drang srong chen po khyod rab tu byung bas de ni bdag 'das na rgyal por 'gyur te 'di nyid du sbyin pa dag stsol ba dang / bsod nams dag bgyid par 'gyur na ci'i phyir rab tu 'byung tso/ rang sangs rgyas kyis tshigs su bcad 8de smras pa/ 'od zer tshe ④ni cung zhig ste/ /re ④ltar thogs na zhag bdun nyid//don gzhan ched du bsams ⑩bsam pa/ /gzhan tshunyid du ni yongs su 'gyur/ /drang srong chen po 'di'i tshe zhag bdun lags sam/ rang sangs rgyas kyis smras pa/zhag bdun yin no/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ drang srong chen po gal te de lta na gnang bar bgyis rab tu phyung shig /de bdag la tshe cung zhig yod par shes nas dad pa drag pos de la bkur sti bya bar brtsams so/ /rang sangs rgyas de rlung nad can zhig pas des lhung bzed lag tu blangs nas za ba na rlung gis lag 1—372

pa 'dar bar gyur to/ /de nas rgyal bu ①gzhon nu de ②gdu bu phyung nas lhung bzed kyi gzhir bzhag pa dang de la lhung bzed mi g.yo bar 'dug go/ /des de mthong nas smon lam gdab ②par brtsams pa/ ji ltar 'di la lhung bzed ④mi g.yo ba de bzhin du dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis bdag gi rgyud la chos ci yod pa de dag mi g.yo bar gnas par gyur cig ces btab po/ /de ⑤de la sngon yi ge dang tshig ran pa ⑥ran par chos 'chad pa yin pas des smras pa/ khyod sngon khyim par gyur pa na yi ge dang tshig ran pa ran par chos 'chad pa ⑦lags na/ da rang byang chub mngon sum du bgyis na ci'i phyir chos mi bshad/ des smras pa/kho bo chos mi 'chad ⑤do/ /'o na su 'chad lags/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams gang yin pa ste/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag ni tshig dang yi ge ran pa ⑨ran par chos 'chad do//des smon lam btab pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das tshig ⑩dang yi ge ran pa skeran par chos 'chad pa gang yin pa de'i mched dang rim gro par bdag gyur cig ces btab po/ /rang sangs rgyas des tsorab tu phyung nas smras pa/ khyod zhag bdun 'das nas 'chi bar 'gyur ba de kho na khyod kyis yid la byos shig /des zhag bdun lon na cung zad kyang ma rtogs nas de'i tso'achi ba'i tshe smon lam btab pa④/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis bdag bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de'i bstan 8pa la rab tu byung nas thos pa mang ba dang / thos pa 'dzin pa dang / thos pa bsags par gyur cig ces btab po/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ rgyal bu tsogazhon nu rang sangs rgyas kyi nu bor gyur pa gang yin pa ⑩de ni dge slong kun 4—373

dga' bo 'di nyid yin te/ de na yang 'dis rang sangs rgyas phu bo shos kyi rim gro byas nas smon lam btab pa de'i las kyi rnam par smin pas bcom ldan 'das kyi ①mched du gyur cing / thos pa mang ba dang ②/ thos pa 'dzin pa thos pa bsags ②pa'i rim gro par gyur to/ /dge slong rnams the tshom skyes nas the tshom thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos las ci zhig bgyis na las de'i rnam par smin pas bcom ldan 'das kyis thos pa mang ba/ thos pa 'dzin pa④/ thos pa bsags pa rnams kyi mchog tu bstan rgyalags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/dge slong dag dge slong kun dga' bo 'di nyid kyis las byas shing bsags pa dang tshogs rnyed pa ni zhes bya ba nas/ lus can dag la 'bras bur 'gyur zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba bskal pa bzang po 'di nyid la skye dgu rnams kyi tshe lo nyi ༅khri thub pa na yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa zhes bya ba nas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'od srung zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ste zhes bya ba'i bar du ste/de grong khyer bā rā ṇa sīr nye bar brten ⑦nas drang srong smra ba ri dgas kyi nags na bzhugs so/ /de'i bstan pa la 'di rab tu byung na de na 'dis yon tan gyi tshogs cung zad kyang ma thob pos/ /'di ⑨rab tu 'byin pa gang yin pa de ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'od sung gis thos pa mang ba0 / thos pa 'dzin pa0/ thos pa bsags pa rnams kyi mchog tu lung bstan ④pa yin pas de 'chi ba'i tshe smon lam btab pa/ bdag gis yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das yon gnas bla na med pa 'od srung 4—374

la tshe ji srid par chotshangs par spyod pa spyad ②na yon tan gyi tshogs cung zad kyang ma thob kyis/ dge ba'i rtsa ba gang yin pa 'dis bdag yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ③'od srung gis bram ze'i khye'u bla ma zhes bya ba gang yin pa de la bram ze'i khye'u khyod skye dgu rnams kyi tshe lo brgya thub pa na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub par 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan pa de'i bstan ④pa la bdag rab tu byung nas nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs te dgra bcom pa mngon sum du byas nas ji ltar bdag gi mkhan po yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'od srung gis thos pa mang ba⑤/ thos pa 'dzin pa/ thos pa bsags pa rnams kyi mchog tu lung bstan pa de bzhin du bdag kyang shākya'i rgyal po'i yang rgyal po bcom ldan 'das shākya zhuthub pa des thos pa mang ba/ thos pa 'dzin pa/ thos pa bsags pa rnams kyi mchog tu lung bstan par gyur cig ces btab po/ /smon lam de'i dbang gis da ltar ngas thos pa mang ba/ thos pa 'dzin pa/ thos pa bsags ⑦pa rnams kyi dumachog tu lung bstan 0to/ /dge slong dag de lta bas na las gcig tu gnag pa rnams kyi zhes bya ba nas/ dge slong dag khyed ⑩kyis de lta bu la bslab par bya'o zhes bya ba'i bar du'o// //sdom la/ rdzu 'phrul ston pa gsum smra dang / /gtum byed rig pa ga yā yidang / /gang gi phyir ni gnod pa dang / /sems can rna ba khyi 8yin no/ /bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab 'od ma'i tshal bya ka lan da ka gnas pa na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe mu ge'i dgon pa nyam nga ba slong tsomo pas zas rnyed par 4—375

dka' ba byung ngo / /de na dge slong rdzu 'phrul thob pa gang yin pa de rnams ni 'dzam bu zhes bya ba'i ming gis 'dzam bu'i gling zhes bya bar btags pa gang yin pa de las shing 'dzam bu'i snye ma kha dog dang dri dang ro phun sum tshogs pa rnams las lhung bzed bkang ste blangs nas bdag nyid longs spyod par byed cing /lhag ma yang dge slong yod pa rnams la 'god ①par byed do/ /gzhan yang 'di'i nye 'khor na bil ba'i tshal lam/ ka pid tha'i ②tshal lam/ skyur rtsi'i ①tshal gang yin pa de las skyur rtsi'i 'bras bu kha ④dog dang dri dang ro phun sum tshogs pa rnams las lhung bzed bkang ste blangs nas bdag nyid longs spyod par byed cing / lhag ma yang dge slong yod pa ⑤rnams la 'ged ༅par byed do/ /byang gi sgra mi snyan gyi gling du dong nas ma rmos ⑦ma btab pa'i 'bras sā lu'i 'bru las lhung bzed bkang ste blangs nas bdag nyid longs spyod par byed cing /lhag ma yang dge slong yod pa rnams la 'ged ⑧par byed do/ /rgyal chen bzhi'i ris tsosam/ sum bcu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi nang du dong nas lha'i bdud rtsi las lhung bzed bkang ste blangs ⑨ nas bdag nyid longs spyod par byed cing /lhag ma yang dge slong yod pa rnams la 'ged yipar byed do/ /yul ljongs 'byor pa dang zhes bya ba nas/ skye bo dang / mi mang pos gang ba'i bar gang yin pa de nas gtsang zhing bsod pa'i bza' ba dang bca' bas lhung bzed bkang ste blangs nas bdag nyid longs spyod par byed cing / lhag ma yang dge slong yod pa rnams la 'ged ⑩par byed do/ /de nas lha sbyin 'di snyam du sems te / da ltar mu ge'i dgon pa nyam tsong ba slong ④mo pas zas rnyed par dka' ba byung ba tshul/ dge slong rdzu 'phrul thob pa gang yin pa de rnams ni 'dzam bu zhes 4—376

bya ba'i ming gis 'dzam bu'i lagling zhes bya bar btags pa gang yin pa de las shing 'dzam bu'i snye ma kha dog dang dri dang ro phun sum tshogs pa rnams kyis ②lhung bzed bkang ste blangs nas bdag nyid longs spyod par byed cing / lhag ma yang dge slong yod pa rnams la 'ged ②par byed do/ /gzhan yang 'di'i nye 'khor na bil ba'i tshal lam/ ka pid tha'i ④tshal lam/ skyur rtsi'i tshal gang yin pa de las skyur rtsi'i 'bras bu kha dog dang dri dang ro phun sum tshogs pa rnams las lhung bzed bkang ste blangs nas bdag nyid longs spyod par byed cing /lhag ma yang dge slong yod pa rnams la 'ged ⑤par byed do/ /byang gi sgra mi snyan gyi gling du dong nas ma rmos ma btab pa'i 'bras sā lu'i 'bru ⑥las lhung bzed bkang ste blangs nas bdag nyid longs spyod par byed cing / lhag ma yang dge slong yod pa rnams la 'ged ⑦par byed do/ /rgyal chen bzhi'i ris sam / sum bcu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi nang du dong nas lha'i bdud rtsi las lhung bzed bkang ste blangs nas bdag nyid longs spyod par byed cing /lhag ma yang dge slong yod pa rnams la 'ged ④par byed do zhes bya ba nas yul ljongs 'byor pa dang zhes bya ba nas/ skye bo dang mi mang pos gang ba'i bar gang yin pa de nas gtsang zhing bsod pa'i bza' ba dang bca' bas 0lhung bzed bkang ste blangs nas bdag nyid longs spyod par byed yi cing / lhag ma yang dge slong yod pa rnams la 'ged ⑩par byed kyis/ gal te bdag gis kyang rdzu 'phrul zhig tsothob na bdag gis kyang 'dzam bu zhes bya ba'i ming gis 'dzam bu'i gling zhes bya bar btags pa gang yin pa tilas shing 'dzam bu'i snye ma kha dog dang dri dang ro phun sum tshogs pa rnams las lhung bzed bkang ste blangs nas bdag 1—377

nyid longs spyod cing / lhag ma yang dge slong yod pa ①rnams la bgo bar bya'o//gzhan yang 'di'i nye 'khor na bil ba'i tshal lam/ ka pid tha'i ②tshal lamalaskyur ci'i 'bras bu kha dog dang dri dang ro phun sum tshogs pa rnams las lhung bzed bkang ste blangs nas bdag nyid longs spyod cing lhag ma yang dge slong yod pa rnams la bgo bar bya'o/ /byang gi sgra mi snyan gyi gling du song la ma mos ma btab pa'i 'bras sā lu'i 'bru las lhung bzed bkang ④ste blangs nas bdag nyid longs spyod cing / lhag ma yang dge slong yod pa rnams la bgo bar ⑤bya'o//rgyal chen bzhi'i ris sam/ sum bcu rtsa gsum gyi yilha rnams kyi nang du song la lha'i bdud rtsi las lhung bzed bkang ste blangs nas ⑦bdag nyid longs spyod cing /lhag ma yang dge slong yod pa rnams la bgo ②bar bya'o/ /yul ljongs 'byor pa dang zhes bya ba nas/ skye bo dang mi mang pos gang ba'i bar gang yin pa de nas gtsang zhing bsod ⑨pa'i bza' ba dang bca' bas lhung bzed bkang ste blangs nas bdag nyid longs spyod cing / lhag ma yang dge slong thoste rnams la bgo bar bya nayi/ su zhig gis tsobadag la rdzu 'phrul gyi lam lung dbog 8par nus snyam mo/ /de nas lha sbyin bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te phyogs gcig btu 'dug go/ /phyogs cig 8tu 'dug nas bcom ldan 'das la lha sbyin gyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag la rdzu 'phrul gyi lam gyi lung dbog tu gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis lha sbyin sdig pa'i 'dod pa de lta bu skyes par gyur pa thugs su chud nas lha sbyin la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to//gi ta ma khyod lhag pa'i tshul khrims la tshul bzhin yid la byos shig dang / khyod ⑩1—378

rdzu 'phrul dang gzhan dag dang yang ldan par 'gyur ro①/ /gi ta ma khyod lhag pa'i sems ②la tshul bzhin yid la byos shig ②dang khyod rdzu 'phrul dang gzhan dag dang yang ldan par 'gyur ro/ / gau ta ma khyod lhag pa'i shes rab ④la ⑤ tshul bzhin yid la byos shig dang / khyod rdzu 'phrul dang gzhan dag dang yang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /⑥de nas lha sbyin 'di snyam du sems te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ⑦bdag la rdzu 'phrul gyi lam gyi lung ma phog go snyam du bsams nas chas te tshe dang ldan pa kun shes kauṇ+ḍi n+ya gang na ba der song ste phyin nas tshe dang ldan pa dukun shes kauṇ+ḍi n+ya la 'di skad ces smras so/ /gnas brtan bdag la rdzu 'phrul gyi lam gyi lung dbog tu gsol/ de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun shes kauṇ+ḍi rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs dang lha sbyin gyi la bltas na tsasdig pa skye'adod pa de lta bu skyes par shes nas lha sbyin la 'di skad ces smras so/ /lha sbyin khyod gzugs la tshul bzhin yid la byos shig dang khyod rdzu 'phrul dang gzhan dag dang yang ldan par 'gyur ⑪rol/ / de nas 8lha sbyin 'di snyam du sems te/ gnas brtan kun shes kauṇ+ḍi rgyas kyang bdag la rdzu 'phrul gyi lam gyi lung ma phog go snyam du bsams nas/ tshe dang ldan pa rta thul dang / bzang ldan dang / rlangs pa dang / ming chen dang /grags 8pa dang / gang po dang / dri ma med pa ④dang / ba lang bdag dang /lag bzangs byadang / gnas brtan 0lnga brgya gang na ba der song ste phyin nas gnas brtan lnga brgya la 'di skad ces smras so/ /gnas brtan ⑩bdag la rdzu 'phrul gyi lam gyi lung dbog tu gsol/ /de nas gnas brtan lnga brgya pos bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs dang / dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan tsu)rnams dang lha sbyin gyi la bltas na ⑩sdig pa'i 'dod pa de lta bu skyes par shes nas 4—379

lha sbyin la 'di skad ces smras so/ /lha sbyin khyod gzugs la tshul bzhin yid la byos shig dang / khyod rdzu 'phrul dang gzhan dag dang yang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /lha sbyin khyod tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa la tshul bzhin yid la byos shig dang༅/ khyod rdzu 'phrul dang gzhan dag dang yang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /de nas lha sbyin 'di snyam du sems te/ gnas brtan lnga brgyas ②byang bdag la rdzu 'phrul gyi lam gyi lung ma phog na/ ci tshe dang ldan pa 'di dag dang bcom ldan 'das dang lhan cig ②snga nyid nas bgros sam/'di ltar bdag la sus kyang rdzu 'phrul gyi lam gyi lung ma phog go snyam mo/ /de nas lha sbyin 'di ④snyam du sems te/ su zhig bdag la rdzu 'phrul gyi lam gyi ⑤lung dbog par nus snyam mo/ /de'i tshe tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung stobs bcu ldan rgyal po'i khab kyi sde can gyi phug na 'dug go/ /de nas lha sbyin 'di snyam du sems te/ gnas brtan 'od srung stobs bcu ldan 'di ni yun ring po nas g.yo med pa/ sgyu can ma yin pa/ drang por byed pa/ drang po'i rang bzhin can yin la/ bdag gi ⑥nye mtshams ⑦kyi phu bo kun dga' bo'i yang mkhan po yin pas gnas brtan bya'od srung stobs bcu ldan gyis bdag la rdzu 'phrul gyi lam gyi lung dbog ⑨par nus so snyam du bsams nas/ tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung stobs bcu ldan gang na ba der song ste phyin nas tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung stobs bcu ldan gyi ⑪ rkang pa gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te phyogs gcig 0tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas lha sbyin gyis tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung stobs bcu ldan la 'di skad ces smras so/ /gnas brtan tsobadag la rdzu 'phrul gyi lam gyi lung dbog tu gsol/ de nas tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung stobs bcu 4—380

ldan gyis bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs dang / dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan ①rnams ②dang / lha sbyin gyi la bltas na sdig pa'i 'dod pa de lta bu skyes par gyur par ma rig nas lha sbyin la rdzu 'phrul gyi lam gyi lung phog go/ /de nas lha sbyin gyis nam gyi cha stod dang / nam gyi cha smad la mi nyal bar brtson pa dang ldan pa'i gnas pas bsam gtan dang po la brten ②te rdzu 'phrul mngon par bsgrubs nas/ de gcig tu gyur cing mang por 'gyur ba dang / mang por gyur cing gcig tu 'gyur ba ④dang / snang bar gyur cing mi snang bar 'gyur ba shes pa mthong bas nyams su myong bar byed do/ /cig pa la yang thad kur 'gro/ri la yang thad kur 'gro/ ra ba la yang lus kyis ⑤mi thogs par thad kur 'gro'o ༅ / /'di lta ste/ nam mkha' dang sa la yang steng du 'byung ba dang byi'u zul byed de dper na chu la bya ba bzhin no/ /chu la yang mi nub par rgyun phyogs su 'gro ste/ dper na sa la bya ba bzhin no/ /skyil mo krung khu gis nam mkha' la 'gro bar byed de/ dper na 'dab duchags bya bzhin no/ /zla ba dang / nyi ma 'di gnyis ⑨'di ltar rdzu 'phrul che ba/ 'di ltar mthu che ba la ⑩yang lag pas nyug cing kun du nyug par byed do/ /de nas lha sbyin 'di snyam du sems te/ ci bdag gis 'dzam bu zhes bya ba'i ming gis 'dzam bu'i 7gling zhes bya bar btags pa gang yin pa de las 'dzam bu'i snye ma kha dog dang dri dang ro phun sum tshogs pa rnams las lhung bzed bkang ste blangs nas bdag nyid longs spyod cing / lhag ma yang dge slong yod pa rnams la bgo bar bya'am/gzhan yang 'di'i nye 'khor na bil ba'i tshal lamatso/ ka pid tha'i 'tshal lam/skyur rtsi'i tshal gang yin pa de las skyur rtsi'i 'bras bu kha dog dang dri dang ro phun 1—381

sum tshogs pa rnams las lhung bzed bkang ste blangs nas bdag nyid longs spyod cing / lhag ma yang dge slong yod pa rnams la bgo bar ①bya'am/ byang gi sgra mi snyan gyi gling du song la ma rmos ma btab pa'i 'bras sā lu'i 'bru las lhung bzed bkang ste blangs nas zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /rgyal chen bzhi'i ris sam/ sum bcu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi nang du song la/ lha'i bdud rtsi las lhung bzed bkang ste ༅blangs nas bdag nyid longs spyod cing /lhag ma yang dge slong yod pa rnams la bgo bar bya'am zhu/ yul ljongs 'byor pa dang zhes bya ba nas skye bo dang / mi mang pos gang ba'i bar de nas gtsang zhing bsod pa'i bza' ba dang bca' ba lhung bzed bkang ste blangs nas bdag gis rtsolongs spyod cing / lhag ma yang dge slong yod pa rnams la bgo bar bya'am snyam mo/ /de nas yang ④lha sbyin 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag gis yul ma ga ṅgā'i mi gtso bo gang zhig dbang du byas na de dbang du gyur pas skye bo'i tshogs chen po tshegs chung ngus bdag gi gyedabang du 'gyur snyam pa dang /de nas lha sbyin 'di snyam du sems te/ gzhon nu ma skyes dgra 'di pha shi nas pa'i rgyal srid kyi dbang phyug la bzhag par 'gyur gyis/ ma la bdag gis gzhon nu ma skyes dgra dbang du 'gyur bar bya ste/ de dbang du gyur na skye bo'i tshogs chen po tshegs chung ⑦bus bdag gi dudabang du 'gyur ro snyam mo/ /de nas lha sbyin gyis glang po kyacang shes bzang po dang / rta cang shes bzang po dang /dge slong skra bregs shing snam sbyar ⑩bgos pa dar la bab pa dag 7tu bsgyur tsonas gzhon nu ma skyes dgra'i sgo nas zhugs shing sge'u chung ngu 'byung ba dang / sge'u chung nas zhugs shing sgor 'byung bar byed do/ /res 'ga' tsogazhon nu gser 4—382

gyi 'og pag gis bcings par bsgyur ①nas gzhon nu ma skyes dgra'i pang na 'gre ldog par byed do/ /ma skyes dgra yang gzhon nu de ②la 'dzin cing kha sprad de ②'khyud ④par byed do/ /ris 'ga' ni khar ⑤mchil ma'i thal ba blugs na de yang lha sbyin med par byed do/ /'di lta ste yirnyed pa dang bkur stis zil gyis non pas sems gtugs pa'i phyir ro/ /de na ༅gzhon nu ma skyes dgra ⑧lhag par yang sdig pa 0can gyi lta bar song ba thob ste/ kye ma ston pa bas ni 'phags pa lha sbyin ches mthu che'o zhes dad par gyur to/ /de la dad par gyur nas lhag par bya ba byed de'i/ shing rta lnga brgya 2tsam dang lhan cig snga dro dang phyi dro rim gro byed du 'gro'o/ /de la g.yos kyi sna rdze'u lnga brgya tsam yang bkad sa dang bkad sa dag tu stobs par byed do/ /lha sbyin yang dge slong lnga brgya tsam dang lhan cig bkad sa'i gung la 'dug par byed do/ /de nas dge slong rab tu mang po snga dro sham thabs bgos lhung bzed dang chos gos blangs te rgyal po'i khab tu bsod snyoms la zhugs so/ /dge slong rab tu mang po rgyal po'i khab tu rtso)bsod snyoms spyod pas 8lha sbyin la rnyed pa dang bkur sti 'di lta bu dag byung bar gyur te/ ma ga ṅgā'i rgyal po lus 'phags ma'i bu ma skyes dgras n+tu shing rta lnga brgya tsam dang lhan cig snga dro dang phyi dro rim gro byed du 'gro zhing / de la g.yos kyi sna rje'u lnga brgya tsam yang bkad sa dang bkad sa dag tu stobs par byed do / /lha sbyin yang dge slong lnga brgya tsam dang lhan cig bkad sa'i gung la ⑫'dug par byed do zhes thos so/ /thos nas kyang rgyal po'i khab tu bsod snyoms spyad de/ zas kyi bya ba byas shing zas phyi ma'i bsod ༅snyoms spangs nas chos gos dang lhung bzed mkhos su phab ste rkang pa bkrus nas bcom ldan 'das gang 1—383

na ba der dong ①ste lhags ②nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te phyogs gcig ⑤tu 'khod do/ /phyogs gcig tu 'khod nas bcom ldan 'das la dge slong rab tu mang pos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa 'dir bdag cag ④dge slong rab tu mang po snga dro sham thabs 'tshal lhung bzed dang chos gos blangs te rgyal po'i khab tu bsod snyoms la zhugs nas btsun pa bdag cag dge slong rab tu mang po rgyal po'i khab tu bsod snyoms spyad ⑤pa na/ lha sbyin la rnyed pa dang bkur sti 'di lta bu dag byung bar gyur te ⑥/ma ga cud+ma'i rgyal po lus 'phags ma'i bu ma skyes dgras dushing rta lnga brgya tsam dang lhan cig snga dro dang phyi dro rim gro bgyid du mchi zhing / de la g.yos kyi sna rdze'u lnga brgya tsam yang bkad sa dang bkad sa dag tu stobs par bgyid do/ /lha sbyin yang dge slong lnga brgya tsam dang lhan cig bkad sa'i gung la mchis par bgyid do zhes thos lags so/ /dge slong dag khyed lha sbyin gyi rnyed pa dang bkur sti la dga' bar ma byed cig /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ lha sbyin gyi rnyed pa dang bkur sti ni gsod pa yin no/ /lha sbyin rtsa/ gyi rnyed pa dang bkur sti ni smad ⑩pa yin no//dge slong dag dper na chu shing gi skye'abras bu phyung nas brnyis 8par 'gyur zhing /chu shing ni 'bras bu phyung nas bskams 8par 'gyur ba de bzhin du lha sbyin gyi rnyed pa dang bkur sti ni gsod ④pa yin no/ /lha sbyin gyi rnyed pa dang bkur sti ni ⑫smad pa yin no/ /dper na sba dang smyug tsom ni 'bras bu phyung nas bskams ⑩par 'gyur zhing / sba dang smyug ma ni tso'abras bu phyung nas dung yag tu 'gyur ba de bzhin du lha sbyin gyi rnyed pa dang bkur sti ni gsod pa yin no/ /lha sbyin gyi rnyed pa dang bkur yisnyi ni smad pa ⑥ yin no/ /dper na dre'u mo 0mngal du 4—384

bzung nas 'chi bar 'gyur zhing / dre'u mo ni mngal du bzung nas ma rung bar 'gyur ba de bzhin du lha sbyin gyi rnyed pa dang bkur snyi ni gsod ①pa yin no/ /lha sbyin gyi rnyed pa dang bkur snyi ni ②smad pa yin no/ /dge slong dag lha sbyin gyi rnyed pa dang bkur sti de lta bu ji snyed byung ba de dag ni skyes bu gti mug can ②de la ④yan ring por gnod pa dang / phan pa ma yin pa dang / sdug bsngal ⑤bar 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag de lta bas na 'di ltar bslab par bya ste/rnyed pa dang bkur sti gang yin pa zil gyis mnan par bya'i rnyed pa dang bkur sti byung ba la sems gtugs te gnas par mi bya ste/ dge slong dag khyed kyis de lta bu la bslab par bya'o/ /chu shing 'bras bu smyug rtse'abras dang / /sba ni 'bras bus thoskems pa dang / /rang gi bu duyis dre'u mo ltar/ /skyes bu tha shal bkur stis 'joms/ /ji srid byis pa mngon byed pa/ /de srid du ni phung bar 'gyur/ /byis pa'i dkar ba'i cha 'joms pa/ /rtse mo las kyang ltung bar 'gyur / /de nas lha sbyin rnyed pa dang bkur stis zil gyis non pa sems yongs su gtugs pa la sdig pa'i 'dod pa 'di lta bu skyes par gyur te/ da thoni bcom ldan 'das bgres 'khogs gtugs te 'khor bzhi la gdams ngag dbog tu mnyel rngu bar gyur gyis/ e ma'o bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong gi dge 'dun bdag la spangs te bdag gis dge slong gi dge 'dun yongs su drang zhing /bcom ldan 'das ni thugs las chung ngur mthong ba'i chos skyel bde bar gnas pa'i rnal 'byor gyi rjes su brtson pas 8bzhugs kyang ci ma rung snyam du sems bskyed ma thag tu lha sbyin rdzu 'phrul de las yongs su 8nyams ④kyang bdag 8yongs su nyams so zhes mi shes so/ /de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos skrod klunga'i 1—385

bu dge slong nog can zhes bya bas bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar tshangs par spyod pa ②spyad de/ tshangs pa'i gnas pa bzhi bsgoms nas 'dod pa rnams la 'dod pa'i 'dun pa spang ba'i phyir de la mang du gnas pas tshangs pa'i 'jig rten dang skal ba mnyam par skyes so/ /de'i tshe tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po ngan spong gi chu srin byis pa gsod kyi ri la 'jigs byed kyi tshal gyi ri dgas kyi nags na 'dug go/ /de nas tshangs pa nog can gyis lha sbyin rdzu 'phrul de las yongs su ②nyams par shes nas/ dper na skyes bu stobs dang ldan pa'i lag pa bskum ②pa las brkyang ba'am brkyang ba las bskum pa tsam gyis tshangs pa nog can ④tshangs pa'i 'jig rten nas ⑤mi snang bar byas te ngan spong du 'ongs nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po'i mdun du 'dug go/ /de nas tshangs pa nog can gyis tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi 0bu chen po shes par gyis shig /lha sbyin rnyed pa dang bkur stis zil gyis non pa sems gtugs pa la sdig pa'i 'dod pa 'di lta bu ⑦skyes te/ da ni bcom ldan 'das bgres 'khogs gtugs te 'khor bzhi du la gdams ngag dbog tu mnyel ⑨bar gyur gyis/ e ma'o bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong gi dge 'dun bdag la spangs te/ bdag ②gis dge slong gi dge 'dun yongs su drang zhing / bcom ldan 'das ni thugs las chung ngur gnas shing mthong ba'i chos la bde bar gnas pa'i rnal 'byor gyi rjes su brtson pas yibazhugs kyang ci ma rung snyam du tsosems bskyed ma thag tu rdzu 'phrul de las slar yongs su nyams te/ yongs su nyams kyang bdag ni slar yongs su nyams so zhes ma shes kyis/ btsun pa mod gal gyi bu snying brtse ba nye bar bzung ste 1—386

bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin nas don 'di rgyas par gsol na legs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos tshangs pa nog can la cang mi smra bas khas blangs so/ /de nas tshangs pa nog can gyis tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po ①cang mi smra bas khas blangs par rig nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po'i rkang pa gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te de nyid du mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos tshe dang ldan pa ②tshangs pa nog can song nas ring po ②ma lon par shes nas ji ltar sems mnyam par bzhag na ngan spong nas mi snang bar gyur te/ rgyal po'i khab 'od ma'i tshal bya ka lan da ④ka gnas par phyin pa de lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so / /de nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas nas phyogs gcig ⑤tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig ༅tu 'dug nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos tshangs pa nog can dang lhan cig bar skabs kyi gtam ji snyed glengs pa de dag thams cad rgyas par gsol to/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /mod gal ⑦gyi bu snga ⑤mo zhig tu lha sbyin sems la bkram ⑨nas rig par ma byas sam ci na da gzod ⑨ tshangs pa nog can gyis sbran / btsun pa mad lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das dang tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu yithabs cig 8tu bar skabs kyi gtam 'di gleng bar mdzad pa na/de nas lha tsosbyin grogs dge slong bzhi ④po ko ka li ka dang / khaṇ+ḍa dra 'bya dang /ka ti yimo ra ka ti gyi ⑩dang / rgya mtshos byin dang lhan cig bcom ldan 'das 4—387

gang na ba der dong ①ba dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis lha sbyin rgyang ring po kho na nas gzigs so/ /gzigs nas kyang tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po la bka' stsal pa/ mod gal gyi bu lha sbyin 'o ni da ltar 'ong gis tshig sungs shig dang / de'u re skyes bu gti mug 'o ni bdag nyid kyis/ bdag nyid lung bstan tseto/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos bcom ldan 'das kyi shezhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas nas ji ltar ④sems mnyam par bzhag na 'od ma'i tshal nas mi snang bar gyur te/ ngan spong phyegi chu srin byis pa gsod kyi ri la 'jigs byed kyi tshal gyi 'uri dgas kyi nags su phyin pa de lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /de nas lha sbyin bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te phyogs gcig 3tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig 5tu 'dug nas/ bcom ldan 'das la lha sbyin gyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /da thoni bcom ldan 'das bgres 'khogs gtugs te 'khor bzhi tshe' gdams nyunyengag dbog tu mnyel 8bar gyur gyis/ e ma'o bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong gi dge 'dun bdag la spongs shig dang / bdag gis dge slong gi dge 'dun yongs su drang gis/bcom ldan 'das ni thugs las chung 6bur bde bar gnas pa'i rnal 'byor gyi rjes su brtson pas skyobazhugs su gsol/ skyes bu gti mug re zhig shā ri'i bu dang / mod gal gyi bu tshangs pa mtshungs skyepar spyod pa ⑩de dag la yang ngas ⑩dge slong gi dge 'dun mi spongs tson/ ro dang 'dra ba mchil hūm 'thung ba khyod la lta ga la spong / de nas lha sbyin 'di snyam du du sems te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis shā ri'i bu dang mod gal gyi bu la ni bsngags pa gsungs la bdag la 4—388

ni ro dang 'dra ba mchil ①ma 'thung ba'o zhes smad pa gsungs so snyam mo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la ②lha sbyin 'khrugs pa dang / zhe snang dang / nga rgyal dang / 'chab pa chadang / bgrongs pa dang / mi bzod pa dang / ma dad pa bstan to④/ /de nas lha sbyin gyis 'jal ⑤ to zhes byas nas mgo lan gsum lcogs yite/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga nas song ngo // //'dul ba gzhi/ bam po dgu bcu rtsa thobadun pa/ de'i tshe tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo bsil niyab thogs te bcom ldan 'das kyi snam logs na ⑨bcom ldan 'das la g.yob cing 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo song la 'od ma'i tshal bya ka lan da ka gnas pa na dge slong ji snyed nye bar brten byate gnas pa de dag thams cad rim gro'i gnas su sdus skyeshig /btsun pa bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos bcom ldan 'das kyi ltar mnyan nas 'od ma'i tshal bya ka lan da ka gnas pa na dge slong ji snyed nye bar brten nyunyete gnas pa de dag thams cad rim gro'i gnas su bsogs 8nas bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te phyogs gcig tsu) tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig nyu)tu 'dug nas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos 'di skad ces gsol to skye/ /btsun pa 'od ma'i tshal bya ka lan 0da ka gnas pa na dge slong ji snyed nye bar brten te mchis pa de dag thams cad rim gro'i gnas su bsogs (rme lags te/bcom ldan 'das da yini de'i dus la bab par dgongs su gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das rim gro'i gnas gang na ba der gshegs te byon nas/ dge 1—389

slong gi dge 'dun gyi gung la gdan bshams pa nyid la bzhugs so/ /bzhugs nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag ston pa lnga po 'di dag 'jig rten na yod cing mngon ①te/ lnga gang zhe na/'di na duston pa gcig ni tshul khrims yongs su ma dag pa yin bzhin du bdag gi ②tshul khrims yongs su dag ste nyon mongs pa can ma yin no zhes khas 'che ba ④ste/de nyan thos rnams dang lhan cig gnas pa'i rgyus so sor shes nas ston pa shes ldan 'di ni tshul khrims yongs su ma dag pa yin bzhin du bdag gi 'tshul khrims yongs su dag ste nyon mongs pa can ma yin no zhes khas 'che ba yin te/ gal te bdag cag gis gzhan la de ༅skad smras na/ des na 'di'i yid la mi ⑦'bab par 'gyur bas ston pa de la yid du mi 'ong bar 'gyur ba gang yin pa de bdag cag gis glengs te ④ci rung / ston pa shes ldan 'di rang nyid shes par 'gyur grang / 'di bdag cag la 'di lta ste/ chos gos dang / bsod snyoms dang / gnas mal dang / nad gsos kyi rkyen sman gyi yo byad rnams kyis sems so snyam ste/ de nyan thos rnams kyis tshul khrims las rjes su srung bar sems so/ /ston pa de lta bu ni nyan thos rnams kyis tshul khrims kyi sgo nas rjes su srung ⑨bar re ba yin te/ 'di ni 'jig rten na /) ston pa yod cing mngon /sprepa dang po yin no/ /gzhan yang 'di na ston pa gcig ni 'tsho ba yongs su ma dag pa yin bzhin du bdag gi 'tsho ba yongs su dag ste nyon mongs pa can ma yin no zhes khas tso'ache ba ste/ de nyan thos rnams dang lhan cig gnas pa'i rgyus 8so sor shes te/ ston pa shes ldan 'di ni 'tsho ba yongs su ma tsodag pa yin bzhin du bdag gi 'tsho ba yongs su dag ste/ nyon mongs pa can ma yin no 1—390

zhes khas 'che ba yin te/ gal te bdag cag gis gzhan la de skad ②smras na/des na ②'di'i yid la mi 'bab par 'gyur bas ston pa de la yid du mi 'ong bar 'gyur ba gang yin pa de bdag cag gis glengs te zhuci rung / ston pa shes ldan 'di rang nyid shes par 'gyur grang / 'di bdag cag la 'di lta ste/ chos gos dang / bsod ④stoms dang / gnas mal dang / nad gsos kyi rkyen sman gyi ⑤yo byad rnams kyis sems so ༅snyam ste/ de nyan thos rnams kyis 'tsho ba'i sgo nas rjes su srung bar sems so/ /ston pa ④de lta bu ni nyan thos rnams ⑤kyis 'tsho ba'i sgo nas rjes su srung ⑨bar re ba yin te/ 'di ni 'jig rten na yod cing mngon pa'i ston pa gnyis pa yin no/ /gzhan yang 'di na ston pa gcig ni shes pa mthong ba yongs su ma dag pa yin bzhin du bdag gi shes pa mthong ba yongs su dag ste/ nyon mongs pa can ma yin no zhes khas 'che ba ste/de nyan thos rnams dang lhan cig gnas pa'i rgyus so sor byashes nas ston pa shes ldan 'di'i nyushes pa mthong ba yongs su ma dag pa yin bzhin du bdag gi 6shes pa mthong ba yongs su dag ste/ nyon mongs pa can ma yin no zhes khas 'che ba yin te/ gal te bdag cag gis gzhan la de 8skad smras na/ des na 'di'i yid la mi 'bab par 'gyur bas ston pa de la yid du mi 'ong bar 'gyur ba gang yin pa de bdag cag ④gis glengs te 8ci rung / ston pa shes ldan 'di rang nyid shes par 'gyur grang / 'di bdag cag la 'di lta ste/ chos gos dang /bsod snyoms dang / gnas mal dang / nad gsos kyi rkyen sman gyi yo byad rnams kyis sems so snyam ste/ de nyan thos rnams kyis shes pa mthong ba'i sgo nas rjes su srung ⑩bar sems so/ /ston pa ⑩de lta bu ni nyan thos rnams kyis 4—391

shes pa mthong ba'i sgo nas rjes su srung ①bar re ba yin te/ 'di ni 'jig rten na yod cing mngon pa'i ston pa gsum pa yin no/ /gzhan yang 'di na ston pa gcig ni lung ston pa phun sum tshogs pa ma yin bzhin du bdag gis lalung ston pa ni phun sum tshogs pa yin te nyon mongs pa can ma yin no zhes khas 'che ba ste/de nyan thos rnams dang lhan cig gnas pa'i rgyus so sor shes nas ston pa shes ldan 'di ni lung ston pa phun sum tshogs pa ma yin bzhin du bdag gi lung ston pa ni phun sum tshogs pa yin te/ nyon mongs pa can ma yin no zhes khas 'che ba yin te/ gal te bdag cag ④gis gzhan la de skad ces smras na/ des na 'di'i ④yid la mi 'bab par 'gyur bas ston pa de la yid du ⑤mi 'ong bar ⑥'gyur ba de bdag cag ⑦gis glengs ④te ci rung ston pa shes ldan 'di rang nyid shes par 'gyur grang / 'di bdag cag la 'di lta ste/ chos gos dang /bsod snyoms dang / gnas mal dang / nad gsos kyi rkyen sman dang nyu/yo byad rnams kyis sems so snyam ste/ de nyan thos rnams byakyis lung ston pa phun sum tshogs pa'i sgo nas rjes su srung hubar sems so/ /ston pa de lta bu ni nyan thos rnams kyis lung ston pa phun sum tshogs pa'i sgo nas rjes su srung chubar re ba yin te/ 'di ni 'jig rten na yod cing mngon pa'i ston pa bzhi pa yin no//gzhan yang 'di na ston pa gcig ni chos 'dul ba nyes par 'chad bzhin du bdag gi 8chos 'dul ba ni legs par bshad pa yin te nyon mongs pa can ma yin no zhes khas 'che ba ste/ de nyan thos rnams dang lhan cig gnas pa'i rgyus so sor shes nas ston pa shes ldan 'di ni chos 'dul ba nyes par tso'achad bzhin du bdag gi ④chos 'dul ba ni ⑩legs par bshad pa ste/ nyon mongs pa can 4—392

ma yin no zhes khas 'che ba yin te/ gal te bdag cag gis gzhan la de skad smras na/ des na 'di'i yid la mi 'bab par 'gyur bas ston pa de la yid du mi 'ong bar 'gyur ba gang yin pa de bdag cag gis glengs te ༅ci rung / ston pa shes ldan 'di rang nyid shes par 'gyur grang 'di bdag cag la 'di lta ste chos gos dang / bsod khusnyoms dang / gnas mal dang / nad gsos kyi rkyen sman dang / yo byad rnams kyis sems so rdusnyam ste/ de nyan thos rnams kyis chos 'dul ba legs par bshad pa'i sgo nas rjes su srung byabar sems so/ /ston pa de lta bu ni nyan thos rnams kyis chos 'dul ba legs par bshad pa'i sgo nas rjes su srung bar 3re ba yin te/ 'di ni 'jig rten na yod cing mngon pa'i ston pa lnga pa yin no/ /dge slong dag nga ni 2tshul khrims yongs su dag pa kho na yin pas nga tshul khrims yongs su dag pa ste nyon mongs rtsocan ma yin no zhes zhal gyis 'che ste/ nyan thos rnams kyis ri snang la tshul khrims kyi sgo nas rjes su shermesrung nyuge bar bsam yang mi dgos la nga yang nyan thos rnams kyis dzo tshul khrims kyi sgo nas rjes su srung bar 'dod pa mi mnga'o/ /dge slong dag nga ni 'tsho ba yongs su dag pa kho na yin pas nga'i 'tsho ba yongs su dag ste nyon mongs pa can ma yin no zhes zhal gyis me'ache ste/ nyan thos rnams kyis nga la 'tsho ba'i sgo nas rjes su srung bar bsam 6yang mi dgos la/ nga la 6yang nyan thos rnams kyis skye'atsho ba'i sgo nas rjes su srung skyabar 'dod pa mi mnga'o/ /dge slong dag nga 7ni ye shes gzigs pa yongs su dag pa kho na yin pas nga ye shes gzigs pa yongs su dag (sreste nyon mongs pa can ma yin no zhes zhal gyis 'che ste/ nyan thos rnams kyis nga la ye shes gzigs pa'i sgo nas rjes su srung skyebar bsam yang mi 4—393

dgos la nga yang nyan thos rnams kyis ye shes gzigs pa'i sgo nas rjes su srung ①bar 'dod pa mi mnga'o/ /dge slong dag nga ②ni lung ston pa dang ldan pa kho na yin pas nga'i lung ston pa phun sum tshogs te nyon mongs pa can ma yin no zhes zhal gyis ④'che ste/ nyan thos rnams kyis nga la lung ston pa phun sum ④tshogs pa'i sgo nas rjes su rgyabasrung 'ubar bsam yang mi dgos la/ nga yang nyan thos rnams kyis ④lung ston pa dang ldan par rjes su srung zhubar 'dod pa mi mnga'o/ /dge slong dag nga'i chos ⑨'dul ba ni legs par gsungs pa n+tu kho na yin pas nga'i chos 'dul ba legs par gsungs pa ste/ nyon mongs pa can ma yin no zhes zhal gyis 'che ste/ nyan thos rnams kyis mang la chos 'dul ba ni skyelegs par gsungs pa'i sgo nas rjes su bsrung kyebar bsam thomi dgos la/ nga yang nyan thos rnams kyis mechos 'dul ba legs par gsungs pa'i sgo nas rjes su srung ⑩bar 'dod pa mi mnga'o/ /dge slong dag nga rtsa ni khyed la tshar bcad 6cing tshar bcad /(cing / thag bcug cing thag bcug d+ngha )cing rab tu smra'i byakhyed la ngo ni mi byed de/ rdza mkhan gyis du rdza ma tshos pa rnams la bya ba bzhin du gang rung ba de 'jog par zad pas nga'i tshig gi lam rnams bzod par yang gyis shig /de nas lha sbyin gyis ko ka li ka dang / khaṇ+ḍa dra bya dang / ka ti mo ra ka ti gyi dang / rgya du )mtshos byin la smras pa/ ko ka li ka dang / khaṇ+ḍa dra bya dang /ka ti mo ra ka ti gyi dang / rgya mtshos byin dag du tshur/bya dge sbyong dugi ta ma 'dug bzhin du nyan thos kyi dge 'dun mthun pa dbye ba dang 'khor lo dbye bar bya'o/ /des na bdag cag shi ste 0'das na yang / dge sbyong gi ta ma de ltar rdzu 'phrul che ba/ de ltar mthu che ba 'dug bzhin du lha sbyin dang / ko ka 1—394

li ka dang / khaṇ+ḍa dra bya dang / ka ti mo ra ka ti gyi dang / rgya mtshos byin gyis nyan thos kyi dge 'dun mthun pa phye ba dang / 'khor lo ①bye ba byas so zhes phyogs dang 2phyogs mtshams ②su grags pa dang / sgra dang tshigs su bcad pa snyan pa rgya cher 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de rnams kyis smras pa/ lha sbyin bdag cag gis ni bcom ldan 'das kyi bonyan thos kyi dge 'dun mthun pa rgyadabye ba dang / 'khor lo dbye bar bya thomi nus so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ tshe dang ldan pa lha sbyin bcom ldan 'das kyi rtsonyan thos rdzu 'phrul che ba mthu che ba skulha'i mig dang pha rol gyi sems rig pa dag yod la/ de dag ni rgyang ring po nas kyang mthong laspu/ drung na ce'adug kyang mi snang byab dag yin te/ de rnams kyi 6sems kyis sems khyab par byas nas/ yid kyis yid rnam par shes kyi ri/ de rnams kyis bdag cag bskyod pa nyid kyis shes par 'gyur ro/ /des smras pa/ko ka li ka dag tshur thabs yod kyis bdag cag dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan tho rnams kyi drung du song la gnas brtan nyusnyedag thugs las chung ngur mdzod cig dang / bdag cag gis gnas brtan rnams la yo byad thams cad kyis nyunimi brel bar bgyi'o zhes yo byad thams cad kyis bstab nyuX par bya zhing dge slong gsar bu rnams la yang lhung bzed dang / chos gos dang / lhung bzed kyi snod dang / chu tshags dang / ska rags dang / lung 'bogs (5pa dang /klog tu gzhug pa dang / 'don du gzhug pa dang / rnal 'byor dang / yid la byed pas nye bar bsdu zhing rim gro bya'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa lha sbyin thabs de ni bden pa zhig yod do/ /de na lha sbyin gyis dge 'dun mthun pa bludabye ba'i phyir rtul 0 bar brtsams so/ /dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan zhurnams kyis lha 4—395

sbyin dge 'dun mthun pa dbye ba'i phyir rtul ①bar bskyod ②pa nyid tshor nas skabs de dge slong rnams la smras pa dang / dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa/ btsun pa lha sbyin ni dge 'dun mthun pa dbye ba'i slad du rtul ba ⑧bgyid lags so/ /de nas ④bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag khyed kyis lha sbyin dang / de lta bu dang mthun pa gzhan su yang rung ba la bzhams te bsgo bar bya'o/ /bsgo ba yang 'di ltar bya phyeste/ lha sbyin khyod dge 'dun mthun pa dbye ba'i phyir rtul bar ma byed cig/dbyen byed par 'gyur ba'i rtsod pa yang dag par blangs nas rab tu bzung ste ma 'dug shig /lha sbyin khyod dge 'dun dang mthun par gyis shig /dge 'dun mthun skyomi phyed/ kun tu dga'/ mi rtsod/ mchog gcig 'don pa gcig 3cing / chu dang 'o ma gcig tu 'dres pa lta bur gyur la/ ston pa'i bstan sapa gsal bar byed na bde ba la rig par gnas par 'gyur ro zhes bsgo spushiganyu nge /dge slong de rnams kyis lha sbyin /༷ bzhams te bsgo ba dang / de bzhams te bsgo yang gzhi de nyid la nan gyis mchog tu bzung zhing mngon par zhen nas 'di nyid bden gyi gzhan ni brdzun no zhes rjes su tha snyad 'dogs tho)par byed nas/ skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa/btsun pa bdag cag gis lha sbyin la bzhams te bsgo lags na/ de bzhams te bsgo 6yang gzhi the ༷de nyid la nan gyis mchog tu bzung zhing mngon par zhen nas 'di nyid 8bden gyi gzhan ni brdzun ⑩pa'o zhes 0tha snyad 'dogs par bgyid lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' 455 pa/ dge slong dag khyed kyis lha sbyin dang / gzhan yang de lta bu dang mthun pa su yang rung ba la gsol ba 4—396

dang bzhi'i ①las kyis bsgo bar bya'o/ /bsgo ba yang 'di ltar bya steme/gnas mal bsham khyapa byas nas gaṇ+ḍi brdungs ④te dris pa'i tshig gis dge slong rnams la yang dag par bsgo ⑤la/ dge 'dun thams cad 'dug cing mthun par gyur pa dang / dge slong gcig gis gsol ba byas te las bya'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ lha sbyin 'di dge 'dun mthun pa ⑥dbye ba'i slad du rtul te dbyen bgyid par 'gyur ba'i rtsod pa yang dag par blangs nas rab tu bzung ste mchis na༅/ 'di la dge slong mang pos bzhams te bsgo na she/ bzhams te bsgo yang gzhi de nyid la nan gyis humachog tu bzung zhing mngon par zhen nas 'di nyid bden gyi gzhan ni brdzun kye pa'o zhes rjes su tha snyad 'dogs par bgyid na/ gal te dge 'dun gyi tsho)dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang / dge 'dun gyis lha sbyin la lha sbyin khyod dge 'dun mthun pa dbye ba'i phyir rtul 6bar ma byed cig /dbyen byed par 'gyur ba'i rtsod pa yang dag par blangs nas rab tu bzung ste ma 'dug shig /lha sbyin khyod dge 'dun dang mthun par gyis shig /dge 'dun mthun mi phyed/ kun du dga' mi rtsod/ mchog gcig 'don pa gcig cing chu dang 'o ma gcig tu 'dres pa lta bur gyur la/ ston pa'i bstan nyunyepa gsal bar byed na bde ba la reg par gnas par 'gyur ro zhes lha sbyin la gsol ba dang bzhi'i cilas kyis bsgo ba mdzad do/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /las ni 'di ltar bya ste/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ lha sbyin 'di dge 'dun mthun pa dbye ba'i slad du rtul 8te dbyen bgyid par 'gyur ba'i rtsod pa yang dag par blangs nas rab tu bzung ste mchis nas 'di la dge slong mang 4—397

pos ①bzhams te bsgo ba nami/ bzhams te bsgo yang gzhi de nyid la nan gyis mchog tu bzung zhing mngon par zhen dunas 'di nyid bden gyi gzhan ni brdzun ④pa'o zhes rjes su ⑤tha snyad 'dogs ༅par bgyid de/ de'i slad du dge 'dun gyis lha sbyin la lha sbyin khyod dge 'dun mthun pa dbye ba'i phyir rtul ⑦bar ma byed cig /dbyen byed par 'gyur ba'i rtsod pa yang dag par blangs nas rab tu bzung ste ma 'dug shig /lha sbyin khyod dge 'dun dang mthun par gyis shig /dge 'dun mthun mi phyed/ kun du dga' dumi rtsod/ mchog gcig 'don pa gcig cing (chu dang 'o ma gcig tu 'dres pa lta bur gyur la/ ston pa'i bstan pa gsal bar byed na bde ba la reg par gnas par 'gyur gyis/ lha sbyin khyod dge 'dun mthun pa dbye ba'i phyir rtul bar ma byed cig /dbyen byed par 'gyur ba'i rtsod pa tshuyang dag par blangs nas rab tu bzung ste ma 'dug shig /lha sbyin khyod dge 'dun dang mthun par gyis shig /dge 'dun mthun mi phyed/kun du dga' mi rtsod/ mchog gcig /'don pa gcig cing chu dang /'o ma gcig tu 'dres pa lta zhu bur gyur la/ ston pa'i bstan nyu pa gsal bar byed na bde ba la reg par gnas par 'gyur ro skyosazhes lha sbyin la gsol ba dang bzhi'i las kyis bsgo bar nyu dzemadzad na/ tshe dang ldan pa gang dag lha sbyin la gsol ba dang bzhi'i las kyis bsgo bar 6mdzad par bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung tsheshig /gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsung 8shig /'di ni las brjod pa dang po ste/ de bzhin du las brjod pa gnyis pa dang gsum pa'i bar du bya'o/ /dge 'dun nyunyede rnams kyis lha sbyin la gsol ba dang / bzhi'i yilas kyis bsgo na/ bsgo yang gzhi de nyid la nan gyis mchog tu bzung zhing 4—398

mngon par zhen nas 'di nyid bden gyi ① gzhan ni brdzun no ②zhes rjes su tha snyad 'dogs so/ /de'i grogs ①byed cing mi mthun par smra ba'i ④rjes su phyogs pa'i ⑤dge slong bzhi 'upo ko ka li ka dang / khaṇ+ḍa dra bya dang / ka ti ⑦mo ra ka ti gyi dang / rgya mtshos byin te/ de rnams kyis kyang dge slong rnams la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa dag ⑧khyed cag dge yang rung sdig kyang zhurung dge slong 'di la ci yang ma smra shig /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ dge slong 'di ni chos smra ba 'dul ba smra ba/ dge slong 'di ni chos dang 'dul ba yang dag par blangs nas rab tu bzung ste rjes su tha snyad 'dogs par byed pa/dge slong 'di ni shes bzhin du smra'i mi shes par skyem yin pa'i phyir te/ dge slong 'di gang la nyunye'adod cing bzod pa de la bdag cag kyang 'dod cing bzod do//skabs tho)de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa/ btsun pa bdag cag gis lha sbyin la gsol ba dang bzhi'i las kyis bsgo na/ bsgo nyu yang gzhi de nyid la nan nyu —gyis mchog tu bzung zhing mngon par zhen nas 'di nyid bden gyi gzhan ni brdzun mepa'o zhes rjes su tha snyad 'dogs par bgyid lags so/ /de'i 〉grogs bgyid cing mi mthun par smra ba'i nyu rjes su phyogs pa'i dge slong bzhi nyunyepo ko ka li ka dang / khaṇ+ḍa dra bya dang / ka ti mo ra ka ti gyi dang / rgya mtshos byin de rnams kyang dge slong rnams la 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa dag khyed cag dge yang rung sdig kyang rung dge slong 'di la ci yang ma smra shig /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ dge slong 'di ni chos smra ba/ 'dul ba smra ba/ dge slong 'di ni chos dang 'dul ba yang dag par blangs nas rab tu bzung ste rjes su mtha snyad 'dogs par byed pa0/ dge slong 'di ni shes bzhin du smra'i mi shes par ma 4wa 399
