te song ngo / /stes te phyugs lardzi dag cig laphyugs skyong zhing phyogs der phyin pa dang / de rnams kyis de mthong nas dris pa/ kye nang rje khyod su zhig des ji ltar gyur pa rgyas par ②smras pa/ de rnams kyis thos nas snying rje skyes te/ de rnams kyis de phyugs rdzi dpon po'i khyim du khrid do/ /de de na pi wang ⑤blang bar brtsams pa dang / phyugs rdzi dpon po de'i chung ma gzugs dang lang tsho'i dregs pas rgyags pas pi wang ⑤gi sgra thos nas bsgugs ⑥pa las/ de byas pa chud gzon pa'i spyod pa rjes su ⑦dran nas rna ba bkag ⑧ste 'dug nas ma btub bo / /'dod pa la zhen pa rnams ni mi bya ba ci yang med pas des khyim thab ⑨la dpar ba bo smras pa/ mi long ba 'di bdag la sgugs na/ khyod 'di hu'adra ba dag sdud par byed dam/ sha 'khon 8rnams kyi nang na 'di lta ste bud med kyi sha 'khon cini tha chad yin pas des bsams pa/ 'di chad pas ni bcad zin pas spang ba tsom gtogs par 'di la 6ci byar yang med do snyam nas des de khyim nas spangs te lam po che dang / srang dang / bzhi mdo dang / sum mdo rnams na pi wang ༅gis 'tsho bar byed do/ /de'i pha shi nas de'i nu bo sdig byed rgyal srid la bzhag go/ /de yang rim gyis mtshams gzhan gyi rgyal po sngon bu mo byin pa gang yin pa de'i grong khyer du phyin to/ /de yang chen mor gyur nas/de slong ba yul sna tshogs na gnas pa rgyal po'i bu dang / blon po'i bu dang /mdun na 'don gyi bu dag lhags nas pas smras pa/ bu mo khyod gang la byin pa'i gzhon nu dge byed de ni rgya mtsho chen por song ba ⑩las de nyid du tshul ma yin pas shi bar gyur to/ /da ni khyod slong ba dag lhags te/ gang la khyod ma byin pa de mi dga' bar 'gyur na/ 'di la 'ji ltar bsgrub par bya/ des smras pa/4wa 449

yab gal te de ltar ༅na grong khyer byi dor bgyid du stsol cig dang bdag nyid kyis khyim ②thab 'dam mo/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ bu ②de bzhin gyis shig /de nas rgyal pos yul sna tshogs dang grong khyer sna tshogs rnams su rang nyid khyim thab 'dam par bsgrags nas grong khyer de yang gseg ma dang / rdo ba ④dang /gyo mo bsal ⑤cing tsan dan gyi chus chag chag btab/ dri zhim pa'i ༅pog por dag bzhag /gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan bsgreng / dar gyi chun 'phyang mang po dpyangasam/ me tog rnam pa sna tshogs kyi lha rnams ④kyi dga' tshal gyi skyed mos tshal bzhin du dga' dga' ltar byas nas dril sgrogs su bcug pa/ grong khyer na gnas pa dang grong mi dang yul sna tshogs nas lhags pa'i skye bo'i tshogs kyi shes ldan dag nyon cig /sang rgyal po'i gzhon nu ma rang nyid khyim thab 'dam gyis khyed cag 'byor pa ji lta ba bzhin du rtsa'adu bar gyis shig /nam nangs nas rgyal po'i gzhon nu ma de rgyan sna tshogs kyis bklubs ⑨ te gzhon nu ma du mas yongs su bskor nas nags tshal gyi lha me tog rgyas pa'i nags tshal gyi nang na shin tu mdzes pa de bzhin skyodapal gyi 'byor pa chen pos grong khyer gyi dbus na srog chags brgya 8stong phrag mang po 'dus pa'i nang du rang nyid thonakhyim thab 'dam du 'ongs so/ /dge byed de yang de'i phyogs gzhan zhig na pi wang 'ulen cing 'dug go/ /sems can rnams ni las rnams kho nas phan tshun sbyor bar byed pa yin la/ rgyu'i stobs che yang rkyen gyi stobs la ltos pa yin pas / de nas rgyal po'i gzhon nu ma de pi wang 8gi sgras sems bsdus pas dge byed pi wang ⑩len pa la chags nas des de la 'di bdag gi khyim thab bo zhes me tog gi phreng ba bor ro/ /skye bo'i tshogs yid mi bde bar gyur cing kha cig 4—450

snying na nas mod la 'phya bar brtsams pa/ rgyal po'i gzhon nu ma 'di ltar gzugs bzang ba dar la bab pa sgyu ༅rtsal phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pas yul sna tshogs nas ②lhags pa'i rgyal po dang / blon po dang /② mdun na 'don gyi bu rnams dang / gzhan yang grong khyim ④na gnas pa'i skyes pa'i ⑤gtso bo rnams spangs te long ba la khyim thab tu ⑥'dam pa ci tha tshig /zho shas 'tsho ba rnams yid mi bde zhing ⑦mi dga' bas rgyal po la smras pa/ lha gzhon nu ma rang nyid kyis khyim thab bdams shelags so/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ ci 'dra ba zhig /lha long ba zhig lags so/ /de yang thos nas yid mi bde bar gyur te de nas de bkug nas smras pa/ bu klurgyal po dang / nor can dang / tshong dpon dang / ded dpon dang / nyuste blon po'i bu dang / mdun na 'don gyi bu gzugs bzang ba dang skyedar la bab pa 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa dag yod na/ khyod kyis ci'i phyir 'di 'dra ba zhig khyim thab tu bdamasasku/ des smras pa/ yab 'di kho na bdag 'tshal lags soskye/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ bu skyogal te de ltar ⑫na de nyid kyi thad du song shig tsheci'i phyir 'dug /de de'i drung du song nas smras pal/ bdag gi khyim thab tu khyod 'dams 8so/ /des smras pa/ khyod kyis ma legs pa zhig byas te de lta mod kyi 'di ni long ba yin pas/ bdag skyes pa gzhan dang lhan cig dga' mgur spyad par bya'o snyam du bsams pa lta zhig /des smras pa/ bdag ni de lta bu'i las byed pa ma yin no/ /des smras pa/ci mngon des bden pa tsogasol bar brtsams te/ bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig gang gis rgyal bu gzhon nu dge byed de dang ⑪khyod la 'dod chags skyes kyi gzhan su la yang ma yin zhe na/ bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig des khyod kyi mig 4wa 451

gcig sngon gyi ji lta ba bzhin du gyur cig ces bden pa'i byin ①gyis brlabs ma thag kho nar de'i mig gcig dusngon gyi duji lta ba bzhin du gyur te④/ des smras pa/dge byed de nyid nga yin te/ nu bo shos sdig byed kyis 'di lta bu'i gnas skabs su byas so/ /des smras pa/ gzhon nu dge byed de kho na khyod yin par ci mngon / des kyang bden pa phyagasol bar brtsams te/ bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig gang gis sdig byed kyis bdag gi mig phyung ba yon de la ngan sems cung zad kyang ma byung zhe na/ bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig des bdag gi mig cig ⑦shos kyang sngon gyi ji lta ba dubazhin du 'gyur cig ces byas pa dang / bden pa gsol bas de'i mig cig 5shos kyang sngon gyi 7ji lta ba bzhin du gyur to/ /de nas rgyal po skyogazhon nu ma des dge byed dbang po ma tshang ba ma yin pa de khrid nas rgyal po'i drung du song ste smras pa/ yab dge byed de nyu)ni 'di nyid lags so//rgyal po yid rtso ma ches pa las des nyu)ji ltar gyur pa smras pa dang rgyal po mchog tu ngo mtshar skyes nas de nas des bu mo de dpal gyi 'byor pa chen pos byin nas dpung chen po dang chas te grong khyer der song saste sdig byed rgyal srid las phyung ste skyedage byed de yang pha'i rgyal srid la bzhag go/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/de'i tshe de'i dus kyi dge byed gang yin pa de ni nga nyid nyu8yin no/ /de'i tshe de'i dus kyi sdig byed gang yin pa de ni lhas byin 8'di nyid yin te/ de na yang du 'di byas pa mi gzo ba dang byas pa mi tshor ba yin no/ /da ltar yang 'dis ⑥byas pa mi gzo ba dang byas pa mi tshor ba yin no//gzhan yang 'di ji ltar byas pa mi gzo ba dang / byas pa mi tshor ba de nyon cig /dge slong dag sngon byung ba rgyal po'i pho brang 6zhig na rgyal po zhig 4—452

'byor pa dang / rgyas pa dang / bde ba dang / lo legs pa/ skye bo dang mi mang pos rab tu gang ba na rgyal srid byed du 'jug go/ /de btsun mo dang lhan cig rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed de/de ⑨rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed pa las rim gyis bu bzhi btsas late yal ga dang / lcug ①ma dang / rjes su mthun pa'i lcug ④ma dang sa ga'o/ /de rnams bsrings bskyed de chen por gyur nas yul gzhan gyi rgyal po'i bu mo dag las ⑤chung ma blangs pa dang / de rnams rgyal po la brnyas ༅thabs byed par brtsams pa dang / de nas rgyal pos spyugs te rang rang gi chung ma khrid de dong ba las ji tsam na dgon pa'i lam zhig tu phyin pa na de rnams lam rgyags ⑦chad nas de rnams la duphan tshun du nang khrims bcas te/chung ma re re bsad la de'i shas dgon pa'i lam rgal bar bya'o zhes byas so/ /sa gas bsams pa/ gzhan gyi srog gcod pa bas rang gi srog chud zos pa bla'i ⑨'dir yong ci'i dus la bab ce na chung ma khrid de bros te 'gro'o snyam nas/ des chung ma khrid de bros pa las de'i chung ma bza' ba dang btung ba dang huX bral ba dang lam gyi dub pas blong blong por gyur te smras pa/ rje'i sras srog dang bral sh+yibar 'gyur ro/ /sa gas bsams pa/ bdag gis 'di srin po rnams kyi ⑫nang nas yongs su bskyabs nas da tsogal te shi bar gyur na ma legs so snyam nas des brla'i sha las bcad de 8zar bcug cing / lag pa gnyis kyi rtsa gtubs ⑫pa'i khrag blud de des de khrid de rim gyis yiri zhig gi ⑩drung du phyin nas/ de na rtsa ba dang 'bras bus 'tsho bar byed do/ /ri de'i drung na 'bab chu zhig 'bab pa de la mi zhig dgras lag pa dang rkang pa gtubs tsonas chur bskyur te de ⑩1—453

chus khyer ba na nyam ①thag pa'i nga ro'i skad 'byin to②/ /sa ga yang phyogs gzhan zhig na rtsa ba dang 'bras bu rko ba las des mi de'i 'o dod 'bod pa thos nas / de sems kyi rgyud snying rjes brlan pas ri de la 'dzegs te kun tu blta bar brtsams pa las/ ji tsam na mi ②chus khyer ba de mthong nas des myur ba ④myur bar ri las babs te ⑤'bab chu'i nang du zhugs nas mi de khur du blangs te ⑥'bab chu'i 'gram du phyung ste bzhag nas de'i sdug bsngal gyis ④snying gdungs nas smras pa/ bu 'di ci las gyur/ des ji ltar gyur pa thams cad smras nas ⑧de nas des de dbugs phyung ste/ rtsa ba dang 'bras bus botshim par byas nas chung ma la gtad de / des skyede'i rim gro byas nas sos par 'gyur to/ /de de'i rim gro byed pa na gtsugs pa'i bde bas yang dang yang du drung du song nas gtam rnam pa sna tshogs smra zhing 'dug go/ /'di ni chos nyid yin te/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni rang bzhin gyis 'dod chags chung ba yin pas sa ga de dang lhan cig res 'ga' dga' mgur spyod la /nye/ res 'ga' cidaga' mgur spyod par mi byed do/ /byang chub sems dpa'i mthus sdong bu dang rtsa ba dang 'bras bu de dag lhag par mthu dang ldan pa yin pas des de dag longs spyad ⑫pas nyon mongs pa bdo nas mi rkang lag rdum bu 8de la bsgugs par brtsams pa dang de ma btub nas smras pa/ re zhig bdag shi zin pa dang 'dra ⑩ba las da lta 8sos pa yang stes te gson na/ gal te yang 'di 'dra ba byas na khyod kyi khyo des bdag thams cad kyi thams cad du srog dang phral bar 'gyur ba'i gnas gang yin pa de ⑩yod do/ /de la des yang nas 0 yang du bsgugs pa dang nyon mongs pa rnams ni thul bar dka' ba yin pas de 0de dang lhan cig nyal lo/ /4—454

de de dang lhan cig kun du dga' ba dang yid du 'ong ba dang / lhag par chags par gyur pas mngags kyang sde'i drung du mi 'gro'o/ /des bsams pa/'di ltar 'di chags par gyur la sha 'khon ①rnams kyi nang na ②'di lta ste/bud med kyi sha 'khon ①tha chad yin pas da ④ni bdag ma rung ngo snyam nas des de dang lhan cig gros bya bar brtsams te/ khyod kyi khyo 'dis gal te bdag cag nyal ba ⑤shes par gyur na gdon mi za bar khyod la gnod pa byed cing bdag kyang srog dang phral bar 'gyur ro/ /des bsams pa/ smras pa 'di ni legs kyis thabs shig bsham par bya'o snyam mo/ /bud med ni ma bslabs par mkhas pas des mgo bo zhugos kyis ⑦dkris nas ri'i brag ka zhig na nyal te 'dug go/ /ji tsam na sa ga ②rtsa ba dang 'bras bu khyer te tso'ongs nas 0 de de ltar nyal ba mthong nas de nas dris pa bzang mo 'di ci zhig /des smras pa/ rje'i sras bdag klad 7pa bro 8'tshal te te por mi bde'o/ /sa gas smras pa/ de la ji ltar bsgrub par 8bya/ des ri'i bya skyibs na rdo dreg cig mthong nas des smras pa/rje'i sras bdag sngon yang klad ④pa'i bro nad 'di byalta bus thebs pa na sman pas ⑩rdo dreg bstan te des sos ༅par gyur lags so/ /sa gas smras pa/ rdo dreg btsal tho)lo/ /des smras pa/ rje'i sras ri'i bya skyibs 'di la mchis kyis bdag gis khyod kyis spyang yithag gzung gis khyod kyis phyung shig /bdag nyid chen po drang po ⑥ drang po yin pas de'i ngan g.yo ma shes pas de bzhin du byas zung shig dang dbyung ngo zhes khas blangs nas des de thag pa las dpyang la btang ba dang / des lag pa gcig gis thag pa btang ba na des kyang btang nas chur lhung ngo / /sems can tshe ring ba rgyaX srid kyi bde ba nyams su myong 4—455

bar 'gyur ba ni mi 'chi ba yin pas chu'i rgyun phyogs su khyer nas rgyal po'i pho brang zhig tu phyin to/ /de'i rgyal po yang bu med par shi'o/ /blon po rnams dang / grong mi dang / yul mi dang bcas pa thams cad 'dus nas gros byed de / shes ldan dag rgyal po nongs na da su zhig rgyal srid la gzhag par bya/de rnams kyis ①mtshan mkhan gyi mi rnams bskos te/ shes ldan dag sems can bsod nams kyi skal ba chen po dang ldan pa tshol cig dang de rgyal srid la gzhag par bya'o/ /de rnams kyis phyogs kun du btsal bar brtsams ②pa na/ las rnams bskal pa brgyar yang ni/ /chud mi za ba'ang tshogs dang dus/ /rnyed na lus can rnams la ni/ /'bras bu dag tu 'gyur ba nyid/ /sa ga la rgyal srid 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i las kyi rnam par smin pa nyid nye bar gnas pas 'bab chu nas byung nas phyogs gzhan zhig na 'dug pa las byang chub sems dpa'i mthus sa duphyogs de rgyan gyis brgyan pa bzhin du 'dug go/ /ji tsam na mtshan mkhan gyi mi rnams phyogs der lhags nas rngubadag nyid chen po de rgyal srid kyi mtshan dang ldan par mthong nas/ de rnams dga' ba dang yid bde bas blon po rnams kyi drung du dong ste smras pa/ bdag cag gis btsal na sems can bsod nams kyi skal ba chen po dang ldan pa zhig yod de de la rgyal srid 'os ⑤so/ /de nas blon po de ༅rnams kyis lam gyi 0byi dor byas grong khyer byi dor byas nas dpal gyi 'byor pa chen pos grong khyer du khrid de nyi ma dang / tshes grangs dang /yud tsam dang / rgyu skar rnams rim bzhin du sbyar te rgyal srid kyi dbang bskur rol/ /de la btsun mo med nas blon po rnams dang / mdun na 'don rnams dang / yul gzhan gyi rgyal po rnams dang / gzhan yang nor can dang /1—456

tshong dpon dang / ded dpon rnams dang ①/ rang gi bu mo rgyan thams cad kyis bklubs ②nas khrid de rgyal pos khab tu bzhes par bya ba'i phyir grong khyer der lhags na/ rgyal po de bud med kyis sun phyung ba yin pas khas ma blangs so//blon po rnams kyis smras pa/ lha rgyal po rnams ni btsun mo dang / gzhon nu dang / blon po dang / grong mi dang / yul mir bcas pa lags kyis btsun mo gzhag tu gsol/ yul sna tshogs na gnas pa'i mi zhugatso bo rnams dang yul gzhan ④gyi rgyal po rnams dang / mi gtso bo de ⑤rnams kyi bu mo rnams de'i mngon ༅du 'gyur bar bya ba'i phyir sta gon byas te bzhag na/ 'on kyang de khas len du ma btub ste bud med rnams yang dang yang du smod ⑦do/ /sems can rnams kyi bsod nams kyi mthus longs spyod rnams mthu dang ldan zhing phun sum tshogs pa yin pas gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' ༅bud med byas pa chud gzon pas ri de las bor ba de'i tshe ri de'i rtsa ba dang 'bras bu rnams srabs par gyur cing mthu med par gyur to/ /de nas bud med de mu ge'i dus kyi 'chi ba'i 'jigs pas skrag ⑨nas rkang lag ma tshang ba'i mi rmye de khur du thogs te grong mthar song nas lam po che dang / srang dang / bzhi mdo dang / sum mdo rnams su yang 7sprang zhing rgyu'o/ /dris pa na smras pa/ bdag khyim thab las mi 'phyo ba'o8/ /bud med gang zhig khyim thab las mi 'phyo ba de 'jig rten gyis mchod pa'i chos de yod pas de gang du zhugs pa der slong tsomo 'thob bo ji tsam na de rim gyis rgyal po'i pho brang du phyin pa dang / 'jig rten gyis thos nas mchog tu ngo mtshar skyes so/ /kha cig dag ni ngo mtshar skyes nas de la blta ba'i phyir phyir 8byung ba dang grong khyer na gnas pa'i skye bo'i tsotshogs kyis glags 1—457

rnyed nas de dag 'phya bar byed/ gzhogs ①'phyas byed/ kha zer bar byed de/rgyal po 'di ni bud med thams cad la smod par byed na khyim thab ②las mi 'phyo ba mi rkang lag ma tshang ba khur ②nas 'khyam ④pa dam pa 'di ma mthong ba lta/gtam de mdun na 'don gyis rgyal po la smras pa dang ⑤/ rgyal pos bsams nas des smras pa/ bud med de bltas ༅khug shig⑦ /de bkug nas rgyal pos mthong ba dang / 'dzum dmul te tshigs su bcad pas smras pa/ nga yi brla yi sha dag dang / /khrag kyang zos shing 'thungs nas duni/ /rdum po khur du thogs pa khyod/ /khyim thab las da rtsami 'phyo 'am/ /rdo dreg dag gi ched du ni/ /nga ⑩ni g.yang husar bor nas su/ /rdum po khur du thogs pa khyod/ /khyim thab las da mi 'phyo 'am/ /de ngo tsha bar gyur pa'i snying gis gdong smad de 'dug go/ /blon po rnams kyis don de rgyal po la dris pa dang des ji ltar gyur pa rgyas par smras nas/ de la smad pa'i tshig gis grong khyer gyi phyi rol du bskrad do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag ji snyam du sems de'i tshe de'i dus kyi rgyal po skyogazhon nu sa ga gang yin pa de ni nga nyid yin no/ /de'i tshe de'i dus kyi bud med gang yin pa de ni lha sbyin 'di nyid yin te/ de na nyunyeyang 'di byas pa mi gzo ba dang byas pa mi tshor ba yin no/ /da ltar yang 'di byas pa mi gzo ba dang byas pa mi tshor ba yin no//gzhan yang ji ltar 'di byas pa mi gzo ba dang byas pa mi tshor ba de nyon cig /dge slong dag sngon byung ba thams cad kyi cogong rdal gyi grong khyer na rgyal po thams cad kyi bshes gnyen zhes bya ba zhig rgyal srid byed du 'jug ste/ 'byor pa dang / rgyas pa dang / bde ba dang / lo legs pa/ skye bo dang mi mang pos 4—458

rab tu gang ba na 'thab pa dang / thab ①mo dang / khrag 'khrug dang / 'gyed pa dang / chom rkun med cing nad rab tu zhi bar gyur pa 'bras dang / bu ram shing dang / ba lang dang ②/ ma he phun sum tshogs pa na chos kyi rgyal po chos dang ldan pal/ chos bzhin gyis rgyal srid byed du 'jug ste/ rgyal po de yang dad pa bzang ba / dge ba'i bsam pa can/ bdag dang gzhan la phan par zhugs pa/ snying rje can / bdag nyid chen po chos 'dod pa/ skye dgu ④la byams pa zhig yod pa de dus gzhan zhig na btsun mo dang lhan cig rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/dga' mgur ⑤spyod par ༅byed de/ de ⑨rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed pa na btsun mo sems can dang ldan par gyur to/ /de zla ba brgyad dam dgu 'das nas khye'u gzugs bzang bdu/ mdzes pa ⑨/ blta na sdug pa / pags tsu )pa'i mdog gser 'dra ba/ mgo bo tunyegadugs ltar 'dug pa tusme/dpung pa ring ba/ dpral ba'i dbyes che ba/ smin skum 'jar skyib/ sna'i gzangs byamatho ba/ yan lag dang nying lag thams cad dang ldan pa zhig btsas so / /btsas nas de'i btsas ston rgya cher byas nas/ khye'u'i ming cir gdags zhes kluming 'dogs par byed dobya/ /nye du rnams kyis smras pa/ khye'u 'di rgyal po thams cad kyi bshes gnyen gyi sras yin pas de bas na khye'u'i ming thams cad sgrol zhes bya bar gdags so/ /zhes btags nas ⑫khye'u thams cad sgrol ma ma brgyad 0po pang na 'tsho ba'i ma ma gnyis dang / nu ma snun pa'i zhu ma ma gnyis dang / dri ma 'phyi ba'i sum ma gnyis dang / rtsen 'grogs kyi ma ma gnyis dang ⑫/ ma ma brgyad ④la rjes su gtad nas de 'o ma dang / zho dang /mar dang / zhun mar dang / mar gyi snying khu dang / gzhan yang yo byad kyi 4wa 459

bye brag gtso bo gtso bo ①dag gis sring bar byed/ skyed par byed cing rdzing na gnas pa'i pad ma bzhin du myur du skyed par byed do/ /de ②gang gi tshe chen por gyur pa de'i tshe yi ge dang / grangs dang / rtsis dang / lag rtsis la nye bar zhugs shing rgyal po rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba yul gyi 'byor pa dang / mthu dang / brtson 'grus thob pa/ sa chen po'i dkyil 'khor mngon par zil gyis mnan te gnas pa rnams kyi bzo'i gnas dang las kyi gnas tha dad par gyur pa gang dag yin pa 'di lta ste/ glang po che'i gnya' bar zhon pa dang / rta la zhon pa dang / shing rta la zhon pa'i ②thabs dang /ral gri'i thabs dang / gzhu'i 'dzin stangs dang / mdun du bsnur ④ba dang /phyir bsnur ba dang / lcags kyus sgyur thabs dang / zhags pa gdab pa dang /mda' bo che 'phen pa dang / gcad pa dang / dral ba dang / dbug pa dang / 'dzin stangs dang / gom stangs dang / rgyang nas phog pa dang /sgra grag rgyapar rdzog pa dang / gnad du phog pa dang / mi 'chor yobar phog pa dang / tshabs che ba ste gnas lnga rnams rtsol yang ④byang bar gyur to/ /gzhon nu thams cad sgrol dad pa bzang ba/ dge ba'i bsam pa can/ bdag dang gzhan la phan par zhugs pa/ snying rje can bdag nyid chen po chos 'dod pa/skye dgu rnams la byams pa/ thams cad ⑨rab tu gtong ba/ thams cad ⑨ yongs su gtong ba/ chags pa med par yongs su gtong ba/ gtong ⑩ba chen po la zhugs pa yin te/ de'i gtong ba rgya chen po thos na tsodapag tshad brgya nas kyang don du gnyer ba'i skye bo 'ong ste/ thams cad kyang yid la re ba yongs su ⑫rdzogs par byas nas gtong ngo / /de nas re zhig cig na byang chub sems dpa' ④4wa 460

shing rta nor bu dang / gser dang / dngul dang / rdo rje dang / byi ru dang / bai ḍūr+ya ①dang / spug dang / pad ma rā ga ②dang / in+d+ra nī las 'bar bar byas pa/ tsan dan mchog gi snying po las bsgrubs pa/ seng ge dang / stag dang / gung gi pags ②pas g.yogs pa/ rta rlung gi shugs ltar mgyogs pa/ gser dang dngul gyi dril bu g.yer ma'i sgra 'khrol ba bzhi dang ldan pa mchog gi nang du zhugs nas grong khyer dam pa nas skyed mos tshal du mngon du ④song ngo / /de nas bram ze rig byed dang ⑤rig byed kyi yan lag shes pa kha cig gis thams cad sgrol bsu nas smras pa/ rgyal rigs gzhon nu khyod rgyal bar gyur cig /yang smras pa/ khyod ni 'jig rten thams cad du/ /thams cad gtong zhes rnam par grags/ /bram ze rnams la shing rta 'di/ /khyod kyis sbyin pa gtang zhubar rigs/ /de skad ces smras ⑦pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad sgrol shing rta de las myur ba 0myur bar babs te snying dga' ba dang / mgu ba dang / rab tu dga' bas bram ze de khyadag la shing rta de byin nas smras pa/ bdag gis ji ltar bram ze la/ /mchog tu dga' bas shing rta btang / /de bzhin bdag gis srid pa gsum/ /btang nas byang chub mchog reg shog /de dus gzhan zhig na glang po che'i mchog rgyal srid 'phel zhes bya ba me tog kun da dang / puṇ+ḍa rī ka ⑩dang / kha ba dang /dngul dang / sprin dkar po lta bu'i mdog can bdun legs par gyur pa/rkang lag legs par gnas pa/ glang po che sa srung gi bu ltar 'gying zhing 'gro ba/skal ba mchog gi mtshan can/ bsod nams byas pas mthong ba la zhon nas shin tu sdug pa'i bran dang / mdza' bshes dang / g.yog ⑩rnams phyi bzhin 4wa 461

'brang ①zhing zla ba rgyu skar gyi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba bzhin du so ga'i ②dus la bab ②pas shing rnams me tog kha 'bus shing / ngang pa dang / khrung khrung dang / rma bya dang / ne tso ④dang / ri skegs dang / khu byug dang /shang shang te'u sgra 'byin pa'i nags tshal gyi skyed mos tshal gyi ⑤sar song ba dang /de nas phyir rgol bas rbad ༅pa'i bram ze kha cig gzhon nu thams cad sgrol gyi drung du rings pa rings par 'ongs nas gzhon nu thams cad sgrol la smras pa/ rgyal rigs gzhon nu khyod rgyal bar gyur cig /yang smras pa/ lha min lhar bcas 'jig rten du/ /khyod ni thams cad gtong zhes grags/ /khyod kyi glang po mchog 'di ni/ /bdag cag rnams la stsal ba'i rigs/ /de skad ces smras pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' glang po che'i mchog de las myur ba myur bar babs nas/ dga' ba dang / mgu ba dang / rab tu dga' ba'i yid kyis de dag la glang po che'i mchog de byin nas smras pa/ bdag gis ji ltar bram ze la//mchog tu dga' bas glang chen btang / /de bzhin bdag gis srid pa gsum/ /btang nas byang chub mchog reg shog /rgyal po thams cad kyi bshes gnyen gyi ⑦bu thams cad sgrol gyis glang po che'i mchog rgyal srid 'phel zhes bya ba phyir rgol bas rbad dupa'i bram ze rnams la byin no ⑨zhes thos so/ /thos nas kyang rgyal po thams cad kyi cibashes gnyen shin tu khros 'khrugs nas gzhon nu thams cad sgrol bkug ste smras pa/ gzhon nu khyod 7nga'i yul na ma 'dug par song shig /de nas gzhon nu thams cad sgrol phas spangs pa dang bsams pa/ bdag gis byang chub kyi phyir 'bad pa byas pa dang / 'jig rten thams cad rjes su gzung ⑫ba'i phyir brtson 'grus kyi go cha bgos pas glang po che de yang btang ste/ de bas 4—462

khyim na gnas pas ni/ /ci nus pas ni sbyin pa btang ①/ /dka' thub nags su brten nas ni/ /nges pa mchog dag bya ba yin/ /bslangs na ②mi sbyin bya ba yini/ /tshig ni smra bar mi phod kyi⑦/ /de bas bdag ni khyim spangs te/ /dka' thub nags su rab tu 'gro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas de ltar snying la mna' mtho bcad nas chung ma rgyags sbyin ⑤ma'i drung du song ste de dag rgyas par smras so/ /de nas rgyags sbyin mas thos ⑥ma thag tu sdug pa dang bral bar dogs pa'i snying gis thal mo sbyar te byang chub sems dpa' la smras pa/ rje'i sras gal te de ltar ⑦na bdag kyang dka' thub kyi nags su mchi ste/ bdag ni rje'i sras dang bral na skad cig tsam yang 'tsho bar rngo mi ⑧thog lags so/ /ci'i slad du zhe na/ nam mkha' zla bas stongs nyupar gyur pa dang / /ji ltar sa ni lo tog gis stongs dang / /pad ma chu yis stongs par gyur pa dang / /bud med khyim thab kyis stongs rtso )de bzhin no/ /byang chub sems dpas smras pa/bdag cag mthar gdon mi za bar 'bral bar nyunye'agyur te/ 'di ni 'jig rten gyi rang bzhin 8no/ /khyod ni bza' ba dang / btung ba dang / mal cha dang /bgo ba mchog cil goms pas lus ④shin tu skyid de 8ba yin/ dka' thub kyi nags na ⑩ni rtswa dang lo ma bting bar ni nyal/ rtsa ⑩ba dang / me tog dang /'bras bu ni za/ rtswa drar 8ba dang / zug rdo dang / rtswa byudang / tsher mas gang ba'i sa la ni rgyu/ yang dang yang du za gcig du )pa la ni stenadu spre/bdag nyid skye bo thams cad la ni bsten dgos/ glo tsobur du 'ongs pa thams cad mchod pa la ni 'bad dgos la/ de na yang nga gdon mi za bar ci nus kyis sbyin pa gtong ste de la khyod kyis cung zad kyang mi 'gyod par bya dgos so/ /4—463

de bas na re zhig da dung yang legs par soms ①shig rgyags sbyin ②mas smras pa/rje'i sras bdag rngo ci thog ②gis rje'i sras kyi rjes su sgrub ④lags so/ /byang chub sems dpas smras pa/ gal te de lta na dam bcas pa de dag khyod kyis dran par byos shig /de nas byang chub sems dpa' pa'i ②drung du song nas mgo bos phyag byas te/ yab cig ⑥bdag gis sbyin par glang chen stsal/ /nongs pa ༅gang lags sa bdag bzod ⑧par gsol/ /bdag ni grong nas dgon par mchi ⑨lags kyi/ /mi yi dbang po phyag mdzod stongs cim gyur/ /de nas rgyal po bu dang bral ba'i sdug bsngal gyis dbugs kyis brnangs 0te skad 'dar 'dar bos the2smras pa/ bu sbyin pa'i blo bor la 'dug shigatso /byang chub sems dpas smras pa/ sa ni ri dang bcas par yang / /gal te ldog par 'gyur gda' yis//sa bdag bdag ni sbyin pa las/ /sems ni ldog par mi bgyid do/ /zhes smras nas song ngo / /de nas bu dang / bu mo dang / chung ma dang lhan cig shing rta'i nang du zhugs te grong khyer dam pa de nas byung nas pho brang 'khor gyi mi dang yul mi mya ngan byed pa brgya stong rjes su 'brang bzhin du song ngo / /de nas mi zhig gis ngu zhing smre sngags 'don pa'i sgra de yang thos/ skye bo'i tshogs chen po byagrong khyer gyi sgor byung ba yang mthong nas mi zhig la dris pa/ kye nang rje skye bo'i tshogs chen po 'di cho nges 8'debs pa ci las gyur des smras pa/ shes ldan ci mi shes sam/ 'di ltar mi yi dbang po nyid kyi sras po mche ba bzang / /brtan ⑩pa'i ngang tshul rab tu sbyin la dga' ba 'di nas sprugs/ /de ni bu dang chung ⑩mar bcas te nags mthar chas pa la/ /pho brang 'khor ba rnams 'dus shin tu snying rjes cho nges 'debs/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas grong khyer 4wa 464

dam pa de nas byung ba'i pho brang 'khor ba rnams la ci rigs par mngon du ①song nas smras pa/ shes ldan dag slar deng shig /slar deng shig /'di ltar shin tu yun ring po nas sdug pa dang 'grogs pa yang mjug tu gdon mi za ②bar 'bral ba'i mtha' can du 'gyur te/ gnyen ④gyi skye bo dang 'grogs pa ni lam ma'i ngal thubaso ba'i bste gnas kyi shing dang 'dra bas gdon mi za bar sdug pa dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /de ⑤ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'jig rten kun na skye bo dbang med de/ /mdza' ba rnams dang bral ⑥bar 'gyur bsams tsonas/ /khyed kyis sa steng 'bad pa thams cad kyisabya/ /tso)zhi phyir blo gros mi g.yo brtan pa ⑩gyisal/ /de nas dpag tshad sum 7brgya 'das pa dang hu)/ byang chub sems dpa' mthong nas bram ze zhig mngon du 'ongs te smras pa/ kye rgyal rigs gzhon nu bdag ni khyod kyi yon tan thos nas 'di nas dpag tshad sum brgya tsam gyi yul nas 'dir mchis lags kyis/ khyod kyi shing rta mchog 'dis bdag ngal ba 'bras bu mchis par bgyi ba'i rigs so/ /de nas rgyags sbyin rkyem mi bzod pa skyes te tshig brlang tho) pos bram ze de la smras pa/ e ma'o nags na'ang mi dbang sras la slong ba gang / /bram ze 'di ni shin tu brtse ba med pa'i blo/ /mi dbang sras po mi dbang dpal las nyams gyur pa/ /'di la 'dir ni snying rje cig mi skye'am/ /byang chub sems dpas smras pa/ khyod kyis bram ze ma spyo shig/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rgyags sbyin tshugal te nor 'dod len pa 'di dag skyemed gyur na/ /kun sbyin med par mi gang zhig gis sa steng byang chub 'thob/ /sbyin sogs tshupha rol phyin drug tshul gyis yon tan mchog can gyi/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis kun mkhyen nyid mchog rtag tu 'thob/ /de nas byang 4wa 465

chub sems dpa' mchog tu dga' ①bas rta dang ldan pa'i shing rta de bram ze de la byin nas smras pa/ bram ze ser sna dri ma sel byed pa/ /shing rta rab tu byin pa 'di yis 'dir/ /bdag ni drang srong che ②mchog gis bskor ba'i/ /zag med chos kyi shing rta che skor shog /de nas thams cad sgrol gyis snying rab tu dga' bas shing rta'i mchog de yang bram ze la byin nas gzhon nu ②mdog gnag phrag pa la khyer/ rgyags sbyin byams ni gzhon nu ma dra ba can khyer nas dka' thub kyi nags ༅logs su chas pa dang rim gyis dka' ༅thub kyi nags su phyin to/ /de nas thams cad sgrol dka' thub kyi tshal der rang gi snying mgu bar byed pa'i brtul zhugs blangs te gnas so/ /ci tsam na rgyags sbyin lcam rtsa ba dang 'bras bu'i phyir dka' thub kyi nags su dusong ba dang bram ze zhig thams cad sgrol gyi drung du 'ongs nas smras pa/ rgyal rigs gzhon nu khyod rgyal bar gyur cig /bdag cag bkol ba ma mchis pa ⑨/ /spa shug lhan cig 'khyam bgyid na/ /de yi don du bus pa gnyis/ /khyod kyis bdag la sbyin pa'i rigs/ /de skad ces smras pa dang / de nas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad sgrol bu sdug pa gtong ba la chung shig sems shing 'dug pa dang de nas bram ze des byang chub sems dpa' thams cad sgrol la smras pa/ kye rgyal cirigs gzhon nu bdag gis khyod thams cad ster ba'o zhes thos na 'di ltar khyod la bdag gis bslangs pa de la ci zhig dpyad du yod/ khyod ni kun ster snying rje yi/ /bdag nyid can du sa steng 7grags/ /ji ltar grags pa de bzhin du/ /khyod kyis rtag tu bya ba'i rigs / /de skad ces ⑩smras pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad sgrol gyis 'bram ze de la smras pa/ kye bram ze chen po/ rang gi srog ni gtong ba 4—466

la'ang / /lan 'ga' dpyod ①pa ma myong na/ /rang gi bu ni gtong ②ba la/ /bdag blo gzhan du 'gyur ci smos/ /bram ze chen po de lta mod kyis/ bdag gis nags su bskyed thubaskyed pa'i/ /bus pa 'di gnyis yongs spangs na/ /ma dang bral ba'i nyon mongs pa/ /'di dag ji ltar gnas snyam mod/ /gzhon nu shin tu brtse med pas/ /bus pa btang la bdag min ⑤zhes/ /kha cig bdag la 'phyar yi'ong gis/ /bram ze bdag ni khrid na legs/ /de nas bram ze des thams cad sgrol la smras pa/ kye rgyal rigs gzhon nu rgyal po chen po'i rigs su skyes pa/ sa 'di thams cad du yon tan grags pa/ srog chags thams cad la snying rje ⑦brtse bas 'o byams par zhugs pa/ sbyin pa dang /mchod pa dang / bkur stis spos kyi glang po lta bu dge sbyong dang / bram ze dang / blo 0bur ba'i skye bo la mchod pa byed pa/ skye bo bkren pa dang /phongs pa dang / mgon med pa dang / ltogs pa yongs su sdug pa thams cad kyi yid la re ba yongs su rdzogs par byed pa/ mthong na don yod pa khyod ༅kyis bdag 'ongs na cinom pa med pa'am/ lam gyis ༅dub pa 'bras bu med pa'am/mthong na don med pa'am/ re ba dang yun ring po nas brnag brnag pa'i 'dod pa 'bras bu 8med par bya ba gang yin pa de ni cha ma yin te/ khyod kyi ⑫ med do zhes bya ba'i tshig gis 8kho bo'i yid la re ba kun tu rtog pa'i rta bstabs ⑫na myur du ldog par 'gyur ro/ /de bas na khyod kyis bdag gi yid la re ba yongs su rdzogs par byas nas btang (9ba'i rigs so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/chu gter gos su gyon zhing bza' mig mtshungs med pa/ /ri bo mchog rgyas nu mar ldan pa'i ro stod can/ /grong khyer grong rdal bcas pa'i sa la btsal byas 1—467

kyang / /mche bzang khyod dang mtshungs par gtong phod yod ma yin/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad sgrol gyis bram ze'i tshig de thos nas bu la chags pa'i slong ①bas 'di dag sems par byed de/ gal te re zhig bu gnyis po / /bram ze ②byin na bu dang ni/ /bral ba ③las byung sdug bsngal dag /bdag dang rgyags sbyin ④gyis 'thob 'gyur/ /'on te 'di la ma byin na/ /brtul zhugs las kyang nyams gyur cing / /bram ze 'di ni tshi chad ⑤de/ /ji ltar 'ongs pa bzhin du 'gro/ /nyes yin bu bral nyam thag pa'i/ /mya ngan sa steng bdag gis 3blang / /de bzhin ma byas dam bcas pa/ /zhig cing brtul zhugs nyams par 'gyur⑤/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad sgrol gyis sdug pa'i bu gnyis nges par btang 0bar chad nas smras pa/ kye kho bos dka' spyad brgya yis 'jig rten sdug bsngal gyinyuste / /rgya mtsho chen po so sor 'jigs hubyed pa/ /gting mi dpogs par rab tu bying cib dag /pha rol bsgral phyir lam gyi zam stegs bca'/ /zla ba dri med nya ba'i bzhin ras can/ /ma zhum kha nas de skad tshig smras nas/ /mchi ma'i brlan 8chus mig ni gang gyur pas ⑨ / /byis 8pa gnyis po bram ze de la byin/ /yang smras pa/ bu 'di byin pa'i 'bras bu ni/ /rgya chen bdag gis thob gyur nas/ /des ni 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las/ /'jig rten rnams ni bsgral bar bya/ /byis pa gzhon nu dag byin ma thag tu sa 'di rnam pa drug tu g.yos so/ /de nas sa g.yo ba ⑩des nags de na gnas pa'i dka' thub can rnams sngangs 0nas phan tshun smras pa/sa ni mi bzad tsogayos gyur pa/ /'di ni su yi mthu ltas yin/ /gang gi mthu ni 'di 'dra ba/ /shin tu bsal /webar shes par bya/ /de na gnas 'jog dang 4—468

rus ①gcig ②pa rgan po dka' thub can ltas shes pa la mkhas pa gzhan ②zhig yod pa des drang srong de rnams la don de go bar byas pa/ gdon mi za bar dka' byathub kyi nags su ⑤'dug pa'i bu byis pa 'bras bu dang chu 'thung ba yid du 'ong ba'i ⑥mig tu sdug par byed pa gnyis thams cad sgrol gyis skye bo ④sdug bsngal gyis nyam ②thag pa/ yongs su thar bar bya ba'i phyir btang ste/ des na las g.yos par ⑩gyur to// //'dul ba gzhi7/ bam po brgya 8pa/ de nas bus pa tsogazhon nu de gnyis kyis phas snying nas yongs su btang ba'i blo rig nas snying rje rje skad du ngu zhing thal mo gnyis sbyar nas thams cad sgrol gyi hu rkang pa 8gnyis la gtugs te smras pa/ yab cig yum ni ma mchis par/ /khyod ni bdag cag stsol bzhed pa/ /re zhig de ni mthong gyur nas/ /de nas bdag cag stsal du gsol/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' yid la gcags pa'i sdug bsngal gyis ngom zung phyaganag cing mchi ma 'dzag bzhin de gnyis la 'khyud nas smras pa/ bu dag nga yi tsosnying du mi sdug min/ /snying brtse 8snying rje med min te/ /'jig rten kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /yon tan mthong nas btang ba yin/ /ci nas nga yis byubyang chub mchog /zhi ba rang gis cithob nas ni/ /sdug bsngal rgya mtsho la gnas pa'i/ /rten med 'jig rten rnams bsgral lo/ /de nas byis pa gzhon nu de dag gis phas 0snying nas yongs su btang ba'i blo rig nas pha'i rkang pa gnyis la mgo bos tsophyag 'tshal te thal mo sbyar nas snying rje rje skad dang sma 3bab pa'i tshig gis dal gyis smras pa/ gal te khyod kyis thag bkum na/ /ma la bdag cag gnyis kyi phrin 3—/ /khyod kyis bzod pa mdzod cig ces/ /yab cig khyod kyis gsung du 4wa 469

gsol / /yab gzhan yang byis par gyur pas bla ma khyod la nongs pa ①bgyis pa gang / /gal te la lar thugs la mi bab 0tshig 'ga' smras pa 'am/ /gus par mnyan pas yongs su mnyes pa nyid du ma bgyis pa/ /de ni byis pa'i nongs pa lags zhes ③bzod pa mdzad du gsol/ /de skad ces smras nas pha la phyag 'tshal te lan gsum du bskor ba byas nas mig mchi mas gang bzhin bla ma la smra bar yid la gcags pas yang dang yang ④phyir lta zhing bsti gnas de nas byung ste song ngo / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' byis pa gzhon nu'i tshig shin tu snying rjer rung ba de dag gis snying blong nas yid kyi ⑤byang chub tu smon lam btab ste/⑥dka' thub kyi tshal gyi lo ma'i spyil bur zhugs so/ /byis pa gzhon nu dag dong ma thag tu stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di yang rnam pa drug tu g.yos so/ /lha stong phrag du mas ༅yang bar snang la ca co dang ga zha'i sgra 'byin cing / e ma'o rab sbyin bdag nyid che/ /byis pa 'di gnyis btang ⑧nas kyang / /gang gi yid ni 'gyur med pa/ /de ni spunges pa rmad ⑩cig go/ /de nas rgyags sbyin byam rtsa ba dang 'bras bu rnams khyer te bsti gnas logs su ⑫chas pa las sa che thang du g.yos pa des myur ba kho nar bsti gnas de nyid du song ba dang / lha gzhan zhig gis rgyags sbyin ma 8byang chub sems dpa' sems can cithar bar bya bar brtson pa 8byas pa'i sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i bar chad byed par 'gyur du 'ong ngo snyam nas seng ge mo zhig gi yigazugs su bsgyur te lam bkag sbyinas 'dug pa dang rgyags sbyin tsoms ri dgas kyi rgyal po'i chung ma de la smras pa/ ri dgas rgyal po'i chung ma sgeg sgeg ma/ kho mo lam 'dir yibakag nas ci ste 'dug /ji ltar bdag ni mi 'phyo nges gyur na0 / /lam 4—470

las bzur te 7myur du 'gro bar gyis/ /gzhan yang khyod kyang ri dgas rgyal po'i chung ma la/ /bdag kyang mi yi ②dbang po seng ge yi/ /btsun mo yin pas chos kyi spun gyur ①gyis/ /ri dgas rgyal mos bdag gi lam phye shig /de skad ces smras pa dang lha seng ge mo'i gzugs su bsgyur ba de yang lam de nas logs shig tu song ngo / /de nas rgyags sbyin ④mas bkra mi shis pa'i ltas dag mthong nas yud tsam zhig bsams pa/ ji ltar bar snang la ngud mo'i sgra grag ⑤pa dang / ji ltar yang ༅tshal na gnas pa'i 'byung po rnams mya ngan byed pa'i sgra grag ⑦pa las na gdon mi za bar bsti gnas su sem legs pa zhig byung bar gyur to snyam nas smras pa/ ji ltar bdag mig 'gul ba dang / /ji ltar bya skad 'byin pa dang / /ji ltar bdag ni dogs pa las/ /bus pa de gnyis btang bar nges/ /ji ltar sa 'di g.yos pa dang / /bdag gi snying ni 'dar ba dang //ji ltar lus kyang rma ba las༅/ /bus pa de yang btang ⑩bar nges/ /zhes de lta bu'i mi legs pa brgya stong dag sems shing bsti gnas su song nas bste gnas su zhugs te/ mi dga' bzhin yibaltas na bu de gnyis ma mthong nas de nas rmongs shing snying 'dar bas bste gnas kyi gzhi de'i rjes bzhin du sems te/phyogs 'di na ni gzhon nu mdog nag sring mo dang lhan cig ri dgas kyi phru gu dang lhan cig rtag tu rtse rtse/ 'di ni de gnyis kyis sa 'ardul las byas pa'i khyim yin / 'di ni de gnyis kyi rtsed mo'i cha byad yin na de gnyis ni mi snang na gal te zhig na bdag gis ma mthong gi lo ma'i spyil bur zhugs nas nyal lta srid dam snyam du de ltar snying la re zhig 'bu mthong bar 'dod pas rtsa ba dang 'bras bu phyogs gcig 8tu bzhag nas mig mchi mas gang bzhin du khyim thab kyi rkang pa 4—471

gnyis ①la gtugs te smras pa/ rje'i sras khye'u dang bu mo de ②gnyis gang du mchis / thams cad sgrol gyis smras pa/ kho bo'i drung du bram ze zhig /re bas yang dag 'ongs gyur nas/ /bus pa de gnyis de la byin/ /de la rjes su yi rang gyis/ /de skad ces smras pa dang / rgyags sbyin ④ma ri dgas mo mda' dug can gyis phog pa bzhin du sa la skyel ⑤nas nya chu'i gnas nas phyung ba bzhin du 'gre ldog par byed/ khrung khrung bu stor ba bzhin du ⑥ni snying rje rje skad du ngu /ba be'u shi ba bzhin du ni 'ba' sgra ⑦sna tshogs 'don cing smras pa/ pad mo ⑧gzhon nu lta bu'i byad bzhin can/ /lag pa pad ma'i mda' 0ltar gzhon sha can / /bdag gi bu gnyis sdug bsngal ma myong ba/ /'gro ba gang du yisong nas sdug bsngal gyur/ /ri dgas bu ltar drang zhing ri dgas migayo /ri dgas lhan cig bsti gnas dga' ba 8na/ /de ring bdag gi tsobu gnyis ji lta bural/ /gzhan gyi dbang gis dong zhing sdug bsngal gyur/ /mig ni mchi mas gang ba'i mig gis ni/ /snying rjes ngu bas shin tu sdug bsngal ba/ /de ring bdag gis legs par ma mthong bas/ /skye bo bkren pa'i nang na sdug pas 'tsho//de gnyis bdag gi pang nas ④bskyed bskyed pa/ /zas su rtsa ba me tog 'bras bu za / /bzod dang gnas pas bla ma rtag dga' bsabla/ /bdag gi bu gnyis shin tu sdug bsngal lo/ /de gnyis ma dang nye du bral ba dang / /rtsa tshulag rnams kyis gzu lums spangs pa las/ /skye bo sdig can ngan dang phrad gyur nas//bdag gi bu gnyis shin tu sdug bsngal lo/ /skom zhing bkres ⑩pas bdag nyid rtag gdungs na/ /de gnyis su yi dbang gis 'gro bar 'gyur/ /bran du gyur pas tsogadon mi za bar ni/ /de gnyis nyam thag yisdug bsngal yongs su zin⑥/ /1—472

bdag gis nges par tshe rabs gzhan dag tu/ /srog chags sdug pa brgya dag phral ①ba yi/ /sdig las shin tu mi bzad ②'dir byas pa / /des na ba be'u med bzhin cho nges 'debs/ /bden tshig gang gis bdag ni rtag tu yang / /sems can kun la yid ni mnyam gyur pa/ /bden tshig des ni bdag gi bu gnyis po/ /bran du gyur pa las ni thar bar shog /de nas rgyags sbyin mas bus pa gzhon nu de dag gis bskyed cing bsrungs ④pa'i shing gang yin pa de dag lo ma thib be 'dug par mthong nas snying du sdug nas ⑤'khyud de smras pa/ bus pas ⑥ril ba chung ngu'i chus bcus pa⑦/ /lo ma rnams la duchu thigs 'dzag pa yi//ljon shing rnams ni sems dang bcas pa bzhin/ /bus pa nu zho ma blud lta bur ngu//yang bus pa gzhon nu de gnyis khyadang rtse rtse ba'i ri dgas kyi phru gu bsti gnas na 'dug pa rnams mthong nas mi dga' ste snying rje rje skad kyi tshig gis dal bus smras pa / de'i ne'u zla mthong bar 'dod pa gang / /gnas su sa tshugs mtshon cing tshol byed pa/ /ri dgas phru gu rgyu ba 'di dag kyang / / bdag gi ༅sdug bsngal mi chung gzhan yin no/ /de nas bus pa gzhon nu de dag lam gang nas dong ba'i lam der rjes bcad pa dang / bus pa gzhon nu de gnyis rjes drang por ma byung gi gya gyus gang bar mthong nas lhag par yang sdug bsngal gyis gdungs nas smras pa/ ji ltar 'then pa'i 7rjes byung dang / /la lar myur du song ba las/ /brdegs te khrid par gdon mi za/ /kye ma bram ze brtse med ⑫mchog /mgul ni dbugs kyis brdzags 8shing skad kyang 'dzer/ /ma mchu ⑫mdzes pa 'dar zhing bdag gi bu/ /ri dgas bzhin du ④mig kyang rig rig ste//rkang pa 'jam pos ji ltar song zhig gu/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' ⑩de 4—473

ltar smre sngags 'don pa'i bdag nyid de mthong nas mi rtag pa nyid dang ldan pa'i tshig de dang de dag gis rnam grangs mang por go bar byas nas smras pa/ kho bos bu gnyis grags pa yis/ /btang ba ma yin snang bas ①min/ /sems can kun la phan don du/ /btang bar zhudaka' ba'i 0bu de btang ④/ /mchog tu btang sdudaka' bdag nyid dang / /bu dang chung ma rnams btang zhunas//sems dpa' chen pos tshul bzhin du/ /byang chub mchog ni thob ༅par 'gyur/ /rgyags sbyin bdag gis gtong dub la brten gtang ⑨dka' ba'i/ /bus pa de gnyis 'jig rten thar pa'i don du btang rtso/ /bdag dang chung ma gzhon nu nor yang gtang kyebya ste/ /kun la thams cad btang skyoba'i blo gros nga la yod/ /de nas rgyags sbyin mas sems brtan 6te/ byang chub sems dpa' la smras pa/khyod la bar chad mi bgyid kyis/ /khyod blo gzhan du ma 'gyur cig /gal te bdag kyang stsol bzhed na/ /dogs pa ma mdzad bdag stsol cig /gzhan yang dpa' bo mugang phyir nyid kyi mi/ /sdug pas chags pa btang meb yi/ /don de myur du thob nas ni/ /srid las 'gro ba bsgral bar mdzod/ /de nas lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyis byang chub sems dpa' dang / rgyags sbyin skyem lku brtson 'grus shin tu rmad du byung ba dang / shin tu bya dka' bar rig nas sum bcu rtsa gsum pa'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor te/ steng gi nam mkha' 8las bsti gnas der lhags nas ༅snang ba rgya chen pos gnas gu rngu de gsal bar byas te / nam mkha' la 'dug bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' la smras pa/ 'di ltar 'jig rten rmongs pa blo ngan gzhung gis bcings pa'i blo gros can/ /longs spyod la chags snying gi zhags pa bu yis bcings pa'i nang na yang / /khyab bdag 4—474

khyod gcig ⑨chags pa med pas dga' ba skyed pa'i bu gtong bas/ /nges par go 'phang bde dang zhi ba dri med dka' ba med pas ②'thob/ /de skad ces byang chub sems dpa' spro ba bskyed snonas lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya ④byin gyis bsams pa/ 'di gcig ⑤pu g.yog dang bral na nyon mongs par 'gyur gyis/ma la bdag gis rgyags sbyin ma bslang zhungo snyam nas/ de nas bram ze'i cha byad du bsgyur te byang chub sems dpa'i drung du song nas yang byang chub sems dpa' la smras pa/ yan lag kun bzang khyim thab ⑦las/ /'phyo ba med cing snying nye ba/ /rigs na bsngags shepa'i sring mo 'di/ /bdag la bran mo'i don du stsol/ /de nas rgyags sbyin ⑨ma mi bzod pa skyes nas bram ze la smras pa/ngo tsha med cing hu brkam pa khyod/ /'di ni bram ze'i tha shal te/ /khyod lta 'phyon hum mi byed cing / /dam chos dga' ba nga 'dod dam/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad sgrol snying rje dang ldan pa'i snying gis rgyags sbyin tsam la brtag par brtsams pa dang / de nas rgyags sbyin skyems byang chub sems dpa' la smras pa/ bdag ni bdag la g.yar skyongan med/ /de bzhin bdag la lta ma lags/ /gcig pu ji ltar bzhugs 'gyur zhes/ /de ltar khyod slang g.yar ngan bgyid/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas 8rgyags sbyin byam la smras pa/go 'phang mi zad ngamya ngan med pa tshol bdag la/ /sa steng 'dir ni rgyags sbyin ⑫mya ngan bya mi dgos/ /khyod ni mya ngan med par bram ze 'di rjes 'brongs/ /bdag ni ri dgas 'chi ⑩ba bzhin du bste gnas 'then0 / /de skad ces smras nas dga' ba dang / mgu ba dang / yid rab tu dga' bas bsams pa 0/sbyin pa 'di ni nags tshal 'dir/ /bdag gi sbyin pa tha ma yin/ /rgyags 4—475

sbyin 'dir ①yang yongs btang nas/ /yongs su gzung ②ba med par 'gyur snyam du rig nas rgyags sbyin ①ma lag pa nas bzung ste bram ze de la smras pa/bdag gi ④mchis 'brang ⑤sdug pa 'di/ /snying nas snying nye bsgo ba nyan/ / ya rabs ༅tshul can snyan par smralta/ /bram ze'i mchog khyod bzhes su gsol/ /de nas mche ba bzang po yi du/ /chung ma byang chub 'dod phyir btang ⑨/ /chu la gru ni ji lta bar/ /sa ni mtha' dag rnam drug g.yos/ /de nas rgyags sbyin byam bram ze'i dbang du gyur te/ khyo dang / bu dang / bu mo dang bral ba'i sdug bsngal gyis nyam thag nas dbugs brdzags /sprepas mgul sgra ngar ngar por 'gags 8bzhin 'di skad ces smras so/ /bdag gis tshe rabs snga ma la/ /ci 'dra ba yi las ngan byas/ /des na ba be'u shi ba bzhin/ /skye bo med pa'i nags na ngu / /de nas lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyis bram ze'i cha byad mi snang bar byas te rang bzhin gyi cha byad du gnas nas rgyags sbyin hu)ma la smras pa/ skal bzangs d+ku bdag ni bram ze ma yin mi yang ma yin gyi/ /bdag ni lha yi dbang po brgya byin lha min 8'joms byed de/ /khyod kyi tshe'adul ba'i ⑩mchog tu gyur pa 'di yis bdag mgu yis/ /bdag las dam pa gang zhig 'dod pa de 'dir smra bar gyis/ /de nas de'i tshig gis rgyags sbyin 8ma yid bde ba skyes nas brgya byin la phyag 'tshal nas smras pa/ spyan stong ldan pa bdag gi bu/ /bran gyur pa las thar mdzad cing / /mes po'i drung du phyin par yang / /sum bcu rtsa gsum bdag pos mdzod/ /de skad ces smras nas yang dbang po chen po bsti gnas su zhugs nas byang chub sems dpa'i drung du song ste0/ rgyags sbyin ⑥ ma lag pa g.yon pas bzung nas byang chub sems dpa' la smras pa/ bdag 1—476

gis khyod la rgyags sbyin ①'di/ /g.yog gi phyir ni sbyin par byas/ /khyod kyis su la'ang ②ma sbyin cig /bzhag pa byin na smad par 'gyur/ /de nas lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyis bram ze khye'u dang bu mo khyer ba de ji ltar grong khyer gzhan yin no snyam ②nas grong khyer de nyid du song ste bus pa gzhon nu de dag btsong bar brtsams ④pa de lta bur ⑤mongs par byas so/ /ji tsam na blon po rnams kyis mthong nas rgyal po la smras pa/ lha khyod kyi dpon po mdog nag ⑥dang / /dra ba can dang de gnyis ni/ /bram ze shin tu ma rungs pa/ /grong khyer mchog 'dir 'tshong zhing klumachis/ /de skad ces ②thos nas rgyal po de sems mi dga' nas smras pa/ /gzhon nu gnyis myur du ston cig /blon po rnams kyis skad phyung ba dang grong khyer pa rnams myur du rgyal po'i mdun du nye bar lhags nas༅/ ji tsam na blon po gzhan zhig ⑩ gis rgyal po'i drung du khrid pa dang / mi yi dbang po mngon phyogs khrid pa'i tsha bo gos med cing / /lus rbeg dri ma can gyi lus de de yis mthong nas ni/ /mod la seng ge'i 'khri las sa yi steng du ltung ⑩gyur te/ /pho brang 'khor mi blon tshogs bud med dag kyang 0ngu bar gyur/ /de nas rgyal pos blon po rnams la byasmras pa/ gang zhig nags na gnas pa ④yang / /sbyin la tsomangon par ⑩dga' ba'i yid/ /mig bzangs ⑫de ni myur du 'dir/ /chung ma dang bcas dgug par gyis/ /de nas lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyis byang chub sems dpa' la phyag byas nas rang gi gnas su song ngo / /phyi zhig na rgyal po thams cad kyi bshes gnyen 'das pa dang / bram ze de yidang / blon po dang / grong mi dang / yul mi ⑥ rnams ⑥lhan cig chubasti gnas der song nas byang chub sems dpa' la gsol ba btab ste/4—477

rang gi grong khyer du bos nas rgyal por bcug go/ /de nas rgyal po thams cad sgrol ②thams cad gtong zhes bya bar gyur to/ /des dge sbyong ②dang / bram ze dang / bkren pa dang / phongs ②pa dang / mdza' bo dang / nye du dang / gnyen bshes ④dang / zho shas 'tsho ba rnams la sbyin pa rnam pa du ma dag byin nas tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ byang chub don du gnyer ba yis/ /rgyal rigs bram ze rje'u rigs dang ⑤/ /dmangs rigs gdol yopa g.yung po la'ang / /'jigs pa med par sbyin pa btang ghu/ /gser dang dngul dang ba lang rgyadang / /rta dang nor bu'i rna rgyan dang / /de bzhin las dag byed pa'i bran / /tshul khrims phun sum tshogs la sbyin/ /chags pa med pa'i sems kyis ni/ /bu dang chung ma ⑨yongs btang bas/ /'jig rten 'di dang pha rol tu / /mi yis dag pa thob par 'gyur/ /gang gi tshe rgyal po thams cad kyi bshes gnyen gyis thams cad sgrol gyi ched du bram ze dzu dzu ka la nor mang po sbyin skyepa de'i tshe de 'byor pa rgya nyu3chen por gyur pa dang / de la snying du sdug pa dang /rtsa lag dang / grogs po dag 'ongs nas smras pa/ khyod kyi 15'byor pa dang /dpal dang skal nyunyeb phun sum tshogs pa gang yin pa ci yang rung de dag thams cad ni gzhon nu thams cad sgrol de la brten te 6yin no/ /des smras pa/ gzhon nu thams cad sgrol gyis mkho bo la ci zhig byas/ rigs mchog gi nang du skyes pas kho bo 'jig rten gyi yon gnas su gyur te/ des na kho bo skal ba dang ldan par tsu'ugyur to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus kyi gzhon nu thams cad sgrol gang yin pa de ni nga nyid 0yin no/ /de'i tshe de'i dus kyi dzu dzu ka gang yin pa de ni lha sbyin 'di 4—478

nyid yin te/ de na yang 'di byas pa mi gzo ba dang byas pa mi tshor ba yin no/ /da ①ltar yang 'di byas pa mi gzo ba dang byas pa mi tshor ba yin no/ /de lta bas na dge slong dag 'di ltar bslab par bya ste/ byas pa gzo ba dang byas pa tshor bar bya ste/ cung zad byas pa yang chud mi gsan ②par bya na mang po la lta smos ②kyang ci dgos te/ dge slong dag khyed kyis de ltar bslab par bya'o//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab bya'od ma'i tshal bya ⑤ka lan da ka gnas pa na bzhugs ⑥so/ /de'i tshe yul tsam pa na khyim bdag gru ⑦'dzin zhes bya ba phyug pa dunor mang ba tsolongs spyod che ba yongs su gzung ba yangs shing rgya che ba/ rnam thos kyi bu'i nor dang ldan pa rnam thos gyi bu la nor gyis 'gran pa zhig gnas te/ des rigs mnyam pa las chung ma blangs nas/ de de dang lhan cig rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed de/ de rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed pa las/ dus gzhan zhig na chung ma sems can dang ldan par gyur te⑩ /'di ltar de'i mngal yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir de skyeyid du mi 'ong ba'i sgra cung zad kyang mi 8thos shing grang ba na grang ba'i yo byad dang / dro ba na dro ba'i yo byad dang / sman pas bcas pa'i kha zas ha cang tsu)kha ba ma yin pa dang /ha cang skyur ④ba ma yin pa dang / ha cang lan tshwa blache ba ma yin pa dang / ha cang mngar ba ma yin pa dang / ha cang tsha ba ma yin pa dang / ha cang bska ba ma yin pa ste/ de ltar kha ba dang / skyur ba dang / lan tshwa tunyedang /mngar ba dang / tsha ba dang / bska ba spangs pa'i kha zas kyis rngubasnyen bkur tsobyed cing do shal dang / se mo dos lus brgyan nas lha'i bu mo dga' tshal na rgyu 1—479

ba bzhin du khri'u nas khri'ur ①dang / khri nas khrir rgyu zhing ②'og gis gzhi ①la mi 'bab bo༅/ /de'i tshe khyim bdag gru 'dzin dgos pa 'ga' zhig la rgyal po'i khab tu song ngo / /de yang zla ba dgu 'am/ bcu lon te rgyu skar gro bzhin ⑤la bab pa na khye'u gzugs bzang po blta yin sdug pa mdzes pa de'i rkang pa'i mthil gnyis la spu gser gyi kha dog 'dra ba sor bzhi ④tsam skyes pa zhig btsas so/ /btsas nas ji tsam na khyim bdag gru 'dzin gyi mi zhig rings pa rings par rgyal po'i khab tu song nas khyim bdag gru 'dzin la smras pa/ khyim bdag dgyes pa skyed cig /khyod kyi khye'u zhig btsas so/ /de nidaga' ba dang yid bde ba skyes nas smras pa/ kye nang rje 0ci zhig smra0 / des smras pa/ khyim bdag khyod kyi khye'u zhig btsas so/ /de dga' ba dang / yid bde ba skyes nas yang dris pa/kye nang rje ci zhig smra/ des smras pa/ khyim bdag khyod kyi khye'u zhig btsas so/ /yang bodris pa/ kye nang rje 6ci zhig smra/ de nas mi de 'di snyam du sems te ci khyim bdag 'di yang nas yang du 'dri ba bdag la kyal ka hunyesmra bar mi 'dod grang snyam du bsams tsu )nas cang mi smra bar 'dug go/ /khyim bdag gis smras pa/kye nang rje khyod kyis nyes te/ gal te khyod kyis lan brgyar smras par gyur na yang /ngas kyang khyod kyi 8kha gser gyis skyalan brgya bkang bar 'gyur ba zhig /de nas khyim bdag gru 'dzin gyis mi de'i kha gser gyis lan gsum bkang nas dkor pa la khye'u dkan dbab ⑩pa'i rin gser bye ba nyi shu byin cig ces spring ngo / /khyim bdag gru 'dzin dga' ba dang yid bde bas rgyal po'i drung du song nas lha bdag gi khye'u zhig btsas so/ /rgyal pos smras pa legs so/ /ngas de la tsam pa gzhi tsodang bcas pa dang / glang po che bdun gyi tshogs sbyin no/ /khyim 1—480

bdag gru 'dzin gyis rgyal po gzugs can snying po la bltas te tsam par 'ongs ①nas de nas khyim bdag gi gnyen ②rnams kyis nyi ma bdun gsum nyi shu chagacig ④tu btsas pa'i btsas ston rgya cher byas nas khye'u'i ming cir gdags zhes ⑤ming 'dogs par byed do/ /gzhan dag gis smras pa/ khye'u 'di rgyu skar gro bzhin la btsas la 'di btsas pa na phas kyang dkan dbab pa'i rin du gser bye ba nyi shu byin pas/ de bas na khye'u'i ming zhugro ༅bzhin duskyes bye ba nyi shu pa zhes bya bar gdags so zhes ⑨de'i ming gro bzhin skyes bye ba nyi shu pa zhes bya bar btags te/khye'u gro bzhin hu skyes bye ba nyi shu pa ma ma brgyad la rjes su gtad de/ pang na 'tsho ba'i ma ma gnyis dang / nu ma snun pa'i ma ma bluganyis dang / dri ma 'phyi ba'i ma ma gnyis dang / rtsen 8grogs kyi tsom ma gnyis te/ de ma ma brgyad po dag gis 'o ma dang / zho dang / mar dang / zhun mar dang ④/ mar gyi snying khu dang gzhan skeyang yo byad kyi bye brag gtso bo gtso bo dag gis skyed par byed/sring bar byed cing rdzing na gnas pa'i pad ma bzhin myur du skyed par byed de/de gang gi tshe chen por gyur pa de'i tshe yi ge dang / grangs dang / rtsis dang /lag rtsis dang / dbyung ba dang / gzhug pa dang / gzhag pa la nye bar zhugs shing / brtag pa brgyad po gzhi brtag pa dang / gos brtag ༅pa yidang /rin po che brtag pa dang / shing brtag pa dang / glang po che brtag pa dang /rta brtag pa dang / gzhon nu brtag pa dang / gzhon nu ma brtag pa dang /'byed pa dang / klog pa la mkhas pa dang / g.yer por gyur to/ /de bsod nams kyi 8skal ba chen po dang ldan pa yin no/ /zhes rigs mnyam pa mang pos thos nas bu sring dag byin no/ /de'i pas 'dug pa'i khang pa gsum po 4—481

dgun gyi dang / dpyid kyi dang / dbyar gyi rtsig tu bcug ste ②chung ma gsum po chen ma ②dang / bar ma dang / chun ma bzhag nas de steng gi khang bzangs kyi gzhir song ste skyes pa med pa ②na rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/dga' mgur spyod par byed do/ /de nyi ma re re zhing lnga brgya'i ston mo snod ④nas 'tshed cing sbyor ro/ /lha sbyin gyis ⑤gzhon nu ma skyes dgra yil rbad ⑦pa gzhon nu rgyal po thams cad ni gang gi tshe skra skya bo skyes par gyur pa de'i tshe gzhon nu'i thu 2bo shos rgyal srid kyi dbang phyug la bzhag sbyinas rab tu 'byung na/khyod kyi yab ni skra kha dog rnam pa gsum pa'i mthar phyin na 'on kyang 'dod pa rnams la zhen bzhin te nye bar zhi bar mi 'gro'o/ /ma skyes dgras smras pa/de nyid kyis shes mod/ de la cici byar yod/ lha sbyin gyis 7smras pa/ pha rol gnod 6pa gyis shig /'dod pa don du gnyer ba rnams ni mi byed pa ci yang med pas/ ji tsam na rgyal po gzugs can snying po bcom ldan 'das mar gsol nas 'jams gsol bar bzhed 8pa'i 'jams kyi zhal ta byas te/ 'od ma'i tshal du song ba ma skyes dgras mthong nas des rmye rdo rje rtse gcig 8pa zhig 'phangs pa dang rgyal po sgra la mkhas pa yin pas des g.yon phyogs su thug pa'i rdze'u chag ⑩par gyur nas de nyid nas slar log go/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni 'di lta bu mi mkhyen pa'am/ mi gzigs pa'am/ thugs su ma chud pa'am/ rnam par mi mkhyen pa cung zad kyang mi mnga' bas/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po la bka' stsal pa/mod gal gyi bu ma skyes dgra mi dge ba'i bshes tsu)gnyen lha sbyin gyis zin pas/de bzhin gshegs pa'i bsod snyoms ma rung bar byas kyis tsam 8par gru 'dzin gyi 4—482

bu'i drung du song la ①bsod ②snyoms khyer te shog shig /btsun pa bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos bcom ldan 'das las mnyan ④nas ji ltar sems mnyam par bzhag ⑤na rgyal po'i khab nas ⑥mi snang bar gyur te tsam par ⑦phyin pa de lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /gro bzhin skyes bye ba nyi shu pa nyi ma la dad pas de nyi ma re re zhing nang par sngar langs te nyi ma la phyag byed pa na tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po'i rdzu 'phrul gyis nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor brtol nas babs pa/ tshe dang ldan pa gro bzhin skyes bye ba nyi shu pas mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang bdag gis dumangon sum kho nar nyi ma nyid kyi ⑨gzugs mthong ngo snyam nas mchog tu ngo mtshar skyes so/ /mthong nas yang ⑨ tshigs su bcad nas ⑩smras pa/ nyi ma brtol nas sa steng mngon phyogs myur nyid du/ /bdag gi tsoganas su byon pa 'di ko su zhig lags/ /'di ci nyi ma'am nor sbyin zla ba'am brgya 8byin nam/ /'on te lha yi bdag po mod la gshegs shig gu④/ /tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po'i sems kyis kyang de'i bsam pa shes nas yang hunyetshigs su bcad de smras pa/ kho bo phya'od zer stong gi 'od 'bar nyi ma ma yin rgyu skar bdag po min/ /kho bo rnam thos ma yin mchog ldan ma yin legs pa'i brtul zhugs dbang phyug min/ /kho bo thugs zhi gzi brjid ⑩kyis 'bar sangs rgyas sras po yin par shes par byos/ /kho bo thub la bsod snyoms dgongs tsonas bslang 8ba'i phyir ni khyod kyi drung du 'ongs/gro bzhin skyes kyis smras pa/ ci shes ldan nyid thub pa yin nam/ des tsu tretshigs su bcad de smras pa/ ji ltar gser gyi ri bo lhun po'i 0zlar ni yungs kur tsokhyer te 'ong ba dang / /ji ltar nyi ma'i zlar ni sa steng srog chags srin 4wa 483

bu me khyer 'jal ba dang / /rin chen gyis phyug ①rgya mtsho'i zlar ni 'di ni ②gnag gi rmig rjes sgrun pa ltar / /de bzhin mi mchog bla ma sangs rgyas la ltos ston pa'i sras dag ④rig par gyis/ /gro bzhin skyes kyis smras pa/ rjes su dpag pa 'di yis na⑤/ /bdag gis khyod kyi 'dren pa ni/ /ji ltar dka' thub rab che ba/ /gsal bar rab tu rtogs lags so/ /dgos pa ci la byon bka' ⑥stsol cig /bcom ldan 'das kyi bsod ②snyoms phul cig /bcom ldan 'das de su yin/ khyim bdag gi bu dge sbyong gau ta ma shākya'i sras shākya'i rigs las skra dang kha spu bregs te gos ngur smrig bgos nas dad pa yang dag pa ⑧kho nas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ste/ de bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa zhig yod do/ /khyim bdag gi bu de ni sangs rgyas zhes ⑨bya'o/ /④des sangs rgyas zhes ⑩bya ba'i sgra sngon ma thos pa thos nas ba spu'i mkhung thams cad g.yos shing mngon par dad pa des 6snod du btsos pa lnga brgya po de nyid tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po la phul lo/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos de las bsod snyoms blangs nas ji ltar sems mnyam par bzhag na tsam pa nas mi snang bar gyur te④/rgyal po'i khab 'od ma'i tshal 8bya ka lan da ka gnas par phyin pa de lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ des bcom ldan 'das la bsod tsosnyoms phul te bcom ldan 'das kyis gsol bar brtsams pa na/ ma ga ṅgā'i rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying pos snod nas btsos pa ༅phyi ma shos khyer te bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar song ba dang / ji tsam na 'od ma'i tshal thams cad kha zas kyi dri zhim po rnam pa sna tshogs kyis khyab par mthong nas des bsams pa/4—484

gdon mi za bar lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya ①byin nam/ lha gzhan dag gis ②bcom ldan 'das la bsod dusnyoms phul te/ 'di ltar 'od ma'i tshal 'di kha zas kyi dri zhim po rnam pa sna tshogs kyis khyab par gyur to snyam du bsams nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das la lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya ④byin nam/ lha gzhan dag gis bsod dusnyoms phul ⑥ba'am ci lags na/ 'di ltar 'od ma'i tshal 'di zhal zas kyi dri bda' ⑦ba sna tshogs kyis khyab par gyur dulags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/rgyal po chen po lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya rtsabyin gyis kyang ma yin la/ lha gzhan rnams kyis kyang ma phul te/ de lta mod kyi khyod nyid hu)kyi yul tsam pa na gru 'dzin gyi bu nyi ma re re lnga brgya'i ston mo snod nas 'tshed nyuskrecing sbyor ba yod de/de las skyedage slong mod gal gyi 0bus blangs so/ /bcom ldan 'das de'i bsngags pa gsung bar nyu )brtsams pa thos nas de yang mthong bar 'dod nyunyepa skyes pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi chuthugs kyis de'i bsam pa mkhyen nas bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po chen po sems can de ni bsod tshenams kyi nyu)skal ba chen po dang ldan pa yin pas khyod bsod nyurtenams yongs su zad ri ༷ rmepar 'gyur du 'ong gis de la bka' ma rurjestsol cig /de lta mod kyi rgyal po chen po lhung bzed kyi lhag ma la cilongs spyod cig /des gsol pa/ btsun ri )pa bdag rgyal po rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba du lags te/ sngon ni su'i lhung bzed 5kyi lhag ma yang ma thu'atshal lags mod kyi/ bcom ldan 'das ni 4chos nyid kyis bdag gi snyeyab lags pas/ gal te bcom ldan 'das kyis hubaka' stsal na longs spyod du par bgyi'o zhes des longs spyod rgyapar brtsams so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis 4wa 485

bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po chen po khyod kyis sngon lan 'ga' yang bza' ba dang btung ba 'di 'dra ba ①mongs spyad pa yod zhudam/ rgyal pos gsol pa/btsun pa bdag kyang ②rgyal po'i rgyud du btsas/ rgyal po'i rgyud las chen por gyur cing rgyal por gyur kyang g.yar zas dang btung khub 'di 'dra ba ni sngon lan 'ga' yang myong rgyabar ma 'tshal lags so/ /rgyal po chen po sems can skal ba chen po de ni 'di ltar 'di 'dra ba'i bza' ba dang btung ba la longs spyod do/ /de nas ma ga ṅgā'i rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying pos bcom ldan 'das kyi skyozhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te bcom ldan rtso'adas kyi spyan snga nas song nas/ des blon po rnams la bsgo ba/ shes ldan dag yul tsam par 'dong gis dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi pa go skon ducig /ci'i slad du lags/gru 'dzin gyi bu blta'o/ /lha'i yul na de mchis pas de she nyid 6dgug tu gsol/de ni sems can bsod nyu1nams kyi skal ba chen po dang ldan pa yin pas de la nyunyebaka' mi nyu stsol to/ /lha ji ltar bka' ma nyu stsal kyang bdag cag nyu)gis mchi bar nyugye'agyur ba de ltar bgyi'o/ /de bzhin du gyis shig /de rnams kyis tsam 7 par yi ge spring ba/ shes ldan dag rgyal po gshegs par 'gyur gyis grong khyer byi dor gyis shig /rtswa skyonadang chas dag sta gon gyis shig ces spring ba de rnams kyis thos nas shin tu dga' bar gyur pa dang yang yi ge spring ba/ shes ldan dag rgyal po ni mi gshegs mod kyi gzhon nu gshegs par 'gyur ro zhes spring ba dang / de rnams skrag ste hu)gzhon nu gtum po lan 'ga' zhig 'ongs na yang gnod par 'gyur ro pya snyam nas kyeyang spring ba/ rgyal po yang mi gshegs gzhon nu yang mi gshegs te/ de lta mod kyi khyed kyis gang gā ru)ji ltar rgyun las bzlog phyogs su 4—486

'bab pa de ltar gags rtsigs ①shig ces spring ba thos nas tsam pa na gnas pa'i grong khyer gyi ②mi rnams 'dus nas shes ldan dag gdon ②mi za bar rgyal po ni bdag cag la chad pa gcad ④par bzhed ⑤pas des yin yi ge 'di skad spring mod ces de rnams kyis blon po rnams la don de spring ba dang / de rnams kyis blags ⑦te yang drang por spring ba/ shes ldan dag 'di ni bden pa yin te/rgyal po dang gzhon nu yang mi gshegs ⑧la/ gang gā gags brtsig ⑨pa yang dgos pa cung zad kyang med do/ /de lta mod kyi lha ni gru 'dzin gyi bu blta bar bzhed ⑩do zhes spring ba dang / de rnams kyis 7nyan rna ba'i mi zhig mngags so/ /des kyang de bzhin du bsnyad do/ /de nas de rnams 'dus nas khyim bdag gru 'dzin gyi drung du song nas khyim bdag lha gro bzhin skyes bye ba nyi shu pa blta bar bzhed nas 7blon po rnams kyis bdag tshil drang por spring ste/ nyan rna ba'i mis kyang don de nyid smras na/ 'di thong ④shig /des smras pa8/ shes ldan dag kho bo'i gags kyi skal ba gang yin pa gser gyi gong bus rtsig ༅kyang bla'i 0mi btang 8ngo / /de rnams kyis smras pa/ khyim bdag gal te de lta yin du zin kyang ma 'ongs pa'i skye bo rnams la snying brtse bar gyis shig des smras pa/ shes ldan dag gal te de lta na dam zhig bca' ste/ gal te khyed cag gi bu rnams kyang gro bzhin skyes dang lhan cig gtong ba lta 7na btang ⑥ ngo / /de rnams kyis smras pa/ khyim bdag 0de bzhin du bgyi'o/ /'o na shes ldan dag ding ⑫shig /khyim bdag gru 'dzin gro bzhin skyes bye ba nyi shu pa gang na ba der song ste phyin nas gro bzhin skyes bye ba nyi shu pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bu grong mi 'di dag 'di skad ces zer ro/ /des smras pa/ yab gal te de lta na mchi'o/ /4—487

bu gdon mi za bar rgyal po de khyod kyi rkang ①mthil gyi spu ②gser gyi kha dog can ③blta bar 'dod kyis/ rgyal po de dag ni gnas ma yin par khro bas khyod la gnod pa byed ④par 'gyur du 'ong gis khyod kyis rkang pa bteg ste ⑤de la bstan par mi bya'i/ 'di re ⑤mu tig phreng ba 'di ⑦rgyal po de'i zhabs kyi drung du zhog la phyag byas nas de'i spyan sngar skyil mo krung nichos te 'dug shig ⑨dang /des na 0spu rnams mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /khyim bdag gru 'dzin gyis bsams ⑪pa / gro bzhin skyes bzhon 8pa gang gis gtang ⑫/ ci glang ④po che'i bzhon ⑫pas sam/ rta'i bzhon 0pas sam/ shing rta'i bzhon 0pas sam/ 'on te gru'i bzhon 8pas snyam pa las de 'di snyam du sems te/ 'di dag gi nang na gru'i bzhon pa mchog yin pas gru'i bzhon pas gtang yingo snyam du bsams nas des ⑥ chu bo gang gā zhu la gru sbrengs nas der duskyed mos tshal rnam pa sna tshogs byed du bcug 0ste/ me tog dang 'bras bu zhu rnam pa sna tshogs dang ldan zhing ngang pa dang / khrung khrung dang / rma bya dang / ne tso dang / ri skegs dang / khu byug la sogs pa bya rnams skad 'byin cing rol mo'i cha byad sna tshogs dang /bud med rgyan sna tshogs kyis bklubs ④pa dag 'dug tu bcug ste/ 'byor pa des chu'i nang nas btang phyango / /de rim gyis rgyal po'i khab tu ༅nye bar phyin pa/rgyal po gzugs can snying pos gru 'dzin gyi bu 'ong ngo zhes thos nas des 3rgyal po'i khab nas gang gā'i 'bab chu'i bar der 'obs brkos nas chus bkang ste de'i nang nas gru drangs so/ /rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer yang rdo ba dang /gseg ma dang / gyo mo bsal 6cing tsan dan gyi ⑥ chus chag chag btab/ dri zhim 0po'i pog phor bzhag /dar gyi chun 'phyang samang po btags/ rgyal 4—488

mtshan dang / ba dan btsugs ①me tog sna tshogs kyis lha rnams kyi dga' tshal gyi skyed mos tshal bzhin du dga' dga' ltar byas te/ de 'byor pa des rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer du khrid do/ /de nas rgyal po seng ge'i khri la 'dug pa'i rkang pa'i drung du mu tig gi phreng ba bzhag nas mgo bos phyag byas te mdun du skyil mo krung ②bcas nas 'dug pa dang / rgyal pos de'i rkang pa gnyis la gser gyi kha dog 'dra ba'i spu yod pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang khyokye ma gro bzhin skyes bye ba nyi shu pa ni bsod thunams kyi skal ba chen po dang ldan pa yin no zhes mchog tu ngo mtshar skyes so/ /mthong nas smras pa gro bzhin skyes khyod kyis bcom ldan 'das mthong ngam/ lha ma mthong lags so/ /tshur shog 'dong ngo / /des dris pa lha ci bcom ldan 'das bzhin ⑤pas gshegs sam/'on te zhabs kyis yilags/ rgyal pos smras pa/ de rab tu byung ba yin na de la bzhon pas ci bya/ des smras pa/ lha gal te de lta na bdag kyang sug pa kho nas 'chi'o zhes de rkang pa kho nas chas pa na/ de'i zho shas 'tsho ba rnams kyis sa la gos dag bting ⑦ba dang / des smras pa/ ci bcom ldan 'das gding ⑧ba las bzhud dam/ 'on te gding ba med par bzhud⑨/ de rnams kyis smras pa / gding ba med par bzhud do/ /des smras pa/ gding ba sdus ⑩shig /bdag kyang gding ba med par 'gro'o/ /zho shas 'tsho ba rnams kyis gos rnams bsdus pa dang / mi ma yin pa rnams kyis bting yinas des smras pa/ shes ldan dag ngas khyed cag la ma bzlog gam/ de rnams kyis smras pa/ lha bzlog lags so/ /'o na yang su zhig gis bting ⑫/ lha khyod bsod tsonams kyi skal ba chen po mnga' bas mi ma yin pa rnams kyis bting lags grang / des tsosnying 1—489

nas tshig tu smras pa/ mi ma yin pa dag gos rnams sdus ①shig /de rnams kyis bsdus nas rkang pa sa la bzhag pa na sa chen po rnam pa drug tu g.yos par ②gyur te/ sa chen po 'di g.yos/ rab tu g.yos/ kun tu rab tu g.yos/ldeg rab tu ldeg /kun tu rab tu ldeg par gyur te/ shar phyogs mtho na nub phyogs dma'/ nub phyogs mtho na shar phyogs dma'/ lho phyogs mtho na byang phyogs dma'/ byang phyogs mtho na lho phyogs dma'/ mtha' mtho na dbus dma' / dbus mtho na mtha' dma' bar ③gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis ④dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag 'di nas bzung ste bskal pa dgu bcu rtsa gcig gi bar du gru 'dzin gyi bus lan 'ga' yang gding ba med par rkang pa sa la ⑤ma bor te/ da ltar bor ba yang chos la gus pas ༅yin gyi bsod ⑦nams yongs su zad pas duni ma yin te/ des ⑨na sa 'di rnam pa drug tu g.yos par gyur to/ /de nas gro bzhin skyes bye ba nyi shu pa bcom ldan 'das gang zhu na ba der song ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te phyogs gcig tsu〉tu 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i 8bsam pa dang / bag la nyal dang ⑫/ khams dang rang bzhin thugs su chud nas gang thos pas 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi so sor rtogs par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i chos bshad par mdzad pas gro bzhin skyes bye ba nyi shu pas 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo nyi shu mtho ba ④ye shes kyi 8rdo rjes bcom nas rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas te/ des bden pa mthong ba dang / de stan las ⑩langs te bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar yinas bcom ldan 'das gang na tsob de yilogs su thal mo sbyar ba btud ⑥de bcom ldan 4wa 490

'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bdag legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu byung ba dang bsnyen par 7rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos po thob pa lta na/ bdag bcom ldan 'das kyi ②spyan sngar tshangs par spyad pa spyod ⑤lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyim bdag gi bu de bzhin gshegs pa rnams sam/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i nyan thos rnams ni pha mas ma gnang ba'i rigs kyi bu rab tu 'byin pa dang bsnyen ④par rdzogs par mi byed kyis song la pha dang / ma la rtogs shig /rgyal pos gsol pa/ btsun pa bdag ni rten pa thams cad kyi dpon po ⑤lags te don du 'di ni chos nyid kyis bdag gi bu lags pas 'di bdag gis gnang lags kyis bcom ldan 'das ⑥ci legs su rab tu ⑦dbyung du gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong tshur shog ces bya bas chadage slong tshur shog tshangs par spyad pa spyod cig ces gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal ma thag kho nar skra byi ba dang snam sbyar gyon par gyur te skra dang kha spu zhag bdun skyes pa tsam dang /lag pa lhung bzed dang / bya ma bum gyis 'brel ⑨pa dang / lo brgya ⑪ lon pa'i spyod lam lta bur gnas par gyur to/ /'dir smras pa/ de bzhin gshegs pas tshur shog bka' stsal pas/ /skra byi snam sbyar gyon pa'i lus ldan zhing / /mod la dbang po rab zhir gnas gyur te/ /sangs rgyas dgongs pas lus gzugs bkab par gyur/ /drug sde rnams kyis de la co dri bar brtsams ⑫pa / re zhig bstan tho)pa la ni gcig tu brtson par bya dgos 4)pa yin na/mar sar gyi gong bu 'dis khyad par ci zhig rtogs 8par 'gyur zhes de rnams kyis de bco dris pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo gang na ba der song ste 4—491

phyin nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la 'di skad ces smras so/ /btsun pa kun dga' bo bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong gcig tu brtson pa'i rnal 'byor dang mthun pa'i ting nge 'dzin du gsungs ①pa gang lags/ tshe dang ldan pa gro bzhin skyes 'chag pas thob pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni yun ring du gnas par 'gyur ro zhes bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal ②sto/ /des bsil chaba'i tshal gyi ④dur khrod du song ste phye/ 'chags byas nas de na ༅tshe dang ldan pa gro bzhin skyes bye ba nyi shu pa rgyal po'i khab kyi bsil ⑦ba'i tshal gyi dur khrod du gnas nas rtag tu 'grus pa dang ldan par byang chub kyi phyogs dang mthun pa'i chos rnams la rnal 'byor gyi rjes su brtson pa'i sgom dupas gnas so/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa gro bzhin skyes bye ba nyi shu pa gcig pu dben par song ste nang du yang dag bzhag pa na sems la sems kyi bornam par rtog pa 'di snyam du skyes par gyur te/bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos brtson 'grus brtsams 2te gnas pa ji snyed cig yod pa de rnams kyi skyonang na bdag mchog yin naskye/ 'on kyang bdag len pa med par zag pa rnams las sems rnam par grol bar ma gyur gyis/ bdag gi nye du rnams la longs spyod rgya chen po yod pas/ ma la bdag 'dug la 'dod pa rnams la longs spyod cing sbyin pa dag sbyin bsod skyonams dag bya'o snyam mo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs kyis tshe dang ldan pa gro bzhin skyes bye ba nyi shu pa'i bsam pa mkhyen nas dge slong zhig la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong tshur shog/khyod gro bzhin skyes bye ba nyi shu pa gang na ba der song ④la phyin nas gro bzhin skyes bye ba nyi shu pa la 'di skad ces gro bzhin skyes bye ba nyi shu pa khyod la ston pa gsung ngo zhes sgo (nyeshig /btsun pa bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes dge slong des 4wa 492

bcom ldan 'das las ①mnyan nas tshe dang ldan pa gro bzhin skyes bye ba nyi shu pa gang na ba der song ste phyin nas tshe dang ldan pa gro bzhin skyes bye ba nyi shu pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa gro bzhin skyes khyod la ston pa gsung ngo / /tshe dang ldan pa bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes tshe dang ldan pa gro bzhin skyes bye ba nyi shu pas dge slong de las mnyan nas bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te phyogs gcig ②tu 'dug goge/ /phyogs gcig ༅tu 'dug nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa gro bzhin skyes bye ba nyi shu pa la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /gro bzhin skyes khyod gcig ⑤pu dben par song ste nang du yang dag bzhag pa na sems la sems kyi 'urnam par rtog pa 'di lta bu bcom ldan 'das kyi rngunyan thos brtson 'grus brtsams te gnas pa ji snyed duyod spupa de rnams kyi nang na bdag mchog yin na/ 'on kyang bdag len pa med par zag pa rnams las sems rnam par grol bar ma gyur gyis/ bdag gi nye du rnams la longs spyod rgya chen po yod pas ma la bdag 'dug la 'dod pa rnams la longs spyod cing sbyin pa dag sbyin/ bsod nams rngu dag bya'o snyam pa skyes par ma 'gyur tam/ de nas tshe dang ldan pa gro bzhin skyes 'di snyam du sems te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs kyis bdag gi sems mkhyen to snyam du bsams nas 'jigs pa dang skrag pa dang skyo bas ba 6spu zing zhes byed nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun 8pa de lta lags so/ /de'i phyir gro bzhin skyes khyod ④la dri yis khyod kyis ji ltar bzod pa bzhin 8de'i lan thob shigatso /gro bzhin skyes ji snyam du sems khyod sngon khyim par gyur pa na pi bang tho)gi rgyud kyi sgra la 1—493

mkhas pa yin nam/ btsun ①pa bdag sngon khyim par gyur pa na pi bang ②gi rgyud kyi sgra la mkhas pa mad lags so/ /gro bzhin skyes ji snyam du sems/ gang gi tshe pi bang khugi ④rgyud shin tu bsdams par gyur ⑤pa de'i tshe ji ga ⑥mi bang ⑦gi sgra snyan par 'gyur ba'am/ sgra yid du 'ong ba'am/ sgra dang ldan pa'am/las su rung bar 'gyur ram/ btsun pa ma lags so/ /'o na gang gi tshe pi bang phyagi rgyud lhag par lhod par gyur pa zhude'i tshe ji ga pi bang khya gi sgra snyan par 'gyur ba'am/ sgra yid du 'ong ba'am/ sgra dang ldan pa'am/ las su rung bar 'gyur ram/ btsun pa ma lags so/ /gang gi tshe pi bang nyunyegi rgyud shin tu bsdams pa ma yin zhing lhag par lhod pa ma yin par gyur te rgyud ran par 'dug pa de'i tshe pi bang the5gi sgra snyan par 'gyur ba'am/ sgra yid du 'ong ba'am/ sgra dang ldan pa'am/ las su rung bar 'gyur ba ma nyunyeyin nam/ btsun pa de lta lags so/ /gro bzhin skyes de bzhin du ha cang brtson 'grus brtsams pa ni rgod par 'gyur ro/ /ha cang zhan na ni zhum par 'gyur ro/ /gro bzhin skyes de lta bas na khyod kyis ran pa nyid rtogs par bya ste/ des kyang nga rgyal du mi bya zhing de la yang lha )bag yod par bya/ de'i tshe mtshan ma yang gzung bar bya/glu/gro bzhin skyes khyod gnas pa 'dis gnas na ring po mi thogs pa kho nar zag pa rnams zad nas zag pa med pa rnam par grol ba'i sems dang / rnam par grol ba'i shes rab mthong ba'i chos nyid la rang gi mngon par shes pas mngon sum du byas nas rdzogs par byas te/ bdag gi skye ba zad do/ /tshangs par spyod pa bsten to/ /bya ba byas so/ /srid pa 'di las gzhan ⑩mi shes so zhes sgrogs par 'gyur ro/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa gro bzhin skyes bye ba nyi shu pa bcom 4wa 494

ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par dga' ste rjes su yi rangs ①nas bcom ldan 'das kyi 0zhabs gnyis la mgo bos ①phyag byas te bcom ldan 'das kyi ④spyan snga nas song ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis pi bang ⑤gi dpe ⑥'dis tshe dang ldan pa gro bzhin skyes la gdams ngag phog nas gcig pu dben pa bag yod pa rtun pa dang ldan pa bdag khyonyid gtong bar gnas so/ /gcig pu dben pa bag yod pa rtun pa dang ldan pa bdag nyid gtong bar gnas pa na gang gi phyir rigs kyi bu rnams skra dang kha spu ④bregs te gos ngur smrig ⑨bgos nas dad pa yang dag pa kho nas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu 'byung ⑨ bar byed pa/tshangs par spyod pa'i mtha' bla na med pa de ༅tshe de nyid la rang gi mngon par shes pas tsamangon sum du byas te④/ bsgrubs nas bdag gi skye ba zad do/ /tshangs par spyod pa bsten to/ /bya ba byas so/ /'di las srid pa gzhan ④mi shes so zhes cigo bar byed cing tshe dang ldan pa de tsokun shes par gyur cite/ sems shin tu rnam par grol ba'i dgra bcom par gyur to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa gro bzhin skyes bye ba nyi shu pa dgra bcom pa thob ste/ rnam par grol ba'i dga' ba'i bde ba nyams su myong nas de 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag bcom ldan 'das blta tsob dang bsnyen 2bkur bya ba'i phyir 'gro ba'i dus ni 'di yin no snyam nas de nas tshe dang ldan pa gro bzhin skyes bye ba du nyi shu pa dgongs ka 0nang du yang dag 'jog las langs te bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song nas phyin pa dang bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te phyogs gcig ⑫tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa gro bzhin skyes bye ba nyi shu pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa dge slong 4wa 495

dgra bcom pa/ zag pa zad pa/ bya ba byas pa/ byed pa byas pa/ khur bor ba/ bdag gi ①don rjes su thob pa/ srid par kun tu sbyor ②ba yongs su zad pa/ yang dag pa'i shes pas sems shin tu rnam par grol bar gyur pa gang lags pa de de'i tshe gnas drug la mos par 'gyur te nges par 'byung ba la mos par 'gyur ba lags/ 'tshe ba ma mchis pa la mos par 'gyur ba lags/rab tu dben pa la mos par 'gyur ba lags/ srid pa zad pa dang / len pa zad pa dang / mi brjed pa'i sems la mos par 'gyur ba lags so/ /btsun pa 'di na kha cig 'di snyam du kye ma tshe dang ldan pa 'di dad pa tsam kho na la gnas pas ②nges par 'byung ba la mos so snyam du sems na/ btsun ④pa de ltar blta bar mi bgyi ste/ 'dod chags zad pa dang / zhe sdang zad pa dang /gti mug zad pas nges par 'byung ba la mos par 'gyur ⑤lags so/ /btsun pa 'di na kha cig 'di snyam du kye ma tshe dang ldan pa 'di tshul khrims tsam kho na la brten nas mi 'tshe ba la mos so snyam du sems na/ btsun pa de ltar blta bar mi bgyi ste/ 'dod chags zad pa dang / zhe sdang zad pa dang / gti mug zad pas mi 'tshe ba la mos par 'gyur skyolags so/ /btsun pa 'di na kha cig 'di snyam du kye ma tshe dang ldan pa 'di rnyed pa dang / bkur sti dang /tshigs su bcad pa tsam kho na tshol ba'i slad du rab tu dben pa la mos so snyam du sems na/ btsun pa de ltar blta bar mi bgyi ste/ 'dod chags zad pa dang / zhe sdang zad pa dang / gti mug zad pa dang / sred pa zad pa dang /len pa zad pa las mi brjed pa'i sems la yang mos par 'gyur ⑦lags te/btsun pa dge slong dgra bcom pa zag pa zad pa/ bya ba byas pa/ byed pa 4—496

byas pa/ khur bor ba/ rang gi don rjes su thob pa/ srid par ①kun tu sbyor ba yongs su zad pa/ yang dag pa'i shes pas sems shin tu rnam par grol bar gyur pa gang lags pa de de'i tshe de gnas drug po 'di dag la mos par 'gyur ②lags so/ /btsun ②pa dge slong slob pa blugang yin pa ma ④thob pa gang lags pa ༅de gong ma'i grub pa dang bde ba'i mya ngan las 'das pa don du gnyer ba'i tshul la lan mang du gnas te⑦/ de de'i tshe slob pa'i tshul khrims dang /slob pa'i dbang po dang ldan pa lags so/ /de dus gzhan dun zag pa rnams zad nas zag pa med pa'i rnam par grol ba'i sems dang / rnam par grol ba'i shes rab mthong ba'i chos nyid la rang gi mngon par shes pas mngon sum du bgyis te bsgrubs ⑨nas bdag gi skye ba zad do/ /tshangs par spyod pa bsten to//srid pa 'di las gzhan mi shes so zhes sgrogs pa de'i tshe ni de mi slob pa'i tshul khrims dang / mi slob pa'i dbang po rnams dang ldan lags so// //'dul ba gzhi ⑩/ bam po brgya rtsa skyogacig pa/ btsun pa dper na bus pa gzhon nu chung ngu zhan pa gan rkyal mdu nyal ba de ni de'i tshe byis pa'i ngang tshul dang / byis pa'i dbang po rnams dang ldan lags la/ de dus gzhan na chen por gyur pa'i rgyus dbang po rnams yongs su smin pa de'i tshe ni chen po'i ngang tshul dang / chen po'i dbang po dang ldan cilags so/ /btsun pa de bzhin du dge slong slob pa ④yid ma thob pa gang lags pa de gong ma'i grub pa dang bde ba'i mya ngan las 'das pa la tsodon du gnyer ba'i tshul la lan mang du gnas te/ de de'i tshe slob pa'i tshul khrims dang slob pa'i dbang po dang ldan lags so/ /de dus gzhan na zag pa rnams zad nas zag pa med pa'i rnam par grol ba'i sems 4—497
