dang / rnam par grol ba'i shes rab mthong ba'i chos nyid la rang gi mngon par shes pas mngon sum du bgyis te bsgrubs ①nas bdag gi skye ba zad do/ /tshangs par spyod pa bsten ②sto/ /bya ba byas so/ /srid pa 'di las gzhan mi shes so zhes sgrogs pa de'i tshe ni de mi slob pa'i tshul khrims dang / mi slob pa'i dbang po dang ldan lags so/ /gal te de'i mig gis rnam par shes par bya ba'i gzugs rnams mig la shin tu snang bar gyur kyang de'i rnam par grol ba'i sems dang / rnam par grol ba'i shes rab de gtugs ②par mi ④'gyur te/ de'i sems phyin ci ma log pa shin tu rnam par grol ba/ shin tu bsgoms ⑤pa de nang du gnas par 'gyur zhing de la zad par yang rjes su blta'o༅/ /gal te de'i rna bas ⑦rnam par shes par bya ba'i sgra rnams dang / snas rnam par shes par bya ba'i dri rnams dang / lces rnam par shes par bya ba'i ro rnams dang / lus kyis ⑧rnam par shes par bya ba'i reg bya rnams ⑨dang / yid kyis rnam par shes par bya ba'i chos rnams the'u yid la shin tu snang bar gyur kyang de'i rnam par grol ba'i skyesems dang / rnam par grol ba'i shes rab de gtugs par mi 'gyur te de'i sems phyin ci ma 8log pa/ shin tu rnam par grol ba/ shin tu bsgoms ⑫pa code nang du gnas par 'gyur zhing de la zad par ④yang rjes su blta'o⑩/ /btsun pa dper na grong khyer ram/ grong rdal dang ha cang yang thag ⑩mi ring ba zhig na ri brag chen po ser ga ma mchis pa/ shin tu mkhregs pa gcig tsoku 'thas pa zhig mchis na/ de la gal te shar 7phyogs nas rlung gi shugs drag po ⑥langs kyang de g.yos par mi 'gyur/ de 'gul bar mi 'gyur zhing de nub phyogs su bkur bar mi nus lags so/ /gal te lho phyogs dang / nub phyogs 4wa 498

dang / byang phyogs nas rlung gi shugs drag po langs kyang de g.yos par mi 'gyur / de 'gul ①bar mi 'gyur zhing de ②sto phyogs su bkur bar mi nus lags te/ gang nas rlung gi shugs drag po langs kyang des de g.yos par mi 'gyur / de 'gul bar mi 'gyur zhing de gang du yang bkur bar mi nus lags so / /de bzhin du gal te de'i mig gis rnam par shes par bya ba'i gzugs rnams mig la shin tu snang bar gyur kyang de'i rnam par grol ba'i sems dang /rnam par grol ba'i shes rab de gtugs par mi 'gyur te de'i sems phyin ci ma log pa/ shin tu rnam par grol ba/ shin tu bsgoms ②pa de nang du gnas par 'gyur zhing de la zad par yang rjes su lta'o④/ /gal te de'i rna bas rnam par shes par bya ba'i sgra rnams dang / snas rnam par shes par bya ba'i dri rnams dang / lces rnam par shes par bya ba'i ro rnams dang / lus kyis ⑤rnam par shes par bya ba'i reg bya rnams dang / yid kyis rnam par shes par bya ba'i chos rnams yid la shin tu snang bar gyur kyang de'i rnam par grol ba'i sems dang /rnam par grol ba'i shes rab de gtugs par mi 'gyur te/ de'i sems phyin ci ma log pa/ shin tu rnam par grol ba/ shin tu bsgoms ⑥pa de nang du gnas par 'gyur zhing de la zad par yang rjes su lta'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa gro bzhin skyes bye ba nyi shu pas/ de skad ces ⑦gsol nas gnas brtan chadagra bcom pas gzhan yang 'di skad ces gsol to/ /nges par 'byung la mos pa dang / /sems ni 'tshe ba med pa dang / /rab tu dben la mos pa dang / /srid pa zad la dga' ba dang / /len pa zad la mos pa dang / /sems ni brjed pa med gyur pa/ /skye mched skye ba shes nas su/ /sems ni rnam par grol bar 1—499

'gyur / /de nas sems ni rnam ༅grol zhing / /sems zhi ba yi skyob pa yisal//bya ba dag ni byas zin pas/ /bya ba yod pa ma yin no/ /ji ltar brag gi ri bo la / /rlung gis rab tu mi g.yos pa/ /de bzhin sdug dang mi sdug pa'i/ /gzugs rnams dang ni sgra dag dang / /dri dang ro dang reg pa dang / /chos kyis skyob pa mi g.yo ste/ /bkrir mi btub pa'i sems gnas ②shing / /de la'ang zad par rjes su lta/ /dge slong rnams the tsom skyes te the tsom thams cad gcod pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa tshe dang ldan pa gro bzhin skyes bye ba nyi shu pas las ci zhig bgyis na las de'i rnam par smin pas phyug cing nor mang ba ༅longs spyod ②che ba'i rigs su skyes shing rkang pa'i mthil zhuganyis su spu gser gyi kha dog 'dra ba skyes pa dang / gdugs re re zhing lnga brgya'i ston mo snod gyonas sgrol zhing sbyor ba dang / 'di nas bzung ste bskal ⑧pa dgu bcu rtsa gcig gi bar du lan spu'aga' yang gding ⑨ ba ma mchis pa'i sa ⑩phyogs su rkang pa ma bzhag pa dang / btsas ma thag tu dkan dbab pa'i rin gser bye ba phrag nyi shu thob cing bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan 8pa la rab tu byung nas kyang nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs te dgra bcom pa mngon sum du bgyis lags / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag gro bzhin skyes bye ba nyi shu pa 8'di nyid kyis las tshogs rnyed pa rkyen yongs su bsgyur ④ba/'od pa bzhin du nye bar gnas pa/ gdon mi za bar 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i las dag byas shing 8bsags pas gro bzhin skyes 'di nyid kyis las byas shing bsags pa dag gzhan su zhig gis so sor myong bar 'gyur/ dge slong dag las byas ⑩shing bsags pa dag ni phyi rol gyi sa'i khams la rnam par smin par mi 4—500

'gyur / chu'i khams la mi 'gyur/ me'i khams la mi 'gyur/ rlung gi khams la mi 'gyur gyi 'di ltar las dge ba dang mi dge ba byas shing bsags pa dag ni zin pa'i phung po dang / khams dang / skye mched rnams la rnam par smin par 'gyur te/ las rnams bskal ①pa brgyar yang ni/ /chud mi za ba'ang tshogs dang dus/ /rnyed na lus can rnams la ni/ /'bras bu dag tu 'gyur ba nyid/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba bskal ②pa dgu bcu rtsa gcig na 'jig rten du ②yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ④ba / bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ⑤ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnam par gzigs zhes ⑥bya ba byung ste/ de ༅dge slong drug khri nyis stong gis yongs su bskor dunas ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs pa na 0rgyal po'i pho ⑨ brang bshes ldan zhes bya bar gshegs so/ /rgyal po'i pho ༅brang bshes ldan na dga' sde rab tu mang po gnas te/ de rnams kyis yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs dge slong drug khri nyis stong gis yongs su bskor te ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs pa na 'dir byon to zhes thos so/ /thos nas kyang thams cad 'dus te yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs gang na ba der dong ste lhags tsonas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te phyogs gcig 0tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig 8tu 'dug nas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs kyis dga' sde rnams la chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par ston par mdzad / yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug par mdzad/ yang dag par 4—501

gzengs stod ①par mdzad/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad de/ rnam grangs du mar chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par bstan②/ yang dag par 'dzin du bcug /yang dag par gzengs bstod②/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad nas cang mi gsung ngo / /de nas dga' sde rab tu mang po stan las langs te bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar ④nas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs gang na ba de ②logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de / yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun dang thabs cig ⑥la bdag cag dgung zla gsum du na bza' ༅chos gos dang / bsod ②snyoms dang /gzims cha dang / snyun dpyad kyi rkyen sman dang / yo byad rnams sbyor zhing mchis na gnang bar mdzad du gsol/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ⑨rnam par gzigs kyis ⑨ dga' sde rab tu mang po rnams la cang mi gsung bas ⑪gnang ngo / /de nas dga' sde rab tu mang pos yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs cang mi gsung bas gnang bar rig nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par dga' ste rjes su yi rangs tsonas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas nas stan las langs te dong ngo / /de rnams 8'dun khang du 'dus te ④gros bya bar brtsams pa/ shes ldan dag bdag cag blagis bcom ldan 'das ji ltar gdugs tshod gsol bar bya/ ci 'dus te bya'am/ 'on te re res bya/ de na kha cig gis smras pa/ nyi ma re re zhing 'dus te gdugs tshod gsol na bdag ④cag gi zhing blas 0kyi mtha' rnams 8bar chad du 'gyur bas shes ldan dag gal te 'dod na re mos yire mos 4—502

gdugs tshod gsol bar bya'o zhes de rnams kyis re mos ①re mos spyi bungs las ②ston mo bya bar brtsams te/ 'byor pa ji lta ba bzhin bdag nyid kyi yang snon par byed do/ /de nas dga' sde rnams kyi nang na bram ze'i khye'u bkren pa zhig yod pa de ma'i drung du song ste smras pa/ yum dga' sde rnams kyis chakhrims su bcas pa re mos chare mos bcom ldan 'das gdugs tshod gsol bar bya'o zhes ⑤bcas na⑥/ de la bdag gi ⑦'byor pa ni nyung na bdag gis ji ltar gdugs tshod gsol bar bgyi/ des smras pa/ bu gal te de lta na khyod kyis nyi ma tha ma zung dul dus de'i bar du cung zad sgrubs 7shig /tshogs kyi rgyu lhag kyang cung zad rnyed grang / des nyi ma tha ma bzung ⑩nas de na tshogs kyi rgyu lhag pa yirab tu mang po yod pa dang / des kyang cung zad bsgrubs yinas de nas des gnas khang rtsig 8tu bcug ste/ der gos rnams bting nas grwa rnams su 'khyo pa ṇa ④lnga lnga bzhag /de la 'dom lpags shig bdog pa de ⑩yang gnas khang gi sgor bting cingo / /de nas lnga brgya'i 8ston mo snod du btsos shing sbyar nas bkur ༅ste chen pos yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs la 0 gdugs tshod gsol te zhabs la gtugs nas smon lam btab pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis bdag phyug cing nor mang ba 0longs spyod che ba'i rigs su skye zhing dulan 'ga' yang gding ba ma mchis pa'i sa phyogs su rkang pa mi 'jog pa dang / yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs kyi 0zhabs kyi mthil gnyis la spu gser gyi kha dog 'dra ba sor bzhi tsam 'khrungs pa ji 'dra ba de lta bur bdag gi ④yang de dang tso'adra ba dang yon tan 'di lta bu dag kyang thob cing / ston pa 'di 'dra ba mnyes par bgyid par 'gyur 0gyis ⑥mi mnyes par phyobagyid par du4—503

ma gyur ①cig ces byas so/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus kyi dga' sde'i bram ze'i khye'u gang yin pa de ni gro bzhin skyes bye ba nyi shu pa 'di nyid yin te/ 'dis yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs la bya ba byas shing smon lam btab pa de'i ②las kyi rnam par smin pa gang yin pas phyug cing nor mang la ②longs spyod che ba'i rigs su skyes pa dang / rkang pa gnyis la spu gser gyi kha dog 'dra ba sor bzhi tsam skyes pa deng / 'di nas bzung ste bskal ④pa dgu bcu rtsa gcig gi bar du lan 'ga' yang gding ⑤ba med pa'i sa phyogs su rkang pa ma bor ba dang / btsas pa na yang dkan dbab pa'i rin du gser bye ba phrag nyi shu thob cing / nga'i bstan ⑥pa la rab tu byung nas kyang nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs nas dgra bcom pa mngon sum du byas so / /dge slong dag de lta bas na las gcig tu gnag pa rnams kyi rnam par smin pa ni gcig tu ⑦gnag pa yin la/ gcig tu dkar ba rnams kyi ni gcig tu dkar ba yin/ 'dren ma rnams kyi ni 'dren dum yin pas/ dge slong dag de lta bas na las gcig 0tu gnag pa rnams dang 'dren tho )ma rnams ni spangs la/ las gcig 7tu dkar ba rnams la brtsal bar bya ste/ dge slong dag khyed ⑩kyis de ltar bslab 8par bya'o//gang gi tshe ma skyes dgra mi dge ba'i bshes gnyen lha sbyin gyis zin pas rgyal po gzugs can snying po la rdo rje rtse gcig pa 'phangs pa de'i tshe/ rgyal po'i khab na gnas pa'i grong mi rnams kyis 'phya bar brtsams te/ de na kha cig ni rgyal po la mi snyan pa 8sgrogs par byed de/ 'di ma btsas pa nyid nas yab la dgrar 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan (sten/ ci'i phyir ma btsas pa nyid du mi tho9bsad/1—504

gzhan dag gis smras pa/ shes ldan dag rgyal pos ma nyes te ci thams cad kyi lung bstan ①pa bden par 'gyur ram/ gzhon nu nyid dul ba yin mod kyi 'on kyang lha sbyin mi dge ba'i bshes ②gnyen gyis bslus snonas des ④na bya ba ngan pa la shin tu zhugs par gyur to/ /gzhan dag gis smras pa/ shes ldan dag rgyal po dang lha sbyin gyis kyang ma nyes te/ 'on kyang lha sbyin khrid de 'jig rten gyi ⑤khams kyi bar du mi bzhag par 'di ltar rab tu 'byin par mdzad pas na bcom ldan 'das kho nas nongs so/ /kha cig gis smras pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ma nongs te/ de gang gi ༅phyir gnas nas dbyung ba'i las ma byas pas dge 'dun gyis nyes so/ /de nas nyugang dag rgyal po la mi snyan par sgrogs pa des rgyal po ngo tsha bar mi byed kyi/ sngon gyi tshe rabs rnams su bdag gis las 'di dag byas shing bsags pa yin no snyam mo/ /gang dag bcom ldan 'das dang dge 'dun la mi snyan pa sgrogs pa des ni rgyal po shin tu ngo tsha bar byed de/bdag gi 0lus ngan pa gang yin pa des ⑨'jig rten ⑨ bcom ldan 'das dang dge 'dun gyi ༅mi snyan pa brjod cido snyam mo/ /dge slong rnams the tshom skyes te the tshom thams cad gcod pa tsobacom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa nongs pa gzhan gyis bgyis la skyon gzhan la bsgo ④ba la gzigs/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag da hunyeltar gyi 'di 'ba' zhig tu ma zad de/ji ltar 'dis 'das pa'i dus na yang nyes pa gzhan gyis byas la skyon gzhan la bsgos ⑩pa de ⑩nyon cig /dge slong dag sngon byung ba grong khyer bā rā ṇa sī na rgyal po tshangs sbyin zhes bya ba 'byor pa dang / rgyas pa dang / bde ba dang /lo legs pa 8skye bo'i tshogs yimang pos rab tu ⑦ gang ba na rgyal srid byed du 4—505

'jug go/ /de la khyi gnyis zhig yod pa 'gram dang nye 'gram zhes bya ste/ de gnyis kyis rgyal po'i rta khyab kyi cha spyad 'chos so/ /ji tsam ①dus gzhan zhig na rgyal po tshangs sbyin dra ma la cha ba na des blon po rnams ②la bsgo ba/ shes ldan dag rta khrab kyi yo byad ltos shig /de rnams kyis blta bar brtsams pa na thams cad bcad cing rab tu gtubs par mthong nas de rnams kyis rgyal po la smras pa/lha rta khrab kyi cha spyad zhes ②rnams kyis ④'tshal to/ /rgyal pos ⑤smras pa/ shes ldan dag gal te de lta na ngas khyi rnams yongs su spang ngo ⑥/ /de na ④kha cig ni bsad ⑤do/ /kha cig ni bros so/ /ji tsam na yul gzhan gyi khyi zhig yul nas bā rā ṇa sīr la'ong ba na des de rnams 'bros pa mthong nas dris ⑩pa/ shes ldan dag ci'i phyir khyed 'di ltar skrag /de rnams kyis ji ltar gyur pa rgyas par smras pa dang des smras pa/ khyed ci'i phyir rgyal po la gsol bar yim byas/ de rnams kyis smras pa/ gzhan dag ni kha btagatso /kho bo cag ni bros na rgyal po la gsol bar bya ba'i cigatol ga la yod/ des smras pa/ 'dug shig ④dang khyed kyi don du kho bos rgyal po la gsol ba bya'o/ /des de rnams dbugs phyung nas slar log pa dang / de nas des rgyun lugs 'chad tsam na thos pa'i nyen kor ⑩du 'dug nas tshigs su bcad pas gsol ba btab pañtsa/ rgyal po'i khab na zhes tsoganyis mchis pa 'gram dang ni/ /nye 'gram stobs dang kha dog ldan pa gang lags pa/ /de 'dir dgum rgyu bdag cag dgum pa'i rgyu ma lags/ /lha yicig dgum rgyu ma lags bkum du pa rigs pa min/ /rgyal pos thos nas des menam langs pa dang blon po rnams la bsgo ⑤ba/ tsho shes ldan dag mdang sum nga la tshigs su bcad pas gsol ba byed pa gang yin pa de tshol cig /de rnams kyis ⑫4wa 506

sku sung ①rnams la bsgo rjob/ shes ldan dag mdang sum lha la tshigs su bcad pas gsol ba byed pa de ①tshol cig /de rnams kyis smras pa/ yul gyi khyi lags so/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ shes ldan dag ④ci 'gram dang nye 'gram gyis zos sam 'on te/ khyi gzhan rnams kyis yin ⑤rtogs shig //blon po rnams 'dus nas gros bya bar brtsams pa/ shes ldan dag lhas 'di skad ces khyi rnams rtogs shig ces bka' stsal na/ de rnams la ji ltar brtag ⑥par bya/gzhan dag gis smras pa/ de la gzhan brtag ⑦tu ci yod/ skra'i thum po byin te skyug tu gzhug dumod/ de rnams kyis skra'i thum po byin te skyug tu bcug pa las / ji tsam na 'gram dang nye 'gram gnyis ko ba'i dum bur skyugs nas rgyal po la rig par ⑨byas pa dang / rgyal pos de gnyis spangs te/ lhag ma rnams la mi 'jigs pa byin no/ /yidage slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus kyi 'gram dang nye 'gram gang yin pa de gnyis ni lha sbyin dang / ma skyes dgra 'di gnyis yin te/ de na yang 'di gnyis kyis nyes pa byas la skyon gzhan la bsgo'o kye/ /da ltar yang 'di gnyis kyis nyes pa byas la skyon gzhan la bsgo'o༅/ /gzhan yang ji ltar lha sbyin byas pa mi gzo ba dang byas pa mi tshor ba de nyon cig/dge slong dag sngon byung ba grong khyer bā rā ṇa sī na rgyal po tshangs sbyin zhes bya ba rgyal srid byed du 'jug go/ /ji tsam na mi zhig sta re dang khur shing thogs te shing gi phyir nags khrod du song nas/ de de na shing tshol bar byed pa na seng ges skrag nas bros tho)pa las su ra khung zhig du lhung ngo / /seng ges kyang de bza' ba'i bsam pas de nyid du lhung ngo / /sbrul zhig gis 8byi ba zhig skrag nas bros pa dang / khras byi ba bza' ba'i phyir bsnyags 8pa las/ ci tsam 4—507

na thams cad su ra khung du lhung ste/ de dag thams cad gcig la gcig bsad ①par 'dod pa'i gnod ②sems dang ldan par gyur pa dang seng ges smras pa/shes ldan dag khyed ②thams cad kho bo'i bgrod pa yin te/ de lta mod kyi bdag cag sdug bsngal ④mi bzad pa dog pa thob pas 'di ni gnod par ⑤bya ba'i dus ma yin gyis ma 'gul bar 'khod cig /stes dbang gis rngon pa zhig ri dgas rnams tshol zhing phyogs der phyin pa dang ⑥/ des su ra khung der blta bar brtsams pa las/ de rnams kyis brtabs ⑦pa'i tshig gis ⑤smras pa/ kye nang rje skyabs gyis shig /de nas rngon pa des shes nas thog mar seng ge 0phyung ba dang / des rkang pa la gtugs te smras pa/ khyod kyi drin gzo bar bya ste/'on kyang 'di na mgo nag po gnas pa de ni byas pa chud gson yi pa yin gyis ⑪khyod kyis ma dbyung shig ces smras nas song ngo / /ji tsam na rngon pa des thams cad mthar gyis phyung ngo / /ji tsam dus gzhan zhig na seng shes ri dgas shig bsad pa dang rngon pa de yang phyogs der phyin pa seng shes de ngo shes nas rngon pa'i rkang pa la gtugs te ri dgas de byin no/ /dus gzhan zhig na rgyal po tshangs sbyin 8btsun mo dang lhan cig skyed mos tshal gyi sar song nas des skyed mos tshal der bde ba nyams su myong bar byas nas gnyid kyis log go/ /btsun mo bud med rnams kyang bag yangs su gnas pas gos dag phud de skems(spre/rgyan dag bkrol nas phyogs dag tu bzhag ste 8skyed mos tshal na 'chag par byed/'dug par byed/ nyal bar byed/ gnyid 6log par byed do/ /ji tsam na btsun mo zhig rgyan rnams bkrol te phyogs zhig tu bzhag nas gnyid log pa dang khras de blangs nas rngon pa de la byas pa gzo bar bya tho)ba'i phyir byin no/ /1—508

rgyal po tshangs sbyin gnyid kyis snyom ①pa bsal nas myur ba myur bar bā rā ṇa sbor zhugs so/ /btsun mo dang / gzhon nu dang / blon po dang / grong mi dang / yul mi rnams kyang rings par dong ngo / /ji tsam na btsun mo des rgyan btsal ba las ma rnyed nas des rgyal po la smras pa/ lha skyed mos tshal du bdag gi rgyan stor ②lags so/ /rgyal pos blon po rnams la bsgo ba/ shes ldan dag rgyan stor gyis su yis ⑧khyer tshol cig /de rnams kyis btsal bar brtsams pa na mgo nag po de rngon ④pa'i drung du dus dus su 'gro bas de de'i khyim du song ba na mtshan ma las de la ④rgyan yod par shes nas/ byas pa chud gzon pa des rgyal po'i drung du song nas gsol pa dang / de nas rgyal po mchog tu khros te rgyal po'i mi rnams kyis rngon ༅pa bkug ⑦nas smras pa/ kwa'i ⑧nang rje khyod kyis skyed mos tshal nas rgyan brkus 0so/ /de nas de skrag nas ji ltar gyur pa smras te rgyan de rgyal po la phul na/ 'on kyang mi de bcings nas btson rar bzhag go/ /byi bas song nas sbrul la smras pa/ mgo nag po sdig pa byed pa des bya ba byas cinas bdag cag gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen rgyal pos bcings nas btson rar bzhag go/ /sbrul gyis smras pa/ kye rngon 7pa de ring bdag gis rgyal po la zin par byas khyod kyis sngags kyi tshig 'di 8dang sman 0'di dag gis gsos shig dang / de ltar tson 8rgyal po de dga' nas khyod gdon mi za bar btang nas longs spyod kyang bgo bsha' byed par 'gyur ro/ /des smras pa legs kyis tsode bzhin gyis shig /sbrul gyis rgyal po zin pa dang rngon pas song ste sngags dang sman de ⑩dag gis gsos so/ /de nas rgyal po mgu nas btson las btang ste tsolongs spyod dag gis yibago bsha' yang byas so/ /bcom ldan 4—509

'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus kyi rngon pa gang yin pa de ni nga nyid ①yin no/ /de'i tshe de'i dus kyi byas pa ②chud gson pa'i mi chagang yin pa de ni lha sbyin 'di nyid yin te/ de na ④yang 'di byas pa mi gzo ba dang byas pa mi 'tshor ba yin no/ /da ltar yang 'di ⑥byas pa mi gzo ༅ba dang byas pa mi tshor ba yin no//gzhan yang ji ltar 'di byas pa mi gzo ba dang byas pa mi tshor ba de nyon cig /dge slong dag sngon byung ba dus ma yin par zhag bdun du sprin chags te lhas char phab nas ne'u le zhig byi ba'i tshang du zhugs so/ /sbrul zhig kyang duchar pas skrag nas phan tshun ri 'orgyu ba na de nyid du zhugs so/ /ji tsam na ne'u le des byi ba de gsad 6par brtsams pa na sbrul gyis smras pa/ shes ldan dag bdag cag sdug bsngal /kāmi bzad 8pa dog pa thob kyis gcig la gcig 8gnod pa ma byed par ma 'gul bar 'khod cig /de na casprul gyi ming ni dga' sde zhes bya'o//ne'u le'i ming ni dga' bo zhes bya'o/ /byi ba'i ming ni gang gās 6byin 6zhes bya'o/ /dga' sde dang / dga' bos gang hās 9byin la smras pa/ khyod 'jab cing song la bdag cag gi 8kha zas tshol cig /de drang zhing bsam pa bzang ba yin pas de gnyis kyi ched du snying nas kha zas btsal bar brtsams pa na ma rnyed do/ / dga' bos yidaga' sde la smras pa/ gal te gang hās zhu byin phyakha zas med par 'ongs na de nyid bdag gis bza' bar bya'o/ /dga' sdes bsams pa/sdug bsngal pu /mi bzad pa dog pa thob tsunyen yang 'di de la gsod par rtsom na/gal te de kha zhu zas med par 'ongs na lta smos kyang ci dgos ④pas ye ⑩de la spring bar bya'o snyam nas des de la spring ba/ dga' bo na re 'di skad ces gal te 4—510

gang gās ①byin kha zas med par 'ongs na de nyid bdag gis bza' bar bya'o zhes zer ro/ /gang gās ②byin gyis kha zas btsal ba las cung zad kyang ma rnyed nas des bsams pa/ gdon mi za bar des bdag zos par 'gyur ro snyam nas des dga' sde la spring ba/ mi bkren ltogs pa'i shugs kyis yongs ②dub nas / /nyam thag snying rje med par ④'gyur bas khyod/ /byas pa chud gson ⑤sems can de la ni/ /gang gās ༅byin pa phyir mi 'ong zhes gsungs/ /zhes ⑦spring ngo / /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus kyi gang gās ⑧byin gang yin pa de ni nga nyid ⑨yin no/ /de'i tshe de'i dus kyi ne'u le dga' bo gang yin pa de ni lha sbyin 'di nyid yin te/ de na yang 'di byas pa mi gzo ba dang byas pa mi tshor ba yin no/ /da ltar yang 'di byas pa mi gzo ba dang byas pa mi tshor ba yin no/ /gang gi tshe ma skyes dgras rgyal po gzugs can snying po la rdo rje rtse gcig pa 'phangs pa de'i tshe rgyal pos de la spyos nas gzhon nu ci'i phyir khyod kyis nga la rdo rje rtse gcig pa 'phangs/ des rngu smras pa/ lha hunyetshig 6pa 'tshal ba'i slad du ste/ lha la ni 8longs spyod mnga' na bdag la ma mchis so/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ bu gal te de lta na song la tsam pa gzhi bodang bcas pa khyod kyi yin no/ /de dga' ba dang / mgu ba dang / rab tu dga' bas lha sbyin gyi drung du song ste smras pa/ 'phags pa bdag gis tsam pa gzhi dang bcas pa thob bo/ /des smras pa/ gzhon nu khyod kyis pha rol gnon pa'i 'bras bu mthong ngam/ 'phags pa mthong ngo / /da dung yang pha rol gnon pa gyis shig dang / khyod kyi skemangon par 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /des tsam par dpyad bab pas gtse bar brtsams te gtses pa na skye bo'i tshogs 'bros pa la zhugs te/1—511

kha cig ni ①rgyal po'i khab tu dong ngo / /kha cig ni yul gzhan du dong nas blon po rnams kyis rgyal po la pho nyas bzlugs ②pa/ lha gzhon nus tsam pa'i skye bo gtses te/ gtses ②pa na ④'bros lags kyis/ lha gzhon nu de las bzlog ⑤par mdzad pa'i rigs so/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ gzhon nu ci'i phyir yul mi la gnod par ༅byed/ des smras pa/ lha dpung rgyas par mi 'gyur lags so/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ gzhon nu gal te de lta na rgyal po'i khab 'ba' zhig ma gtogs par yul ma ga dhā khyer cig /des yul ma ga dhā blangs nas lha sbyin gyi drung du dong ④ste smras pa/ 'phags pa bdag gis rgyal po'i khab 'ba' zhig ②ma gtogs pa yul ma ga dhā thams cad thob bo/ /des smras pa/ gzhon nu pha rol gnon ⑨pa'i 'bras bu ni de 'dras yang pha rol gnon ④pa gyis shig /des yul ma ga dhā brlag hupar bya bar brtsams pa na yul ma ga dhā na gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs kyis rgyal po gzugs can snying po la gsol pa/ lha gzhon nus yul ma ga dhā brlag rtsonapar bgyis kyis mazlog mdzod cig /rgyal pos de bkug ste 0 smras pa/ gzhon nu ci'i phyir yul ma ga dhā brlag nyu)par bya/ des smras pa/lha bdag gi skye bo'i tshogs phal mo skyeche rgyas par mi 'gyur lags so/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ gzhon nu gal te de lta na mdzod cig hu)ma gtogs pa 8thams cad khyod kho na'i yin no/ /des rgyal po'i khab kyang blangs nas lha sbyin gyi drung du song ste smras pa/ 'phags pa bdag gis mdzod cig ⑩ma gtogs par longs spyod thams cad thob bo/ /des smras pa/ pha rol gnon pa'i 'bras bu de yin mod kyi 'on kyang rgyal po rnams ni mdzod kyi mthu can yin te/ gang la mdzod yod pa de rgyal po yin pas mdzod kyi phyir pha rol gnon pa gyis shig /des rgyal 1—512

po'i khab kyang brlag ①par bya bar brtsams pa na rgyal po'i khab na gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs dang / yul ma ga dhā na gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs dang / tsam pa pa ②thams cad skrag par gyur nas/ ji ltar ma skyes dgras mi mthong ba de ltar pho nya btang ste rgyal po la gsol pa/ lhas bdag cag bu bzhin du so sor bskyangs ②na gzhon nus ma 'os ④pa bzhin ⑤du bkren par bgyis pas lha'i yul mi phal 'ucher bros lags te/ bdag cag kyang 'bros par 'tshal lags so/ /rgyal po snying rje'i bdag nyid can chos gtsor byed pa de mi bde ba skyes nas ma skyes dgra bkug ste/ dga' ba dang / snyan pa dang / rjes su mthun ⑦pa'i tshig gis mgo la byugs te smras pa/ bu ngas khyod la yul thams cad byin na ci'i phyir yi chad ༅par bya ༅so sor skyongs shig /des smras pa/ lha rgyal po rnams ni mdzod kyi mthu can lags na/ bdag la mdzod kyi mthu ma mchis na ji ltar bgyi / des smras pa/ gal te de ⑩lta na btsun mo'i 'khor ma gtogs pa thams cad khyod kho na'i yin no/ /'on kyang rang bzhin ngan cing sdig pa'i grogs po can de 'dug tu mi btub cing brlag tshipa kho nar byed do/ /rgyal pos spyo ba dang bcas pas smras pa/ bang mdzod dang / mdzod dang / yul thams cad khyod kho na la byin na ci'i phyir da dung rlag 3nyepar byed/ de skad ces smras pa dang de khros nas blon po rnams la smras pa/ shes ldan dag rgyal po rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang bskur tsob la smod pa gang yin pa de ④la chad pa cis gcad(sme / blon po rnams kyis smras pa/ lha chad par tsugyidagum lags mod/des smras pa/ de ⑩nga'i yab yin pas ji ltar bsad kyis ⑫/ deng la de zung ⑪ste phyag sbal du chug du la zhog shigasu /de phyag sbal du bcug pa dang / rgyal po 1—513

de la grong mi rnams dga' bas yul de na gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs kyis thos nas yid mi bde bar gyur na ma skyes dgra gtum ①pa dang / brlang 0ba dang /gzu lums ②che bas de la su yang kha zer mi phod do/ /rgyal po gzugs can snying po ༅phyag sbal na las kho na la rten cing 'dug pa de la lus 'phags mas snod du btsos pa skyel bar byed do/ /ma skyes dgras btson srungs ⑤rnams la dris pa/shes ldan dag rgyal po bgres po ji ltar 'tsho bar byed/ de rnams kyis smras pa/lha khyod kyi yum gyis snod nas btsos pa skyel lags so/ /ma skyes dgras bsgo ba/phyin chad bza' ba dang btung ba ji ltar yang skyel bar mi 'gyur bar ༅khog shig⑦/btsun mo rnams la yang bsgo ba/ sus kyang phyag sbal du bza' ba dang btung ba bskyal dubar mi bya'o/ /gang zhig skyel na de chad pas bsad 0do/ /de zhe gnag pa'i tsolas can yin par shes pas 7su yang kha zas sbyor ba ciyang mi byed na skyel ba lta smos kyang ci dgos/ de nas lus 'phags ma khyim thab la sdug par 'chums rtsonapa'i snying gis phye'i 'de hu gus lus 8byugs shing rkang gdub kyi sbubs chus bkang nas bskyal byabar brtsams te de des 'tsho bar byed do/ / btson srungs kyi nyu)mi rnams kyis de'i thabs shes mod kyi rgyal po de la dga' bas mthong yang ma skyes dgra la ma sbran to/ /ji tsam na yang ma skyes dgras btson srungs kyi tsomi rnams la smras pa/ shes ldan dag rgyal po bgres po ji ltar 'tsho bar byed/de rnams kyis rgyas par smras pa dang / des smras pa/ shes ldan dag lus 'phags ma ji ltar yang hu)phyis skyel bar mi 'gyur bar khog shig0 /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed 0pa'i phyir skar khung gi drang thad kyi bya rgod kyi phung po'i ri la 'chag par brtsams nas/ rgyal po gzugs 4—514

can snying pos ①skar khung nas drang thad kyi bya rgod kyi phung po'i ri la ②bcom ldan 'das gang na ba la bltas lanas dga' ba skyed pas des na srog dang bral bar ma gyur to/ /ma skyes dgras yang btson srungs kyi ④mi rnams la smras pa/ shes ldan dag bza' ba dang btung ba ni bkag na da ltar rgyal po bgres po ji ltar 'tsho bar byed/ de rnams kyis smras pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis de rjes su gzung ⑤ba'i slad du skar khung gi drang thad kyi bya rgod kyi phung po'i ri la 'chag par mdzad pa de la de gdugs re re zhing bzhengs nas gzigs lags so/ /des ⑥smras pa/ skar khung khog la de'i rkang pa gnyis kyang spu gris dros ④shig /de rnams kyis 0skar khung dag bkag de'i rkang pa gnyis kyang spu gris dras pa dang de sdug bsngal 0gyi tshor bas gdungs pas mchi mas brnangs ⑩shing skad 'gags ༅la mig mchi mas gang bas bsams pa/ bdag sdug bsngal 8mi bzad pa dog pa thob na bcom ldan 'das kyis ma dgongs pa lta zhig snyam mo/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni de lta bu mi mkhyen pa'am/ mi gzigs pa'amatsunye/thugs su mi chud pa'am/ rnam par mi mkhyen pa ci yang mi mnga'o/ /chos nyid kyis ④sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa/ 'jig rten la phan par zhugs pa/ bsrung (smeb gcig pu pa/ nyag (9gcig dpa' ba/zla med pa/ gnyis su mi gsung ba/ zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gis bzhugs pa / dul ba'i gnas gsum gyi gzhi la mkhas pa/ chu bo bzhi las rgal ba/rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi'i zhabs kyi mthil legs par gnas pa/ bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi la yun ring po nas yongs su sbyang ba mdzad pa/ yan lag lnga spangs pa/ 'gro ba lnga las yang dag par 'das pa/ yan lag drug dang ldan pa/4—515

pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs pa/ byang chub kyi yan lag bdun gyi me tog gis phyug pa/ lam gyi yan lag brgyad ②ston pa/ mthar gyis ②gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu la mkhas pa/ stobs bcu'i stobs dang ldan pa/phyogs bcur snyan pas yang dag par rgyas pa/ brgya phrag bcur dbang sgyur ①ba las khyad par du 'phags pa rnams ni sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum du 'jig rten la rnam par gzigs nas gang ni nyams/ gang ni 'phel/ gang ni mi bzad par gyurabya/ gang ni dog par gyur/ gang ni sdug bsngal ⑤bar gyur/ gang ni mi bzad pa yidang dog pa dang sdug bsngal ⑦bar gyur/ gang ni ngan song la gzhol/ gang ni ngan song la 'bab/ gang ni dungan song la bab/ ngas gang ni ngan song nas 0drangs te mtho ris dang thar pa dang 'bras bu la gzhag par bya/ gang gi dge ba'i rtsa ba dag ma bskyed ⑩pa ni bskyed ༅par bya/ gang gi dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed 8pa dag ni yongs su smin par bya/ gang gi yongs su smin pa tho)ni rnam par grol bar bya zhes ye shes gzigs pa la 6'jug par mdzad do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po la bka' stsal pa/ mod gal gyi bu song la nga'i tshig gis rgyal po gzugs can snying po la nad med par gyur cig ces 8byos la 'di skad ces bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal nas dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis ⑩bya ba gang yin pa de ngas khyod la mdzad zin te/ khyod sems can dmyal ba dang /dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang / yi hu)dgas rnams nas ni rkang pa drangs/ lha dang mi rnams su ni rab tu bzhag /'khor ba'i 8ni mthar byas/ khrag dang mchi ma'i rgya mtsho ni bskamasañtsa/ rus pa'i ri bo las ni bsgral me / ngan song 4—516

rnams kyi sgo ni bcad/ mtho ris dang thar pa'i sgo rnams ni phye na/ 'on kyang khyod nyid kyi ①las tshogs rnyed pa/ rkyen yongs su bsgyur dub/ 'od pa bzhin du nye bar gnas pa/ gdon mi za bar 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i las dag khyod nyid kyis byas shing bsags pa dag gzhan su zhig gis ②so sor myong bar 'gyur/rgyal po chen po las byas shing bsags pa dag ni phyi rol gyi sa'i khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur/ chu'i khams la mi 'gyur/ me'i khams la mi 'gyur/rlung gi khams la mi 'gyur gyi/ 'di ltar las dge ba dang mi dge ba byas shing bsags pa dag ni zin pa'i phung po dang / khams dang / skye mched rnams kho na la rnam par smin par 'gyur te/ las rnams bskal ④pa brgyar yang ni/ /chud mi za ba'ang tshogs dang dus/ /rnyed na lus can rnams la ni/ /'bras bu dag tu 'gyur ba nyid/ /rgyal po chen po de lta bas na las kyi skyabs can du gyis shig ces gsung ngo / /zhes byos shig /btsun pa bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos ⑤bcom ldan 'das las mnyan nas ji ltar sems mnyam ༅par bzhag na bya rgod kyi phung po'i ri las mi snang bar gyur to༅la/ /phyag sbal du rgyal po gzugs can snying po'i mdun du 'dug pa de lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par bzhugs dute 'di skad ces smras so/ /rgyal po chen po bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal nas khyod nad med par gyur cig ces gsung ngo //btsun pa mod gal gyi bu chen po bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal po chen po bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal nas 'di skad ces/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis ⑨bya ba gang yin pa de ngas khyod la mdzad de⑩/ khyod sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro dang / yi dgas rnams nas ni rkang pa drangs/ lha dang mi 4—517

rnams su ni rab tu bzhag /'khor ba'i ①ni mthar byas/ khrag dang mchi ma'i rgya mtsho ni bskams②/ rus pa'i ri bo las ni bsgral / ngan song rnams kyi sgo ni bcad/ mtho ris ④dang thar pa'i sgo rnams ni phye na/ 'on kyang khyod nyid kyi ⑤las tshogs rnyed pa/ rkyen yongs su bsgyur ⑥ba/ 'od pa bzhin du nye bar gnas pa/ gdon mi za bar 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i las dag khyod nyid ⑦kyis dubyas shing bsags pa dag gzhan su zhig gis ④so sor myong bar 'gyur/rgyal po chen po las byas shing bsags pa dag ni phyi rol gyi sa'i khams la rnam par smin pa ra mi 'gyur/ chu'i khams la mi 'gyur/ me'i khams la mi 'gyur/rlung gi khams la mi 'gyur gyi/ 'di ltar las dge ba dang mi dge ba ⑩byas shing bsags pa dag ni zin pa'i phung po dang / khams dang / skye mched rnams kho na la rnam par smin par 'gyur te/ las rnams bskal nyunyepa brgyar yang ni/ /chud mi za ba'ang tshogs dang dus/ /rnyed na lus can rnams la ni/ /'bras bu dag tu 'gyur ba nyid/ /rgyal po chen po de lta bas na khyod kyis hu)las kyi skyabs can du gyis shig ces gsung ngo / /de phyag sbal du bcug pa dang / spu gris rkang pa dras pa dang / bza' ba dang btung ba dang bral ba'i sdug bsngal ⑫gyis nyen pas smras pa/ btsun pa mod gal gyi bu chen po gang na kha zas bzang po 'tshal lags/ des smras pa/ rgyal po chen po rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha rnams na'o zhes smras nas/ tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos ji ltar sems mnyam par bzhag na phyag sbal de nas mi snang bar gyur te④/ bya rgod kyi phung po la phyin pa de lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /ma skyes dgra'i bu 'char byed bzang po'i mdzub byamo la phol mig byung bas de ngu bar gyur 4—518

nas ma skyes dgras ①drung du song ste/ des de pang ②par bzhag nas mgul nas 'khyud / 'o byas/ kun tu 'khyud na 'on kyang de ngu ste 'dug tu mi btub bo//de nas ma skyes dgras de'i mdzub ②mo khar bcug pa dang / phol mig khar rdol nas ma skyes dgras rnag khrag sa la pho'o/ /gzhon nu 'char byed bzang pos rnag khrag de mthong nas lhag par ngu bar brtsams pa dang / btsun mo lus 'phags mas 'dzum 0phyung ba ma skyes dgras mthong nas smras pa/ yum 'di ji lta bu zhig /des smras pa/ bu nad 'di ni khyed ⑤kyi yab mes brgyud ⑥de 'ongs pa yin te/ khyod kyang de ltar gyur pa na khyod kyi yab kyis mdzub ⑦mo khar bcug pa dang / phol mig rdol nas khyod mi ngu bar bya ba'i phyir rnag khrag sa la ma pho bar khong ⑧du mid do des smras pa/ yum bdag gi yab 'di 'dra bar byams par gyur tam/ des smras pa/ de 'dra'o/ /de nas ma skyes dgra pha la zhe sdang gi kun nas dkris pa dang bral zhing rjes su chags pa skyes te/ des blon po rnams la smras pa/ shes ldan dag gang zhig ⑨ nga la rgyal po bgres po gson no zhes zer ba de la ngas rgyal srid phyed sbyin no/ /rgyal po de la grong mi dang yul mi rnams dga' ba yin pas skye bo'i tshogs chen pos phyag sbal logs su brgyugs pa'i sgra rgyal pos thos nas bsams pa/ da ⑩ni gnod pa mi bzad pa ci zhig byed par 'gyur ro snyam stetho〉/ skrag nas shugs nar zhes phyung ste shi ba dang /rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bu'i bur skyes te pang du 'dug nas lha'i bdud rtsis ⑫longs spyod par byed do/ /rnam tsothos kyi bus smras pa/ khyod su zhig /des bdag ni rgyal ba byakhyu mchog lags so/ /zhes smras pas/ de'i ming rgyal ba khyu mchog rgyal ba 'khyu mchog ces bya bar 'grags so/ /dge slong rnams the tshom 1—519

skyes te the tshom thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/btsun pa rgyal po gzugs can snying po ①las ci zhig bgyis na las de'i rnam ②par smin pas phyug cing nor mang la longs spyod che ba'i rgyal po'i ②rigs su skyes par gyur cing bcom ldan 'das kyi ⑦spyan snga nas bden pa mthong bar bgyis pa dang / spu gris sug pa rkang pa dras te phyag sbal du stsal cing bkres pa dang /skom pas gzir nas gum par gyur ⑤lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag rgyal po gzugs can snying po 'di nyid kyis las tshogs rnyed pa/ rkyen yongs su bsgyur ⑥ba/ 'od pa bzhin du nye bar gnas pa / gdon mi za bar 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i las dag byas shing bsags pas/gzugs can snying pos las ④byas shing bsags pa dag gzhan su zhig gis so sor myong bar 'gyur/ dge slong dag las byas shing bsags pa dag ni phyi rol gyi sa'i khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur/ chu'i khams la mi 'gyur/ me'i khams la mi 'gyur/ rlung gi khams la mi 'gyur gyi/ 'di ltar las dge ba dang mi dge ba dubyas shing bsags ⑨pa dag ni zin pa'i phung po dang / khams dang / skye mched rnams kho na la rnam par smin par 'gyur te/ las rnams bskal ⑪ pa brgyar yiyang ni/ /chud mi za ba'ang tshogs dang dus/ /rnyed na lus can rnams la ni/ /'bras bu dag tu 'gyur ba nyid/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba sangs rgyas rnams 'byung ba med pa na 'jig rten du rang sangs rgyas dman pa dang ngan 8pa la snying brtse tsob can/ bas mtha'i gnas mal la dga' ba / 'jig rten gyi yon gnas gcig ④bu dag 'byung bar 'gyur ba yin pas/ji tsam na rang sangs rgyas zhig ljongs rgyu zhing spyod 8pa na bā rā ṇa sīr phyin nas 4—520

bā rā ṇa sī'i rdza mkhan zhig gi ①las khang du nub mo nye bar brten te gnas so/ /'gron ②pa zhig kyang las khang de nyid du gnas ②btab pa las der 'gron ④pa des bshang ba byas nas nub mo nyid langs te song ngo / /dgra bcom pa rnams dang / rang sangs rgyas rnams ni ma ⑤bsams par ye shes mthong ba mi 'jug pa yin pas rang sangs rgyas kyis 'di nyid du bsod snyoms spyad par bya'o snyam nas de nyid du 'dug go/ /ji tsam na zhurdza mkhan nam nangs nas las kyi khang par zhugs na mi gtsang bas ma rungs par ④byas pa mthong ngo mi phal pa rnams ni mi rtog pa yin pas des durang sangs rgyas la sems rab tu gdug par byas te de sems rab tu snang bas smras pa/ rab tu byung ba khyod kyi 0rkang pa gnyis yi spu gris dras sam ci na gang gi phyir khyod kyis las khang du bshang ba byas shing (7phyi rol du ma song / des de sgo bcad nas 'di nyid du skom pa dang bkres pas tho)shi shig ces bzhag go/ /bdag nyid chen po des bsams pa/nyon mongs pa 0'di ni nyams kyis gal te bdag gis sgo phye ste song bar gyur na lhag par yang nyams par 'gyur ro snyam nas de cang mi smra bar 'dug go/ /ji tsam na rdza mkhan dro'i dus la bab nas de'i zhe sdang gi 8kun nas dkris pa dang bral nas des smras pa/ kye blarab tu byung ba gdugs tshod gsol gyis tshur spyon/rang sangs rgyas kyis smras pa/ bzhin bzangs kho bo dus su longs spyod pa yin pa las dus las yol zin to/ /des smras pa/ gal te de lta na 'di nyid du bzhugs te/ sang bshos cigasol la gshegs shig /des de la snying brtse ⑩ba'i phyir khas blangs so/ /des de phyi de ④nyin par kha zas bsod ⑩pas tshim par byas so/ /bdag nyid chen po de dag ni lus kyis chos ston gyi ngag gis ma 4—521

yin pas de steng ①gi nam mkha' la mngon par 'phags te 'bar ba dang /gsal ②ba dang / char 'bebs pa dang / glog 'byin ①pa'i cho 'phrul dag bya bar brtsams so/ /so so'i skye bo ni rdzu 'phrul la myur du sems gtod pa yin pas de ④shing rtsa ba nas bcad pa bzhin du rkang pa gnyis la gtugs ⑤te smras pa/yon gnas chen po mar spyon/ mar spyon/ bdag 'dod pa'i 'dam du bying ba lag nas drang du gsol/ de babs pa dang / des de'i rkang pa gnyis la gtugs te smon lam btab pa/ bdag gis yon gnas dam pa 'di lta bu la gnod pa bgyis pa'i las gang lags pa de'i skal ba can du ma gyur cig /bya ba byas pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba gang yin pa 'dis bdag phyug cing nor mang la longs spyod che ba'i rigs su skye zhing 'di bas khyad par du 'phags pa'i ston pa mnyes par bgyid kyi mi mnyes par mi bgyid pa dang ⑥/ 'di lta bu'i chos rnams kyang thob par gyur cig ces byas so/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems de'i tshe de'i dus kyi rdza khumakhan gang yin pa de ni gzugs can snying po 'di nyid yin te/rang sangs rgyas la sems rab tu gdug dupas ngag rtsub po'i 0las phyung ba gang yin pa de'i las kyi rnam par smin pas spu gris rkang pa gnyis dras pa dang / phyag sbal du bcug pa dang / skom pa dang bkres pas ༅shi ba yin no/ /des bzod pa gsol nas smon lam btab pa gang yin pa de'i las kyi ⑩rnam par smin pas phyug pa dang rgyal po'i rigs su skyes nas kyang nga'i spyan snga nas 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo nyi shu mtho ba ⑫ ye shes kyi 8rdo rjes bcom nas rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du thob par byas so/ /dge slong dag de lta bas na las gcig (stetu gnag pa rnams kyi rnam par smin pa ni gcig tu gnag 8pa yin la/4—522

gcig tu dkar ba rnams kyi ni gcig tu dkar ba yin/ 'dren ma rnams kyi ni 'dren ①ma yin no②/ /dge slong dag de lta bas na las gcig tu gnag pa rnams dang 'dren ①ma rnams spangs te/ las gcig tu dkar ba la brtsal bar bya ste/ dge slong dag khyed kyis ④de lta bu la bslab par bya'o// //'dul ba gzhi༅/ bam po brgya rtsa ༅gnyis pa/ blon po rnams kyis ma skyes dgra la smras pa/ lha rgyal po bgres 0po ni nongs so/ /des thos nas brgyal ⑧te sa la 'gyel ba dang / chus gtor nas dbugs slar byung ⑨nas mya ngan gyi khang par zhugs te 'dug go/ /de'i mya ngan bsal bar sus kyang mi nus naso blon po rnams kyis de'i mya ngan bsal ba brtsal ⑩bar brtsams pa lasayi ji tsam na lho phyogs nas gar mkhan zhig 'ongs nas/ blon po rnams kyis de de'i mdun du gar byed du bcug kyang ma skyes dgra yid mi bde ba nyid pas sus kyang de la legs so 8zhes bya ba ma byin nas/ gar mkhan phyir byung ba dang bcom ldan 'das kyang phyogs der gshegs so/ /des bcom ldan 'das mthong nas des bsams pa/ skyes bu dam pa 'di lta bu dag la byas dang des bdag la legs so zhes bya ba byin pa zhig snyam ste/ de bcom ldan 'das la sems mngon par dad pas tsu)rdza rnga chen po brdungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dzum ④pa mdzad do/ /chos nyid kyis gang gi 8tshe sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams 'dzum pa mdzad pa de'i 0tshe zhal nas 'od zer sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po dang / btsod ka dag byung nas kha cig ni 'og tu 'gro/ kha cig ni steng du 'gro la/ gang dag 'og tu dong ba de dag ni sems can dmyal ba yang sos dang / thig nag dang / bsdus ⑩'joms 1—523

dang / ngu 'bod dang / ngu 'bod chen po dang / tsha ba dang /① rab tu tsha ba dang / mnar med pa ②dang / chu bur can dang / chu bur rdol pa can chadang / so thams thams dang / kyi ④dud zer dang / a cu 0zer dang / ut+pal ⑥ltar gas pa dang / pad ma ltar gas pa dang / pad ma ltar gas pa chen por song ste/ sems can dmyal ba tsha ba ⑦gang yin pa de dag ⑧ni bsil bar gyur te 'bab par byed la/ sems can dmyal ba grang ba gang yin pa de dag tu 0dro bar gyur te 'bab par byed do/ /des sems can dmyal ba de dag gi gnod pa'i bye brag ⑩dag rgyun gcod par byed cing de dag 'di snyam du shes ldan dag ci 0bdag cag 'di nas shi 'phos sam 'on te gzhan du skyes snyam du sems so/ /de tsodad pa bskyed 8par bya ba'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyis sprul pa gtong bar mdzad de/④ de dag gis sprul pa mthong nas 'di snyam du sems te/ shes ldan dag bdag cag 'di nas shi 'phos pa yang ma yin 8la gzhan du skyes pa yang ma yin te/ 'di ltar sems can sngon ma mthong ba 'di'i mthus bdag cag 8gi gnod pa'i bye brag dag rgyun chad ⑩par gyur to snyam mo/ /de dag sprul pa la sems mngon par dad par gyur nas sems can dmyal ba myong bar 'gyur ba'i las de zad par byas nas gang du bden pa dag gi snod du gyur par 'gyur ba'i lha dang mi rnams kyi nang du nying mtshams sbyor ba len par byed do//gang dag steng du 'dong ba de dag ni rgyal chen bzhi'i ris dang / sum bcu rtsa gsum dang / 'thab bral dang / dga' ldan dang / 'phrul dga' dang /gzhan 'phrul dbang byed dang / tshangs ris dang / tshangs pa'i mdun na 'don dang / tshangs chen dang / 'od chung dang / tshad med 'od dang /1—524

'od gsal dang / dge chung dang / tshad med dge dang / dge rgyas dang /sprin med dang / bsod nams 'phel dang / 'bras bu che ba dang / mi che ba dang / mi gdung ba dang / gya nom snang ba dang / shin tu mthong ①dang /'og min gyi lha rnams kyi nang du song nas mi rtag pa dang / sdug bsngal ②ba dang / stong pa dang / bdag med pa zhes bya ba'i sgra sgrog ②par byed cing /tshigs su bcad pa gnyis po/ brtsam ④par bya zhing 'byung bar bya/ /sangs rgyas bstan ⑤la 'jug par bya/ /'dam bu'i khyim la glang chen bzhin/ /'chi bdag sde ni gzhom par bya/ /gang zhig rab tu bag yod par/ /chos 'dul 'di la spyod 'gyur ba/ /skye ba'i ༅'khor ba rab spangs nas/ /sdug bsngal ⑦tha mar byed par 'gyur/ /zhes bya bar ④yang sgrogs so/ /de nas 'od zer de dag gis ⑨stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams byul nas bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi rjes bzhin rjes bzhin du 'gro ste/ de la gal te becom ldan 'das 'das pa'i las lung ston par bzhed na ni bcom ldan 'das kyi snam logs su nub par 'gyur ro/ /ma 'ongs pa'i las tsolung ston par bzhed na ni mdun logs su nub par 'gyur/ sems can dmyal bar skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni zhabs kyi mthil du nub par 'gyur/ dud 'gror skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni rting par nub par 'gyur/ yi dgas su skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni zhabs kyi mthe bor nub par 'gyur/ mir skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni pus mor nub par 'gyur/ stobs kyi 'khor los 7sgyur ba'i rgyal srid lung ston par bzhed na ni phyag mthil g.yon par nub par 'gyur/'khor los 8sgyur ba'i rgyal srid lung ston par bzhed na ni phyag mthil g.yas par 4—525

nub par 'gyur/ lhar skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni lte bar nub par 'gyur / nyan thos kyi byang chub tu lung ston par bzhed na ni zhal du nub par 'gyur / rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub tu lung ston par bzhed na ni mdzod spur nub hupar 'gyur/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung ston par bzhed na ni gtsug tor du nub par 'gyur ro/ /de nas 'od zer de dag gis bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum du bskor phyab byas te bcom ldan 'das kyi mdzod spur nub bo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa ②kun dga' bos thal mo sbyar te zhus pa/ kha dog sna tshogs stong gis bkra ba ④yi/ /tshogs rnams zhal gyi sgo nas byung gyur pa/ /ji ltar gdugs ni shar bar gyur pa bzhin / /de yis phyogs rnams kun tu snang bar bgyis/ /yang tshigs su bcad de gsol pa/ rgod bral zhum dang rgyags pa spangs pa yirgya sangs rgyas 'gro nang mchog gi rgyur gyur pa/ /rgyal ba dgra thul byed rgyu ma mchis par/ /rtsa lag dung ltar dkar 'dzum ston mi mdzadagye/ /de slad brtan mepa nyid blos dus mkhyen nas3/ /rgyal ba'i dbang po thub pa skyes kyi mchog /nyan par 'tshal ba nyan pa po rnams kyi/ /the tshom skyes pa gsung tshig brtan ⑨pa dang / /dam pa bzang po dag gis bsal skyedu gsol/ /tshwa nyunyechu ri dbang lta bur brtan ⑫pa'i mchog /rdzogs sangs rgyas rnams blo 'bur 'dzum mi ston/ /brtan pa ci slad 'dzum pa ston mdzad pa/ /skye bo phal chen 'di dag de nyan 'tshal/ /kun dga' bo khyod kyis gar mkhan nga la sems mngon par dad par byas nas rdza rnga chen po rdung bar byed pa de mthong ngam/ btsun pa de mthong lags so/ /kun dga' bo gar mkhan de sems bskyed cipa des rang sangs rgyas rnga sgra zhes bya 1—526

bar 'gyur te/ de'i sbyin pa'i chos ni 'di yin te/ nga la sems dad par byas pa gang yin pa'o/ /lha sbyin gyis ma skyes dgra la smras pa/ kho bos ①khyod rgyal srid la bzhag pa yin gyis ⑤khyod kyis kyang kho bo sangs rgyas nyid du skos ③shig /des smras pa/ bcom ldan 'das ni sku gser gyi kha dog tu ④'dug la ⑤re zhig dang por gser gyi kha dog nyid med do/ /des smras pa/ kho bos kyang ⑥gser gyi kha dog tu snang bar bsgyur ༅ro/ /zhes des gser mgar bkug nas smras pa/ kho bo'i lus gser gyis g.yogs shig /des dusmras pa/ 'phags pa gal te tshor ba mnags phod na'o/ /des smras pa/ khyod kyis g.yogs shig dang phod par bya'o/ /des tsan tsu ⑨zhes bya ba'i 'bru mar gyis ⑨ lus byugs nas gser gyi gyim phag gis lus g.yogs 0pa dang de sdug bsngal 8mi bzad pa tsha ba rtsub 8pa yid du mi 'ong ba'i tshor ba nyams su myong ngo / /dge slong rnams kyis bko ka li ka la dris pa/ lha sbyin gang na/ des smras pa/ phyogs che ge mo zhig na gser gyi kha dog tu snang bar sgyur 8ro/ /dge slong rnams phyogs der song ba dang / de rnams kyis tsode sdug bsngal /3gyi tshor bas nyen te/ ku co 'don pa thos nas de rnams bcom ldan 'das kyi 8spyan sngar dong ngo / /dge slong rnams the tshom skyes te the tshom thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa lha sbyin yigaser gyi kha dog don du gnyer bas du sdug bsngal 0mi bzad pa tsha ba rtsub pa yid du mi mchi tsoba'i tshor ba nyams su myong ba la gzigs/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag da ltar gyi 'di 'ba' zhig tu ma zad de/ ji ltar 'di 'das pa'i dus na yang gser gyi zhwa don du gnyer ba'i phyir tshul ma yin pas sdug bsngal tsobar gyur pa de ④1—527

nyon cig /dge slong dag sngon byung ba grong khyer bā rā ṇa sī na khyo lam ring por song ba'i bud med cig yod pa de'i mdun du bya rog cig skad snyan pa ⑨snyan par 'byin nas des smras pa/ bya rog song shig bya rog ②song shig gal te bdag gi khyim thab bde bar 'khor na khyod la dugaser gyi zhwa zhig sbyin no/ /ci tsam na de'i khyim thab de yang bde bar slar 'ongs so/ /bya rog de gser gyi zhwa'i ched du de'i mdun du 'dug nas skad snyan pa ④snyan par phyung ba dang de nas des ⑤de la gser gyi zhwa zhig byin no/ /des de gyon nas phan tshun du lding ba dang ⑥/de gser gyi zhwa'i phyir bya khras mgo bcad do/ /lhas tshigs su bcad de smras pa/don med gzhi dang ldan pa yi/ /nor ni phung bar 'gyur ba ste/ /gang gi mgo la gser yod pa'i/ /bya rog gis ⑦ni phung byed btsal/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis shebaka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus kyi bya rog gang yin pa de ni lha sbyin 'di nyid yin te/ de na yang 'di gser gyi rgyus tshul ma yin pas sdug bsngal spubar gyur to/ /da ⑩ltar yang 'di gser gyi kha dog don mdu phyaganyer ba'i phyir sdug bsngal comi bzad pa tsha ba rtsub tshupa yid du mi 'ong ba'i tshor ba nyams su myong bar gyur to/ /gzhan yang lha sbyin gyis ma skyes dgra la smras pa/ kho bos ni khyod brgyal srid la bzhag gis khyod kyis kyang kho bo sangs rgyas nyid du chug shigatso /des smras pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs kyi mthil la ni 'khor lo'i mtshan gyis mtshan pa'i rtags yod na/ khyod kyi 8rkang pa'i mthil la ni 'khor lo'i mtshan gyis mtshan pa'i rtags med do/ /des smras pa/kho bos kyang rkang pa'i mthil la ni tso'akhor lo'i rtags bsgrub 7par bya'o zhes des lcags mgar rnams bkug nas smras pa/ kho bo'i rkang mthil la 'khor lo 'dri 4—628

nus sam/ de rnams kyis smras pa/ 'phags pa gal te tshor ba mnags ①pod na'o / /des smras pa/ phod kyis gyis shig /de rnams kyis bsams pa/'di mthu dang ldan pa yin pas gal te 'di bzhin du bris khun rdog pas bdag cag srog dang phral ②bar 'gyur ba'i gnas gang yin pa 'di ༅yod do snyam nas/de rnams kyis ⑤cig pa 'bigs su bcug nas smras pa/ 'phags pa rtsig pa'i bu ga ༅'dir rkang pa gnyis chug shig⑦ /des rtsig pa'i bu gar rkang pa gnyis bcug pa dang lcags mgar rnams kyis 'khor lo me'i kha dog tu 'dug par byas nas rkang pa bsregs pa dang / de sdug bsngal dumi bzad pa tsha ba rtsub ⑨pa yid du mi 'ong ba'i tshor ba nyams su myong bar gyur to7/ /dge slong rnams kyis ko ka li ka la dris pa/ lha sbyin gang na/ phyogs ga ge mo zhig na rkang pa'i mthil la 'khor lo'i rtags sgrub skyebo/ /dge slong rnams phyogs der song ba dang de rnams kyis de hu)sdug bsngal rtso)gyi tshor bas nyen cing ku co 'don pa yang 6thos nas de rnams bcom ldan 'das kyi blaspyan sngar dong ngo / /dge slong rnams the tshom skyes nas the tshom thams cad gcod pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/btsun pa lha sbyin rkang pa'i mthil la 'khor lo'i rtags don du gnyer bas sdug bsngal tshemi bzad pa tsha ba rtsub rtsa pa yid du mi mchi ba'i tshor ba nyams su myong bar gyur pa la gzigs/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag da ltar gyi 'di 'ba' zhig tu ma zad de/ ji ltar 'das pa'i dus na yang 'di rkang rjes kyi phyir tshul ma yin pas sdug bsngal 3/bar gyur pa de nyon cig /dge slong dag sngon byung ba gangs can la glang po che zhig yod pa chu 'thung du 'babs pas pode'i phyi bzhin wa zhig kyang babs 0 pa dang / des 0glang po che'i rjes 4wa 529

mthong nas bdag nyid kyi gom pas gzhal bar brtsams te des bsams pa/rjes 'di ni bdag gi ①yin no zhes de mchong zhing ②mchong ②zhing rjes kyi steng du rkang pa ④'jog pa na sdom ⑤dum khye'u ga zhig gi steng du rdeg 'chos par gyur to//⑥lhas tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ mdor na glang chen rkang rjes dang / /blun po khyod rjes mi 'dra yi༅/ /don med blo 'di slongs byas ⑧shig /ngal ba thob par gyur ta re/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus kyi wa gang yin pa de ni lha sbyin 'di nyid yin te/ de na yang 'di rkang rjes kyi phyir tshul ma yin pas sdug bsngal ⑨bar gyur to/ /da ltar yang 'di rkang pa'i tsu) mthil la 'khor lo'i rtags don du gnyer ba'i phyir sdug bsngal skyemi bzad pa tsha ba rtsub 8pa yid du mi 'ong ba'i tshor thab nyams su myong bar ④gyur to/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab na 8bya rgod kyi kluphung po'i ri la gnod sbyin kum bi ra'i chaganas na bzhugs so/ /lha sbyin gyis 8yang ma skyes dgra la smras pa/kho bos khyod ni rgyal srid la bzhag na khyod kyis kho bo sangs rgyas su gzhug ma nus kyis/1—/ da ni kho bos dge sbyong gi ta ma srog dang dbral gyis ṭu khyod kyis sus bsad dam/ gang du bsad pa thum smra 3shig /des smras pa/ de bzhin du gyis shig /ji tsam na dulho phyogs nas 'khrul 'khor gyi sgyu rtsal gyi slob dpon zhig 'ongs nas lha sbyin gyis de bkug nas tsunyesmras pa/ kye slob dpon khyod kyis mi lnga brgyas 'phen pa de lta bu'i skyogs nus sam/ des smras pa/ 'phags pa nus so/ /des de la mu tig gi do shal brgya stong ri ba byin zhing mi stong gi gla yang byin nas smras pa/ gnas gang na bcom ldan 'das bzhugs pa de'i drang thad kyi bya rgod kyi phung po'i ri'i steng der skyogs chos shig /skyogs 'phen pa'i 4—530

mi lnga brgya po de dag kyang 'khod du bcug go/ /gnas gzhan zhig tu nyis brgya lnga bcu 'khod du bcug nas bsgo ba/ khyed cag gal te dge sbyong gau ta ma skyogs kyis ma sod ①na khyed ②kyis sod gcig de'i don du gnas gzhan dang ④gzhan du yang mi rnams 'khod du bcug nas thams cad la bsgo ba/ khyed cag gang gi gor phyedage sbyong gi ta ma 'ongs dang de dag gis sod ༅cig /bdag nyid kyang phyogs gzhan zhig tu 'dug nas 'di rnams kyis shor dang bdag gis bsad ⑦do snyam mo/ /ji tsam na mi lnga brgyas duskyogs 'phang bar brtsams shete smras pa/su'i phyir skyogs 'phang / ji tsam na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das shod na bzhugs pa mthong nas de rnams kyis smras pa/ shes ldan dag bdag cag rang gi srog btang ⑨ ba ni bla'i lha dang mis mchod pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bgrongs 7pa ni de lta ma yin gyis skyogs bor 8ro zhes de rnams kyis skyogs bor nas bya rgod kyi phung po'i ri la phan tshun du rgyu zhing gnas gang zhig nas 0babs na lha sbyin gyis mi mthong bar 'gyur snyam mo/ /de rnams kyis bsam tsu )pa/bcom ldan 'das kyis thugs su chud nas them skas 8shig sprul pa dang / de rnams kyis them skas tsomathong nas 'di snyam du sems te/ shes ldan dag them skas 'di sus btsugs snyam na de ni bcom ldan 'das kyi mthus yin no snyam nas/de rnams kyi ⑩lhag par yang bcom ldan 'das la sems mngon par dad par gyur te them skas de las babs nas bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der dong ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyang de dag gdul ba kho na la ltos tsonas bya rgod phung po'i ri la 'chag cing bzhugs so/ /de nas de rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi ༅zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te chos mnyan pa'i phyir spyan snga na 'dug go/ /1—531

bcom ldan 'das kyis ①de rnams kyi bsam pa dang / bag la nyal ②dang /khams dang / rang bzhin mkhyen chanas gang thos pas 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi so sor rtogs par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i chos bshad pa mdzad pas/ de rnams kyis 'jig ④tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo nyi shu mtho ba ye shes kyi ②rdo rjes bcom nas rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas te bden pa mthong ba dang lan gsum du ched du brjod pas khyached du brjod pa/ btsun pa bdag cag la phas ma bgyis/ mas ma lags/ rgyal pos ma lags/ lha rnams kyis ma lags/ sdug pas ma lags/ rang gi skye bo dang gnyen gyi tshogs kyis ma lags/ sngon gyi 'das pa rnams kyis ma lags/ dge sbyong dang bram ze rnams kyis ma lags pa gang ④lags pa de bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag cag la mdzad de/ dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro dang /④ yi dgas rnams nas ni rkang pa drangs/ lha dang mi rnams su ni rab tu bzhag /'khor ba'i ni mthar ⑨bgyis / khrag dang mchi ma'i rgya mtsho ni bskams/ tshe/ rus pa'i ri bo las ni bsgral tshe / ngan song gi sgo rnams ni bskum skye/ mtho ris dang thar pa'i sgo rnams ni phye/ thog ma med pa'i mdus nas bsags pa'i 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i 1 7rtse mo nyi shu mtho ba ye shes kyi rdo rjes bcom nas rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du bgyis te/ btsun pa bdag cag ni 'phags so/ /mngon par 'phags so/ /bdag cag bcom ldan 'das dang chos dang dge slong gi dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi skyilags kyis/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag cag dge bsnyen du gzung ⑩du gsol/ deng slan chad 0du 8ji srid 'tsho'i bar du srog dang yang bsngos /nga)te skyabs su mchi bar mngon par dad lags so zhes 4—532

gsol nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi ②spyan snga nas bslab ②pa'i gzhi ②lnga rnams blang bar brtsams so/ /'khrul 'khor gyi sgyu ④mal gyi slob dpon yang 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bgrongs ⑤par byed pa yin no snyam du bsams nas/de rnams kyi phyi bzhin 0them skas la ⑦babs nas mu tig gi do shal brgya stong ri ba khyer te bros so/ /lha sbyin ni rdo ba 'phen par dga' bas yang dang yang du lta ba ⑤na ma 'phangs so snyam ste0/ rang nyid kyis ⑩mi lnga brgya po gzhan khrid de bya rgod kyi phung po'i ri la 'dzeg par brtsams pa na/ mi lnga brgya po de 7dag bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga na chos nyan pa comathong ngo / /mthong nas kyang lhag par yang mi bzod pa skyes te phyogs gzhan zhig nas bya rgod kyi phung po'i ri la 'dzegs 8pa dang / ji tsam na 'khrul 'khor gyi slob dpon yang bros par mthong nas/ de rang nyid kyis 'khor lnga brgya dang skyogs 'phang bar brtsams so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa/ nga nyid kyis las tho )tshogs rnyed pa/ rkyen yongs su bsgyur /9)ba/ 'od pa bzhin du nye bar gnas pa/ gdon mi za bar 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i las dag byas shing bsags pas/ nga thunyid kyis cho las byas shing bsags pa dag gzhan su zhig gis so sor myong bar 'gyur snyam du dgongs nas mi lnga brgya po de dag la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /shes ldan dag lha sbyin kun nas dkris pa drag po la gnas nas bya rgod kyi phung po'i ri la 'dzeg gis deng shig /'di dag ni nga'i las yin no/ /de nas mi lnga brgya po de dag bros so/ /lha rnams kyi tsoshes pa mthong ba ni 'og tu 'jug pa yin pas de nas gnod sbyin lag na rdo rjes yi'adi snyam du sems te/ lha sbyin ni bcom ldan 'das bgrongs ( tre pa'i phyir pha rol ( spreganon pa byed do snyam du ()bsams nas/1—533

gnod sbyin kum bi ra gang na ba der song ①ste phyin pa dang / gnod sbyin kum bi ra la 'di skad ces smras so/ /lha sbyin ni bya rgod ②kyi phung po'i ri la skyogs kyis bcom ldan 'das la rdo ba ①'phen par rtsom la/ bcom ldan 'das ni khyod kyi thuganas na bzhugs na⑤/ de la kho bos 'bad de rdo ba bar snang la rdo rjes phye mar brlag khyon gal te ⑦zu mar brlags ⑤pa'i dum bus ⑨bcom ldan 'das kyi steng du 'bab par 'gyur 0gyis/ khyod kyis grogs gyis shig /des smras pa/ bdag yibaka' 8bzhin 'tshal bcom ldan 'das kyis zhuni bla gab med pa na bzhugs ④bzhugs nas ri'i phug tu gshegs so/ /lha sbyin 'khor lnga brgya pos skyogs drangs te bcom ldan 'das la rdo ba 'phangs so/ /gnod sbyin lag na rdo rje'i 8rdo rjes phye mar byas pa las de'i phyed bcom ldan 'das kyi gnas su lhung du cha ba gnod sbyin kum mabi ras legs par ma zin pa ⑩des bsad nas rdo ba'i dum bu yar ba zhig gis bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la rma byung bar gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad de /sprebaka' stsal pa/gang du gnas na las kyis mi rdzi ba'i/ /sa phyogs de ni yod pa ma yin te/ /bar snang nyid min rgya mtsho'i nang min zhing / /ri bo'i phug tu zhugs pa'ang ma yin no/ /gnod sbyin kum bi ra yang dge ba'i sems kyis shi ste shi nas sum bcu rtsa gsum pa'i lha gya nom pa rnams kyi nang du skyes so/ /chos nyid kyis lha'i bu'am lha'i bu mo ni skyes nas ring po ma lon par sems gsum skye bar 'gyur te/gang nas shi 'phos pa dang / gang du skyes pa dang / las gang gis 7yin pa'o//des gnod sbyin las shi 'phos pa dang / sum bcu rtsa gsum pa'i lha gya rnam pa rnams kyi nang du skyes pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la sems mngon par dad 4—534 —

par byas pa ①yin par mthong ste/ de nas sngon gnod sbyin byed ②byed pa'i lha'i bu 'di snyam du sems te/ zhag lon nas bcom ldan 'das la blta ba'i phyir 'gro ba ni bdag gi cha ma yin gyis/ ma la bdag gis zhag ma lon par bcom ldan 'das la blta ba dang bsnyen ①bkur bya ba'i phyir 'gro'o ④snyam nas/ de nas sngon gnod sbyin byed byed pa'i lha'i bu rna cha gdub kor ⑤dri ma med cing g.yo ba thogs pa/ do shal dang se mo dos lus brgyan yinas de nyid kyi mtshan mo lha rnams kyi me tog ut+pa ⑦la dang / pad ma dang / ku mu da ⑧dang / pad ma dkar po dang / man dā ⑨ra ba rnams kyis thu ba bkang ste/ bya rgod kyi phung po'i ri ⑨ thams cad snang ba rgya chen pos gsal bar byas nas bcom ldan 'das la me tog gis gtor nas sh+yi/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar chos mnyan pa'i phyir 'dug go/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i bsam pa dang / bag la nyal dang / khams dang / rang bzhin thugs su chud nas gang thos pas 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi so sor rtogs par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i chos bshad pa mdzad pas sngon gnod sbyin byed byed pa'i lha'i bu 'jig tshogs la 8lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo nyi shu mtho ba ye shes kyi rdo byarjes bcom nas rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum bladu byas te bden pa mthong nas lan gsum du ched du brjod pas ched du brjod pa/btsun pa bdag la phas ma lags/ mas ma lags/ rgyal pos ma lags/lha rnams kyis ma lags/ sdug pas ma lags/ rang gi skye bo dang gnyen gyi tshogs kyis ma lags/ sngon gyi 'das pa rnams kyis ma lags/ dge sbyong dang bram zes ma lags pa gang lags pa de bcom ldan 'das kyis babadag la mdzad de/ khrag dang mchi ma'i rgya mtsho ni bskams8/ rus pa'i ri bo tshulas ni 4—535

bsgral① / ngan song rnams kyi sgo ni bkum/ mtho ris dang thar pa'i sgo rnams ni phye/ lha dang mi rnams su ni bdag rab tu bzhag go/ /yang gsol pa/khyod mthus nyes pa mang ldan mi bzad pa'i②/ /ngan song lam bkag bsod nams mang dupo yi/ /mtho ris 'gro ba phye zhing bdag gis ni/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i lam yang thob par gyur/ /khyod la brten thunas shin tu rnam dag mig /nyes bral dag pa de ring bdag gis thob/ /go 'phang ⑤zhi ba 'phags pa rjes ⑥thob ste/ /sdug bsngal ⑦rgya mtsho'i pha rol rgal lags so/ /'gro bar ⑧lha min lha dang mis mchod pa/ /skye dang rga dang na 'chi bral ba po ⑨/ /srid pa stong du mthong bar rab dka' ba/ /thub pa deng khyod mthong ba'i 'bras bu mchis/ /de nas do yi shal rab 'phyang dga' gyur pa/ /zhabs gnyis la ni mngon par phyag 'tshal nas/ /dgra thub pa ༅la g.yas nas bskor cibyas nas/ /lha yi 'jig rten mngon phyogs mkha' la song / /de nas sngon gnod sbyin byed byed pa'i lha'i bu tshong pa khe spogs rnyed pa lta bu dang / zhing pa lo thog 8legs pa lta bu dang / dpa' bo g.yul ngo borgyal ba lta bu dang / nad pa nad thams cad las yongs su thar ba lta bur 'byor pa gang gis bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar song tsoba'i 'byor pa de nyid kyis rang gi gnas su song ngo / /dge slong rnams nam gyi cha stod dang cha smad la mi nyal bar rnal 'byor la rjes su brtson pas ⑩gnas pa na/ de rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga na ༅snang ba rgya chen po de mthong ngo / /mthong nas tsu)the tshom skyes (7te bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ mdang sum zhu bcom ldan 'das la blta ba'i slad du mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa'am/ lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin nam/4—536

'jig rten skyong ba bzhi mchis lags sam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa / dge slong dag nga la ①blta ba'i phyir 'ongs pa ni mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa yang ma yin/ lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin yang ma yin/ 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi yang ma yin te/ de lta mod kyi lha sbyin nga ②bsad ②pa'i phyir 'bad ④pas bya rgod kyi phung po'i ri las smyogs ⑤kyi rdo 'phangs pa gang yin pa de bar snang 0nyid la gnod sbyin lag na rdo rjes phye mar byas pa de'i phyed nga'i steng du lhung ba gnod sbyin kum bi ras gzung ④nyes pas de des ⑧bsad do/ /nga la sems mngon par dad par byas spunas shi bas sum bcu rtsa gsum pa'i lha gya rnam pa rnams kyi nang du skyes pa yin te/ de mdang sum byanga'i spyan sngar 'ongs nas ngas de la chos bshad de bden pa mthong bar byas nas rang gi gnas su song ba yin no/ /dge slong dag de lta bas na las gcig tu gnag pa rnams kyi rnam par smin pa ni gcig tu gnag pa yin la/ gcig tu dkar ba rnams 2kyi ni gcig tu dkar ba yin /sre/ 'dren nyu)ma rnams kyi hu )ni 'dren tsunyem yin pas/dge slong dag de lta bas na las gcig tu gnag pa klurnams dang 'dren ma rnams ni spangs la/ las gcig tu dkar ba la brtsal bar bya ste/ dge slong dag khyed kyis ⑩de lta bu la bslab 8par bya'o/ /byadage slong rnams the tshom skyes te the tshom thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa btsun pa gnod sbyin kum bi ras bcom ldan 'das kyi slad du bdag nyid yongs su btang ba la gzigs/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag da ltar gyi ⑥ 'ba' zhig tu ma byazad de/ ji ④ltar 'das pa'i dus na yang 'dis nga'i phyir bdag nyid yongs su btang ba de nyon cig /dge slong dag sngon byung 4—537

ba grong khyer bā rā ṇa sī na rgyal po tshangs sbyin zhes bya ba 'byor pa dang / rgyas pa dang / bde ba dang / lo legs pa/ skye bo dang mi mang pos rab tu gang ba na rgyal srid byed du 'jug go/ /de'i tshe grong khyer bā rā ṇa sī dang ha cang yang mi ring ba zhig na yod pa'i bsti gnas rtsa ①ba dang / me tog dang / 'bras bu dang / chu phun sum tshogs pa dang ②/ bya sna tshogs skad 'byin pa zhig na drang srong dka' thub drag po spyod pa chu dang rtsa ③ba dang 'bras bu la longs spyod pa/pags ④pa dang shing shun gyon pa zhig gnas so/ /de'i bste gnas kyi nye ⑤'khor na rngon pa skyozhig ri dgas bsad cing 'tsho bar byed de/ de dus dus ⑦su drang srong de'i gan du 'ong ngo / /drang srong des kyang de la ci nas kyang durngon pa 'dis bdag gi nye ⑨'khor na gnas pa'i ri dgas rnams gsod par mi 'gyur bar byabya ba'i phyir de la skyengal sos nas rtsa 8ba dang 'bras bus 8stobs par byed pas / de gnyis gcig skyel gcig pha dang bu'i 'du shes skyes par gyur te rngon n+tupas ni drang srong la pha zhes tshig tu 'bod do/ /drang srong gis kyang rngon pa la bu zhes 'bod do/ /ji tsam 7dus gzhan zhig na rgyal po tshangs sbyin nang par sngar langs te ri ⑩dgas shor du phyir byung ba des ri dgas shig la mdas 8shi gsor du bsnun ༅pa dang drang srong de'i bsti gnas su zhugs so/ /der yang rgyal pos lcags mdas gnad du bsnun 0 pas shi bar gyur to/ /de nas drang srong de khro ba'i kun nas dkris pas smras pa/ rgyal po khyod ni phung krol spyod pa ngan pa zhig ste / des na ri dgas nga tsol skyabs su 'ongs pa bsad do zhes de skad ces smras pa dang / rgyal po de 0zhe sdang gi ⑥kun nas dkris ④pa la zhen pa'i blos 3blon po rnams la smras pa/ shes ldan dag rgyal po rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang 4—538

bskur ①ba la kha tshas zer ②ba gang yin pa de la chad pa ci ②bcad blon po rnams kyis smras pa/ lha chad pas ④dgum lags mod/ rgyal pos smras pa/ gal te de lta na ②drang srong 'di ngas yongs su spangs so/ /blon po rnams kyis drang srong gsad ⑥par brtsams pa na stes dbang gis rngon pa de yang drang srong de'i nyen ༅'khor na 'dug nas des bsams pa②/ bdag gson ⑨bzhin du drang srong ci'i phyir gsod du gzhug snyam nas/ des g.yul 'gyed par brtsams pa na drang srong cibyos nas ⑩/ dpung chen po'i tshogs kyis de bsad do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus kyi drang srong gang yin pa de ni nga nyid yin no/ /de'i tshe de'i dus kyi rngon pa gang yin pa de ni gnod sbyin kum bi ra 'di nyid yin te/ de na yang 'dis nga'i phyir bdag nyid yongs su btang ngo / /da ltar yang 'dis nga'i phyir bdag nyid yongs su btang ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyi 8zhabs la 6rdo ba'i dum bus rma byung ba khrag 'chad lku du ma btub nas de 8bzhin du 'dzag go/ /sman pa'i rgyal po 'tsho byed bcom ldan 'das kyi snyun brtag tshepa'i phyir dus gsum du spyan sngar 'gro'o/ /rgyal po'i khab na gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs dad pa can dang / yul sna tshogs nas lhags pa'i yang dag pa'i lta ba dang ldan pa nor can dang / tshong dpon dang / ded dpon rnams kyang 'ongs te/ de na kha cig gis smras pa/ 'tsho byed sman 'di ni de la bzang ngo / /gzhan dag gis smras pa/'di ni de bas kyang bzang ngo / /sman pa'i rgyal po 'tsho byed kyis smras pa/'di la mod la gdangs par 'gyur ba'i sman yod mod kyi de ni rnyed par dka'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos smras pa/ 'tsho byed de ci yin/ des smras pa/1—539

tsan dan sa mchog yin no/ /de'i tshe tsan dan sa mchog nyurnyed pa nyid med do/ /ji tsam na tshong pa thuzhig yod pas 'di ltar bdag gis tsan dan sa mchog dus dus su btsongs pas 1ma skyes dgra 'di ni gtum pa rngubarlang ba/ gzu lums can yin pas gal te ma stes te de la tsan dan sa mchog dgos par gyur la/de ma rnyed 3na gdon mi za bar mgo gcod par yang 'gyur ro snyam nas tsan dan sa mchog bsres 4te bzhag pa zhig yod do/ /des sman pa'i rgyal po 'tsho byed kyis ji ltar bcom ldan 'das kyi 7snyan la ni tsan dan sa mchog gis gdangs par 'gyur ro zhes bstan ri pa thos nas des bsams pa/ ma skyes dgra 'di lha sbyin 9gyis rbad nyu pas bcom ldan 'das la zhe 'gras pa'i blo yod de11/ gal te bdag gis bcom ldan 'das la tsan dan sa mchog phul na bdag la gnod pa byed pa'i gnas gang yin pa de yod do sasnya/ma mo/ /yang bsams rdo pa bcom ldan 'das ni lha dang mis mchod pa rta yin pas gal te de'i don du srog dang phral na yang phral du zad/ ma la bdag (5gis bcom ldan 'das la tsan dan sa mchog dbul lo snyam nas/ des 15tsan dan sa mchog khyer te bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar song nas zhabs la gtugs 1 te gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gis bcom ldan 'das la tsan dan sa mchog gis bgyi ba ci tsunamachis pa skyeskyeglo bar chud na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis thugs brtse bar dgongs te 'di bzhes su gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rgya tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo bdag nyid chen po 'di ( nyelas tsan dan sa mchog long shig /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos blangs so/ /de nas tshong pa de medaga' ba dang mgu ba skyes nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo 4—540

bos phyag byas te bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga ①nas song ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das 'dzum pa mdzad do/ /chos nyid kyis gang gi tshe sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams 'dzum pa mdzad pa de'i tshe zhal nas 'od zer sngon po dang /ser po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po dang / btsod ka ②dag byung nas kha cig ni 'og du ②'gro/ kha cig ni steng du 'gro la④/ gang dag 'og tu 'gro ba de snudag ni sems can dmyal ba yang sos dang / thig nag dang / bsdus ⑥'joms dang / ngu 'bod dang / ngu 'bod chen po dang / tsha ba dang /rab tu tsha ba dang / mnar med pa dang / chu bur can dang / chu bur rdol pa can dang / so thams thams ④dang / kyi hud zer ba dudang / a cu cizer ba ⑨ dang / ut+pal skyeltar gas pa dang / pad ma ltar gas pa dang / pad ma ltar gas pa chen por song ste/ sems can dmyal ba tsha ba gang yin pa de dag tu ni bsil bar gyur te 'bab par byed la/ sems can dmyal ba grang ba gang yin pa de dag tu ni dro bar gyur te 'bab par byed do/ /des sems can dmyal ba de dag gi rkyeganod pa'i bye brag dag rgyun gcod par byed cing / de dag 'di snyam du shes ldan dag ci bdag cag 'di nas shi 'phos sam/ 'on te gzhan du skyes snyam du sems so/ /de dag dad pa bskyed 8par bya ba'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyis sprul pa gtong bar mdzad de/ de dag gis sprul pa mthong nas 'di snyam du sems te/ shes ldan dag bdag cag 'di nas shi 'phos pa yang ma yin la gzhan du skyes pa yang ma yin te/ 'di ltar sems can sngon ma mthong ba 'di'i mthus bdag cag gi ciganod pa'i bye brag dag rgyun chad par gyur to snyam mo/ /de nas 8sprul pa la sems mngon par dad par gyur nas 4—541

sems can dmyal ba myong ①bar 'gyur ba'i las de zad par byas nas gang du bden pa dag gi snod du gyur par 'gyur ba'i lha dang mi rnams kyi nang du nying mtshams 0sbyor ba len par byed do/ /gang dag steng du 'gro ba de dag ①rgyal chen bzhi'i ris dang / sum bcu rtsa gsum dang / 'thab bral ba ④dang /dga' ldan dang / 'phrul dga' dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed dang /tshangs ris dang / tshangs pa'i mdun na 'don dang / tshangs 0chen dang /'od chung dang / tshad med 'od dang / 'od gsal dang / dge chung dang /tshad med dge dang / dge rgyas dang / sprin med dang / bsod nams 'phel dang / 'bras bu che ba dang / mi che ba dang / mi gdung ba dang /gya rnam snang 6)dang / shin tu mthong ⑦dang / 'og min gyi dulha rnams kyi nang du song nas mi rtag pa dang / sdug bsngal spub dang / stong pa dang / bdag med pa zhes bya ba'i sgra sgrogs par byed cing tshigs su bcad pa gnyis po/brtsam 6par bya zhing 'byung bar bya/ /sangs rgyas bstan skyel 'jug par bya/ /'dam bu'i khyim la glang chen bzhin/ /'chi bdag sde ni gzhom par bya/ /gang zhig rab tu bag yod par/ /chos 'dul 'di la spyod 'gyur ba/ /skye ba'i 'khor ba rab spangs nas/ /sdug bsngal 8tha mar byed par 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba yang sgrogs so/ /de nas 'od zer de dag gis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams byul nas bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi rjes bzhin rjes bzhin du 'gro ste/ de la gal te bcom ldan 'das 'das 8pa'i las lung ston par bzhed na ni bcom ldan 'das kyi snam logs su nub par 'gyur ro/ /ma 'ongs pa lung ston par bzhed na ni mdun logs su nub par 'gyur/ sems can 1—642

dmyal bar skye bar ①lung ston par bzhed na ni zhabs kyi mthil du nub par 'gyur/dud 'gror skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni rting par nub par 'gyur/ yi dgas su skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni zhabs kyi mthe bor nub par 'gyur/mir skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni pus mor nub par 'gyur/ stobs kyi rgya'akhor los sgyur ba'i rgyal srid lung ston par bzhed na ni phyag g.yon pa'i mthil du nub par 'gyur/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal srid lung ston par bzhed na ni phyag g.yas pa'i mthil du nub par 'gyur/ lhar skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni lte bar nub par 'gyur/ nyan thos kyi byang chub tu lung ston par bzhed na ni zhal du nub par 'gyur/ rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub tu 3lung ston par bzhed na ni mdzod spur nub par 'gyur/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub gelung ston par bzhed na ni gtsug tor du nub par 'gyur ro/ /de nas 'od zer de dag gis bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bsko ra 5ba byas nas mdzod spur nub par gyur to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos nethal mo sbyar te/ bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ kha dog sna tshogs stong gis 7bkra ba yi/ /tshogs rnams zhal gyi sgo nas byung gyur pa/ /ji ltar gdugs ni shar bar gyur pa bzhin/ /de yis phyogs rnams kun du snang bar bgyis / /yang tshigs su bcad de gsol pa/ rgod bral zhum dang rgyags pa spangs pa yi /sangs 1rgyas 'gro nang mchog gi rgyur gyur pa/ /rgyal ba dgra thul byed rgyu ma mchis par/ /rtsa lag dung ltar dkar 'dzum ston mi ma/dzad/ /de slad brtan skyepa nyid blos dus mkhyen nas/ /rgyal ba'i dbang po thub pa skyes kyi mchog /nyan par 'tshal ba nyan pa po rnams kyi/ /the tshom skyes pa gsung tshig brtan nyu1pa 4—543

dang / /dam pa bzang po dag gis bsal ①du gsol/ /tshwa ②chu ri rgyal lta bur brtan ③pa'i mchog /rdzogs sangs rgyas rnams blo ④bur 'dzum mi ston/ /brtan ⑤pa ji slad 'dzum pa ston mdzad pa/ /skye bo phal chen yi'adi dag de nyan 'tshal / /kun dga' bo de de bzhin te/ de de bzhin no/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni rgyu med rkyen med par 'dzum pa mi mdzad de/ kun dga' bo khyod kyis de bzhin gshegs pa la tshong pas sems mngon par dad par byas nas tsan dan sa mchog phul ba gang yin pa de mthong ngam/ btsun pa mthong lags so/ /kun dga' bo tshong pa de dge ba'i rtsa ba dang / sems bskyed ༅pa dang / sbyin pa'i chos yongs su btang ba des rang sangs rgyas tsan dan can ⑧zhes bya bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i sbyin pa'i chos ni 'di yin te/ nga rtsal sems dad par byas pa gang yin pa'o/ /'on kyang khrag de 'chad tsodu ma btub nas de bzhin du 'dzag go/ /'tsho byed kyis smras pa/ da nyunyeni bud med gzhon nu'i 'o mas gdab 'tshal lo/ /dge slong rnams kyis bud med gzhon nu ci 'dra ba nyu)ma shes nas/ des smras pa/bu thon bu btsas pa gang yin pa de ni bud nyunyemed gzhon nu 'dod de skye/ de'i 'o ma gang yin pa de ni bud med gzhon nu'i 'o ma zhes bgyi'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos lha sbyin dang / lha sbyin gyi phyogs ma gtogs par 'khor bzhi po dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen tsodang / dge bsnyen tsom dang / rgyal po'i khab na gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs phal cher la yang bsgo nas thams cad kyis bud med gzhon nu'i 'o ma btsal bar brtsams so/ /'khor bzhi po dang skye bo'i tshogs rnams tshol ba na de rnams kyis thabs yod yod ⑩kyis 4—544

bgegs ①byed do/ /ji tsam na rgyal po'i khab na bu thon bu btsas pa'i bud med gzhon nu 'o ma nyung ste rang gi bu yang 'o mas mi ngoms na gzhan la sbyin du lta ga la yod pa zhig 'dug pa des ji ltar bcom ldan 'das la bud med gzhon nu'i 'o ma'i dgos pa byung ba thos nas des bsams pa/ gal te phul na ni bdag gi ②bu nyam chung bas cha'o ma med na 'chi bar 'gyur la nyes dmigs de 'ba' zhig ④tu ma zad kyi gzhan 'di yang yod de/ lha sbyin bcom ldan 'das la yun ring po nas phyir rgol ba dgrar gyur pa yin te/ des rbad ④pa ni rgyal po ma skyes dgra yin / lha sbyin gyi phyogs ni 'uko ka li ka dang / khan da drab bya dang / ka ti ma thor ka ti gyi dang / rgya mtshos 3byin yin pas 'di dag gis kyang bdag khyagadon mi za bar bsad byapar 'gyur ro snyam mo/ /yang bsams pa/ bdag bsad hupa dang bu dang bral ba ni bla'i lha dang mis mchod pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das snyun gyis 'o brgyal 25ba'i tshor ba sku nyams su brtar skyonas des na nyu) rgyal po'i khab na gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs thams cad 'khrugs par gyur pa ni de chelta ma yin gyichu/ ma la bdag gis ma'o ma khyer la 'gro'o snyam ste/ de bcom ldan 'das la sems shin tu dad pa 8byas nas snod gsar skyepar 'o ma bzhos te/bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song nas phyin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas du te 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das la du pho'atsho byed kyis bud med gzhon nu'i 'o ma bstan ( )par bdag gis 'tshal na/ bdag rjes su gzung duba'i slad du bud med gzhon nu'i 'o ma 'di bzhes su gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo bsam pa bzang po can gyi bu mo 'di 4wa 545

las 'o ma long shig /des blangs pa dang des bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga nas song ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis ①'dzum pa mdzad do/ /chos nyid kyis gang gi tshe sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams 'dzum pa mdzad pa de'i tshe zhal nas 'od zer sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po dag byung nas/kha cig ni 'og tu 'gro/ /kha cig ni steng du 'gro la/ gang dag 'og tu 'gro ba de dag ni sems can dmyal ba yang sos dang / thig nag dang / bsdus 'joms rgyadang / ngu 'bod dang / ngu 'bod chen po dang / tsha ba dang /rab tu tsha ba dang / mnar med pa dang / chu bur can dang / chu bur rdol dang / so thams thams dang / kyi hud zer zudang / a chu zer skyidang /ut+pal skyiltar gas pa dang / pad ma ltar gas pa dang / pad ma ltar gas pa chen por song ste/ sems can dmyal ba tsha ba gang yin pa de dag tu ni skyobasil bar gyur te 'bab par byed la/ sems can dmyal ba grang ba gang yin pa de dag tu ni dro bar gyur te 'bab par byed do/ /des sems can dmyal ba de dag gi gnod pa'i bye brag dag rgyun gcod par byed cing / de dag 'di snyam du shes ldan dag ci bdag cag 'di nas shi 'phos sam/ 'on te gzhan du skyes snyam du sems so/ /de dag dad pa bskyed ⑦ par bya ba'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyis dusprul pa gtong bar mdzad de/ de dag gis sprul pa mthong nas 'di snyam du sems te shes ldan dag bdag cag 'di nas shi 'phos pa yang ma yin la/gzhan du skyes pa yang ma yin te/ 'di ltar sems can sngon ma mthong ba 'di'i mthus bdag cag gi ⑨gnod pa'i bye brag dag ②rgyun chad par gyur to snyam mo/ /1—546

de dag sprul pa la sems mngon par dad par gyur nas/ sems can dmyal ba myong bar 'gyur ba'i las de zad par byas nas gang du bden pa dag gi snod du gyur par 'gyur ba'i ༅lha dang mi rnams kyi nang du nying mtshams ②sbyor ba ③len par byed do// //'dul ba gzhi༄/ bam po brgya rtsa ⑤gsum pa/ gang dag steng du 'gro ba de dag ni rgyal chen bzhi'i ris dang / sum bcu rtsa gsum dang / 'thab bral dang / dga' ldan dang / 'phrul dga' dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed dang / tshangs ris dang / tshangs pa'i mdun na 'don dang / tshangs chen dang / 'od chung dang / tshad med 'od dang / 'od gsal dang /dge chung dang / tshad med dge dang / dge rgyas dang / sprin med dang /bsod nams 'phel dang / 'bras bu che ba dang / mi che ba dang / mi gdung ba dang / gya nom snang gyedang / shin tu mthong dang / 'og min gyi lha rnams kyi nang du song nas mi rtag pa dang / sdug bsngal ⑦ba dang / stong pa dang / bdag med pa zhes bya ba'i sgra sgrogs par byed cing / tshigs su bcad zupa gnyis po/ brtsam hupar bya zhing 'byung bar bya/ sangs rgyas bstan bol 'jug par bya/ /'dam bu'i khyim la glang chen bzhin/ /'chi bdag sde ni gzhom par bya/ /gang zhig rab tu bag yod par/ /chos 'dul 'di la spyod 'gyur ba/ /skye ba'i 'khor ba yirab spangs nas/ /sdug bsngal tsotha mar byed par 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba yang sgrogs par byed do/ /de nas 'od zer de dag gis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams byul nas bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi ④rjes bzhin rjes bzhin ④du song ste/ de la gal te bcom ldan 4—547
