rkyen yongs su bsgyur ba/ 'od pa bzhin du nye bar gnas pa/ gdon mi za bar 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i las dag byas shing bsags pas nga nyid kyis las byas shing bsags pa dag gzhan su zhig gis so sor myong bar 'gyur①/ las byas shing bsags ②pa dag ni phyi rol gyi sa'i khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur zhes bya ba nas/ lus can dag la 'bras bur 'gyur zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /gdon mi za bar lha sbyin gyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i dge 'dun 'byed par 'gyur ro/ /rgyu lngas na dge 'dun bye bar mi 'gyur te/ re zhig dang por sangs rgyas 'jig rten du 'byung ba'i tshe dge 'dun bye ②bar mi 'gyur te/ kye ma'o grogs po dag sangs rgyas 'jig rten du 'byung ④zhes grag go zhes bya ba'i ⑤'jig rten de la phyogs pas so/ /ston pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas ⑥dge 'dun bye ⑦bar mi 'gyur te/ gang la la zhig 'di skad du nga ⑧nyid ston pa yin no zhes zer na de la gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das zhal bzhugs 0shing 'tsho la gzhes ⑨ pa de'i tshe ⑫khyod gar song zhes brjod par zad pas so/ /lta ba'i nyes pa dang / tshul khrims kyi 8nyes pa ma byung ba'i tshe dang /nyan thos zung mchog tu ma bstan pa de'i tshe 'dage 'dun bye 8bar mi 'gyur te/de 8ci'i phyir zhe na/ dge 'dun bye ba gdon mi za bar nyan thos zung gis sdum par ⑨byed pas so/ /mtshams ⑩ma bcad pa na dge 'dun bye tsobar mi 'gyur te/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ mtshams yikyi nang du dge 'dun 'byed par 0 'gyur gyi mtshams 0kyi phyi rol du ni ma yin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 'di snyam du dgongs te/ nga'i 'dage slong gi dge 'dun skyon med pa las tshul khrims kyi skyon dang lta ba'i skyon gyi skyon byung ste/ tshul khrims kyi skyon ni ka zhulan da ④ka'i 4—597

bu bzang byin ①las byung ngo / /lta ba'i skyon yang dge slong 'chi ltas kyis phyung bas gdon mi za bar lha sbyin gyis dge 'dun 'byed par 'gyur gyis/ ma la nga rgyal po'i khab tu dbyar bzhugs par dam bca'o snyam mo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 'di snyam du dgongs te/ slob pa dang mi slob pa'i gang zag rnams dang /thabs cig ②rgyal po'i khab tu gshegs na/ lha sbyin gyis dge 'dun gyi dbyen ②bya bar mi nus kyis/ ma la nga so so'i skye bo'i ④dge ba'i gang zag rnams dang thabs cig ⑤'gro'o snyam ste༅/ mnyan yod du ji tsam bzhed ⑦kyi bar du bzhugs nas rim gro byed pa tshe dang ldan pa sgra can 0zin dang / dge slong lnga brgya dang thabs cig tu 0rgyal po'i khab gang na ba der rgyu tsu) zhing gshegs te/rim 0gyis rgyu 8zhing gshegs pa na rgyal po'i khab tu byon to// //'dul ba gzhi3)/ bam po brgya rtsa thostelnga pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab 'od ma'i tshal bya ka lan da ④ka gnas par dbyar bzhugs ⑩par zhal gyis bzhes so/ /de'i tshe mu ge nyam nga ba dgon pa slong ṇimo pas zas rnyed par dka' ba ⑫ byung ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag ying dbyar gyi zla ba gsum po 'di la nang du yang dag par 'jog sum̐ )par bzhed kyis/ bsod (7snyoms stobs pa dang /gso sbyong de nyid kyi tshe ma gtogs par 'dage slong ༷su yang nga'i 0spyan sngar ma 'ongs bla shig /dge slong gi dge 'dun gyis kyang khrims su bcas pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag dbyar gyi zla ba gsum po 'di la bsod 4)snyoms stobs pa dang /gso sbyong de nyid kyi tshe ma gtogs par 0bcom ldan 'das la blta ⑥ba'i phyir bdag cag su yang 'gro bar mi bya'o zhes bcas so/ /de'i tshe tshe dang ldan pa shā ⑥4—598

ri'i bu dang / mod gal gyi bu ①gnyis ni lho phyogs kyi ri la dbyar gnas par dam bcas so/ /lha sbyin gyis chazla ba gsum du dge slong gi dge 'dun la chos gos dang / bsod ②snyoms dang / gnas mal dang / nad kyi rkyen sman gyi yo byad rnams kyis bstabs te zla ba gsum 'das pa dang / des dge slong rnams la smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag dge sbyong gi ta ma ni nyan thos rnams la 'di skad ces dge slong dgon pa pa nyid kyis ni dag pa dang / grol ba dang /nges par 'byung ba dang / bde ba dang sdug bsngal ba ④las 'da' ba dang /bde ba dang sdug bsngal ⑤las 'das pa yang thob par 'gyur ro/ /bsod rjosnyoms pa nyid dang / phyag dar khrod pa nyid dang / chos gos gsum pa nyid dang / bla gab ④med pa nyid kyis ⑧ni dag pa dang / grol ba dang / nges par 'byung ba dang / bde ba dang sdug bsngal las 'da' ba dang /⑨ bde ba dang 0sdug bsngal las 'das pa thob par 'gyur ro zhes chos 'chad kyis/ tshe dang ldan pa dag gang su dag brtul 7zhugs kyi gzhi tsolnga po 'di dag mi 'dod pa dang / mi bzod pa dang / yid la mi 'bab pa de ni dge sbyong gau ta ma las ring du 'gyur/ thag ring du 'gyur gyis de tshul shing long shig ces byas pa dang / dge slong lnga brgyas tshul shing blangs te lha sbyin stan tilas langs te song ba'i rjes bzhin rjes ④bzhin du dge slong lnga brgya 'brang ngo / /tshe dang ldan pa sgra can tsozin sgo na 'dug pa des de dag lha sbyin gyi rjes bzhin rjes bzhin ⑩du 'brang ba mthong nas des smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag ci'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas spangs te sdig pa 'dod pa 'di'i 0rjes bzhin rjes bzhin du 8'brang / de rnams kyis ⑩smras pa/4—599

tshe dang ldan pa sgra can ①zin mu ge'i dgon pa nyam nga ba 'di 'dra ②ba byung ba ①na/bcom ldan 'das ni mi snang ba na bzhugs ④te/ bdag cag lha sbyin gyi ⑤mthus srog dang ma bral mod/ gal te lha sbyin gyis zla ba gsum du dge slong gi dge 'dun ma gsos par gyur na/ dge slong gcig yikyang gson por mi 'gyur ro/ /gang gi tshe lha sbyin gyis ⑦de bzhin gshegs pa'i nyan thos kyi dge 'dun mthun pa phye ba de'i tshe sa chen po 'di g.yos par gyur/ skar nimada' lhung ⑨/ phyogs rnams dmar por gyur/ bar snang la lha rnams rnga'i sgra 'byin nges pa la ma zhugs pa rnams nges pa la mi 'jug /'bras bu mi 'thob/ 'dod chags dang bral bar mi 'gyur/ zag pa rnams zad par mi 'gyur/ lung mi 'bog⑩/mi klog /mi 'don/ mdo sde dang / 'dul ba dang / chos mngon pa 'dzin pa dang / dgon pa pa rnams mdo sde dang / 'dul ba dang / chos mngon pa dang ⑩/ dgon pa 8sems pa la rab tu sbyor bar mi byed/ nyan thos kyi byang chub kyi sa bon skyed par mi byed cing / rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub kyi ma yinatso/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi ma yin no//lha dang mir bcas pa'i 'gro ba yang 'khrugs par gyur to/ /stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams na chos kyi 'khor lo rgyun chad de/ sems can gyi rgyud la mi 'byung ngo / /tshe dang ldan pa shā ④ri'i bu dang / mod gal gyi bus bsams pa/ ci'i phyir sa chen po 'di g.yos par gyur snyam mo/ /dgra bcom pa rnams ni tsobasams ⑩par shes pa mthong bar ⑩mi 'jug pas de gnyis kyis bsam 8pa la zhugs na/ lha sbyin gyis yibacom ldan 'das kyi du nyan thos kyi dge 'dun phye bar mthong nas de gnyis 'di snyam du sems te/ song la bcom ldan 4—600

'das kyi khyonyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang ②slar sdums bya'o snyam mo/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa shā ③ri'i bu dang / mod gal gyi bu chen po gnyis kyis byadabyar gyi zla ba gsum po dag 'das nas chos gos byas pa dang ldan/ chos gos zin pa dang ldan nas chos gos dang lhung bzed thogs te/ rgyal po'i khab gang na ba der rgyu zhing dong nas rim gyis rgyu zhing dong ba dang rgyal po'i khab tu phyin to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa shā ⑤ri'i bu dang / mod gal gyi bus chos gos dang lhung bzed mkhos su phab nas rkang pa gnyis bkrus te bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der dong ngo / /de'i tshe tshe dang ldan pa sgra can yizin sgo na 'dug go/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa sgra can rtsizin gyis tshe dang ldan pa shā ⑤ri'i bu la 'di skad ces smras so/ /mkhan po lha sbyin gyis bcom ldan 'das kyi 0nyan thos kyi dge 'dun phye'o / /des smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa bdag cag don 'di kho na'i phyir 'ongs kyis/ khyod ⑩sems las chung 7ngur mdzod cigatso /slar sdums bya'o zhes smras nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar dong ste lhags nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te phyogs gcig tu 0'khod do/ /phyogs gcig 8tu 'khod nas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa shā 8ri'i bu dang / mod gal gyi bus 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bdag cag de bzhin gshegs pa'i nyan thos kyi dge 'dun bye ⑩ba slar sdums bgyid du mchi'o⑩//bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ shā tsori'i bu dang mod gal gyi bu dag legs so legs so/ /gang zhig de bzhin gshegs pa'i nyan thos kyi dge 'dun bye ba slar sdums byed pa de ni bsod yinams mang po tshad med cing grangs med pa skyed par 'gyur ro/ /dper na 'ga' zhig gi ②skra dum bu brgyar gtubs 0pa 1—601

'phro dang 'phror sbyor bar byed pa de bzhin du gang zhig /de bzhin gshegs pa'i nyan thos kyi dge 'dun bye ba slar sdums byed na de ni bsod ①nams mang po tshad med cing grangs med pa skyed par ②'gyur ro/ /shā ②ri'i bu dang mod gal gyi bu ④gang zag bzhi po 'di dag ni tshangs pa'i bsod ⑤nams skyed par 'gyur ro/ /bzhi gang zhe na gang zag gang zhig sngon mi bzhugs pa'i sa phyogs su / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung gi mchod rten gnas par byed pa 'di ni tshangs pa'i bsod yinams skyed pa'i gang zag dang po yin te/ bskal par mtho ris rnams su dga' bar 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang gang zag gang zhig sngon med pa'i sa phyogs su phyogs bzhi'i dge slong gi ⑦dge 'dun gyi gtsug dulag khang byed du 'jug pa 'di ni tshangs pa'i bsod ⑨nams skyed pa'i gang zag gnyis pa yin te/ bskal par mtho ris rnams su dga' bar 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang gang zag gang zhig de bzhin gshegs pa'i nyan thos kyi dge 'dun bye ⑩ba slar sdums byed pa yi'adi ni tshangs pa'i bsod tsonams skyed pa'i gang zag gsum pa yin te/ bskal par mtho ris rnams su dga' bar 'gyur ro④/ /gzhan ④yang gang zag gang zhig byams pa dang ldan pa'i sems 'khon ④med pa/'gran tho9zla med pa/ gnod pa med pa/ yangs pa rgya chen por gyur pa/tshad med pa/ shin tu bsgoms pas phyogs gcig 0tu mos te khyab par byas nas rdzogs par byas te gnas shing de bzhin du gnyis pa dang / de bzhin du gsum pa dang / de bzhin du bzhi pa dang / bla dang / 'og dang / thad kur rnam pa thams cad du thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'jig rten 'di byams pa dang ldan pa'i sems 'khon 8med pa/ 'gran ⑩zla med pa/ gnod pa med pa/1—602

yangs pa/ rgya chen por gyur pa/ tshad med pa/ shin tu bsgoms pas mos te khyab par byas nas rdzogs par byas te gnas pa dang / de bzhin du snying rje dang / dga' ba dang / btang snyoms dang ldan pa'i sems 'khon ①med pa/'gran ⑤zla med pa/ gnod pa med pa/ yangs pa/ rgya chen por gyur pa/tshad med pa/ shin tu bsgoms pas phyogs gcig ②tu mos te khyab par byas nas rdzogs par byas te gnas shing de bzhin du gnyis pa dang / de bzhin du gsum pa dang / de bzhin du bzhi pa dang / bla dang / 'og dang / thad kur rnam pa thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'jig rten 'di btang snyoms dang ldan pa'i sems 'khon ④med pa/ 'gran ⑤zla med pa/ gnod pa med pa/yangs pa/ rgya chen por gyur payi/ tshad med pa shin tu bsgoms pas mos te/khyab par byas nas rdzogs par byas te/ gnas pa 'di ni tshangs pa'i bsod ⑦nams skyed pa'i gang zag bzhi pa yin te/ bskal par mtho ris rnams su dga' bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa shā ②ri'i bu dang / mod gal gyi bu bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par dga' ste rjes su yi rangs spunas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga nas chas 7te lha sbyin gang na ba der dong ngo / /de'i tshe lha sbyin lho phyogs kyi ri la ko ka li ka ni de'i 0g.yas tsos bzhag /khaṇa ḍa drab bya ni g.yon du bzhag nas sangs rgyas ltar 'chos shing tso'achad pa na/ lha sbyin gyis ⑫tshe dang ldan pa shā 8ri'i bu dang / mod gal gyi bu gnyis rgyang ring po kho na nas mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang bsams pa/ bdag gis 8nyan thos chen po dag kyang dbang du byas pas da ⑩ni bdag thams cad mkhyen pa yin no snyam nas/1—603

ko ka li ka dang / khaṇa ḍa drab bya la longs shig longs shig /ces gru phugs byas pa dang / de gnyis kyis bsams pa/ bdag cag gis 'di ltar 'di dge 'dun 'byed pa'i grogs byas pa de nyid bdag cag gis nyes te/ 'di mthu ①dang ldan pa yin pas gal te bdag cag brdegs na ②gdon mi za bar 'chi bar 'gyur gyis ldang ngo snyam nas de gnyis langs pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu ni g.yas phyogs su 'dug go/ /tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po ni g.yon phyogs su 'dug go/ /de nas lha ②sbyin gyis tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu la smras pa/ shā ri'i bu nga rgyab na ④bugs mi bde ste re zhig de bsal gyis khyod dge slong rnams la chos kyi gtam spobs ⑤par gyis shig⑥ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus kyang ⑦mi smra bas lha sbyin la khas blangs so/ /de nas lha sbyin bla gos bzhi bltab tu bting / snam sbyar bltab ⑧ste sngas su bcug nas glo g.yas pa phab ste gnyid log pa las tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus ji ltar lus gan rkyal gyis sngur ba'i sgra 'byin cing 'dug pa de lta bur byin gyis brlabs so/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus dge slong rnams la smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag ston pa lus gan rkyal gyis sdur cing gnyid log pa'i gnas skabs la ltos0/ de nas tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po 'khor rnams skyo ba skyed cig /de nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po ji ltar sems mnyam par bzhag na ⑩shar phyogs kyi steng gi nam mkha' la mngon par 'phags nas spyod lam rnam pa bzhi byed de/ 'chag pa dang / 'greng ba dang / 'dug pa dang /nyal bar byed do/ /me'i ting nge 'dzin la'ang 7snyoms par 'jug ste/ me'i 4—604

ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs pa na/ tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po'i lus las 'od zer sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang /dkar po dang / btsod ①ka dang / shel gyi kha dog dag 'byin par byed do/ /cho 'phrul zung du yang ston par byed de/ lus kyi smad nas ②me 'bur bar byed cing / lus kyi stod nas chu grang mo'i rgyun 'bebs par byed do/ /lus kyi stod nas me 'bar bar byed cing / lus kyi smad nas chu grang mo'i rgyun 'bebs par byed pa de lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /shar phyogs la ji lta ba bzhin du lho phyogs dang / nub phyogs dang / byang ③phyogs su ④yang de bzhin te/ phyogs bzhir rdzu 'phrul gyi cho ⑤'phrul rnam pa bzhi bstan nas rdzu 'phrul gyi mngon par 'du byed pa de dag bsdus te stan bshams pa nyid la 'dug pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos dge slong rnams skyo ba bskyed do / /de nas tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus dge slong yirnams kyis gang thos na lha sbyin spong bar 'gyur ba de lta bu'i chos bshad nas yang ⑦smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag khyed cag las gang dag ston pa la dga' ba de dag ni longs shig 'dong ngo zhes tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu dang / mod gal gyi bu gnyis chas pa na dge slong de rnams kyang de'i rjes bzhin rjes bzhin du ⑧'brang ngo / /ko ka li kus lha sbyin bslang ba/ longs longs nyan thos chen po dag gis khyod kyi 'khor phrogs 0so/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa shā 0ri'i bu 'di snyam du sems te/ gal te lha sbyin gyis ⑩'khor ma mthong bar khrid na khrag dron du skyugs nas 'chi bar 'gyur ba'i gnas gang yin pa 'di yod kyis/ mdor na mthong ba kho nar byas la bkri'o ④snyam nas de dag dal gyis 'gro ba'i spyod lam gyis tsodage slong gi dge 4—605

'dun dang lhan cig dong ba dang ①/ lha sbyin kun nas dkris ②pa drag pos mig sdog ③cing bsnyags pa las tshe dang ldan pa shā ④ri'i bus 'obs mchog tu 'jigs su rung ba sa'i gting mi ⑤snang ba zhig sprul pa dang lha sbyin ko ka li ka dang / khaṇa ḍa drab bya dang / ka ti mo ra ka ti gyi dang / rgya mtshos byin rnams dang lhan cig 'obs de'i mthar ⑥kun du bskor bar brtsams pa na rgal ma nus nas des bsams pa/ 'khor mi 'thob par ma zad tshul ma yin pas ⑦sdug bsngal bar 'gyur ro snyam du bsams nas slar log go/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ⑧ri'i bu dang / mod gal gyi bus 0kyang dge slong gi dge 'dun khrid nas bcom ldan 'das gang tshun ba der dong ngo / /de nas dge slong de rnams bdag cag gis bcom ldan 'das yon tan tshad med pa dang ldan pa spangs layi/ lha sbyin sdig pa can la rten pa ci tha tshig ces 'gyod pa skyes/ yid la gcags 7pa skyes/yul yul por byas/ phrag pa 4)bcum/ mgo smad de bcom ldan 'das kyi 8spyan sngar dong ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi 8thugs kyis dge slong de rnams kyi sems mkhyen ⑩nas dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag khyed tso'ongs pa legs so/ /rab tu byung ba legs so/ /khyed kyis mi'i rnyed pa ni legs par rnyed pa yin te/ brgya lam na lan 'ga' 'phags pa'i gnas su skye ba dang / dbang po ma tshang ba tsom yin pa dang / glen pa ma yin pa dang /lug ltar lkugs ⑩pa ma yin pa dang / lag brda ⑥ byed pa ma yin zhing legs par smras pa dang / nyes par smras pa rnams kyis 0chos kyi don shes par nus/brgya lam na lan 'ga' de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams 'jig rten du 'byung / brgya lam na lan phye'aga' de 4wa 606

bzhin gshegs ①pas gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba 'jig rten la chos bshad pa snang ngo / /dge slong dag de lta bas na rnyed par dka' ②ba bas kyang shin du dka' ②ba ni 'di yin te/ 'di lta ste 'phags pa'i gnas su skye ba dang /dbang po ma tshang ba ma yin pa dang / glen pa ma yin pa dang / lug ltar lkugs ④pa ma yin pa dang / lag brda ⑤byed pa ma yin zhing legs par smras pa dang nyes par ⑨smras pa rnams kyis ④chos kyi don shes par nus pa'o/ /da ltar 'jig rten du ston pa de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan padu/ bde bar gshegs pa/'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i spub lo sgyur ⑩ba bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das nga byung ༅zhing chos bshad pa 8nye bar zhi bar 'gyur ba/ yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur ba / mngon par byang chub par 'gyur ba/ bde bar gshegs pas rab tu gsungs pa 'di lta ste/ 'di yod pas 'di 'byung la/ 'di skyes pas 'di skye ba / 'di lta ste ma rig pa'i rkyen gyis 'du byed/ 'du byed kyi rkyen gyis rnam par shes pa/ rnam par shes pa'i rkyen gyis ming dang gzugs/ ming dang gzugs kyi rkyen gyis tsu)skye mched drug /skye mched drug gi rkyen gyis reg pa/reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba/ tshor ba'i rkyen gyis bsred pa/ sred ④pa'i rkyen gyis len pa/ len pa'i rkyen gyis srid pa/ srid pa'i rkyen gyis skye ba/ skye ba'i rkyen gyis rga shi dang / mya ngan dang / smre sngags 'don pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba dang 'khrugs ⑩pa rnams 'byung bar 'gyur te/sdug bsngal gyi phung po chen po 'ba' zhig po 'di 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /'di lta 4—607

ste 'di med pas 'di mi 'byung la/ 'di 'gags pas 'di 'gag ①par 'gyur ba 'di lta ste ma rig pa 'gags pas 'du byed 'gag /'du byed 'gags pas rnam par shes pa 'gag /rnam ②par shes pa 'gags ③pas ming dang gzugs 'gag /ming dang gzugs 'gags pas skye mched drug 'gag /skye mched drug 'gags pas reg pa 'gag /reg pa 'gags pas tshor ba 'gag/tshor ba 'gags pas sred pa 'gag /sred pa 'gags pas len pa 'gag /len pa 'gags pas srid pa 'gag /srid pa 'gags ④pas skye ba 'gag⑤ /skye ba 'gags pas rga shi dang / mya ngan dang / smre sngags 'don pa dang /sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba dang / 'khrugs ⑥pa rnams 'gag par 'gyur te/ sdug bsngal gyi phung po chen po 'ba' zhig po 'di 'gag par 'gyur ro / /dge slong dag de lta bas na bdag gi don dang / gzhan gyi don dang / gnyi ga'i 3don la rjes su lta ba rnams kyis ni 'di la rab tu bslab par bya ste/ci nas kyang rab tu byung ⑧ba don yod pa dang / 'bras bu dang bcas pa dang /bde ba skyed pa dang / rnam par smin pa bde ba dang / gang dag gis chos gos dang / bsod ༅snyoms dang / gnas mal dang / nad kyi rkyen sman gyi yo byad rnams byayongs su longs spyod pa de dag la ci nas kyang de dag gis phan btags pa'i 'bras bu shin tu che ba dang / phan yon che ba dang / gzi brjid ⑪che ba dang / yangs shing rgya 8che bar 'gyur ba de ltar dge slong dag khyed kyis bslab par bya'o/ /gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong de rnams tu)'ongs pa legs so zhes bya ba dang rab tu tsobyung ba legs so zhes bya ba gsungs pa de'i thostetshe de rnams kyi zhum pa dang / mi dga' ⑩ba dang / 'gyod pa dang /4wa 608

rnam par 'gyod pa dang / yid la gcags ①pa gang yin pa de dag thams cad kyi thams cad du bral bar gyur to/ /de nas dge slong gzhan rnams the tshom skyes te the tshom thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ②la zhus pa/btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis phrin ②las ci zhig mdzad na/ phrin ④las de'i ⑤rnam par smin pas bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos kyi dge 'dun bye bar gyur lags / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyis yisngon gyi tshe rabs gzhan rnams su phrin ⑦las byas shing bsags ⑧pa dang tshogs rnyed pa dag ni zhes bya ba nas/ lus can dag la 'bras bur 'gyur zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba ⑨bsti gnas rtsa ba dang / lo ma dang / me tog dang / 'bras bu dang / chu phun sum tshogs pa4) / shing sna tshogs kyis 0mdzes par byas pa/bya'i tshogs du mas bsten pa gzhan zhig na drang srong lnga brgya'i gtso bo drang srong zhig gnas so/ /ji tsam na drang srong gzhan zhig ljongs rgyu zhing song ba na bsti gnas der phyin na drang srong des de la bkur sti legs par ma byas pas de mi bzod pa skyes nas de'i 'khor 'byed par byed de8/ drang srong sdig pa 'dod pa 'di cung zad kyang mi shes na ci ste de'i drung du 8'dug /tshur kho bo dang lhan cig 'dong 'kho bos khyed 8mngon par shes pa lnga rnams la rab tu dgod do zhes des de rnams la yiphye bas drang srong de'i gdams ngag nyan du mi btub bo/ /drang srong des ⑩bsams pa/ sdig pa byed pa tso'adis bdag gi drang srong 'di rnams phye'o snyam nas/ des de la bzhams te smra bar brtsams pa/ tshe dang ldan pa 'khor 'byed par ma byed cig /'di ni drang srong gi chos ma yin no/ /1—609

'on kyang de 'byed bzhin te 'dug tu ma btub nas drang srong de yid mi bde zhing thabs cig ①sems shing gnas so/ /sangs rgyas rnams 'byung ba med pa na 'jig rten du rang sangs rgyas dman pa dang ngan pa la snying brtse ②ba can/bas mtha'i gnas mal la dga' ba/ 'jig rten gyi yon gnas gcig ③bu rnams 'byung bar 'gyur bas/ de nas rang sangs rgyas zhig ljongs rgyu zhing song ba na drang srong de'i bste gnas su phyin pa dang / drang srong des de'i lus mdzes pa dang spyod lam zhi ba mthong ngo / /mthong nas des de la dad pa bskyed nas des de la bya ba byas te smon lam log par btab pa/ drang srong sdig ④can gang yin pa 'dis bdag gi ⑤'khor phye bas bdag gis 'di shes bya thams cad la dbang thob pa ༅na yang 'khor 'byed par ⑦byed par gyur cig ces byas so / /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus kyi ljongs kyi drang srong gang gis de'i 'khor phye ②ba de ni nga nyid yin no/ /de'i tshe de'i dus kyi gzhug mar gnas pa'i drang srong gang yin pa de ni lha sbyin yin te/ ngas de'i 'khor phye ba'i las kyi rnam par smin pa gang yin pa des na smon lam log par btab pas ⑨'dis nga'i tshudage 'dun phye ba yin no/ /dge slong dag de lta bas na las gcig tu gnag pa rnams kyi zhes bya ba nas/ dge slong dag khyod yikyis de lta bu la bslab par bya'o zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /dge slong rnams the tshom skyes te the tshom tsothams cad gcod 8pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/btsun pa lha sbyin gyis ④phyi pa dag ni nang par bgyis/ nang pa dag ni phyi par bgyis pas 'khor phrogs ④pa la gzigs/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' 455 pal/ dge slong dag da ltar gyi 'di 'ba' zhig du tsom zad de/ ji ltar 1—610

'das pa'i dus na yang 'dis phyi pa dag ni nang par byas/ nang pa dag ni phyi par byas pas 'khor phrogs ①pa de nyon cig /dge slong dag sngon byung ba phyogs shig na srog chags wa zhig gnas te de shin tu brkam ②chags can zhig pas chadagon par yang rgyu grong 'dab tu ④yang rgyu'o/ /de mthar gyis ⑤rgyu ba na rim gyis btso yiblag mkhan zhig gi khyim du zhugs pa las rams kyi ༅rdza mar lhung nas de skyug bro bar gyur te de dang ha cang yang mi ring ba na tshwa sgo'i ⑤phung po zhig 'dug pa de la nyal nas glos 'gres pa las de bas kyang lhag par 0lus ma rung bar gyur te/ chu'i nang du zhugs nas langs te song ba dang ④nyi ma'i zer gyis phog pas nor bu gzi'i /0kha dog ltar ⑩gyur pa ji tsam na wa rnams kyis ⑫mthong nas/ de rnams phyogs phyogs su bros te rgyang ring por ④'khod nas smras pa / khyod su zhig gang nas 'dir 'ongs/ des smras pa/ kho bo ni brgyar 'gro ④zhes bya ste/ lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya ⑩byin gyis rkang bzhi pa rnams kyi rgyal por tshudabang bskur to/ /wa rnams kyis 8bsams pa/ /'di'i lus kyi kha dog sngon ma mthong ba las na gdon mi za bar de kho na yin no snyam nas/ wa rnams kyis ༅rkang bzhi pa thams cad la rig par byas so/ /seng ge rnams kyis 0 bsams pa/ bdag cag las khyad par du 'phags pa su zhig yod na de rkang bzhi pa rnams kyi rgyal por gyur 0re zhig dong la rang gi tshogs kyi dpon po chal rig par bya'o snyam nas/ de rnams kyi tshogs kyi dpon po ral pa can zhig ri'i phyogs zhig na gnas pa de la de rnams kyis smras pa dang / des rkang bzhi pa gzhan zhig la bsgo phyob/ song la rdzirkang bzhi pa'i dpon po ⑤de rkang bzhi pa 'ga' zhig gis mthong ngam/ ma mthong rtogs shig /de de'i drung du song ste 44611

brtags na sngon ①ma mthong ba yin zhing seng ge rnams ②ma gtogs par rkang bzhi pa thams cad kyis yongs su bskor bar gyur nas de de'i drung du song ste ji ltar mthong ba dag smras pa des thos nas seng ge'i tshogs kyis ②yongs su bskor te de'i drung du dong ngo / /de ni rkang bzhi pa du mas ④yongs su bskor cing glang po che ⑤la zhon nas rgyu ba na de ⑥seng ge rnams kyis yongs su bskor cing / de nas ni stag rnams so/ /de nas ni rkang bzhi pa rnams so/ /de rnams kyi phyi rim rgyang ring po nas ni wa rnams 'dong ngo / /de'i ma ri sul zhig na gnas pa de la des wa zhig mngags te bus rgyal srid nyams su myong gis tshur spyon cig ces spring ba dang / des smras pa/ de'i 'khor ci 'dra ba zhig des smras pa/ de'i 'khor nang pa ni seng ge dang / stag dang / glang po che dag yin no/ /phyi pa ni bdag cag nyid ༅yin no/ /des smras pa/ ma rung zin gyis song shig /des tshigs su bcad pas kyang smras pa/ bdag ni ri 'di'i sul na bder gnas shing / /bsil ba'i chu la bsod nyams ④'thung bar byed/ /de ni ji srid wa sgra mi grag pa/ /de srid glang po che yis bder 'gro 'gyur/ /de song ste des wa rnams la smras pa/ rkang bzhi pa rnams kyi ②rgyal po 'di ni wa kho na yin te / bdag gis de'i ma ri sul ga ge mo ⑩zhes bya ba na yi'adug pa mthong ngo / /de ⑩rnams kyis smras pa/ gal te de lta tson de wa yin nam ma yin pa ④bdag cag gis brtag go/ /chos nyid kyis tshul rnams ni gang zhig gis wa skad thos nas skad ma byung na de'i spu rnams 'byi bar 'gyur bas wa skad dbyung (9bar brtsams ⑩nas des bsams pa/ gal te bdag gis skad ma phyung tson ni gdon mi za bar bdag gi spu rnams 'byi bar 'gyur la/ gal te glang po che las babs 4—612

nas skad phyung na ni 'dis bdag bsad ①du 'ong gis ②'di nyid du skad dbyung ngo snyam nas des glang po che la zhon bzhin ②skad dbyung bar brtsams pa dang /glang po ches shes nas was ④bdag la bzhin ⑤nam zhes des de bor te rkang pas brdzis so/ /lhas tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ gang dag nang pa phyi pa dang / /phyi pa nang par byed de dag /'di 'dra bar ni brlag 'gyur te/ /glang po che yis wa bzhin no/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus kyi wa gang yin pa ⑥de ni lha sbyin 'di nyid yin te/ de na yang 'dis nang pa dag ni phyi rol par byas/ phyi rol pa dag ni nang par byas pas tshul ma yin pas sdug bsngal bar gyur to/ /da ༅ltar yang 'dis nang pa dag ni phyi rol par byas/phyi rol pa dag ni nang par byas pas 'khor rnams phrogs ༅par gyur to/ /gang gi tshe tshe dang ldan pa shā ⑨ri'i bu dang / mod gal gyi bu gnyis kyis lha sbyin gyi 'khor phrogs pa de'i tshe/ lha sbyin gyis ko ka li ka dang / khaṇa ḍa drab bya dang pokhyed gnyis kyis nga'i 'khor 'phrog tu bcug go zhes brdegs so/ /dge slong rnams the tshom skyes te the tshom thams cad gcod ༅pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun 8pa lha sbyin gyi 'khor ni gzhan gyis /'phrogs la/ gzhan la 'dis sdug bsngal bskyed pa la gzigs/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' 455 pa / dge slong dag da ltar gyi 'di 'ba' zhig tu ma zad de/ 8ji ltar 'das pa'i dus na yang 'di'i chung ma gzhan 8gyis phrogs la gzhan tsodag la tshul ma yin pa'i sdug bsngal bskyed pa de nyon cig/dge slong dag sngon byung ba phyogs gzhan ⑩zhig na glang po che'i tshogs shig gnas so/ /de na glang po che zhig bal glang tsomo zhig la sdug par 'dzin pa dang /4—613

de ni ①glung po che'i phru gu gzhan ②zhig yod pa la lhag par chags nas des glang po che'i phru gu de la smras pa/ tshor du 'ong gis bdag cag 'bros sam de nas glang po che'i phru gu des smras pa/ gang gis na bdag cag 'bros pa'i thabs ci yod/ /des ②smras pa/ bdag gis thabs shig ④shis so zhes des ༅glang po che de la smras pa / khrus bya ba'i phyir rdzing du 'jug par bya'o/ /de zhugs pa dang des smras pa / bdag cag las su ༅yun ring du nub par 'dug par ⑦blta'o blun po'i phung po can de ⑧de dang lhan cig chu nang du nub par 'dug pa na de langs te glang po che'i phru gu dang lhan cig bros so/ /glang po che spuring zhig 'dug nas langs na mi snang nas des bsams pa/ bdag pham par 'gyur du 'ong gis slar yang nub par bya'o snyam nas/ de byaslar yang nub par byas nas mche ba sa la btsugs te 'dug go/ /de ring zhig lon nas dbugs tsodo chad de langs nas nyu)glang po che mo de ma mthong nas des rdzing bu de phan tshun du dkrug par brtsams pa dang / des der nya dang / rus 8sngal dang / sbal pa la sogs pa srog chags mang po tshul ma yin pas sdug bsngal bar byas so/ /lhas tshigs su bcad pas blams pa/ kye ma'o sha yi phung po che/ /'di la shes rab yod ma yin/ / gzhan gyis 6chung ma phrogs gyur na/ /gzhan ⑩la sdug bsngal sten par byabyed/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus na 8glang po che dam pa gang yin pa de ni lha sbyin yin te/ de na yang chung ma gzhan 7gyis phrogs la gzhan ⑩la tshul ma yin pa'i sdug bsngal bskyed do/ /da ltar yang 'khor gzhan 0gyis phrogs la gzhan dul tshul ma yin pa'i sdug bsngal bskyed do// //1—614

sdom ni/ glags dang mthong ba nyid dang ni/ /ut+pal ①mdog ni bsad pa dang / /ril ba dang gsum 'o ma dang / /sa 'tsho ②ma dang bzod gsol dang / /glang dang sems pa nyid dang ni/ /bya dang tha ma bzhi ②yin no/ /dge slong dag byathe tshom skyes te the tshom thams cad gcod ⑤pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa tshe dang ldan pa shā ⑥ri'i bu dang / mod gal gyi bu gnyis kyis lha sbyin la glags btsal ba las glags rnyed pa la gzigs/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag da ⑦ltar gyi 'di 'ba' zhig tu ma zad de/ ji ltar 'das pa'i dus na yang shā tshiri'i bu dang / mod gal gyi bu gnyis kyis lha sbyin la glags btsal ba las glags rnyed pa de nyon cig/dge slong dag sngon byung ba ri 'or rtsazhig na 'phong gi slob dpon zhig gnas te/des rigs mnyam pa las chung ma blangs nas de de dang lhan cig rtse bar byed/dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyad tu) par byed de (spre/ de rtse bar byed/dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed pa las dus gzhan zhig na chung ma sems can dang ldan par gyur to/ / 8de zla ba brgyad dam dgu lon pa na bu mo zhig btsas te btsas nas 8zhag bdun gsum nyi shu n+tu gcig tu de'i 8btsas pa'i btsas ston rgya cher byas nas rigs dang mthun pa'i ming btags 7te de bskyed bsrings nas chen mor gyur to/ /'phong gi slob dpon gyis bsams pa/bu mo 'di ni bdag gis gzugs dang ldan pa'am/ tshul khrims dang ldan pa'am/nor can su la yang sbyin par mi bya ste/ 'on kyang bdag las gnas lnga bslabs te byang bar gyur pa gang yin pa de la bdag gis 'di sbyin no snyam mo/ /de las ⑩bram ze'i khye'u gnyis shig 'phong bslabs 8pa las/ de na gcig /2ni gnas lnga 4wa 615

la byang bar gyur to/ /cig ༅shos kyis ni gcod ②pa la byang bar gyur to/ /de gnyis las gnas lnga la byang bar gyur pa gang yin pa de la des bu mo byin pa dang cig 0shos po de ④mi bzod pa skyes nas chom rkun ⑤pa rnams kyi nang du zhugs te/chom rkun lnga brgya'i sde dpon du gyur nas de phyogs gcig yon lam bcad nas 'khod do/ /snga ma po des bu mo de bag mar blangs nas mda' lnga brgya shong ba'i dong ba gnyis thogs te shing rtar zhugs ⑦nas rang gi khyim du dong ngo / /ji tsam na tshong pa chom rkun gyis ni'ajigs pa mdun du dong ba sdod pa dang des smras pa / shes ldan dag deng 0shig ci sdod/ de rnams kyis smras pa/ chom rkun pa rnams kyis lam bcad do/ /des smras pa/ tshur ci zhig byar yod ces de chas pa dang tshong pa ④rnams kyis smras pa/ shes ldan dag re zhig sdod cig /'di ni 'gro la rag ste 'di bdag hunyid 'chi ba dang / chung ma phrogs par gyur pa'i tsu)gnas gang yin pa de yod do/ /rkun po rnams shing ljon pa zhig la 'dzegs nas phyogs su lta bar byed cing 'dug pa dang / de rnams kyis de (spreshing rtar zhugs pa mthong nas de rnams kyis smras pa/ shes ldan dag mi nguzhig shing rtar zhugs nas song ngo 3/ /chom rkun pa'i sde dpon gyis de la pho nya zhig btang ste shing rta slar bzlog skyapa dang / des smras pa/ shes ldan ༅dpa' bo la dpa' bo'i lan 8byin cig /de rnams kyis smras pa/ bdag cag kyang dpa' bo yin no zhes sde dpon gyis mi rgod lnga brgya btang ba dang des de rnams bsad do/ /de bzhin du nyi shu zhig 'ongs pa de de skyernams kyang bsad de/ ji tsam na thams cad bsad nas chom rkun pa'i sde dpon 'ba' zhig lus pa 0dang des 0ral gri blangs te mdun du bsdad do/ /des mda' 'phangs par brtsams 1—616

pa na de'i ral gris gtubs ①so/ /ji tsam na des mda' lnga brgya ②'phangs pa de dag thams cad des gtubs ②nas mda' gcig ④cig lus te des de ma 'phangs pa dang / de nas ①bu mo des smras pa/ mda' bzhag ste ci bgyi 'phongs ⑥shig /des smras pa/ mda' 'di 'ba' ④zhig lus te 'di 'phangs na kho bo bsad nas khyod kyang srogs par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bu mo des lus kyi sgyur stangs kyis lan bu bcos par brtsams pa na/ de la chom rkun pa'i sde dpon rtog par byed pa na des de'i gnad du mdas ②bsnun pa dang / de 'chi ka na tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ shing rta can gyis bdag ma bsad/ /'dod chags sdig pa'i sems kyis ni/ /bdag ni g.yul gyi dbus zhugs nas/ /bag med bzhin la lta spubs bsad/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ /de'i tshe de'i dus kyi shing rta can gang yin pa de ni shā ri'i bu 'di nyid yin no/ /de'i tshe de'i dus kyi bu mo gang yin pa de ni mod gal gyi bu yin no/ /de'i tshe de'i dus kyi chom rkun pa'i sde dpon gang yin pa de ni lha sbyin yin te/ de na yang 'di gnyis kyis de la glags btsal ba las glags rnyed do/ /da ltar yang 'di gnyis kyis de la glags btsal ba las glags rnyed do//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab 'tsho byed gzhon ༅nus bskyed kyi a mra'i tshal na dbyar bzhugs ⑩par zhal gyis 8bzhes so/ /de nas lus 'phags ma'i bu ma ga ṅgā'i rgyal po ma skyes dgra dbyar nye bar sgrub par bodabyar zla 'bring po'i nya dbu ma de nyid kyi mtshan mo yin par shes shing mngon pa'i zla nyi mo la blon po'i tshogs kyis ④yongs su bskor te steng gi khang bzangs kyi gzhir ④song nas blon po rnams la smras pa/ kye grogs po ⑩dag dbyar nye bar sgrub ⑩pa 1—617

dbyar zla 'bring po'i nya dbu ma de nyid kyi mtshan mo yin par shes shing mngon pa'i zla nyi mo 'di lta bu la ngas ci zhig bya/ de nas pho brang slas kyi bud med cig gis lus 'phags ①ma'i bu rgyal po ma skyes dgra la 'di skad ces smras so/ /lha dbyar nye bar sgrub pa ②dbyar zla ③'bring po'i nya dbu ma'i mtshan mo lags par mkhyen cing mngon pa'i zla nyi mo 'di lta bu la lha 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga 'byor cing ldan pas rol par mdzad/ dgyes par mdzad/ dgyes dgur spyod par mdzad na lha'i bgyi ba ni de lags pa snyam bdag sems lags so/ / de nas pho thubrang slas gzhan zhig gis yang 'di skad ces smras so/ /lha dbyar nye bar sgrub ⑤pa dbyar zla 'bring po'i nya dbu ma'i mtshan mo lags par mkhyen cing mngon pa'i zla nyi mo 'di lta bu la lha 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga 'byor cing ldan pas rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer gyi nye 'khor gyi shul phra mo rnams byul zhing rol par mdzad/ dgyes par mdzad/ dgyes mgur ༅spyad par mdzad na lha'i bgyi ba ni de lags pa snyam bdag sems lags so/ /gzhon nu 'char byed bzang pos 'di skad ces smras so/ /lha dbyar nye bar sgrub ༅pa dbyar zla 'bring po'i nya dbu ma'i mtshan mo lags par mkhyen cing mngon pa'i zla nyi mo du'adi lta bu la lha dpung gi mtshogs yan lag bzhi pa glang po che ba'i mtshogs dang / rta pa'i tshogs dang / shing rta pa'i tshogs dang / dpung bu chung gi tshogs go bskon yinas/ gzhan gyi yul 'khor dang / gzhan gyi yul du 8gshegs te/ g.yul chen po'i g.yul sprad nas g.yul las rgyal bar bgyis te/ rgyal nas g.yul de nyid las pags ⑫te bzhugs ④na lha'i bgyi ba ni de lags pa snyam bdag sems lags so/ /de nas blon po rgan po gzhan zhig gis 'di skad ces smras so/ /lha dbyar nye bar 4—618

sgrub ①pa dbyar zla 'bring po'i nya dbu ma'i mtshan mo lags par mkhyen cing mngon pa'i zla nyi mo ②'di lta bu la lha 'od srung ⑤rdzogs byed 'dus pa can/ tshogs can / tshogs kyi slob dpon/ skye bo mang pos gzugs bzang por bkur ④ba/skye bo mang pos mdun gyis bltas pa⑤/ kun tu 'tsho lnga brgya'i gtso bo de rgyal po'i khab tu dbyar gnas par dam bcas pa de la lha bsnyen bkur mdzod cig /lha'i bgyi ba ni de lags pa snyam bdag sems lags so/ /yang blon po rgan po gzhan zhig gis 'di skad ces smras so/ /lha dbyar nye bar sgrub ⑥pa dbyar zla 'bring po'i nya dbu ma'i mtshan mo lags par mkhyen cing mngon pa'i zla nyi mo 'di lta bu ④lha ⑧kun du rgyu gnag lhas kyi bu dang / smra 'dod kyi bu mo'i bu yang dag rgyal ba can dang / mi pham ༅skra'i la ⑩ba can dang / ka t+ya'i blabu nog can dang / lha gcer bu pa gnyen gyi bu 'dus pa can/ tshogs can/8 tshogs kyi slob dpon/ skye bo mang pos gzugs bzang por bkur ba/ tshogs chen po'i nyu)mdun gyis nyu )bltas pa zhig mchis te/ de rgyal po'i khab 'di nyid du dbyar gnas par dam bcas pa de la lha bsnyen bkur mdzod cig8 /lha'i bgyi ba ni de lags pa snyam bdag sems lags so/ /de'i tshe 'tsho byed gzhon nus bskyed 'khor de nyid kyi nang na 'dus shing 'dug par gyur to/ /de nas lus 'phags ma'i tho)bu ma ga d+ma'i rgyal po ma skyes dgras 'tsho tho)byed gzhon tho)nus bskyed chal smras pa kwa'i nang rje 'tsho zhu byed ci'i phyir cang mi smra/ ci cung zad mi smra'am / lha dbyar nye bar sgrub pa 0dbyar zla 'bring po'i nya'i mtshan mo lags par mkhyen cing mngon pa'i zla nyi mo 'di lta bu la/ lha bcom ldan 'das 'dus pa can/ tshogs chen dzu stetshogs kyi slob dpon/ skye bo mang pos gzugs 4wa 619

bzang por bkur ba/ tshogs chen pos mdun gyis ①bltas pa de rgyal po'i khab 'di nyid kyi bdag gi a mra'i tshal na dbyar bzhugs ②par zhal gyis bzhes pa de la lha bsnyen bkur mdzod cig /lha'i bgyi ba ni de lags pa snyam bdag sems lags so/ /de'i tshe lus 'phags ma'i bu ma ga ṅgā'i rgyal po ma skyes dgra bcom ldan 'das la sems gzhol bar gyur/ bcom ldan 'das la 'bab par gyur/bcom ldan 'das la bab par gyur to/ /de nas lus 'phags ma'i bu ma ga ṅgā'i rgyal po ma skyes dgras 'tsho 5byed gzhon nus bskyed la 'di skad ces smras so/ /'tsho 5byed song la glang po che'i dam pa chen po stod cecig dang / de la kho bo zhon nas bcom ldan 'das blta thoba'i phyir 'gro'o/ /lha bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes 'tsho ༅byed gzhon dunas bskyed kyis lus 'phags ma'i bu ma ga d+ma'i rgyal po ma skyes dgra las mnyan nas glang po che spudam pa chen po de codang bal glang skyemo lnga brgya tsam gtad skyonas pho brang slas lag na sgron blam thogs pa lnga brgya tsam bal glang tsomo re re zhon nas lus 'phags ma'i bu ma ga ba'i rgyal po ma skyes dgra gang na ba der song ste phyin nas lus 'phags ma'i bu ma ga d+ma'i rgyal po ma skyes dgra la 'di skad ces /nyesmras so/ /lha glang po che'i dam pa chen po bsgron skyelags te/lha da nyu)de'i dus la bab par mkhyen par mdzad du gsol/ de nas lus 'phags ma'i bu ma ga d+ma'i rgyal po ma skyes dgra glang po che dam pa chen po la zhon nas pho brang slas lag na sgron ma thogs pa lnga brgya tsam bal glang tsomo re re zhon pas mdun du bdar nas rgyal po'i khab nas byung ste bcom ldan 'das yibalta du ba dang bsnyen bkur bya ba'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar song ngo / /de'i tshe lus 'phags ma'i bu ma ga d+ma'i rgyal po (rmem skyes dgra yul spong byed pa rnams 4—620

dang mi mthun par gyur to①/ /de nas lus 'phags ma'i bu ma ga d+ma'i rgyal po ma skyes dgra rgyal po'i khab nas byung ma thag kho nar bdag 'tsho byed gzhon nus bskyed 'dis bsad ②par 'dod pa'am/ bslu bar 'dod pa'am/ khas len du gzhug par 'dod pa'am/ gshed ma'ams/ phyir rgol ba'am/ mi mdza' ba dag la gtad par mi 'dod grang snyam du bsams thunas skrag par gyur/bag tsha bar gyur/ spu zing zhes byed par gyur nas 'tsho byed gzhon nus bskyed la 'di skad ces smras so/ /'tsho byed khyod zhukho bo la gsod ⑥par 'dod pa'am/bslu bar 'dod pa'am/ khas len du gzhug par 'dod pa'am/ gshed ma pa'am / phyir rgol ba'am/ mi mdza' ba dag la gtad par mi 'dod grang /des 'di skad ces smras so/ /lha khyod la bdag dgrongs thopar 'tshal ba'am/ bslu bar 'tshal ba'am/ she smrar gzhug par 'tshal ba'am/ gshed ma pa'am/phyir rgol ba'am/ mi mdza' ba dag la gtad 2par 'tshal ba ma lags so/ /de nas lus 'phags ma'i bu ma ga jo'i rgyal po ma skyes dgras 'tsho nyuX byed gzhon nus bskyed la 'di skad ces smras so/ /'tsho nyunyebyed bcom ldan 'das de la 'khor ji snyed 8yod/ dge slong stong 6nyis brgya lnga bcu lhag tsam mo/ /e ma'o 'tsho byed khyod 0kyis nga ji ltar bsad 8par mi 'dod/ bslu bar mi 'dod/smrar gzhug ⑩par mi 'dod/ gshed ma pa'am/ phyir rgol ba'am7 mi mdza' ba dag la gtod par mi 'dod/ da 8ltar bcom ldan 'das de la 'khor de snyed yod na lu ba'i sgra yang mi gragayi /sbrid pa'i sgra yang mi grag go/ /lha bcom ldan 'das de ni sgra chung ba bzhed/ sgra chung ba la dgyes/ sgra chung bas 'dul / sgra chung ba'i bsngags pa mdzad pas 'khor yang sgra chung ba nyid do/ /4—621

lha de lta bas na myur ba 0myur bar glang po che dam pa chen po thob shig② /'di ltar 'khor gyi khyim na 'bru mar gyi zhugs mar gyi 'od gda'o/ /de nas lus 'phags ma'i bu ma ga dha'i rgyal po ma skyes dgras myur ba myur bar glang po che'i ②dam pa chen po btab rtsonas des ji tsam bzhin ④pas rung ba'i sa'i bar du bzhon pas ༅song ste bzhon ④pa las babs nas rkang pa kho nas kun dga' ra ba'i rkyenang du zhugs ri (so/ /de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi gung la mtsho ltar dang zhing cogasal la skyertog pa med pas skyobazhugs so/ /de nas lus 'phags ma'i bu ma ga ṅgā'i rgyal po ma skyes dgra 'khor gyi khyams dang nye bar song tsonas 'tsho byed gzhon nus thobaskyed la smras pa/ 'tsho byed bcom ldan 'das de gang na bzhugs/ lha bcom ldan 'das de ni dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi gung la mtsho ltar dang zhing gsal skyel rnyog pa med par bzhugs pa pha bi kho na lags so/ /de nas lus 'phags ma'i bu ma ga d+ma'i rgyal po ma skyes dgra bcom ldan 'das gang na tsustob der song ste phyin nas skye bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas nyu)pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs nas/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud yode bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces bya gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun dang thugs dul ba nye bar zhi ba ji lta surmebu dang ldan pa de bzhin du gzhon nu 'char byed bzang po yang sems dul ba dang / nye bar zhi ba de 'dra ba dang ldan par gyur cig /rgyal po chen po rang nyid dga' bar 'urab tu bstan pa legs so legs so / /rgyal po chen po rang gi stan la 'dug shig phyo /de nas lus 'phags ma'i bu ma ga ṅgā'i rgyal po ma skyes dgras bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la ⑥4—622

mgo bos phyag byas te phyogs gcig ①tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu ②'dug nas bcom ldan 'das la lus 'phags ma'i bu ma ga ṅgā'i rgyal po ma skyes dgras 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis gal te zhu ba lung bstan pa'i slad du skabs phye ba lta na bdag phyogs 'ga' zhig zhu lags so/ /rgyal po chen po ci dang ci 'dod pa zhus shig /btsun pa las kyi gnas dang bzo'i gnas tha dad pa gang dag lcalags pa 'di lta ste/ phreng rgyud ④pa dang /smyug ma mkhan dang / gdan pa dang / rtswa thun dang / 'dul mkhan dang /glang po che la 'tshal ba dang / rta la 'tshal ba dang / shing rta mkhan dang /ral gri'i thabs dang / gzhu'i 'dzin stangs pa dang / zhabs ⑤'bring pa ⑥bgyid pa dang / go re long dang / bro ga 2len pa dang / rgyal po'i bu rab gnon tshan po che dpa' ba rtul phod pa rnams dang / mnyes ⑧par bgyid pa dang / skra mkhan dang / khrus mkhan de rnams rang rang gi bzo'i phyaganas dang /las kyi gnas rnams kyis bgyi ba bgyid cing sbyin pa dag stsol/ bsod menams dag bgyid ༅la gso ba rnams gso zhing 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga 'byor cing ldan pas rtse 8bar bgyid/ dga' bar bgyid/ dga' mgur spyod par bgyid pa 6de lta bu rnams la yang dag par mthong ba'i dge sbyong gi tshul gyi 'bras bu gdags pa 'thob cilags sam// //'dul ba gzhi skye/ bam po brgya rtsa ⑩drug pa/ rgyal po chen po khyod kyis 'di 'dra ba'i zhu ba 'di las sngon dge sbyong dang bram ze gzhan rnams la dris pa dran nam/ btsun pa dran lags te/ btsun ⑩pa dus gcig 8cig na bdag 'od sung rdzogs byed gang na ba der mchis te/ mchis nas 'od srung rdzogs 4—623

byed la bdag gis 'di skad ces btsun pa 'od srung las kyi gnas dang bzo'i gnas tha dad pa gang dag lags pa 'di lta ste/ phreng rgyud pa ①dang / smyug ma mkhan dang / gdan pa dang / rtswa thun dang / 'dul mkhan dang /glang po che la zhon pa dang / rta la zhon pa dang / shing rta mkhan dang / ral gri'i ②thabs dang / gzhu'i 'dzin stangs ⑧pa dang / zham ④'bring byed pa dang / go re long dang / bro ga rgyalen pa dang / rgyal po'i bu rab gnon tshan cupo che dpa' ba rtul 2phod pa rnams dang / mnyes par byed pa dang /skra mkhan dang / khrus mkhan de rnams rang rang gi bzo'i duganas pa spudang /las kyi gnas rnams kyis rtsobya ba byed cing sbyin pa dag gtong / bsod nams dag byed la/ gso ba rnams gso zhing 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga ༅'byor cing ldan par gyur nas rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed na de lta bu rnams la yang dag par mthong ba'i dge sbyong gi tshul gyi 'bras bu gdags pa 'thob bam 8zhes dris pa na de 'di skad ces rgyal po chen po 8bdag ni 'di ltar lta zhing 'di skad smra ste/ sbyin pa med do/ /mchod sbyin med do/ /sbyin sreg 6med do/ /legs par spyad pa med do/ /nyes par spyad pa med do / /legs par spyad nyunyepa dang nyes par spyad pa'i las rnams kyi 'bras bu rnam par smin pa med do/ /'jig rten 'di med do/ /'jig rten pha rol med do/ /ma med do/ /pha med do/ /sems can brdzus te skye ba med do/ /'jig rten na dgra bcom pa yang dag par song ba yang dag par zhugs pa gang dag tshe 'di nyid la rang gi mngon par shes pas 'jig rten 'di dang 'jig rten pha rol mngon sum ⑩du byas nas bsgrubs te bdag ni ༅skye ba zad do/ /tshangs par 4—624

spyod pa bsten to/ /bya ba byas so/ /srid pa 'di las gzhan mi shes so zhes go bar byed pa dag ①med do/ /srog ni 'di nyid la 'tsho ②zhing de phyis chad par 'gyur / zhig par 'gyur te shi ba'i 'og tu mi 'byung ngo / /skyes bu'i lus ni 'byung ba chen po bzhi las gyur pa yin te/ de ni gang gi tshe shi ba na de'i sa'i lus ni sa'i bag la zha chu'i lus ni chu'i me'i lus ni me'i rlung gi lus ni rlung gi bag la zha zhubar 'gyur ro/ /dbang po rnams ni nam mkha'i rjes su 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /skyes bu'i ro ni khri dang lnga'i mi dag gis khyer te dur khrod du 'gro zhing bsregs phan chad mi mngon par 'gyur ro/ /bsreg ④bya dag ni thal bar 'gyur ro/ /rus pa dag ni thi ba'i mdog 'dra bar gnas so/ /'di ltar rmongs pas nye bar bstan pa ni sbyin la mkhas pas nye bar bstan pa ni rgyalen to/ /de la gang dag yod par smra ba de dag thams cad ni gsog gsob thobardzun du smra ba brdol rtsob yin no/ /'di ltar byis pa dang mkhas pa de gnyis ni phyis chad par 'gyur zhig par 'gyur te shi ba'i 'og tu mi 'byung ngo ⑧zhes mchi ste/btsun pa dper na mi zhig a mra'i rtso'abras bu rnams dris na la ku tsa'i 'bras bu rnams lung ston par bgyid la/ la ku tsa'i 'bras bu rnams dris na a mra'i 'bras bu rnams lung ston par bgyid pa de bzhin du 'od srung rdzogs byed la bdag gis yang dag par mthong ba'i dge sbyong gi tshul gyi skye'abras bu huskredris na ma mchis pa nyid lung ston par bgyid nas kye/ btsun pa de la bdag 'di snyam du ⑫sems te/ bdag 'dra ba'i skyes bu mkhas pas gzugs bzang por bkur ba yul na gzhug mar gnas pa'i dge sbyong ngam bram ze la mngon sum 8du smad pa ni bdag gi cha ma lags so snyam nas/ btsun pa bdag gis 'od srung 8rdzogs 1—625

byed kyis ༅smras pa la mngon par bstod ②pa yang mi bgyid/ smad pa yang mi bgyid de/ mngon par bstod pa duyang ma bgyis/ smad pa ④yang ma bgyis par stan las langs te mchis nas bdag kun du rgyu gnag lhas kyi ④bu gang na ba der mchis te thomachis nas/ kun du rgyu gnag lhas kyi bu la 'di skad ces btsun pa kun du rgyu 'jig rten gyi las kyi gnas dang / bzo'i rtsoganas tha dad pa gang dag yin pa 'di lta ste/ phreng rgyud dupa dang / smyug ma mkhan dang /gdan pa dang / rtswa thun spudang / 'dul mkhan dang / glang po che la zhon pa dang / rta la zhon pa dang /skye shing rta mkhan dang / ral gri'i thabs dang /gzhu'i 'dzin stangs pa dang / zham nyunyu'abring byed pa dang / go re long dang /bro ga skulen pa dang / rgyal po'i bu rab gnon tshan kyipo che dpa' ba rtul coyod pa rnams dang / mnyes par byed pa dang / skra mkhan dang / khrus mkhan de rnams rang rang gi bzo'i gnas dang / las kyi gnas rnams kyis tsobya ba byed cing sbyin pa dag gtong / bsod thunams dag byed la gso ba rnams gso zhing 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga 'byor nyuX cing ldan par gyur nas rtse nyunyebar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed na de lta bu rnams la yang dag par mthong ba'i dge sbyong gi tshul gyi 'bras bu gdags pa 'thob bam zhes dris pas skyen/de 'di skad ces rgyal po chen po bdag ni 'di ltar lta ru )zhing 'di skad 0smra ste/sems can rnams kun nas nyon mongs par 'gyur ba la rgyu med rkyen med do/ /sems can rnams rgyu med rkyen med par kun nas nyon mongs par 'gyur ro/ /sems can rnams rnam par dag par 'gyur ba la rgyu med rkyen med do/ /sems can rnams rgyu med rkyen med par rnam par dag par 'gyur ro/ /sems can 1—626

rnams shes pa med par 'gyur ba dang / mthong ba med par 'gyur ba la rgyu med rkyen med do/ /sems can rnams rgyu med rkyen med par shes pa med pa dang mthong ba med par 'gyur ro/ /sems can rnams shes par 'gyur ba dang mthong bar 'gyur ba la rgyu med rkyen med do/ /sems can rnams rgyu med rkyen med par shes pa dang mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /stobs med do/ /brtson 'grus med do/ /stobs dang brtson 'grus med do/ /skyes bu'i rtsal med do/ /pha rol gnon pa med do/ /skyes bu'i 1rtsal dang pha rol gnon pa med do/ /bdag gi rtsal med do/ /gzhan gyi rtsal med do/ /bdag gi rtsal dang gzhan gyi rtsal med do/ /sems can thams cad dang srog thams cad dang / 'byung po thams cad mthu med stobs med dbang med brtson 'grus med/ pha rol gnon pa med do/ /'gro ba mtshams sbyor ba'i srid pa dag nges par gyur to/ /'di ltar 'gro ba drug po dag tu bde ba dang sdug bsngal so sor myong bar 'gyur ro zhes mchi ste/ btsun pa dper na mi zhig a mra'i 'bras bu rnams dris na la ku tsa'i rgya'abras bu rnams lung ston par bgyid la/ la ku tsa'i 'bras bu rnams dris na a mra'i 'bras bu rnams lung ston par bgyid pa de bzhin du kun du rgyu gnag lhas kyi bu la bdag gis yang dag par mthong ba'i dge sbyong gi tshul gyi 'bras bu dris na rgyu ma mchis pa nyid du lung ston par bgyid nas/ btsun rdupa de la bdag 'di snyam du sems tebya/ bdag 'dra ba'i skyes bu mkhas pas gzugs bzang por bkur ba yul na gnyug mar gnas pa'i dge sbyong ngam bram ze la da ji ltar mngon sum du smad par bya snyam nas/ bdag gis thukun du rgyu gnag lhas kyi bu'i smras pa la mngon par bstod pa yang mi bgyid/ smad pa yang 4—627

mi bgyid de/ mngon par bstod ①pa yang ma bgyis②/ smad pa yang ma bgyis ②par stan las langs te mchis nas/ bdag smra 'dod kyi bu mo'i bu yang dag rgyal ba can gang na ba der mchis te mchis nas smra 'dod kyi bu mo'i bu yang dag rgyal ba can la 'di skad ces btsun ④pa yang dag rgyal ba can las kyi gnas dang bzo'i tseganas gang dag yin pa 'di lta ste/ phreng rgyud ④pa dang / sgyug ma mkhan dang / gdan pa dang / rtswa thothun dang / 'dul mkhan dang /glang po che la zhon pa dang / rta la zhon pa dang / shing rta mkhan dang / ral gri'i thabs dang / gzhu'i 'dzin stangs ⑧pa dang / zham ⑨'bring byed pa dang /go re long dang / bro ga rtsolen pa dang / rgyal po'i bu rab gnon tshan po che dpa' ba rtul phod pa rnams dang / mnyes par byed pa dang / skra mkhan dang khrus mkhan de rnams rang rang gi bzo'i gnas dang /sprelas kyi gnas rnams kyis bya ba byed cing sbyin pa dag gtong / bsod nyunyenams dag byed la gso ba rnams gso zhing 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga 'byor cing ldan par gyur nas rtse bar byed/dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed pa nyusnyen de lta bu rnams ④yang dag par mthong ba'i dge sbyong gi tshul gyi 'bras bu gdags pa 'thob bam zhes dris pa na / de 'di skad ces rgyal po chen po bdag ni 'di ltar blta skyozhing 'di skad smra ste/ byed pa dang / byed du 'jug pa dang / gcod pa dang / gcod du 'jug pa dang / sreg pa dang / sreg tu 'jug pa dang / rdeg pa dang /rdeg tu 0'jug pa dang / srog mchags la 'tshe ba dang / ma byin par len pa dang / 'dod pa dag la log par spyod pa dang / shes bzhin du brdzun du smra ba dang / myos par 'gyur ba'i btung tsob 'thung ba dang / khyim 'bubs 0pa 4—628

dang / mdud pa bkrol ①ba dang / rim gyis ②'phrog pa dang / lam 'gog cing 'dug pa dang / grong 'joms par byed pa dang / grong khyer 'joms par byed pa dang / yul 'joms par byed pa dang / sa gzhi khuchen po 'di la sems can gang dag yod pa de dag thams cad 'khor lo'i mtha' spu gri la ④byas pas de dag thams cad kun du gcod ⑤par byed/ kun du 'cheg ⑥par byed/ kun du rdung klubar byed/ kun du 'dral bar byed cing de dag thams cad kun du bcadadu/ kun du gshegs/ kun du brdungs/ kun du dral nas sha'i thang ma gcig ༅tu byed ⑩/ sha'i tshoms blagacig tu byed/ sha'i bungs gcig tu byed/ sha'i phung skyepo gcig tu byed cing sha'i thang ma gcig tu byas / sha'i tshoms 8gcig tu byas/ sha'i bungs gcig tu byas/ sha'i phung po gcig tu byas nas de ltar kun du sgrub par byed pa las lku gzhi de las sdig pa yang med/ gzhi de las sdig par 'gyur ba yang med do/ /chu klung gang gā'i lho phyogs nas kun du gcod par byed/ kun du 'cheg nyunyepar byed/ kun du rdung bar byabyed/ kun du 'dral bar byed cing 'gro la/ chu klung gang gā'i byang phyogs nas sbyin par tsu )byed/ mchod sbyin byed cing 'gro bar gyur nyurmen/gzhi de las sdig pa dang bsod lonams kyang med/ gzhi de las sdig pa dang bsod zhu nams su 'gyur ba yang med do/ /'di ltar sbyin pa dang / dul ba dang / yang dag par sdom pa dang / don spyod zhupa dang / don mthun pas de ltar byed pa yang bsod byanams mi byed pa kho na yin no zhes mchi ste/ btsun kūpa dper na mi zhig a mra'i 'bras bu rnams dris na la ku tsa'i 'bras bu rnams lung ston ④par bgyid la④/ la ku tsa'i 'bras bu rnams dris na a mra'i 'bras 4—629

bu ①rnams lung ston par bgyid ②pa de bzhin du smra 'dod kyi bu mo'i bu yang dag rgyal ba can la bdag gis yang dag par mthong ba'i dge sbyong gi tshul gyi 'bras bu dri ba dris na byed pa nyid ma mchis par lung ston par bgyid do/ /btsun pa de la bdag 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag 'dra ba'i skyes bu mkhas pas gzugs bzang por bkur ba yul ②na gnyug mar gnas pa'i dge sbyong ngam bram ze la da ji ltar mngon sum du smad par bya snyam nas/ bdag gis ⑤smra 'dod kyi bu mo'i bu ⑤ yang dag rgyal ba can la mngon par bstod pa yang mi bgyid smad pa yang mi bgyid de/ mngon par bstod ⑥pa yang ma bgyis/ smad pa yang ma bgyis ⑦par stan las langs te mchis nas bdag mi pham ②skra'i la ⑨ba can gang na ba der mchis te mchis nas/ mi pham 0skra'i la yib can la 'di skad ces btsun ⑫pa mi pham 'jig rten gyi las kyi gnas dang bzo'i gnas tha dad pa gang dag yin pa tso'adi lta ste/ phreng rgyud ④pa dang / smyug ma mkhan dang / gdan pa dang / rtswa tsunyethun dang / 'dul mkhan dang / glang po che la zhon pa dang /rta la zhon pa dang tho9/ shing rta mkhan dang / ral gri'i tho)thabs dang /gzhu'i 'dzin stangs pa dang / zham 8'bring byed pa dang / go re long dang /bro ga 0len pa dang / rgyal po'i bu rab gnon tshan po che dpa' ba rtul phod pa rnams dang mnyes par byed pa dang / skra mkhan dang / khrus mkhan de rnams rang rang gi bzo'i 0 gnas dang / las kyi gnas rnams 0kyis bya ba byed cing sbyin pa dag gtong / bsod (chenams dag byed la gso ba rnams gso zhing 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga 'byor cing ldan par gyur nas rtse bar byed dga' bar byed / dga' mgur spyod par byed na de lta bu rnams la yang dag par mthong 1—630

ba'i dge sbyong gi tshul gyi 'bras bu gdags ①pa 'thob bam zhes dris pa na ②de 'di skad ces rgyal po chen po bdag ni 'di ltar blta duzhing 'di skad ces ༅smra ste/lus bdun po 'di dag ni ma byas pa/ byas pas ma byas pa ma sprul pa/ sprul pas ma byas pa gnod par bya ba ma yin pa ther zug tu gnas pa/ ka ⑤ba bzhin yiganas pa dag yin te/ bdun gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste sa'i lus dang /chu'i lus dang / me'i lus dang / rlung gi lus dang / bde ba dang /sdug bsngal ba dang / srog gson pa nyid ni bdun pa ste/ lus bdun po de dag ni ma byas pa/ byas pas rtsom byas pa/ ma sprul pa/ sprul pas ma byas pa/gnod par bya ba ma yin pa/ ther zug tu gnas pa/ ka ba bzhin du gnas pa dag yin no/ /de dag ni du'adi lta ste/ bsod rtsonams su 'gyur ba'i phyir ram / sdig par 'gyur ba'i phyir ram/ bsod nams dang sdig par 'gyur ba'i phyir ram bde bar 'gyur ba'i phyir ram/ sdug bsngal bar 'gyur ba'i phyir ram / the ) bde ba dang nyunyesdug bsngal bar 'gyur nyu5ba'i phyir g.yo bar mi byed/ rnam par 'gyur bar mi byed/1) gcig 6la gcig skyeganod par mi byed do/ /skyes bu gang gis rtsoskyes bu'i mgo gcod par byed pa des kyang 'jig rten na g.yo ba'am gnas pa la gnod pa cung zad kyang skumi byed de/ lus bdun po dag la bar med par mtshon thal byung du 'gro zhing der srog la gnod pa yang med do/ /de la gsod par 8byed pa'am/ gsod du bcug 7pa'am/ dran par byed pa'am / dran par byed du bcug du pa'am/ skul ༅bar byed pa'am/ skul du bcug pa'am/ rnam par rig par byed pa'am/ rnam par rig par byed du bcug cipa 'ga' yang med do/ /byis pa'am mkhas pa gang dag yin pa dag 4—631

ni skye gnas gtso bo dang ldan pa khri bzhi stong dang / rtog pa chen po drug khri dang drug brgya dang / las lnga dang / las gsum dang / las gnyis dang las dang las phyed ①dang / las ②drug bcu rtsa gnyis dang / rtog pa bar ma drug bcu rtsa gnyis dang / 'du shes bdun dang / sems can dmyal ba brgya nyi shu dang / dbang po brgya sum bcu dang / rdul gyi khams sum bcu rtsa drug dang /klu'i rigs bzhi khri dgu stong dang / nam mkha' lding gi rigs bzhi khri dgu stong dang / kun tu rgyu'i rigs bzhi khri dgu stong dang / kun tu 'tsho'i cirigs bzhi khri dgu stong dang / gcer bu pa'i rigs bzhi khri dgu stong dang / 'du shes can gyi gnas bdun dang / 'du shes med pa'i gnas bdun dang / lha ma yin bdun dang / sha za bdun dang / lha bdun dang / mi bdun dang /mtsho bdun dang / mtsho bdun brgya skyidang / 'bri ba bdun dang / 'bri ba bdun brgya dang / rmi lam bdun dang / rmi lam bdun brgya dang / sad pa bdun dang / sad pa bdun brgya dang / g.yang sa bdun dang / g.yang sa bdun brgya dang / rigs btsun pa drug dang / mngon par mtho ba bcu dang /skyes bu chen po'i rgyas ⑥brgyad po de dag tu bskal pa chen po brgyad 2khri bzhi stong du mtshams sbyor ⑤cing 'khor nas sdug bsngal mthar byed do/ /'di lta ste/dper na/ skud pa'i dru bu ⑨yang ba tu )steng gi nam mkha' las 'phangs pa gzangs pa shin sa la 'bab pa de bzhin du byis pa'am/ mkhas pa gang dag yin pa dag kyang de dag tsobaskal pa chen po brgyad khri bzhi stong du mtshams tsosbyor cing 'khor nas sdug bsngal mthar byed do/ /de la dge sbyong dang bram ze gang dag 'di skad ces bdag tshul khrims sam/ brtul zhugs sam/ dka' tuste4—632

thub bam/ tshangs par spyod pa la gnas pa 'dis las yongs su ma smin pa ni yongs su ༅smin par bya zhing yongs su smin pa ni reg par byas nas byang bar bya'o zhes zer ba 'ga' yang med do/ /bde ba dang sdug bsngal 'di nges pa yin no / /yar skye ba dang mar 'grib pa ni mi srid do/ /'di lta bu 'di nyid dang gzhan ②ma yin pas 'khor ba gzhal lo zhes mchi ste/ btsun pa dper na mi zhig a mra'i 'bras bu rnams dris na la ku tsa'i cha'abras bu rnams lung ston par bgyid la/ la ku tsa'i 'bras bu rnams dris na a mra'i ④'bras bu rnams lung ston par bgyid pa de bzhin du mi pham ༅skra'i la ba can la bdag gis yang dag par mthong ba'i dge sbyong gi tshul gyi 'u'abras bu dris na 'khor ba dag nyid lung ston par bgyid nas/ btsun ④pa de la bdag 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag 'dra ba'i skyes bu mkhas pas gzugs mdzes par bkur ba yul na gnyug mar gnas pa'i dge sbyong ngam bram ze la da ji ltar mngon sum du smad par bya snyam nas mi pham ⑧spa'i la ba can gyis smras pa la mngon par bstod pa huyang mi bgyid/smad pa hūṃ )yang mi bgyid de/ mngon par bstod pa (7yang ma bgyis smad pa nyu)yang ma bgyis par stan las langs te mchis nas bdag gcer 8bu pa gnyen gyi bu gang na ba der rgyu) mchis nas/ gcer bu pa gnyen gyi bu la 'di skad ces btsun pa gnyen gyi bu 'jig rten gyi las kyi gnas dang / bzo'i gnas tha dad pa gang dag yin pa 'di lta ste/ phreng rgyud tsunyepa dang / smyug ma mkhan dang /gdan ⑩pa dang / rtswa mthun dang / 'dul mkhan dang / glang po che la zhon pa dang / rta la zhon pa dang / shing rta mkhan dang / ral gri'i thabs dang /gzhu'i 'dzin stangs pa dang / zham 8'bring byed pa dang / go re long dang /1—633

bro ga ①len pa dang / rgyal po'i bu rab gnon tshan po che dpa' ②ba rtul ②mod pa rnams dang / mnyes par byed pa dang / skra mkhan dang khrus mkhan de rnams rang rang gi bzo'i gnas dang / las kyi gnas rnams kyis ④bya ba byed cing sbyin pa dag gtong / bsod ⑤nams dag byed la/ gso ba ni ⑥gso zhing 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga 'byor cing ldan par gyur nas rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed na de lta bu rnams la yang dag par mthong ba'i dge sbyong gi tshul gyi 'bras bu gdags pa 'thob bam zhes dris pa na/de 'di skad ces rgyal po chen po bdag ni 'di ltar lta zhing 'di skad ⑦smra ste/skyes bu gang zag 'dis so sor myong ba gang yin pa ci yang rung ste/ de thams cad sngon byas pa'i rgyu las byung ba yin no/ /las rnying pa rnams ni dka' thub kyis 'byang bar 'gyur la/ las sar pa rnams ni mi bya ba'i chu lon gyis dubazlog par bya'o/ /de lta phyosnan phyin chad zag pa med do/ /zag pa med na las zad do/ /las zad na sdug bsngal zad do/ /6sdug bsngal zad na sdug bsngal mthar byed par 'gyur ro nyunyezhes mchi ste/ btsun pa dper na mi zhig a mra'i 'bras bu rnams dris na la ku tsa'i 'bras bu rnams su 8lung ston par bgyid mal/la ku tsa'i 'bras bu rnams dris na a mra'i 'bras bu rnams lung ston par bgyid pa de bzhin du gcer bu pa gnyen gyi ④bu la bdag gis yang dag par mthong ba'i ⑫dge sbyong gi tshul gyi tso'abras bu dris na ༅sngon bgyis pa'i rgyu las byung ba nyid lung ston par bgyid nas/ btsun pa de la bdag 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag 'dra ba'i skyes bu mkhas pas gzugs bzang por bkur ba yul na gnyug mar gnas pa'i dge sbyong ngam bram ze la mngon sum du smad pa ni bdag gi 8cha ma 1—634

lags so snyam nas/ bdag gis gcer bu pa gnyen ①gyi bu'i smras pa la mngon par bstod pa ciyang mi bgyid/ smad par ②yang mi bgyid de/ mngon par bstod pa yang ma bgyis smad par g.yang ma bgyis par stan las langs ④te mchis nas bdag ka t+ya'i ⑤du nog can gang na ba der mchis te/ mchis nas ka t+ya'i ⑥bu nog can la 'di skad ces/ btsun pa ka t+ya'i ⑦bu 'jig rten gyi las kyi gnas dang / bzo'i duganas tha dad pa gang dag yin pa 'di lta ste/ phreng rgyud ⑨pa dang / smyug ma mkhan dang / gdan ⑨ pa dang / rtswa yithun dang /'dul mkhan dang / glang po che la tho)zhon pa dang / rta la zhon pa dang /shing rta mkhan dang / ral gri'i thabs dang / gzhu'i 'dzin stangs pa dang /zham ma'abring byed pa dang / go re long rkyi dang / bro ga 6len pa dang / rgyal po'i bu rab gnon tshan po che dpa' ba rtul ༅phod pa rnams dang / mnyes par byed pa dang / skra mkhan dang / khrus mkhan de rnams rang rang gi bzo'i rtso snaganas dang / las kyi gnas rnams kyis 6bya ba byed cing sbyin pa dag gtong /bsod blunams dag byed la/ gso ba rnams gso zhing 'dod pa'i yon tan ṭu lnga 'byor cing ldan par gyur nas rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed na de lta bu rnams la yang dag par mthong ba'i dge sbyong gi tshul gyi 'bras bu gdags pa 'thob bam zhes de skad dris pa dang / ka t+ya'i sh+yibu nog can bdag la 'di skad ces rgyal po chen po bdag ni 'di ltar lta zhing 'di skad ces 6smra ste/ gal te 'ga' zhig bdag gi gan du mchis te 'di skad ces 'jig rten pha rol yod dam zhes 'dri tson/ de la bdag 'jig rten pha rol yod do zhes dri ba dris pa'i lan 'debs so/ /'jig rten pha rol med pa 4wa 635

dang / 'jig rten pha rol yod ①pa dang med pa dang / yod pa yang ma ②yin med pa yang ma yin pa dang / de bzhin du 'jig rten pha rol 'di lta bu nyid dang / 'di lta bu nyid ma yin pa dang / gzhan nyid dang gzhan nyid ma yin pa dang / 'jig rten pha rol gzhan ma yin pa nyid dang gzhan ma yin pa nyid ma yin pa yin nam zhes 'dri na de la bdag ci'ajig rten pha rol gzhan ④ma yin pa nyid dang gzhan ⑤ma yin pa nyid ma yin no zhes dris pa'i lan 'debs so ⑥zhes mchi ⑦nas bdag de la 'di snyam du sems te/ rgyal po'i khab 'di na rab tu byung bar gyur pa ji snyed gnas pa de rnams kyi nang na lhag par blun pa/lhag par glen pa/ lhag par slu 2bar byed pa ni 'di lta ste/ ka t+ya'i spugu nog can 'di yin no snyam pa las de la yang bdag 'di snyam du sems te/cigazugs bzang por bkur skyeb 6yul na gnyug mar gnas pa'i skyodage sbyong ngam bram ze la 7)mngon sum du smad pa ni bdag gi cha ma lags so snyam nas bdag gis ka t+ya'i 6bu nog can gyis 6smras pa la mngon par bstod pa mayang mi bgyid/smad pa hu)yang mi bgyid de nyuthemangon par bstod pa yang ma bgyis/ smad pa yang ma bgyis bupar stan las langs te mchis lags te/ bcom ldan 'das la bdag don de kho na zhu lags na/ btsun pa 'jig rten gyi las kyi gnas dang /bzo'i gnas tha dad pa gang dag lags pa 'di lta ste/ phreng rgyud tsu〉pa dang /smyug ma mkhan dang / gdan pa dang / rtswa thun dang / 'dul mkhan dang /glang po che la 'tshal ba dang / rta la 'tshal ba dang / shing rta mkhan dang /ral gri'i thabs dang / gzhu'i 'dzin stangs pa dang / zham ④'bring bgyid pa dang / go re long dang / bro ga tsolen pa dang rgyal po'i bu rab gnon tshan po 1—636

che dpa' ba rtul ①mod pa rnams dang / mnyes par bgyid pa dang / skra mkhan dang / khrus mkhan de rnams rang rang gi bzo'i gnas dang / las kyi gnas rnams kyis ②bgyi ba bgyid cing sbyin pa dag stsol/ (sod chanams dag bgyid la gso ba dag gso ④zhing 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga 'byor cing ldan par gyur nas rtse bar bgyid/ dga' bar bgyid/ dga' mgur spyod par ⑤bgyid na de lta bu rnams la yang dag par mthong ba'i dge sbyong gi tshul gyi 'bras bu gdags pa 'thob ༅lags sam/ rgyal po chen po de'i phyir khyod nyid la dri yis khyod kyis ji ltar bzod pa de bzhin du de lung ston cig /rgyal po chen po dper na 'di na khyod kyi bran mngag gzhug ⑦pa go re long rang dbang med la dudaga' mgur byar med pa zhig yod pa des khyod steng gi khang bzangs kyi gzhi la 'dug ste 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga 'byor cing ldan par gyur nas skyes pa med par rol mos rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang 'di snyam du sems te/ lus 'phags ma'i bu ma ga ṅgā'i rgyal po ma skyes dgra 'di yang mi yin la bdag kyang mi yin pa las gzhan du na lus 'phags ma'i bu ma ga ṅgā'i bu hum skyes dgras sngon bsod blu nams dag byas shing bsags pa des na da ltar steng gi khang bzangs kyi gzhi la 'dug nas skyes pa med pa'i rol mos rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed dga' mgur spyod par byed kyis/ ma la bdag gis kyang dge ba'i chos cung zad yang dag par blangs te gnas par bya'o snyam zhing bdag gis dge ba'i chos ci ⑩zhig yang dag par blangs te gnas par bya snyam pa las/ ma la bdag skra dang kha 8spu bregs te gos ngur smrig bgos nas dad pa yang dag pa kho nas khyim nas khyim med par rab 1—637

tu 'byung bar bya'o snyam nas des de ltar thag bcad ①de skra dang kha spu bregs nas gos ngur smrig khyabagos te dad pa ②yang dag pa kho nas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung nas des ji srid 'tsho'i ④bar du srog gcod ⑤pa spangs te srog gcod ⑥pa las slar log /ma byin par len pa dang / mi tshangs par spyod pa dang / brdzun medu smra ba dang / phra ma dang / tshig rtsub po dang / tshig kyal 0pa dang / brnab sems dang / gnod sems dang / log par lta ba spangs te log par lta ba las slar log par gyur pa de khyod kyi zho shas 'tsho ba rnams ljongs su 'khyam zhing yo)dong bas mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang de rnams 'di snyam du sems te/ 'di ni lus 'phags ma'i bu ma ga d+ma'i rgyal po ma skyes dgra'i 'bangs mngag gzhug pa go re long rang dbang med pa dga' mgur byar med pa yin na/ de skra dang kha spu bregs nas gos ngur smrig bgos te dad pa rtso ༷yang dag pa kho nar rtso1khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung nas skyode ji srid 'tsho'i bar du srog gcod skyepa spangs te/ srog gcod cipa las slar log ma byin par len pa dang / mi tshangs par spyod pa dang / brdzun du smra ba dang / phra ma dang / tshig rtsub nyunyepo dang / tshig kyal nyu9pa dang / brnab sems dang /gnod sems dang / log par lta ba maspangs te log 8par lta ba las slar log nas yang dag pa'i lta ba dang ldan gyis/ ma la bdag cag rgyal po'i spyan sngar dong la snyan du gsol lo zhes de rnams khyod kyi drung du 'ongs nas smras pa/ lha mkhyen par mdzad du gsol/ lha'i 'bangs mngag gzhug pa go re long rang dbang ma mchis pa dga' mgur bgyir ma mchis pa zhig mchis pa de skra dang kha spu bregs te gos ngur smrig bgos nas dad pa yang dag pa kho nas khyim nas khyim med 1—638

par rab tu byung nas des ji srid 'tsho'i bar du srog gcod ①pa spangs te srog gcod ②pa las slar log /ma byin par len pa dang / mi tshangs par ①spyod pa dang / brdzun du smra ba dang / phra ma dang / tshig rtsub po dang / tshig kyal ④pa dang / brnab sems dang / gnod sems dang / log par lta ba spangs te log par lta ba las slar lalog ste༅/ yang dag pa'i lta ba dang ldan lags so zhes smras ༅na/ rgyal po chen po de la ji snyam du sems/ ji ga khyod kyis de skad smra ba la shes ldan dag deng la mi de khug shig dudang slar yang nga'i bran mngag gzhug pa go re long ⑨rang dbang med par 'gyur ro zhes smra bar 'gyur ram/ btsun pa ma lags so/ /gzhan mdu na bdag de la lta ba'i slad du mchi ste/ des sngon bdag la mngon du smra ba dang / phyag 'tshal ba dang /ldang ba dang / thal mo sbyar ba dang / 'dud skyepa'i las gang lags pa bgyid 8lags pas de nyid la bdag gis de dag bgyi zhing / ji srid 'tsho'i skyobar du de la 'di lta ste chos gos dang / bsod lha ༷snyoms dang / gnas mal dang /nad kyi rkyen sman gyi yo byad rnams kyis bstab 8par bgyi'o/ /rgyal po chen po de ji snyam du sems/ de lta skyeyin na ngas yang dag par mthong ba'i dge sbyong gi tshul gyi 8'bras bu bstan pa ma 8yin nam/ btsun pa mad lags te/ de ltar sh+yan bcom ldan 'das kyis yang dag par mthong ba'i dge sbyong gi tshul gyi 'bras bu bstan lags so/ /rgyal po chen po dper na khyod kyi yul 'di na khyim bdag zhing pa skrun pa skyed pa rgyal zhu po'i bang mdzod 'phel bar 0byed pa zhig yod pa des khyod steng gi khang bzangs kyi gzhi la 'dug nas skyes pa med par rol mos rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed pa mthong ngo / /4—639

mthong nas kyang 'di snyam ① du sems ②te/ lus 'phags ma'i bu ma ga d+ma'i rgyal po ma skyes dgra 'di yang mi yin la/ bdag kyang mi yin pa las gzhan ②du na lus 'phags ma'i bu ma ga ṅgā'i rgyal po ma skyes dgra ⑤sngon bsod ⑤nams dag byas shing bsags ⑥pa des na da ltar steng gi khang bzangs kyi gzhir ⑦song nas skyes pa med pa'i rol mos rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed kyis/ ma la bdag gis kyang dge ba cung zad yang dag par blangs te gnas par bya'o ༅snyam zhing bdag gis dge ba'i chos ci zhig yang dag par blangs 0te gnas par bya snyam pa las/ ma la bdag skra dang kha spu ④bregs te mgos ngur smrig bgos nas dad pa yang dag pa kho nas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu 'byung bar bya'o snyam nas/ des de ltar thag bcad 8de skra dang kha spu bregs nas gos ngur smrig bgos te dad pa yang dag pa kho nas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung nas de 8ji srid 'tsho'i bar du srog gcod ༄pa spangs te srog gcod 8pa las slar log /ma byin par len pa dang / mi tshangs par spyod pa dang / brdzun skyadu smra ba dang / phra ma dang / tshig rtsub po chadang / tshig 8kyal skyepa dang / brnab sems dang / gnod sems dang / log par lta ba spangs te log par du lta ba las slar log par gyur pa de khyod kyi zho shas 'tsho ba rnams ljongs su 'khyam zhing dong bas mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang de dag 'di snyam du sems te/ 'di ni lus 'phags ma'i bu ma ga d+ma'i rgyal po ma skyes dgra'i khyim bdag zhing pa 0sgrun pa skyed pa'i 0( srebang mdzod 'phel bar byed pa yin na / de skra dang kha spu bregs nas gos ngur smrig bgos te dad pa yang dag pa kho nas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung nas/ de ji srid 'tsho'i ④bar du srog 4—640

gcod ①pa spangs te/ srog gcod ②pa las slar log /ma byin par len pa dang / mi tshangs par spyod pa dang / brdzun du smra ba dang / phra ma dang /tshig rtsub po dang / tshig kyal ①pa dang / brnab sems dang / gnod sems dang / log par lta ba spangs te/ log par lta ba las slar log nas yang dag pa'i lta ba dang ldan gyis/ ma la bdag cag rgyal po'i ༅spyan sngar dong la snyan du ⑤gsol lo zhes de rnams khyod kyi drung du 'ongs nas smras pa/ lha mkhyen par mdzad du gsol/ lha'i khyim bdag zhing pa skrun pa skyed ⑥pa rgyal po'i bang mdzod 'phel bar ⑦bgyid pa zhig mchis pa de skra dang kha spu bregs te gos ngur dusprig bgos nas dad pa yang dag pa kho nas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung nas de ji srid 'tsho'i rtsabar du srog gcod ⑩ pa spangs te/ srog gcod ༅pa las slar log /ma byin par len pa dang / mi tshangs par spyod pa dang / brdzun du smra ba dang / phra ma dang / tshig rtsub tsopo dang / tshig kyal 8pa dang / brnab sems dang / gnod sems dang / log par lta ba spangs te log par lta ba las slar log lku ste/ yang dag pa'i lta ba dang ldan lags so zhes smra na/ rgyal po chen po de la nyunyeji snyam du sems/ ji ga khyod kyis de skad smra ba la shes ldan dag deng la mi de khug shig tsodang slar yang nga'i zhing pa skrun pa skyed pa rgyal po'i bang mdzod ⑩'phel bar 'gyur ro 8zhes smra bar 'gyur ram/ btsun ༅pa ma lags so/ /gzhan du na bdag de la blta 0ba'i slad du mchi ste/ des sngon bdag la mngon du smra ba dang / phyag 'tshal ba dang / ldang ba dang / thal mo sbyar ba dang / 'dud pa'i las gang dag lags pa bgyis 0lags pas de nyid la bdag gis de dag bgyi zhing ji srid 4wa 641

'tsho'i bar du de la yang ①'di lta ste/ chos gos dang / bsod ②snyoms dang /gnas mal dang / nad kyi rkyen sman gyi yo byad rnams kyis bstab ②par bgyi'o/ /rgyal po chen po de khyoji snyam du sems/ de lta yin na ngas yang dag par mthong ba'i dge sbyong gi tshul gyi 'bras bu bstan pa ma yin nam/ btsun pa mad lags te / bcom ldan 'das kyis yang dag par mthong ba'i dge sbyong gi tshul gyi ⑤'bras bu bstan lags so/ /rgyal po chen po 'di la ston ⑥pa de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa / bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ba bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten du byung ste/ des chos bshad pa ni thog mar dge ba/ bar du dge ba/ tha mar dge ba/ don bzang po/ tshig 'bru bzang po ma 'dres pa yongs su rdzogs pa yongs su dag pa rnam par byang ba/ tshangs par spyod pa rab tu ston te/ chos de khyim bdag gam/ khyim bdag gi bus mnyan te/ de ⑦chos de thos nas gnas gsum po 'di lta ste/ chags pa'i chos dang / zhe sdang gi chos dang / gti mug gi chos la ston pa'i rnam par dag pa tshol bar byed de/ci tshe dang ldan pa 'di la duchags pa gang gis khyazil gyis gnon rju cing sems la khyab na mi shes bzhin kho nar shes so zhes smra/ ma mthong bzhin kho nar mthong ngo zhes smra zhing gzhan dag la yang gang de dag la yun ring por gnod pa dang /phan pa ma yin pa dang / sdug bsngal bar 'gyur ba de lta de ltar ston pa'i chags pa ma spangs pa dang / yongs su ma shes pa dang / ma bkag ⑩pa dang /ma bsal tsoba'i chags pa de yod dam/ 'on te tshe dang ldan pa 'di la chags pa 4—642

gang gis ①zil gyis non ②cing sems la khyab na mi shes bzhin kho nar shes so zhes smra/ ma mthong bzhin kho nar mthong ngo zhes smra zhing gzhan dag la yang gang de dag la yun ring por gnod pa dang / phan pa ma yin pa dang / sdug bsngal bar 'gyur ba de lta de ltar ston pa'i chags pa ma spangs pa dang / yongs su ma shes pa dang / ma bkag pa dang / ma bsal ②ba'i chags pa de med snyam na/ de 'di snyam du sems te/ tshe dang ldan pa 'di la chags pa gang gis byazil gyis ④non cing sems la khyab na mi shes bzhin kho nar shes so zhes smra/ma mthong bzhin kho nar mthong ngo zhes smra zhing gzhan dag la yang gang de dag la yun ring por gnod pa dang / phan pa ma ༅yin pa dang / sdug bsngal bar 'gyur ba de lta de ltar ston pa'i chags pa ma spangs pa dang / yongs su ma shes pa dang / ma bkag pa dang / ma bsal thoba'i chags pa de dumed dope/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ ma chags pa'i lus kyi 'du byed dang / ngag gi 'du byed dang / yid kyi 'du byed gang dag yin pa de dag tshe dang ldan pa 'di la yod la/'di chos gang mdor bsdus hu pa'am/ rgyas par 'chad kyang rung 'di'i chos ni zhi ba gya rnam pa/ zab pa zab par snang ba/ mthong bar dka' ba/rtogs ⑩par 8dka' ba/ brtag skyepar bya ba ma yin pa/ rtog ge'i spyod yul ma yin pa/ zhib rtsomo brtags 8pa'i mkhas pa dang mdzangs skyepas rig par ⑩bya ba 8yin na/ de yang 'di ltar tshe dang ldan pa 'di gcig ༅tu chags pas zhu shes par sla ba ma yin pas tshe dang ldan pa 'di ma chags pa yin te/ tshe dang ldan pa 'di ni chags pa ma yin no snyam mo/ /gang gi tshe 'di dang po chags pa'i chos la rnam par dag par mthong nas de'i 'og tu gnyis pa zhe sdang gi chos dang /1—643

gsum pa gti mug gi chos la ①tshol bar byed de/ ci tshe dang ldan pa 'di la gti mug gang gis zil gyis ②rnan cing sems la khyab na mi shes bzhin kho nar shes so zhes smra/ ma mthong bzhin kho nar mthong ngo zhes smra zhing gzhan dag la yang gang de dag la yun ring por gnod pa dang / phan pa ma yin pa dang /sdug bsngal bar 'gyur ba de lta de ltar ston pa'i gti mug ma spangs pa dang /yongs su ma shes pa dang / ma bkag pa dang / ma 0bsal ba'i gti mug de yod dam/ 'on te tshe dang ldan pa 'di la gti mug ④gang gis ①zil gyis ༅non cing sems la khyab na ⑦mi shes bzhin kho nar shes so zhes smra/ ma mthong bzhin kho nar mthong ngo zhes smra zhing gzhan dag la yang gang dag dude dag la yun ring por gnod pa dang / phan pa ma yin pa dang / sdug bsngal bar gyur pa ⑨de lta de ltar ston pa'i gti mug ma spangs pa dang / yongs su ma shes pa dang /ma bkag pa dang / ma bsal ba'i gti mug de med snyam na/ de 'di snyam du ⑩sems te/ tshe dang ldan pa 'di la hugati mug gang gis zil gyis /3non cing sems la khyab na mi shes bzhin kho nar shes so zhes smra/ ma mthong bzhin kho nar mthong ngo zhes smra zhing gzhan dag la yang gang dag nyu)de dag la yun ring por gnod pa dang / phan pa ma yin pa dang / sdug bsngal bar 'gyur ba de bolta de/ ltar ston pa'i gti mug ma 8spangs pa dang / yongs su ma shes pa dang / ma bkag pa dang / ma bsal ba'i gti mug de med do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe tson/gti mug med pa'i lus kyi 'du byed dang / ngag gi 'du byed dang / yid kyi 'du byed gang dag yin pa de dag tshe dang ldan pa 'di la yod la/ 'di chos gang mdor bsdus ༅pa'am/ rgyas par 'chad kyang rung / 'di'i chos ni zhi ba/1—644

gya rnam pa/ zab pa zab par snang ba/ mthong bar dka' ba/ rtogs par dka' ba/ brtag par bya ba ma yin pa/ rtog ge'i spyod yul ma yin pa/zhib mo ①brtags pa'i mkhas pa dang mdzangs ②pas rig par bya ba yin na/ de yang 'di ltar tshe dang ldan pa 'di gcig pu ②gti mug pas ni shes par sla ba ma yin pas tshe dang ldan pa 'di ④gti mug pa ma yin te/ tshe dang ldan pa 'di ni gti mug med pa yin no snyam mo/ /gang gi 0tshe 'di gsum pa yigati mug gi ⑦chos la rnam par dag par mthong nas de'i 'og tu 'di la rnam pa dang ldan pa'i dad pa skyed par byed do/ /dad pa skyes nas 'di ltar slob par byed de/khyim na gnas pa ni gnod pa can dang ⑧/ rdul ༅khrod na gnas pa yin la/rab tu byung ba ni mngon par skabs yod pa yin te/⑩ khyim pa skyokhyim na gnas pas ni ji srid 'tsho'i bar du gcig tu sal 8gyis dag par tshangs par spyod pa yongs su rdzogs pa/ yongs su dag pa rnam par byang ba 'ba' zhig po 'di la spyad 8par sla ba ma yin pas/ ma la bdag skra dang kha spu bregs te gos ngur smrig bgos nas dad pa yang dag pa kho nas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu 'byung ④bar bya'o snyam ste/ des de ltar thag bcad nas nor gyi tshogs mang po'am/nyung ngu spangs te nye du'i 'khor mang po'am nyung ngu spangs nas 8spa dang kha spu bregs te gos ngur smrig bgos nas dad pa yang dag pa kho nas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ngo / /de de bzhin du rab tu byung nas de tshul khrims dang ldan pa la gnas pa yin/ so sor thar pa'i sdom pas bsdams pa yin/ spyod pa dang / spyod yul phun sum tshogs pa yin/ tha na ⑩kha na ma tho ba phra mo la yang ⑩'jigs par lta ba yin/ bslab pa'i gzhi rnams blangs te 8slob pa yin 4wa 645

no / /de srog gcod ①pa spangs nas srog gcod ②pa las slar log pa yin te/chad pa spangs pa yin/ mtshon cha spangs pa yin/ 'dzem ①pa dang / snying rjer thuldan pa yin/ sems can srog chags su gyur pa thams cad la chung ngu na srog chags grog spur yan chad srog gcod ⑤pa las slar log pa yin no/ /de ma byin par len pa spangs nas ma byin par len pa las slar log pa yin te/ byin pa len pa yin/ byin pa la dga' ba yin byin pa lhug par btang rtsib la dga' ba yin te/ rkun ma ma yin/ brkam ༅chags ma yin/ gtsang ma yin/dag pa yin/ bdag nyid kha na dum tho ba med par srung zhing ma byin par len pa las slar log pa yin no/ /de mi tshangs par spyod pa spangs nas mi tshangs par spyod pa las slar log pa yin te/ mtshangs par spyod pa rtsoyin/ spyod pa ngan pa spangs pas dag pa yin/ gtsang ba yin/ dri nga ba med pa yin/'khrig pa dang bral ba yin/ smad rim gyi chos dang bral ba yin/skye mi tshangs par spyod pa las slar log pa yin no/ /de brdzun du smra ba spangs nas brdzun du smra ba las slar log pa yin te/ bden par smra ba yin bden pa skyol dga' ba yin / mnyan par 'os pa yin/ yid ches pa yin/ brtan rtso)pa yin/'jig rten la mi bslu 6ba yin te/ brdzun skyedu smra ba las slar log pa yin no/ /de phra ma'i tshig spangs nas phra ma las slar log pa yin te/ de tshu bi dag las thos te de dag dbye ba'i phyir pha bi dag la smra ba ma yin/ pha bi dag las thos te de dag dbye ba'i phyir tshu 2bi dag la smra ba ma yin/ bye ba rnams sdums byed pa yinas / mthun pa rnams la gzengs 8bstod pa yin/ mthun pa la dga' ba yin / mthun pa la mgu ba yin/ mthun par ༅byed pa'i tshig smra ba yin te/1—646
